f7d35db5a5e064e98c9f12739e68f1583ced9c5d.title: GLM 5.3 Flash quota switches to session starts
f7d35db5a5e064e98c9f12739e68f1583ced9c5d.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash quota caps at 2 starts per day instead of 2 fractional sessions. The `countsAdmissions` flag on `FreebuffSessionRateLimit` drives the `starts` vs `used` label in `formatFreebuffRowQuota`. Shared premium allowance still charges partial time rounded up to a tenth. Updates `FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE` and CLI README.

9188c032117f7f2326e7bec8afb0a1bc62c33c1a.title: ad-experiment request sampling
9188c032117f7f2326e7bec8afb0a1bc62c33c1a.summary: First-party routing switches from per-user to per-request sampling via new optional sampleId parameter in firstPartyAdRouteForUser. Shared firstPartyPrimaryBucket function maps server-minted sample IDs to 10,000-bucket space, ensuring route gate and campaign allocator align. Fallback to userId preserves deterministic behavior for legacy callers and tests. Covers common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts.

ed224f5a8768b78f3333974446054d71497e4419.title: CLI release version bump to 0.0.157
ed224f5a8768b78f3333974446054d71497e4419.summary: Version updated from 0.0.156 to 0.0.157 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Routine release increment for CLI packaging.

cb53f476e75fa8151b31fc9ae263d0aa59281d5d.title: Add cancellation reason constants and beta rate lock multiplier
cb53f476e75fa8151b31fc9ae263d0aa59281d5d.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CANCELLATION_REASONS` with five fixed ids and `isFreebuffCancellationReason` validator to standardize offboarding data. Defined `FREEBUFF_BETA_RATE_LOCK_MULTIPLIER` as 3 to express beta pricing loss without inventing future dollar figures. Changes isolated to `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts`. Server validates against these ids to prevent uncountable free-text responses.

9066513a775a950c3c5f620141e41cd8ebfc76b3.title: Add Desktop idle session release
9066513a775a950c3c5f620141e41cd8ebfc76b3.summary: Introduced FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS (10 min) in freebuff-models.ts to release Desktop tabs holding idle sessions. Prevents single-slot lockups on limited tiers when no turn is active. Server refunds unused time via buildAdmitStampStatement, re-admitting next send on same instance. Only active turns reset clock; scrolling/typing ignored.

9043277365c41dd3d8c20f4d192b64d879823dce.title: ADCOMMENTWRITINGRULES replaces generated suggestions
9043277365c41dd3d8c20f4d192b64d879823dce.summary: AD_COMMENT_WRITING_RULES and AD_DEFAULT_COMMENT_GUIDANCE replace the previous AD_GENERATED_COMMENT_COUNT constant. The change shifts from providing multiple AI-generated comment options to enforcing manual, original writing to avoid repetitive bot-like output. AD_GENERATED_COMMENT_COUNT is marked @deprecated but retained for backward compatibility with older rows and tests. Scope includes common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts.

c359f63c20bbc0f7d23fb950af7764257b6ec274.title: UTC fallback for model unavailable times
c359f63c20bbc0f7d23fb950af7764257b6ec274.summary: Server-side `freebuffModelUnavailableWindow` now defaults to UTC via `FALLBACK_WINDOW_TIME_ZONE` and appends explicit zone labels using `formatWindowTimeZoneLabel`. This prevents ambiguous local-time rendering on remote CLI boxes or server containers where the runtime zone differs from the reader's. The `model_unavailable` response type adds an optional `availableAt` ISO string, allowing clients to compute local times while retaining `availableHours` as a UTC-anchored fallback for older servers.

b3e1d17c5a89e05ad7692f0dd70466a97851a3c7.title: Add exception budget to PostHog clients
b3e1d17c5a89e05ad7692f0dd70466a97851a3c7.summary: Added `createExceptionBeforeSend` filter to `createPostHogClient` in `common/src/analytics-core.ts`. New `common/src/util/exception-budget.ts` implements a geometric ladder to cap repeated exceptions per process. This prevents billing spikes from retry loops (e.g., 1M+ exceptions in one day) while preserving first sightings of distinct errors. Scope covers CLI, Desktop, and server via shared core.

1d9a61e734810b53404ced16489971b33109725e.title: Enforce DeepSeek V4 Pro paywall on Freebuff Web
1d9a61e734810b53404ced16489971b33109725e.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro added to FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_PRO_MODEL_IDS, enforcing paid access exclusively on Freebuff Web via server-side key validation. Desktop and CLI retain free access to prevent breaking legacy clients. The row closes during DeepSeek peak windows using isFreebuffWebProClosedNow to avoid doubled upstream costs, with open windows labeled by freebuffWebProOpenWindowLabel.

bd5c18ff73257a748a3bd0e402e25af4c012649f.title: Paid plans reach limited regions; GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4
bd5c18ff73257a748a3bd0e402e25af4c012649f.summary: Added `hasPaidSubscription` to `isFreebuffSessionModelAllowedForAccessTier` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, allowing paid accounts in limited regions to access subscription-metered models like GLM 5.3 Flash. This fixes a logic gap where limited-region subscribers paid for plans but received no access to the models those plans meter. The change is scoped to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts`, with GLM 5.3 Flash replacing DeepSeek V4 Pro in the subscription model set. Subscription quotas were resized sub-linearly (Starter 4/day to 3/day, Plus 12/day to 7/day) to prevent the Plus plan from being a pure linear buy over three Starters.

28d0514641dc8804ec29db0727c13bb9f2bc2ca1.title: Subscription sessions add to base instead of replacing
28d0514641dc8804ec29db0727c13bb9f2bc2ca1.summary: Subscription sessions now top up the free base pool rather than replacing it. A row showing '5 base + 4 subscription' yields a total limit of 9. Quota-exempt accounts (god/admin) now report free pool figures to maintain consistency with combined rate limits. The `rateLimitsByModel` rows derive from this single memoized read, ensuring panel and picker headers agree.

e30c58d37ea03426da0f01a727c5acff3895a462.title: Add withdrawn flag to free session admission response
e30c58d37ea03426da0f01a727c5acff3895a462.summary: Added `withdrawn` boolean to `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` and `freebuffWithdrawnModelAvailabilityLabel` to constants. Admission now sets this flag for models in `FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS` to distinguish permanent withdrawal from hourly limits, preventing wasted session units. CLI `use-freebuff-session.ts` renders a system message on `withdrawn` picks; older clients rely on `availableHours` prose. `resolveFreebuffSessionModelForAccessTier` comments clarify that withdrawn models are refused at admission, not silently coerced.

9f0de8454bcac2ea8898d1f6592c488da4942f7b.title: Imprezia ad url field set to empty string
9f0de8454bcac2ea8898d1f6592c488da4942f7b.summary: Changed `imprezia-ad.ts` to set `url` to `''` instead of `ad.clickUrl`. Imprezia lacks advertiser domains, so renderers omit destination names. Clicks continue routing through `clickUrl`. Scope limited to `common/src/util/imprezia-ad.ts`.

b11ec75a04ede2ef903e89bbe41fb5080514e102.title: Add freeDayUsed and freeDayLimit to subscription usage
b11ec75a04ede2ef903e89bbe41fb5080514e102.summary: Added `freeDayUsed` and `freeDayLimit` to `FreebuffSubscriptionUsage` in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. This exposes the caller's free premium-session pool for today, which clients cannot derive from `rateLimitsByModel` because it carries only the next-charged pool row, preventing double-counting once the free pool is exhausted. Both fields are optional, zero for quota-exempt accounts, and absent on older servers.

72f1310353bddeacfee88d760a6193527ff69dd2.title: Luna/Pro sub-cap lifted on Starter and Pro tiers
72f1310353bddeacfee88d760a6193527ff69dd2.summary: dailyPremiumSessions raised to match dailySessions (4 and 12) for Starter and Pro tiers in common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts. Field retained to preserve wire shape and enforcement logic, allowing cap reinstatement via config change. Disclaimer generation updated to conditionally emit the sub-cap warning only when dailyPremiumSessions < dailySessions. This removes the misleading restriction text from the UI while keeping the underlying model routing constraints active.

b42492330322ad9c82caf4620c05e4ab36d661d4.title: Disable nodemodules caching on Linux CI jobs
b42492330322ad9c82caf4620c05e4ab36d661d4.summary: Dependency caching disabled for Linux CI jobs in `docs/testing.md` after cold `bun install` proved 7-8s faster per job than warm cache restores on Ubicloud runners. This change applies to `setup-project` and standalone Ubicloud workflows, while Windows and macOS caches remain active pending similar measurements. Small caches for `sdk/dist`, Next.js builds, and the Bun runtime are retained due to favorable transfer-to-compute ratios.

907cda721501e4f656b82ef0bf61e19af07926ef.title: CLI session hook preserves subscription data
907cda721501e4f656b82ef0bf61e19af07926ef.summary: CLI session hook and API utils now preserve subscription info across session state transitions and compact polls. Prevents plan panel flickering during picker transitions and post-session banners by carrying data like rate limits. Covers CLI hooks, API utils, and shared types in common/src/types.

15ebdcb20344b1faa17ff5345846ba1241d3e664.title: CLI think tag parser fixes orphan close tags and block merging
15ebdcb20344b1faa17ff5345846ba1241d3e664.summary: Refactored `think-tag-parser.ts` to handle orphan `</think>` tags by pushing preceding text as thinking segments. `block-operations.ts` simplified `appendTextWithThinkParsingToBlocks` by merging last block content with new text before checking for think tags, replacing complex partial tag logic. This ensures correct block splitting when think tags span multiple text chunks. No user-facing command changes.

ec01bf10020d29d13062f0218f3176e5a0e3f4b0.title: Add daily and total budget spend states to not serving reasons
ec01bf10020d29d13062f0218f3176e5a0e3f4b0.summary: Added `daily_cap_spent` and `total_budget_spent` to `NOT_SERVING_REASONS` and `NOT_SERVING_COPY` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`. These states match `ineligibleReason` values from the serve path to prevent console UI disparities where a campaign shows a serving dot despite being refused a fill. The copy explicitly differentiates the temporary daily cap (resuming at midnight PT) from the permanent total budget exhaustion. Scope limited to shared core constants.

10218ba5aa9794a3327524cc1922daa9f3e39ce1.title: Add model availability window and pro-only gating predicates
10218ba5aa9794a3327524cc1922daa9f3e39ce1.summary: New `getFreebuffModelAvailabilityWindowLabel` and `formatDeepSeekOffPeakWindowLocal` expose open windows for time-gated models in local time. `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_PRO_MODEL_IDS` and `isFreebuffSubscriptionProModelId` gate subscriber-only access, currently empty. `getFreebuffPlanPauseWindowLabel` distinguishes plan pauses from model unavailability. `requiresSubscription` added to session responses to signal upgrade-fixable refusals.

4a41787b377f56263a296bc5a8458ad2707aafae.title: First-party ad view ack with placement ordering
4a41787b377f56263a296bc5a8458ad2707aafae.summary: Adds first-party ad view acknowledgement transport in common/src/ads/first-party-view-ack.ts with retry logic and deduplication. ChoiceAdBanner now orders ads by canonical placement IDs via orderedRequestedAds, preserving request order and preventing duplicate slot mounts. Scope covers CLI ad-banner.tsx, freebuff-landing-screen.tsx, use-gravity-ad.ts, and new common/ads modules. First-party provider uses resilient view ack (3 attempts, 2s timeout, 10s ceiling); third-party providers retain legacy pixel path.

54790e3a6614fea67d6dabd01fd367fabb684dc8.title: Add allowlisted reposnapshot telemetry column
54790e3a6614fea67d6dabd01fd367fabb684dc8.summary: New `repo_snapshot` column added to `ChatCompletionTraceRow` and populated in `sdk/src/run.ts` via `toRepoSnapshot` projection. Explicit allowlist in `common/src/util/file.ts` restricts telemetry to aggregate scalars, preventing legacy `gitChanges` fields like `status` and `diff` from leaking raw patch content. `REPO_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS` excludes branch names and file paths, enforcing contract compliance for repository scale metrics. Empty or undefined snapshots return `undefined` rather than null rows to distinguish unmeasured states.

c5e4bf5459e0119e774dbda81d74d89d580f6c6f.title: Update freebuff tier change notice text
c5e4bf5459e0119e774dbda81d74d89d580f6c6f.summary: Updated the `FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE` constant in `common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts` to reflect current model availability and quota status. The new text removes the specific V4 Pro/V4 Flash provider recovery message and announces the removal of per-model caps, noting MiMo and DeepSeek V4 Flash remain unmetered. This change affects the shared core utility module used by Web, CLI, and Desktop surfaces. The notice is a static string constant exported for UI consumption.

7a65d914646cc0f2883efcbc94971198e8064c16.title: Fix model unavailable window quoting
7a65d914646cc0f2883efcbc94971198e8064c16.summary: Added freebuffModelUnavailableWindow to derive refusal message from model availability. Fixes off_peak_only models quoting staffing hours instead of DeepSeek peak window return. Uses formatDeepSeekExpensiveWindowReturn for local time phrasing.

a733b317c1e05ace5fe868e3d4f52d300dbd018c.title: GLM 5.2 daily session cap restored to 1
a733b317c1e05ace5fe868e3d4f52d300dbd018c.summary: A hard cap of 1 session per day was reinstated for GLM 5.2 via the new `FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_MAX_DAILY_SESSIONS` constant, replacing the uncapped referral system active since 2026-07-30. This prevents referral farming from converting directly into excessive paid hours by limiting the total daily pool, including streaks and bounties. The CLI referral banner (`freebuff-referral-banner.tsx`) now detects this cap and suppresses "+1/day" promises when `qualifiedCount` hits the limit. The `qualifiedCount` field in `freebuff-session.ts` is explicitly clamped server-side to match this new ceiling.

4e45c27aa823ee8d4a0abe9d493d85479e030149.title: Add fusioncode spend provider, update tier change notice
4e45c27aa823ee8d4a0abe9d493d85479e030149.summary: Added `fusioncode` to `SPEND_PROVIDER_IDS` in `spend-providers.ts` as a capped Flash front lane. Updated `FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE` in `freebuff-model-availability.ts` to inform users that V4 Pro is temporarily served by V4 Flash during provider recovery, removing the previous mention of MiMo/DeepSeek V4 Flash being unmetered. Scope covers shared core constants and utility strings.

fbda78872046ff7f2223c83c8093d1d1f9237dca.title: Ignore local ads-pilot-launch manifests
fbda78872046ff7f2223c83c8093d1d1f9237dca.summary: Added `ads-pilot-launch.local.json` to `.gitignore`. Prevents accidental commit of real advertiser identifiers. Scope: repository hygiene.

8238d829cad6ce2b95694de923e6e58c9a240e5d.title: Add monthlySpendLimitUsd to subscription tiers
8238d829cad6ce2b95694de923e6e58c9a240e5d.summary: Added `monthlySpendLimitUsd` to `FreebuffSubscriptionTier` and related types. This field sets a provider-spend ceiling per billing period, distinct from session count caps. The change addresses cost divergence where sessions vary significantly in provider price by model. Scope covers `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts` and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`.

ed41bbe6cce57a22a3d03f3a69848063615c385c.title: Clarify Imprezia platformString docs in client
ed41bbe6cce57a22a3d03f3a69848063615c385c.summary: Updated JSDoc for `platformString` in `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`. Replaced misleading comment claiming it names the surface with accurate description: it represents the Imprezia platform family, while product attribution resides in `surface`. Ensures correct interpretation of the field for shared core clients.

81dc44a30b2de783596bce9e6c8192a674be6a23.title: Add billing mode and settlement flags to axiom-only-log
81dc44a30b2de783596bce9e6c8192a674be6a23.summary: Adds first_party_billing_mode and external_settlement_enabled to ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS in common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts. These fields represent effective runtime money gates, emitted as bounded configuration state rather than campaign pricing or advertiser identifiers. The change ensures accurate logging of external settlement capabilities within the shared core utilities.

cb3ea78eda6ea14b43bc1624d0e854fdd9a898d0.title: GitHub ad platform star action and screenshot-only attestation
cb3ea78eda6ea14b43bc1624d0e854fdd9a898d0.summary: GitHub added to AD_PLATFORMS in common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts. platformRequiresComment predicate skips comment logic for GitHub since stars require no text. ad-comment-url.ts enforces screenshot-only attestation with explicit GitHub branch. LinkedIn host allowlist extended with lnkd.in shortener.

75d33f9429a93c53c7c2f5b5dac73adc3a832d32.title: Bump freebuff CLI version to 0.0.156
75d33f9429a93c53c7c2f5b5dac73adc3a832d32.summary: Version bumped from 0.0.155 to 0.0.156 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Ensures release consistency. No functional changes.

99c8777e213d27579525e378d569d3e430d7b1e6.title: Fix Imprezia sandbox key log spam
99c8777e213d27579525e378d569d3e430d7b1e6.summary: Imprezia sandbox key refusal now logs once per process, then downgrades to debug. Previous behavior caused 1M+ error rows daily, consuming 70% of Axiom error ingest and burying real errors. Change applies to common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts via sandboxRefusalLogged state flag.

a4d50e7363432ab28c574b022a0b2fc76de0ab2a.title: Add first-party click and impression tracking events
a4d50e7363432ab28c574b022a0b2fc76de0ab2a.summary: Added `ADS_FIRST_PARTY_CLICK_RECORDED_EVENT` and `ADS_FIRST_PARTY_IMPRESSION_RECORDED_EVENT` to `axiom-only-log.ts`. Introduced `ADS_FIRST_PARTY_TRACKING_FIELDS` schema to allowlist specific metadata like `provider`, `surface`, and `pixel_count`. Updated `AxiomOnlyLogEvent` union and `getAxiomOnlyLogEvent` switch to sanitize and return these new events.

dc2947f208c695a64f1781053d8afe1a3968a40a.title: Preserve OpenRouter error details in stream chunks
dc2947f208c695a64f1781053d8afe1a3968a40a.summary: Mid-stream OpenRouter errors now convert to `APICallError` objects carrying full provider details instead of generic messages. The `openaiCompatibleErrorDataSchema` adds a loose `metadata` field to capture upstream reasons from `metadata.raw` that were previously discarded. `streamErrorChunkToApiCallError` in `packages/llm-providers/src/openai-compatible/openai-compatible-error.ts` reconstructs the error to match server-side `buildEnhancedErrorMessage` behavior, ensuring clients see specific failure causes rather than 'Agent run error' prefixes.

8d2fe1d276001824281f633df332852e67e82564.title: Block 5 disposable email domains via honeypot probing
8d2fe1d276001824281f633df332852e67e82564.summary: Adds gmaoiil.com, duojumbo.online, duojumbo.com, itesun.com, and geusil.com to DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS in common/src/util/disposable-email.ts. Qualification relies on honeypot probing rates (22-52%) rather than account volume, distinguishing these from benign baselines like gmail.com (0%) and outlook.com (5%). gieemel.com and bekri.site were explicitly excluded due to zero or low probing activity despite similar ban rates.

0b60b7df7979a111f67629386bd2a64f36885060.title: Git context shifts from raw diffs to structured repository summaries
0b60b7df7979a111f67629386bd2a64f36885060.summary: Replaced raw git status/diff strings with structured metadata fields like branch, contributor counts, and commit percentiles. This change prevents out-of-memory errors caused by buffering huge working trees and caps path listings at 25 files. The update affects `agents/base3.ts`, `common/src/util/file.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`, and `sdk/src/run-state.ts`. Legacy fields remain optional in schemas to ensure stored run states from older clients parse correctly.

8953a389fa9deb1c8cb479d483b24327a2c38cb7.title: Add tracked link placement grain and first-party cohort logging fields
8953a389fa9deb1c8cb479d483b24327a2c38cb7.summary: Adds `TRACKED_LINK_PLACEMENT_ID` and `placementSlotLabel` to handle reporting grains outside the buyable `PLACEMENT_SLOTS` catalog, preventing `undefined` labels for external clicks. Normalizes primary allocation percentages to 10,000-bucket basis points via `firstPartyPrimaryBasisPoints` to ensure routing and campaign selection use identical precision. Extends Axiom logging with `first_party_primary_cohort`, `first_party_served_cohort`, and `primary_allocation_invalid` fields to distinguish deliberate control groups from missing data. Updates `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`, `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts`, and `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`.

ed27ce1cf3e461105e209dcd13d8e5e22219331f.title: Add ads.externalconversionpostback axiom log event
ed27ce1cf3e461105e209dcd13d8e5e22219331f.summary: Added `ads.external_conversion_postback` event to `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. Defines an allowlist of operational fields (`outcome`, `rejection_reason`, `charged_cents`, etc.) to ensure the stream remains safe to aggregate without leaking partner credentials or opaque identifiers. This prevents the log from growing into an attribution/debugging record, as the database handles drill-down. Scope limited to core logging constants and sanitization logic.

e3a285c926ba174296495a785ca36ed7ea44aad8.title: useEvent hook generic signature tightened
e3a285c926ba174296495a785ca36ed7ea44aad8.summary: The `useEvent` hook in `cli/src/hooks/use-event.ts` replaces the `any[]` based generic constraint with explicit `TArgs` and `TReturn` type parameters. This change eliminates the need for unsafe type assertions on the returned callback. The modification is internal to the CLI's React hooks, affecting only type inference for consumers of `useEvent`.

115a6a5cc676b1a4969d2045ad34ebb5d8bd00ab.title: Onboarding accepts partial submissions
115a6a5cc676b1a4969d2045ad34ebb5d8bd00ab.summary: validateOnboardingSubmission now treats empty optionIds as skipped questions, not errors. Only entirely empty submissions are refused. This prevents 400s on partial answers in common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding.ts.

116f691de944ce3ef91a7e628964eba0b4e6c10d.title: Remove per-model daily caps in README
116f691de944ce3ef91a7e628964eba0b4e6c10d.summary: Documentation updated to reflect removal of per-model daily session limits. Models now share the normal daily session pool; MiMo 2.5 and Ox Alpha remain unmetered. Changes applied to README.md, README.zh-CN.md, and freebuff/cli/release/README.md.

989208414f3649ca01ab3b87500917770ddcf204.title: Add gravityoutcome to axiom-only-log
989208414f3649ca01ab3b87500917770ddcf204.summary: Added `gravity_outcome` field to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. This field records whether the preceding Gravity attempt filled, no-filled, or failed. It enables observability of recovered no-fill inventory without exposing campaign or creative identity data.

061b2465fb339069a9a7b09081c6125a5919a574.title: GPT-5.6 Luna replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash as CLI default
061b2465fb339069a9a7b09081c6125a5919a574.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna is the new default model in full mode, replacing DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 in the CLI picker. DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro now carry a peak-hours pause, enforced via `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_PEAK_PAUSED_MODEL_IDS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts`. Subscription types in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` add `downgrade` and `pendingTierId` fields to handle scheduled tier reductions at renewal. Documentation updates in READMEs reflect the new default and pause constraints.

836022e5e8a479b8330a80261070e80b636da639.title: Decouple Desktop concurrency bucket from premium quota list
836022e5e8a479b8330a80261070e80b636da639.summary: FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_PREMIUM_BUCKET_MODEL_IDS now explicitly lists GPT-5.6 Luna, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and GLM 5.2 instead of deriving from FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS. This split prevents quota metering changes from silently capping concurrent tabs, fixing an issue where adding Flash to the quota list restricted the default model to one session. The change applies to shared core constants in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. A new constraint notes that metered models cannot yet be multi-tab due to potential admit stamp collisions in buildAdmitStampStatement.

01b15151126e71919675bb0ab8972e1720377b12.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash closed at peak, default moved to GPT-5.6 Luna
01b15151126e71919675bb0ab8972e1720377b12.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash availability set to off_peak_only with fallback to GPT-5.6 Luna. Default model constants updated to Luna. Scope limited to common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Luna cost is 2.11x cheaper than Flash at peak.

467ba64dca85ea541f5c3db0d34bbf024ccccf92.title: Add surface field to ImpreziaChatAdRequest type
467ba64dca85ea541f5c3db0d34bbf024ccccf92.summary: Added `surface` field to `ImpreziaChatAdRequest` type in `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`. Field accepts 'desktop' | 'cli' | 'cloud' | 'web' | 'chat' | 'mobile'. Existing `sourceUrl` field retains its doc comment clarifying it names calling surface, not OS.

8bf398cd72689f7ca4bea6eb14ad7a7b162763ee.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash unmetered in full-access pool
8bf398cd72689f7ca4bea6eb14ad7a7b162763ee.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash reverted to unlimited status in the full-access pool, removing its entry from FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS and clearing the 2026-08-18 metering flag. The change relies on the cheaper Luminal lane absorbing traffic (43/80 pins) rather than the shared daily premium quota. Scope covers common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts, with the tier notice updated to list Flash alongside MiMo as unmetered. Limited tier users remain unaffected as they read LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS, and callers must pass premiumExhausted to ensure fallback logic correctly routes to FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID when the hero model's quota depletes.

7e9bd8cdb6cb73fb329d494669361e7226a17ed0.title: Ad creative sanitizer expands escape and ignorable stripping
7e9bd8cdb6cb73fb329d494669361e7226a17ed0.summary: sanitizeAdText in common/src/util/ad-creative-safety.ts now strips C1 control characters and a comprehensive Unicode Default_Ignorable_Code_Point set. Replaces narrow BIDI_OVERRIDE and INVISIBLE regexes with a single explicit DEFAULT_IGNORABLE pattern covering Unicode 16 properties, including variation selectors and tag characters. CSI and OSC regexes updated to match 8-bit escape sequences (, ) alongside standard ESC-prefixed forms. Deterministic across Bun and browser runtimes without relying on runtime Unicode tables.

ee79648a9e2aff11d54250c2dd488709b9fb3626.title: GPT-5.6 Luna session cap raised to 3
ee79648a9e2aff11d54250c2dd488709b9fb3626.summary: FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_CAPS increases the GPT-5.6 Luna limit from 2 to 3 daily sessions. The corresponding FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE string in freebuff-model-availability.ts is updated to reflect the new quota. This change applies to the shared core constants and availability notices used across all surfaces. The 'luna' pool configuration remains unchanged.

1bbdc9e90d4becb32401d13293d9cbd7c9a5841c.title: Add impreziaforced ad experiment arm
1bbdc9e90d4becb32401d13293d9cbd7c9a5841c.summary: Added `imprezia_forced` arm to `AdExperimentArm` type and `adExperimentArmForUser` function. Implements `isImpreziaAudienceEmail` to check for `@imprezia.ai` domain or specific test email, routing these users deterministically to the new arm. Scope limited to `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts`. Function now accepts optional `userEmail` parameter to enable this check before standard hash-based bucketing.

d9e94b083c24c9e1fa9655b0e55f5cdfc6506865.title: Remove GPT-5.6 Luna session cap
d9e94b083c24c9e1fa9655b0e55f5cdfc6506865.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna is uncapped, joining Pro and Flash on the shared daily pool. The previous 3-session limit was based on inverted pricing data; Luna is now cheaper per session than the uncapped rows. The `FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_CAPS` table is retained but emptied to preserve the cost-lever mechanism. `FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE` updated to reflect no per-model caps.

79ca37b5008dc6dfe804a8b7bb002be7d4435abf.title: CLI refactor: time format alias and block helper logic
79ca37b5008dc6dfe804a8b7bb002be7d4435abf.summary: Refactored `formatResetTime` in `cli/src/utils/time-format.ts` to act as a typed alias for `formatResetTimeLong`, narrowing the parameter to `Date | null` while the underlying implementation accepts `Date | string | null`. Updated `cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts` to replace `else if` chains with early returns and `continue` statements in `checkBlockIsUnderParent`, `extractBlockById`, and `updateToolBlockWithOutput`. The `updateToolBlockWithOutput` logic now explicitly checks for `run_terminal_command` tool names to parse stdout/stderr before falling back to generic formatting.

4140a604bcff8120f0e60c1cd20258bdbb9e6cd0.title: Fix quota display for exempt accounts
4140a604bcff8120f0e60c1cd20258bdbb9e6cd0.summary: Removed static fallback for premium session limit in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`. Quota counter now hides entirely when no server snapshot exists, preventing misleading '0 of 4' text for exempt users. Logic relies strictly on server-sent `sharedRateLimit` data. Updated `FREEBUFF_INCLUDE_UNUSED_RATE_LIMITS_HEADER` docs in `freebuff-models.ts` to clarify historical naming.

2b718cc3be65d5704cf71390e398c989c1641b84.title: Ad telemetry and placement logic updates
2b718cc3be65d5704cf71390e398c989c1641b84.summary: Adds first-party decision and settlement telemetry schemas to Axiom logs, enforcing scalar-only fields to exclude high-cardinality IDs. Updates placement slots to include `Desktop-Below-Chat` and `Single-Ad-Unit-1` as live legacy inventory, while adjusting primary metrics to CPC-focused fields like `billableClicks` and `avgCpc`. Sets default first-party routing to dark deploy (0% allocation, backfill disabled) to prevent unintended inventory diversion. Legacy conversion labels remain addressable in types but hidden from CPC MVP UI reporting.

1a069f10a6dcb5116116520f285a565bc7e658ac.title: Remove isImpreziaSandboxTester from imprezia-client
1a069f10a6dcb5116116520f285a565bc7e658ac.summary: Removed `isImpreziaSandboxTester` from `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`, simplifying the sandbox opt-in logic. The `allowSandbox` parameter now solely controls whether sandbox creatives are served in production, bypassing the previous email allowlist check. This change reduces code complexity in the ad client by eliminating the dual-gate verification mechanism.

41eb6446627cc703eeb8323efaf1e6477204a06d.title: Imprezia sandbox allowlist gate
41eb6446627cc703eeb8323efaf1e6477204a06d.summary: Adds allowSandbox opt-in and isImpreziaSandboxTester helper to gate Imprezia sandbox creatives in production. Sandbox keys previously blocked unless testMode; now require explicit session pinning plus email allowlist match. Changes confined to common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts. Allowlist reads from IMPREZIA_SANDBOX_TESTERS env var; absent or empty defaults to deny.

95e94c20aecc773fd13da69de9eebff40f6436bb.title: Imprezia Chat Ads integration and experiment bucketing
95e94c20aecc773fd13da69de9eebff40f6436bb.summary: Adds `ad-experiment.ts` for deterministic 10% Imprezia-first bucketing using FNV-1a hashing, parking unauthenticated users in control to prevent dilution. Implements `imprezia-ad.ts` and `imprezia-client.ts` for server-to-server Chat Ads API communication, enforcing sandbox/prod key prefixes to isolate environments and prevent test creatives in production. Billing relies on two browser-fired beacons; missing viewable reports result in no payment. Shared in `common` to ensure consistent arm assignment across Web, CLI, and Desktop surfaces.

6f79426bd3986cb1cd77168c2e80b2ad53862550.title: Add subscriber access tier row helper
6f79426bd3986cb1cd77168c2e80b2ad53862550.summary: New `subscriber-access-tiers.ts` exports `subscriberAccessTierRows` to format access tier counts. Maps 'full', 'limited', 'unknown' to localized labels with `toLocaleString('en-US')`. Falls back to em-dash for undefined counts. Scope: `common/src/util/`.

09f62ecb291de42ee67f62602f769b8f37c79bfb.title: docs: update testing.md on flake mitigation strategy
09f62ecb291de42ee67f62602f769b8f37c79bfb.summary: Updated docs/testing.md to reflect #1983 un-skipping a flaky test by migrating from hand-rolled `mount()` to `@testing-library/react` + jsdom. Clarified that the dispatcher swap theory remains unconfirmed as the original flake was never reproduced. Noted that twelve other files still use the manual swap pattern, retaining flake risk. Issue #1899 remains open pending CI stability.

50aa984b714af271946c68a2ed80466a01338c4e.title: Simplify keyboard navigation logic in CLI
50aa984b714af271946c68a2ed80466a01338c4e.summary: Refactored slash and mention menu navigation in `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts` to use concise guard clauses. Replaced nested if-else blocks checking `historyNavDownEnabled` and `historyNavUpEnabled` with single boolean conditions. This reduces code volume by 24 lines while preserving existing navigation priorities and fallback behaviors.

6f9acbfeb578ed83e026547695d86a172b8011fe.title: Freebuff CLI version bumped to 0.0.154
6f9acbfeb578ed83e026547695d86a172b8011fe.summary: Version field in freebuff/cli/release/package.json updated from 0.0.153 to 0.0.154. This reflects a standard release increment for the CLI package. Scope limited to the CLI release manifest.

923de567621991a2f4d90fe7bcfcf4fd016a24ca.title: adsfetchcompleted allowlisted for Axiom operational logging
923de567621991a2f4d90fe7bcfcf4fd016a24ca.summary: Added `ads_fetch_completed` to the Axiom-only log allowlist in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. This permits content-free operational events to retain specific numeric, string, and boolean metadata in Axiom without becoming product analytics events or bypassing redaction. The change defines an explicit field schema for ad fetch outcomes, including provider details, ad count, surface, placement, session ID, duration, and client UA info. Unknown fields and unexpected value types are strictly discarded during sanitization.

5a504c380ad0497547ff88e63624d6101795cc92.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro availability set to always
5a504c380ad0497547ff88e63624d6101795cc92.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro availability changed from off_peak_only to always in freebuff-models.ts. Peak-hour closure removed because the model is served by Cheaper Inference with flat pricing, eliminating the upstream cost spike that necessitated the restriction. The unavailableFallback to V4 Flash is also removed. READMEs and CLI release notes updated to reflect the change.

a23c8b25050c3630473d9be4309c3eaa858cde07.title: Replace Promise.withResolvers in stream-parser
a23c8b25050c3630473d9be4309c3eaa858cde07.summary: Replaced Promise.withResolvers with manual Promise construction in packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts. The change removes reliance on the newer static method, ensuring compatibility with runtime environments lacking full ES2024 support. Scope limited to agent-runtime stream processing logic. resolveStreamDonePromise is now assigned via a side-effect during Promise instantiation.

695d4d15676d9937d172ccf87909013085942be1.title: DeepSeek peak hours restricted to weekdays
695d4d15676d9937d172ccf87909013085942be1.summary: DeepSeek pricing logic now treats weekends as always off-peak. Added `isBeijingWeekend` helper to `freebuff-peak-hours.ts` to gate peak window checks. Subscription disclaimers updated to specify 'weekday peak hours'.

5acb86de2a75b3c0a36e2ce451723bf1e5dece38.title: Remove low-value analytics events and PostHog log mirroring
5acb86de2a75b3c0a36e2ce451723bf1e5dece38.summary: Deleted `USER_INPUT_COMPLETE`, `CLI_LOG`, `AGENT_STEP`, `TOOL_USE`, and several API request events from `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. The CLI logger no longer sends `CLI_LOG` events to PostHog, and `cli/src/commands/router.ts` removed the per-prompt input tracking block. Inline ad pool reuse now uses `enqueueClientLog` directly instead of `trackInlineAdEvent`. Scope covers CLI, Shared/Core, and Agent Runtime packages, reducing analytics noise and ingest costs.

990ae116fee764e1daf72f0fda57880cf3d369b7.title: V4 Pro uncapped, shared premium pool
990ae116fee764e1daf72f0fda57880cf3d369b7.summary: Removed the 1-session/day cap for V4 Pro in `FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_CAPS` and updated `FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE`. Pro now shares the premium session pool with Flash, reflecting its lower cost on Cheaper Inference. The change is isolated to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and `common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts`. A new test pins the notice string to the caps table to prevent drift.

44616e1e8cbc975b693b136b98b301ccc157d7d1.title: Add 2026-09-14 price change to Solar promo constants
44616e1e8cbc975b693b136b98b301ccc157d7d1.summary: Added 2026-09-14T03:46:00Z entry to SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES for FREEBUFF_SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL_ID, raising price from 5 to 10. Marked SOLAR_REGULAR_OFFER as historical; solarOfferAt() resolves current pricing. Updated common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts.

01301385919da16daba8bd458609835c69e31a7e.title: PLACEMENTSCONSOLEENABLED no longer gates access
01301385919da16daba8bd458609835c69e31a7e.summary: PLACEMENTS_CONSOLE_ENABLED no longer gates console access; `FREEBUFF_PLACEMENTS_AUDIENCE` env knob (`off`|`admin`|`all`) in `access.ts` does. Constant kept `false` to mark data as fixtures, not real spend. Update docs to reflect `placementsAudience()` as the sole gate.

7895583a6c3216d4a977080028483c8b65fc9d3d.title: ADRESETTIMEZONE constant added to freebuff-ads
7895583a6c3216d4a977080028483c8b65fc9d3d.summary: Added AD_RESET_TIMEZONE = 'America/Los_Angeles' to common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts. Ads system daily boundaries (spend caps, engagement ceilings, delivery reporting, placements spend ledger day column) are Pacific calendar days, aligning with existing product daily budgets. Placed in common so web/ Stripe webhook can compute the same day boundary as the console.

28220d571736520903c8e75cfd41a8588cd5e1a0.title: Derive god-only model IDs and add GPT-5.6 Luna ES to premium
28220d571736520903c8e75cfd41a8588cd5e1a0.summary: FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODEL_IDS derives from FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS map instead of hand-listing, preventing drift with isFreebuffWebGodOnlyModelId checks. FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_ES_MODEL_ID added to FREEBUFF_WEB_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS. Subscription comments updated to reference GOD_ONLY_BAIT_MODEL_IDS array. Covers common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and freebuff-subscriptions.ts.

098dd053d11a6338dae3f4abd62996a0c18982aa.title: Refactor implementor display name lookup in CLI
098dd053d11a6338dae3f4abd62996a0c18982aa.summary: Refactored getImplementorDisplayName in cli/src/utils/implementor-helpers.ts to use a data-driven IMPLEMENTOR_DISPLAY_NAMES array instead of chained if-else statements. The new implementation preserves strict ordering, ensuring specific model identifiers like editor-implementor-opus are checked before the generic editor-implementor suffix to prevent incorrect fallbacks. Scope limited to CLI utilities. The refactor simplifies adding new implementor variants by requiring only an array entry rather than new conditional logic.

ac2a035d604166a86390a7272dd56b60efd8a556.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 replaces V4 Pro as default in free model
ac2a035d604166a86390a7272dd56b60efd8a556.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro as the default model and reopens availability, driven by Pro's return to a peak-priced direct lane. Pro is now restricted to off-peak hours with a fallback to Flash, ensuring the premium pool remains active. Updates cover `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, `freebuff-model-availability.ts`, and documentation in `README.md` and `freebuff/cli/release/README.md`. A test pins `FREEBUFF_MODELS[0]` to `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` to maintain Flash's leading position.

0b697402591b23688e8fff0b8861d7b427190e2e.title: AdCard renders headline, fixes missing CTA label
0b697402591b23688e8fff0b8861d7b427190e2e.summary: ad-banner.tsx adds getCardAdLayout to render ad.title as a bold headline in the CLI AdCard. Previously, the title was only used as a ctaText fallback, causing creatives with explicit CTAs to drop their headlines. The layout logic ensures the 'Ad' disclosure stays visible by moving it to the headline row when present, and defaults missing fields to prevent render errors from malformed Gravity/Carbon payloads.

9a9f7dd95b7843187a4048b1b950b3539ab8fd5c.title: Move inline ad layout to common and add placements constants
9a9f7dd95b7843187a4048b1b950b3539ab8fd5c.summary: Extracted `getInlineAdLayout`, `truncateToWidth`, and `extractDomain` from `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx` to `common/src/ads/inline-ad-layout.ts`. This ensures the CLI and web advertiser preview render identical ad layouts at 20, 48, and 60 columns. Added `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts` and `freebuff-topups.ts` defining preview widths, activation windows, and prepaid balance rules. `isServableLandingUrl` in `freebuff-ads.ts` now restricts terminal card rendering to `http`/`https` schemes.

84c46ec290a6e544a29a30189b87a2fa1fa4ec90.title: Pro tier withheld from subscription catalog
84c46ec290a6e544a29a30189b87a2fa1fa4ec90.summary: The 'pro' tier is removed from FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_IDS and FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS in common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts. Checkout validates against this catalog, making the existing Stripe price unreachable without a code edit. Disclaimers were expanded to clarify rolling windows and carryover rules instead of restating raw limits.

b2efafdc0d4a0bf860ea5dd9581c8d754a664087.title: Add gpt-5.6-luna-es model ID and agent roots
b2efafdc0d4a0bf860ea5dd9581c8d754a664087.summary: Introduces `openai/gpt-5.6-luna-es` as a distinct model ID for the Novita route. It is explicitly separated from Luna to prevent silent substitution, as the route identifies as Codex. Context window set to 372k per provider specs. Added to `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS` and `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` for base2/base3, marked god-only to exclude from standard free inference.

a275174b3e37c2e809245dcc06a74e6406b8d8b2.title: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.153
a275174b3e37c2e809245dcc06a74e6406b8d8b2.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json incremented from 0.0.152 to 0.0.153. Standard release preparation. No functional code changes.

07685661de57b219d53ab908cf2e2bafcdb3e1eb.title: ADSHOWCASETWEETSTATSASOF updated to August 21, 2026
07685661de57b219d53ab908cf2e2bafcdb3e1eb.summary: AD_SHOWCASE_TWEET_STATS_AS_OF in common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts updated to 'August 21, 2026'. Like and reply counts for two showcase tweets refreshed from X's syndication endpoint. Reposts and views remain null; comments document manual retrieval from X analytics.

b563ba5e6b3bf0de5a76a0d72c354ae3db370210.title: Add x-freebuff-privileged-user header
b563ba5e6b3bf0de5a76a0d72c354ae3db370210.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_PRIVILEGED_USER_HEADER` ('x-freebuff-privileged-user') to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. This header acts as a trusted server-to-server companion to the acting-user header, set by the Freebuff Web/Cloud proxy to '1' after verifying admin/god roles server-side. It is honored only when the request authenticates as the Freebuff Web service account, preventing privilege escalation from other callers.

9d0e435b3802e4b6b833c1ed349d604e5b804f0d.title: Add Ox Alpha stealth model for Web/Cloud
9d0e435b3802e4b6b833c1ed349d604e5b804f0d.summary: Ox Alpha (`stealth/ox-alpha`) added as a free, anonymous frontier coding model served via OpenRouter. Restricted to Web and Cloud surfaces by absence from `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS`, with new root agents `base2-free-ox-alpha` and `base3-free-ox-alpha` pinned to the single model. Context window set to 1,000,000 tokens in `agents/base-chat.ts`. A zero `provider.max_price` fence prevents unmetered spend if the host reprices.

592d93f5d9e627a00fa4db4e1d1e8ca7662421a0.title: Populate X ad showcase metrics
592d93f5d9e627a00fa4db4e1d1e8ca7662421a0.summary: Populated `reposts` and `views` for two ad showcase tweets in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`. Updated `AdShowcaseTweet` interface documentation to clarify that `views` stores raw counts, not abbreviated display values. Metrics are manually copied from X author views due to lack of public endpoint access.

2a3c3c791364d4f39c2c61d80162909cd199cd29.title: Add paid subscription tiers and session entitlements
2a3c3c791364d4f39c2c61d80162909cd199cd29.summary: Introduces `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts` defining Starter/Plus/Pro tiers with pooled session allowances and premium sub-caps for Luna/DeepSeek V4 Pro. Updates `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` to include `subscription` fields in entitlement breakdowns and new `FreebuffSubscriptionTierOffer`/`Usage` interfaces for client rendering. Premium models are capped separately because they cost 4-5x more than Flash; Kimi K3 Eco is excluded from pricing due to honeypot traffic. Stripe price IDs are omitted from the public mirror, living in server env instead.

b21d5ab27d1d97f850e5b3b673d985093136342e.title: Freebuff CLI release bumped to 0.0.152
b21d5ab27d1d97f850e5b3b673d985093136342e.summary: Version 0.0.152 applied to freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Incremental release bump. No functional changes in CLI surface.

d777cd21617ccc5dd611a59920a609556e577551.title: Version 0.0.151
d777cd21617ccc5dd611a59920a609556e577551.summary: Version bump to 0.0.151. Updates package.json in freebuff/cli/release.

4fa5ea05a929de13ec11d3f1a4549953efa6c09b.title: Enable Placements Console, Add First-Party Ad Routing, and Sanitize
4fa5ea05a929de13ec11d3f1a4549953efa6c09b.summary: Placements console is enabled (`PLACEMENTS_CONSOLE_ENABLED = true`) after wiring campaign persistence, impression attribution, and spend ledger settlement. New `sanitizeAdText` and `sanitizeAdUrl` utilities strip terminal escape sequences, control characters, and enforce HTTPS for advertiser creatives. First-party ad routing logic added via `firstPartyAdRouteForUser` with stable FNV-1a bucketing, defaulting to 10% primary allocation and backfill enabled. Placement IDs verified against live Axiom logs to ensure sellability, removing invalid `cli_chat` surface references.

aefe67a7bd41d1b8cce4e53d39f9e22677aaf630.title: CLI model selector adds nowMs prop to pin clock
aefe67a7bd41d1b8cce4e53d39f9e22677aaf630.summary: FreebuffModelSelector gains an optional nowMs prop to freeze the picker's clock at a specific epoch millisecond. This prevents time-of-day dependent row availability (e.g., V4 Pro closing during DeepSeek's expensive window) from causing flaky tests based on CI execution time. The change is scoped to cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx. When nowMs is provided, the underlying useNow interval is cancelled outright, ensuring the frozen picker never re-renders itself back onto real time.

1e69baf9bf0ba91e9f693f1a6942e2b92c880783.title: Git Bash path translation for Windows file resolution
1e69baf9bf0ba91e9f693f1a6942e2b92c880783.summary: SDK path resolvers now translate single-leading-slash Git Bash paths to native Windows paths via cygpath.exe before resolution. This ensures agent-provided MSYS paths resolve correctly on Windows. Implemented in sdk/src/tools/path-utils.ts and sdk/src/tools/windows-bash.ts. MSYS drive paths like /c/ convert directly to C:\, while other paths invoke cygpath -w with a 5-second timeout and result caching.

105640d21d124ff1dd6a7ccd7df06fffb9a5c34f.title: Gravity Index provision action added
105640d21d124ff1dd6a7ccd7df06fffb9a5c34f.summary: Added `provision` action to `GravityIndexParams` in `agents/types/tools.ts` and `common/src/types/gravity-index.ts`. This allows agents to create user accounts and receive credentials directly, bypassing signup pages. Requires `user_consent: true` and `search_id`. Runtime logic in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts` handles credential injection and conversion tracking.

ffed5e29d2c86da974e22ca462675bb334d3212c.title: ensureDirectoryExists handles EEXIST race
ffed5e29d2c86da974e22ca462675bb334d3212c.summary: ensureDirectoryExists in common/src/util/file.ts now catches EEXIST and retries with backoff. This fixes failures when Windows cloud filesystem drivers expose new directories with latency. sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts uses this helper instead of raw mkdir. Retry delays are 0, 10, 50, 100ms.

ed706ca47d476c9a68e7302b22b3c615dd522dd1.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro becomes default full-access hero
ed706ca47d476c9a68e7302b22b3c615dd522dd1.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaces V4 Flash as the default full-access hero in the CLI picker and core constants. V4 Flash now pauses during peak hours, routing traffic to V4 Pro via the new `unavailableFallback` mechanism to prevent silent detours to unlimited models. All `supersedes` notices and 'RECOMMENDED' badges were removed, making list order the sole steering signal. GPT-5.6 Luna limits increased to two sessions daily, while V4 Pro remains the only premium row available 24/7.

3f3cb3851705ca43846d8a13c2c12a7ebfe94a38.title: Remove DeepSeek peak-hours spend ceiling logic
3f3cb3851705ca43846d8a13c2c12a7ebfe94a38.summary: Removes `isDeepSeekPeakHour`, `nextDeepSeekWindowBoundary`, and `formatDeepSeekPeakWindowsLocal` from `common/src/constants/freebuff-peak-hours.ts`. Deletes `FREEBUFF_PEAK_LIMIT_NOTICE` and the `FreebuffSpendCeilingPeak` interface from `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`. Strips the optional `peak` field from `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. Eliminates the mechanism that reduced daily spend caps during DeepSeek's peak pricing windows.

5baa7a52d32ba2ed115a659fa28eed38a4414cef.title: Document standard trust cost write path
5baa7a52d32ba2ed115a659fa28eed38a4414cef.summary: Added comments to `FREEBUFF_TRUST_COST_PER_PROMPT` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts` explaining the buffered write path for standard models. Notes that `enqueuePromptTrustCharge` skips the write path if cost is set to 0. Scope limited to shared core constants.

657d06d953134758769d273970853bd370e89c3e.title: ADPRICINGENABLED set to true
657d06d953134758769d273970853bd370e89c3e.summary: AD_PRICING_ENABLED flipped from false to true in common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts, reactivating campaign billing after the free-campaign window. Stripe price lookup, checkout, and subscription webhooks remain intact, requiring no other changes to resume charging. The feed retains its single `billing_active` rule, ensuring no serving bypass exists when pricing is re-enabled.

55402897958a0f19676f33abeb1432e63ea53ca7.title: gitignore adds QA fixture and design scratch
55402897958a0f19676f33abeb1432e63ea53ca7.summary: Added `feedback-lab/src/real-data.json` and `freebuff/web/.impeccable/` to `.gitignore`. Prevents accidental commits of sensitive QA feedback containing personal handles and internal design tooling artifacts. Scope limited to repository hygiene configuration.

0ce5fb0b7d299ff3a646c2785016dd3287928df3.title: Add issue templates and CI workflows for public repo
0ce5fb0b7d299ff3a646c2785016dd3287928df3.summary: Added structured issue templates (bug, feature, support) and disabled blank issues to route quota/support queries to Discord. Introduced Public CI workflow to build/test exported packages and PR Hygiene workflow to validate PR structure via pull_request_target. Updated CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect these new validation steps.

04e751a97e5f614d12c8165741fdaaf212197531.title: docs/testing.md: flake hunting and CI retry checks
04e751a97e5f614d12c8165741fdaaf212197531.summary: Added section on flake hunting limitations. Documents useProjectSkills flake case. Explains CI retry hiding failures via gh pr checks. Details React dispatcher swap race condition in mount().

7b1bde13e85e50fb7f0ca7675ebf8c29788ec464.title: CLI Premium section renders per-model quotas for DeepSeek pool split
7b1bde13e85e50fb7f0ca7675ebf8c29788ec464.summary: CLI model selector now uses `getFreebuffSectionQuotas` to split Premium section quota rows by pool, rendering inline counts for models on stricter pools. Previous `Object.values(...)[0]` shortcut mislabeled headers when DeepSeek's one-a-day ceiling introduced a second pool alongside the premium pool. Shared logic lives in new `common/src/util/freebuff-session-pools.ts`, used by CLI, Web, and Desktop via `FreebuffSectionQuotas` interface. Older servers omit `pool` field, falling back to single-bucket behavior preserving prior display; `poolLabel` is server-authored so new pools require no client release.

9311890b70d198454df8e25b72df2d064854dc48.title: Show local time for unavailable models in CLI picker
9311890b70d198454df8e25b72df2d064854dc48.summary: CLI model selector now displays local time when a model is unavailable, replacing silent greying. New `getFreebuffModelUnavailableLabel` function in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` calculates return time for `off_peak_only` models (DeepSeek V4 Pro) using `deepSeekExpensiveWindowEndsAt`, while `deployment_hours` models retain existing label. `common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts` refactored to share `isAvailableAt` logic between picker and server admission checks, ensuring consistent `availability` interpretation. `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` integrates the label into card details, handling spacing and color for closed notes.

b9ace3f9b2782eb321dd299ec9972689f3e08daa.title: Policy notice retired early, ad showcase stats added
b9ace3f9b2782eb321dd299ec9972689f3e08daa.summary: Policy notice retired early on 2026-08-20 via `noticeEndsAt` in `freebuff-data-use.ts`. `freebuff-ads.ts` adds `AD_SHOWCASE_TWEETS` and `AdShowcaseTweet` interface. Media images render in fixed boxes. Repost and view counts remain null without authenticated X API keys.

6c1591f8a5caf4b189e75bea718139d506c0b121.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash becomes default; MiniMax M3 un-premiumed
6c1591f8a5caf4b189e75bea718139d506c0b121.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 replaces GPT-5.6 Luna as the default full-mode model due to upstream cost pressures. MiniMax M3 is removed from `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS` and set to `premium: false` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to maintain unlimited access while preserving quota invariants. Per-user daily ceilings now apply to GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Pro, with V4 Pro additionally restricted to off-peak hours. Documentation in `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`, and CLI release notes updated to reflect new defaults and temporary restrictions.

b4e5713b824dff395fcf7112cfc5ccae94429984.title: Disable per-campaign ad review queue
b4e5713b824dff395fcf7112cfc5ccae94429984.summary: Sets `AD_CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_ENABLED` to false in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`, bypassing manual per-campaign checks. Advertiser account approval remains required. Admin dashboard lists campaigns for spot-checking instead of blocking.

b378f994a87f43adea2fa4fed651663f2b89b08e.title: Disable ad billing and enforce 7-day campaign limit
b378f994a87f43adea2fa4fed651663f2b89b08e.summary: Sets `AD_PRICING_ENABLED` to `false` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`, pausing Stripe charges while keeping webhook/checkout logic intact. Introduces `AD_MAX_CAMPAIGN_LENGTH_DAYS = 7` with `resolveCampaignEndDate` to clamp all free campaign durations, preventing open-ended spending of real user Trust payouts. Billing re-enables by flipping the constant to `true`.

f7bb825f48d23a5e38f2a43748657d567847cd9a.title: gitignore scripts/tmp- ad-hoc investigation scripts
f7bb825f48d23a5e38f2a43748657d567847cd9a.summary: Added scripts/_tmp-* to .gitignore. Prevents ad-hoc investigation scripts from being accidentally committed. Covers repo root scripts directory.

8c034b5f9242c0bb48b8021f96eeb2e159096d16.title: Reject bare post URLs in ad comment verification
8c034b5f9242c0bb48b8021f96eeb2e159096d16.summary: checkCommentUrl in ad-comment-url.ts now rejects URLs lacking a commentUrn, closing a loophole where submitting the promoted post's own link passed validation on LinkedIn. Previously, this returned ok with platform_only strength, causing inconsistent enforcement across platforms. AD_EVIDENCE_ATTESTATION in freebuff-ads.ts was also updated to explicitly require liking, reposting, and commenting. Scope limited to common/src/util/ad-comment-url.ts and common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts.

7dcb4fb1e09cbd72bb0d86409739ff616bc6d472.title: Add sandbox concurrency and project daily limits
7dcb4fb1e09cbd72bb0d86409739ff616bc6d472.summary: Renamed FREEBUFF_WEB_LIMITED_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT to FREEBUFF_WEB_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT and set to 5. Added FREEBUFF_WEB_MAX_OPEN_SANDBOXES constant set to 2. Changes applied in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. New limits prevent Daytona quota saturation and unbounded sandbox growth.

24de8d9513fd0584a4a18a73f3d3ca5e7e54a1bf.title: normalizeUrlInput prepends https for scheme-less URLs
24de8d9513fd0584a4a18a73f3d3ca5e7e54a1bf.summary: Added `normalizeUrlInput` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`. It prepends `https://` to trimmed inputs lacking a scheme regex match (`/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i`). `platformForUrl` now uses this helper before `new URL` parsing. Fixes silent submission failures when users paste URLs without schemes.

2e3e3f6691f3de16b7b0b5ddcb1612c553a382de.title: Trust floor 0, standard prompts free
2e3e3f6691f3de16b7b0b5ddcb1612c553a382de.summary: FREEBUFF_TRUST_ALLOW_NEGATIVE set false; FREEBUFF_TRUST_MIN_BALANCE 0. standard cost 0, glm/premium 1, frontier 2. chargePromptTrust early-returns on zero cost, skipping balance/ledger writes. Read-clamp fixes 17,993 negative rows on next load without backfill.

08a8371fb064793ba00624c528e8738489aea268.title: Freebuff trust cost now flat 1 per prompt
08a8371fb064793ba00624c528e8738489aea268.summary: FREEBUFF_TRUST_COST_PER_PROMPT in common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts now charges 1 trust for every message, removing the tiered standard: 0 / glm: 1 / premium: 1 / frontier: 2 scheme. Standard models (DeepSeek Flash, MiMo, web-standard pool) previously cost 0, allowing `chargePromptTrust` to return early and skip balance writes; all prompts now debit. Frontier models (Claude Fable 5) dropped from 2 to 1 to match the flat rate, though class distinctions are preserved as a seam for future rate changes. This makes engagement math predictable: 1 engagement = 50 messages, regardless of model selection.

ba0e40bacf53a1ffa8dfcf0db6ab7b0da43b139a.title: Align ad impression pixel UA with auction client
ba0e40bacf53a1ffa8dfcf0db6ab7b0da43b139a.summary: The impression pixel now sends the same browser-like UA and OS as the auction, replacing the server-side default of Freebuff-CLI/<version>. This fixes a bot-filtering conflict where Gravity saw one impression describing two different clients. Changes affect cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts and common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts. The shared Chrome version constant was also corrected from 124.0.0.0 to 151.0.0.0, as the previous value was 27 stable versions behind despite recent bump comments.

187b1e916c06bd3ab87208ac647577fb4b9f6b03.title: Clarify ad billing: daily subscription, not metered
187b1e916c06bd3ab87208ac647577fb4b9f6b03.summary: Updated `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts` to define `AD_ENGAGEMENT_PRICE_CENTS` as a divisor for the daily budget cap rather than a per-engagement cost. `AD_MIN_DAILY_BUDGET_CENTS` is now explicitly the smallest daily charge. This aligns documentation with the shift from metered billing to a flat daily subscription model.

b5111f885a8e3b737cffff102f353444ea860ada.title: Add flagged status and advertiser showcase constants
b5111f885a8e3b737cffff102f353444ea860ada.summary: Added `flagged` to `AD_ENGAGEMENT_STATUSES` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts` to align with the `ad_engagement_status` pg enum, fixing silent representation failures on typed surfaces. Introduced `AD_SHOWCASE_POST_URLS` and `AD_SHOWCASE_REACH` constants to power the advertiser landing page. Engagement metrics resolve dynamically from the database, while `AD_SHOWCASE_REACH` uses operator-supplied view counts (300 before, 10k-50k after) for `@victorxheng` to prevent fabricated claims.

aaf1843ce840d29bf339feae4644adf3df1e06c9.title: Add scratch- to .gitignore
aaf1843ce840d29bf339feae4644adf3df1e06c9.summary: Added `scratch-*` pattern to root `.gitignore`. Prevents throwaway helper scripts from being committed, as a previous slip occurred at the root directory where nested ignores failed. Covers all subdirectories.

fad014c575a497df9a3169fb2bc516281a081a58.title: Remove placeholder comment in SDK constants
fad014c575a497df9a3169fb2bc516281a081a58.summary: Removed placeholder comment in sdk/src/constants.ts. No functional changes. Internal cleanup only.

01ea6aba4c679543e05913a5db8faa49937b13c0.title: Add luminal to spend providers
01ea6aba4c679543e05913a5db8faa49937b13c0.summary: Added 'luminal' to SPEND_PROVIDER_IDS and mapped it to 'Luminal' in PROVIDER_LABELS within common/src/constants/spend-providers.ts. This expands the supported providers for spend tracking. The change is internal and affects the shared core constants.

35dc6d079403192cc19e9552f4a951fa9776f707.title: Skill tool disk lookup now respects includeHomeSkills opt-in
35dc6d079403192cc19e9552f4a951fa9776f707.summary: The `skill` tool's `loadSkillFromDisk` now accepts and enforces the `includeHomeSkills` flag, preventing unintended home directory searches on servers. `ProjectFileContext` in `common/src/util/file.ts` and `sdk/src/run-state.ts` were updated to propagate this setting. This ensures the tool's disk lookup aligns with the initial loader, closing a security gap where server-side skills could override repo-specific ones.

e73d39fff1ab55bc2c2615d60efd7129afa5c7fc.title: CLI and shared constants now point to /earn/trust with unified prompt
e73d39fff1ab55bc2c2615d60efd7129afa5c7fc.summary: CLI referral banner links to /earn/trust instead of /earn?tab=referrals#referral-status. Shared constants FREEBUFF_EARN_PATH and FREEBUFF_EARN_PROMPT ensure identical wording across CLI, Desktop, and Web. This shifts focus to the Trust engagement feed, which pays within a minute, rather than the slower referral path. The short prompt variant is used in the CLI action row to save space.

89832d9b3ade452149cf8e9658bd4537107fc5e7.title: Spend ceiling peak reduction skips tiers without DeepSeek
89832d9b3ade452149cf8e9658bd4537107fc5e7.summary: Added `tierRunsDeepSeek` helper to `freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` to bypass peak-hour ceiling reductions for access tiers lacking DeepSeek models. This prevents unnecessary spending limits for users on tiers like `limited` that only run non-DeepSeek models (e.g., MiMo 2.5), whose costs do not double during peak hours. The check dynamically reads from `getFreebuffModelsForAccessTier` rather than hardcoding tier names, ensuring the reduction automatically reapplies if DeepSeek models return to a tier's catalog.

cef358330ebed218abe3c1d8df88a8d4bb8315db.title: Add isLimitedTierSubstitutedModel to prevent metered path for limited
cef358330ebed218abe3c1d8df88a8d4bb8315db.summary: Added `isLimitedTierSubstitutedModel` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` to correctly identify requests where the server substitutes `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` for a model that left the limited tier. This prevents admission and billing checks from disagreeing, which previously caused these requests to fall into the metered path and attempt credit ledger writes for accounts with no balance. The function verifies the model matches `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID`, the agent is a known non-programmatic free-mode agent, and the publisher is `codebuff` or empty. This mirrors the logic in `isHoneypotFreeModeAllowed` to ensure consistent free-mode gating across chat/completions and llm-api/helpers.

1470aa4e189c2d0347843109e5ec86dbab395402.title: DB health alerts run without pgreadallstats via coverage dial
1470aa4e189c2d0347843109e5ec86dbab395402.summary: Replaced the `pg_read_all_stats` boolean precondition in `common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts` with a coverage dial. `buildBackendXminSql` dropped the `backend_type = 'client backend'` filter and now counts `snapshot_holders`, `visible_backends`, and `opaque_backends` so invisible sessions become a reported number instead of a silent all-clear. `buildStatementSnapshotSql` folds redacted rows into `opaque:<userid>` buckets because `queryid` is redacted in lockstep with `query` text, preserving `total_exec_time` deltas. Scope is shared core; `evaluateStatCoverage` splits activity/statement probes so a missing `pg_stat_statements` extension cannot take both alerts down.

5f72959fab4202f5b667112c914282bcc195fb9b.title: Local GPT-4o token estimation and skill parsing refactor
5f72959fab4202f5b667112c914282bcc195fb9b.summary: Replaced Anthropic API token counting with local GPT-4o BPE estimation in `run-agent-step.ts` to remove serial latency, updating `contextTokenCount` semantics in `agent-definition.ts` and `session-state.ts`. Extracted `parseSkillFileContent` to `common/src/util/parse-skill.ts` to avoid tree-sitter WASM resolution failures in Convex actions, re-exported by SDK. CLI now explicitly sets `includeHomeSkills: true` in `codebuff-client.ts` and `skill-registry.ts` to preserve user skill visibility, while SDK defaults to project-only for server safety. Added `gray-matter` dependency to `common/package.json` for frontmatter parsing.

9b9b25e76714ba3cfc7fff9a8b13428164cdc2cf.title: Update Desktop service path references to mission.ts
9b9b25e76714ba3cfc7fff9a8b13428164cdc2cf.summary: Freebuff Desktop's autorun agent service path updates from `autorun.ts` to `mission.ts` in `common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts` and `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. This corrects internal documentation and code comments to reflect the actual file location for the mission decider. The change ensures accurate tracking of the `decide` tool signature to prevent false-positive foreign client flags. Scope limited to core constants; no behavioral changes.

bdc6b61fb93d720c2e1dbc084046eec16580336f.title: Lower PREMIUMSESSIONLIMIT to 5
bdc6b61fb93d720c2e1dbc084046eec16580336f.summary: FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT decreased from 6 to 5 in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. The change tightens the cap on fresh sessions for premium users across Web and Cloud surfaces. CLI remains unlimited for these models.

d2b9697a48a5b058d6648dbe78561f63a88af7b8.title: Bump freebuff CLI version to 0.0.150
d2b9697a48a5b058d6648dbe78561f63a88af7b8.summary: Version updated from 0.0.149 to 0.0.150 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Standard release increment.

d20038cb58001e360bbcfb30960817b202e8993a.title: Add spend-providers constants separating vendor and billing
d20038cb58001e360bbcfb30960817b202e8993a.summary: New `common/src/constants/spend-providers.ts` defines `SPEND_PROVIDER_IDS` and `UNATTRIBUTED_PROVIDER` to distinguish model vendors from billing counterparties. This prevents misattribution of costs (e.g., Luna served via OpenRouter but billed to OpenAI) by using `message.provider` for billing and `modelVendor()` for model family analysis. NULL provider rows render as `(unattributed)` and age out via retention, avoiding incorrect guesses for high-spend mixed-vendor models.

695a52ed5a16bd3c3482682e2f84b29ac47c5190.title: Spend ceilings add 2x hard cap for restricted-risk cohorts
695a52ed5a16bd3c3482682e2f84b29ac47c5190.summary: The 1x ceiling gates fresh/legacy-queued external sessions. Restricted-risk cohorts enforce a 2x hard cap on single-session live reclaims and new prompts. Desktop reclaim admission skips the spend gate, but restricted Desktop tabs meet the same hard cap at prompt time. Internal accounts are exempt before callers aggregate spend.

35eec19e84f06cc0bfef213d204165ac1e9867a4.title: DeepSeek peak hours window shared by billing and spend ceilings
35eec19e84f06cc0bfef213d204165ac1e9867a4.summary: New `freebuff-peak-hours.ts` defines DeepSeek's UTC peak windows (01:00-04:00, 06:00-10:00) as the single source of truth for pricing and limits. `freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` imports these helpers to apply a `FREEBUFF_PEAK_LIMIT_NOTICE` and expose `FreebuffSpendCeilingPeak` (baseUsd, multiplier, endsAt) when caps are reduced. `freebuff-session.ts` adds an optional `peak` object to server responses, allowing clients to display local time boundaries and recovery times instead of a flat daily reset.

c200e2d4f1c2dbc77bdd889971d83fb755fb0f53.title: Shared database health alert SQL and threshold logic
c200e2d4f1c2dbc77bdd889971d83fb755fb0f53.summary: New `common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts` exports raw SQL strings and evaluation functions for production database health checks, covering transaction wraparound, long-lived `backend_xmin` snapshots, invalid/stuck index builds, and busy-backend equivalents. This centralizes logic previously scattered in ad-hoc scripts, grounding thresholds in measured capacity data (e.g., 50% wraparound budget, 1M xid snapshot age, 30m stuck build, 4 busy backends). The module includes a `pg_read_all_stats` probe to prevent silent false-negatives when the monitoring role lacks visibility into fleet-wide stats. Dependency-free design allows alert scripts to wrap these strings with `sql.raw(...)`.

8da51dc0eaecae13822690e91ea90a9038bd9dc6.title: MiMo 2.5 replaces Flash as limited tier default
8da51dc0eaecae13822690e91ea90a9038bd9dc6.summary: MiMo 2.5 becomes the sole limited-tier model after DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 was paused due to upstream repricing. The change updates LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and adjusts CLI landing screen notices in cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx. Full access remains unaffected, with Flash still serving as the fallback and planner model for supported regions.

7129d45870e6486850aca5729015b555653ca7d1.title: Freebuff Levels and Ad Marketplace
7129d45870e6486850aca5729015b555653ca7d1.summary: Introduced `common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts` to establish an earned-capacity system and advertiser marketplace. Premium session base dropped 5 to 4, and limited-region base dropped 6 to 3, with `FREEBUFF_LEVEL_SESSIONS=off` reverting these changes if needed. Ad pricing set at $0.50 per engagement, with daily budgets capped between $10 and $1000 in $5 increments. `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` updated to include a `level` field for earned sessions.

d0c7b069051a45044d107598a2ce98ef80d63100.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro repricing invalidates cost-based model default
d0c7b069051a45044d107598a2ce98ef80d63100.summary: DeepSeek repriced the V4 Pro family on 2026-08-16, splitting costs into peak and off-peak windows and inverting previous cache-read advantages over GPT-5.6 Luna. `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` updates `DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL` comments and `FREEBUFF_WEB_DEEMPHASIZED_MODEL_IDS` documentation to reflect that V4 Pro is now 2.2x-4.4x dearer on cache reads. The `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_WEB_MODEL_ID` remains V4 Pro and the de-emphasis list remains empty, but the cost justification for this default is explicitly marked as stale and requiring product review.

095d6d65a1697d4cb31e0a39df9adeafcf7946c2.title: Remove Beta label from Freebuff Desktop
095d6d65a1697d4cb31e0a39df9adeafcf7946c2.summary: Desktop product row in README tables drops the Beta qualifier. Applies to English and Simplified Chinese documentation. Internal copy update only; no functional or CLI changes.

192cb715a3ae26a1deee15731d0ddd86560fe262.title: Add desktop.loginstarted event to analytics
192cb715a3ae26a1deee15731d0ddd86560fe262.summary: Added DESKTOP_LOGIN_STARTED to analytics events to capture sign-in attempts. Included in ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS to ensure funnel conversion rates remain accurate by preventing differential sampling between start and completion events. Applies to common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts and common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts.

2d370c194f127b56a4273462587f7589a557b834.title: Buffer media until tool calls answered in messages.ts
2d370c194f127b56a4273462587f7589a557b834.summary: convertToolMessages now buffers media parts until all tool calls are answered, preventing AI SDK validation errors when parallel calls are interleaved with media. The logic tracks unanswered toolCallIds, skipping provider-executed calls, and flushes pending media only when the set is empty. This fixes threads wedging during history replay where media inline split batches. Implemented in common/src/util/messages.ts as a backstop alongside dropUnansweredToolCalls.

ae35b542f1b2cc0e6e455ef9effa1cdb9ad4c818.title: SG moves to elevated $5 ceiling; 5 abuse domains flagged
ae35b542f1b2cc0e6e455ef9effa1cdb9ad4c818.summary: Singapore shifted from restricted $0.50 to new elevated $5 ceiling in `freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`, driven by 22.9% false-positive refusal rate among ordinary SG users. The abuse was domain-based, not geographic: `dhisy.com`, `dewaa.id`, `sendang.space`, `yotube.id`, `gusil.my.id` added to `disposable-email.ts` with measured ban rates 68–93% against gmail's 5% baseline. CN remains restricted; `FREEBUFF_ELEVATED_COUNTRIES` is env-overridable for traffic-shift latency.

eb2eb5ec4b15f2b31cee2ff7c6870aef398526aa.title: Remove NEXTPUBLICHUMANBEHAVIORINGESTIONURL
eb2eb5ec4b15f2b31cee2ff7c6870aef398526aa.summary: Removed NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_INGESTION_URL from clientEnvSchema and clientProcessEnv in common/src/env-schema.ts. The SDK's default ingestion host is now enforced, eliminating the option to point deployments at non-default Human Behavior endpoints. This change affects shared core environment validation. Developers must ensure their deployments use the standard ingestion URL.

2fa82f2e26c68a2e750dcdd3515855e661d05577.title: Extract UTC day helpers into common/src/util/utc-days.ts
2fa82f2e26c68a2e750dcdd3515855e661d05577.summary: New `utc-days.ts` consolidates `shiftUtcDay`, `dayWindowBounds`, and `trailingUtcDays` previously duplicated across rollup scripts and web dashboards. Centralization prevents drift in half-open `[start, end)` timestamp math, ensuring Postgres microsecond precision doesn't drop rows. Scope covers shared core utilities used by ad-revenue and freebuff-spend jobs. `dayWindowBounds` explicitly avoids inclusive millisecond ends to prevent off-by-one errors.

2afc2b2dfac9a0bcb48e18ccc0c1f720f6f2e6a7.title: Luna provider pin replaced by price ceiling
2afc2b2dfac9a0bcb48e18ccc0c1f720f6f2e6a7.summary: OpenAI endpoint routing for `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` switched from a hard pin to a preference order with fallbacks, bounded by `FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_MAX_PRICE`. This change addresses OpenAI's account-level policy blocks causing 100% failure rates on the pinned endpoint. The cost fence remains strict to prevent silent 10x billing from Azure/Bedrock re-pricings. Additionally, `errorSchema` was moved to the first position in Zod unions for chat and completion models to prevent provider error chunks with empty `choices` from being silently stripped and misinterpreted as network failures.

f97ca5511b01eba2552e9be7d7332194f5118ca3.title: mainstreamprivacy class lifts Proton and Apple from spend ceiling
f97ca5511b01eba2552e9be7d7332194f5118ca3.summary: Added `mainstream_privacy` kind to `FlaggedEmailDomainKind` in `common/src/util/disposable-email.ts`. Proton, Apple Hide-My-Email, Tutanota, DuckDuckGo, and Firefox Relay domains moved from `PRIVACY_RELAY_EMAIL_DOMAINS` to `MAINSTREAM_PRIVACY_EMAIL_DOMAINS`. Operator decision 2026-08-14 lifted big-brand consumer mailboxes off the spend ceiling, resolving contradiction with IP-side Apple Private Relay handling. New `isSpendCeilingFlaggedEmailDomain` helper returns false for `mainstream_privacy`, while `classifyEmailDomain` still detects them for trust scoring.

6c49e12dc09c72d510ee13940ea543ef19b418e5.title: Desktop auto-run agent added to free root IDs
6c49e12dc09c72d510ee13940ea543ef19b418e5.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_AUTORUN_AGENT_ID` to `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS` and `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. This fixes 402 "Out of credits" errors for free-mode Desktop users by allowing the auto-run decider to bypass metered paths and hierarchy gates. The agent is mapped to `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_MODELS` to prevent `session_model_mismatch` 403s when deciding on the tab's current model. A specific system prompt opening was added to distinguish this non-editing decider from the main coding agent.

7c219be7ef6d60e088fcfa9fcd566a798153d57b.title: FREEBUFFRESTRICTEDNOTICE replaces generic copy for flagged cohorts
7c219be7ef6d60e088fcfa9fcd566a798153d57b.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_RESTRICTED_NOTICE` and `FREEBUFF_RESTRICTED_NOTICE_REASONS` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`. Replaces generic capacity message for `privacy_egress`, `restricted_country`, `flagged_email_domain`, and `unverified_egress` reasons. `third_party_client`, `region`, `trust_level` retain blind copy. New `freebuffSpendNoticeFor` helper selects message by resolved ceiling reason.

09e160095a84086726021f1c614790d8558f8ca5.title: Add reCAPTCHA env schema and distinct block reasons
09e160095a84086726021f1c614790d8558f8ca5.summary: Added NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_V2_SITE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_V3_SITE_KEY, and NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_V2_SIZE to clientEnvSchema. Introduced recaptcha_missing and recaptcha_invalid to SignupBlockReason. These changes separate reCAPTCHA failures from Turnstile 'captcha' errors to aid debugging and support dual-version reCAPTCHA configuration.

5db7a544be7c5ec414b833a4cb295fa8511b1b8c.title: Spend ceiling hard multiplier and unverified egress reason
5db7a544be7c5ec414b833a4cb295fa8511b1b8c.summary: Added FREEBUFF_SPEND_CEILING_HARD_MULTIPLIER=2 to enforce a hard cap on small ceilings, preventing excessive overshoot for restricted/privacy reasons while sparing region/trust limits. Introduced 'unverified_egress' reason and 'skipped' provider status to handle cases where privacy checks are disabled or exhausted, mapping them to 'unverified_egress_limited' decisions. Changes affect common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts and common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts.

6e27bb24543eadf602931a09a003526915b1509c.title: Add shared capacity refusal notice
6e27bb24543eadf602931a09a003526915b1509c.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CAPACITY_NOTICE` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`. The shared string prevents leaking specific detection signals (country, domain, toolset) by ensuring identical copy for all restricted accounts. Scope is limited to shared constants, serving as the base for future UI/CLI enforcement surfaces.

871d75810e6732f65067d4bd6faec927c529332d.title: Per-account daily spend ceilings replace flat 50 USD limit
871d75810e6732f65067d4bd6faec927c529332d.summary: Added `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` to replace the flat `FREEBUFF_DAILY_SPEND_LIMIT_USD = 50` with per-account ceilings. Ceilings compose by minimum across region, restricted country, flagged email, and third-party client rules. Region ceilings set to 15 USD for full tier and 5 USD for limited tier; restricted cohorts capped at 1 USD.
