5b05edcad1c49dbfae18bb40a3a8026b8b5673c6.summary: The GLM 5.2 streak bonus shifts from milestone-based grants to live derivation from usage dates, refilling every Monday Pacific while the streak remains active. `getFreebuffStreakGlmBonusUnits` calculates the +1 session directly, removing `isFreebuffStreakMilestone` and excluding GLM from persisted daily pool rewards. This ensures the perk shuts off immediately upon streak breaks and aligns with the weekly reset cycle.

d24c97e0aa12993c710b9495edbe6315550f9910.title: Move ad user agent logic to shared common util
d24c97e0aa12993c710b9495edbe6315550f9910.summary: Extracted `getAdUserAgent` from `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` into new shared file `common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts`. This ensures all native clients send a consistent browser-like UA to ad providers, preventing fallback to runtime UAs like `Bun/<version>` which trigger fraud screening. The function now accepts an optional `platform` argument, mapping 'macos'/'windows' to 'darwin'/'win32' internally. Chrome version remains 124.0.0.0, last bumped 2026-04-21.

ef2019f26ece398825b6dbe8451e9b5aec3be563.title: Add spendlimited status to Freebuff session types and CLI
ef2019f26ece398825b6dbe8451e9b5aec3be563.summary: The `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` type in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` now includes a `spend_limited` status to signal when a user hits the daily cross-model provider-spend budget. The CLI's `use-freebuff-session.ts` hook treats this status as a terminal 429 error for new session admissions, while `app.tsx` routes it to the landing screen. Existing live sessions and reconnects remain unaffected by this budget cap.

10fb028c168f112636f95dc76cc992a67819940e.title: readfiles gains 20,000 token and 100,000 char aggregate limits
10fb028c168f112636f95dc76cc992a67819940e.summary: The read_files tool now enforces a shared 20,000 estimated-token and 100,000-character budget across all returned files, replacing the previous per-file character truncation. A new file-read-limits.ts utility implements chunked token estimation with surrogate-pair safety to prevent BPE performance issues. This change affects agents/types/tools.ts, common/src/tools/params/tool/read-files.ts, and sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts. Duplicate resolved paths are now skipped via a Set to prevent redundant budget consumption.

4ccefe89dc731502797440fa56faa60e1417f9eb.title: isExplicitlyDefinedModel moved to model-config
4ccefe89dc731502797440fa56faa60e1417f9eb.summary: isExplicitlyDefinedModel relocated from util/model-utils to constants/model-config. Removes circular dependency chain and CommonJS require in old utility path. model-utils retains compatibility re-export. Referral analytics comments and tier docs simplified; unused referral events removed from AnalyticsEvent enum.

9db53d4c2136be67ada35d5716835b1bdb6fa07d.title: Desktop root agent IDs vary by execution mode
9db53d4c2136be67ada35d5716835b1bdb6fa07d.summary: Desktop thread agent IDs now vary by execution mode (local/worktree) alongside the legacy unsuffixed ID. `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS` and `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` updated to include all variants. `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_MODELS` extracted to deduplicate picker set across variants. Legacy unsuffixed ID remains accepted for older Desktop clients.

fd7faf65bf78df2e9a52f592853b2ee7e2ead054.title: Add limitContent flag to getFiles for full file access
fd7faf65bf78df2e9a52f592853b2ee7e2ead054.summary: SDK `getFiles` now accepts `limitContent` boolean to bypass token budget truncation. `run.ts` passes `limitContent: false` to `readFiles` when preparing context for `str_replace`/`write_file`, ensuring exact matches on lines below the display limit. Default remains `true` for user-facing reads. Covers `sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts` and `sdk/src/run.ts`.

c931d187e9c094739c6acc86ec1c583dc9319d51.title: SDK adds userId delegation for trusted service accounts
c931d187e9c094739c6acc86ec1c583dc9319d51.summary: The SDK now supports `userId` delegation for trusted service accounts via `FREEBUFF_ACTING_USER_HEADER`. This allows ordinary API keys to run on behalf of a signed-in user, while `run.ts` logic prioritizes the requested `userId` over the authenticated one. Changes span `sdk/src/run.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/database.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`, and `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`. The `GetUserInfoByIdFn` contract was added to `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts` to support this flow.

ececbb77e5428cdaca12b67e331952f67b7fe267.title: freebuff 0.0.123
ececbb77e5428cdaca12b67e331952f67b7fe267.summary: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.123. Affects freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Minor version increment.

4e24162fc7e8d8a5ebc827b26c3afc48c6ed057f.title: Context pruner enforces independent role budgets
4e24162fc7e8d8a5ebc827b26c3afc48c6ed057f.summary: agents/context-pruner.ts Phase 2 now tracks separate exhaustion flags for user and assistant/tool budgets instead of a single cutoff index. This prevents one role's budget overflow from evicting entries belonging to the other role. The newest entry is explicitly unshifted into the included list if it exceeds its own role's budget, replacing the previous empty-summary fallback.

191fd58e6fbdcd4f428da59d556490c152d2361f.title: Context pruning telemetry allowlist for Axiom
191fd58e6fbdcd4f428da59d556490c152d2361f.summary: Added `axiom-only-log.ts` to allowlist `context_pruning.completed` events, bypassing standard CLI redaction to preserve numeric metadata in Axiom without shipping to PostHog. This ensures operational telemetry remains best-effort and non-blocking, separating infrastructure metrics from product analytics. The change affects `agents/context-pruner.ts` and `cli/src/utils/logger.ts`, updating log schemas to accommodate operational event names.

7dbf452bebddc6dd0ea8d46809d425a182a44753.title: Remove KAT Coder Pro V2 model
7dbf452bebddc6dd0ea8d46809d425a182a44753.summary: KAT Coder Pro V2 removed from free model picker. Upstream model deprecated. Affects common/src/constants/free-agents.ts, common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts, common/src/constants/model-config.ts. Limited-region Web users now share session pool without KAT exemption.

0fbf0d3b2edb429bb9f489b15af7022062d7e7ec.title: Add noGravityIndex flag to Base2 and GLM V52 to free agents
0fbf0d3b2edb429bb9f489b15af7022062d7e7ec.summary: Base2 agent gains `noGravityIndex` option to conditionally exclude the `gravity_index` tool and its system prompt directive. `FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID` added to `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Updates `agents/base2/base2.ts` to gate tool availability and prompt injection via the new flag.

a793b16ecd43ca8d61e002222b2c9f8f8614880b.title: Referral banner moves into model selector scrollbox
a793b16ecd43ca8d61e002222b2c9f8f8614880b.summary: The GLM referral banner now renders inside the `FreebuffModelSelector` scrollbox, joining model rows in a single navigation order. This change removes the need for the global `freebuff-landing-focus-store.ts` bridge, as focus targets are managed locally within the selector component. The landing screen logic updated to prevent full ASCII logo promotion when a referral menu is present, ensuring the scrollable menu retains necessary vertical space.

1de3f90a35a3cdef2dd3c3cbaee5d8dee637889e.title: freebuff 0.0.122 release
1de3f90a35a3cdef2dd3c3cbaee5d8dee637889e.summary: Bumped CLI release version to 0.0.122 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Minor packaging update for the freebuff npm package.

2bb0662c5dd481ddb3bb79db171548568e33e9a5.title: CLI release launcher extracted to shared core package
2bb0662c5dd481ddb3bb79db171548568e33e9a5.summary: Launcher logic for Codebuff, Codecane, and Freebuff moved to `cli/release-core/launcher.js`. Product packages now supply config to `createLauncher()`. `prepack` scripts copy `launcher.js` and `http.js` into package dirs; `postpack` removes them. No lifecycle scripts run on user install.

75c94becef9f223a3266bab4840d4594ae3e8fe8.title: response-ad-positions split first-ad offset from step
75c94becef9f223a3266bab4840d4594ae3e8fe8.summary: common/src/util/response-ad-positions.ts introduces RESPONSE_AD_FIRST_NODE_COUNT and raises RESPONSE_AD_NODE_STEP from 2 to 3. responseAdSlotCount and responseAdNodePositions accept firstAdAfterNodes, decoupling the initial ad offset from the inter-ad stride. The position formula shifts to firstAdAfterNodes - 1 + k * step. Affects core ad placement logic consumed by CLI and shared surfaces.

c4a838fedc84d87b1640d62047cc4aa7bff923b4.title: CLI release downloader adds retry and redirect hardening
c4a838fedc84d87b1640d62047cc4aa7bff923b4.summary: Updated cli/release and cli/release-staging http.js to support 303/307/308 redirects and added withRetries. index.js refactored downloadBinary into downloadAndExtract using stream/promises pipeline. Retry logic handles 408/425/429/5xx statuses and excludes EACCES/ENOSPC/EPERM/EROFS errors. Config adds downloadRequestTimeout 120000 and downloadMaxAttempts 3.

739b605e24c6307c71c81c8323b3f38563a76ec1.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite stable ID replaces preview
739b605e24c6307c71c81c8323b3f38563a76ec1.summary: Stable OpenRouter model ID `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite` replaces `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` for lightweight agent workloads. Introduced `common/src/constants/gemini.ts` exporting `GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_LITE_MODEL_ID` to centralize the string, updating `agents/basher.ts`, `agents/browser-use/browser-use.ts`, `agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts`, `agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts`, `agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts`, and `agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts`. Scope covers `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, `agents/types/agent-definition.ts`, `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/README.md`, and `sdk/README.md`. The `ModelName` union type drops the `-preview` suffix.

464115e810f97affdcebc6f7e5485d3664c6956c.title: Abort active run on chat switch to prevent transcript corruption
464115e810f97affdcebc6f7e5485d3664c6956c.summary: Chat switches (/new, /resume) now abort in-flight agent runs via new `active-run.ts` registry. Prevents orphaned runs from checkpointing or saving state into the wrong chat directory, which previously caused transcript overwrites. Scope: CLI `app.tsx`, `command-registry.ts`, `use-send-message.ts`, `run-state-storage.ts`. Detail: `flushLiveChatState` now synchronously drains pending checkpoints to their captured `chatDir` before exit, skipping live provider flush if chat has rotated.

9ef7e7f28943c8ab971309b595bafd08d00d7b3a.title: CLI installer adds HTTP proxy support and safe archive resume
9ef7e7f28943c8ab971309b595bafd08d00d7b3a.summary: Installer now supports HTTP proxies and safe resume for partial archives. `http.js` adds `HTTP_PROXY` handling and `downloadFile` with range checks. `index.js` removes `postinstall.js`, replacing it with robust download logic that detects corrupt archives and preserves existing binaries on failure. Scope covers `cli/release` and `cli/release-staging` packages.

6e2ec2feb080513c017c65cf5f6aaff9ca564a2e.title: Add parseSkillFileContent and loadSkillsSync to SDK
6e2ec2feb080513c017c65cf5f6aaff9ca564a2e.summary: The SDK now exports `parseSkillFileContent` and `loadSkillsSync` from `sdk/src/skills/load-skills.ts`. `parseSkillFileContent` isolates frontmatter parsing and validation from disk I/O, while `loadSkillFromFile` acts as a wrapper that reads the file and delegates to the parser. This change affects `sdk/src/index.ts` and `sdk/src/skills/load-skills.ts`, enabling programmatic skill validation without filesystem dependencies.

c26e125f40313cb18757411f71954c23c3b1cf5f.title: CLI inline ad banner redesign
c26e125f40313cb18757411f71954c23c3b1cf5f.summary: Redesigned the inline ad banner layout in `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx`. Changed `INLINE_AD_CARD_HEIGHT` from 3 to 4 and restructured the `AdCard` component's inline variant from a single row to a two-row column layout. The top row displays the ad title and an 'Ad' disclosure, while the bottom row shows the description and a truncated destination label if the width allows. This update aims to improve readability and visual hierarchy for inline advertisements.

47ef2af4ac5eb7f77c5ae2be02f77801fabf9490.title: CLI inline ad slot telemetry
47ef2af4ac5eb7f77c5ae2be02f77801fabf9490.summary: Added `CLI_INLINE_AD_SLOT_ELIGIBLE` and `CLI_INLINE_AD_POOL_REUSED` analytics events to track ad slot usage in the CLI. Sampling applied via `analytics-sampling.ts` to recover response-length distribution without full stream ingestion. Changes in `use-gravity-ad.ts`, `analytics-events.ts`, and `analytics-sampling.ts`.

8e3f104307089d0da674ad22011f2114b5bcf71d.title: SDK run-terminal-command adds MSYS disablepcon on Windows
8e3f104307089d0da674ad22011f2114b5bcf71d.summary: run-terminal-command.ts appends disable_pcon to MSYS env var on Windows. Prevents Git Bash descendants from allocating ConPTY despite detached/hidden flags. Preserves existing MSYS options via filter/join. Scope: SDK terminal tool.

ae87d9cee86c3c4665a0447b4c8cef653c739b76.title: Move lazy-response-ad utilities to common
ae87d9cee86c3c4665a0447b4c8cef653c739b76.summary: Ad queue and position helpers moved from `cli/src/utils/` to `common/src/util/` for shared use. `MAX_RESPONSE_AD_POOL_SIZE` capped at 4; `RESPONSE_AD_NODE_STEP` set to 2. New analytics events `DESKTOP_INLINE_AD_SLOT_ELIGIBLE` and `DESKTOP_INLINE_AD_POOL_REUSED` added. CLI files now re-export from `@codebuff/common`.

c4c5dcd66aaa42cd023a0ad0c146feacf180ebc9.title: Daily streak bonus grants +1 session every day at 7+ day streak
c4c5dcd66aaa42cd023a0ad0c146feacf180ebc9.summary: Streak reward logic in `common/src/util/freebuff-streak.ts` changed from granting bonuses only on 7-day milestones to granting a daily pool bonus every day the streak is 7+ days. The GLM 5.2 bonus remains weekly, granted only on exact milestone days. UI copy in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts` updated to reflect daily session grants. Function renamed from `streakRewardPoolsForMilestone` to `streakRewardPools`.

879cc9e68d329f65c252f1f1473f5d0b37dccd15.title: Extract think-tag stripping into util for agent runtime
879cc9e68d329f65c252f1f1473f5d0b37dccd15.summary: Refactored inline regex logic in `run-agent-step.ts` into new `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/think-tags.ts`. The new `stripThinkTags` helper now explicitly handles orphan `</think>` closes leaked by native-reasoning providers like Kimi, preventing premature turn termination. Scope limited to `agent-runtime` core; no API or user-facing behavior changes.

185d51ce8b38a5b87b260ff2abd8c5e62afd08e4.title: Freebuff CLI release version bump to 0.0.120
185d51ce8b38a5b87b260ff2abd8c5e62afd08e4.summary: Version incremented from 0.0.119 to 0.0.120 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Standard release packaging update.

33192e18252182b6f101ffe9191d2da5fb230c57.title: Kimi K2.7 Code returns to free model picker
33192e18252182b6f101ffe9191d2da5fb230c57.summary: Kimi K2.7 Code replaces K2.6 in the free model picker, restoring visibility after prior provider-side first-token stalls. The update modifies `FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to point to `moonshotModels.kimiK27Code` and inserts `KIMI_MODEL` into the `FREEBUFF_MODELS` array. Documentation in `README.md` and `freebuff/cli/release/README.md` reflects the new model name and tagline ('Best for coding'). The agent definition `agents/reviewer/code-reviewer-kimi.ts` now imports the constant instead of hardcoding the model ID, and `freebuff/SPEC.md` clarifies image attachment limitations based on multimodal support.

4beca76c6485fa3c57a3716650a0eecd996044b4.title: Add SIGNUPCREDITMINGITHUBACCOUNTAGEMONTHS constant
4beca76c6485fa3c57a3716650a0eecd996044b4.summary: Added `SIGNUP_CREDIT_MIN_GITHUB_ACCOUNT_AGE_MONTHS` to `common/src/constants/limits.ts`. Defines minimum GitHub account age in calendar months for signup credit eligibility. Google-first signups receive no signup credits.

2f0296cf9937bb0bc0256849868e81c193f0f472.title: Lazy inline ad pools replace 8-ad batch fetch in CLI
2f0296cf9937bb0bc0256849868e81c193f0f472.summary: CLI chat now lazily fills a bounded four-ad pool per assistant message instead of fetching a fixed batch of eight ads per prompt. This change reduces unnecessary ad requests by fetching ads on-demand only when the renderer detects eligible transcript slots. Scope covers `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, `cli/src/components/blocks/blocks-renderer.tsx`, and new utility `cli/src/utils/lazy-response-ads.ts`. The renderer repeats the full pool if response length exceeds distinct ad count, while the rotating above-input slot remains separate for reporting continuity.

1d64a9f44880ccf58e335af1efb24a93ec923831.title: Fix terminal focus detection via CSI regex
1d64a9f44880ccf58e335af1efb24a93ec923831.summary: Replaced naive substring checks with regex `FOCUS_EVENT_RE` to match complete CSI focus sequences (`ESC [ I` and `ESC [ O`). This prevents unrelated bytes in batched stdin chunks from triggering false focus events. Added `parseFocusState` to determine net focus state from the last event in a chunk and track `lastReported` state to avoid re-renders from repeated identical events. Covers `cli/src/hooks/use-terminal-focus.ts`.

e1ce92184215843f83e268d758011594a4a0c8a5.title: cloneSessionState replaces cloneDeep in SDK checkpoint snapshots
e1ce92184215843f83e268d758011594a4a0c8a5.summary: New cloneSessionState helper in sdk/src/run.ts replaces cloneDeep for checkpoint snapshots. JSON round-trip on mainAgentState cuts copy cost from ~230ms to ~4ms on large sessions, preventing CLI render-thread freezes during 5s in-flight snapshots. fileContext is shared by reference; fallback to cloneDeep handles circular refs or BigInt.

633c256122a18c49ab89171fbcf977a4370c4658.title: gravity-ad request body omits surface field when null
633c256122a18c49ab89171fbcf977a4370c4658.summary: use-gravity-ad.ts conditionally spreads the surface field into the JSON request body, omitting it entirely when null or undefined. Previously, the field defaulted to 'chat' in the payload. This change prevents sending an explicit surface value when one is not provided by the caller.

d049aa594eaa6ffe79276ee9358921814f6e3077.title: DynamicAgentTemplateSchema accepts spawnagentinline and handleSteps
d049aa594eaa6ffe79276ee9358921814f6e3077.summary: DynamicAgentTemplateSchema refine rule now permits 'spawn_agent_inline' tool or programmatic 'handleSteps' generator when spawnableAgents is non-empty. Previously required only 'spawn_agents' tool in toolNames. Covers common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts. Error message updated to mention handleSteps alternative for spawnableAgents validation.

af893569c95a1986af346b999206f467f2729e53.title: .gitignore adds .freebuff/ desktop runtime state
af893569c95a1986af346b999206f467f2729e53.summary: Added .freebuff/ to .gitignore to exclude Freebuff Desktop local runtime state (SQLite DB, git worktrees, materialized built-in skills). These files are generated at runtime and should not be tracked in source control.

b01c3662b93cb30efaf48dd1e2581326fc8a31f4.title: FREEBUFFWEBLIMITEDPROJECTDAILYLIMIT increased to 3
b01c3662b93cb30efaf48dd1e2581326fc8a31f4.summary: FREEBUFF_WEB_LIMITED_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT constant in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts raised from 1 to 3. Limits daily project creation for outer-region Freebuff Web users. Resets at midnight Pacific time.

bd3b19ed76cf17a16e45df2e329ee5e84b7b6883.title: run-terminal-command always uses detached process group
bd3b19ed76cf17a16e45df2e329ee5e84b7b6883.summary: run-terminal-command.ts now sets detached: true unconditionally, replacing the previous !isWindows check. This ensures POSIX commands run in their own process group for reliable timeout/abort cleanup of grandchildren. On Windows, the flag maps to DETACHED_PROCESS, which combined with windowsHide (CREATE_NO_WINDOW) fully detaches the child from the parent's console. This prevents console-attached descendants from stealing VT input from ConPTY and painting gibberish over the TUI.

a4b9f8de17a56af3e9a90753bcdfe9858f9a3a4d.title: Add session model admission guards and trusted acting-user header
a4b9f8de17a56af3e9a90753bcdfe9858f9a3a4d.summary: New session admission helpers (isFreebuffSessionModelId, resolveFreebuffSessionModelForAccessTier) enforce model access for CLI/Desktop/Web/Cloud. A trusted x-freebuff-acting-user-id header is added for server-to-server calls, restricted to the Codebuff API when authenticating as the Freebuff Web service account. Three new model IDs (HY3, HY3 Atlas, Kat Coder Pro V2) are registered in free-agents.ts. The admission logic accepts the union of supported and Web-only model IDs without altering the CLI picker.

758fdbfedc1bd8c31dee38e5fdf17ae71b7cb67c.title: Async coalescing checkpoint saves fix CLI freezes
758fdbfedc1bd8c31dee38e5fdf17ae71b7cb67c.summary: CLI periodic state snapshots now persist asynchronously via scheduleCheckpointSave, replacing synchronous saveChatState calls in use-send-message.ts. This prevents render/input thread stalls caused by multi-MB transcript serialization during long sessions. run-state-storage.ts introduces coalescing logic to drop intermediate states, while write-file-atomic.ts adds writeFileAtomicAsync and unique temp suffixes using randomUUID to prevent race conditions between sync exit-flushes and async checkpoints.

d2ae8a0dc59e09d6a13717590ebdd0fd9e2b3dfa.title: ChatHeader component and bounded output buffer
d2ae8a0dc59e09d6a13717590ebdd0fd9e2b3dfa.summary: Extracted logo and sheen animation logic into new `cli/src/components/chat-header.tsx`. Added `enabled` prop to `useSheenAnimation` to control animation state. Implemented `BoundedOutputBuffer` in `sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts` to cap memory usage during command execution by retaining only head and tail segments. Updated `cli/src/chat.tsx` to manage header visibility based on scroll position.

081bdb229790aa903da4ba4462827ba867139ff3.title: freebuff-referral-banner.tsx border color switch
081bdb229790aa903da4ba4462827ba867139ff3.summary: Updated `borderColor` from `theme.primary` to `theme.muted` in `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx`. Aligns banner styling with the muted theme palette.

9e48fc62b994946fb6f5412439bc458c0c222904.title: KAT Coder Pro V2 added to web model picker
9e48fc62b994946fb6f5412439bc458c0c222904.summary: KAT Coder Pro V2 (`kwaipilot/kat-coder-pro-v2`) added to `FREEBUFF_WEB_MODELS` and premium lists. HY3 tagline changed to 'Trialing its performance' and marked premium. `kwaipilot` prefix allowed; KAT model non-cacheable. Files: `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, `common/src/constants/model-config.ts`.

d0de3f5b1cbd70534b9d6c36f0dfc9c77ae8f92b.title: Add experimental model flag and cloud CTA analytics event
d0de3f5b1cbd70534b9d6c36f0dfc9c77ae8f92b.summary: Adds optional `experimental` boolean to `FreebuffModelOption` interface and sets it to `true` for `HY3_MODEL`, `HY3_ATLAS_MODEL`, and `KAT_CODER_PRO_V2_MODEL` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Introduces `FREEBUFF_CLOUD_CONNECT_REPO_CLICKED` event in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` to track cloud landing page CTA interactions. The experimental flag drives a 'TEST' badge in the UI picker to indicate models are not yet production-grade.

6ab789012e6e8f3f43e22246828cb88f0c7a0a80.title: Add Tencent HY3 paid model constant
6ab789012e6e8f3f43e22246828cb88f0c7a0a80.summary: Adds FREEBUFF_HY3_OPENROUTER_PAID_MODEL_ID and openrouter_tencent_hy3 to shared constants. Defines the paid 'tencent/hy3' identifier alongside the existing free variant. Updates common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and common/src/constants/model-config.ts.

4afa065433a1f7c99574755052324ab24fc7bd1c.title: HY3 added to Web-only model picker
4afa065433a1f7c99574755052324ab24fc7bd1c.summary: HY3 model support added to Freebuff Web surfaces via `FREEBUFF_WEB_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. `HY3` and `HY3 Atlas` variants defined, but excluded from `FREEBUFF_MODELS` to prevent CLI/Desktop pickup during initial rollout. `common/src/constants/model-config.ts` updated with `tencent` prefix, `openrouter_tencent_hy3_free`, and `atlasCloudModels.tencentHy3` entries.

25bcff7a78ced153e5d55e161619e48ffdb74ddb.title: Add CLI install copy analytics event
25bcff7a78ced153e5d55e161619e48ffdb74ddb.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CLI_INSTALL_COMMAND_COPIED` enum value to `AnalyticsEvent` in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Tracks when users copy the install command on the CLI landing page (`/cli`). Distinguishes hero vs install section via `location` property and serves as a proxy for install intent since CLI activation lacks direct web identity linkage.

d0b938bca49fdf28e96d4a4079bcf350946b2f6f.title: Simplify Buffy system prompt, remove dead isSonnet flag
d0b938bca49fdf28e96d4a4079bcf350946b2f6f.summary: Buffy system prompt in agents/base2/base2.ts collapses Core Mandates and Code Editing Mandates into single General guidelines block. Removed dead isSonnet boolean. Added conditional <think> tag instruction for default/max modes. Free mode text now references Freebuff instead of Codebuff. Scope limited to base2 agent prompt construction.

4fe98d8c048b271a57a32a41c6e79a114f39cb93.title: freebuff 0.0.119 release
4fe98d8c048b271a57a32a41c6e79a114f39cb93.summary: Version bump to 0.0.119. Scope limited to freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No functional code changes.

05e61796b1e972e04d7ab08ff3ec77fa2d6808ce.title: Pass apiKey to token count API in run-agent-step
05e61796b1e972e04d7ab08ff3ec77fa2d6808ce.summary: Explicitly pass params.apiKey to callTokenCountAPI in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts. Fixes failure of web API context token count checks for interactive CLI users lacking CODEBUFF_API_KEY in environment, which previously forced fallback to less accurate local estimates. Scope limited to agent runtime step loop.

0deed0f9ae60e3d338e71d7077fe4180e21277f4.title: Windows terminal watchdog drops EncodedCommand
0deed0f9ae60e3d338e71d7077fe4180e21277f4.summary: The Windows terminal watchdog now invokes powershell.exe with plain `-Command` text instead of `-EncodedCommand` base64 payloads. This change prevents the CLI from triggering EDR/AV heuristics that flag encoded PowerShell spawns while keeping command lines auditable in process listings. The reset payload is now serialized as a numeric byte array to maintain the no-double-quote invariant required for safe quoting. Additionally, `stopTerminalWatchdog` now nullifies the disarm path if the child process fails to spawn, preventing orphaned disarm files.

bc264d00cf190d86d2953e9937afc68c3b371446.title: Add GLM V52 to Web picker, hy3/kat root agent IDs, quota header
bc264d00cf190d86d2953e9937afc68c3b371446.summary: GLM_V52_MODEL added to FREEBUFF_WEB_MODELS. 'base2-free-hy3', 'base2-free-hy3-atlas', and 'base2-free-kat-coder-pro-v2' added to FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS to prevent 403 subagent spawn failures in trial runs. New FREEBUFF_INCLUDE_UNUSED_RATE_LIMITS_HEADER allows Web/Cloud pickers to request zero-usage quota snapshots for accurate session labels, with optional referral info added to FreebuffSessionServerResponse types.

fd36250a7af2416544869fa2694916edfd81b6d2.title: runner tsconfig maps @codebuff/sdk to source
fd36250a7af2416544869fa2694916edfd81b6d2.summary: Added path mapping for @codebuff/sdk to ../../sdk/src/index.ts in freebuff/runner/tsconfig.json. This ensures typecheck works without a prior sdk build, matching cli/tsconfig.json behavior. Scope: runner tsconfig. Detail: CI runs from a fresh checkout with no dist, so source mapping avoids build dependency.

07ab1c6445e0e36697f749f10d34eccea254b5e5.title: Structured logging for freebuff/runner via @codebuff/logging
07ab1c6445e0e36697f749f10d34eccea254b5e5.summary: Replaces ad-hoc console logs in the runner with structured logging via a new logger.ts module and @codebuff/logging dependency. Captures lifecycle, error, and event batcher logs with consistent JSON payloads, including runId and runnerId, shipping to Axiom if configured. Updates README with required Axiom environment variables.

304f8c16ed581066ab94ad28f4f3d6ab3642865f.title: Skip code review agent in free mode when noReview is set
304f8c16ed581066ab94ad28f4f3d6ab3642865f.summary: Free mode agent prompt now checks `noReview` flag before spawning `freeCodeReviewerAgentId`. When `noReview` is true, only bashers for typechecking and testing run in parallel. Scope limited to `agents/base2/base2.ts`. Logic ensures review step and subsequent fix instructions are omitted only when explicitly disabled.

778ce13d412dcf87de7eec8b2732d27aa9c35c3a.title: Structured token counting replaces JSON.stringify in Agent Runtime
778ce13d412dcf87de7eec8b2732d27aa9c35c3a.summary: Agent Runtime switches from `countTokensJson` to `countTokensMessages` for message history and `countTokens` for system prompts. `JSON.stringify` inflated counts by treating image base64 as text and adding JSON envelope overhead; `countTokensMessages` counts structured content (text, tool inputs/results) with a flat 1600-token image cost and 8-token per-message overhead. `countTokensJson` now handles `undefined` via `?? ''` fallback. Applies to `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/token-counter.ts`, `run-agent-step.ts`, and `messages.ts`.

f0d966458519ffa59de0fbce27fad27f0ac7a047.title: Remove freebuff/runner Render worker package
f0d966458519ffa59de0fbce27fad27f0ac7a047.summary: Deleted `freebuff/runner` package (README, `package.json`, `src/convexBridge.ts`, `src/eventBatcher.ts`, `src/executeClaudeCode.ts` and 8 more files). This removes the off-Convex Render worker that executed agent turns via `codebuff` SDK harness, streaming batched events through `recordRunEventBatch` and managing transient-failure HTTP retries for `RunnerCtx` bridge operations. Scope limited to `freebuff/runner/` directory; no changes to `convex/` or `web/` surfaces. The `freebuff_runner_enabled` feature flag and associated `runner_bridge` mutations remain in `convex/` but now have no consumer.

0a6df5765585fe3da17d92272fbce28be74bc127.title: Inline ads intersperse within CLI assistant responses
0a6df5765585fe3da17d92272fbce28be74bc127.summary: Inline ads now auction per-prompt and intersperse between rendered blocks in assistant responses, replacing the static transcript anchoring. The rotating above-input ad remains but auctions separately, keeping legacy placement id `Single-Ad-Unit-1` for reporting continuity. Changes span `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` (batch logic), `cli/src/components/blocks/blocks-renderer.tsx` (rendering), and `cli/src/utils/response-ad-positions.ts` (new position calc). Ad count scales with response length (0-8), and positions stabilize once a following node exists.

48803a249a48035e7f3c3041d5f704b233720a4c.title: Add windowsHide true to SDK terminal command spawning
48803a249a48035e7f3c3041d5f704b233720a4c.summary: Added windowsHide: true to child process options in run-terminal-command.ts. Prevents Windows console-attached descendants from stealing VT input from the TUI's ConPTY, eliminating gibberish echoes like ^[[I^[[<35;12;7M. Scope limited to SDK terminal tool execution.

2a0165cd6654c96138ebf48279da6271d3edb8d9.title: Harden type backfill in run-agent-step.ts
2a0165cd6654c96138ebf48279da6271d3edb8d9.summary: The type backfill logic in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` now treats missing, null, and empty-string `type` values as absent. This ensures Anthropic's `type: 'object'` requirement is met for union/intersection schemas lacking a valid type. Scope is limited to the agent runtime schema conversion.

e40725574901bc9196b956db9113351627654769.title: MiniMax M2.7 removed from free agent modes
e40725574901bc9196b956db9113351627654769.summary: Free and lite modes now exclusively route to MiniMax M3, removing the legacy M2.7 model ID from constants, agent definitions, and context pruner logic. This change consolidates free-tier model selection and drops support for the deprecated 'Fastest' MiniMax variant, updating root and reviewer agent mappings in `free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`. The `code-reviewer-minimax.ts` file is deleted, and context length constraints for M2.7 are removed from `base2.ts`.

04d67d73b9052e63dead5ad1a6cf6bbe76c4cd2e.title: Kimi model removed from FREEBUFFMODELS
04d67d73b9052e63dead5ad1a6cf6bbe76c4cd2e.summary: KIMI_MODEL removed from FREEBUFF_MODELS array in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Eliminates Kimi from default free model picker list. Affects Shared/Core constants, propagating to Web, CLI, and Desktop surfaces. Requires no migration; existing sessions unaffected.

10ec4e5ad003a6c5bd72ba98ad322469581d3d69.title: SDK tools drop project-root confinement
10ec4e5ad003a6c5bd72ba98ad322469581d3d69.summary: Removed path traversal guards from `apply-patch`, `change-file`, `code-search`, `list-directory`, `read-files`. Replaced `resolveFilePathWithinProject` with `resolveFilePath`, allowing absolute and outside-project paths. `isWithinProject` flag added to `ResolvedFilePath` type to gate project-scoped logic like gitignore checks. `read-files` now skips gitignore filtering for external paths.

5ab9f24e10c3cafc301fe1eb3838c0c54008806f.title: Convert Zod tool schemas to JSON Schema for Anthropic token counting
5ab9f24e10c3cafc301fe1eb3838c0c54008806f.summary: Added `toTokenCountInputSchema` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` to convert Zod `inputSchema` to JSON Schema before sending to Anthropic's `count_tokens` API. Raw Zod serialization previously shipped internals like `def`/`shape`, causing inaccurate token counts and `tools.N.custom.input_schema.type: Field required` errors for union/intersection schemas lacking a top-level `type`. The fix uses `z.toJSONSchema` with `io: 'input'`, strips `$schema`, and backfills `type: 'object'` if missing.

dc8f236d73ec651b392b4dbb09a8826258f12666.title: Reddit CAPI first-prompt and retention events added
dc8f236d73ec651b392b4dbb09a8826258f12666.summary: New Reddit Conversions API integration fires first-prompt and retention milestone events. Core files `reddit-capi.ts`, `reddit-capi-events.ts`, and `reddit-freebuff-retention.ts` handle token validation, event mapping, and date logic. Analytics enum `FREEBUFF_REDDIT_FUNNEL_FIRST_PROMPT` splits into CLI/Web/Chat variants plus new 1d/7d/24d retention keys. Events fire fire-and-forget; no-op if `accessToken` unset or non-prod.

30819406bcc40a132d363f3ac2bceb285ad06031.title: CLI prompt builders accept ChatGPT connection status callback
30819406bcc40a132d363f3ac2bceb285ad06031.summary: Refactor `buildPlanPrompt` and `buildReviewPrompt` to accept an optional `isChatGptConnected` callback. This allows injecting connection state for testing or custom logic instead of relying on global `getChatGptOAuthStatus`. `routeUserPrompt` also accepts an `exchangeChatGptAuthCode` callback for similar testability improvements. Scope: `cli/src/commands/prompt-builders.ts`, `cli/src/commands/router.ts`.

fe1d484e63713352e7fa5bbc033a1171fbed39c7.title: CLI chat history and trace writer support custom data directories
fe1d484e63713352e7fa5bbc033a1171fbed39c7.summary: Functions `getAllChats`, `trimOversizedChatLogs`, and `deleteChatSession` in `chat-history.ts` now accept an optional `dataDir` argument, overriding the default project data directory. `createTraceWriter` in `trace-writer.ts` accepts a custom `resolveTraceFilePath` callback. This allows external tools or tests to target specific chat and trace storage locations without changing global state.

f7828c2c4b5a55de46b00f0484ed047e091d0964.title: freebuff/runner package added
f7828c2c4b5a55de46b00f0484ed047e091d0964.summary: New `@codebuff/freebuff-runner` package. Moves agent execution from Convex actions to a long-lived Bun worker. Uses `convexBridge.ts` for HTTP calls and `eventBatcher.ts` for stream deltas. Requires `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` and `CODEBUFF_API_KEY`. Deploy worker before enabling `freebuff_runner_enabled` flag.

e8a95a27ac79ae26a56a5fa8d8e9904471ec4423.title: Agent runtime skips token-count API for free mode
e8a95a27ac79ae26a56a5fa8d8e9904471ec4423.summary: Added `isFreeMode` check to bypass token-count web API in free mode. Prevents serial overhead and reduces web-service load. Paid Codebuff runs retain accurate API counts. Implemented in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`.

7f595c4c0634c855c18f0cfb325c173392e3bd61.title: CLI waiting-room copy replaced by session-admission messaging
7f595c4c0634c855c18f0cfb325c173392e3bd61.summary: Waiting-room UI strings removed from CLI boot signals and e2e helpers; `waiting_room_queued` now surfaces 'Your free session is still being set up' instead of queue copy. Sessions admit immediately, so the legacy 429 code only fires in a transient race with a concurrent session request. Error-code names stay `waiting_room_*` for wire compatibility. Scope: `cli/scripts/smoke-binary.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts`, `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`, `freebuff/e2e/utils/freebuff-session.ts`.

030a4c60e51b5da6ad04a6ac3e3470a7ce53b874.title: Add chat ads experiment analytics events
030a4c60e51b5da6ad04a6ac3e3470a7ce53b874.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CHAT_ADS_EXPERIMENT_EXPOSED` and `FREEBUFF_CHAT_ADS_AD_SHOWN` to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. These events track the server-rendered Gravity ads experiment on the web `/chat` page, bucketing users by ID to compare against the existing inline slot. Both events include `experiment` and `variant` properties to enable PostHog breakdowns of exposure and CTR.

afc82b86ff83681ec1cf4e282c9cf930f7806eac.title: freebuff CLI 0.0.118 release
afc82b86ff83681ec1cf4e282c9cf930f7806eac.summary: Version bump to 0.0.118 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Internal packaging update. No user-facing changes.

f8b3b17b3ed642b2fb5d7bea14d33db9aa340651.title: CLI waiting-room surface renamed to landing screen
f8b3b17b3ed642b2fb5d7bea14d33db9aa340651.summary: Renamed `WaitingRoomScreen` to `FreebuffLandingScreen` and `joinFreebuffQueue` to `startFreebuffSession` across CLI components and hooks. Updates internal state labels, comments, and UI text to reflect the direct session start flow rather than queueing. The `surface` identifier in the ads API request remains hardcoded as `waiting_room` to preserve backend placement mapping. No user-facing behavior changes; purely a naming refactor.

3d1a8e68f275183a92cfbb5100a2528bd5ce4c79.title: CLI terminal watchdog and kitty keyboard protocol reset sequences
3d1a8e68f275183a92cfbb5100a2528bd5ce4c79.summary: Added `cli/src/utils/terminal-watchdog.ts` and `cli/src/utils/terminal-reset-sequences.ts` to handle terminal state cleanup during uncatchable process deaths. The watchdog spawns a detached `/bin/sh` process that resets terminal escape sequences (including new kitty keyboard protocol `[<u` and modifyOtherKeys `[>4;0m` flags) if the CLI dies via SIGKILL or native crash. `cli/src/index.tsx` starts the watchdog before renderer initialization and `cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts` synchronously kills it during clean shutdown to prevent race conditions. Release scripts `cli/release/index.js`, `cli/release-staging/index.js`, and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js` updated with matching `SAFE_TERMINAL_RESET_SEQUENCES` to maintain sync with OpenTUI's enabled modes.

bd166f455bc3bee08e35e0cc212e4da6fbbe4f15.title: Wrap fetch to retry transient network errors
bd166f455bc3bee08e35e0cc212e4da6fbbe4f15.summary: Global fetch wrapped in `fetchWithRetryableNetworkErrors` to rethrow transient connection failures (socket closed/reset, connection refused) as retryable `APICallError`s. This fixes Bun's plain Error throws being ignored by AI SDK's auto-retry logic, enabling exponential backoff for brief network blips. Scope includes `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`, `common/src/util/error.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, and `sdk/src/run.ts`. `isTransientNetworkError` detects specific message substrings and error codes to distinguish dropped connections from server errors.

8151087175d6205542190ed092126bdd19ae4130.title: CLI requeue messages on freebuff session end
8151087175d6205542190ed092126bdd19ae4130.summary: CLI adds `addToQueueFront` and `requeueMessageAtFront` to hold messages at the queue head when a freebuff session ends unexpectedly. `handleFreebuffGateError` now surfaces inline errors if `hasReceivedContent` is false, preventing silent prompt consumption. `getFreebuffInstanceId` refactors to use `holdsLiveFreebuffSlot` to prevent state drift during server-side grace windows. Logging for blocked queues moves to `use-chat-streaming.ts` to log transitions once instead of per render.

f65992d39adda73162606b55c07b364ca8afa181.title: 20s timeout added to CLI session fetch
f65992d39adda73162606b55c07b364ca8afa181.summary: Added `sessionFetchSignal` helper in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` to combine caller abort signals with a 20s `AbortSignal.timeout`. Applied to `callSession` fetch calls. Prevents hung requests from pinning the landing screen spinner indefinitely by forcing a timeout and rescheduling on error.

4ea700cd6ebb12e204b37095f477a2e8fd5955b5.title: Add DESKTOPQUEUESENDNOW analytics event
4ea700cd6ebb12e204b37095f477a2e8fd5955b5.summary: Added `DESKTOP_QUEUE_SEND_NOW` enum value in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. This event tracks when users trigger the 'send now' action from the desktop queue. Scope limited to shared core constants; desktop client implementation will consume this new event identifier.

cee618d4b5a9d00053d9955262595b276fd7ea1e.title: Message queue holds sends when Freebuff session ends
cee618d4b5a9d00053d9955262595b276fd7ea1e.summary: CLI message queue now gates dequeuing on `holdsLiveFreebuffSlot` to prevent rejected sends after session expiry. `use-chat-streaming.ts` computes `sendBlocked` and passes it to `useMessageQueue`, which halts processing while retaining queued items. `use-freebuff-session.ts` exports the slot predicate, replacing internal `shouldReleaseSlot`. Queued work automatically resumes when the session becomes active again.

22aa19aade611c31aff555cc55f280c653910fe7.title: Refactor SDK runtime URL resolution into getRuntimeAppUrlFromEnv
22aa19aade611c31aff555cc55f280c653910fe7.summary: Extracts `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` and `CODEBUFF_APP_URL` lookup logic from `getWebsiteUrl` into a new exported helper `getRuntimeAppUrlFromEnv` in `sdk/src/env.ts`. This centralizes runtime override handling for remote hosts bundling the SDK, preventing bundle-time localhost URL inlining issues. The change affects `sdk/src/constants.ts` and `sdk/src/env.ts`, updating the internal resolution mechanism while preserving existing behavior.

671c093077dc5cd74ab2b1892c7c134d84c8fbd8.title: Chat history sidecar metadata and full transcript retention
671c093077dc5cd74ab2b1892c7c134d84c8fbd8.summary: CLI chat history now uses a sidecar `chat-meta.json` to list chats without parsing full transcripts, and `send-message.ts` stops trimming message arrays to 100 items. `chat-history.ts` prefers `readChatMeta` for speed, falling back to full file parsing if the sidecar is missing or stale (size/mtime mismatch). `run-state-storage.ts` writes the sidecar atomically after messages and cleans it up in `clearChatState`.

4f5a72d6b85c9521b28248e359c11719cf6d55c4.title: Add shared log-data serialization util
4f5a72d6b85c9521b28248e359c11719cf6d55c4.summary: Added `common/src/util/log-data.ts` with `LOG_LEVEL_ORDER` and `serializeLogData` to unify Axiom log-row pipelines across sinks and Convex. Prevents circular ref crashes and enforces `MAX_LOG_DATA_BYTES` caps. Updated `analytics-events.ts` docs to clarify `MESSAGE_SENT` emission points and add `cloud` to valid `surface` values.

a07d73d1f0bdd5f9c47d64423d3837d59bcb2309.title: SDK resolves Codebuff backend URL at call time
a07d73d1f0bdd5f9c47d64423d3837d59bcb2309.summary: SDK exposes getWebsiteUrl() to resolve the Codebuff backend base URL at call time, replacing the bundle-time WEBSITE_URL constant. This prevents esbuild from inlining a dev-machine localhost URL into remote runtimes (Convex Node actions, Next server routes), which cannot reach it. Deployment process.env NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL or CODEBUFF_APP_URL wins over the bundled value when present. Files: sdk/src/constants.ts, client.ts, composio.ts, impl/agent-runtime.ts, impl/database.ts, impl/model-provider.ts, validate-agents.ts.

77cfee986c1b3e6fd7fffc5b37bb7c4028a30446.title: AbortSignal support for SDK tools
77cfee986c1b3e6fd7fffc5b37bb7c4028a30446.summary: Added `signal` parameter to `code_search`, `read_url`, and `run_terminal_command` in the SDK. This allows user interrupts to cancel fetches, kill ripgrep, and terminate terminal processes. Terminal commands on POSIX now spawn detached in their own process group to ensure grandchild processes are killed on abort or timeout, with a grace period between SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

85ccc41bab5e0ee15d2cd97f2230055f4f2984b2.title: Add occupiesFreebuffDesktopSlot helper for multi-session concurrency
85ccc41bab5e0ee15d2cd97f2230055f4f2984b2.summary: Adds `occupiesFreebuffDesktopSlot` helper in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to unify one-tab logic for LIMITED and FULL tiers. Updates `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` with optional `reason: 'concurrent_sessions'` to distinguish tab limits from quota limits. Scope limited to Shared/Core types and constants. Limited tier users now get one tab regardless of model, enforced by shared helper.

effaebabd70b475f18cd90481cc6cbc88c5ff9e3.title: CLI checkpoints in-flight turns to prevent loss on crash or exit
effaebabd70b475f18cd90481cc6cbc88c5ff9e3.summary: The CLI now synchronously checkpoints chat state to disk immediately upon sending a message and periodically during streaming via `onStateSnapshot` in the SDK. This ensures that if the process is killed or the terminal closes mid-run, the user's prompt and partial agent progress are preserved rather than lost. The implementation relies on new owner-guarded providers in `run-state-storage.ts` to prevent stale runs from overwriting newer state, and `sanitizeRestoredMessages` in `send-message-helpers.ts` to mark interrupted AI responses as complete with an interruption notice on restart. Changes span `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, `cli/src/utils/create-run-config.ts`, and `sdk/src/run.ts`.

c59bde7fe2f90f0e25b0ce36a1d8856ec8ccfa5f.title: CLI inline ads and Windows terminal watchdog support
c59bde7fe2f90f0e25b0ce36a1d8856ec8ccfa5f.summary: Inline ads interleave into the CLI chat transcript via `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, replacing the rotating `ads[0]` slot with `placedAds` anchored to completed messages. The `AdSurface` type adds `'cli_chat'` alongside `'waiting_room'`, requiring strict alignment with the server's `AD_SURFACES` enum. Placement logic uses `AI_MESSAGE_ID_PREFIX` from the new `cli/src/utils/ai-message-id.ts` to detect finished turns, ensuring ads appear after answers complete rather than mid-stream. Terminal watchdog in `cli/src/utils/terminal-watchdog.ts` now supports Windows via PowerShell, and `cli/src/types/env.ts` exposes `SystemRoot` for path resolution.

fe8de7d67497f25e3d80567e07554ae28a82a6e0.title: Version bump to 0.0.117
fe8de7d67497f25e3d80567e07554ae28a82a6e0.summary: Package version updated to 0.0.117 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Reflects standard release increment.

b10e9ab1644601375492fa771f2acd2088b27429.title: Merge assistant messages in OpenAI-compatible converter
b10e9ab1644601375492fa771f2acd2088b27429.summary: Assistant message merging added to convertToOpenAICompatibleChatMessages. Fixes DeepSeek V4 validation errors by keeping reasoning_content and tool_calls on the same wire message. Metadata unions use later-wins precedence. Scope limited to packages/llm-providers/src/openai-compatible/chat/convert-to-openai-compatible-chat-messages.ts.

d304465cf1503c0d27dc79e6ffaf252657fe922c.title: Desktop ad impression and click tracking
d304465cf1503c0d27dc79e6ffaf252657fe922c.summary: Added `DESKTOP_AD_SHOWN` and `DESKTOP_AD_CLICKED` to `AnalyticsEvent` in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Enables client-side desktop funnels for sponsored ads interspersed into the transcript. Server-side `ads_*` events in `web/api/v1/ads` handle the fetch/impression/click ledger; these new enums track the desktop UI surface.

b5b0f9c223124e9746e9faa8d3d5e96978262dc9.title: freebuff CLI 0.0.116
b5b0f9c223124e9746e9faa8d3d5e96978262dc9.summary: Bumped version to 0.0.116 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Minor release iteration.

e6af6ff08ba0ed02b362aae22b208e554fd5f74a.title: handleStepsFn preserves live function across agent runtime
e6af6ff08ba0ed02b362aae22b208e554fd5f74a.summary: Added handleStepsFn to AgentTemplate and DynamicAgentTemplate schemas to retain the live function alongside its stringified form. The runtime now prefers handleStepsFn over eval'd strings to prevent ReferenceErrors from out-of-scope bundler helpers. Covers common types, agent-runtime, and SDK loaders. JSON serialization drops the function field automatically.

55f61ffc60b73ecdfb31f8d649e85e4ff3086c0b.title: Freebuff CLI referral banner now supports limited-tier daily bonus
55f61ffc60b73ecdfb31f8d649e85e4ff3086c0b.summary: Referral banner logic updated to support limited-tier users earning daily free-session bonuses, not just full-tier GLM unlocks. The `FreebuffReferralInfo` type now makes `weeklySessionsRemaining` and `resetAt` optional, while `qualifiedCount` represents the capped bonus sessions for limited tiers. The CLI branches on `accessTier` to render either the GLM card or a quiet muted line for limited users. Layout height calculations in `waiting-room-screen.tsx` adjusted to prevent banner squashing in limited-tier mode.

f67bb803bda67f875fd14647d3f3458e56e732fb.title: Refactor eval to deserializeHandleSteps
f67bb803bda67f875fd14647d3f3458e56e732fb.summary: Introduce `deserializeHandleSteps` helper in `run-programmatic-step.ts` to replace direct `eval` calls for string-based `handleSteps` templates. This isolates deserialization logic and improves type safety via `HandleStepsFn`. Scope limited to `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`. The helper casts `eval` to a typed function to safely return the generator.

bfaad48713d14b4e948a6ad49a2c6f79d6cb250c.title: Add FREEBUFFREFERRALREDEEMFAILED and FREEBUFFREFERRALSOCKSIGNAL
bfaad48713d14b4e948a6ad49a2c6f79d6cb250c.summary: Added two new enum values to AnalyticsEvent in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts: FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_REDEEM_FAILED and FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SOCK_SIGNAL. FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_REDEEM_FAILED captures redemption attempts blocked by one-shot eligibility guards (signup_too_old, user_banned, referrer_limit_reached, reverse_referral, self_referral), excluding repeat-prone invalid_code and already_referred errors to prevent log spam. FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SOCK_SIGNAL flags referrals where the referred user shares an IP or browser with the referrer, serving as corroborating evidence for fraud detection rather than a standalone verdict.

122933fd79cf8b99c6346050f96fc8dc56649141.title: CLI login constants import shared host
122933fd79cf8b99c6346050f96fc8dc56649141.summary: CLI login flow uses shared `FREEBUFF_WEB_URL_PROD` constant from `common/src/constants/hosts.ts` instead of hardcoded URL. `tsconfig.json` adds `@codebuff/common/*` path mapping to resolve the import. Scope limited to CLI and shared core constants.

b88380a4c48c5a1dfe12d788f62d794c5df7db57.title: CLI: atomic chat writes, corrupt history surfacing, chat id rotation
b88380a4c48c5a1dfe12d788f62d794c5df7db57.summary: Chat state saves now use `writeFileAtomic` (temp file + rename) instead of direct `writeFileSync`, preventing truncated `chat-messages.json` from crashes/kills mid-write. `getAllChats` catches parse failures and lists them with `unreadable: true` in `/history` instead of silently dropping them; selection blocks resume with a status message, deletion still works. New chat and `/clear` now call `startNewChat()` to rotate the chat id, preventing overwrites of the previous conversation's directory. Covers CLI `app.tsx`, `command-registry.ts`, `chat-history-screen.tsx`, `chat-history.ts`, `run-state-storage.ts`, and new `write-file-atomic.ts`.

6937a4a1d869a5d878d178a2c3b57d4ae6f75562.title: Add DESKTOPTHREADTITLED analytics event
6937a4a1d869a5d878d178a2c3b57d4ae6f75562.summary: Added `DESKTOP_THREAD_TITLED` enum value to `AnalyticsEvent` in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Enables tracking of desktop thread title updates. Scope limited to shared core constants.

03843a6a7999022e6a7cb133ae6a3d5e8bd851f5.title: Add referral signup window and limit constants
03843a6a7999022e6a7cb133ae6a3d5e8bd851f5.summary: Hoists `REFERRAL_SIGNUP_WINDOW_DAYS` (30) and `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SIGNUP_LIMIT` (100) into `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts`. The window constant prevents attribution of pre-existing accounts by enforcing a 30-day post-signup limit. The signup limit acts as an anti-spam ceiling for `referral_v2` rows, preventing pathological row creation while leaving legitimate reward caps untouched.

1576d8cceceddde2310b475e1dbe0f0f0add67d5.title: Unified referral GitHub account age requirement lowered to 4 months
1576d8cceceddde2310b475e1dbe0f0f0add67d5.summary: The `MIN_GITHUB_ACCOUNT_AGE_MONTHS_REFERRAL` constant in `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` was changed from 12 to 4. This adjustment aligns with the unified referral system's goal of standardizing the GitHub account age bar across all products, replacing previous per-program requirements (12 months for CLI/GLM, 4 months for Web). The change affects the core eligibility logic for referral perks, ensuring users with a minimum 4-month account age qualify regardless of the specific Freebuff product used.

f1a5a202b3505df7216651ab21560dd053faf148.title: Windows AVX2 detection via IsProcessorFeaturePresent with disk cache
f1a5a202b3505df7216651ab21560dd053faf148.summary: CLI release scripts now detect Windows AVX2 support by invoking `IsProcessorFeaturePresent(40)` via PowerShell instead of relying solely on CPU model checks or assuming availability. Results are cached to disk to avoid repeated subprocess overhead on every launch, while Linux continues using `/proc/cpuinfo`. This change applies to `cli/release/index.js`, `cli/release-staging/index.js`, and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js`. Inconclusive probes (e.g., locked-down policies) default to assuming AVX2 for the current session without persisting the guess, relying on SIGILL fallbacks.

e90202304629a44f84287728ac07d150354508a2.title: Minimax M3 moved to top of free model picker
e90202304629a44f84287728ac07d150354508a2.summary: MINIMAX_M3_MODEL reordered to first position in FREEBUFF_MODELS array. Mechanism: simple array index shift in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Scope: Shared/Core constants, affects Web, CLI, and Desktop pickers. Detail: DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL now second; no logic or validation changes.

0eb5e08fac20277f02c9f486b6176610e73431da.title: Add daily project creation cap for limited-tier Web users
0eb5e08fac20277f02c9f486b6176610e73431da.summary: Introduced `FREEBUFF_WEB_LIMITED_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT` constant set to 1 in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. This imposes a temporary project-creation cap for outer-region (limited-tier) Freebuff Web users, where each new project consumes one slot. The quota resets at midnight Pacific time.

3f6c218fcf769874ed0dbdd7ffac50e3294db19e.title: CLI nextDelayMs handles premiumslottaken
3f6c218fcf769874ed0dbdd7ffac50e3294db19e.summary: `nextDelayMs` in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` now returns `null` for `premium_slot_taken` alongside `model_locked`, `rate_limited`, and `model_unavailable`. This prevents invalid delay calculations when the CLI encounters a premium slot contention response. The change is scoped to the CLI session hook.

79127c26ba4d555c14ad85e5f16539447f4a81b8.title: Add freebuff-desktop-thread agent ID
79127c26ba4d555c14ad85e5f16539447f4a81b8.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_THREAD_AGENT_ID` ('freebuff-desktop-thread') to `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. This single root ID replaces per-model IDs for the desktop hosted harness, allowing the full desktop picker set. The agent is registered in `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS` for abuse detection.

92a719efa08071eb2c6f0eb67079416304201adb.title: Add desktop analytics events with 100% sampling
92a719efa08071eb2c6f0eb67079416304201adb.summary: Adds nine new `desktop.*` analytics events to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` and updates `MESSAGE_SENT` comment to include `desktop` surface. These events are added to `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` set in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts` to bypass the default 1% sampling rate. This ensures low-volume desktop app launch, login, and activity funnels are fully tracked without statistical noise.

b4989d0c77187ca908ff2417b1dfd4e68be25818.title: flexShrink: 0 on CLI referral banner and card
b4989d0c77187ca908ff2417b1dfd4e68be25818.summary: Added flexShrink: 0 to FreebuffReferralBanner and WaitingRoomScreen components to prevent layout squashing in height-starved landing columns. This ensures bordered copy and action buttons do not overlap status lines or preceding text. The change also refines the row reservation logic for the GLM referral banner to accurately account for bordered button heights (3 rows). Updated files include cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx and cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx.

c7df706d4a2306da3d645b3d5091a718f0b057bc.title: CLI streak perk note
c7df706d4a2306da3d645b3d5091a718f0b057bc.summary: Added `getFreebuffStreakBonusNote` to display recurring streak rewards on the CLI waiting room when streak >= 7 days. The note accurately reflects active bonuses, showing GLM 5.2 sessions only if `isFreebuffStreakGlmBonusActive` confirms the gate is open. Scope covers `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`, `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts`, and `common/src/util/freebuff-streak.ts`. `streakRewardPoolsForMilestone` now uses the shared active-gate check to prevent granting unusable GLM bonuses when the referral program is disabled.

a64b9c03fd75cad359bf64f3c82b1bc7651a2bc4.title: Add referral lifecycle analytics events
a64b9c03fd75cad359bf64f3c82b1bc7651a2bc4.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_REDEEMED`, `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_COMPLETED`, and `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SWEEP` to the `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. These events track the referral program server lifecycle, emitted from `packages/billing` via the server logger to Axiom. The `sweep` event aggregates outcomes across the pending population once per run to avoid high-volume per-evaluation ingestion.

a60a6abccdfcbbe6d3a72c17ed86dbc03810876a.title: Streak rewards and Tab command acceptance
a60a6abccdfcbbe6d3a72c17ed86dbc03810876a.summary: Tab now accepts highlighted slash commands into the input without execution, replacing previous navigation behavior. Streak rewards system added, granting bonus sessions for 7-day milestones via `FREEBUFF_STREAK_REWARDS_ENABLED`. Scope covers `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts` for input handling and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` for reward logic. Full-access users receive premium and GLM 5.2 weekly bonuses; limited users receive daily limited-pool sessions.

90210bb6a19dd9ee6bdc4f322668619399caa166.title: Add accessTier to CLI MESSAGESENT analytics
90210bb6a19dd9ee6bdc4f322668619399caa166.summary: Added `accessTier` property to `MESSAGE_SENT` event tracking in `cli/src/commands/router.ts`. Retrieves tier from `useFreebuffSessionStore` state, defaulting to 'unknown' if session or tier is missing. Applies only to Freebuff CLI surface. No action required.

2cb4fc339e109217ef4fba773241100ee66680f0.title: Add unified referral constants and CLI daily session bonus cap
2cb4fc339e109217ef4fba773241100ee66680f0.summary: Introduced `MIN_GITHUB_ACCOUNT_AGE_MONTHS_REFERRAL` (12 months) to unify GitHub account-age requirements across all referral programs, replacing the previous split bars of 4 months for Web and 12 months for CLI/GLM. Added `REFERRAL_CLI_DAILY_SESSION_BONUS_CAP` (3) to limit the daily free-mode session bonus granted by qualified limited-tier referrals. These constants in `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` support the consolidation of referral logic described in `docs/referrals.md`.

454dcd2c72790576154d4ed6cc68d96bf47dad96.title: SDK adds drainSteeringMessages hook for mid-turn agent steering
454dcd2c72790576154d4ed6cc68d96bf47dad96.summary: The SDK `RunOptions` type now accepts an optional `drainSteeringMessages` callback, allowing hosts to inject user messages into a running agent without aborting the current turn. In `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, this hook is drained at each step boundary after the LLM call and tool execution complete, appending returned texts to the message history as `USER_PROMPT` tagged messages. This mechanism ensures the agent responds to new inputs in the next step, maintaining a clean history state while extending the turn.

8a96d48d79d02c951416f047ba4d2b269407b584.title: CLI engaged-time heartbeat adds PRODUCTACTIVEMINUTE
8a96d48d79d02c951416f047ba4d2b269407b584.summary: New `PRODUCT_ACTIVE_MINUTE` analytics event fires once per active minute in CLI, driven by `EngagementTracker` and existing activity signals. Gated by `IS_FREEBUFF` and started only after renderer creation; stopped in `exitFreebuffCleanly()` before flush. `PRODUCT_ACTIVE_MINUTE` is always tracked (never sampled) but excluded from Axiom log mirror. Covers `cli/src/utils/engagement.ts`, `common/src/util/engagement-tracker.ts`, `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`.

15c9fe6c7e7bff8436ca2e3f48cb699de7d56c55.title: Desktop premium concurrency slot and multi-session headers
15c9fe6c7e7bff8436ca2e3f48cb699de7d56c55.summary: Added FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_PREMIUM_BUCKET_MODEL_IDS and isFreebuffDesktopPremiumBucketModelId to enforce a one-per-user concurrency cap for premium models plus MiniMax M3 and GLM 5.2 in Freebuff Desktop multi-session mode. Introduced wire headers FREEBUFF_INSTANCE_HEADER, FREEBUFF_MODEL_HEADER, and FREEBUFF_MULTI_SESSION_HEADER for /api/v1/freebuff/session to synchronize server and client literals. Defined premium_slot_taken status in FreebuffSessionServerResponse with currentInstanceId to enable tab switching or closing. Scope covers common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts.

425e9cb485d05a34b93c2abdf22a8e980fc2effb.title: Add chat title generation analytics event
425e9cb485d05a34b93c2abdf22a8e980fc2effb.summary: Added FREEBUFF_CHAT_TITLE_GENERATED to AnalyticsEvent enum in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. Tracks server-side new-thread title generation attempts with outcome (generated|empty|unknown_model|error|aborted), latencyMs, model, and titleLength properties. Enables queryable failure/fallback rates and added latency metrics.

9e61e4b90860c77829c87b675c5a7f002276ef9d.title: Improve MCP stdio server error handling and isolation
9e61e4b90860c77829c87b675c5a7f002276ef9d.summary: Capture stderr from failed stdio MCP servers (capped at 8KB) to provide actionable errors instead of opaque 'Connection closed' messages. Wrap per-server tool loading in try/catch so a single failed server disables only its own tools without aborting the entire agent turn. Updates common/src/mcp/client.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/mcp.ts.

82827cafd83ff35bc18530e2729ccf86ee4497f4.title: freebuff CLI version bump to 0.0.114
82827cafd83ff35bc18530e2729ccf86ee4497f4.summary: Version bumped from 0.0.113 to 0.0.114 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Internal packaging update.

bf6d1e5e2016e11d155092e0e93ad17493db7a12.title: Bump CLI version to 0.0.115
bf6d1e5e2016e11d155092e0e93ad17493db7a12.summary: Bumped package version to 0.0.115 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Updates the release metadata for the CLI.

ca8ddb859a773965c2058c74e401c818650f92d9.title: CLI removes queued session state and waiting room
ca8ddb859a773965c2058c74e401c818650f92d9.summary: CLI session flow now transitions directly from model selection to active chat, eliminating the 'queued' status and associated waiting room UI. This change simplifies the admission logic in `cli/src/app.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` by removing queue polling and elapsed-time formatting. The `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` type in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` no longer includes 'queued' or 'disabled' variants, treating missing endpoints as 'none' to force a fresh model picker interaction.

ae4bfa7060da887ef37210aa0d5c33adad14963d.title: CLI streak dots and GLM 5.2 referral cap
ae4bfa7060da887ef37210aa0d5c33adad14963d.summary: Streak indicator displays a 7-day progress dot track via getFreebuffStreakLine. Referral banner enforces FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_REFERRAL_CAP, updating copy and button states. Affects cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts, freebuff-referral-banner.tsx, and waiting-room-screen.tsx. Dots roll over after day 7; streak text uses singular 'day' as a compound modifier.

6e063e113c757309a151e1c78b52ebca7a12c0e6.title: Add ipinfo ASN type benign and hosting checks
6e063e113c757309a151e1c78b52ebca7a12c0e6.summary: Added `isFreebuffBenignAsType` and `isFreebuffHostingAsType` helpers to `common/src/util/freebuff-privacy.ts`. These functions classify ipinfo's `as.type` field to distinguish benign networks (ISP, business, education, government) from hosting infrastructure, which is the only meaningful abuse signal. The change ensures real users behind ordinary networks are not incorrectly flagged by hosting heuristics.

c0d984a61fa18c7fdb06b8132b63d3134abf5816.title: GLM referral banner persists across session states
c0d984a61fa18c7fdb06b8132b63d3134abf5816.summary: Referral data persists in landing view via new process-wide cache in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-referral-cache.ts`. Server omits referral blocks after join/end states, causing banner disappearance during `ended` row sweep; `rememberReferral` captures last valid block, `getCachedReferral` restores it in `toLandingSession`. Scope covers `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` integration and `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` UI updates. Streak dots logic in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts` changed from rolling modulo to `Math.min` cap, keeping 7+ day streaks visually full.

5824dc1d4e6d9948220ac83e68c0254f775f08c7.title: Add waitForBootSignal to e2e session utils
5824dc1d4e6d9948220ac83e68c0254f775f08c7.summary: Added `waitForBootSignal` method to `FreebuffSession` class and exported `FREEBUFF_BOOT_SIGNALS` constant. Replaces reliance on single ASCII logo detection with polling against multiple static strings (e.g., 'Start coding for free', 'Pick a model to start') to handle CI runner variability where full ASCII art may not render. Changes scoped to `freebuff/e2e/utils/freebuff-session.ts` and `freebuff/e2e/utils/index.ts`. Method polls every 500ms up to 30s timeout, throwing error with last output snapshot on failure.

7f4effcaa955faf0576cdffb799998fd36733bbe.title: CLI streak display adapts to narrow terminals and long runs
7f4effcaa955faf0576cdffb799998fd36733bbe.summary: Streak line logic now appends '+' for runs >7 days and moves the indicator to a new line below 50 cols. `freebuff-streak-line.ts` updates `getFreebuffStreakLine` to handle overflow; `waiting-room-screen.tsx` adjusts row calculation based on `contentMaxWidth`. Referral banner text simplified in `freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` to remove hard-coded cap references. Scope limited to CLI components and utils.

b3c3decd0afb7d08f0ab70a80070a316c1547bab.title: skill handler reads disk-first
b3c3decd0afb7d08f0ab70a80070a316c1547bab.summary: Skill handler now reads from disk first, falling back to session cache. Ensures skills installed or updated via `npx skills add` reflect latest contents immediately. Affects `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/skill.ts` and `common/src/tools/params/tool/skill.ts`. Base agent prompt updated to guide users through community skill discovery and installation.

dd3e1e6aa9ef1bd11f446bb4cca0ceaf1ac3e89b.title: Referral banner layout fixes
dd3e1e6aa9ef1bd11f446bb4cca0ceaf1ac3e89b.summary: Added `flexShrink: 0` to the `CopyInviteLinkButton` container in `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` to prevent border clipping in narrow rows. Changed `wrapMode` from 'none' to 'word' for the qualified count text to enable proper wrapping.

6e8e17d890d006bf4ee5a2545d18ed9fac02f01e.title: Analytics events added, CLI v0.0.113
6e8e17d890d006bf4ee5a2545d18ed9fac02f01e.summary: Added seven analytics events to track the Get Started referral onboarding funnel in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Marked two older events as deprecated. Bumped CLI version to `0.0.113` in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.

43301d5fd2bcb9bdf1e0f3fc26a14de115359d84.title: Add Reddit funnel and attribution analytics events
43301d5fd2bcb9bdf1e0f3fc26a14de115359d84.summary: Added six new analytics events to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`: `FREEBUFF_ATTRIBUTED` for UTM/ad-click super-properties, and five `FREEBUFF_REDDIT_FUNNEL_*` events covering CLI install, login, sign-up, first prompt, and gravity ad click. These track acquisition attribution and Reddit ad funnel conversion in PostHog, filterable by `utm_source` and `reddit_click_id`. Scope limited to the shared constants file; no other packages or surfaces modified. Events are enum members only; actual emission logic is not included in this diff.

ec42536f50943a38138d63621738bf4a4e5bfa8f.title: CLI referral banner: /get-started link, copy button, tier guard
ec42536f50943a38138d63621738bf4a4e5bfa8f.summary: Referral links now point to `/get-started` with `?referrer=` param for personalized landing pages. New `CopyInviteLinkButton` component replaces plain text links with bordered, copy-to-clipboard control. `FreebuffReferralInfo` type adds `referrerName` field. Banner repositioned in `waiting-room-screen.tsx` after streak line. Full-tier-only guard hides banner for limited users.

d1fb7fdf239e8a306f7d31a19fd4de4fa4ab58e0.title: Add suggestfollowups to base-chat agent
d1fb7fdf239e8a306f7d31a19fd4de4fa4ab58e0.summary: The suggest_followups tool is added to the toolNames array in agents/base-chat.ts. The system prompt instructs the agent to call this tool last, providing three specific follow-up questions with short labels and full first-person prompts. This change applies to the Freebuff Chat agent definition, enhancing post-response interaction guidance.

3e442f817a080ee0f2ac2ecd86193db9e2c7349f.title: Persistent anonymous analytics id and cli.login on session restore
3e442f817a080ee0f2ac2ecd86193db9e2c7349f.summary: Anonymous PostHog id now persists to config dir via cli/src/utils/anonymous-id.ts, replacing per-process generateAnonymousId in cli/src/utils/analytics.ts. Pre-login launches collapse to one person that aliases cleanly into the account. cli.login now fires on session restore (via='session_restore') in cli/src/hooks/use-auth-state.ts and on plain login (via='plain_command') in cli/src/login/plain-login.ts, with flushAnalytics before process.exit. getConfigDir moved to cli/src/utils/config-dir.ts to break an import cycle; auth.ts re-exports it as a wrapper so existing spyOn(authModule, 'getConfigDir') tests keep working.

979954f98423e67c331525052c100358fa1f97a4.title: Add login funnel analytics events to CLI
979954f98423e67c331525052c100358fa1f97a4.summary: CLI login flow emits `cli.login_started`, `cli.login_failed`, `cli.login_timeout`, and `cli.login_aborted` events via `login-flow.ts`. These track the gap between launch and successful `cli.login`, tagged with `via` (modal | plain_command) to segment surfaces. Changes affect `cli/src/login/login-flow.ts`, `cli/src/login/plain-login.ts`, and related hooks, adding `trackEvent` injection. New events bypass sampling in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts`.

4d7555cb6f9415176119010fabe5c27f13d8243b.title: Gate premium Gemini Pro to thinker subagents with suffix-tolerant
4d7555cb6f9415176119010fabe5c27f13d8243b.summary: Added `isFreebuffGeminiProAgent` gate in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` restricting premium Gemini Pro calls to CLI (`thinker-with-files-gemini`) and Web Chat (`thinker-gemini`) subagents. Introduced `freebuffModelIdMatches` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to tolerate dated snapshot suffixes (e.g., `-20260219`), preventing callers from bypassing gates by sending dated model IDs. This logic now applies to `isFreebuffGeminiProModelId` and `isFreebuffPremiumModelId` to enforce daily rate caps on dated variants. Scope covers shared core constants used by CLI and Web surfaces.

eebd6089f2b07ee217e4367ccdf074effed29364.title: CLI model selector keyboard navigation extends to referral banner
eebd6089f2b07ee217e4367ccdf074effed29364.summary: Added `freebuff-landing-focus-store.ts` to bridge keyboard focus between the model selector and the referral banner. The selector's arrow navigation now includes banner buttons (copy invite link, use GLM) via shared state, allowing users to tab/arrow into these controls from the model list. Copy logic was refactored into `useCopyToClipboard` hook in `copy-button.tsx` to support firing actions from keyboard navigation outside the button component. Banner focus targets are appended to `navIds` in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, with stale cursor clearing on unmount.

750dc9aaa60a81d5716bfe47380a859dd7159720.title: /plan and /review run on selected model, ChatGPT gate removed
750dc9aaa60a81d5716bfe47380a859dd7159720.summary: Removed the mandatory ChatGPT connection gate for /plan and /review commands. These commands now default to the user's currently selected model for deep-thinking steps, delegating to @thinker-gpt only when a ChatGPT account is connected via /connect. Updated `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` to drop the connection check, `cli/src/commands/prompt-builders.ts` to conditionally select prompt variants, and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts` to remove 'Connect required' prefixes and generic descriptions.

1bac5606860ccd893adeb9188103fde0d2bb93f6.title: GLM 5.2 referral sessions and banner
1bac5606860ccd893adeb9188103fde0d2bb93f6.summary: GLM 5.2 added as referral reward via base2-free-glm.ts and code-reviewer-glm.ts. Excluded from model picker in freebuff-model-selector.tsx, surfaced in new freebuff-referral-banner.tsx. Weekly session pool distinct from premium daily, capped by FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_REFERRAL_CAP. Sessions exactly one hour, served by Fireworks, omitted from FREEBUFF_TRACED_MODEL_IDS.

feb051debac2365daf253d424385b6c6e57ec64a.title: Bun 1.3.11 to 1.3.14
feb051debac2365daf253d424385b6c6e57ec64a.summary: Bun upgraded 1.3.11 to 1.3.14. Engines, packageManager, .bun-version updated. Internal tooling.

0b97b6efd524e5044a6c7b31e20a7a748326feff.title: Version 0.0.112 for freebuff CLI release package
0b97b6efd524e5044a6c7b31e20a7a748326feff.summary: The `freebuff` CLI release package version bumps from 0.0.111 to 0.0.112. This update applies to `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.

ff16426abdc93feb759df1e90f94539e877a07ca.title: Bump CLI package version to 0.0.111
ff16426abdc93feb759df1e90f94539e877a07ca.summary: Version incremented to 0.0.111 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Reflects standard release packaging update for the CLI.

637bdf14fa0443c9539f6550eeb64ae129fb55c6.title: Add MESSAGESENT analytics event for CLI DAU tracking
637bdf14fa0443c9539f6550eeb64ae129fb55c6.summary: CLI now emits `MESSAGE_SENT` on every user-submitted prompt. This enables accurate Daily Active Users (DAU) measurement by filtering on the `surface: 'cli'` property. The event is added to `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts` to prevent sampling, and gated by `IS_FREEBUFF` in `cli/src/commands/router.ts`.

538768ba9aaf73180427a125c12e05edf67fbbd6.title: CLI premium model selector always shows reset countdown
538768ba9aaf73180427a125c12e05edf67fbbd6.summary: CLI `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` removes the `premiumUsed > 0` guard, displaying the reset countdown even at 0 usage. Pacific-day boundary fallback in `getFreebuffPremiumResetAt` ensures the timer works before server `resetAt` arrives. Scoped to CLI PREMIUM section for full-access tier.

95a1156a6015112ed1b82cb897df77395b0fd5b0.title: Press Enter cue on focused recommended model row
95a1156a6015112ed1b82cb897df77395b0fd5b0.summary: Added right-aligned "Press Enter ↵" cue to the focused recommended row in `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`. The cue's width is folded into the one-line max calculation via `recommendedOneLineLen` so only the hero row reserves the gutter, preventing longer rows like DeepSeek Pro's warning from unnecessarily widening buttons. Scoped to the CLI model selector; the cue renders only when `!wrapDetails` and `cuePad >= CUE_GAP`.

4c9007c7eaa0c04135f1be020c5209621d5aa716.title: Add externaluserid to Gravity attribution
4c9007c7eaa0c04135f1be020c5209621d5aa716.summary: Added optional `external_user_id` to `runtimeAttributionFields` in `common/src/types/gravity-index.ts`. Updated `gravitySurface` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/gravity-index.ts` to identify `freebuff_web` agents and forward `fingerprintId` as the external user ID for shared service-account surfaces. This prevents conversion attribution from collapsing onto the service account API key.

2e94bb23cc19832c25dad3b04883f71a44fdd998.title: Move premium session quota to model selector header
2e94bb23cc19832c25dad3b04883f71a44fdd998.summary: Premium session quota and reset countdown moved to the PREMIUM section header in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`. Below-picker counter in `waiting-room-screen.tsx` restricted to `limited` tier only. Regular tiers omit counter when collapsed since recommended hero is unlimited. `formatSessionUnits` utility added for header rendering.

692bf102f5e653d85d43fc32883c4d8366c537ef.title: README consolidation and model documentation updates
692bf102f5e653d85d43fc32883c4d8366c537ef.summary: Documentation restructured to establish root `README.md` as single source of truth, with `freebuff/README.md` now linking to it. Model documentation updated to reflect new full/limited mode tiers, listing DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiMo 2.5 Pro, Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5, and MiniMax M3 for full mode. `freebuff/cli/release/README.md` updated with same model list and clarified data training policy regarding labeled models.

edacbeb3609c311a58aac127c5264255149302df.title: Rebrand Manicode to Freebuff in LICENSE and eval fixtures
edacbeb3609c311a58aac127c5264255149302df.summary: Copyright headers in root and template LICENSE files updated from Manicode, Inc. to Freebuff, Inc. Buffbench eval fixtures (eval-codebuff-hard.json, eval-codebuff.json, eval-codebuff2.json, eval-manifold.json) scrubbed of legacy 'manicode' strings in database URLs, backend endpoints, and credential paths. This aligns internal test data and legal metadata with the current Freebuff brand. No runtime logic changes; affects shared/core templates and eval datasets.

43d2681d423104d649f6809fe00414f57b212420.summary: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.109. Version increment in freebuff/cli/release/package.json.

59f2ba13cee05f37282e74d3738adfe15633ef31.title: smoke-binary retries boot 3 times
