59f2ba13cee05f37282e74d3738adfe15633ef31.summary: cli/scripts/smoke-binary.ts adds MAX_BOOT_ATTEMPTS = 3 to retry boot detection on transient Windows runner hangs. runBootAttempt isolates spawn and output capture, returning an AttemptOutcome union. Negative gate first: known fatal markers fail immediately without retrying. Positive gate: boot signal match exits 0; no-signal triggers next attempt.

de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.title: Referral tier daily limits raised across all tiers
de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.summary: Standard and premium model daily limits increased in FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_TIERS. Tier 0 standard limit moves from 20 to 24, premium from 3 to 4. Tier 1 standard limit moves from 30 to 40, premium from 4 to 6. Tier 2 standard limit moves from 50 to 70, premium from 6 to 10. Tier 3 standard limit moves from 80 to 110, premium from 10 to 15.

747abe3c717770a91c955c6e004da6e4154eb159.title: freebuff 0.0.110 release
747abe3c717770a91c955c6e004da6e4154eb159.summary: Version bump to 0.0.110 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No functional changes.

a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.title: Lite mode switches from DeepSeek V4 Flash to MiniMax M3
a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.summary: Lite mode now defaults to MiniMax M3 via Fireworks AI API, replacing DeepSeek V4 Flash. Free mode remains on MiniMax, and free clients continue selecting explicit variants from the model picker. Change applies to agents/base2/base2.ts. Freebuff clients select explicit free variants from the model picker.

cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.title: SuggestedPrompts visibility logic updated in CLI chat
cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.summary: SuggestedPrompts rendering moved to top of chat view in cli/src/chat.tsx. Visibility now requires showOnboardingPrompts, !reviewMode, and !isFreebuffSessionOver. This ensures prompts only appear during active, non-review sessions.

a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.title: CLI mirrors analytics to Axiom logs pre-auth
a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.summary: CLI analytics events now mirror to the Axiom logs sink via `enqueueClientLog`, enabling install-to-login funnels in APL. `log-shipper.ts` removed the auth gate, posting batches anonymously when no token exists, correlated by `client_session_id`. New `common/src/util/log-mirror.ts` filters high-volume PostHog auto-events like `$snapshot` from the Axiom copy, while `common/src/util/rate-limit.ts` adds a fixed-window limiter for unauthenticated `/api/logs` ingest.

25b6dde3bbfade9e2e2423e30c20766f5c73d2b9.title: Bump freebuff CLI release version to 0.0.108
25b6dde3bbfade9e2e2423e30c20766f5c73d2b9.summary: Version field in freebuff/cli/release/package.json incremented from 0.0.107 to 0.0.108. This is a routine release packaging update for the CLI distribution. No functional code changes or dependency updates included in this diff.

b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.title: CLI waiting-room promotes ASCII logo when model picker collapses
b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.summary: FreebuffModelSelector now emits onExpandedChange to mirror its collapsed state to WaitingRoomScreen. The waiting-room screen uses this to promote the compact wordmark to the full ASCII logo when the picker is collapsed on mid-height terminals (>= 26 rows), filling otherwise dead space. Covers cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx and cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx. useLayoutEffect ensures the parent's logo decision settles before paint, preventing layout flicker on mount and toggle.

a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.title: CLI model picker collapses to recommended hero; MiniMax M3 untraced
a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.summary: The CLI model selector now defaults to a collapsed state showing only the recommended model, enabling single-Enter starts for new users. A sentinel ID drives the expand/collapse toggle, which remains keyboard-navigable alongside model rows. This behavior applies to the landing screen when the saved preference matches the recommendation; in-queue switchers and mismatched preferences remain expanded. MiniMax M3 loses its 'Collects data for training' warning, removing it from `FREEBUFF_TRACED_MODEL_IDS` as Fireworks hosting prevents provider-side training.

7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.title: gravitySurface drops existingMetadata surface fallback
7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.summary: Refactor `gravitySurface` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/gravity-index.ts` to derive attribution solely from `agentTemplate.id`. Removes logic checking `existingMetadata.surface`, eliminating the fallback to prior metadata. This simplifies the handler call site by passing only the template object.

f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.title: CLI log shipper mirrors logs to /api/logs
f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.summary: Added client-side log shipper in `cli/src/utils/log-shipper.ts` that batches and POSTs CLI logs to `/api/logs` (Axiom sink). Runs alongside PostHog, best-effort, fire-and-forget, never throws. Controlled by `CODEBUFF_SHIP_LOGS` env var (default on outside dev/test/CI). New schemas in `common/src/schemas/logs.ts` enforce caps: 500 records/batch, 4KB message, 64KB data, 1MB body.

f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.title: gravity-index surface resolution now checks existing metadata
f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.summary: gravitySurface in gravity-index.ts now accepts existingMetadata and returns its surface field if present, falling back to the agentTemplate.id check otherwise. This preserves previously assigned attribution surfaces during tool calls instead of overwriting them with derived defaults. Scope: packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/gravity-index.ts. The existing surface value must be a non-empty string to take precedence.

370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.title: Web referral tiers: 4-month GitHub age gate
370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.summary: New `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` defines Web referral ladder (1/3/7 qualified referrals) scaling daily model limits and unlocking deploy watermark removal. Referrals require referred user's GitHub account to be at least 4 months old at signup (anti-farming), computed on calendar months. `FREEBUFF_WEB_REFERRAL_LIMIT` set to 20 to bound farming while accommodating unqualified signups, distinct from CLI's `user.referral_limit` default of 5.

ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.title: Clarify referral tier limits for geo-gated regions
ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.summary: Updated documentation in `freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` to specify that while users in limited regions can still unlock referral tiers, only standard/free-model limits apply because premium models remain geo-gated. This clarifies the mechanism for tier scaling and perks in restricted areas. The change is isolated to the shared constants file and does not affect core logic or CLI behavior.

d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.title: Add agentId to reasoning chunks
d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.summary: The SDK's run.ts and agent-runtime stream-parser now emit a stable agentId in reasoning chunks instead of runId. This allows consumers to correctly attribute reasoning to the specific subagent (e.g., thinker-gemini) by matching the agentId from subagent_start events. The change touches common/src/types/print-mode.ts schema and sdk/src/run.ts. Base-chat.ts also updated to spawnableAgents include 'thinker-gemini' with new reasoning delegation instructions.

ed764c4f8db46d834c0b0f04883fee15b35c4c55.title: Smoke binary accepts OpenTUI terminal handshakes as boot signals
ed764c4f8db46d834c0b0f04883fee15b35c4c55.summary: cli/scripts/smoke-binary.ts adds OpenTUI alternate-screen and Kitty keyboard protocol escape sequences to BOOT_SIGNAL_PATTERNS. Fixes flaky Windows GitHub Actions smoke tests where the binary emits terminal setup but fails to flush static React text before timeout. Accepting these handshakes proves the renderer reached the post-init terminal surface. Fatal markers and tree-sitter checks still fail the smoke if async startup breaks later.

874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.title: Add Kimi K2.7 Code agent and model constant
874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.summary: New `base2-kimi-2-7-code` agent definition added, utilizing `moonshotModels.kimiK27Code`. `moonshotModels` constant introduced in `model-config.ts` and `ModelName` type updated in `agent-definition.ts` to include `moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code`. `FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID` refactored to use `moonshotModels.kimiK26` instead of hardcoded string. BuffBench eval config updated to run the new agent.

7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.title: Expand gemini-thinker parent models and refine prompts
7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.summary: Added MiMo 2.5 Pro and MiniMax M3 to FREEBUFF_GEMINI_THINKER_PARENT_MODELS in freebuff-models.ts, expanding deep reasoning availability to all full-access models except limited tiers. Updated system, instruction, and step prompts in freebuff-gemini-thinker.ts to broaden trigger conditions from "complex problems" to "problems worth thinking through," explicitly including non-trivial bugs and uncertain approaches. The CLI and server use this set to toggle spawnability and admit child requests, while the legacy Fastest MiniMax M2.7 remains excluded to preserve latency.

957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.title: Prevent CLI crashes on WSL and headless Linux browser open
957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.summary: The `safeOpen` utility now explicitly checks for `powershell.exe` accessibility on WSL and attaches an error listener to the spawned process. This prevents uncaught exceptions that terminate the CLI when Windows interop is disabled or when `xdg-open` fails on headless Linux systems. The change adds `wsl-utils` as a dependency in `cli/package.json` to align path resolution with the underlying `open` library.

4999c63158f0f57c511141ac4277be73ca153b19.title: Freebuff CLI release package.json bumped to 0.0.107
4999c63158f0f57c511141ac4277be73ca153b19.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json updated from 0.0.106 to 0.0.107. Scope limited to CLI release packaging metadata.

9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.title: Shallow scan for home directory roots in CLI file tree
9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.summary: CLI `@` mention file tree now performs a shallow capped scan when project root is home directory or ancestor, replacing previous full disablement. `isShallowScanRoot` and `SHALLOW_SCAN_MAX_DEPTH` (3) gate behavior in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts`, limiting crawl to `SHALLOW_SCAN_MAX_FILES` (2000) and `SHALLOW_SCAN_MAX_DIRS` (500) to prevent disk-wide traversal. `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx` adds footer hint via `tryGetProjectRoot()` when shallow mode active, rendered by updated `SuggestionMenu` in `cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx`. Directories beyond depth 3 appear as nodes but contents remain unscanned.

9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.title: base-chat gains gravityindex tool
9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.summary: base-chat agent toolNames expanded with gravity_index. System prompt updated to instruct gravity_index usage for third-party service recommendations, with specific formatting for setup links. gravity-index.ts handler modified to accept agentTemplate parameter. New gravitySurface helper maps agentTemplate.id to surface string ('freebuff_chat' for base-chat, 'codebuff_cli' otherwise), replacing hardcoded 'codebuff_cli' in metadata. This ensures clicks/conversions are attributable to the originating product.

778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.title: Prevent code reviewer spawning for non-code changes
778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.summary: Added prompt logic to agents/base2/base2.ts to explicitly instruct the agent not to spawn a code reviewer when no code changes are made (e.g., planning or answering questions). This applies to default, max, and free models to prevent unnecessary reviewer invocations.

ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.title: Fix agent runtime state leak on abort, bound SDK agent cache
ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.summary: Added clearProgrammaticRunState in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts to release generator, STEP_ALL flag, and proposed file content on abort/error exits, not just endTurn. Wrapped loopAgentSteps in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts with finally block calling this cleanup. Replaced unbounded Map with BoundedAgentCache (200 entries, FIFO eviction) in sdk/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts to prevent memory growth in long-lived processes.

8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.title: CLI model selector layout updates
8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.summary: CLI model selector layout updates. Premium/Unlimited headers now show reset countdowns and no-limit labels. Streak and limited-mode notices render below the picker. Compact terminals hide the notice. Country codes format to names with fallbacks.

5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.title: Add Freebuff Web tier, geo-exempt models, limited session pool
5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.summary: Introduces Freebuff Web-specific access tiers and model gating in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Extends FreebuffAccessTier with 'blocked' for Tor/anonymous networks, rejecting agent sends server-side. Defines a Convex-enforced limited session pool (5 sessions, 1h) separate from CLI Postgres, plus geo-exempt models (DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5) allowing unlimited usage for limited-tier Web users. Includes helper functions to validate and coerce model selections for limited tiers.

0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.title: Fetch idle timeout detection and clearer user messaging
0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.summary: Added `isFetchIdleTimeoutError` to detect Bun's 5-minute fetch inactivity timeout (DOMException `TimeoutError`) and `FETCH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_USER_MESSAGE` to replace the raw runtime error with actionable network-path guidance. `run-agent-step.ts` and `sdk/run.ts` now route detected idle timeouts to the user-facing message instead of the generic `Agent run error:` prefix. `sdk/impl/database.ts` truncates persisted `errorMessage` to 5000 chars to prevent stack-trace bloat. Covers `common/src/util/error.ts`, Agent Runtime, and SDK surfaces.

e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.title: Replace claude-fable-5 with claude-opus-4.8 in Max agents
e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.summary: Claude-fable-5 replaced by claude-opus-4.8 across Max-tier agents including base2, best-of-n selector, editor implementors, and code reviewers. Fable model options removed from createBestOfNSelector2, createBestOfNImplementor, and createThinkerBestOfN type unions. Agent IDs and spawnableAgents updated from fable variants to opus variants (e.g., thinker-best-of-n-fable to thinker-best-of-n-opus). Bedrock providerOptions now apply only to isOpus checks.

6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.title: Base-chat agent switches to DeepSeek V4 Flash on Fireworks
6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.summary: The `base-chat` agent definition now uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_FIREWORKS_MODEL_ID` (`fireworks/deepseek-v4-flash`) instead of the direct DeepSeek API constant. This change targets freebuff.com/chat specifically, leveraging Fireworks' faster inference despite a slight capability trade-off. The new model ID is defined in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` but intentionally excluded from `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS` and free-mode allowlists, ensuring CLI and web builder agents continue using the direct DeepSeek endpoint.

a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.title: Claude Fable 5 replaces Opus 4.7 in max-tier agents; Opus bumps to 4.8
a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.summary: Claude Fable 5 (`anthropic/claude-fable-5`) replaces Claude Opus 4.7 as the primary model for `editor-multi-prompt`, `code-reviewer-multi-prompt`, and `best-of-n-selector2` in max-tier workflows. Claude Opus 4.7 is globally bumped to Opus 4.8 (`anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`) for `editor`, `general-agent`, and `code-reviewer`. New `code-reviewer-fable.ts` and renamed `thinker-best-of-n-fable.ts` / `editor-implementor-fable.ts` files update agent IDs and spawnable lists in `context-pruner.ts` and `base2.ts`. All Fable and Opus models strictly enforce `amazon-bedrock` provider routing.

f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.title: Researcher agent enforces iterative multi-round web research
f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.summary: The researcher-web agent definition in agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts now mandates iterative research. The systemPrompt warns that search snippets are not evidence, and the instructionsPrompt requires multiple rounds of web_search followed by parallel read_url calls. A hard rule prevents answering until at least 3 (or 5 for complex queries) pages are successfully fetched.

53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.title: LoginModal adds wrap warning for truncated auth URLs
53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.summary: LoginModal in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx` now detects multi-line URL wrapping via `loginUrlWrapped` and renders a warning message. Terminal link detection and drag-select only capture the first row of wrapped text, causing truncated auth codes. The fix advises users to press 'c' to copy the full link.

38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.title: Freebuff Chat spawns researcher-web
38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.summary: Chat agent gains toolNames: ['spawn_agents'] and spawnableAgents: ['researcher-web'] in agents/base-chat.ts. researcher-web displayName changes from 'Weeb' to 'Web Researcher' in agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts. System prompt instructs spawning for current info, parallel searches, and source citation. Covers freebuff.com/chat surface.

6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.title: Handle synchronous spawn errors in CLI launcher
6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.summary: Wrap spawn() calls in try/catch to handle synchronous exceptions like UNKNOWN errno on Windows caused by antivirus or Smart App Control blocking the executable. Add exitOnSpawnFailure helper to centralize error printing and process exit(1) for both missing binary and spawn failures. Update cli/release/index.js and freebuff/cli/release/index.js. This ensures the CLI launcher exits cleanly instead of crashing with an unhandled promise rejection or stack trace when the binary cannot be spawned.

f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.title: SDK read-url adds SSRF protection with manual redirect validation
f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.summary: New ssrf.ts module enforces SSRF policies for read-url by validating URL schemes, IP literals, and resolved hostnames against private/reserved ranges. read-url.ts now follows redirects manually (max 5 hops) to re-validate each target, replacing native fetch redirect handling. IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (e.g. ::ffff:127.0.0.1) are normalized to their embedded IPv4 range for accurate classification. Callers can inject lookupHost or set resolveDns: false to skip DNS resolution while still blocking IP-literal targets.

66b39f9ac99af7faa8b610590717bdfa5daeb7f1.title: CLI log.jsonl summary-only, trace.jsonl opt-in, oversized log trim
66b39f9ac99af7faa8b610590717bdfa5daeb7f1.summary: use-send-message.ts logs runConfig summary (agent, promptLength, contentBlockCount, previousMessageCount, agentDefinitionCount, costMode, maxAgentSteps) instead of full runConfig, preventing multi-GB log.jsonl bloat. New trace-writer.ts and common contracts/trace.ts append per-message agent histories to trace.jsonl, gated by CODEBUFF_TRACE=1 in prod and always-on in dev; AgentRuntimeDeps gains optional traceWriter. chat-history.ts trimOversizedChatLogs deletes log.jsonl files >10MB untouched for 14+ days, deferred via setTimeout in index.tsx to keep startup off the stat sweep. logger.ts exports CHAT_LOG_FILENAME and clearLogFile now also clears debug/trace.jsonl.

c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.title: Add base-chat agent definition
c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.summary: New `agents/base-chat.ts` defines the `base-chat` agent for freebuff.com/chat. It uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` with zero tools and filesystem access. The agent outputs only the last message and accepts a single string prompt. Subagents and model overrides are planned for future updates.

937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.title: Add claude-fable-5 and claude-opus-4.8 model support
937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.summary: Added anthropic/claude-fable-5 and anthropic/claude-opus-4.8 to ModelName types and OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP. Base2 agent now routes isMax to claude-fable-5, else claude-opus-4.8. Updates affect agents/base2/base2.ts, agents/types/agent-definition.ts, and common constants.

44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.title: MiniMax M3 gets dedicated reviewer agent
44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.summary: Added `code-reviewer-minimax-m3` agent definition and mapped it in `FREEBUFF_REVIEWER_AGENT_ID_BY_MODEL`. Removed `noReview: true` flag from `base2-free-minimax-m3` to enable review capability. Registered model in `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` for free mode routing.

323d5e50a72afae4df7bd73a04c94ded077e8d8c.title: Bump freebuff CLI to 0.0.106
323d5e50a72afae4df7bd73a04c94ded077e8d8c.summary: Version bump in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.105 to 0.0.106. No functional code changes. Affects CLI release packaging only.

7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.title: Waiting room copy rework for limited mode
7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.summary: Waiting room screen updates limited mode copy to focus on model availability rather than access restrictions. The `getLimitedModeReason` function is renamed to `getLimitedModeNotice` with revised messaging for country blocks, VPNs, and unknown regions. The `sessionLabel` now distinguishes between 'sessions' and 'premium sessions' based on access tier. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.title: Improve CLI rate limit error visibility and parsing
5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.summary: Enhanced CLI error handling to display specific upstream rate limit details alongside the standard Freebuff message. The `parseApiErrorResponseBody` function in `common/src/util/error.ts` now extracts nested `message` and `code` fields from OpenAI-style error objects. This allows users to see the actual provider error (e.g., from Fireworks or OpenRouter) instead of a generic 429 message.

7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.title: DEFAULTFREEBUFFMODELID switches to MiniMax M3
7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.summary: DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts changes from FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID to FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID. MiniMax M3 selected for superior intelligence and multimodal capabilities, preserving the 5/day premium quota. Affects new user defaults in core constants; existing sessions and fallback logic remain unchanged. FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID stays distinct to handle resolution errors.

409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.title: CLI detects blocked OSC 52 in Codespaces and remote VS Code terminals
409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.summary: Added isOsc52Blocked() to detect GitHub Codespaces and remote VS Code terminals that silently drop OSC 52 sequences. Clipboard copy logic now checks this flag to bypass OSC 52 attempts and force Shift+drag guidance when no platform tool exists, even for callers suppressing routine messages. Covers cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts, cli/src/types/env.ts, cli/src/utils/env.ts, and cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx. Detection relies on TERM_PROGRAM=vscode combined with CODESPACES=true or existing SSH environment variables.

ac888447c1bb269cec8476262a11cf270b02942c.title: v0.0.105
ac888447c1bb269cec8476262a11cf270b02942c.summary: Version bump to 0.0.105. Scope limited to freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Internal packaging update.

e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.title: Fix Claude 4.6 assistant prefill rejection in agent runtime
e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.summary: Added `supportsAssistantPrefill` check to `common/src/constants/model-config.ts` and applied logic in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Claude 4.6+ (including Fable) rejects requests ending in an assistant message with "unsupported assistant prefill" errors, particularly via Amazon Bedrock. The runtime now ensures the conversation ends with a user message for these models, while older Claude versions and other providers retain prefill support. Buffbench error dumps matching `*-error-*.json` are now ignored via `.gitignore`.

241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.title: Fix plain Enter detection for Kitty protocol keyboards
241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.summary: MultilineInput now treats key.source === 'kitty' as a valid Enter signal, bypassing legacy escape-prefix and raw \r/\n heuristics. This prevents plain Enter from being misinterpreted as Alt+Enter on Kitty-protocol terminals, which encode Enter as an escape sequence (e.g. \x1b[13u) while reliably reporting modifiers. Change scoped to cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx. The isKittyKey flag explicitly disables hasEscapePrefix checks for these events to ensure accurate modifier state.

3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.title: CLI session summary shows remaining quota instead of used
3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.summary: Active session summary now displays remaining quota units rather than used units. The `recentCount` metric already includes the active session's reservation, so showing `quota.limit - quota.recentCount` accurately reflects sessions available to start. Waiting room label updated from 'sessions' to 'premium sessions' for limited tier consistency. Changes affect `freebuff-active-session-summary.tsx` and `waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.title: MiniMax M3 data collection warning and picker order
2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.summary: MiniMax M3 adds a 'Collects data for training' warning to its model configuration. The model moves to the second position in the FREEBUFF_MODELS array, immediately after DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL. This change affects the shared constants file used by CLI and Web UI pickers.

e39f9da8bc239a0b8c08ee3014e7ec7c2a287c41.title: Add MiniMax M3 premium model and free agent

9e59dcc4f5df63719dff99e9e4ec1db6abcb1fbb.title: Fix CLI Enter key detection and sanitize message surrogates
9e59dcc4f5df63719dff99e9e4ec1db6abcb1fbb.summary: CLI model selector and waiting room now use `isPlainEnterKey` to correctly handle keypad Enter and linefeed, fixing frozen menu behavior on niche Linux terminals. `common/src/util/messages.ts` adds `wellFormStringsInPlace` to recursively replace lone UTF-16 surrogates with U+FFFD before provider requests. 4b2b9ba193f215d52fdda833622d4929ab3b2be8.title: fitToolResults preserves fresh tool exchanges during history

8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.text: The free trial for a specific AI model ended, so it no longer appears in the selection list. Users already using this model can finish their current tasks, but new sessions must choose a different free option.

358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.text: The team updated the tool's internal records to match the latest release. This is a routine maintenance step that does not change how the tool works for you.

477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.text: The free chat option now uses the latest version of the DeepSeek model. You can choose between three levels of thinking effort, giving you more control over how detailed the answers are.

f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.text: A new experimental model is now available for free in the app's model picker. It uses its own specialized reviewer, so sessions work correctly without being blocked.

78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.text: A small update was made to the tool's internal tracking system. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.text: The free version of the assistant now uses a newer, more reliable model. This update helps prevent errors or refusals when the system is busy, ensuring smoother conversations.

6e392721fb79228f970577ee7d957562e282073f.text: The assistant updated its internal tracking system. Nothing changed for you. You can keep using it exactly as before.

77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.text: The software received a minor internal update. Nothing changed in how it works for you.

bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.text: New users now see clickable starter suggestions to help them begin. These disappear permanently after the first interaction to keep the screen clean.

bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.text: The assistant's underlying software was updated to a newer version. This change does not affect how the product works or what features are available to you.

c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.text: The software now recognizes an older assistant model. This helps the product work with clients released before July 2026.

ed26dd9b5f6f9727085a011414d3e8ceb738118f.text: The command-line tool was updated to its newest version. This is a small, internal change that keeps the tool current.

28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.text: You can now save your entire chat history to a file, which is helpful for long conversations that might otherwise be shortened. The system also waits longer before shortening history, and it no longer deletes past messages if the assistant fails to respond properly.

73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.text: You can now adjust how much the assistant thinks before answering by typing /reasoning. This lets you choose between faster, simpler replies or slower, more detailed ones without restarting the app.

61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.text: New assistant models are now available. Older tools are removed. Session and streak information displays more accurately.

3dc7ec2306d94243ab2ba83ab457b59bcd4713c1.text: A new command opens a full-screen view to edit, reorder, or delete messages waiting to be sent. This lets you manage your message queue directly without leaving the chat.

cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.text: The app removed the option to link an external account for extra features. The assistant now always uses its built-in tools.

98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.text: A new command opens your account dashboard in the browser. This gives you a single place to see your usage and stats, without needing to remember multiple different commands.

175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.text: Users can now connect their own AI service accounts to the assistant. Doing so removes ads and uses the user's existing subscription limits instead of the free tier.

4b2b9ba193f215d52fdda833622d4929ab3b2be8.text: The assistant now keeps its most recent actions and results intact while shortening older parts of the conversation. This helps prevent it from forgetting what it just did, making responses more accurate and consistent.

6f79426bd3986cb1cd77168c2e80b2ad53862550.text: The system now displays clearer labels for different access levels and shows a dash if data is missing. This makes subscription details easier to read and understand.

ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.text: Users can now type /copy to send the full chat history to their clipboard. When connected remotely, the system automatically shortens the text to ensure it copies successfully.

b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.text: The code that decides which command suggestions to show was cleaned up. This change is internal and does not affect how the commands work.

44616e1e8cbc975b693b136b98b301ccc157d7d1.text: The price for the Solar Pro 4 model increased from 5 to 10 credits starting September 14, 2026. Previous promotional pricing is now marked as historical, so the system automatically shows the current cost.

2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.text: The team updated internal notes to help keep the website stable and working correctly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

286d268c11543e5525d49ce12cd2d707cdd5ecbc.text: A small internal update fixes how test sessions end during checks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

4ff23980eed8bb8c8060150d73829847ba390d48.text: A small internal test update stops the assistant from hallucinating answers. This change does not affect the product you use.

217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.text: When you hit your daily limit, you now see a direct link to add more credits. This lets you quickly top up and keep working.

4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.text: The app now stores sensitive login details in a temporary, private location instead of showing them in the main project folder or command history. This keeps your secrets safer while you use the product.

dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.text: The app now has a new command to check its health and resource usage. It also cleans up background tasks more reliably on Windows, preventing stuck programs from slowing down your computer.

72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.text: The cost report now separates actual usage from estimated full-day data, so you can see exactly how many hours were recorded versus what was forecasted.

3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.text: The team added a new automatic test to check that the website works correctly when it is published. This helps catch problems earlier so users are less likely to see broken features.

a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.text: Solar Pro 4 pricing reverted to metered pricing. OpenRouter price overrides now lack expiry dates, relying on a persistent discount.

51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.text: The app now tracks costs for paid subscribers more clearly. This helps show what money comes from subscriptions and what is still missing.

9d2ffeb174143be273cd3257275edcf79094c33f.text: The app now includes several new free options for the AI assistant. Some of these new choices work best in specific places, and two of them can also look at pictures.

abd23ca628058b352e08b9fc4028f775b2c72042.text: A small internal update was made to how the product is packaged for distribution. This change does not affect how you use the product or add any new features.

0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.text: Fixed a startup error that occurred when project settings were missing. The tool now handles this situation gracefully without crashing.

dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.text: The assistant now views images as actual pictures instead of broken text, but this only works if the app provides the necessary image-reading support. Large images are still rejected, requiring users to shrink them first.

aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.text: Operators can now change the price required to accept sponsored compute tasks without updating the software. If no new price is set, the system uses the previous default.

a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.text: The system now checks special ad display data to ensure it is correct. If the data is broken, the system ignores it instead of saving it.

a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.text: New users will randomly see either monthly or yearly pricing for the house subscription, and this choice will stay the same every time they visit.

ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.text: You can now pay for your subscription yearly instead of monthly. The system checks if yearly plans are available for your specific tier before letting you buy.

1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.text: When the app says it is too busy, it now shows the exact number of people who can use it at once. This helps you know the limit without guessing.

871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.text: The tool received a routine update. You do not need to do anything.

4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.text: The app now shows ads in specific spots on iPhone screens. Users will see these new ads while chatting or coding.

02082cce25560ae06491ef8c0ef30c6518b5afc7.text: The team added tests to verify the assistant correctly finds and uses the right agents. No user-facing changes.

385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.text: The app now asks for permission before starting if your spending limit is too high. This helps prevent unexpected charges.

2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.text: The account page now labels spending limits as 'model spend' instead of 'tokens' to clarify costs. For some users, dollar amounts are hidden, so the page shows no cost details.

1dd01919a42648d9da8f473c4f84b3b0b55b8605.text: The text tool stopped using a helper that made error messages look nicer. This change does not affect how the tool works.

6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.text: The app now shows a clear message when purchases are paused, instead of saying the service is down. This helps you understand that the issue is temporary and not a system failure.

f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.text: The chat assistant now uses a different, more thoughtful AI model that takes extra time to reason carefully before answering. This means responses may be slower but more accurate and detailed.

af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.text: Switching from our built-in tools to your own account settings works once, but you cannot switch back later. This keeps your account details safe and unchanged during ongoing tasks.

5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.text: The default credit limit for postpaid users increased. A new rule ensures that service is only paused if the account balance drops below a specific threshold, preventing unexpected cutoffs.

2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.text: The website's promotional banners for the paid subscription plan were updated. You may see different headlines and pricing information when visiting the site.

bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.text: Desktop sessions now stay open for 15 minutes of inactivity instead of 10. This gives you more time to step away without losing your place.

4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.text: The app now handles technical errors more clearly, showing friendly messages instead of confusing codes. Internal updates also prevent occasional glitches when saving work.

cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.text: The app now safely adds a clickable link for sponsored content without changing the agreed-upon terms. You will see a clear button to visit the advertiser's page when relevant.

df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.text: The service switched to a different connection to help the provider find a problem. Your data still stays private and is never used to train the AI.

c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.text: Older desktop versions now show a clear message asking for an update instead of a confusing error when they cannot resume your purchased time. This change only affects how the app tells you what to do next.

e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.text: The system now sends your location information to ad partners. This helps them show ads that fit your area and track how well those ads work for you.

c53b6a752b9954bbd96a70f0d3eafd60c350491f.text: The system updated its internal checks to match a new way of organizing instructions. This small change ensures the assistant continues to follow rules correctly, with no visible difference for users.

a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.text: The app cleaned up some unused internal tools. This change does not affect how you use the product.

b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.text: The system now tracks purchase usage to prevent errors when buying items. This ensures your transactions complete correctly without needing to retry failed attempts.

81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.text: The system now automatically hides temporary login keys from being saved in the wrong place. This small internal update keeps your account safer without changing how you use the product.

54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.text: The software received a small, routine update to its internal numbering system. This change does not add new features or fix any specific problems, so users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.text: The app no longer blocks you after spending a set amount in a day. Instead, it may pause briefly between requests to help manage usage.

17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.text: The tool now carefully tracks session refunds to prevent errors when closing the program. If a refund fails, the session stays open so you can retry, ensuring you do not lose your credit.

abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.text: Closing a welcome message no longer accidentally starts a paid session. Also, you can now tap locked features to see pricing details.

6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.text: The app moved its 'Earn' message to a safer spot so it won't get deleted when old features are removed. You will see slightly updated text on the referral banner: 'Earn Freebucks · engage with a promoted post'.

5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.text: Starting September 9, the price for Solar Pro 4 dropped to zero freebucks. Past prices remain recorded for accounting accuracy.

f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.text: The daily limit for using Freebucks has increased to four times your balance. You can now use more Freebucks each day before hitting the cap.

04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.text: The model list now shows a clear 'Peak pricing' label and details for models with a temporary extra cost, replacing the old text-only notice. Prices and timing are adjusted to your local time zone.

95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.text: The number of free premium sessions you get per day goes back to 5. This matches the limit from before the recent level system was removed.

7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.text: Small internal update. When an ad fails to load, the system now records more details about why the ad network rejected it. This helps support staff fix issues faster.

e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.text: A specific AI assistant is no longer blocked for general paid users, allowing those with full access to use it. However, it remains restricted for limited-tier accounts.

5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.text: The app now uses a different AI model for its free hero feature, while keeping the previous model available as a backup. This change fixes a bug where the first use of the feature would fail if the main model was locked, making the service more reliable.

253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.text: The system now automatically tracks when free promotions start and end based on price changes, rather than using fixed dates. This ensures you are never charged for usage during a free promotion period.

8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.text: The warning message shown when a usage limit is reached is now shorter and simpler. This change removes confusing technical guesses about why the limit was hit, making the notice easier to understand.

872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.text: Advertisers now see clearer reasons why ads are blocked, distinguishing between country rules and placement issues. This helps them fix targeting settings faster.

4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.text: Some users were wrongly told they had run out of free credit. The system now correctly checks your remaining balance before blocking access.

f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.text: The system now records basic details about each task the assistant performs. This internal update helps track performance without saving any private conversation content.

54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.text: The command-line tool now shows how long until the free daily credit limit resets. This matches what users see in the web and desktop versions.

ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.text: The tool that helps the app package itself received a small routine update. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.text: A small internal update lets the system keep a sample settings file visible. This helps the team set up the product correctly without showing real personal data.

d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.text: A small internal update was made to the software's packaging system. This change does not affect how you use the product.

a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.text: Sponsored headlines now display cleanly without showing raw code symbols. If an advertiser uses incorrect formatting, the text appears as plain words instead. This change is small and internal.

c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.text: The app now shows wait times in days instead of hours for monthly limits. It also fixes a display error so you see the correct number of free uses left, rather than a dollar amount.

fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.text: The app now shows clearer messages about the new points system on the main screen. It also fixes a glitch so the welcome message stays hidden after you close it.

02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.text: The app now shows special sponsor breaks for Freebuff Pro. These ads use new images and are kept separate from regular content.

6c846b9d1e27bda1da35cfbe900f062eefb7e2b2.text: The command-line tool now shows your credit balance and lets you choose models by cost. A one-time welcome card explains how usage is charged.

4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.text: The assistant gained access to a new model with limited free usage. The interface now shows remaining free credits more accurately and consistently to prevent display glitches.

76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.text: The assistant now uses a new default model for most users, while limited-access users keep the previous one. Badge displays for certain models were corrected to show accurate availability times.

88e05db4b26f8e58eca99dbae7cf8ef26f22d0a5.text: The system now tracks how you interact with sponsor breaks to tell the difference between thoughtful exits and quick dismissals. This data helps adjust how often and in what format these breaks appear to better suit your preferences.

2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.text: The system now strictly checks sponsor data to prevent display errors and separates different types of breaks so they don't interfere with each other's limits. These are small internal fixes that keep the app running smoothly.

e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.text: From September 5 to 7, the Solar Pro 4 model costs zero credits instead of five. After this period, the price returns to normal.

f1654d2c20dcf2cc75a464b7c6707d1cfeef6711.text: Solar Pro 4 is now a standard option instead of an experimental test. Users can select it normally without seeing warning labels.

7d386183ac1fba92b91d0fd6116ed7f61dbacd6d.text: Clarified how bonus time works. Unused monthly bonuses stay until the next period starts, not when the plan ends.

9f81f91397709452f3b757a035fb9e93d0ab9454.text: A specific AI model is back for free users after a speed issue was fixed. It also moved to a premium list, so paid subscribers now have a daily limit on how much they can use it.

d573b4d0977a99b5bea28768a03e3731c51343f5.text: The system can now measure how different ad formats affect user choices without slowing down the app.

3de218cfbec42f26a76cf460205d0a5727735c10.text: If the system can't reach the offer, it now stays visible but disabled, instead of disappearing. Only a confirmed removal hides it. This prevents temporary glitches from making offers vanish.

b8a55e9b61345917b0f8b470e4c02ab4f4956d4f.text: The system now enforces fixed spending limits for sponsored tasks and checks that these limits are set correctly. It also hides sensitive login keys from error reports to keep accounts safer.

b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.text: The app now records how long the ad dismissal button stays locked. This helps ensure ad timings stay consistent.

20289ffb12000c10fd26cd3735849066e963d1cc.text: The system now records clearer details when a link fails to work, helping engineers spot problems faster.

d4ee9ca285c94e9348a7da806a9d2b7ecc69807b.text: The sponsor panel now expands to show more details when you press a specific key combination. It automatically hides when you send a message or take over the screen, and only appears if your window is tall enough to fit it.

7b211367021e612630a9c1040fea39abdc157e45.text: When you ask the assistant to plan a task, it now strictly avoids making any actual changes to your files or system. This ensures that planning steps remain safe and separate from execution, preventing accidental edits while you are still deciding on the approach.

f3857f1b81fa3b21e59eba6564a47a8edb64c5f3.text: The system now hides internal technical details from advertisers, showing only simple, safe messages about why ads were or were not shown. It also sets a fixed maximum cost for certain self-service ad placements.

df4b9aa599930aa2b2b9b2bd283089261c4d445d.text: Measurement data now comes from your device instead of a central server to ensure accuracy. This change does not affect how you use the product.

8fafc97b35aa47a8dcea952690e2a8bf115f2da8.text: The system now waits longer before switching to a backup model. This gives it more time to find a working connection, reducing unnecessary fallbacks.

23c15cfd4656c6eb305dfe9e4bbab938ebadbed8.text: The system now records when advertiser reports are viewed, including details like how long it took and how many results were shown. This helps track report usage and performance for internal monitoring, but users will not see any change in how the product works.

2a92b62f5263e702f76e3a7c3b9f89b29a046710.text: The internal packaging files were updated. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

09fa12bf061ab808dd43735fc2de7beb5288e441.text: When a spending limit is reached, the system now stops trying to send the request again and immediately shows the specific message from the server. This prevents unnecessary delays and ensures the user sees the correct reason for the block rather than a generic error.

2476a76f4dd8eb14dba89d848e676146c839a7e5.text: The system now records a specific measurement label with each financial record. This internal change helps the service track performance without affecting what you see or do.

bb9e8822ea946d45870d09ff2ad8db35f872bbda.text: The system now clearly shows that your balance mixes permanent earnings with monthly bonuses that expire. When you spend, it uses the expiring bonuses first so you do not lose them.

e2b7fe5a4ebe36206150cc194cc297fc0c8bd251.text: The system now tells the assistant exactly which tool you are using instead of guessing. This helps the assistant understand your needs better.

f25d4059b88ff4bdca2e120522d0970fb8d2d103.text: The app now shows a 'this month' spending limit and how much you have left. The spent amount updates once an hour, so it might not show the very latest costs right away.

7bdce0946bbc83e804efd99fca98fa2d99b90e19.text: The software now restricts access to one premium model and limits how many tasks you can run at once to prevent errors. If you leave a task idle for ten minutes, the system automatically frees up space for new requests.

8870810f21a3f99ee8e7f349bd10e1dce92488d2.text: In regions with limited access, the web app now offers a wider selection of AI models, including a faster option. Your spending limits still apply, and the most advanced model remains restricted to paid plans.

219a700815b8cd4d3e19ae9761b2127a53a669e0.text: The team cleaned up the code behind the scenes to make the service more reliable and secure. They also added a new type of ad layout to test how it looks for users.

10144f7ad1bd85fa528642276370444f1862214b.text: Fixed an internal setup issue that previously blocked development builds. No visible change for users.

13c3ba7d0b36a754116bac24f76957a3eebb9f64.text: A small internal update adds a unique tracking number to each ad request. This helps the system organize and match records more accurately, but you will not notice any change while using the product.

6e53c6db1674d4f343f2392092a6f316fa9644fb.text: A small internal update helps the system check what access level the main service assigned, instead of guessing. This prevents the menu from showing the wrong label for what you can actually do.

7c5cc043fcad67cd82f362c61bc4c82cae553a78.text: Introductory discounts now scale with the subscription tier, offering $3, $6, or $15 off instead of a flat $3. This ensures higher-priced plans provide more significant savings relative to their cost.

6222be5e6b2164b7dae9ff261d06be5fc88c2b47.text: The message for sponsored proposals now omits details about session and credit usage. Although the text is shorter, running these proposals still uses your credits.

6470ff421860de64df4196f6891f11470625bce0.text: The app now tracks how long ads take to appear and uses unique labels to prevent counting the same ad view twice. This helps the team spot slow-loading ads and keep ad reports accurate.

3160888e27f2fb25238fef56ff8e67b9d8d1f5ea.text: This is a small, internal update to the test data used to check how sponsored proposals display logos. It ensures the system properly recognizes when a logo is present versus missing. You will not see any visible changes in the product.

a852b83bdfb6dbc2fdc996eb33eecc2e1fbb2489.text: The system now records clearer details about why certain actions were included in a sample for measurement. This helps the team understand how often specific features are used, without changing how the product works for you.

0f33961336a021a0fe9943aa72144fec1183c3ab.text: The system now tracks when you decline a suggestion, when a task fails, and when it succeeds. This helps improve how the assistant works, but does not change what you see or pay.

ebb4deb34adc86dfaa1b4584d98edaf6db889f3d.text: The assistant now stops immediately when you cancel a request. This prevents it from continuing to wait or retry in the background after you have already left.

38b9fb0ffb5f0f14035dcf78969d153d7b0acfd8.text: The app now asks for permission before running an ad proposal, so you can review it first. Saying no cancels the request without saving anything.

7faa16471f65d093f3535980864182ff79dac50a.text: The consent prompt for sponsored content now appears as a single sentence showing the advertiser's name. This makes the request shorter and easier to read.

892f79590b0dbbf4753d4f66051c8b3d8af7a3ce.text: The system now records when ad requests are refused. This helps operators monitor the service. No user data is stored.

6b1963707ad3659f9d2308535dff59f317cd8174.text: A new setting lets the software hide its automatic signature lines from certain saved changes. This keeps the history cleaner for specific tasks, but normal use stays exactly the same.

18eee2a9d4ab53dcf63a34e2a5b113f86b86f469.text: A confusing dollar limit display was removed from your session. Only the main usage meter now appears, making it easier to understand which limit applies.

9b16ec41446c36cc56ac43f225aa3b720d29d848.text: A security step that required a special code to delete an account has been removed. This means the system no longer checks for that specific code before allowing account deletion.

60123cbaaa09113e6f314b9c877df53e41165095.text: The system now uses a unique marker for each transaction to ensure it is counted only once, even if the process repeats. This prevents duplicate entries in your records.

7b65652ad9decd202054622a7fbe267cc7c11201.text: The system now records extra details about where requests come from and how it makes decisions. This helps the team tell the difference between normal behavior and technical problems, without changing what you see or do.

c6a7eae9e05dad4f07be5d34298dcecf93ed08bd.text: The system now records extra details about ads to help measure their effectiveness. This change does not affect which ads you see.

f27429b2728f0614353df3194a77b493d0444e18.text: A check was added to ensure that advanced features are only marked as working after real user testing, not just internal simulations. This prevents the system from showing false success reports for these features.

7f41c17658f1631e318a9aa7b0e4d9bd26ad58da.text: The assistant now gives clearer instructions when a desktop app is needed to approve an action, and blocks unsafe file paths to prevent mistakes.

4ff67e17e1d2980de3411ac0f573e20160b845d8.text: The app now correctly shows if a task is running or failed instead of asking you to start it again. It also fixes errors that happened when saving work in certain project setups.

6edee52fa9c4ab5511163f99269dd8613f0669f2.text: The app now runs sponsored tasks in a safer, isolated way on your computer. This change tightens security to prevent tasks from accessing more of your system than they need.

d4bc77782d48297b04fb290ea5fb43ca4dae0d37.text: The software's internal packaging was updated. This change affects only how the product is bundled for release and does not add new features or fix bugs for users.

26a3a70dac0329050970baa5e1d585b22c8ada9a.text: The privacy policy text was updated to match the September 2 version. The wording about data storage and partners was clarified.

afc8351b5b724273614569816b30691f1fecf536.text: The assistant stopped using a paid deep research service. It now relies on a standard web search provider, so users lose access to advanced research features.

2a6cd7375ba0be59db222123a7294c0982ad0453.text: The system can now easily share its list of known temporary email services with other parts of the network. This helps keep spam filters up to date without changing how the main system checks email addresses.

9ede9a4a53b7798cd504493c12aa75323f7a0225.text: Small internal update. Developers clarified that a specific test step ignores live settings to prevent errors. This keeps the product stable.

477a8a0d84c0b6cd3c5181ef0a6498eec2079321.text: The system now keeps two types of session updates separate, so it can report active sessions more clearly. This is an internal change and you will not notice any difference.

9b2ca33ed534768e4860d8b6949da3934abf2d81.text: Paid subscribers no longer see internal house ads. Other ads remain unchanged.

59cca53dfb5bc9c9c03141f91494646de4a40ce3.text: The system stopped using a special marker to remember which test group you are in for certain ads. This change is internal and mostly affects how the system logs data, so you likely won't notice a difference in how the product works.

26f3b123cc05ef5f25fd8b0fe2adf7fbbdeeb691.text: The rules for showing ads were clarified in the notes. This change does not affect what you see.

56dbe402f41689aa095fa05026ddd53037ff462d.text: The system now sets a fixed 24-hour limit for certain ad tracking tokens. This prevents errors when users pause and resume activities, ensuring smoother performance.

dd1d934b7418b612d453d52e5fc2091011923dbc.text: The assistant now uses a new, lower-cost default model for all users. Your saved preferences automatically update to match this change.

6a4ad1d04afdcc25bf6aea1e3503199ae65e39c3.text: A newer, improved version of the AI assistant is now the default choice for new chats. Existing conversations can finish using the old version, but your saved settings will automatically switch to the new one.

3975224904d989f60ad8db9139bf51b7390e67c0.text: The assistant now handles sponsored proposals through new commands and menu options. Keyboard shortcuts on cards were removed to avoid conflicts with typing, so users must use commands or menus to control proposals.

8221e333895c0933b2ab58d669ac40272c339eb8.text: The system now tracks spending limits separately from your account balance and daily usage. This ensures that specific plan restrictions are enforced correctly without blocking other funds.

6891efd69b17644d4cc43382efd3a757e25507a1.text: The system now uses a fixed rule to consistently group you, so ads shown to you stay stable. It also records more details about which ads are eligible for you.

f2ddf900349a34acf802d7645accc70840d0a4f3.text: The assistant can now use a new deep research tool that searches across many sources and combines the results into a single, cited answer. This means you get a clearer, more reliable summary instead of a long list of raw links.

d227b0349fd05b02d6d5a0f0c628783996fbf89d.text: The system now records whether it successfully found a user's account during sign-in attempts. This helps the team understand how well identity verification works without storing personal details.

e47bf5c35bbc5397a02ad2dc1074907ad4fdf225.text: The system now checks if a specific type of house campaign is allowed to run for you, based on your location and account settings. This change is internal and mostly affects how ads are selected behind the scenes, so you might not notice any difference in your experience.

a71de944590b9d02d5c182133e8c17de5e600db0.text: The assistant now uses its deepest thinking mode again. This restores better reasoning quality for complex tasks, fixing a recent update that made it think too briefly.

48b5fee79a1016800772e01eafa8ceb3db346f98.text: Free users can now try the assistant six times again instead of three. This restores the original limit for regular users while keeping protections against abusive accounts.

a90d9c446543900a2ec75675fe03844a537ac3f1.text: The system now manages memory differently depending on which model you use. For some models, it clears old information faster, while others keep it longer. This helps the assistant stay efficient without losing track of your conversation.

c179bfcc451be624a8bffc032075ba836a5a967b.text: The team added checks to ensure numbers display correctly. This prevents minor calculation errors from appearing in the app.

c10a9f304bd1337ad48ef2b2294d38af5e460dab.text: The subscription notice now updates its length automatically. The window changed from 5 to 7 days. You will see the correct number instead of old text.

3b8fa14a1010363bb909958213fa8beea9c31a30.text: The system now tracks which free ads lead to payments, helping measure ad performance without exposing sensitive user data.

2a958f98f5f8c683057d7419feae9093bea14cfb.text: One-time card charges now show a clearer name on your statement. This makes it easier to recognize the purchase.

01bf3cd467fb1a2700c866b3097fff745b3c0f5b.text: The free version now displays weekly and monthly usage limits in the selection menu. This update only changes what you see and does not yet apply these limits to your actual usage.

8592ea01be0a05c20e0741bc3b1dfe82c4694e7b.text: The system now keeps temporary setup details in a private folder instead of the main archive. This ensures sensitive approval data stays secure and out of shared records.

e1792f99509f9abc40904b9f4dad683d57510329.text: The system now tracks when ads are actually seen by users, not just loaded. This ensures more accurate billing and reporting for both web and desktop apps.

ae136bca432c7f3c74cb18d6c7fda924de2d8a12.text: The app's internal label updated. This routine change does not affect how the tool works or looks for you.

0d2d7a08594e7172e82d0f59a6a4c8a6bcc001b4.text: The daily limit for using this AI model was removed, allowing you to use it more often until the current discount ends on September 10.

390944fda9461b1401383ef148dfcd844f8d4427.text: The team added extra checks for the text cursor. This internal work helps prevent future bugs when moving the cursor up or down.

5d679590800f31569758fe1002a5ef087668f7b7.text: The assistant switched to a cheaper, more efficient model to handle its thinking tasks. You will likely see no change in how it works, but the service can now run more sustainably without high costs.

d36ecd09839c43b9c0949a8ad83ea5a171cba6bc.text: The system now records extra details about why it sometimes shows fewer ads. This helps the team understand and improve ad delivery.

321907165f73f9a66f780f275f38e27092f87aa9.text: The system can now occasionally show the main book's ad instead of a partner's ad for users in select regions. This adjustment helps balance which ads appear, though it may not be noticeable for most people.

3dd1da66d178a91f9d099d3370564ecb00dde3dc.text: The tool received a routine update. This change does not add new features or fix problems for users.

161b864dd4f665957ded8250837935b5f8612cfc.text: The app now uses a shared system to display sponsored content. This helps the ads look and work the same way on different devices.

6341ef3af85281a213d98d6fab35e502e544dbd5.text: The system now correctly identifies where ads should appear on your screen. This fixes a bug that could cause ads to fail to load or register clicks properly, especially in older chat formats.

7bcf9ba0b06d17819d238906d0d0436fa1eb432e.text: The app now shows shorter time labels, like '24 hrs', in tight spaces to keep cards readable.

605ba1edc6365594cf457c25adab324cb801d41c.text: A small internal fix prevents a live system setting from accidentally breaking testing tools. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

b6775f5c3e83b041816b59b2c2bb6dcadadf9f91.text: Preview widths for ad placements were adjusted to fit better within the dialog box. This prevents horizontal scrollbars from appearing when viewing ad creatives.

091a224cd3b63af11dbded3dea62c726a669d112.text: Internal testing tools now let administrators skip collecting file change history and block access to sensitive system paths. This change does not affect how the product works for regular users.

70f1d8d632956affcf4ef483ae0c317dfd8d9403.text: The assistant now always uses a steady, high-effort thinking mode to prevent endless loops. You no longer need to adjust settings; it works reliably out of the box.

210f7ac71cdb6b0f59662b85b4b86cdf0ef5e723.text: The minimum price charged for a click in countries with low sales activity dropped from 50 cents to 10 cents. This allows ads to show and earn money in places where they were previously too expensive to run.

12f8f2bb5b72969b7114cec9f24ae47e7e5e4500.text: Token counts are now accurate and formatted consistently, preventing inflated totals for cached requests.

a49b46d62f39fd4cf45e3ba02499b8aefbca0d24.text: The app now shows clearer upgrade options when you hit usage limits and reminds you as you get close to your daily cap. Paid accounts have higher spending limits than free ones, and the weekly usage period is now correctly shown as seven days.

fcb16dec8af815505ae1dcc2d4f8be9c907fc814.text: The system now strictly limits the Solar Pro 4 assistant to one interaction per day to control costs and ensure data privacy compliance.

d49020039fb91ec4c15dbfeaf70940853e84f5e8.text: The link that connects your account to GitHub now goes to a different settings page. This is a small internal fix to match the website's current layout.

f9b0815704eb34ebed2b8852b1a27c4902664d58.text: The app now shows how much credit you have left for the day, week, or month. This helps you see exactly what you can spend before running out.

31e6e831630f42720b61aa08561daa941dbf4ed3.text: The system previously added up cached text twice, making usage numbers look much higher than they really were. This fix corrects the calculation so you see an accurate count of the words the assistant uses.

21d3b7668e7f43c2bcfbcd065b1915ae4329f6d3.text: If you have a full subscription, referral rewards now give you one extra chat each day instead of unlocking a special AI model. Limited subscribers still get access to that model through the banner.

94eb1cfce38c1ccd0f91a5a7a1e66013863eabbb.text: Ads now change based on your location. This helps show better matches, but keeps old behavior as default.

dcc6b662d492759a0776826bd0ee32e36480baa4.text: The maximum daily spending limit for ad placements increased from $50 to $500. The slider for setting this limit now uses steps that make low amounts easier to select, preventing small budgets from being hard to adjust.

443f19f0eae03bcbc0dfb3ac6a5cd869fb9dcbae.text: You can now type instructions after selecting a skill to guide its output, or just press enter to run it as-is. The screen also shows how much space the conversation is using to help you manage long chats.

f3e97864f5d12d3df41f0bc10e08b5afd66dd101.text: The account status labels shown to users are now kept separate from the internal rules that check trust levels. If a system error occurs, the app will still let you use the free mode without slowing you down.

d88c688727818ebcf7ce9bdcdcc18ba16d7946a2.text: Ad prices now follow one strict rule to prevent errors. This keeps costs steady and predictable for you.

7266e1b5944dd0a7094a9cbaa49361d470b67c9e.text: A safety check was added to ensure all subscription options are correctly listed online. This prevents the system from accidentally switching you to a different model when you view the plans page.

a67e89052816db2de4de5bc42c4b6c318f91797a.text: Paid subscribers can now open more desktop sessions at the same time. Free users keep their original limits.

477b0e47facf165557cca9b60a070dacc3f6f9d9.text: The model picker now checks your paid subscription to keep your chosen model instead of switching it to a free one.

646e9fe14848ff98d26448d1c90f42422e3dbe8a.text: The software version number increased. Nothing else changed, so how the tool works stays exactly the same.

9c2974837d8b90725ae61ebe6ac5c8c7f29ea493.text: Added internal tests for the command-line tool to check how it displays time. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

c3521fd87fc4c8f683e73c08251772dc976ca8ec.text: The app now checks account deletion requests using a secure digital seal to prevent errors. This ensures your data is only removed after the request is fully verified.

9c1de51074bf984f2827742fffce78a1e7580203.text: The system now ignores lists of user emails when saving changes. This small internal fix helps keep private data safe.

fd3c20c290bf78152ecc86ab7ba9191f420ca1ea.text: The free assistant now uses a new, cheaper model by default. This change removes the previous limit on how many times you can chat each day.

94288ad24bcefe362692ded7a3a8c692a503ff16.text: The app stopped using a specific AI model for premium features. This change helps manage costs and keeps the service running smoothly for everyone.

8542dfe658589b2433a7d039b031d1e0eab1be07.text: Rules for advertiser credit limits are now set in stone. This ensures credits follow strict daily spending caps and minimum requirements, with exceptions only for disputes.

e5d41741aeca4ae11989042f2af1647b94c11e41.text: The assistant now offers a new setting to control how much thinking time it uses, with a maximum option added. The default thinking level was slightly lowered to match the new maximum setting, giving you clearer control over its depth.

df7e3aa400c51c34ba5185d01ce1527c892a671f.text: A small internal cleanup removed a duplicate shortcut for formatting time. Nothing changes for you.

4a9013b2a97bd2bade3e61b99f3deb7814094eb0.text: The system now records which path a conversion used to arrive, separating secure server connections from browser-based ones. This helps the service team track performance and filter logs correctly without affecting how you use the product.

f4fca07fcd3d2a041699d3c1216bb216d2dae2ec.text: The system now sets a minimum price for ad clicks based on location. This ensures ads remain fairly priced in different countries without changing existing base rates.

23c05c4a5fce1db9301b66529c2dd543d51c1e77.text: The system now tracks spending for actual ad delivery separately from other charges. This keeps performance numbers accurate even if extra fees appear later.

590e6d257bf4128557f1e5823077c586bb424138.text: Ads now spread evenly across each hour instead of bunching up after quiet periods. This stops the system from spending its entire daily allowance too quickly or resetting at midnight.

6ace1d00c9409518218bbf90225391e9002a5b21.text: Ad delivery timing is now randomized within daily limits to prevent predictable patterns. This change only affects when ads are offered, so your actions are never rejected due to past ad engagement.

1312fa1702921f9df8394bf191da9ef062fba043.text: The app now uses a backup image for a specific ad icon when the main image is unavailable. This ensures the ad displays correctly without requiring manual updates.

bd4a417e32556ffb2004437274d0cdd893ad3907.text: The system now strictly separates ad performance tracking from billing, ensuring advertisers are only charged when a proposal is accepted. This change prevents accidental charges for other activities and keeps the cost of sponsored ads predictable.

179f317de8d228cc02d32ac4730781a8c0aadbc9.text: A new version of the command-line tool is available. This update only changes the version number, so it does not add new features or fix any bugs.

57c010db236b4b5ffba7030cb4eff4bb50a4a333.text: The tool now shows your current usage limits and when they reset. This helps you see if you can keep using it or need to wait.

72fffec8570aebd6a07ae1fce403fcdedee01dbd.text: You can use GLM 5.3 Flash without hitting daily limits.

1f35b8067456bba14e902e3018e6c41545b2a64e.text: The system now records only basic information about ad decisions, such as how long they took and if they succeeded, without saving any private details like specific links or error messages.

8f390e940d2f9457ea52bca4567f727f0a049277.text: The assistant now separates its internal planning notes from the final answer, so private thoughts no longer appear as visible text.

5c0c933cea38831e8f3c2a1042c1852363445159.text: Budget spending can now follow a curve that starts fast and slows down, rather than just decreasing evenly. This helps spread out daily spending limits more smoothly, so you do not run out of budget too early in a campaign.

2f4829e864d268f1cd6987537fd7956f6c67d0dc.text: The app now shows a built-in subscription offer when no paid ads are available. This keeps the ad space filled with a consistent price that matches checkout.

42989afa85b9d0c2cf43c220309ef9f05951d3bb.text: The assistant can now use a specific model during busy hours again. This change helps keep the service running smoothly and reduces costs for other models.

3623ca3ffeb9e8ed71a65207075c1d4d18e639f3.text: The app now allows up to 25 different ad versions per campaign instead of 10. This prevents errors when creating multiple ad variations.

d40c36e4aae67b74e3067d4c23a2c1c3db9bf665.text: The system now hides internal backup copies from the main project, preventing duplicate data and errors.

02f42768b0bc73acb01625d4d082a2f6f72d497e.text: Paid subscribers in certain regions can now select premium AI models directly from the menu, instead of being forced to use a basic option. This fixes a display error so the available choices match what your account actually supports.

7bb5501109a4dd88daf5e262cb1356b7b815b200.text: The system now limits displayed trust levels to a standard range. This prevents confusing errors when showing progress in the app.

f68e7ca5489c3652786a98440b44dc36b95d9176.text: The app now adjusts daily spending limits for non-subscription ads using a steady, hard-to-predict pattern. This helps manage budgets without changing the prices you pay.

ec3142a4e62ca638acd914b68a3842d4e8c347f3.text: Developers can now test message sending more easily. This small internal update makes the app more reliable for everyone.

9188c032117f7f2326e7bec8afb0a1bc62c33c1a.text: Ad experiments now pick random requests instead of fixed users. This keeps test groups balanced as traffic shifts. Users may see slightly different ads over time.

0591414315966ad5f2442f39de7c0ca6a9478558.text: The default spending limit for postpaid advertisers dropped from $250 to $100. This restricts how much you can spend before paying.

2cf1163dc72fd40df1b7d56a4ed94d668116dc47.text: The app now handles slow responses and access errors more reliably. This prevents the software from getting stuck while waiting for data and provides clearer feedback if the service is not enabled.

cb3ef3135c27c68f08c1c3e92290607a08732afc.text: A popular AI model is now available without a daily usage limit, though it draws from your general credit balance. A new billing system handles payments for this model.

38feaebb146a689d5dbf3a38b322e7db2e63f071.text: The system now tracks how different ad setups perform behind the scenes to help choose the best ones for you. This change is internal and does not alter what you see.

a4837a425cd7f9ac57d590d53a9ef1bc20fa63f6.text: The software now supports searching on Windows computers with ARM processors. This change adds a new platform option to the internal search tool.

5c250334a319ef47c7ae2d5653ec7f062e1eead1.text: New rules added for advertising launch promos. Promo credits expire in 60 days. Referrer rewards capped at 10.

6f7cf660e827d750b278497432eebfa763ca58e5.text: Ads now appear on the desktop new-tab screen. This change is small and internal.

b3e1d17c5a89e05ad7692f0dd70466a97851a3c7.text: The system now limits how many times it reports the same error repeatedly to prevent sudden cost spikes. This stops endless error messages from being sent while still letting the team know when a new problem occurs.

bd5c18ff73257a748a3bd0e402e25af4c012649f.text: Paid users in restricted regions can now use the new chat model. Daily limits were slightly reduced to keep plans fair.

47c4bf8cf7f311a30adfb47f4ca09d914cc3ce9a.text: The system now supports paying with a saved card if your balance goes negative, and automatically blocks extreme price changes for ads. This keeps your account history accurate and prevents unexpected costs.

9066513a775a950c3c5f620141e41cd8ebfc76b3.text: If you leave a chat tab open without sending messages, the system now releases the connection after ten minutes. This prevents the tab from blocking your ability to start a new conversation.

adbcb4e4a515334bd3f46580fe8188ba3d27bf84.text: The system now requires $100 in spending before granting a referral reward. When eligible, the reward is $500.

4ff202b7d262eb975b755a5da73965c661801cc6.text: The system now shows clear upgrade links when you run out of usage, and displays your allowance in hours instead of vague session counts.

f7d35db5a5e064e98c9f12739e68f1583ced9c5d.text: Your daily limit for this model now counts how many times you start a chat, not how long you use it. You can begin two conversations each day.

c359f63c20bbc0f7d23fb950af7764257b6ec274.text: Time displays for unavailable features now show clear zone labels to prevent confusion. This small fix ensures you see the correct local time when checking availability.

e30c58d37ea03426da0f01a727c5acff3895a462.text: The system now tells you when a specific model is permanently unavailable instead of making you guess. This stops you from wasting your session time on models that won't work.

ed224f5a8768b78f3333974446054d71497e4419.text: The command-line tool updated to a newer version. This is a small internal change that users will not notice.
