This sends a POST to `/api/v1/ads/click` with `impUrl` and `surface`, triggering PostHog event `ads.clicked` and DB update. Scope covers `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/choice-ad-banner.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, and new web API route `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/click/_post.ts`. Clicks are recorded before opening the URL, with auth token required and silent failure handling.

a3dbf723659094910c2cf7d85ec5535dadc3bd98.title: Block VPN and proxy traffic
a3dbf723659094910c2cf7d85ec5535dadc3bd98.summary: Freebuff now hard-blocks requests from VPN, proxy, and Tor networks. The CLI waiting room displays specific signal labels (e.g., 'VPN or Tor') instead of generic 'anonymized networks' text. Web API completions endpoint enforces this block by checking `ipPrivacySignals` against `FREEBUFF_HARD_BLOCKED_PRIVACY_SIGNALS` in `common/src/util/freebuff-privacy.ts`. Existing sessions using blocked networks will terminate with a 403 `free_mode_unavailable` error.

14fa5cb720bc6ffa0a47767e93d43d21fb01fb9a.title: Add incremental chat completion traces
14fa5cb720bc6ffa0a47767e93d43d21fb01fb9a.summary: SDK `RunState` gains `traceSessionId` (UUID), threaded through `run.ts` and `extraCodebuffMetadata` as `trace_session_id`. New BigQuery `chat_completion_traces` table stores `ChatCompletionTraceRow` with delta hashing (`delta_message_hashes`, `common_prefix_length`, `cache_hit`, `full_snapshot`) and JSON-stringified payloads. `setupBigQuery` auto-creates the table with monthly partitioning on `created_at` and clustering on `user_id`, `trace_session_id`, `trace_lineage_id`. CLI `run-state-storage.ts` imports `randomUUID` for state persistence alignment.

a85cb595b5dece0859ec6bb1d05f898d79ad0fdf.title: Add DeepSeek session trace exporter
a85cb595b5dece0859ec6bb1d05f898d79ad0fdf.summary: New script `scripts/export-deepseek-session-traces.ts` reconstructs multi-turn DeepSeek V4 free-mode sessions from BigQuery. It groups provider call rows by `client_id`, selecting the highest-context request to extract full conversation history. Targets include `base2-free-deepseek` (Pro) and `base2-free-deepseek-flash` (Flash). Supports sampling modes (newest, random, even) and date range filtering for trace export.

84778f9c96c19f127e53384b91190eb9d0e40c3c.text: The app now hides error messages when helper tasks finish without producing any results. This makes the conversation cleaner by removing confusing blank error notices.

6c000e2fb5fcd6455833bc4e8ef3b40662e05bcb.text: The app now tracks when you click an ad in the chat or waiting room.

092de618a0779bc979a7077e49bf77725042e455.text: The system now uses a second check to verify internet privacy. This reduces errors where safe connections were wrongly blocked. Clean results restore full access, while failures keep limited access.

4423d090bc0971f43a9c24e00c675b163ce61f38.text: Free features now skip balance checks. This prevents errors when using tools that cost nothing.

d555af2e5b1448463bf81cbb73702e6de7e7003a.text: A small internal update lets the team view recent conversation histories more easily. This change does not affect how you use the product.

692b6fa2f3086116b9bf800c806b6963bd46df3b.text: The setup page now shows a clear message when the link expires, instead of getting stuck.

565af42cfc6575e75f78e03f4ba8ad2609c4f31b.text: The assistant now knows today's date. This helps it give more accurate answers about time.

14fa5cb720bc6ffa0a47767e93d43d21fb01fb9a.text: The assistant now records detailed logs of each chat message to track how conversations are processed. This helps the team understand performance and fix issues faster.

a85cb595b5dece0859ec6bb1d05f898d79ad0fdf.text: The company added an internal tool to gather conversation history from their servers. This helps staff review how the AI assistant responds to users.

a3dbf723659094910c2cf7d85ec5535dadc3bd98.text: Freebuff now blocks connections that hide your identity, such as those using VPNs or proxies. If you use these services, you will see a specific warning and lose access to the free mode.

ae7713bb730569e0e4cfc464cd0e84ae5a4570c1.title: Clarify limited mode reason text in CLI waiting room
ae7713bb730569e0e4cfc464cd0e84ae5a4570c1.summary: Updated getLimitedModeReason in cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx to display 'based on detected country: <code>' instead of 'outside available countries (<code>)' for country_not_allowed errors. The change improves clarity on why access is restricted based on geolocation. Formatting adjustments were also applied to PRIVACY_SIGNAL_LABELS and selectorMaxHeight calculations.

2af416b863e4aab3507c0cb19b141fd839d44871.title: Clarify global availability in FAQ
2af416b863e4aab3507c0cb19b141fd839d44871.summary: Updated the FAQ answer in freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx to state that Freebuff is available in all countries, operating in either 'full' or 'limited' mode. This change clarifies that while full access is restricted to a specific list of countries, the service remains accessible globally with limited functionality.

d7915d1a449c1be76381e933b1237998f23e20ec.title: Remove redundant text from /live page
d7915d1a449c1be76381e933b1237998f23e20ec.summary: Removed explanatory subtitles and raw country codes from the /live stats view. Simplified the hero text and list items to focus on metrics. Updates `freebuff/web/src/app/live/live-client.tsx`.

522068a877a8196bc879f2fcd71b4e4d2ccbea38.title: Remove redundant live stats copy
522068a877a8196bc879f2fcd71b4e4d2ccbea38.summary: Stripped `sublabel` and descriptive paragraph from `HomepageLiveStats` in `live-summary.tsx`. Removed static text to reduce visual noise. Scope: Web live stats UI only.

f3d9f45431c96e2327bd28425a86a7bd853be3b4.title: Revert Windows Bun baseline compile target
f3d9f45431c96e2327bd28425a86a7bd853be3b4.summary: Reverts Windows Bun compile target from `bun-windows-x64-baseline` to `bun-windows-x64` across CI workflows and build scripts. Removes baseline-specific runtime preparation steps in `cli-release-build.yml`, `freebuff-e2e.yml`, and `npm-app-release-build.yml`. Updates `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts` and `setup-bun-compile-runtime` action to use standard x64 target.

cd83f663cb98745c005bd8ef51efcdf67cdf5f15.title: readfiles accepts absolute paths and fixes result mapping
cd83f663cb98745c005bd8ef51efcdf67cdf5f15.summary: read_files tool schema now accepts absolute paths within project root, previously restricted to relative paths. get-file-reading-updates.ts switched from filtering requestedFiles to mapping Object.entries(loadedFiles), fixing normalized path mismatches. Affects common/src/tools/params/tool/read-files.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/get-file-reading-updates.ts. Path normalization consistency ensured for agent file operations.

f60634199133dea8a0d80c669a57cc7d750525c0.title: CLI API client respects httpproxy env vars
f60634199133dea8a0d80c669a57cc7d750525c0.summary: Added proxy support to `createCodebuffApiClient` in `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts`. The client now resolves proxy URLs from `HTTPS_PROXY`, `https_proxy`, `HTTP_PROXY`, or `http_proxy` env vars, or explicit config. Pass `proxy: null` to disable. Applies to all API calls via Bun's `fetch` proxy option.

1796dbd4a28fab935a1eac47ddb0fa9db83fea66.title: Fix Freebuff 429 error messaging in CLI
1796dbd4a28fab935a1eac47ddb0fa9db83fea66.summary: The CLI now intercepts HTTP 429 rate-limit errors for Freebuff, displaying a friendly 'temporarily busy' message instead of raw API details. This is implemented via `getFreebuffRateLimitErrorMessage` in `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`, which checks for `statusCode === 429` and preserves specific `free_mode_rate_limited` messages if present. The fix applies to both `handleRunCompletion` and `handleRunError` in `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts`, gated by `IS_FREEBUFF`. Documentation in `docs/error-schema.md` is updated to reflect this new error handling path.

b1e92cb142e6cb222c6b54d9db58b5c4ac5a0109.title: Refactor live stats polling and add homepage summary
b1e92cb142e6cb222c6b54d9db58b5c4ac5a0109.summary: Extracted `useLiveStats`, `countryName`, and `EMPTY_LIVE_STATS` from `live-client.tsx` to new `live-stats-client.ts`. Added `enabled` and `pauseWhenHidden` options to the hook to support visibility-aware polling. New `live-summary.tsx` implements `HomepageLiveStats` using `IntersectionObserver` to trigger updates only when the section is visible. `home-client.tsx` now imports `HomepageLiveStats` instead of `CompactLiveStats`.

f14fd0cc343ecd2079f46853acc8966fee8a6449.title: Add freebuff access tier analytics
f14fd0cc343ecd2079f46853acc8966fee8a6449.summary: Access tier analytics added to completions API. `FreebuffAccessTier` type imported, `trackEvent` enriched with `accessTier` property. Proxy resolution uses `getSystemProcessEnv` in CLI. Covers `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

f14fd0cc343ecd2079f46853acc8966fee8a6449.text: The system now tracks which access level you have when you use the assistant. This helps the service understand usage patterns, but does not change how you interact with it.

522068a877a8196bc879f2fcd71b4e4d2ccbea38.text: We removed extra text from the live stats section on the homepage to make it look cleaner. You will see less clutter and fewer repeated details when checking these numbers.

d7915d1a449c1be76381e933b1237998f23e20ec.text: The live statistics page now shows only the key numbers. Extra text and country codes were removed to make the view cleaner.

cd83f663cb98745c005bd8ef51efcdf67cdf5f15.text: The assistant can now find files using their full location addresses instead of just short names. This prevents errors when the assistant tries to read specific files in your project.

2af416b863e4aab3507c0cb19b141fd839d44871.text: The help page now clarifies that you can use the service from any country. While some features may be restricted based on your location, basic access remains available worldwide.

ae7713bb730569e0e4cfc464cd0e84ae5a4570c1.text: When you cannot use the software due to your location, the message now simply states which country was detected. This makes the reason for the restriction clearer.

f60634199133dea8a0d80c669a57cc7d750525c0.text: The program now follows your computer's web proxy settings when connecting to the internet. If you use a proxy, the tool will work correctly without extra steps.

1796dbd4a28fab935a1eac47ddb0fa9db83fea66.text: When the service is too busy, the app now shows a simple message instead of confusing technical errors.

b1e92cb142e6cb222c6b54d9db58b5c4ac5a0109.text: The live statistics section now updates only when you are looking at it, and a new summary view appears on the homepage. This change reduces unnecessary background activity.

f3d9f45431c96e2327bd28425a86a7bd853be3b4.text: The software stopped using a special compatibility mode for Windows. This change is internal and should not affect how the product works for you.

6a1803431b6de7e4b6e4519bedfec9e164604a5b.title: Add /model alias to end-session
6a1803431b6de7e4b6e4519bedfec9e164604a5b.summary: Added aliases: ['model'] to the end-session command in cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts and cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts. This allows users to trigger the session-end model picker using /model instead of /end-session. Updated slash command description to remove redundant waiting room reference.

30c51ac38ce89001a9a39a00416a2d56ad446fce.title: Windows CLI builds switch to bun-windows-x64-baseline target
30c51ac38ce89001a9a39a00416a2d56ad446fce.summary: Windows binary compilation now targets bun-windows-x64-baseline instead of bun-windows-x64. A new composite action downloads and caches the specific Bun runtime zip, setting BUN_COMPILE_EXECUTABLE_PATH for the build script. cli/scripts/build-binary.ts passes this path to bun build --compile-executable-path when present. Scope covers CI workflows (cli-release-build, freebuff-e2e, npm-app-release-build) and the CLI build script.

9d59c700eaa58184656fe03f362b7a04c4aee4c0.title: CLI model selector adapts to short terminals
9d59c700eaa58184656fe03f362b7a04c4aee4c0.summary: CLI waiting-room components implement progressive disclosure for low-height terminals. The `useLogo` hook downgrades the ASCII art to a single-line text variant when the vertical budget falls below 6 rows. The `FreebuffModelSelector` and `LimitedLandingPanel` now accept a `maxHeight` prop, enabling internal scrollboxes with precise layout math to prevent flexbox compression. This ensures the model picker remains accessible and visually stable on small screens.

982f726c537864c08fa1e238ac7eae796286d453.title: Reduce chat request retention
982f726c537864c08fa1e238ac7eae796286d453.summary: Chat request logging now uses createRequestAuditRecord to store request summaries instead of full bodies. This change addresses retention issues by omitting messages from BigQuery inserts and telemetry. Covers all LLM API handlers (CanopyWave, DeepSeek, Fireworks, Moonshot, OpenAI, OpenCodeZen) and the main chat completions endpoint. The new helper extracts model, stream, temperature, max_tokens, and message/tool counts while setting messages_omitted: true.

7d451c872df79982a576bc3a1ac2906762cf1445.title: Fix disconnected stream retention
7d451c872df79982a576bc3a1ac2906762cf1445.summary: Added `skipDisconnectedBilling` for DeepSeek V4 Flash to cancel streams on client disconnect, preventing unnecessary consumption. Implemented `DISCONNECTED_STREAM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS` (2m) in OpenRouter to cancel disconnected streams that exceed the drain window. Updated chat completions telemetry to omit message bodies for `limited` access tiers. Changes affect `web/src/llm-api/deepseek.ts`, `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts`, and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

7dc62c8e1a89fb06800c16072f4db5e169f1ddb4.title: Web FAQ clarifies limited mode
7dc62c8e1a89fb06800c16072f4db5e169f1ddb4.summary: Added 'What is limited mode?' entry to home-client.tsx. Explains DeepSeek V4 Flash only and 5 one-hour sessions per day for VPN or non-full-access countries. Updated 'What models do you use?' and 'Which countries...' to distinguish full vs limited access. Minor documentation change.

e43653226f8be2c6f80ddbf0c98bcfa96cde9856.title: Add compact live stats to homepage
e43653226f8be2c6f80ddbf0c98bcfa96cde9856.summary: Added `CompactLiveStats` component to `home-client.tsx`. Updated `/api/live` cache headers to `s-maxage=60` and `stale-while-revalidate=30`. Server `getFreebuffLiveStats` now caches results for 60s. Client polling interval increased from 15s to 60s.

8cca5ab9b098ec1421e51a7c41b5eb13be0d2cda.title: Add Simplified Chinese README
8cca5ab9b098ec1421e51a7c41b5eb13be0d2cda.summary: Adds README.zh-CN.md with full Chinese translation of Codebuff/Freebuff docs. Links from English README via bilingual header. Covers CLI install, agent creation, SDK usage, and model picker details.

5380b97cc366aad170b24591ca16269002164dbd.title: Add /model aliases for CLI mode commands
5380b97cc366aad170b24591ca16269002164dbd.summary: Added aliases `model:<mode>` for all `mode:<mode>` commands in the CLI command registry and slash command data. This allows users to use `/model:<mode>` syntax interchangeably with `/mode:<mode>`. Changes apply to `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`.

9d59c700eaa58184656fe03f362b7a04c4aee4c0.text: The model picker now adjusts its display to fit smaller screens without hiding options. This makes the tool easier to use on laptops with limited vertical space.

5380b97cc366aad170b24591ca16269002164dbd.text: You can now use '/model:' instead of '/mode:' to switch settings. Both commands do the same thing.

6a1803431b6de7e4b6e4519bedfec9e164604a5b.text: You can now type /model to end your session and pick a new model. This replaces the longer /end-session command.

7d451c872df79982a576bc3a1ac2906762cf1445.text: The system now automatically stops processing when you close a chat window, saving computing resources. Additionally, private message contents are hidden from internal tracking for certain users.

8cca5ab9b098ec1421e51a7c41b5eb13be0d2cda.text: The help guide is now available in Simplified Chinese. This makes setup and usage instructions easier to read for Chinese speakers.

7dc62c8e1a89fb06800c16072f4db5e169f1ddb4.text: The help page now explains that some regions have restricted access, allowing only one specific AI model and five one-hour sessions per day. It also clarifies the differences between full and limited access.

30c51ac38ce89001a9a39a00416a2d56ad446fce.text: The tool now uses a version designed for older computers. This helps the app run smoothly on more types of Windows machines.

982f726c537864c08fa1e238ac7eae796286d453.text: The system now saves only basic details about chat requests instead of full message text. This keeps private conversations out of internal records.

e43653226f8be2c6f80ddbf0c98bcfa96cde9856.text: The homepage now shows a smaller live stats panel that updates less often to save resources.

47d025ad7973d0b474df5b2f2e83d6459469d17c.title: Waiting-room screen: premium reset text uses comma
47d025ad7973d0b474df5b2f2e83d6459469d17c.summary: Premium reset countdown in `WaitingRoomScreen` switched from `  ·  ` separator to `, `. Affects model selection screen reset text. File: `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

7f4d431302996f59c6624a4f9eaf992dc7d413b9.title: LimitedLandingPanel button text color tweak
7f4d431302996f59c6624a4f9eaf992dc7d413b9.summary: Interactable button text in `LimitedLandingPanel` now uses `theme.foreground` instead of `theme.primary`. Visual tweak for better contrast/readability. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/limited-landing-panel.tsx`.

f29db9e9ef09c89801ac25e7eaebe384991403b5.title: Overhaul Freebuff live map
f29db9e9ef09c89801ac25e7eaebe384991403b5.summary: Live map now uses accurate Natural Earth geometry and Equal Earth projection instead of hand-drawn blobs. Country centroids moved to generated `world-map-data.ts` via REST Countries data. `live-client.tsx` applies proper projection math for rendering. Covers Web `/live` surface.

cfc3e1ae4f15d4849696cdb1437075ba154a3d0e.title: Remove padded count from limited landing session counter
cfc3e1ae4f15d4849696cdb1437075ba154a3d0e.summary: The waiting-room screen's session counter now uses `formatSessionUnits` instead of `formattedSharedPremiumUsed` to display the used count. This drops zero-padding from the number. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

4fb13aebd6a2e8db8ea0f3af3c48be8c74fa0c6f.title: Drop invalid Freebuff login auth codes
4fb13aebd6a2e8db8ea0f3af3c48be8c74fa0c6f.summary: Invalid CLI auth codes are now rejected during login, preventing malformed or opaque tokens from being forwarded to the `/onboard` route. A new `cli-auth-code-shape.ts` module centralizes regex validation and parsing logic, replacing inline checks in `_helpers.ts`. The change affects Web UI login flows (`/login`, `sign-in-button`, `login-card`) and NextAuth redirect handling (`auth-options.ts`). `getCliAuthOnboardSearchParams` explicitly strips invalid `auth_code` parameters before redirecting, ensuring only valid codes persist in the URL.

c3027175a0242057dd0de85ffcc835c9ad75a5e7.title: CLI waiting room labels limited access reason
c3027175a0242057dd0de85ffcc835c9ad75a5e7.summary: Waiting room screen now displays specific limited access reasons like 'hosting network detected' or 'outside available countries' instead of generic text. Server responses (session-view, handlers) and common types now propagate countryCode, countryBlockReason, and ipPrivacySignals to the client. Covers CLI, Shared/Core, and Web surfaces.

62c807a76b20fde83dc17bad79d7e787a864c538.title: extractApiErrorDetails unwraps nested AI SDK retry errors
62c807a76b20fde83dc17bad79d7e787a864c538.summary: New `extractApiErrorDetails` in `common/src/util/error.ts` traverses `lastError`, `errors`, and `cause` chains to pull status codes and parsed response bodies from nested AI SDK `RetryError` wrappers. Replaces direct `parseApiErrorResponseBody` calls in `sdk/src/run.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, ensuring accurate error reporting when upstream failures are wrapped. Docs updated in `docs/error-schema.md` to reflect the new `session_superseded` 409 error code.

558d1fe9213d28182cede6c95c42da24b4384bb4.title: Fix model switch landing
558d1fe9213d28182cede6c95c42da24b4384bb4.summary: Fix freebuff model switch landing (#669) by preserving metadata during session transitions. `use-freebuff-session.ts` introduces `toLandingSession` to extract `accessTier`, `queueDepthByModel`, and `rateLimitsByModel` from the current state before resetting status to 'none'. `session-ended-banner.tsx` updates button labels to 'Back to start' for limited tiers and 'Change model' otherwise, using dynamic pending states. Scope: CLI session hooks and UI components. Detail: `apply({ status: 'none' })` replaced with `apply(landingSession)` to prevent metadata loss on rejoin or return-to-landing.

af4e0fe1473a8a441a36d071db2cfda4dd30c3b2.title: Simplify Freebuff limited-mode landing screen
af4e0fe1473a8a441a36d071db2cfda4dd30c3b2.summary: New `LimitedLandingPanel` component replaces the generic model selector for limited-tier users, acting as a confirm gate rather than a picker. The `FreebuffModelSelector` hides the 'LIMITED' header and comparative taglines for this tier, while `WaitingRoomScreen` and `SessionEndedBanner` update session labels to 'sessions' to avoid leaking internal tier names. This change affects CLI components only, specifically `cli/src/components/limited-landing-panel.tsx` and related UI files.

8c189c305a0e72090d8eec4585136627709ce00d.title: Add dev-only env to force Freebuff limited mode
8c189c305a0e72090d8eec4585136627709ce00d.summary: Adds FREEBUFF_DEV_FORCE_LIMITED to force 'limited' access tier on localhost. Updates packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts and web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts to bypass country checks and skip cache reads/writes when active. Scoped to dev environment via NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT check.

c3027175a0242057dd0de85ffcc835c9ad75a5e7.text: When you are blocked from joining a call, the screen now shows the specific reason, like being outside allowed countries or using a restricted network, instead of a vague message.

47d025ad7973d0b474df5b2f2e83d6459469d17c.text: The waiting room screen now uses a comma instead of a dot to separate text in the premium reset countdown. This is a small visual change that makes the message easier to read.

558d1fe9213d28182cede6c95c42da24b4384bb4.text: When you switch models or return to the start, your account limits and wait times stay accurate instead of resetting. This keeps the app from showing wrong information about your usage.

cfc3e1ae4f15d4849696cdb1437075ba154a3d0e.text: The number showing how many sessions you have used no longer has extra zeros in front of it. This is a small visual change that does not affect your actual session count.

7f4d431302996f59c6624a4f9eaf992dc7d413b9.text: The text color on a specific button in the setup screen changed to improve readability. This small visual tweak makes the button easier to see.

f29db9e9ef09c89801ac25e7eaebe384991403b5.text: The live map now uses real geographic data instead of simplified shapes. This means country locations and borders appear more accurate and correctly proportioned when you view the map.

62c807a76b20fde83dc17bad79d7e787a864c538.text: The system now looks deeper inside technical errors to find the real problem. This helps show clearer messages when things go wrong.

8c189c305a0e72090d8eec4585136627709ce00d.text: Developers can now test a restricted version of the service on their own computers. This change does not affect how the product works for regular users.

af4e0fe1473a8a441a36d071db2cfda4dd30c3b2.text: The free version's start screen now asks for confirmation instead of showing a list of options. Internal labels are simplified to avoid confusing terms.

4fb13aebd6a2e8db8ea0f3af3c48be8c74fa0c6f.text: The system now checks login codes for errors before processing them. This prevents broken or confusing links from appearing when you sign in.

cae558b46d0c0c795fbf2c4644b5bbbfff8b2807.title: Local token counting for DeepSeek Flash
cae558b46d0c0c795fbf2c4644b5bbbfff8b2807.summary: Agent runtime skips remote token count API for free DeepSeek Flash agents, using local estimation instead. New helper `shouldUseLocalTokenCountForFreebuffDeepseekFlash` gates this behavior in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Implementation in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` replaces the `callTokenCountAPI` block for this specific model.

71b82cd473a88c3b984e5369f048ed7d9d7647aa.title: Coerce stringified params in spawn agent tools
71b82cd473a88c3b984e5369f048ed7d9d7647aa.summary: Added `coerceToObject` helper in `common/src/tools/params/utils.ts` to parse stringified JSON objects into actual objects for the `params` field. Applied via `z.preprocess` to schemas in `spawn-agent-inline.ts` and `spawn-agents.ts`. This fixes validation errors when models emit `params` as a JSON string instead of an object. Malformed strings remain untouched to ensure schema validation still rejects them.

6383ae8acdef116d44f37f944b28d0f5df4b5397.title: Log invalid Freebuff login auth codes
6383ae8acdef116d44f37f944b28d0f5df4b5397.summary: Added `isCliAuthCodeCandidate` to validate auth codes, triggering `logger.warn` with detailed metadata (lengths, hash prefix, params, headers) on failure in `auth-options.ts` and `login/page.tsx`. Handles array `auth_code` params. Improves debugging for malformed CLI login redirects.

317a5c0532048c69209010f9de87f1f07a740b8e.title: Add User-Agent header to CLI ad requests
317a5c0532048c69209010f9de87f1f07a740b8e.summary: CLI ad fetches in `use-gravity-ad.ts` now send a custom `User-Agent` header derived from `getCliAdRequestUserAgent()`. The web API (`_post.ts`, `impression/_post.ts`) and Carbon provider (`carbon.ts`) propagate this `requestUserAgent` to upstream services, replacing the previous browser-only assumption. This ensures ad networks correctly identify CLI traffic for targeting and billing.

ebe848f548bd41e22004128e7960267c059e4693.title: Add Freebuff premium reset countdown
ebe848f548bd41e22004128e7960267c059e4693.summary: Added `freebuff-premium-reset.ts` utility to calculate and format the countdown to the next Freebuff premium session limit reset. The `WaitingRoomScreen` now imports this utility to display the remaining time until the quota resets, leveraging server-provided reset timestamps or falling back to timezone-based day bounds. `use-freebuff-session.ts` includes a new `refreshFreebuffLandingMetadata` function to update quota and queue depths on the landing screen when the midnight-Pacific reset occurs. Scope limited to CLI components and hooks.

2506de227fbcba2c132e11a237f66f8e99d4e426.title: Limited DeepSeek access tier added to CLI model selector
2506de227fbcba2c132e11a237f66f8e99d4e426.summary: Added 'limited' access tier to Freebuff model selection, introducing DeepSeek as a restricted option. Core constants updated to support tiered model filtering via getFreebuffModelsForAccessTier. CLI components (selector, waiting room, session banner) now render tier-specific quotas and labels, distinguishing 'limited sessions' from 'premium sessions'. Database migration 0052 adds accessTier field to session records.

efbd0b6f44586275607d449a3052d0d12c8ff41a.title: Cache free-mode country access
efbd0b6f44586275607d449a3052d0d12c8ff41a.summary: Added `free_mode_country_access_cache` table to store country access decisions for free-mode users. Caches `allowed` status, `country_code`, and IP privacy signals with expiration tracking. Implemented in `web/src/server/free-mode-country-access-cache.ts` and integrated into chat completions endpoint. Reduces repeated GeoIP/Cloudflare country lookups for authenticated requests.

201c08b9fa1066d53695d27fa0645bd19abd8216.title: Analytics sampling and telemetry env vars
201c08b9fa1066d53695d27fa0645bd19abd8216.summary: Added `shouldTrackAnalyticsEvent` to gate high-volume events at 1% default rate. CLI and SDK now respect sampling flags and env vars `CODEBUFF_FULL_TELEMETRY` / `CODEBUFF_FULL_TELEMETRY_IDS` for debugging. Tool stream parsers replace raw contents with `summarizeToolInput` metadata to reduce payload size. Covers `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts`, `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tool-stream-parser.ts`.

7a95a981493400eb1024210de5ea59ab08e9bad7.title: Add Freebuff auth code debug logging
7a95a981493400eb1024210de5ea59ab08e9bad7.summary: Added detailed debug logging for invalid Freebuff CLI auth codes in `freebuff/web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx`. The logger now captures resolved auth code hash prefixes, opaque tokens, and incoming request headers (host, forwarded host/proto, origin, referer, user-agent) to aid in diagnosing auth failures.

2952274587e48f57472f4a9faad67b18d93b91d8.title: Freebuff throughput improvements via billing and logging changes
2952274587e48f57472f4a9faad67b18d93b91d8.summary: Added `recordMessageWithoutBilling` to `packages/billing` to bypass credit ledger writes for free-mode requests. Implemented 1% success-event sampling in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` to reduce PostHog and log forwarding load from high-volume free traffic. Updated `web/src/llm-api/helpers.ts` to invoke the new billing bypass when `isFreeModeAndAllowed` is true. Removes inline country gating checks from the completions handler, relying on upstream session validation.

ebe848f548bd41e22004128e7960267c059e4693.text: The app now shows a countdown timer until your free premium usage limit resets. When the limit resets at midnight Pacific time, the app automatically updates to show your new available time.

6383ae8acdef116d44f37f944b28d0f5df4b5397.text: The system now records more details when a login attempt fails due to an invalid code. This helps support teams diagnose issues faster, though you won't see any changes to how the login process works.

201c08b9fa1066d53695d27fa0645bd19abd8216.text: The system now records fewer background activity reports by default to save data. You can turn on full reporting if you need to help fix a specific problem.

efbd0b6f44586275607d449a3052d0d12c8ff41a.text: The system now remembers which countries can access free features, so it does not need to check location repeatedly. This makes chats faster for free users.

317a5c0532048c69209010f9de87f1f07a740b8e.text: The command-line tool now identifies itself to ad networks. This helps them show the right ads and track costs correctly.

71b82cd473a88c3b984e5369f048ed7d9d7647aa.text: The assistant now correctly reads setup instructions even if it receives them in a slightly wrong format. This prevents errors when launching new tasks.

2506de227fbcba2c132e11a237f66f8e99d4e426.text: The tool now lets you pick a restricted option for the new assistant model. You can see how many limited sessions you have left before starting a chat.

cae558b46d0c0c795fbf2c4644b5bbbfff8b2807.text: The system now estimates message length locally for a specific free model instead of asking a remote server. This makes responses faster.

7d59406b7e81d940065af1a346e33a05e61584d4.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash labeled collecting data for training
7d59406b7e81d940065af1a346e33a05e61584d4.summary: Added `warning: 'Collects data for training'` to DeepSeek V4 Flash in `FREEBUFF_MODELS`. Web FAQ updated to reflect this data collection for DeepSeek V4 Flash. Scope covers `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and `freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx`.

00ac6486b7f4a73b04f65ef4eec8fd5066890343.title: Reorder DeepSeek V4 Flash above MiniMax M2.7 in free model picker
00ac6486b7f4a73b04f65ef4eec8fd5066890343.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash moved before MiniMax M2.7 in FREEBUFF_MODELS array and web home-client FAQ text. Mechanism: direct array element swap in constants and string literal reorder in UI component. Scope: Shared/Core constants, Web UI. Detail: Both surfaces enforce identical ordering logic manually via static data.

b94212ab04f5dfc15f13df05c592f633cbe9fab2.title: ChoiceAdBanner layout clamp
b94212ab04f5dfc15f13df05c592f633cbe9fab2.summary: Added height: 1 and overflow: 'hidden' to the CTA/domain row in choice-ad-banner.tsx. Set wrapMode: 'none' on the domain text. Prevents banner height expansion from long domain labels. Affects CLI ad banner rendering.

cb88ae8074cd9a134d1a6cc2543498652b157004.title: Simplify CLI model selector array handling
cb88ae8074cd9a134d1a6cc2543498652b157004.summary: Removed redundant intermediate arrays in `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`. Directly uses `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and derives IDs via map, eliminating default-model sorting logic. Internal refactor with no behavior change.

bf767d70cac9d83e2918bcde03b419260fb4626f.title: ZeroClick ad display text fixes
bf767d70cac9d83e2918bcde03b419260fb4626f.summary: ZeroClick ad normalization now prioritizes brand name for title and uses content or subtitle for ad text. Fixes incorrect display text caused by previous fallback logic. Affects web/src/lib/ad-providers/zeroclick.ts.

9f96ac1233d28d7111876e14ef5f9682669c2843.title: tmux-cli added to free mode agent models
9f96ac1233d28d7111876e14ef5f9682669c2843.summary: Added tmux-cli to FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. Configures the agent to use FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_MODEL_ID for command execution in free mode. Affects shared core constants and free agent definitions. Includes corresponding test coverage in common/src/__tests__/free-agents.test.ts.

6b27aeb79704c214f07456c7198eb0c01f684d65.title: CLI code-searcher collapsed preview
6b27aeb79704c214f07456c7198eb0c01f684d65.summary: Extracted code-search result counting and collapsed preview generation into `cli/src/utils/code-search-summary.ts`. `code-search.tsx` now delegates result counting to `countCodeSearchResults`, while `agent-branch-wrapper.tsx` uses `getCodeSearcherCollapsedPreview` to render agent-level search summaries. The new utility aggregates `searchQueries` and completed `code_search` tool outputs into a single `N searches · M results` string. Formatting and import paths in `agent-branch-wrapper.tsx` were updated to support the new helper.

fbdf2f3ecac0bf85fe13a36b6087e65769ab3354.title: Update basher collapsed output preview
fbdf2f3ecac0bf85fe13a36b6087e65769ab3354.summary: Adds `getBasherFinishedOutputPreview` to truncate basher agent output to a single line for collapsed views. `getCollapsedPreview` now uses this helper when the agent is not streaming, falling back to text or command output. This change improves readability in the CLI agent branch wrapper by respecting available width.

64b0a93ed00b4dfd435cc8f80083b8d9f201a73b.title: Limit tree-sitter project indexing memory
64b0a93ed00b4dfd435cc8f80083b8d9f201a73b.summary: Added hard limits to tree-sitter parsing in `packages/code-map/src/parse.ts` to prevent OOM crashes during large project indexing. Introduced `CODEBUFF_MAX_PARSE_FILES` (10k), `CODEBUFF_MAX_PARSE_FILE_BYTES` (1MB), and `CODEBUFF_MAX_TOTAL_PARSE_BYTES` (500MB) environment variables with safe defaults. Refactored `sdk/src/run-state.ts` to pass a `SourceReader` callback and enforce a 1MB cap on discovered project file reads via `createDiscoveredProjectReader`. Parsing now breaks early if total byte or file count thresholds are exceeded.

ec28ae51ea968f910d1f03f1437dfff41fb7d6a4.title: Add Live Freebuff Usage Dashboard
ec28ae51ea968f910d1f03f1437dfff41fb7d6a4.summary: New `/live` page displays real-time aggregate Freebuff usage by country and model. Server logic in `freebuff/web/src/server/live-stats.ts` queries active `freeSession` records via Drizzle, filtering expired and banned users. Client component `freebuff/web/src/app/live/live-client.tsx` renders a stylized world map with country markers and model distribution, polling `/api/live` every 15s. Footer component hides itself on `/live` route.

fbdf2f3ecac0bf85fe13a36b6087e65769ab3354.text: The assistant now shows a short, one-line summary of completed tasks instead of a long block of text. This keeps the screen tidy and easy to read.

00ac6486b7f4a73b04f65ef4eec8fd5066890343.text: The free AI model list now shows DeepSeek V4 Flash before MiniMax M2.7. You will see this new order when choosing a model.

cb88ae8074cd9a134d1a6cc2543498652b157004.text: The program cleaned up how it finds the list of models. This change is inside the tool and does not affect how it works for you.

9f96ac1233d28d7111876e14ef5f9682669c2843.text: The free version of the assistant can now use a new tool to run commands. This small internal update helps it do its job better.

ec28ae51ea968f910d1f03f1437dfff41fb7d6a4.text: A new public dashboard now shows real-time usage of the service, broken down by country and AI model.

b94212ab04f5dfc15f13df05c592f633cbe9fab2.text: A small visual fix stops long web addresses from making the ad box grow too tall. The banner now keeps a steady size and hides extra text that doesn't fit.

64b0a93ed00b4dfd435cc8f80083b8d9f201a73b.text: The system now sets strict limits on how much data it reads at once. This prevents the application from crashing or freezing when processing very large projects.

7d59406b7e81d940065af1a346e33a05e61584d4.text: A new warning label now appears next to a specific free AI model, indicating that it collects user data for training purposes. This means users should avoid entering sensitive personal information when selecting this particular model.

6b27aeb79704c214f07456c7198eb0c01f684d65.text: The tool now shows a simple summary of search results, like 'N searches · M results', instead of detailed lists. This makes the output cleaner and easier to read at a glance.

bf767d70cac9d83e2918bcde03b419260fb4626f.text: Ad titles and descriptions now show the correct brand name and text. Previously, some ads displayed wrong information due to a display error.

e798ad9c6c200fd8a54eaf99e65015dc64af4ee8.title: OpenCode Zen model registry and guard tightened
e798ad9c6c200fd8a54eaf99e65015dc64af4ee8.summary: Removed opencode/minimax-m2.7 from openCodeZenModels and OPENCODE_ZEN_MODELS. isOpenCodeZenModel switched from prefix check to in-operator lookup against the registry. getOpenCodeZenModelId fallback now returns model unchanged. Covers common/src/constants/model-config.ts and web/src/llm-api/opencode-zen.ts.

5c6068411b13dda14ab547b54853ea8f9839b5cc.title: Show basher summary prompt in TUI
5c6068411b13dda14ab547b54853ea8f9839b5cc.summary: TUI agent branch previews now display the `what_to_summarize` parameter for `basher` agents when `initialPrompt` is empty. New `getAgentDisplayPrompt` utility in `cli/src/utils/agent-display.ts` handles this fallback logic. `sdk-event-handlers.ts` updated to pass `params` to agent blocks, enabling the UI to access summary details.

3f698f5a0cd76738416987f6faaad900a70cbef5.title: ZeroClick ad fallback added to CLI and API
3f698f5a0cd76738416987f6faaad900a70cbef5.summary: ZeroClick provider added as fallback for Gravity ads in CLI components and API routes. AdResponse type extended with provider and impressionIds fields; recordImpression signature changed from impUrl string to AdResponse object. ZeroClick impressions handled client-side via direct API call, bypassing server-side pixel firing; ZeroClick ads excluded from rotation cache.

d885b4bc8b1f30d435472baa2f9126dd647f0cdb.title: Allow more European countries in free mode
d885b4bc8b1f30d435472baa2f9126dd647f0cdb.summary: Added France (FR), Italy (IT), Spain (ES), and Portugal (PT) to FREE_MODE_ALLOWED_COUNTRIES in web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts. Updated the FAQ text in freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx to reflect the new availability. This change expands the geographic scope for the free mode feature. The update is purely additive to the existing allowlist and documentation.

f01f29111f35346d3db3a579c82ffc1e4d8af610.title: Add DeepSeek V4 Flash to free model picker
f01f29111f35346d3db3a579c82ffc1e4d8af610.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash added to FREEBUFF_MODELS and agent registry. New base2-free-deepseek-flash and code-reviewer-deepseek-flash agents created. Removed noAskUser flag from existing DeepSeek V4 Pro agent. Covers common constants, agent definitions, and docs.

ef6b4ef531ea4711a7407fe672c5f4f5db1e3857.title: Hide code searcher result payload
ef6b4ef531ea4711a7407fe672c5f4f5db1e3857.summary: Code searcher agent now sets `message: ''` in `set_output` to prevent raw structured payload leakage in CLI. `CodeSearchComponent` parses `Found N matches` header for total results, falling back to line counting with `Line \d+:` regex support. Covers `agents/file-explorer/code-searcher.ts` and `cli/src/components/tools/code-search.tsx`. `docs/testing.md` adds tmux workflow examples for verifying UI captures.

37b905688e44841274d2f3af26ae418b8e4b8b9d.title: Add opencode/minimax-m2.7 to OpenCode Zen routing
37b905688e44841274d2f3af26ae418b8e4b8b9d.summary: Added opencode/minimax-m2.7 to openCodeZenModels in common/src/constants/model-config.ts and configured its pricing in web/src/llm-api/opencode-zen.ts. Refactored routing logic to use OPENCODE_ZEN_MODEL_ALIASES and OPENCODE_ZEN_PRICING, replacing the previous hardcoded map. isOpenCodeZenModel now accepts unknown types, checks for the opencode/ prefix or alias presence, and getOpenCodeZenModelId throws a 400 error for unsupported models. Pricing for minimax-m2.7 is set to 0.3/1.2 per million input/output tokens.

f1b6d70380846b0af254ec8d85c8241ff545cae4.title: Track reused CLI auth tokens
f1b6d70380846b0af254ec8d85c8241ff545cae4.summary: CLI login token consumption now updates `verificationToken` to a consumed state instead of deleting it. This allows the system to distinguish between missing and already-used tokens, surfacing specific errors to the user. The change affects `freebuff/web` and `web` packages, specifically `_db.ts`, `_helpers.ts`, and `page.tsx`. Consumed tokens are marked with `cli-login-consumed:<token-hash>` and scrubbed of sensitive data.

7e3fc2306e2b347b4384a11dac1c9fd9ee173f61.title: Add Moonshot Kimi backend provider
7e3fc2306e2b347b4384a11dac1c9fd9ee173f61.summary: New `web/src/llm-api/moonshot.ts` provider routes `moonshotai/kimi-k2.6` to `api.moonshot.ai/v1` with stream/non-stream handlers, pricing map, and `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` env var. Chat completions router inserts `useMoonshot` check before OpenCodeZen, CanopyWave, DeepSeek, Fireworks, and OpenAI. `opencode-zen.ts` removes hardcoded `MOONSHOT_KIMI_MODEL` constant, keeping alias in map. `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts` adds optional `MOONSHOT_API_KEY`; CI defaults to 'test' in `env.ts`.

d885b4bc8b1f30d435472baa2f9126dd647f0cdb.text: The free version of the product is now available in France, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. Users in these countries can access the feature without paying.

3f698f5a0cd76738416987f6faaad900a70cbef5.text: The app can now use a second backup service if the main ad system is unavailable. This change is internal and does not alter how you use the product.

37b905688e44841274d2f3af26ae418b8e4b8b9d.text: The assistant can now use a new model. It costs a small amount per message.

2f7f2db929542d200cc6a617dcc3cabd83aaf557.text: The product now has a secure way to connect to other apps. This feature is currently turned off, so you will not see any changes yet.

7e3fc2306e2b347b4384a11dac1c9fd9ee173f61.text: The assistant can now use a new AI model from Moonshot. This is an internal change that adds support for this option, but it does not change how you interact with the product today.

f1b6d70380846b0af254ec8d85c8241ff545cae4.text: The system now remembers when a sign-in link has already been used instead of discarding it. This lets you see a clearer message if you try to sign in with an expired link, helping you know if the link was never sent or if you already used it.

f01f29111f35346d3db3a579c82ffc1e4d8af610.text: A new AI model option is now available for free. The existing model can also ask clarifying questions during tasks.

e798ad9c6c200fd8a54eaf99e65015dc64af4ee8.text: The assistant stopped using a specific model. The system now checks a strict list of allowed models before using one, making it more reliable.

5c6068411b13dda14ab547b54853ea8f9839b5cc.text: The assistant now shows a summary preview when starting a new task without a prompt.

ef6b4ef531ea4711a7407fe672c5f4f5db1e3857.text: Search results now hide raw technical data, showing only a clean summary. This prevents confusing clutter on your screen.

16137ba62ca6a9b7edb2b431898962c2ef05b8ea.title: Legacy CLI auth code parsing
16137ba62ca6a9b7edb2b431898962c2ef05b8ea.summary: Added regex fallback in `parseAuthCode` to handle legacy hyphen-delimited auth codes when dot separators are missing. This prevents auth failures for older CLI clients by extracting `fingerprintId`, `expiresAt`, and `receivedHash` from the legacy format. Changes apply to `web/src/app/onboard/_helpers.ts` and `freebuff/web/src/app/onboard/_helpers.ts`. Logging in `onboard/page.tsx` now includes `dotCount` and `hyphenCount` to aid debugging of malformed codes.

3f192e006104fa3e18ee98879506805d4f0f2ea0.title: Type guard in isOpenCodeZenModel
3f192e006104fa3e18ee98879506805d4f0f2ea0.summary: isOpenCodeZenModel signature changed to `model: unknown` with return type `model is string`. Added `typeof model === 'string'` check before prefix validation. Fixes type errors in completions.test.ts and opencode-zen.ts. Internal refactor, no user-visible behavior change.

4987adaefa045c3255aa3ebe3be301b062c639d8.title: CLI auth codes use opaque tokens
4987adaefa045c3255aa3ebe3be301b062c639d8.summary: CLI login flow now issues random 32-byte base64url tokens instead of exposing raw fingerprint auth codes. Tokens stored in verificationToken table with cli-login: prefix and expiry. Onboard page resolves token to auth code via getCliAuthCodeForToken, falling back to raw code for backward compatibility. Covers freebuff/web and web packages.

cfd4a2c37bc0cd4a2740188a3182a5aa890deca3.title: Fix completions test dev localhost bypass
cfd4a2c37bc0cd4a2740188a3182a5aa890deca3.summary: Updated `completions.test.ts` to inject `cf-connecting-ip: 192.0.2.1` in the unknown-location test. This bypasses the dev-only localhost check that triggers when `cf-ipcountry` and client IP are absent. Assertion updated to expect `unresolved_client_ip` instead of `missing_client_ip`. Scope limited to `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts`.

206d2310b08f40f9d840c8a4b7dbf682b597bca2.title: Add CLI auth token correlation fields to logs
206d2310b08f40f9d840c8a4b7dbf682b597bca2.summary: Added getCliAuthCodeHashPrefix to compute SHA-256 hash prefixes for opaque CLI auth tokens. Updated auth code issuance and resolution logs to include token hash prefixes, lengths, and request origin details for better traceability. Changes apply to web/src/app/api/auth/cli/code/route.ts, web/src/app/onboard/_helpers.ts, and web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx. Uses node:crypto createHash for 12-char hex digest prefix.

9e34f2500899c235232c0aab3b39452f9963b387.title: Opaque CLI auth tokens replace raw auth codes in login URLs
9e34f2500899c235232c0aab3b39452f9963b387.summary: CLI login URLs now use opaque 43-character tokens instead of exposing raw signed auth payloads. The web API generates these tokens via `randomBytes` and stores them in `verificationToken` under `cli-login:<token>`, while the onboard page resolves them using `DELETE ... RETURNING` to ensure single-use consumption. This change applies to both `freebuff/web` and `web` packages, specifically updating `route.ts`, `_db.ts`, `_helpers.ts`, and `page.tsx`, alongside `docs/authentication.md`. Opaque tokens are strictly validated against `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/` before database lookup.

66648012945c0d1c4002c9b8a370cee1d0735547.title: Enable codex goals and collaboration modes
66648012945c0d1c4002c9b8a370cee1d0735547.summary: Added .codex/config.toml enabling goals and collaboration_modes features. Applies to codex subsystem configuration. Sets feature flags to true.

d8395764bbe0f063c5f616efa7ca997c238aff8e.title: Enable OpenCode Zen for opencode/ prefixed models
d8395764bbe0f063c5f616efa7ca997c238aff8e.summary: OpenCode Zen routing now activates for any model string starting with `opencode/` instead of a hardcoded allowlist. The `isOpenCodeZenModel` check uses `startsWith`, and `getOpenCodeZenModelId` strips the prefix for unknown models. The disabled-model validation gate in `_post.ts` is removed, allowing these requests to proceed to stream/non-stream handlers.

e58596f99351e5b8fc4639b2fb115c076019a668.title: Add disabled OpenCode Zen provider scaffold
e58596f99351e5b8fc4639b2fb115c076019a668.summary: OpenCode Zen provider scaffold added but disabled. Models opencode/minimax-m2.7 and opencode/kimi-k2.6 defined in common/src/constants/model-config.ts. Chat completions API returns 400 error 'opencode_zen_disabled' for these models in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts. OPENCODE_API_KEY added to env schema and .env.example.

48caa4cc399c3d7f3522f8d65492c7c007bea9fc.title: SDK path-utils tolerates absolute file tool paths
48caa4cc399c3d7f3522f8d65492c7c007bea9fc.summary: Added sdk/src/tools/path-utils.ts exporting resolveFilePathWithinProject and getProjectPathLookupKeys. File tools (change-file, read-files, run.ts) now use these helpers instead of inline path.normalize/isAbsolute checks, allowing absolute paths that resolve within the project root while still blocking traversal outside it. Covers SDK core and tools; no CLI/Web surface changes.

16137ba62ca6a9b7edb2b431898962c2ef05b8ea.text: The system now reads older sign-in codes that use dashes instead of dots, preventing login errors for users of previous versions.

3f192e006104fa3e18ee98879506805d4f0f2ea0.text: A small internal update improves how the system checks data types. This change has no visible effect on the product.

d8395764bbe0f063c5f616efa7ca997c238aff8e.text: The assistant can now use a wider range of models. Previously, only a specific list was allowed; now, any model with the correct label works automatically.

cfd4a2c37bc0cd4a2740188a3182a5aa890deca3.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system checks location for one test. No changes to the product you use.

9e34f2500899c235232c0aab3b39452f9963b387.text: Login links now use safer, shorter codes to protect your account information.

48caa4cc399c3d7f3522f8d65492c7c007bea9fc.text: The assistant can now use full file paths as long as they stay inside your project folder. This makes it easier to point to specific files without risking access to files outside your project.

e58596f99351e5b8fc4639b2fb115c076019a668.text: The app added support for two new AI models but kept them turned off. If you try to use them, the app will show an error message.

4987adaefa045c3255aa3ebe3be301b062c639d8.text: When signing in through the command line, the system now uses a temporary, random code instead of your permanent account key. This makes it harder for anyone to steal your login details if they see the code on your screen.

206d2310b08f40f9d840c8a4b7dbf682b597bca2.text: The system now records safer, shortened versions of login keys in its internal notes. This helps staff track sign-in issues without exposing real passwords.

66648012945c0d1c4002c9b8a370cee1d0735547.text: The assistant now supports new ways to track goals and collaborate. This internal change enables these features for you to use.

df40341c78a885040817d1503f7569c250586f0a.title: base2 free orchestrators derive reviewer agent id from model
df40341c78a885040817d1503f7569c250586f0a.summary: base2.ts now resolves freeCodeReviewerAgentId via FREEBUFF_REVIEWER_AGENT_ID_BY_MODEL[model] lookup instead of accepting explicit freeCodeReviewerAgentId parameter. The freeCodeReviewerAgentId option removed from createBase2 signature. base2-free-deepseek.ts, base2-free-kimi.ts, base2-free.ts drop hardcoded reviewer agent id values (code-reviewer-deepseek, code-reviewer-kimi, code-reviewer-minimax) that previously shadowed the default code-reviewer-lite. Fallback to code-reviewer-lite preserved for unmapped models.

9d7e9e4f609d8c4af78b9b11c8943055f969aa86.title: Restore CLI diff viewer rendering
9d7e9e4f609d8c4af78b9b11c8943055f969aa86.summary: Removed `RENDER_DIFFS` flag and associated null-return check in `cli/src/components/tools/diff-viewer.tsx`. Diff viewer now unconditionally renders `diffText` lines with theme colors. Scope limited to CLI component logic.

bdd8b09121cea865b3bbb7a8cf71f8b3d54a690e.title: Waiting room displays used premium sessions
bdd8b09121cea865b3bbb7a8cf71f8b3d54a690e.summary: Waiting room screen switched from displaying remaining premium sessions to showing used count out of total limit. Replaced `premiumLeft` calculation with `isPremiumExhausted` check and `formattedSharedPremiumUsed` string. Text now reads 'X of Y premium sessions used today' with dynamic padding to prevent layout shifts during loading. Internal UI change affecting `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

3afccad624c4f906a74a68fb427af3b43947ec8e.title: Add OpenCode runner to BuffBench
3afccad624c4f906a74a68fb427af3b43947ec8e.summary: OpenCode CLI added as external agent for BuffBench evaluations. New `OpenCodeRunner` spawns `opencode run` with JSON output, defaulting to `opencode/kimi-k2.6` unless `OPENCODE_MODEL` overrides it. Supported via `external:opencode` agent ID in `run-buffbench.ts` and `agent-runner.ts`, with README install instructions requiring `OPENCODE_API_KEY`.

a97f891c79334434dad209d7d957a3dfc5abe21c.title: CLI chat history deletion
a97f891c79334434dad209d7d957a3dfc5abe21c.summary: Chat history screen adds delete action via `deleteChatSession` in `chat-history.ts`. `selectable-list.tsx` supports `actionLabel`/`onAction` props, replacing `Button` with `box` layout for row actions. Deletion validates `chatId` against path traversal, removes directory from `chats/`, and updates UI state immediately. Covers CLI only.

47ae3eb4c94fd1a79d6ec26c490b0f56b799f787.title: Add FREEBUFFKIMIMODELID to FREEMODEAGENTMODELS
47ae3eb4c94fd1a79d6ec26c490b0f56b799f787.summary: Added FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID to FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. Enables Kimi model availability for free mode agents. Covers core constants.

5b1551b55d29b3585fe0dacd20a39624d89a42fc.title: Show premium-session quota in CLI session-ended banner
5b1551b55d29b3585fe0dacd20a39624d89a42fc.summary: CLI session-ended banner now displays "N of M premium sessions used today" alongside the status. `getRateLimitsByModel` helper added to `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` to extract quota snapshots from queued, active, and ended states. `markFreebuffSessionEnded` preserves prior `rateLimitsByModel` data to populate the banner without extra fetches. Server-side `attachRateLimit` extended to include quota data in `ended` responses.

5cd16cb80591c5258cdcc77501077ddd38de07b4.title: CLI /history: Fix up delete buttons
5cd16cb80591c5258cdcc77501077ddd38de07b4.summary: The CLI `/history` delete button now renders as `[×]` instead of `Delete`, with layout width adjusted to 6 chars. `padRight` switched to `Array.from` for code-point counting, preventing emoji/wide-character padding breakage. Reserved width calculation now accounts for border, scrollbar, and button padding explicitly. SelectableList row styling removed `width: 100%` in favor of flex properties and added `marginRight` to the action button.

7a95a981493400eb1024210de5ea59ab08e9bad7.text: The system now records more detailed background notes when a login attempt fails, helping support teams diagnose issues faster. This change does not alter how you use the product or require any action from you.

a97f891c79334434dad209d7d957a3dfc5abe21c.text: You can now delete individual chat sessions directly from the history list in the command-line interface. This change is small and only applies to the text-based tool, not the main app.

9d7e9e4f609d8c4af78b9b11c8943055f969aa86.text: The tool now always shows a clear list of changes when comparing text. Previously, it sometimes hid this view. You will consistently see the differences highlighted.

5cd16cb80591c5258cdcc77501077ddd38de07b4.text: The delete button in the history view changed to a small '×' icon. This makes the list layout look cleaner and prevents text from shifting oddly when using special characters.

df40341c78a885040817d1503f7569c250586f0a.text: The system now automatically picks the right code reviewer based on the AI model you use. You no longer need to set this manually. If a model doesn't have a specific reviewer, it uses the standard one.

2952274587e48f57472f4a9faad67b18d93b91d8.text: Free users experience faster service because the system skips detailed accounting and reduces logging for basic requests. This internal improvement handles high traffic more efficiently.

3afccad624c4f906a74a68fb427af3b43947ec8e.text: The testing tool can now use a new assistant model. This lets the system compare how well different assistants perform on tasks.

47ae3eb4c94fd1a79d6ec26c490b0f56b799f787.text: The free version of the assistant can now use the Kimi model. This adds one more option for answering questions.

5b1551b55d29b3585fe0dacd20a39624d89a42fc.text: When a session ends, the app now shows how many premium sessions you have used today out of your total limit. This helps you track your usage without needing to check elsewhere.

bdd8b09121cea865b3bbb7a8cf71f8b3d54a690e.text: The waiting screen now shows how many premium sessions you have used today instead of how many remain. This small change helps you track your daily usage more clearly.

264e94a343652ebc6ab665d9f3e7810b107471cd.title: Revert deterministic tool call ids
264e94a343652ebc6ab665d9f3e7810b107471cd.summary: Reverts deterministic tool call id generation in `packages/agent-runtime`. `createToolCallIdGenerator` removed from `run-programmatic-step.ts`, `tools/stream-parser.ts`, and `tools/tool-executor.ts`. Callers now use `crypto.randomUUID()` or `generateCompactId()` directly. `util/tool-call-id.ts` deleted.

a88ccccad6a67338711b2eab5e57eb0b3f056514.title: Allow legacy code-reviewer-lite models
a88ccccad6a67338711b2eab5e57eb0b3f056514.summary: Added code-reviewer-lite to FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. Legacy freebuff clients spawned this agent under provider-specific free roots before dedicated reviewer IDs existed. Maps to FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_MODEL_ID, FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID, and FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL_ID. Ensures backward compatibility for older agent invocations.

17f45a497be0e5bc95468c913c2fe0b92db4a9bb.title: Restore subagent alias card matching
17f45a497be0e5bc95468c913c2fe0b92db4a9bb.summary: CLI restores subagent alias card matching by normalizing agent names with underscores to hyphens in `getAgentBaseName`. The `realAgentType` is now passed through `moveSpawnAgentBlock` and `resolveSpawnAgentToReal` to ensure agent cards display the correct type. This fixes matching issues in `cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts` and `cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts`.

b51ad4b60ed674402cdfe528488e453f9929147e.title: Add deepseek to base2-free free mode agent models
b51ad4b60ed674402cdfe528488e453f9929147e.summary: Added FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL_ID to the base2-free set in FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS. Root orchestrator now routes deepseek alongside minimax and glm. Change scoped to common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. Separate base2-free-kimi and base2-free-deepseek agent sets remain unchanged.

247b4c84619b747079e9b166a2438087fa9ccf40.title: Disable CLI diff rendering
247b4c84619b747079e9b166a2438087fa9ccf40.summary: DiffViewer returns null when RENDER_DIFFS is false, disabling CLI diff rendering. Implemented via hardcoded boolean flag in cli/src/components/tools/diff-viewer.tsx. Affects CLI tool output surfaces.

9342438a64ebd4276fc73ae80f54727c56b080db.title: Update Web FAQ model list and data training policy
9342438a64ebd4276fc73ae80f54727c56b080db.summary: Refactored the model list in the Web FAQ to a bulleted format and removed specific session limit details. Updated the data training policy to clarify that third-party training occurs only if users select models explicitly labeled 'Collects data for training'. Changes apply to freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx.

a08c0c90242c4b8ee9b33db2cbd0865a6c1a672b.title: CLI login URL origin derives from NEXTPUBLICCODEBUFFAPPURL
a08c0c90242c4b8ee9b33db2cbd0865a6c1a672b.summary: CLI login URL origin now derives from `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL`, falling back to request origin or hardcoded production domain. Replaces raw request-origin derivation to prevent apex/www host bouncing during OAuth. Covers `freebuff/web/src/app/api/auth/cli/code/route.ts` and `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/code/route.ts` via new `_origin.ts` helper. `allowLocalhost` flag enabled when `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` is not `prod`.

c3b019f1668af33082e689fb99254e9a3ce74d8f.title: Revert duplicate reviewer agent card fix
c3b019f1668af33082e689fb99254e9a3ce74d8f.summary: Reverted changes to `getAgentBaseName` and `moveSpawnAgentBlock` that caused duplicate reviewer agent cards. Removed underscore-to-hyphen normalization in `cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts` and stripped `realAgentType` propagation from `cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts`, `cli/src/utils/spawn-agent-matcher.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`. Restores original agent ID resolution and block movement logic.

fdf8d94e5570efa1d48732b81b57608032d9df4e.title: Next 15.5.16, MiniMax M2.7, env fix
fdf8d94e5570efa1d48732b81b57608032d9df4e.summary: Upgraded Next.js to 15.5.16 in web/package.json and freebuff/web/package.json. Added caniuse-lite to root package.json. Refactored ensureEnvDefault in packages/internal/src/env.ts to apply outside CI checks. Updated home-client.tsx to include MiniMax M2.7 in model FAQ.

1a1f7ed3086c3ee50485d777eb0910e9f64fa8ed.title: Dynamic agent selection by model
1a1f7ed3086c3ee50485d777eb0910e9f64fa8ed.summary: CLI now resolves freebuff agents dynamically based on selected model via new `freebuff-agent-selection.ts` utility. Replaced static `AGENT_MODE_TO_ID` lookup with `getAgentIdForMode()` helper that maps LITE mode to model-specific root agents (e.g., `base2-free-kimi`, `base2-free-deepseek`). Added dedicated reviewer agents (`code-reviewer-kimi`, `code-reviewer-deepseek`, `code-reviewer-minimax`) and updated base2 factory to accept `freeCodeReviewerAgentId`. Core logic moved from `local-agent-registry` to shared constants, enabling per-model Gemini thinker gating via `canFreebuffModelSpawnGeminiThinker`.

b51ad4b60ed674402cdfe528488e453f9929147e.text: The assistant can now use a new, free AI model alongside others. This gives the system more options to choose from when helping you.

c3b019f1668af33082e689fb99254e9a3ce74d8f.text: A fix that caused duplicate agent cards was reverted. The software now identifies these agents correctly, preventing the duplicate display issue.

17f45a497be0e5bc95468c913c2fe0b92db4a9bb.text: The assistant now correctly identifies and displays specific helper tools, even when their names use different formatting. This ensures you see the right information when these tools are active.

264e94a343652ebc6ab665d9f3e7810b107471cd.text: The assistant stopped using a fixed method to label its internal tasks and switched to a random one. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

a88ccccad6a67338711b2eab5e57eb0b3f056514.text: Older free accounts can now use their previous assistant models. This keeps the service working for users who haven't updated their settings.

a08c0c90242c4b8ee9b33db2cbd0865a6c1a672b.text: The login link now always points to the correct website address, preventing errors when you click to sign in.

247b4c84619b747079e9b166a2438087fa9ccf40.text: The tool no longer shows side-by-side comparisons of changes in the command line.

1a1f7ed3086c3ee50485d777eb0910e9f64fa8ed.text: The assistant now automatically picks the best helper for the specific model you choose. This makes sure you get the right tools for each task without having to set anything up.

9342438a64ebd4276fc73ae80f54727c56b080db.text: The help guide now lists models clearly and removes confusing usage limits. Data is only shared for training if you pick a model explicitly marked for it.

fdf8d94e5570efa1d48732b81b57608032d9df4e.text: The website now uses a newer version of its underlying software for better performance and security. The assistant can use a new model, and a technical fix ensures the site works correctly in all environments.

dc68d3253980fb05661f464748e33fd3d7b541e7.title: CLI auto-takeover for dead Freebuff sessions
dc68d3253980fb05661f464748e33fd3d7b541e7.summary: CLI now auto-takeover stale Freebuff sessions if the previous owner process is dead. New `freebuff-instance-owner.ts` tracks local PID in config dir to detect zombie seats. `use-freebuff-session.ts` checks this state before prompting, switching to silent POST if stale. Exit handler updated to call `exitFreebuffCleanly` for Freebuff instances.

992f3382112e6b710f5d76ee5226430f901aa7de.title: Move premium session counter to waiting room title
992f3382112e6b710f5d76ee5226430f901aa7de.summary: Removed section header counter and related logic from `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, moving the premium session quota display to the page title in `waiting-room-screen.tsx`. The selector now purely lists models grouped by tier, while the waiting room screen imports `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT` and calculates remaining sessions to display in the header text. This consolidates quota visibility outside the interactive selection list.

1409cf91caa26aca496d30db773169642430a35c.title: CLI model selector grouped by tier
1409cf91caa26aca496d30db773169642430a35c.summary: Premium and Unlimited models now render in grouped sections within the CLI model selector, replacing per-row tier chips. The shared 0/5 quota counter moved to the PREMIUM section header. Layout adjustments include column-aligned names and explicit flexbox containers in the waiting room screen for landing and queued states. Empty sections are filtered out to prevent orphan headers.

116e456fa93f2d88a754347f5279f0633c3dd877.title: Fix Freebuff CLI auth code handling
116e456fa93f2d88a754347f5279f0633c3dd877.summary: Auth code parsing switched from naive split to lastIndexOf extraction to handle identifiers containing dots. Login URL generation now derives origin from request URL instead of env var, preventing apex/www host bouncing. Changes applied to both freebuff/web and web packages. Added warning logs for invalid auth code attempts.

3dd5916285c3912ebb279fddca5875a5de34dcac.title: Fix auth code expiry parsing
3dd5916285c3912ebb279fddca5875a5de34dcac.summary: Web login page now uses `parseAuthCode` and `isAuthCodeExpired` from `@/app/onboard/_helpers` instead of manual string splitting and `parseInt`. This prevents crashes or incorrect expiry checks when auth code formats vary or contain unexpected values. Scope covers both `freebuff/web/src/app/login/page.tsx` and `web/src/app/login/page.tsx`.

d8e01e3216f2c9976b43ad30fad7f90308f32d70.title: Clarify string tool input errors
d8e01e3216f2c9976b43ad30fad7f90308f32d70.summary: Tool executor error messages updated in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`. Logic distinguishes between JSON parsing failure and successful parsing yielding a string. Scope limited to Agent Runtime tool execution surface.

8ac94a54affac0eea3470c33444b18393683fa02.title: Signup free credits replace monthly grants
8ac94a54affac0eea3470c33444b18393683fa02.summary: New accounts receive a one-time SIGNUP_FREE_CREDITS_GRANT of 500 credits on signup, replacing the previous monthly DEFAULT_FREE_CREDITS_GRANT which is now set to 0. Existing users with prior expiring free grants are grandfathered into monthly cycles via getGrandfatheredFreeGrantAmount logic in packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts. Web auth-options.ts triggers grantSignupCredits; UI labels in web and cli shift from 'Monthly Free' to 'Free' or 'Cycle'.

d313c4a1ea19bd8f6fe9f8b2e7ba25d0522cd3c8.title: Fix edit tool diff rendering
d313c4a1ea19bd8f6fe9f8b2e7ba25d0522cd3c8.summary: Added `shouldShowEditDiff` helper to gate diff preview rendering in `str-replace.tsx`. Prevents create operations from flashing input-derived full-file diffs by waiting for tool result output. Scope limited to CLI components and implementor helpers.

c11a47350991d7298be950a93d1c2071dbb6ce2b.title: Fix duplicate reviewer agent card
c11a47350991d7298be950a93d1c2071dbb6ce2b.summary: Fix duplicate reviewer agent cards by propagating `realAgentType` through `resolveSpawnAgentToReal` and `moveSpawnAgentBlock` in the CLI, and normalizing agent IDs via `normalizeAgentIdForLookup` in the Agent Runtime `tool-executor.ts`. This ensures spawned agents correctly map to their real types and IDs during event handling and execution, preventing UI duplication. Scope includes `cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts`, `sdk-event-handlers.ts`, `spawn-agent-matcher.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`. `getAgentBaseName` now replaces underscores with hyphens to match normalized IDs.

3df6ec9369acfcb1e7cb02288aa307c0940bbbdf.title: Add Freebuff session restart option
3df6ec9369acfcb1e7cb02288aa307c0940bbbdf.summary: Added a session restart option to the CLI session-ended banner, allowing users to start a new same-chat session or pick a new model. The `use-freebuff-session` hook was updated to re-POST with the fallback model on unavailability to prevent stuck pending states. Changes are scoped to the CLI components and hooks, specifically `session-ended-banner.tsx`, `use-freebuff-session.ts`, and `use-send-message.ts`.

3dd5916285c3912ebb279fddca5875a5de34dcac.text: The login page now checks the security code's expiration date more carefully. This prevents errors when the code looks slightly different than expected.

3df6ec9369acfcb1e7cb02288aa307c0940bbbdf.text: You can now restart your chat session directly when it ends, choosing to continue with the same settings or switch to a different assistant model. This prevents the app from getting stuck if the current model is temporarily unavailable.

c11a47350991d7298be950a93d1c2071dbb6ce2b.text: Fixed a bug where the same helper appeared twice on screen.

8ac94a54affac0eea3470c33444b18393683fa02.text: New accounts now get 500 free credits once when signing up, instead of a monthly allowance. Existing users keep their current monthly free credits.

116e456fa93f2d88a754347f5279f0633c3dd877.text: Login errors caused by complex account names are fixed. The app now keeps users on the correct website address during sign-in, preventing unexpected page changes.

1409cf91caa26aca496d30db773169642430a35c.text: The model list now groups options into separate sections instead of showing small labels on every line. The shared usage counter moved to the top of the premium section.

992f3382112e6b710f5d76ee5226430f901aa7de.text: The number of available premium sessions now appears in the waiting room title instead of the model list. This keeps the selection screen cleaner while still showing how many sessions remain.

dc68d3253980fb05661f464748e33fd3d7b541e7.text: The assistant now automatically takes over a shared workspace if the previous user has stopped working. This prevents you from being blocked and removes the need to manually claim the space.

d8e01e3216f2c9976b43ad30fad7f90308f32d70.text: When a tool fails, the error message now clearly says if the problem was bad formatting or if the text was just wrong. This helps you understand what went wrong without guessing.

d313c4a1ea19bd8f6fe9f8b2e7ba25d0522cd3c8.text: The tool now waits for the final result before showing changes. This prevents a confusing flash of full-file text when creating new files.

53bd37e42721c3c82f38c6e13eeca9ad1f6ef2fa.title: Remove stale AGENTS.md docs reference
53bd37e42721c3c82f38c6e13eeca9ad1f6ef2fa.summary: Deleted the `docs/patterns/discover-before-implement.md` line from AGENTS.md. The file was missing from the repo, making the reference dead. Scope is limited to AGENTS.md.

5a613f89b9293bbc9e93f2893301a4b475c8878c.title: Add keyboard navigation to CLI waiting room
5a613f89b9293bbc9e93f2893301a4b475c8878c.summary: Keyboard navigation replaces mouse-only interaction in `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`. Arrow keys and Tab cycle focus between 'Take over' and 'Exit' buttons, with Enter activating the focused option. Visual borders highlight the active button.

495d067c21d83b01b7d3cbd3e820640af3f829db.title: Deterministic tool call ids replace random UUIDs in Agent Runtime
495d067c21d83b01b7d3cbd3e820640af3f829db.summary: Agent Runtime now generates deterministic tool call ids formatted as `functions.<toolName>:<index>` via `createToolCallIdGenerator`, replacing random `crypto.randomUUID` and `generateCompactId` calls. This change ensures stable ids for tool calls across retries or re-parses by counting existing tool calls in message history and pending calls. Affected files include `run-programmatic-step.ts`, `tool-stream-parser.ts`, `tools/stream-parser.ts`, and `tools/tool-executor.ts` within `packages/agent-runtime`. The new `util/tool-call-id.ts` module handles id generation and counting logic.

f1af5d0a51e49608ddda053bf92a70b51897aed0.title: Improve codesearch output formatting
f1af5d0a51e49608ddda053bf92a70b51897aed0.summary: Code search output now groups matches by file with explicit line numbers and includes a global match count header. The formatting logic in common/src/util/format-code-search.ts was refactored to parse ripgrep lines more robustly, handling both match and context lines. In sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts, the output truncation now applies to the formatted string rather than raw stdout, ensuring the match count header and grouping structure are preserved even when output is limited.

884911e73ae7daa3131a1f3640089002400de394.title: browser-use agent enabled in free mode
884911e73ae7daa3131a1f3640089002400de394.summary: The `browser-use` agent is added to `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, mapped to `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview`. This enables browser automation capabilities for free-tier users. The change applies to the shared core constants, affecting all surfaces (Web, CLI, Desktop) that consume this configuration.

881686fe8d94809b7f42b6b88a2ab055f0d19928.title: Freebuff premium sessions reset at Pacific midnight
881686fe8d94809b7f42b6b88a2ab055f0d19928.summary: Premium session quota counting shifted from rolling 20-hour window to daily Pacific midnight reset. Server counts `free_session_admit` rows since last midnight `America/Los_Angeles`; limit remains 5 sessions. CLI waiting-room UI, `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, and `web/src/server/free-session/public-api.ts` updated. `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_WINDOW_HOURS` constant deprecated, replaced by `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_RESET_TIMEZONE` and `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_PERIOD`.

8fa7488daf630728e2d15dc62d3e14b3f3544e07.title: Fix freebuff model tab navigation
8fa7488daf630728e2d15dc62d3e14b3f3544e07.summary: Refactored key event handling in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to use new `freebuffModelNavigationDirectionForKey` utility. Added explicit support for raw ANSI escape sequences for Tab and Shift+Tab navigation in `freebuff-model-navigation.ts`. Applied `stopPropagation` to prevent conflicting key handling.

11fbf88499efe8ae3efd1f5b4835580e066b498f.title: CLI takeover prompt for concurrent Freebuff instances
11fbf88499efe8ae3efd1f5b4835580e066b498f.summary: Added a local-only `takeover_prompt` session status to the CLI. When a second instance starts while another is already running, the new instance prompts the user to either take over the session or exit. This prevents accidental session rotation or conflicts without requiring a server-side change.

dbdd64cd923cf4fa16a3cf73050c57b273b2c0c3.title: DeepSeek image attachment handling
dbdd64cd923cf4fa16a3cf73050c57b273b2c0c3.summary: New `deepseek-request-body.ts` normalizes `ChatCompletionRequestBody` to strip unsupported `image_url` and `file` parts, replacing them with text notices. `types.ts` updates `ChatMessage.content` to accept `ChatCompletionContentPart[]`. Refactors `deepseek.ts` to use shared model IDs and request builders.

31cf16f7e26bd33459b002c33bc55747baf8b2ca.title: strreplace tool args old/new become oldString/newString
31cf16f7e26bd33459b002c33bc55747baf8b2ca.summary: str_replace and propose_str_replace tool parameters renamed from old and new to oldString and newString. New names avoid keyword collisions and match Cursor-style tool schemas. Affects .agents/types/tools.ts, agents/types/tools.ts, editor prompt templates, and CLI str-replace.tsx.

f1af5d0a51e49608ddda053bf92a70b51897aed0.text: Search results now show line numbers and total matches grouped by file. This makes it easier to find specific code sections.

5a613f89b9293bbc9e93f2893301a4b475c8878c.text: You can now use the arrow keys to move between the 'Take over' and 'Exit' buttons, and press Enter to choose one. This lets you navigate the waiting room without needing a mouse.

53bd37e42721c3c82f38c6e13eeca9ad1f6ef2fa.text: A broken link in the internal guide was removed. This change affects only the internal documentation and does not impact the product's performance or features.

884911e73ae7daa3131a1f3640089002400de394.text: Free users can now use a browser automation tool. This lets the assistant perform actions on websites for them.

11fbf88499efe8ae3efd1f5b4835580e066b498f.text: If you start the program while another copy is already running, it asks if you want to switch to the new one or stop. This helps prevent accidental conflicts between sessions.

881686fe8d94809b7f42b6b88a2ab055f0d19928.text: Premium session limits now reset at midnight Pacific time instead of gradually over a 20-hour period. You get five fresh sessions each day at that time.

8fa7488daf630728e2d15dc62d3e14b3f3544e07.text: Arrow keys now switch models reliably. This fixes a bug where pressing the keys sometimes did nothing.

dbdd64cd923cf4fa16a3cf73050c57b273b2c0c3.text: The assistant now handles images and files differently. It replaces them with text notes instead of trying to process them.

495d067c21d83b01b7d3cbd3e820640af3f829db.text: The assistant now gives each action a fixed, predictable name instead of a random one. This helps it remember exactly which steps it already tried, so retries are more reliable and less likely to repeat or skip actions.

30a74b13655cdf54bdb92695b32a79061bab3395.title: Exclude TOOLCALLERROR from agent output
30a74b13655cdf54bdb92695b32a79061bab3395.summary: Tagged TOOL_CALL_ERROR messages are stripped from last_message and all_messages outputs in packages/agent-runtime/src/util/agent-output.ts. stream-parser.ts tags tool call errors with TOOL_CALL_ERROR. Filtering occurs after turn selection in getLastAssistantTurnMessages and getAgentOutput.

5904a9d5b789538679ef7cc195fbdb23ffbbb5a8.title: Premium session quota and shared rate limits
5904a9d5b789538679ef7cc195fbdb23ffbbb5a8.summary: Introduced shared premium session quotas (5 sessions / 20 hours) for DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM models, while MiniMax remains unlimited. CLI components (model selector, status bar, waiting room) now display usage counts and quota states based on `rateLimitsByModel` and `rateLimit` payloads.
