212bab08e71dc3d7dec495ba7d7e2600c0ec77e2.text: New users join instantly when a model has open spots, skipping the wait line. Waiting only starts when the model is full.

b234a41d2a82101d48b6df162b29f0896fe3a70a.text: The system now checks for signs of normal behavior, like long breaks or different helpers, before flagging an account. This reduces mistaken warnings for regular users.

b3c8862230764bfcb68cdd4001824885c81ee8cb.title: Add minimax-m2.7 to Fireworks long test script
b3c8862230764bfcb68cdd4001824885c81ee8cb.summary: Added `minimax-m2.7` configuration to `scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts`. Includes model ID `minimax/minimax-m2.7`, standard model `accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m2p7`, deployment model `accounts/james-65d217/deployments/nrdudqxd`, and cost parameters. Internal testing tooling only.

b0d0e55a348de37244c1edb5c8c97017e573c350.title: Disable minimax/minimax-m2.7 deployment in fireworks-config
b0d0e55a348de37244c1edb5c8c97017e573c350.summary: minimax/minimax-m2.7 deployment mapping commented out in web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts. Prevents routing to accounts/james-65d217/deployments/nrdudqxd. Internal config change.

46bf7033c9cdd02a76ffed40eab17c2ee9a3c1d9.title: Per-model active session counts in admission logs
46bf7033c9cdd02a76ffed40eab17c2ee9a3c1d9.summary: Admission tick logs per-model active session counts via new `activeCountsByModel` store function replacing global `activeCount`. Adds SQL `GROUP BY` on `freeSession.model` for single-query bucketed reads. Updates `AdmissionTickResult` interface and `AdmissionDeps` to carry `Record<string, number>` instead of scalar. Affects `web/src/server/free-session/admission.ts` and `store.ts`; log aggregator now receives `activeCountByModel` metric alongside existing `queueDepthByModel`.

50f2ade2171191f6369ab907ee04f50cf76f3dfb.title: Model tagline moves inline in CLI selector
50f2ade2171191f6369ab907ee04f50cf76f3dfb.summary: Tagline rendering shifts to an inline span next to the model name in cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx, removing it from the trailing hint slot. The hintWidth calculation drops the max(tagline.length) term, fixing the slot to 'No wait' or '999 ahead' widths. Affects the CLI freebuff model picker surface.

f953ae68f3b5abf9b56cc7d69b56ecd0e9266e25.title: Add minimax/minimax-m2.7 deployment
f953ae68f3b5abf9b56cc7d69b56ecd0e9266e25.summary: Added `minimax/minimax-m2.7` to `FIREWORKS_DEPLOYMENT_MAP` in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts`, pointing to `accounts/james-65d217/deployments/nrdudqxd`. This enables the new model version for the web LLM API. Scope limited to `web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts`.

72afab04704468996fb3c2eef1150ff28633b78e.title: Model selector stacks buttons vertically on narrow terminals
72afab04704468996fb3c2eef1150ff28633b78e.summary: Added `useTerminalDimensions` to `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to compute layout dynamically. If calculated button width exceeds `terminalWidth - 4`, `flexDirection` switches from 'row' to 'column'. Keyboard navigation updated to accept Up/Down arrows for focus movement, previously ignored to prevent conflicts.

f872c7ae18bc99433babb66eaa22ec7f2a0cf695.title: CLI uses hardware fingerprint for login
f872c7ae18bc99433babb66eaa22ec7f2a0cf695.summary: CLI login flow now uses a stable hardware-based fingerprint via `node-machine-id` instead of random IDs. `getFingerprintId()` caches the result process-wide and falls back to legacy random generation if hardware hashing fails. Covers `cli/src/utils/fingerprint.ts`, `login-modal.tsx`, `init-app.ts`, and `login-store.ts`. Login polling gates on `fingerprintId` to ensure consistent auth state.

1d89739afa72e15aba869e50191b1be62a0cb290.title: Add two-step keyboard navigation to model selector
1d89739afa72e15aba869e50191b1be62a0cb290.summary: The CLI model selector now uses two-step keyboard navigation: Tab/arrow keys move a focus highlight, while Enter/Space commits the model switch. This prevents accidental queue position loss when navigating past the currently selected model. Mouse clicks remain one-step. Implemented in `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` by separating `focusedId` from `selectedModel` state.

6f2d8fa236055ec7e5f93209d3d93f8808c2eb1f.title: CLI freebuff startup now GET-probes before joining queue
6f2d8fa236055ec7e5f93209d3d93f8808c2eb1f.summary: Startup flow changed from auto-POST to GET-probe. Session status `none` now renders a pre-chat landing screen with a model picker instead of a shimmer 'Joining...' state. Server GET responses include `queueDepthByModel` so the CLI shows live 'N ahead' counts before the user commits to a queue. `switchFreebuffModel` renamed to `joinFreebuffQueue` in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`; `PollController.setHasPosted` removed.

58e7f306da16d24c097bda7826d08d1444777da7.title: evictBanned frees banned users' freesession slots each admission tick
58e7f306da16d24c097bda7826d08d1444777da7.summary: Adds evictBanned to web/src/server/free-session/store.ts, deleting free_session rows where the linked user is banned. Runs in parallel with sweepExpired in runAdmissionTick (web/src/server/free-session/admission.ts) so slots freed this tick admit queued users immediately. Bans via admin UI, direct SQL, or Stripe webhook previously left users holding slots until expires_at. AdmissionTickResult now carries evictedBanned count, logged under freebuff_waiting_room metric.

72afab04704468996fb3c2eef1150ff28633b78e.text: The model selection buttons now stack vertically when the screen is too narrow to fit them side by side. You can use the up and down arrow keys to choose a model in this view.

b3c8862230764bfcb68cdd4001824885c81ee8cb.text: A new option was added to internal testing tools. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

46bf7033c9cdd02a76ffed40eab17c2ee9a3c1d9.text: The system now tracks how many people use each service type at once. This helps staff spot which ones are getting crowded.

1d89739afa72e15aba869e50191b1be62a0cb290.text: The model selector now uses two-step keyboard navigation. You move the highlight first, then press Enter to switch models. This prevents losing your place if you accidentally scroll past the current selection.

f872c7ae18bc99433babb66eaa22ec7f2a0cf695.text: The login system now uses a unique, stable identifier tied to your device instead of a random one. This keeps your login state consistent and prevents unexpected logouts when the app restarts.

58e7f306da16d24c097bda7826d08d1444777da7.text: Banned users now lose their place in line immediately. This frees up spots for other people faster.

b0d0e55a348de37244c1edb5c8c97017e573c350.text: The system no longer sends requests to a specific AI model. This internal update stops that model from being used.

f953ae68f3b5abf9b56cc7d69b56ecd0e9266e25.text: The assistant can now use a new version of its underlying model. This is a small internal update that adds a new option for the team to choose from.

50f2ade2171191f6369ab907ee04f50cf76f3dfb.text: A short description for each model option now appears right next to the model name. This makes the list easier to scan.

6f2d8fa236055ec7e5f93209d3d93f8808c2eb1f.text: The app now checks server status before connecting to a queue, showing a model selection screen with real-time wait times instead of a generic loading message.

b76f9be64e0489961fd31dbb625d9181a9355b1d.title: Improved Freebuff model selector
b76f9be64e0489961fd31dbb625d9181a9355b1d.summary: Refactored the CLI model selector layout using a row-based box structure for better visual separation. Moved the selector component above the status details in the waiting room screen. This change enhances readability and interaction flow within the CLI interface.

ff385b6c6953eb8d617d7f53e1ce76e4dad57f85.title: Add bot investigation and ban scripts
ff385b6c6953eb8d617d7f53e1ce76e4dad57f85.summary: New scripts `scripts/ban-freebuff-bots.ts`, `scripts/investigate-user.ts`, and `scripts/unban-user.ts` enable case-insensitive email lookups, DB schema joins, and bulk `banned` flag updates via Drizzle. `ban-freebuff-bots.ts` defaults to a dry run, requiring `--commit` to toggle `banned=true` and delete `free_session` rows for parsed candidate lists. `investigate-user.ts` aggregates message counts, costs, and repo usage by agent. `unban-user.ts` reverses bans for provided email arguments. `.gitignore` excludes `docs/bot-detection.md`.

8b4f89224820c1cd509317e70450de8042486e3d.title: Switch db:migrate to drizzle-kit migrate
8b4f89224820c1cd509317e70450de8042486e3d.summary: packages/internal package.json script db:migrate now calls drizzle-kit migrate instead of push. Added bootstrap-migrations-journal.sql to seed drizzle.__drizzle_migrations with created_at 1776719872222 (matching 0044_violet_stingray) so migrate skips prior push-managed migrations. Run SQL once per existing environment; fresh databases skip it.

1242b4e38947578ec285e80ed8d498ad170ecd86.title: Set default token counter model to Claude Opus 4.6
1242b4e38947578ec285e80ed8d498ad170ecd86.summary: Token counting defaults to claude-opus-4-6 for non-Claude models after updating DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_MODEL in web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts. Adds anthropic/claude-opus-4.6 to OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP in common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts. Scope covers Web API token count endpoint and shared OAuth model mapping constants. Follow-up: Ensure tokenizer compatibility for Opus 4.6 context windows.

faa7d7a6e9ebd7897d4497103455f3161c7fc3fe.title: CLI status bar gains End session button and unified action rendering
faa7d7a6e9ebd7897d4497103455f3161c7fc3fe.summary: StatusBar renders a dedicated End session button when idle with an active freebuff session, and StopButton is replaced by a shared StatusActionButton for hover-bold styling. A new END_SESSION_MESSAGE constant centralizes the waiting-room notice previously hardcoded in command-registry.ts. The end-session handler appends the system message and calls endAndRejoinFreebuffSession from chat.tsx, removing the redundant IS_FREEBUFF guard from the button render path. Scope limited to CLI chat UI components and constants.

a51a9349ec1bcbe51bad6bdacccd11215310bff7.title: Remove shimmer animation from waiting room wait time
a51a9349ec1bcbe51bad6bdacccd11215310bff7.summary: ShimmerText component removed from wait time display in cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx. Static text now renders position 1 as 'any moment now' or formatted estimatedWaitMs. Affects CLI waiting room screen only.

c3a379ac7a9ae375387a052e2cb5a2ed48b5cea6.title: Block freebuff waiting room for disallowed countries
c3a379ac7a9ae375387a052e2cb5a2ed48b5cea6.summary: Added early country gate to freebuff session API. Rejects non-allowlist regions before queue admission via new `country_blocked` status. Covers CLI, Web, and shared types in `free-mode-country.ts` and `_handlers.ts`. Returns HTTP 403 to force older CLI backoff while new CLI parses body directly.

47084a9dee1e018602723f65e34025c41255896d.title: Docs align model references to Opus 4.7
47084a9dee1e018602723f65e34025c41255896d.summary: Documentation updates replace Claude Opus 4.6 references with Claude Opus 4.7 across FAQ, advanced docs, and tips. Subagent model lists in `what-models.mdx` and `how-does-it-work.mdx` are corrected to match actual agent configurations (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite for research, GPT-5.4 for reasoning). The `page.tsx` FAQ also notes deprecation of Claude Pro/Max subscription connections.

a3087a33f8fffc6f3dbdc169bb6f0c191af8d792.title: CLI wait list UX: Tab/arrow key cycling, fixed-width hints, muted wait
a3087a33f8fffc6f3dbdc169bb6f0c191af8d792.summary: Model selector keyboard shortcuts change from number keys (1-9) to Tab/Shift+Tab and Left/Right arrow cycling. Up/Down keys are intentionally ignored to avoid conflicts with other vertical UI. Trailing hints ('N ahead', 'No wait', tagline) are padded to a fixed width computed via useMemo to prevent button resizing as queue depth changes. Waiting room screen 'Wait' label and value now render in muted foreground instead of primary, reducing visual noise.

79ce156d76a8b978bdd7425f4b66bff19b6827c6.title: Add model selector and /end-session command
79ce156d76a8b978bdd7425f4b66bff19b6827c6.summary: New `FreebuffModelSelector` component and `/end-session` command enable switching between model queues in the CLI waiting room. Selection persists to local settings and sends `x-freebuff-model` header on session POST; server 409 `model_locked` triggers UI confirmation prompt. Covers `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`, and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Migration `0044_violet_stingray.sql` adds queue depth tracking columns.

ff385b6c6953eb8d617d7f53e1ce76e4dad57f85.text: Staff added internal tools to find and block abusive accounts, plus a way to reverse bans if needed. This work happens behind the scenes and does not change how the product works for regular users.

b76f9be64e0489961fd31dbb625d9181a9355b1d.text: The tool now shows model choices in a clearer, separated layout, with the selection area moved to a more logical spot. This makes the interface easier to read and use.

79ce156d76a8b978bdd7425f4b66bff19b6827c6.text: You can now choose which version of the assistant to use in the waiting room. Your choice saves automatically for next time. If the server blocks a change, you will see a confirmation prompt.

a3087a33f8fffc6f3dbdc169bb6f0c191af8d792.text: You can now choose a model by pressing Tab or arrow keys instead of numbers. The screen stays stable while waiting, and the wait time text appears less bright to reduce distraction.

a51a9349ec1bcbe51bad6bdacccd11215310bff7.text: The waiting screen now shows your position and estimated wait time as plain text, removing the animated shimmer effect. This change makes the information easier to read and reduces visual distraction.

1242b4e38947578ec285e80ed8d498ad170ecd86.text: The assistant now uses a newer, smarter model to count text length, even when you are talking to other AI services. This improves accuracy for everyone.

47084a9dee1e018602723f65e34025c41255896d.text: The help guides were updated to name the current assistant model. Some old subscription sign-in methods are no longer supported.

8b4f89224820c1cd509317e70450de8042486e3d.text: The system now records past database updates so it does not repeat them. This internal maintenance change prevents errors when saving data.

c3a379ac7a9ae375387a052e2cb5a2ed48b5cea6.text: The app now checks your location before letting you join the waiting line. If you are in a place where the service is not allowed, you will see a message and be unable to connect.

faa7d7a6e9ebd7897d4497103455f3161c7fc3fe.text: The chat interface now shows a clear 'End session' button when you are idle in a waiting room. Clicking it ends the session and returns you to the chat, with a standard message confirming the action.

8c694456f59d1ebdf7c410ea979a0a59596156c3.title: SDK tests drop referralcode mock
8c694456f59d1ebdf7c410ea979a0a59596156c3.summary: SDK test mocks for user objects remove the `referral_code` field. This aligns test fixtures with the current schema after the field was dropped from the `user` table. Covers `run-cancellation`, `run-error-preserves-history`, `run-file-filter`, `run-handle-event`, and `run-mcp-tool-filter` test suites.

2118e41fd1ff01f99c589aaa4be5eb359cbcdf06.title: Tighten Fireworks prefill p90 degraded threshold to 500ms
2118e41fd1ff01f99c589aaa4be5eb359cbcdf06.summary: Lowered `PREFILL_QUEUE_P90_DEGRADED_MS` from 1000 to 500 in `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts`. The tighter threshold triggers 'degraded' status earlier, leveraging p90 as a leading indicator to halt session admission before median latency rises. Scope limited to server-side health checks for Fireworks backend.

dd373b9102d0ec75fe327a1e3b7dcd2b0f654270.title: Apply 15s timeout to subscription limit tests
dd373b9102d0ec75fe327a1e3b7dcd2b0f654270.summary: Added SUBSCRIPTION_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS (15s) to five subscription limit test cases in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts. Tests covering weekly limit, 5-hour session limit, and fallback behavior now pass the timeout constant to Jest's it() function. Scope: web test suite only. No production code changes.

234adfdc33d52adb8e03da558d111ef5755d7630.title: Freebuff waiting room estimate lowered to 24 seconds per spot
234adfdc33d52adb8e03da558d111ef5755d7630.summary: Wait-time estimate in the free-session queue dropped from 60 seconds to 24 seconds per spot ahead via constant `WAIT_MS_PER_SPOT_AHEAD` in `web/src/server/free-session/session-view.ts`. Adjustment reflects observed throughput in the waiting room. Scope limited to server-side `toSessionStateResponse` and `estimateWaitMs`. Position 1 still maps to 0ms (next tick picks you up).

f7461e3885e81bf95a5058142b2754174f13eb43.title: Remove referrals feature from CLI
f7461e3885e81bf95a5058142b2754174f13eb43.summary: Removed /refer-friends command, referral code parsing utilities, and associated UI banners from CLI. This deletion strips out the entire referral redemption flow, including normalizeReferralCode and handleReferralCode logic. Scope covers cli/src/commands (registry, router, utils), cli/src/components (input bar, banners), and web/src/components (onboard, referral persist). Creator attribution remains intact; no migration path provided for existing saved referral states.

87c6e90052b803282e0edd7017a42409e9b36784.title: Fix grace-period hang and stuck streaming UI in CLI
87c6e90052b803282e0edd7017a42409e9b36784.summary: CLI now renders ask_user prompts during the freebuff grace window by gating the session-ended banner on !askUserState. handleFreebuffGateError calls updater.markComplete() on session_expired or waiting_room_required to stop the streaming cursor and clear the flush interval. Fixes #518.

f2386263397b6d6e6d4473c00622d45d3d027ee2.title: Agent runtime preserves message history on mid-run errors
f2386263397b6d6e6d4473c00622d45d3d027ee2.summary: Agent runtime now mutates `initialAgentState` in place during `loopAgentSteps` instead of creating new objects, ensuring `messageHistory` propagates to SDK callers even if an error throws before return. SDK `run.ts` detects this progress via array identity comparison (`sessionState.mainAgentState.messageHistory !== initialMessageHistory`) to conditionally append the user prompt in `getCancelledSessionState`, preventing duplicate messages when the runtime already processed the input. Changes cover `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` and `sdk/src/run.ts`. The fix relies on shared object references and array identity checks rather than length comparisons to handle context pruning scenarios.

9996bc60d46e06a5738df6d568f147ca937513ab.title: Update accountsuspended example message in error schema docs
9996bc60d46e06a5738df6d568f147ca937513ab.summary: The example message for the 403 account_suspended error in docs/error-schema.md was updated to remove the specific billing reason. This aligns the documentation with the new generic suspension message used by the API. The change also required updating the corresponding test in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts to match the new string.

6736dfa66d6bf15eb812a131068343af0029f59d.title: Keep session alive during /history
6736dfa66d6bf15eb812a131068343af0029f59d.summary: ChatHistoryScreen renders inside AuthedSurface instead of replacing it in App.tsx. This prevents session unmounting, which previously deleted the session row and forced a waiting room return. Affects CLI surfaces via cli/src/app.tsx. Session persistence logic relies on AuthedSurface remaining mounted.

20e84ced412bc793ededb64af3c50bca6765fe5b.title: Waiting room bypass for team@codebuff.com
20e84ced412bc793ededb64af3c50bca6765fe5b.summary: Added `isWaitingRoomBypassedForEmail` to allow `team@codebuff.com` to skip the free session waiting room. Updated `checkSession`, `requestSession`, `getSessionState`, and `endUserSession` in `web/src/server/free-session/public-api.ts` to accept `userEmail` and return `disabled` status if bypassed. Modified `web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` to fetch and pass `email` from user info. This prevents CI e2e test flakiness when the global waiting room is active.

6736dfa66d6bf15eb812a131068343af0029f59d.text: Opening the chat history no longer causes you to be logged out or sent back to the waiting room.

dd373b9102d0ec75fe327a1e3b7dcd2b0f654270.text: Internal checks for subscription limits now wait 15 seconds before timing out. This change affects only testing tools and does not impact how the product works for users.

9996bc60d46e06a5738df6d568f147ca937513ab.text: The message shown when an account is suspended became more generic. This small update ensures the instructions for reading these errors match the actual text displayed.

f7461e3885e81bf95a5058142b2754174f13eb43.text: The app no longer lets you invite friends to get rewards. Existing invitations stop working.

8c694456f59d1ebdf7c410ea979a0a59596156c3.text: A small internal cleanup removed an old data label from test files to match the current system rules. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

f2386263397b6d6e6d4473c00622d45d3d027ee2.text: When the assistant stops working mid-task, it now keeps a record of what was already said. This prevents the same message from appearing twice if you resume the chat.

2118e41fd1ff01f99c589aaa4be5eb359cbcdf06.text: The system now spots slow response times sooner. This change helps prevent you from getting stuck with a sluggish experience.

20e84ced412bc793ededb64af3c50bca6765fe5b.text: A special internal account now skips the wait for free sessions. This helps automated tests run smoothly and does not change how regular users experience the product.

234adfdc33d52adb8e03da558d111ef5755d7630.text: The estimated wait time for free sessions is now shorter, showing 24 seconds per person ahead of you instead of 60. This matches how quickly spots actually open up.

87c6e90052b803282e0edd7017a42409e9b36784.text: The app no longer freezes or shows a stuck loading cursor when a time limit or waiting room appears. You will now see a clear message asking what to do next, instead of the screen hanging.

9278d13d86080c3293753ec84c110db59e73deab.title: Raise provider headers timeout to 30m
9278d13d86080c3293753ec84c110db59e73deab.summary: Increased `headersTimeout` from 10m to 30m for all major LLM providers (Canopywave, Fireworks, OpenAI, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow). Deep-thinking models often exceed the previous 10-minute limit before streaming starts, causing premature connection drops. Updates applied across `web/src/llm-api/` files.

1b47ff6b79bfe5516520bd9bc28dee1c2a2c21c2.title: Update fireworks health test fixtures for tightened threshold
1b47ff6b79bfe5516520bd9bc28dee1c2a2c21c2.summary: Fireworks health classifier test fixtures reduced `prefillQueueBuckets` from 300 to 150. This aligns test data with a tightened queue threshold, ensuring `healthy` status assertions remain valid. Changes are scoped to `web/src/server/free-session/__tests__/fireworks-health.test.ts`.

c0061ed43bee434c65385d84134b8f5dd2b1dd6c.title: Prefill queue health threshold tightened to 125ms
c0061ed43bee434c65385d84134b8f5dd2b1dd6c.summary: PREFILL_QUEUE_DEGRADED_MS in `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts` lowered from 200 to 125. This makes prefill queue health checks more strict, degrading status earlier to match the 2s+ user-perceived latency threshold. Scope limited to the Fireworks health monitoring subsystem.

bf7bf87c62b0dba407d2ee2b03899d2c7ec13677.title: Switch fireworks health check from p50 to p90 prefill queue latency
bf7bf87c62b0dba407d2ee2b03899d2c7ec13677.summary: Fireworks health classification now evaluates p90 prefill-queue latency instead of p50. Threshold constant renamed `PREFILL_QUEUE_DEGRADED_MS` (125) to `PREFILL_QUEUE_P90_DEGRADED_MS` (1000). Change affects `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts` and corresponding tests. P90 provides earlier warning signal for load, halting admission before median latency rises.

2dee392b72ade5fa5f5da75c8c821c8bc8c2b96c.title: Chat completions suspended message update and formatting
2dee392b72ade5fa5f5da75c8c821c8bc8c2b96c.summary: The account suspension error message in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` was simplified to remove explicit billing references. Extensive whitespace and indentation adjustments were applied to the ternary stream and non-stream routing logic. No functional behavior changes were introduced beyond the copy update.

504f80c1ed8afbd7081ff99a1932d9757ff74cdf.title: Remove web referral banner
504f80c1ed8afbd7081ff99a1932d9757ff74cdf.summary: Referral banner removed from web/src/app/layout.tsx. Banner component import and render deleted. Scope limited to web layout. No migration or API change.

3888bda6dbbd4b0dd55364e5781ae9d17b2661b5.title: Log waiting room time-series metrics each admission tick
3888bda6dbbd4b0dd55364e5781ae9d17b2661b5.summary: Admission tick logs now emit every cycle instead of only on state changes, adding `activeCount` to the metric payload. `store.ts` implements `activeCount()` via SQL count on `status='active'`, exposed through `AdmissionDeps` and `AdmissionTickResult`. This enables continuous time-series charting of queue depth and active sessions in the log aggregator, filterable by `metric=freebuff_waiting_room`.

eeffc4f2b7cd78031922b0fd8b22c77f57557e4f.title: Skip flaky subscriber block grant tests
eeffc4f2b7cd78031922b0fd8b22c77f57557e4f.summary: Two test cases in completions.test.ts marked with it.skip: 'continues when ensureSubscriberBlockGrant throws an error' and 'allows subscriber with 0 a-la-carte credits but active block grant'. Tests skipped to avoid CI flakiness. No production code changed.

ec7051080c95a60952a7b243e4c7a89a793c63aa.title: Add .claude/settings.json with auto permission mode
ec7051080c95a60952a7b243e4c7a89a793c63aa.summary: Introduced .claude/settings.json setting permissions.defaultMode to 'auto'. This configuration file governs Claude Code agent behavior within the repository. Affects only the .claude directory; no changes to Freebuff core logic, CLI, or web surfaces.

e0ba3a65c9a4f579af2ffd0f2ed6342ef0513646.title: Switch waiting room wait estimate to fixed one-minute-per-spot
e0ba3a65c9a4f579af2ffd0f2ed6342ef0513646.summary: The `estimateWaitMs` function in `session-view.ts` now uses a hardcoded constant `WAIT_MS_PER_SPOT_AHEAD` (60,000 ms) instead of calculating wait time based on `admissionTickMs`. This decouples the UI estimate from the actual server admission cadence, providing a simpler, human-friendly approximation that ignores health-gated pauses or variable tick rates. The `admissionTickMs` parameter has been removed from `SessionDeps` in `public-api.ts` and the corresponding interface in `session-view.ts`. Documentation in `docs/freebuff-waiting-room.md` is updated to reflect this rule-of-thumb calculation.

1b47ff6b79bfe5516520bd9bc28dee1c2a2c21c2.text: Small internal update to a test helper. This helps check that the service stays healthy when the queue gets shorter. No change to how you use the product.

ec7051080c95a60952a7b243e4c7a89a793c63aa.text: The assistant now automatically follows its own rules without asking for permission first. This internal update does not change how the product works for you.

9278d13d86080c3293753ec84c110db59e73deab.text: The system now waits longer for the assistant to begin answering. This prevents connections from dropping when the assistant is thinking deeply.

2dee392b72ade5fa5f5da75c8c821c8bc8c2b96c.text: The warning shown when an account is suspended no longer mentions billing. This small wording update changes nothing else about how the product works.

bf7bf87c62b0dba407d2ee2b03899d2c7ec13677.text: The system now watches for traffic jams in the queue more carefully, triggering a slowdown warning sooner. This helps prevent long waits for users by stopping new requests before the average delay gets too high.

504f80c1ed8afbd7081ff99a1932d9757ff74cdf.text: The referral banner has been removed from the website. Users will no longer see this message when visiting the site.

3888bda6dbbd4b0dd55364e5781ae9d17b2661b5.text: The system now records queue numbers every cycle instead of only when they change. This helps staff monitor waiting times more accurately.

c0061ed43bee434c65385d84134b8f5dd2b1dd6c.text: The system now checks how busy the assistant's processing queue is more strictly. If the queue gets slightly slower than before, the system will show a 'degraded' status earlier. This helps match the warning with when users actually start noticing delays.

eeffc4f2b7cd78031922b0fd8b22c77f57557e4f.text: A small internal check was paused because it sometimes failed without a real reason. This does not change how the product works for you.

e0ba3a65c9a4f579af2ffd0f2ed6342ef0513646.text: The waiting room now shows a simpler time estimate, assuming one minute for each person ahead of you. This replaces a more complex calculation that tried to match the server's exact timing.

d79dc99d54cde0766206015a188840cb46678613.title: Document prod script execution via Infisical
d79dc99d54cde0766206015a188840cb46678613.summary: Added 'Running Scripts Against Prod' section to docs/development.md. Details using `infisical run --env=prod` to target production databases and services with scripts or one-off queries. Notes default env is `dev` and recommends read-only operations.

59640d5c70dd5863abcdf66110b1b7247c66af05.title: Tighten Fireworks health thresholds
59640d5c70dd5863abcdf66110b1b7247c66af05.summary: Tightened health stats thresholds in `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts`. `PREFILL_QUEUE_DEGRADED_MS` reduced from 600 to 200, and `KV_BLOCKS_DEGRADED_FRACTION` reduced from 0.9 to 0.8. This causes earlier degradation detection for prefill-queue latency and KV block memory pressure.

060eb553eefe78c2d477e7363dfda2e3750aceb8.title: Lower PREFILLQUEUEDEGRADEDMS to 600ms
060eb553eefe78c2d477e7363dfda2e3750aceb8.summary: PREFILL_QUEUE_DEGRADED_MS threshold lowered from 1000ms to 600ms in web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts. Adjusts health status logic to trigger 'degraded' state earlier when median prefill-queue latency crosses the new bound. Scope limited to server-side health monitoring for Fireworks sessions.

528904b505179630fec4697946d63df856a51e4c.title: Skip flaky e2e tests for code edit and terminal command
528904b505179630fec4697946d63df856a51e4c.summary: e2e tests for Code Edit and Terminal Command are skipped via describe.skip. Timeouts increased from 120s to 900s. Addresses test flakiness in CI.

4d6e4c343641ea3c6e8789ac8dee87eb5c35233e.title: Increase timeout for e2e test
4d6e4c343641ea3c6e8789ac8dee87eb5c35233e.summary: CI timeout limits raised for e2e tests in .github/workflows/freebuff-e2e.yml. Job-level timeout-minutes increased from 10 to 20. Test-level --timeout flag now conditionally sets 900000ms for code-edit and terminal-command tests, otherwise 120000ms.

79becb7d0014169ea4b07db5f350afbcb8d29669.title: CLI status bar shows session time when idle
79becb7d0014169ea4b07db5f350afbcb8d29669.summary: Added `formatSessionRemaining` to `cli/src/components/status-bar.tsx` to display session time in the status bar during `idle` state. The label shows remaining time (e.g., `1h 30m left`) or `expiring…` if time is up, using `theme.warning` when urgent. Moved `useFreebuffSessionProgress` hook call earlier in the component to support this logic. Adjusted countdown rendering to hide the separate countdown text when the idle status indicator is active.

1401668addb1c937cbb5763314294f47f4c8abd1.title: Raise e2e test timeout to 1000000ms
1401668addb1c937cbb5763314294f47f4c8abd1.summary: Bump `TEST_TIMEOUT` to 1,000,000ms in `code-edit.e2e.test.ts` and `terminal-command.e2e.test.ts`. Addresses flaky failures in freebuff e2e suites.

ab21fbbdc4bac114401e4786199d4a3911af6d45.title: Admission gate uses Fireworks health state
ab21fbbdc4bac114401e4786199d4a3911af6d45.summary: Replaced boolean reachability probe with `getFireworksHealth` returning `healthy`, `degraded`, or `unhealthy`. Admission halts on `degraded` or `unhealthy` to prevent queue buildup when upstream latency exceeds SLOs. Implemented in `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts` and integrated into `admission.ts` and `store.ts`. Metrics include prefill queue latency and KV block memory pressure.

ff89b57040335b83085dbdb299b6133ff2cfd116.title: CLI waiting room gates freebuff sessions
ff89b57040335b83085dbdb299b6133ff2cfd116.summary: CLI enforces single-instance freebuff sessions via new AuthedSurface gate in app.tsx. Introduces waiting-room-screen, session-ended-banner, and freebuff-superseded-screen to handle queued, ended, and superseded states. Superseded state triggers on 409 session_superseded, stopping polling to prevent fallback into waiting room. Session-ended banner captures Enter to re-queue but disables rejoin while streaming to avoid aborting in-flight agent runs.

5787c43ba551d59afefddbec4a758a87cfc80cc4.title: Free mode renamed to Lite mode
5787c43ba551d59afefddbec4a758a87cfc80cc4.summary: The 'free' agent mode in Codebuff CLI is renamed to 'lite', introducing a new `base2-lite` agent definition. The `createBase2` function now accepts 'lite' as a mode, mapping it to the same underlying model logic as the previous 'free' mode. UI components, hooks, and prop names across `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `build-mode-buttons.tsx`, and block renderers are updated to reflect the `onBuildLite` callback and 'Build LITE' label. Ads logic in `cli/src/commands/ads.ts` treats LITE as a paid mode, relying on saved settings instead of forcing ads enabled.

79becb7d0014169ea4b07db5f350afbcb8d29669.text: The status bar now shows how much time is left in your session when you are idle. If the time is running out, it warns you.

ab21fbbdc4bac114401e4786199d4a3911af6d45.text: The system now checks if the AI service is running smoothly before accepting new requests. If the service is slow or failing, the system pauses to prevent long waits and errors for users.

1401668addb1c937cbb5763314294f47f4c8abd1.text: The system now waits longer for some background checks to finish before giving up. This reduces occasional false errors during automated testing, making the app more reliable without changing how you use it.

4d6e4c343641ea3c6e8789ac8dee87eb5c35233e.text: This internal change gives our automated checks more time to finish. You will not see any difference in the app.

d79dc99d54cde0766206015a188840cb46678613.text: The team wrote instructions for staff to safely check live system data. This helps support agents find problems faster without risking the service.

59640d5c70dd5863abcdf66110b1b7247c66af05.text: The system now spots slow responses or low memory earlier. This means it switches to safer modes faster to keep things running smoothly.

060eb553eefe78c2d477e7363dfda2e3750aceb8.text: The system now flags potential delays in AI responses sooner. This helps support teams notice and fix slow service faster.

528904b505179630fec4697946d63df856a51e4c.text: The checks that test editing and terminal features are temporarily skipped because they fail too often. This change affects internal testing and does not change how the product works for you.

5787c43ba551d59afefddbec4a758a87cfc80cc4.text: The free mode is now called Lite mode. The assistant works the same way, but ads are no longer forced on for this mode.

ff89b57040335b83085dbdb299b6133ff2cfd116.text: The app now limits free sessions to one device at a time. If you sign in elsewhere, the first screen stops and shows a message, so you cannot accidentally run two sessions at once.

5c0c0ac2515c4c1ca066fa70a22ddb4d3a4c0edf.title: Remove paid account gate from completions
5c0c0ac2515c4c1ca066fa70a22ddb4d3a4c0edf.summary: Removed account age and paid relationship checks from `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`. Eliminates `MIN_ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS` and `PAID_GATE_BYPASS_EMAILS` constants along with their associated 403 blocking logic for non-free mode requests. `created_at` field fetching and `principals` balance destructuring removed. Analytics tracking for `blocked_for_free_tier` deleted. BYOK header retrieval moved inline.

61914917527ec0b8842fe3a015e34c957b4e3578.title: Add paid-gate bypass for team@codebuff.com
61914917527ec0b8842fe3a015e34c957b4e3578.summary: Added `PAID_GATE_BYPASS_EMAILS` set containing `team@codebuff.com` to bypass the paid+aged-account gate in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`. This allows integration tests, such as the SDK prompt-caching test, to run against a real server without seeding a purchase for every fresh test account. The bypass checks `userInfo.email` (case-insensitive) before evaluating `hasPaidRelationship` and `accountIsTooNew`.

7f5b41b7626ba943763be093bc64e920dd6a6956.title: CLI release HTTP client avoids DNS lookup after proxied CONNECT
7f5b41b7626ba943763be093bc64e920dd6a6956.summary: Refactored CLI release installer HTTP logic into shared `http.js` module (`createReleaseHttpClient`) used by `cli/release` and `cli/release-staging`. Fixes post-CONNECT DNS lookups by passing pre-established proxy sockets directly to `https.request`. Updates `package.json` files to include `http.js` in published artifacts. Mechanism: `connectThroughProxy` returns a socket; `httpGet` uses this socket for the target request, bypassing local DNS resolution for the target hostname when a proxy is configured.

07d2d7853bef1571195a1a9b051db169561ba40a.title: Increase test timeout for subscription limit enforcement
07d2d7853bef1571195a1a9b051db169561ba40a.summary: Bump test timeout to 15000ms in completions.test.ts. Fixes flaky non-streaming fetch-path tests hitting Bun's 5s default on loaded machines. Affects web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts.

553387c77c78e9f73dad13f01aa76605030008f4.title: context-pruner adds cacheExpiryMs param
553387c77c78e9f73dad13f01aa76605030008f4.summary: context-pruner now accepts cacheExpiryMs to override default 5-minute Anthropic cache expiry. base2.ts injects 10-minute expiry for free-mode agents via serialized handleSteps. Scope limited to agents/base2/base2.ts and agents/context-pruner.ts. Free-mode pruner also strips USER_PROMPT tags when params present.

117cc3de13ecae4863068f4d4870ab01f60d8c25.title: Free mode rejects non-allowlisted agent model
117cc3de13ecae4863068f4d4870ab01f60d8c25.summary: Added validation in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts to reject free-mode requests using non-allowlisted agent+model combinations via isFreeModeAllowedAgentModel. Prevents unpaid accounts from bypassing cost checks to request expensive models (e.g. Opus) on the OpenRouter key. Returns 403 with error 'free_mode_invalid_agent_model' and logs analytics event CHAT_COMPLETIONS_VALIDATION_ERROR. Check runs before rate limiting and OpenRouter calls.

c341c025a0db4f1cf4c9586cee95aac61c126d2d.title: fix code-map line count off-by-one
c341c025a0db4f1cf4c9586cee95aac61c126d2d.summary: Fixed operator precedence bug in `packages/code-map/src/parse.ts`. `numLines` now correctly adds 1 to the newline count instead of evaluating `?? 0 + 1`. Scope limited to `code-map` package internals.

8a7cf082bdd478b85aa746ebe42879733bb3ecdf.title: Fireworks health monitor added
8a7cf082bdd478b85aa746ebe42879733bb3ecdf.summary: New server-side monitor scrapes Fireworks Prometheus metrics every 60s, computes per-deployment health snapshots, and exposes /api/admin/fireworks-health. Static config moved to fireworks-config.ts to avoid edge-runtime import issues. CLI script scripts/check-fireworks-health.ts added for ad-hoc verification. Monitor auto-starts via instrumentation.ts register().

9e0bca43b9da195068a60d936e04e5484f05be61.title: Remove thinker-with-files-gemini from free agents
9e0bca43b9da195068a60d936e04e5484f05be61.summary: Removed thinker-with-files-gemini agent from free mode. Deleted agent definition from FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS and stripped spawn instructions from base2 prompt. Updated spawn-agents tool schema to remove agent from filePaths description.

a92b5cf6c09072e0c1e72ed56d9f41922ff0d610.title: Decouple billing from message insert
a92b5cf6c09072e0c1e72ed56d9f41922ff0d610.summary: Isolated credit consumption from message insertion in `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` to ensure audit rows record upstream OpenRouter costs even if billing fails. Removed `shouldBlockFreeUserOverdraw` and `InsufficientCreditsError`, replacing the hard gate with idempotency checks on `messageId` to prevent duplicate charges on retries. Scope covers `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` and associated tests. Billing errors now log loudly but allow message insertion with `credits=0` to preserve cost visibility.

117cc3de13ecae4863068f4d4870ab01f60d8c25.text: Free accounts can no longer use certain expensive AI models. If you try, the system will block the request and show an error message.

553387c77c78e9f73dad13f01aa76605030008f4.text: The system now remembers conversation details for a longer time when using the free version. This change is internal and does not require any action from you.

07d2d7853bef1571195a1a9b051db169561ba40a.text: Developers increased the time allowed for automated checks to finish on busy computers. This small internal change stops false failure warnings, helping keep the assistant's responses reliable.

7f5b41b7626ba943763be093bc64e920dd6a6956.text: The tool now connects to the internet more reliably when using a corporate network. This prevents errors during updates.

9e0bca43b9da195068a60d936e04e5484f05be61.text: The option to use the 'thinker-with-files-gemini' assistant for free was removed. Free users can no longer select this specific assistant.

a92b5cf6c09072e0c1e72ed56d9f41922ff0d610.text: The system now records usage costs even if billing fails, ensuring no charges are lost. This keeps your account balance accurate and prevents accidental duplicate charges.

c341c025a0db4f1cf4c9586cee95aac61c126d2d.text: Fixed a bug where line counts were sometimes one off.

61914917527ec0b8842fe3a015e34c957b4e3578.text: A special email address can now skip the payment check. This helps test the system. Regular users see no change.

5c0c0ac2515c4c1ca066fa70a22ddb4d3a4c0edf.text: The service no longer blocks access to premium features based on account age or payment status. This internal change removes previous restrictions for eligible requests.

8a7cf082bdd478b85aa746ebe42879733bb3ecdf.text: Internal system monitors service health every minute. No direct user impact.

bd3cface754bc88769a451f1b6f9ee4d2c74fe04.title: Add createdat to agent runtime test fixtures
bd3cface754bc88769a451f1b6f9ee4d2c74fe04.summary: Added `created_at: new Date('2024-01-01T00:00:00Z')` to mock user objects in `common/src/testing/fixtures/agent-runtime.ts` and `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts`. This fixes type errors where the `created_at` field was missing from the test fixtures but required by the runtime schema. Scope covers shared core testing fixtures and the evals implementation. The field uses a fixed ISO 8601 timestamp to ensure deterministic test results.

63db864d994664afaa6b0b01b5a4a4a08fd14e88.title: Referral credits disabled via zero bonus constant
63db864d994664afaa6b0b01b5a4a4a08fd14e88.summary: Referral credit grants disabled by setting CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS to 0 in common/src/constants/limits.ts. web/src/app/api/referrals/helpers.ts skips ledger writes when bonus is zero, preserving referral tracking records only. Mechanism targets self-referral abuse patterns while shifting focus to Freebuff's non-credit model.

9f3f274bf654c394f76472e10eec2f5b683bbf6e.title: Chat completions endpoint allow freemode requests
9f3f274bf654c394f76472e10eec2f5b683bbf6e.summary: Chat completions API now permits freemode requests, bypassing paid relationship and account age validation. Root cause: `isFreeModeRequest` flag added to conditional check in `_post.ts`. Scope: `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

b992bec00d24351d7915f3ffb7ca9cf0c449f546.title: Fix completions test type errors
b992bec00d24351d7915f3ffb7ca9cf0c449f546.summary: Added explicit Record<string, number> type assertions to breakdown and principals fields in completions.test.ts. Resolved TypeScript compilation errors during test execution. Internal change affecting only web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts.

506c5ab18679267f9ef76a9051f1f4943cf7f0cd.title: Fix types in e2e-mocks and SDK tests
506c5ab18679267f9ef76a9051f1f4943cf7f0cd.summary: Added missing created_at field to MOCK_USER in sdk/e2e/utils/e2e-mocks.ts. Type errors in SDK test suites (run-cancellation, run-file-filter, run-handle-event, run-mcp-tool-filter) resolved. Internal type alignment for e2e utilities and unit tests.

c7e2926787e8a817c260246ce75dfdb89a6c7c0d.title: Generation-lookup fallback bills OpenRouter streams missing usage
c7e2926787e8a817c260246ce75dfdb89a6c7c0d.summary: Added `ensureBilled` and `fallbackBillFromGeneration` to `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` to capture `generationId` and `model` from stream chunks. If a stream exits without a usage-bearing chunk, a 500ms delay triggers a lookup of OpenRouter's `/generation` endpoint to bill the final cost. This prevents free completion tokens when mid-stream failures occur.

8f5254f7269d7dabb514d76c63f7eca69169a77d.title: Refine skill loading prompt in base2 agent
8f5254f7269d7dabb514d76c63f7eca69169a77d.summary: The base2 agent's implementation step prompt was updated to change how it instructs skill loading. The directive shifted from a mandatory 'must use' command to a conditional 'consider loading' suggestion. It now explicitly warns against reloading skills already present in the conversation context. This change is isolated to `agents/base2/base2.ts`.

f231508eb3ebf55810bc726751001b8e306fc6f6.title: Add Fireworks cache interval test script
f231508eb3ebf55810bc726751001b8e306fc6f6.summary: New `scripts/test-fireworks-cache-intervals.ts` measures Fireworks prompt caching persistence across idle intervals. Sends priming request, waits configurable intervals, reports cache hit rates. Supports `glm-5.1`, `kimi-k2.5`, `minimax` models with `--deployment` and `--intervals` flags. Internal tooling only.

c1a63d8422c1b138b8a61e0dc27083b1f6145c4e.title: Block codebuff usage
c1a63d8422c1b138b8a61e0dc27083b1f6145c4e.summary: Added `created_at` to `User` type and `userColumns` in `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts`, and `principals` to `GetUserUsageDataFn` in `common/src/types/contracts/billing.ts`. `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` now rejects non-free mode requests if the account is under 3 days old or lacks a paid relationship (purchase/subscription > 0), unless BYOK is used. `web/src/app/api/v1/me/_get.ts` updated to handle `Date` types in the response record.

24c7a015a526af5c874f809a96ea1740a7c9c337.title: Remove initial free credit grant on signup
24c7a015a526af5c874f809a96ea1740a7c9c337.summary: Removed createInitialCreditGrant and processAndGrantCredit calls from NextAuth sign-in callbacks in freebuff/web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts and web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts. New accounts no longer receive DEFAULT_FREE_CREDITS_GRANT. Stripe customer linking remains, but credit initialization logic is deleted. Existing users retain current balances.

506c5ab18679267f9ef76a9051f1f4943cf7f0cd.text: A small internal fix corrected how test data was labeled. Users will see no change in the product.

f231508eb3ebf55810bc726751001b8e306fc6f6.text: A small internal tool now tests how long the assistant remembers recent conversation details during breaks. This helps ensure responses stay accurate and fast.

bd3cface754bc88769a451f1b6f9ee4d2c74fe04.text: A small internal fix corrected missing information in background test data. This change does not affect how you use the product.

63db864d994664afaa6b0b01b5a4a4a08fd14e88.text: The company stopped giving extra points for inviting friends to join. This change helps stop people from gaming the system and focuses on other ways to get value.

c1a63d8422c1b138b8a61e0dc27083b1f6145c4e.text: New accounts now wait three days or need a paid plan before using the main assistant, unless they bring their own key.

24c7a015a526af5c874f809a96ea1740a7c9c337.text: New users no longer get free credits when signing up. Existing users keep their current credit balances.

c7e2926787e8a817c260246ce75dfdb89a6c7c0d.text: If a chat response stops early, the system now checks the final cost after a short delay. This ensures you are billed accurately for all text generated, rather than receiving it for free.

8f5254f7269d7dabb514d76c63f7eca69169a77d.text: The assistant now checks if it already knows how to do a task before looking up new instructions. This prevents it from wasting time re-reading steps it already has.

9f3f274bf654c394f76472e10eec2f5b683bbf6e.text: The chat feature now lets some requests skip the usual checks for paid status and account age. This is an internal change that affects how certain messages are processed.

b992bec00d24351d7915f3ffb7ca9cf0c449f546.text: This internal update fixed a small technical issue in the system's testing tools. It does not change how the product works for you.

fa1d71d7675faadfb04596afc792de92d05fc1ab.title: Fix free-tier credit overdraw and debt accounting
fa1d71d7675faadfb04596afc792de92d05fc1ab.summary: Added `shouldBlockFreeUserOverdraw` gate and `InsufficientCreditsError` to prevent free-tier users from overdrawing credits. `consumeFromOrderedGrants` no longer repays debt; it only deepens it on overflow, with debt cleared exclusively in `grant-credits.ts` when new credits are added. Changes apply to `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` and `packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts`. The debt model now strictly separates consumption (deepening) from granting (clearing).

23efc014d99ccc747103b54a721bc28a356ce881.title: Upgrade agent models to Opus 4.7
23efc014d99ccc747103b54a721bc28a356ce881.summary: Agent definitions and CLI configurations now default to anthropic/claude-opus-4.7, replacing anthropic/claude-opus-4.6. The ModelName type in agents/types/agent-definition.ts adds 4.7 and 4.5, retaining 4.6 for backward compatibility. Updated files include .agents/*-cli.ts, agents/editor/*, agents/thinker/*, and agents/reviewer/*.

0ff352d7420c8d8f9ffacdaea9e6b4568875c06a.title: Inject model id into base2 system prompt
0ff352d7420c8d8f9ffacdaea9e6b4568875c06a.summary: Extracts model selection into const model in agents/base2/base2.ts and interpolates it into Codebuff Meta-information section. Provides runtime model awareness to agent. Minor refactor for prompt context.

6aa4eb23f3ad33ab5334eb8305474fec2d34772d.title: Fireworks API supports reasoningeffort parameter
6aa4eb23f3ad33ab5334eb8305474fec2d34772d.summary: web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts transforms OpenRouter-style reasoning objects into Fireworks' reasoning_effort field. Default effort is medium; enabled defaults true. Fireworks supports reasoning_effort alongside function tools (GLM-4.5/5.1, Kimi K2).

d3bc905a3237c8ce84de761f6696803e8a40f840.title: GLM 5.1 replaces MiniMax M2.5 in docs
d3bc905a3237c8ce84de761f6696803e8a40f840.summary: Documentation and website content updated to reflect GLM 5.1 as the free model. MiniMax M2.5 references removed from README, SPEC, and web docs. Scope changed from 5-10x to 2-5x speedup in home-client.

8470d9d30ed2c3560e382cce65c03bc155141423.title: query-message-costs.ts script for BigQuery cost investigation
8470d9d30ed2c3560e382cce65c03bc155141423.summary: Added scripts/query-message-costs.ts to query BigQuery `message` table for cost and upstream_inference_cost fields. Investigates potential double-counting in web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts#extractUsageAndCost when OpenRouter populates both fields for non-BYOK requests. Supports --prod, --limit, and --model flags for targeted analysis.

fbb215c3b394bb8f70c501c7bbd24017a8bf0ae4.title: Add kimi k2.5 to Fireworks long test
fbb215c3b394bb8f70c501c7bbd24017a8bf0ae4.summary: Adds `kimi-k2.5` config to `scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts` and maps `moonshotai/kimi-k2.5` to custom deployment `accounts/james-65d217/deployments/mx8l5rq2` in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts`. Enables long-context testing for the model using specific cost metrics and dedicated deployment routing. Scope limited to internal test scripts and web API configuration.

c9a72f15599f448ed43719b0e9b4029bc1776138.title: Fireworks custom deployment enabled 24/7
c9a72f15599f448ed43719b0e9b4029bc1776138.summary: isDeploymentHours in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts now returns true unconditionally, removing the 10am–8pm ET time window check. The function ignores the _now parameter, ensuring custom deployments are always attempted regardless of time. Log messages updated to drop 'business hours' context. Affects Fireworks API request routing in the web package.

c85611b367fb131b85f917fc943799d54363f43d.title: Add dedicated load-skills test coverage
c85611b367fb131b85f917fc943799d54363f43d.summary: Adds `sdk/src/__tests__/load-skills.test.ts` to verify skill discovery logic. Tests cover default root scanning, explicit `skillsPath` overrides, precedence rules (project > global, .agents > .claude), and error handling for malformed or invalid skill definitions. Ensures `loadSkills` correctly filters directories by name constraints and frontmatter validity.

512ebc980642295869b91eb7e8415afe83cb451c.title: Fix Anthropic double-charge bug in OpenRouter cost extraction
512ebc980642295869b91eb7e8415afe83cb451c.summary: Cost extraction now uses `Math.max` instead of summing `usage.cost` and `usage.cost_details.upstream_inference_cost` in `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts`. OpenRouter reports identical billed values in both fields for Anthropic routes, causing double-charging when summed. The fix applies strict type checks to safely handle null or missing cost details across different provider shapes.

8470d9d30ed2c3560e382cce65c03bc155141423.text: The team added a tool to check if the system accidentally charges twice for some messages. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

fa1d71d7675faadfb04596afc792de92d05fc1ab.text: Free users can no longer spend more credits than they have. When you add new credits, your previous debt is cleared.

c9a72f15599f448ed43719b0e9b4029bc1776138.text: The assistant can now use a new model all day and night, instead of only during specific business hours.

512ebc980642295869b91eb7e8415afe83cb451c.text: The system previously counted some AI usage costs twice, inflating the total. This fix ensures charges are calculated correctly, showing accurate spending for the affected services.

0ff352d7420c8d8f9ffacdaea9e6b4568875c06a.text: The assistant now knows which model it is using. This helps it answer questions about itself more accurately.

6aa4eb23f3ad33ab5334eb8305474fec2d34772d.text: The assistant now lets you choose how much effort it puts into thinking through answers. You can pick a level to balance speed with detail.

fbb215c3b394bb8f70c501c7bbd24017a8bf0ae4.text: The assistant can now use a new model. This is an internal update for testing.

23efc014d99ccc747103b54a721bc28a356ce881.text: The assistant now uses a newer, more capable version of its underlying intelligence. This improves its ability to understand and generate text without changing how you interact with it.

d3bc905a3237c8ce84de761f6696803e8a40f840.text: The app now uses a new free model instead of the old one. It remains faster than before, but the speedup is smaller than previously claimed.

c85611b367fb131b85f917fc943799d54363f43d.text: The software now includes extra internal checks to ensure it correctly finds and loads user-defined instructions. This improves reliability by catching errors in how these instructions are organized or prioritized.

bec1d40804df694a6030c2f9900084e5ef5cfdb6.title: Add MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 to Fireworks API
bec1d40804df694a6030c2f9900084e5ef5cfdb6.summary: MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 added to Fireworks API routing in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. New entry maps to accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k2p5 with pricing set to $0.60/M input, $0.10/M cached, $3.00/M output. Scope limited to web package; no CLI or desktop changes.

a334a46deccf5e1caa990d649db6a232f453e1d8.title: Update eval judge models to GPT-5.4 and Sonnet-4.6
a334a46deccf5e1caa990d649db6a232f453e1d8.summary: Judge agents in evals/buffbench/judge.ts switched from openai/gpt-5.1 to openai/gpt-5.4 and anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6. Nightly and main eval runners in evals/buffbench/main-nightly.ts and evals/buffbench/main.ts reduced taskConcurrency from 6 to 5 and 10 to 6 respectively. Changes isolated to internal evaluation infrastructure.

c61e5d17a254cc80aac896edc1a7cb3472e41f83.title: Fix 0039 migration journal tag
c61e5d17a254cc80aac896edc1a7cb3472e41f83.summary: Corrects the migration journal entry for index 39 in `packages/internal/src/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json`. Updates the tag from `0039_bumpy_vertigo` to `0039_quiet_franklin_storm` to match the actual migration file. This internal fix ensures Drizzle's migration runner resolves the correct SQL script during schema synchronization.

13d5f6cb9e9e937400c652728747e50e1f01f2e8.title: Fix MCP tool allowlist filtering in SDK run path
13d5f6cb9e9e937400c652728747e50e1f01f2e8.summary: Corrected MCP tool allowlist filtering in sdk/src/run.ts by replacing `in` operator with `Array.includes()` for `toolNames` check. Previous implementation failed for arrays, causing valid tools to be incorrectly filtered out. Affects SDK run path. Added regression test in sdk/src/__tests__/run-mcp-tool-filter.test.ts.

6a1ef293a535c2af8503668e8839ca95ccd36009.title: Increase buffbench eval concurrency
6a1ef293a535c2af8503668e8839ca95ccd36009.summary: Doubles `taskConcurrency` for `runBuffBench` in eval scripts. Nightly runs `base2-free` at 6 (was 3); standard runs `base2-free-evals` at 10 (was 5). Affects `evals/buffbench/main-nightly.ts` and `evals/buffbench/main.ts` only.

88dfbcfa7ef46bd9d4aeb95446ac0e3ec417e959.title: Add e2e test for context pruning threshold accuracy
88dfbcfa7ef46bd9d4aeb95446ac0e3ec417e959.summary: New e2e test agents/e2e/context-pruning-threshold.e2e.test.ts validates context pruning triggers at correct token limits. Addresses previous bug where local overcounting or 30% buffer caused premature pruning at ~140k instead of 200k. Covers Anthropic models via real API token counting, verifies tool-call/result pair integrity post-pruning, and checks for <conversation_summary> or trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit fallback.

af7ab3c768598a761f5b19519be416fdd9c862e0.title: Context Pruner agent model switched to claude-sonnet-4.6
af7ab3c768598a761f5b19519be416fdd9c862e0.summary: The `context-pruner` agent definition now specifies `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6` as its model, replacing `openai/gpt-5-mini`. This change updates the model used for summarizing and condensing conversation context when limits are exceeded. The modification is contained within `agents/context-pruner.ts`.

b702ab96f9e87defdfd18594f0f494e9d284e1f5.title: Minimax M2.7 replaces M2.5 in free agent models
b702ab96f9e87defdfd18594f0f494e9d284e1f5.summary: Minimax M2.7 replaces M2.5 across Librarian, Tmux CLI, and free-mode agent sets (base2-free, editor-lite, code-reviewer-lite). Upstream upgrade to m2.7. Scope: agents/librarian/librarian.ts, agents/tmux-cli.ts, common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. isFreeModeAllowedAgentModel prefix check now matches m2.7 dated variants.

629c552090515dd8e07488eac27309ca9e6c464a.title: Include tools in token count API for accurate billing
629c552090515dd8e07488eac27309ca9e6c464a.summary: Token counting logic now accepts and processes tool definitions, specifically converting them to Anthropic format for precise input token calculation. The `callTokenCountAPI` and `postTokenCount` endpoints were updated to pass `tools` in the payload, while `run-agent-step.ts` maps internal tool definitions to the expected schema. This change ensures that token usage is accurately reflected when tools are present, primarily affecting Anthropic models, with a 30% buffer applied for non-Anthropic providers like OpenAI and Gemini to account for tokenizer differences. Files modified include `packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/codebuff-web-api.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, and `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts`.

4965185c1a82c6cd29e55d5556c6308ceb2defb6.title: Add minimax m2.7 model support
4965185c1a82c6cd29e55d5556c6308ceb2defb6.summary: Added 'minimax/minimax-m2.7' to ModelName union in agent-definition.ts files. Web layer maps this ID to Fireworks standard API model 'accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m2p7' with pricing set at $0.30/$0.06/$1.20 per million tokens for input/cached/input/output. Scope covers core type definitions, initial agents template, and web fireworks.ts.

6a1ef293a535c2af8503668e8839ca95ccd36009.text: The system now runs more quality checks at once. This makes nightly reports finish faster without changing how the product works.

13d5f6cb9e9e937400c652728747e50e1f01f2e8.text: A bug prevented the assistant from using certain tools. This is now fixed, so those tools work as expected.

a334a46deccf5e1caa990d649db6a232f453e1d8.text: The software now uses newer, smarter tools to check the quality of its own work. This helps the system catch mistakes and improve itself over time. It is a behind-the-scenes update with no direct change to how you use the product.

c61e5d17a254cc80aac896edc1a7cb3472e41f83.text: Fixed an internal label mismatch that could confuse the system's setup process. This small housekeeping update ensures the software correctly identifies its own configuration files.

4965185c1a82c6cd29e55d5556c6308ceb2defb6.text: The assistant can now use a new model. This gives you another option for generating responses.

af7ab3c768598a761f5b19519be416fdd9c862e0.text: The assistant now uses a different tool to shorten long conversations. This helps it keep track of important details without getting confused.

629c552090515dd8e07488eac27309ca9e6c464a.text: The system now counts the instructions for tools when calculating usage, ensuring billing is more accurate when the assistant uses external helpers. This prevents undercharging for complex tasks that involve multiple steps or integrations.

bec1d40804df694a6030c2f9900084e5ef5cfdb6.text: The assistant can now use a new model. This internal update means you might see different responses if you choose this specific option.

88dfbcfa7ef46bd9d4aeb95446ac0e3ec417e959.text: The assistant now keeps more of your conversation history before trimming it. This prevents it from forgetting earlier details too soon, making it more accurate in long chats.

b702ab96f9e87defdfd18594f0f494e9d284e1f5.text: The free AI assistant switched to a newer version of its underlying model. You might see slightly better responses when using free agent features.

ff498d0692371a4a14b0a3e4c3c2d53709ba5968.title: Add optional schema for subagent params
ff498d0692371a4a14b0a3e4c3c2d53709ba5968.summary: Replaces generic record with structured Zod schema for subagent params in spawn-agents.ts. Defines optional fields for command, searchQueries, filePaths, and url to guide model tool calls. Scope limited to common/src/tools/params/tool/spawn-agents.ts. Schema uses .catchall(z.any()) to allow unlisted parameters while enforcing known field types.

f3957c64105e465c713227d0b77cb0f5c42258e3.title: Disable minimax deployment
f3957c64105e465c713227d0b77cb0f5c42258e3.summary: Commented out `minimax/minimax-m2.5` entry in `FIREWORKS_DEPLOYMENT_MAP` within `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts`. This disables the custom Fireworks deployment mapping for the minimax model, likely reverting to default routing or removing support. Scope limited to web LLM API configuration.

a2246d987caf879903aee6cb83886ca00eabef6f.title: Update buffbench single eval agent and task IDs
a2246d987caf879903aee6cb83886ca00eabef6f.summary: Agent ID changed from base2 to base2-free-evals and task ID from filter-system-history to server-agent-validation in evals/buffbench/main-single-eval.ts. This aligns the single eval configuration with the free eval agent suite. Scope limited to internal evaluation harness. No user-facing surface or model picker changes.

a69c4f231456107591e85132186ce0c0b82b31d6.title: Escape on askuser form interrupts assistant stream
a69c4f231456107591e85132186ce0c0b82b31d6.summary: Added `onInterruptStream` prop to `ChatInputBar` and wired it in `Chat`. The `handleFormSkip` function now calls `onInterruptStream()` immediately after `skip()`. This ensures the assistant stream is properly interrupted when the user escapes the `ask_user` form. Files changed: `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`.

326f91bb313f53fb16920855c6c9df7b43c325ce.title: Update Fireworks routing test fixtures
326f91bb313f53fb16920855c6c9df7b43c325ce.summary: Test fixtures in `web/src/llm-api/__tests__/fireworks-deployment.test.ts` switch from `minimax-m2p5` to `glm-5p1`. The `STANDARD_MODEL_ID`, `DEPLOYMENT_MODEL_ID`, and `originalModel` arguments in `createFireworksRequestWithFallback` calls now reference `z-ai/glm-5.1`. This aligns test expectations with current model routing logic.

e001224735a444eeff4190f181c1e8c775d4a0f7.title: Basher agent input schema simplification
e001224735a444eeff4190f181c1e8c775d4a0f7.summary: Basher agent schema in agents/basher.ts replaces top-level prompt and rawOutput with optional what_to_summarize param. LLM summarization now triggers only when what_to_summarize is provided; absent field returns raw output. Spawner prompt updated to reflect new contract. Affects core agent definitions only.

9fcd27ae9517496836efbc7244eb02f0c768bc07.title: Centralize tool error value formatting
9fcd27ae9517496836efbc7244eb02f0c768bc07.summary: Extracted inline JSON stringification and truncation logic into formatValueForError in packages/agent-runtime/src/util/format-value.ts. Updated tool-executor.ts, set-output.ts, and spawn-agent-utils.ts to use the new helper, which adds type annotations for primitive values. Scope limited to agent-runtime tool error surfaces.

18283ca63e9608056a4b7fa4fce9c0b1ebf9ecca.title: base2: codesearch tool replaced by code-searcher agent spawn
18283ca63e9608056a4b7fa4fce9c0b1ebf9ecca.summary: base2 agent drops `code_search` from its tool list, adds `code-searcher` to `spawnableAgents`. System prompt refactored to instruct spawning `code-searcher` agent for refactoring awareness and context gathering. `code-searcher` agent prompt updated to enforce `searchQueries` parameter format with examples.

36f9c1561ecd1d1a70aae3ec3edc914f01cb06d7.title: GLM-5.1 added to free agents and model picker
36f9c1561ecd1d1a70aae3ec3edc914f01cb06d7.summary: GLM-5.1 (`z-ai/glm-5.1`) replaces Minimax-M2.5 as the default model for `base2-free`, `editor-lite`, and `code-reviewer-lite` agents. The update includes new Fireworks pricing configs, deployment mappings, and type definitions for the new model. `MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT` increases from 100 to 200 in `common/src/constants/agents.ts`, affecting CLI run configs.

36c7dac32446692336ec0fed4a7d1471fb6030c8.title: Spawn gemini thinker for complex problems only
36c7dac32446692336ec0fed4a7d1471fb6030c8.summary: The `thinker-with-files-gemini` agent is now spawned only for complex problems, skipping routine edits and clearly-scoped changes. This reduces unnecessary agent overhead while maintaining quality for difficult tasks. The agent's reasoning effort was bumped from 'low' to 'medium' to improve its performance on these complex queries. This change affects the free tier agent orchestration logic in `agents/base2/base2.ts` and the agent definition in `agents/thinker/thinker-with-files-gemini.ts`.

a69c4f231456107591e85132186ce0c0b82b31d6.text: Pressing Escape on a question form now stops the assistant's response immediately.

a2246d987caf879903aee6cb83886ca00eabef6f.text: The internal system that checks the assistant's knowledge was updated to match a new testing group. This change does not affect how the product works or what users see.

9fcd27ae9517496836efbc7244eb02f0c768bc07.text: The assistant now uses a consistent method to display error details. This change is internal and may slightly improve the clarity of failure messages.

e001224735a444eeff4190f181c1e8c775d4a0f7.text: The assistant now checks if you want a summary before writing one. If you do not ask for a summary, it gives you the exact result instead. This is a small internal change.

ff498d0692371a4a14b0a3e4c3c2d53709ba5968.text: The system now checks specific details when the assistant asks for help from other tools. This helps ensure requests are formatted correctly, but allows flexibility for other information.

326f91bb313f53fb16920855c6c9df7b43c325ce.text: Internal tests were updated to match current model routing. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

36f9c1561ecd1d1a70aae3ec3edc914f01cb06d7.text: The assistant now uses a new model for some basic tasks. It can also take more steps to finish complex jobs.

f3957c64105e465c713227d0b77cb0f5c42258e3.text: The system no longer uses a specific connection setting for the MiniMax model. This internal change may cause the model to route through default settings or become unavailable.

18283ca63e9608056a4b7fa4fce9c0b1ebf9ecca.text: The assistant now uses a specialized helper to find code instead of searching directly. This helps it understand your project better when making changes.

36c7dac32446692336ec0fed4a7d1471fb6030c8.text: The assistant now uses a deeper reasoning mode only for complex problems, skipping it for simple tasks. This makes routine requests faster while keeping high quality for difficult ones.

eaeec68115cdea97a0c39abb70b8025492bfe3ee.title: Clarify Basher agent command parameter description
eaeec68115cdea97a0c39abb70b8025492bfe3ee.summary: Updated the `spawnerPrompt` and `command` parameter description in `agents/basher.ts` to explicitly require the command within the params object. This clarifies usage constraints for the LLM. Scope limited to the Basher agent definition.

975b87f312741fc6f9e815ee523b7419b2b2c801.title: Include original values in agent tool validation errors
975b87f312741fc6f9e815ee523b7419b2b2c801.summary: Malformed tool call errors from set-output and spawn-agent-utils now append the original input value. This helps debugging by showing exactly what was passed before truncation. The change is limited to agent-runtime error handling.

b45ead77cf75a4f4f2b4c41184295446e9309386.title: read-files truncates large files at 100k chars
b45ead77cf75a4f4f2b4c41184295446e9309386.summary: read-files now truncates content over 100,000 chars to the first 1,000 chars, replacing the previous 1MB skip logic. Files exceeding 10MB are skipped entirely with an explicit error message. Implemented in sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts.

176eb0acaa9a773eab604411f2203f6f54953f09.title: Enable writetodos for free mode
176eb0acaa9a773eab604411f2203f6f54953f09.summary: write_todos tool is now enabled for free mode in agents/base2/base2.ts. Previously gated by !isFree, it is now only gated by !isFast. System prompt instructions for using write_todos on 3+ step tasks now include isFree in the condition.

284eea82b096e428c4a24de7fcf47410c8529211.title: Refine base2 agent prompts for type casting and file writing
284eea82b096e428c4a24de7fcf47410c8529211.summary: Updated base2 agent system prompts to clarify type casting exceptions and prefer str_replace over write_file for targeted edits. Also adjusted free-tier agent spawning instructions to include separate typecheck tasks for local changes and the whole project. These tweaks aim to improve code quality and efficiency based on recent eval misses.

52a75b23037884cbf555f87530e5442d11f62812.title: Bash agent spawn params requirement
52a75b23037884cbf555f87530e5442d11f62812.summary: Updated basher spawnerPrompt to mandate explicit command params. Prevents validation failures caused by prompt-only spawns. Applies to agents/basher.ts.

cd1e4e16b21b0742472287db1f86af48b6acc6da.title: Add STRIPEUSAGEPRICEID to eval-codebuff.json
cd1e4e16b21b0742472287db1f86af48b6acc6da.summary: Added missing `STRIPE_USAGE_PRICE_ID` env var to `evals/buffbench/eval-codebuff.json`. Fixes incomplete Stripe config in eval harness.

8537ffbb0aa735ab6d711fc652bd11ceb0d076c8.title: read-files truncation limit raised to 100k chars
8537ffbb0aa735ab6d711fc652bd11ceb0d076c8.summary: The `read-files` tool now truncates large files to 100,000 characters instead of 1,000. The `TRUNCATE_TO_CHARS` constant was removed, and `MAX_CHARS` is used directly for slicing and error messaging. This change applies to the SDK's `sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts` implementation. The updated error message reflects the new 100k char limit and directs users to other tools for remaining sections.

dd383810b20d07df3a1cd71f9be94d9fb173512a.title: thinker-with-files-gemini replaces thinker-gemini in free mode
dd383810b20d07df3a1cd71f9be94d9fb173512a.summary: New `thinker-with-files-gemini` agent defined in `agents/thinker/thinker-with-files-gemini.ts`, using `google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview` with `includeMessageHistory: false` and mandatory `filePaths` input. Base2 prompt updated in `agents/base2/base2.ts` to require passing relevant file paths when spawning this agent, replacing `thinker-gemini` references. Registered in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` under `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS`. Agent reads provided files via `read_files` tool before thinking, reducing context cost by excluding conversation history.

72144496dd2dac4bf9da952554b34e69a93783c4.title: Choice ad variant for CLI ads
72144496dd2dac4bf9da952554b34e69a93783c4.summary: CLI ad system now supports a 'choice' variant rendering four ads as selectable cards instead of single banner. `useGravityAd` hook exposes `adData` and `recordImpression`, managing separate caches for banner and choice sets. `ChoiceAdBanner` component added, dynamically sizing columns based on terminal width. Backend API `/v1/ads` implements A/B testing logic, assigning `variant: 'choice'` to 50% of requests. Credit earnings UI removed from `AdBanner` and `UsageBanner`.

72144496dd2dac4bf9da952554b34e69a93783c4.text: The command-line interface now displays four selectable ad cards instead of a single banner for half of users. This change allows users to choose which ad to view, while removing the credit earnings display from the ads.

8537ffbb0aa735ab6d711fc652bd11ceb0d076c8.text: The assistant can now read much larger chunks of text from files at once. This means fewer follow-up requests are needed to review long documents.

52a75b23037884cbf555f87530e5442d11f62812.text: The system now requires a specific command to start background tasks, preventing errors from incomplete requests.

975b87f312741fc6f9e815ee523b7419b2b2c801.text: When the assistant fails to understand a command, the error message now shows the exact text it received. This small internal change helps support teams fix problems faster.

cd1e4e16b21b0742472287db1f86af48b6acc6da.text: A small internal fix corrected a missing billing setting used for automated tests. Users will not notice any change in how the product works.

176eb0acaa9a773eab604411f2203f6f54953f09.text: The assistant now creates step-by-step plans for complex tasks, even for free users.

284eea82b096e428c4a24de7fcf47410c8529211.text: The assistant now follows stricter rules for making small edits and checking for errors. This improves reliability and reduces mistakes in generated results.

dd383810b20d07df3a1cd71f9be94d9fb173512a.text: The free assistant now uses a new thinking mode that looks at specific files you mention instead of re-reading the whole chat history. This helps it answer questions about your files faster and more efficiently.

eaeec68115cdea97a0c39abb70b8025492bfe3ee.text: The assistant's instructions for running commands were clarified. This is a small internal update. You will not notice a change.

b45ead77cf75a4f4f2b4c41184295446e9309386.text: The assistant now shows only the first part of very large text files. It refuses to open files that are too big.

ce142ff1af0292cfac040f7e7cc82402e1424145.title: Update buffbench eval agent to base2-free-evals
ce142ff1af0292cfac040f7e7cc82402e1424145.summary: The `agents` array in `evals/buffbench/main.ts` updated from `base2-free` to `base2-free-evals`. This change targets the specific evaluation configuration for the buffbench suite. Scope limited to the internal eval script.

d6769f7b647e6866397210dda0957bd180ea3b8a.title: Basher spawnerPrompt and command description clarified
d6769f7b647e6866397210dda0957bd180ea3b8a.summary: Basher agent spawnerPrompt now requires both a shell command and a prompt. Command description updated to specify bash shell. Internal agent definition change in agents/basher.ts.

d4f08ddeb63417f96c4ba9c7e30fd80e608b52a8.title: thinker-gemini: low reasoning effort, concise output
d4f08ddeb63417f96c4ba9c7e30fd80e608b52a8.summary: thinker-gemini agent sets reasoningOptions.effort to 'low' and tightens instructionsPrompt to demand concise, non-verbose responses. Change reduces token waste and latency for this sub-agent's thinking step. Scope limited to agents/thinker/thinker-gemini.ts. Old prompt said "Think deeply"; new prompt says "Think about" and "say the absolute minimum needed to answer the user's question correctly."

a64c5cc462ef3da1ed159b2a103a9f8e926e790d.title: Add --save-traces flag to buffbench evals
a64c5cc462ef3da1ed159b2a103a9f8e926e790d.summary: Adds `--save-traces` CLI flag to buffbench eval entrypoints (`main.ts`, `main-nightly.ts`, `main-hard-tasks.ts`, `main-single-eval.ts`). Passes flag to `runBuffBench` which writes agent traces to `logsDir/traces` as JSON files when enabled. Default behavior unchanged; flag required to persist traces.

927f7722099850cff0b359c9f3f7d28be459c95c.title: Base2 agent prompt forces thinker-gemini spawn for free tier
927f7722099850cff0b359c9f3f7d28be459c95c.summary: Updated `agents/base2/base2.ts` to mandate `thinker-gemini` agent spawning for most requests in the free tier, shifting from conditional complex-problem triggers to a default-once-per-request rule. The prompt now explicitly instructs the agent to gather context before spawning the thinker to plan the response, and injects a dedicated step in the implementation flow for free users. This change aims to leverage the model's reasoning capabilities more consistently for free users.

2df5e04d4e070ae1a75a7fb195654b626c771f7a.title: Skill tool loads session-created skills from disk
2df5e04d4e070ae1a75a7fb195654b626c771f7a.summary: Agent runtime `handleSkill` now calls `loadSkillFromDisk` when a skill misses the pre-loaded cache. Scans `~/.agents`, `~/.claude`, and project-local equivalents for `SKILL_FILE_NAME` inside a directory matching the requested name. Validates frontmatter via `SkillFrontmatterSchema` and enforces `frontmatter.name === skillName` before returning the definition. Tool description in `common/src/tools/params/tool/skill.ts` updated to reflect dynamic disk loading.

894a5b618d53a24c2af1bb8db82fb17bb3494dbd.title: Context pruner: strip Tools prefix, add no-imitate summary note
894a5b618d53a24c2af1bb8db82fb17bb3494dbd.summary: Context pruner drops `Tools: ` prefix from tool summaries in compacted history.
