A companion script `scripts/compare-cache-debug.ts` diffs these snapshots to identify prompt cache invalidation sources. Scope limited to agent-runtime internals; no user-facing UI changes.

ccbe035eeed0f877262b54c3ef89eae238bf6c35.title: Add meta skill and session artifacts for console log
ccbe035eeed0f877262b54c3ef89eae238bf6c35.summary: Added `.agents/skills/meta/SKILL.md` with validation heuristics and session artifacts (`LESSONS.md`, `PLAN.md`, `SPEC.md`) for a CLI startup log change. The meta skill codifies patterns like using `bun run --cwd` and checking `git diff` scope. These files document the process of adding `console.log('Codebuff CLI starting')` to `cli/src/index.tsx`.

27d4960d7467b1464a50fcd89fe28c759356e3de.text: The assistant now names its saved conversation folders without colons. This fixes errors that happened when those names confused the computer's storage system.

80dc53ab3110fbd9c09ce2fa2e90453e4013893a.text: The assistant now uses a single, more capable tool to find files when asked to search thoroughly. This replaces an older method that used two smaller tools at once. For you, this means file searches in deep mode are handled by one focused process instead of two split ones.

3c28d5fdb0e7e037023c02e165369fb6828f7d0a.text: The software now uses a different underlying engine for its default AI assistants. This update aims to make responses faster and cheaper to run, without changing how you interact with the tools.

b1957203eeb51dba493a545f238baa672aadde9c.text: The file browsing assistant now uses a faster, newer brain for some tasks. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

b2c27168a27cc9da6a838be38d1b8c7a5b304718.text: The command-line tool now accepts fewer setup options, so you can no longer choose a specific assistant or clear logs from the command line. This only affects users of the free version; the paid version still supports all original settings.

af100a17c0367293ff1f89ad4e992fb09c1eb5fc.text: The system now keeps detailed internal notes about how it remembers conversations, which helps engineers find and fix issues where it forgets things or acts strangely. This change happens behind the scenes and does not affect how you use the product.

a051d6395f9ebd84f1dcfc5c5c1e4fa534ec5b33.text: Internal cleanup improved how source files look to writers. No visible changes or new features for users.

b493ab53110787a9c1cc7a02faf624ed4368a8f9.text: The app now supports several new AI assistants and dropped a few older ones. This gives you more options for the tool to use when helping you.

8a449e81a4a8062056d71cc8c03ee08d19e4520d.text: The software now displays comparison tables correctly. This fixes a visual glitch in the help section, making it easier to read.

ccbe035eeed0f877262b54c3ef89eae238bf6c35.text: The internal tools used to build the product were updated to better record their work steps. This change does not affect how you use the product.

f845d424d49d74b5c3664eeedd402cea4b09bac0.title: Add noLearning flag to base-deep agent
f845d424d49d74b5c3664eeedd402cea4b09bac0.summary: Adds `noLearning` boolean parameter to `buildDeepSystemPrompt` and `buildDeepInstructionsPrompt` in `agents/base2/base-deep.ts`. When true, Phase 7 (Lessons) is omitted from the system prompt example and the instructions prompt dynamically adjusts the workflow phase count to 6. The `base-deep-evals` agent definition in `agents/base2/base-deep-evals.ts` now passes `noLearning: true` alongside `noAskUser`.

69b64047d85d7aa17986b3d7ec47aa1af35ad0f6.title: base-deep agent prompt updates for git safety and skill curation
69b64047d85d7aa17986b3d7ec47aa1af35ad0f6.summary: The base-deep agent prompt now explicitly instructs agents to preserve unrelated changes in the git status/diff, preventing accidental reverts of concurrent user work. Skill contribution guidelines are tightened with a HIGH BAR for non-obvious insights, strictly forbidding task-specific or run-specific details in `.agents/skills/` files. These changes apply to `agents/base2/base-deep.ts`, affecting how the agent handles repository state and long-term knowledge capture.

c29bbc207e8ceede2f0b877aab6a76c01f273323.title: Allow dated OpenRouter variants in free mode model checks
c29bbc207e8ceede2f0b877aab6a76c01f273323.summary: isFreeModeAllowedAgentModel now accepts dated model variants (e.g., minimax/minimax-m2.5-20260211) in addition to exact matches. The check iterates allowedModels to verify if the returned model string starts with an allowed base name followed by a hyphen. This change affects the core free-agents.ts constant file. It prevents false negatives when OpenRouter returns versioned model identifiers.

618a31581235d86e760779180eee8b476b7662e9.title: Consolidate deep agent workflow into 7 phases
618a31581235d86e760779180eee8b476b7662e9.summary: Reduced the `base-deep` agent workflow from 8 to 7 phases by merging the standalone Deep Dive into the Spec phase. The new Phase 2 requires drafting a `SPEC.md` before iterative `ask_user` refinement, followed by a `thinker-codex` critique loop. Added explicit two-phase todo tracking: planning todos (Phases 1-3) written at start, replaced by implementation todos after Phase 3. Updates `agents/base2/base-deep.ts` prompts, system instructions, and step reminders to reflect the condensed sequence.

5a57b7b0e3a433e54369592a9387bc0786aba473.title: base-deep-evals agent added for BuffBench
5a57b7b0e3a433e54369592a9387bc0786aba473.summary: New `base-deep-evals` agent definition created in `agents/base2/base-deep-evals.ts`. This variant uses `createBaseDeep({ noAskUser: true })` to disable the `ask_user` tool and related system prompt instructions. `evals/buffbench/main.ts` updated to run `base-deep-evals` instead of `base-deep`.

59d88d23d299030c7f9dc5af8cb47c79c3e98c26.title: base-deep agent adopts 8-phase iterative workflow
59d88d23d299030c7f9dc5af8cb47c79c3e98c26.summary: agents/base2/base-deep.ts replaces loose orchestration instructions with a strict 8-phase workflow: Context, Deep Dive, Spec, Plan, Implement, Review, Validate, Lessons. Each phase enforces iterative critique loops using thinker-codex and code-reviewer-codex until no new issues arise. Implementation tasks now require writing SPEC.md, PLAN.md, and LESSONS.md to .agents/sessions/, updating .agents/skills/ with learnings.

de5a6d9cdd7d30b6066ea2b967cd176051dab988.title: Disable OpenAI token counting in token-count API
de5a6d9cdd7d30b6066ea2b967cd176051dab988.summary: The `useOpenAI` flag in `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts` is hardcoded to `false`, bypassing `isOpenAIProviderModel`. This forces all token count requests to use `countTokensViaAnthropic` regardless of the model. The OpenAI import was removed as it is no longer used.

f9bfec097638416ef3d1757b7fea3c83ed61b8d2.title: Disable Claude OAuth via feature flag
f9bfec097638416ef3d1757b7fea3c83ed61b8d2.summary: Added CLAUDE_OAUTH_ENABLED=false in common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts to disable Claude OAuth functionality. This flag gates the /connect:claude command, OAuth banners, usage display, background credential refresh, and SDK direct Anthropic API routing. When disabled, /connect:claude shows a system message directing users to /subscribe.

df5a04df20ca02720f3f986a88c04de9b2043965.title: Hide ads for CLI subscribers
df5a04df20ca02720f3f986a88c04de9b2043965.summary: CLI now gates Gravity ads and slash commands for users with active subscriptions. `useGravityAd` accepts an `enabled` flag, while `chat.tsx` and `help-banner.tsx` use `useSubscriptionQuery` to determine visibility. Subscribers see no `/ads:enable` or `/ads:disable` prompts, and the help banner omits ad-related shortcuts.

51ae862692a8812e3a488c2e99e7ff465cf51f52.title: Add OpenAI token counting to web API
51ae862692a8812e3a488c2e99e7ff465cf51f52.summary: Implemented `countTokensViaOpenAI` in `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts` to handle token counting for OpenAI models via the Responses API. The logic detects OpenAI providers using `isOpenAIProviderModel`, converts message formats to Responses API input structures, and calls `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses/input_tokens`. Anthropic counting remains the default for non-OpenAI models. Scope is limited to the web API endpoint.

f845d424d49d74b5c3664eeedd402cea4b09bac0.text: The assistant can now skip its 'lessons' step. This makes its process shorter and more direct.

69b64047d85d7aa17986b3d7ec47aa1af35ad0f6.text: The assistant now protects your work by ensuring it does not accidentally delete or revert unrelated changes you made elsewhere. It also stops saving overly specific or temporary notes, keeping its long-term knowledge cleaner and more useful.

c29bbc207e8ceede2f0b877aab6a76c01f273323.text: The assistant now recognizes newer versions of some free models correctly. This prevents it from accidentally blocking access when a model name changes slightly.

5a57b7b0e3a433e54369592a9387bc0786aba473.text: A new internal version of the assistant was added for testing. This version cannot ask you questions, so it must finish tasks using only what you already provided.

51ae862692a8812e3a488c2e99e7ff465cf51f52.text: The assistant can now measure the length of OpenAI messages correctly. This improves accuracy for users interacting with those models.

59d88d23d299030c7f9dc5af8cb47c79c3e98c26.text: The assistant now follows a strict eight-step routine, checking its work repeatedly before finishing. This internal change helps it catch mistakes and learn from them, so it gives you more reliable answers.

f9bfec097638416ef3d1757b7fea3c83ed61b8d2.text: The app now blocks the old sign-in method for this assistant. If you try to use it, you will see a message telling you to subscribe instead.

618a31581235d86e760779180eee8b476b7662e9.text: The assistant now follows a shorter, simpler plan. It will ask you to review a draft before starting the main work.

df5a04df20ca02720f3f986a88c04de9b2043965.text: Paid users no longer see ads or ad-related options in the command line. Free users still see them.

de5a6d9cdd7d30b6066ea2b967cd176051dab988.text: Token counting now always uses Anthropic's method, regardless of which model you pick. This internal change ensures consistent calculation for usage limits.

7612d494f6ba94f0641abf30410adbc21a3ffb86.title: load-agents skips skills directory during recursive agent scan
7612d494f6ba94f0641abf30410adbc21a3ffb86.summary: load-agents.ts adds a guard to skip directories named 'skills' during recursive agent file discovery. This prevents agent loading logic from scanning skill-specific files, isolating agent definitions from skill implementations. Scope limited to sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts.

b5cf55edd5737f8dc858fbf424f8ee885aeb06cc.title: Switch buffbench eval agent from base2-free to base-deep
b5cf55edd5737f8dc858fbf424f8ee885aeb06cc.summary: Eval runner in evals/buffbench/main.ts now targets 'base-deep' instead of 'base2-free'. Change aligns benchmark execution with deep agent variant. Scope limited to Evals subsystem.

be3c2a3d639710f50d2f6daa7573320d02e85ebd.title: Add credits per dollar tooltip to pricing tiers
be3c2a3d639710f50d2f6daa7573320d02e85ebd.summary: Added a `HelpCircle` tooltip to `pricing-client.tsx` displaying calculated credits per dollar for each subscription tier. The `CREDITS_PER_DOLLAR` constant derives values from `SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS` using a fixed `WEEKS_PER_MONTH` multiplier. Users see exact value metrics on hover in the Web pricing UI.

b7dfc25889af3fcaf6ff17147ea8d5987d252cc4.title: Reorder completions credit check after subscription grant logic
b7dfc25889af3fcaf6ff17147ea8d5987d252cc4.summary: In web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts, the credit check moved after ensureSubscriberBlockGrant. Previously, totalRemaining <= 0 triggered a 402 before subscription block grant validation, incorrectly blocking subscribers whose subscription credits are excluded from totalRemaining. The fix introduces subscriberHasAvailableCredits, set true when a block grant succeeds or on fail-open errors, allowing subscribers to bypass the a-la-carte credit check. Covers the completions API endpoint and its tests.

51bf4282d902f44d797956ef786b85d02e9ec640.title: Discord bot clarifies GitHub primary email requirement
51bf4282d902f44d797956ef786b85d02e9ec640.summary: Discord bot commands and error messages updated to specify the primary email for the GitHub account used for Codebuff. The `register-commands.ts` option description and `client.ts` reply content now reference the GitHub primary email and include a link to the profile settings. This change affects the Discord integration surface within the web package. The `env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` is used to construct the direct link to `/profile?tab=account` for user guidance.

9552ba579472f17797bf9350982444258e7618b4.title: SDK 0.10.7 adds applypatch tool and simplifies writefile
9552ba579472f17797bf9350982444258e7618b4.summary: SDK 0.10.7 introduces `apply_patch` for Codex-compatible code editing and refactors `write_file` into a deterministic create/replace tool. `write_file` no longer supports edit snippet comments like `// ... rest of the function ...`, requiring `str_replace` or `apply_patch` for partial updates. This change applies to the `@codebuff/sdk` package.

14fbb52ffa1149b49cf9293371cc5531ee08dae9.title: Add confirmation dialog to auto top-up
14fbb52ffa1149b49cf9293371cc5531ee08dae9.summary: Auto top-up settings now display a confirmation dialog when enabling the feature with a current balance below the configured threshold. This prevents accidental immediate charges by requiring explicit user consent. The change updates the `useAutoTopup` hook to fetch the live balance and modifies `AutoTopupSettings.tsx` to render the new `ConfirmationDialog`. Additionally, the default and maximum threshold constants were adjusted in `constants.ts`.

d778cfd31d9a38a9c36c52ffd6afc76e8644e817.title: Add applypatch tool, Codex agents, thinking UI tweak
d778cfd31d9a38a9c36c52ffd6afc76e8644e817.summary: Added `apply_patch` tool for file operations (create, update, delete) using Codex-style diff format across SDK, agent runtime, and CLI. New `thinker-codex` and `code-reviewer-codex` agents use `openai/gpt-5.3-codex`. CLI thinking component now suppresses rendering for short single-bold messages. `base-deep` agent added with orchestration prompts.

6d01d07189ca915f61757a74da8eed6e431c8dc4.title: Increase subscription credits for tier 100 and 500
6d01d07189ca915f61757a74da8eed6e431c8dc4.summary: Tier 100 creditsPerBlock increased from 350 to 420, and weeklyCreditsLimit from 3500 to 4200. Tier 500 creditsPerBlock increased from 2800 to 2940, with weeklyCreditsLimit raised to 29400. Changes applied to common/src/constants/subscription-plans.ts. Web pricing display updated in web/src/app/pricing/pricing-client.tsx to reflect adjusted usage multipliers.

f67ecd430e3766470583662754da873a9c14dedd.title: Include subscription credits in API balance checks
f67ecd430e3766470583662754da873a9c14dedd.summary: Web endpoints now include subscription credits in balance calculations when `ensureSubscriberBlockGrant` is provided. `calculateUsageAndBalance` accepts an `includeSubscriptionCredits` flag to bypass the `isPersonalContext` exclusion for subscription grants. This ensures newly created block grants are immediately visible to the credit gating logic in `checkCreditsAndCharge` and `postChatCompletions`. Covers `web/src/app/api/v1` and `packages/billing`.

d778cfd31d9a38a9c36c52ffd6afc76e8644e817.text: The assistant can now edit files and use new specialized models for complex tasks. A small visual update hides brief thinking messages to keep the screen cleaner.

be3c2a3d639710f50d2f6daa7573320d02e85ebd.text: A small update to the pricing page now shows exactly how many credits you get for each dollar spent when you hover over a plan. This helps you compare the real value of different subscription options before choosing one.

7612d494f6ba94f0641abf30410adbc21a3ffb86.text: The assistant now ignores a specific folder when searching for new capabilities. This prevents conflicts and keeps the system stable.

f67ecd430e3766470583662754da873a9c14dedd.text: The system now counts subscription credits when checking if you have enough balance to use the service. This means newly added credits are available for use immediately.

14fbb52ffa1149b49cf9293371cc5531ee08dae9.text: Turning on auto top-up now asks for confirmation if your balance is low. This prevents unexpected charges.

6d01d07189ca915f61757a74da8eed6e431c8dc4.text: Two subscription tiers now include more monthly usage credits. The pricing page shows the new credit amounts.

b7dfc25889af3fcaf6ff17147ea8d5987d252cc4.text: Subscribers who ran out of extra credits can now use their subscription allowance instead of being blocked. This fixes an error where the system checked the wrong balance first.

51bf4282d902f44d797956ef786b85d02e9ec640.text: The chat assistant now reminds users to provide their main email address when signing up for the coding service. This update aims to reduce confusion by directing people to the correct account settings page.

9552ba579472f17797bf9350982444258e7618b4.text: The assistant gained a new method for making small, targeted edits to your work. The tool used for saving files now only handles complete rewrites, so partial updates require the new method.

b5cf55edd5737f8dc858fbf424f8ee885aeb06cc.text: The system now uses a more thorough checking method for its internal tests. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

b0b535caa6390e9423727516bdb009508dc9998d.title: Add Account tab to web profile page
b0b535caa6390e9423727516bdb009508dc9998d.summary: New `AccountSection` component added to `web/src/app/profile/components/`. It displays the user's email and verification status via `useSession`. The profile page sidebar now includes an 'Account' tab linking to this section.

a8dd0f4d5f2ccf7eee5a455bf172127031d8d815.title: Move analytics init before agent registry in CLI
a8dd0f4d5f2ccf7eee5a455bf172127031d8d815.summary: Relocates `initAnalytics()` and `trackEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APP_LAUNCHED)` to run before agent registry initialization in `cli/src/index.tsx`. Prevents `trackEvent` throws from logger calls occurring during registry load. Internal timing fix in CLI startup sequence.

427e35f32dd64d15a118db9ac88cf4c93b973d84.title: Fix broken markdown tables in what-models.mdx
427e35f32dd64d15a118db9ac88cf4c93b973d84.summary: Reformatted malformed markdown tables in `web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx`. Corrected line breaks and alignment syntax for the Main Agent and Subagents sections to ensure proper rendering. This is a documentation-only fix with no functional code changes.

e96fc5bc74a277a2c963ca27c994de467656eca8.title: Fix types in e2e mocks
e96fc5bc74a277a2c963ca27c994de467656eca8.summary: e2e-mocks.ts wraps promptAiSdkStreamMock return value in promptSuccess. getUserInfoFromApiKey mock cast switched to unknown to satisfy type checker. Internal test utility adjustment.

e9cbb031f37a29a3ff75673f8aed0545c75a2d3d.title: Fix CONTRIBUTING.md and knowledge.md dev instructions
e9cbb031f37a29a3ff75673f8aed0545c75a2d3d.summary: Updated CONTRIBUTING.md and knowledge.md to remove the incorrect claim that `bun dev` runs both web and CLI. Clarified that `bun up` starts services, requiring separate execution of `bun start-cli` for the CLI. This aligns documentation with actual command behavior, removing Option A/B distinction in favor of explicit terminal steps.

1226e08dc65010d303b274d2578e471923d4fead.title: Troubleshooting docs restructure: add install and cache sections,
1226e08dc65010d303b274d2578e471923d4fead.summary: Restructured `web/src/content/advanced/troubleshooting.mdx` to improve clarity. Added 'Install Node' and 'Delete local cache' sections to guide users to `~/.config/manicode`. Removed 'Codebuff not updating' and 'Connection Issues' sections, eliminating outdated `npm cache clean` instructions and specific websocket timeout error examples.

f6607057b83163683840f5ef1f061a905fa77537.title: Trim quick-start docs
f6607057b83163683840f5ef1f061a905fa77537.summary: Slimmed `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx` to reduce verbosity. Removed detailed `/init` artifact explanations and verbose permission troubleshooting steps, replacing them with concise links to modes and troubleshooting docs.

44db78128e3e40441b4b7945e3b1349455870f37.title: Add OpenRouter mapping for Claude Sonnet 4.6
44db78128e3e40441b4b7945e3b1349455870f37.summary: Adds mapping for 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6' to 'claude-sonnet-4-6' in OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP. Ensures OpenRouter requests for Sonnet 4.6 resolve to the correct Anthropic model identifier. Change confined to common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts.

3f6de551d04a9dc45132e68878ef980ba0956514.title: Fix modes table formatting in docs
3f6de551d04a9dc45132e68878ef980ba0956514.summary: Corrected the MarkdownTable syntax in `web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx`. Previous malformed row separators caused rendering issues. Scope limited to documentation.

3f6de551d04a9dc45132e68878ef980ba0956514.text: A small internal fix corrected formatting in the help guides. The guides now display tables clearly, so users can read the information without confusing layout errors.

b0b535caa6390e9423727516bdb009508dc9998d.text: Your profile page now has a new 'Account' tab. It shows your email address and whether your account is verified.

427e35f32dd64d15a118db9ac88cf4c93b973d84.text: A formatting error made some comparison charts look messy. The pages now display clearly. This change fixes only the text layout.

a8dd0f4d5f2ccf7eee5a455bf172127031d8d815.text: The app now records its launch time before loading other features. This prevents rare startup errors from blocking the launch log.

1226e08dc65010d303b274d2578e471923d4fead.text: The troubleshooting guide was updated to make it easier to find help for installation and cache issues. Outdated advice about connection problems and cache clearing was removed to reduce confusion.

f6607057b83163683840f5ef1f061a905fa77537.text: The quick-start guide was shortened to remove repetitive details. Troubleshooting steps and setup explanations now link to separate, more detailed help pages instead of cluttering the main guide.

e96fc5bc74a277a2c963ca27c994de467656eca8.text: A small internal fix adjusted how the system checks its own test data to ensure it matches expected formats. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

44db78128e3e40441b4b7945e3b1349455870f37.text: A small internal update ensures the assistant correctly uses a specific new model version when accessed through a third-party service. This change does not affect how you interact with the product.

e9cbb031f37a29a3ff75673f8aed0545c75a2d3d.text: The instructions for starting the tool were corrected to show that two separate steps are needed, not one combined command. This internal fix ensures guides match how the software actually works, with no change to the user experience.

419ea9ea24a0d76f129ce34c00b3aed76f41a31d.title: Set Gravity API ad relevancy to 0.3
419ea9ea24a0d76f129ce34c00b3aed76f41a31d.summary: Added `relevancy: 0.3` to the payload sent to the Gravity API in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`. This adjusts the targeting parameters for ad placements. The change is internal to the web API handler.

aa83b05ff418e46a4c508ce209da88b43707f964.title: Refactor prompt cache tests to use real API and git status checks
aa83b05ff418e46a4c508ce209da88b43707f964.summary: Replaced mocked prompt cache tests with real integration tests using CodebuffClient and API key. Added test case verifying cache validity despite git status changes between requests. Requires CODEBUFF_API_KEY environment variable; skips gracefully if missing.

da1d2ed9b21ba5bec138c63a84309afdb4788751.title: SDK 0.10.6 adds skillsDir parameter
da1d2ed9b21ba5bec138c63a84309afdb4788751.summary: SDK 0.10.6 introduces `skillsDir` parameter for custom skill directory loading. Mechanism: allows explicit path specification for skill discovery. Scope: `@codebuff/sdk` package, `sdk/CHANGELOG.md`. Detail: New parameter added to SDK configuration options.

aed5699db1345178ed99d031a97a57570430aef9.title: Bold ad CTA and clickable domain in CLI banner
aed5699db1345178ed99d031a97a57570430aef9.summary: AdBanner CTA text now renders bold via `TextAttributes.BOLD` and domain text becomes an interactive `Button` with underline styling. This increases visual prominence and expands the click target for the ad link in the CLI. Scoped to `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx`. Domain click behavior now mirrors CTA hover states and actions.

538f982782ec25624e12fdefff87c429cb96878f.title: Claude Code comparison table UI improved
538f982782ec25624e12fdefff87c429cb96878f.summary: Claude Code and Codebuff Comparison Table UI Improved (#439). `web/src/content/advanced/claude-code-comparison.mdx` updated. No action required.

310f353fe60e9f05e5292fb22dfd1de8c46f6a0d.title: Pricing hero tooltip clarifies mode and limit scope
310f353fe60e9f05e5292fb22dfd1de8c46f6a0d.summary: Pricing hero copy updated to 'Subscribe to use all modes with higher usage limits' with a HelpCircle tooltip explaining 'Includes 5-hour sessions with weekly limits'. Hero container padding shifted from py-8 to pb-12 for layout balance. Tooltip components imported from @/components/ui/tooltip. Scope limited to web/src/app/pricing/pricing-client.tsx.

b8dbc9e372c1024fe2544204afa2f653d2a22de5.title: Enforce deterministic writefile content
b8dbc9e372c1024fe2544204afa2f653d2a22de5.summary: write_file now requires complete file content, removing edit snippet support. Placeholder comment logic and fastRewrite dependencies deleted from common/src/util/string.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/fast-rewrite.ts. Scope covers agent types, editor prompts, and tool params in common/src/tools/params/tool/write-file.ts. Models must output full files; lazy edits like '// ... existing code ...' are no longer parsed.

fd7905763cf8536b21c1d3a990e97cecf58524bb.title: Add Build FREE button to CLI plan mode
fd7905763cf8536b21c1d3a990e97cecf58524bb.summary: Added 'Build FREE' button to CLI plan mode interface. Propagated `onBuildFree` callback through `chat.tsx`, `use-chat-input.ts`, and component tree (`blocks`, `message-block`, `plan-box`). User can now trigger free build actions directly from rendered plan blocks.

7ea760f09b36d71fd3d7861962cbeb1c146a871e.title: Add script to analyze subscriber profitability
7ea760f09b36d71fd3d7861962cbeb1c146a871e.summary: New internal script scripts/analyze-subscriber-profitability.ts computes projected profit per subscription tier. Queries active subscriptions and credit_ledger usage, normalizing to weekly/monthly rates using PROFIT_MARGIN and SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS. Excludes hardcoded internal emails. Outputs tier summaries, per-subscriber breakdowns, and overall net profit to console.

47f88beeaab13c5bfff7e652691a9abbe32dea5b.title: Add skillsDir parameter to SDK client and run state
47f88beeaab13c5bfff7e652691a9abbe32dea5b.summary: Introduced `skillsDir` parameter in `CodebuffClientOptions` and `InitialSessionStateOptions`. This allows custom skill loading paths to override default locations in `sdk/src/client.ts` and `sdk/src/run-state.ts`. The change propagates through `run.ts` and `index.ts` to support isolated skill directories.

aed5699db1345178ed99d031a97a57570430aef9.text: The ad's action button now appears in bold text, and the website address is clickable. This makes the ad easier to notice and gives you more room to click.

7ea760f09b36d71fd3d7861962cbeb1c146a871e.text: The team added an internal tool to estimate subscription profitability. This change does not affect product features.

fd7905763cf8536b21c1d3a990e97cecf58524bb.text: A new 'Build FREE' button now appears in the plan mode interface. Users can click it to trigger free build actions directly from the displayed plan.

b8dbc9e372c1024fe2544204afa2f653d2a22de5.text: The assistant now always writes a full file instead of just a small update. This means it will never leave out parts of a file by mistake.

da1d2ed9b21ba5bec138c63a84309afdb4788751.text: The assistant can now look for extra skills in a specific folder you choose. This lets you keep your custom tools in a place that makes sense for you.

419ea9ea24a0d76f129ce34c00b3aed76f41a31d.text: The system now sets a specific value to decide how closely ads match your interests. You might see slightly different ads than before.

47f88beeaab13c5bfff7e652691a9abbe32dea5b.text: Users can now choose a custom folder for the assistant's special features. This allows you to keep different sets of skills separate from each other.

538f982782ec25624e12fdefff87c429cb96878f.text: The layout for comparing two AI coding assistants was updated. This small internal change makes the information easier to read.

aa83b05ff418e46a4c508ce209da88b43707f964.text: The team updated internal checks to confirm the assistant works correctly with live data. This improves reliability without changing how the product looks or feels.

310f353fe60e9f05e5292fb22dfd1de8c46f6a0d.text: The pricing page now clearly explains that subscribing unlocks all modes and higher usage limits. A new help icon provides details about session and weekly limits.

f538e7ffabb6b0c2bbcc1649706f8cd9f40de76f.title: Remove Ctrl+U debug logging from multiline input
f538e7ffabb6b0c2bbcc1649706f8cd9f40de76f.summary: Deleted `logger.debug` call and unused import in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. The logging statement tracked cursor position and line start calculations during Ctrl+U keypresses. This cleanup reduces noise in the CLI debug output without altering input handling logic.

841150ec209cce82f55caeade2a4544338a9d2e8.title: Pass costMode through subagent context
841150ec209cce82f55caeade2a4544338a9d2e8.summary: Added optional `costMode` string to `SubagentContextParams` and passed it through in `extractSubagentContextParams` in `spawn-agent-utils.ts`. Ensures subagents inherit the correct cost mode from the parent session context. Internal type and logic change in agent-runtime package.

b222355616dbb009a330d53057729aac8becf671.title: commander-lite model swap to grok-4.1-fast
b222355616dbb009a330d53057729aac8becf671.summary: commander-lite agent model set updated from minimax/minimax-m2.5 to x-ai/grok-4.1-fast in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. Ensures free mode command execution matches correct model routing. Scope limited to shared core constants affecting free agent configuration.

13a411578d705e06f6f7487537f54e60bfa13d8f.title: Docs update Free mode model to MiniMax M2.5
13a411578d705e06f6f7487537f54e60bfa13d8f.summary: Documentation updates reflect Free mode switching from Grok 4.1 Fast to MiniMax M2.5. The Reviewer agent now lists MiniMax M2.5 for Free mode, and FAQ/advanced docs confirm this model handles Free mode editing and code review. Changes affect web/src/content/advanced/how-does-it-work.mdx, web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx, and web/src/content/help/faq.mdx.

f9f48ae256fd817de10158a33d10bb536eb71ae0.title: buffbench eval targets base2-free agent
f9f48ae256fd817de10158a33d10bb536eb71ae0.summary: evals/buffbench/main.ts agents list switches base2 to base2-free. Buffbench now scores the base2-free agent surface. Internal eval harness change only.

34d768eb96e9cdc03772e4e2dfed5c9d7c4525d0.title: Fix CLI agent and message conversion tests
34d768eb96e9cdc03772e4e2dfed5c9d7c4525d0.summary: Updated `local-agents.test.ts` and `messages.test.ts` to align with current implementation behavior. Agent registry tests now account for bundled agents appearing when no local directory exists, checking for absence of test-prefixed agents instead of null returns. Message conversion test expects empty string output for empty tool results instead of placeholder text.

4b8bba75d06e4e6391c44a38228dc22ee1ca4609.title: Free tier drops editor-lite, adds code-reviewer-lite
4b8bba75d06e4e6391c44a38228dc22ee1ca4609.summary: Base2 free tier no longer spawns editor-lite; instead, the main agent implements changes directly via str_replace/write_file and spawns code-reviewer-lite. code-reviewer-lite is a new agent definition using minimax/minimax-m2.5. editor-lite model switched from glm to minimax, and editor.ts updated to accept 'minimax' instead of 'glm'.

ba531540bdad0bb161148debb50a9b23aa6e1bce.title: Handle empty tool result content in convertToolResultMessage
ba531540bdad0bb161148debb50a9b23aa6e1bce.summary: Added guard in `convertToolResultMessage` to handle empty `content` arrays by returning a single `tool-result` with empty JSON output. Prevents errors when processing tool messages with no content parts. Scope limited to `common/src/util/messages.ts`.

11c57cc42a98cd1125768aad0b0baed8e947a8a4.title: Rename editor-glm to editor-lite and update to MiniMax M2.5
11c57cc42a98cd1125768aad0b0baed8e947a8a4.summary: Renamed `editor-glm` to `editor-lite` and switched underlying models to `minimax/minimax-m2.5`. Updated `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` to map `editor-lite`, `base2-free`, and `commander-lite` to MiniMax M2.5. Modified `agents/base2/base2.ts` prompts and `agents/editor/editor.ts` logic to reflect the new agent ID and model choice. Adjusted `web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx` to display MiniMax M2.5 in the Free mode documentation.

6fc9d8c2bd75caf2584a33cc37e65e5eac947afc.title: code-reviewer-lite added to free agents
6fc9d8c2bd75caf2584a33cc37e65e5eac947afc.summary: Added `code-reviewer-lite` entry to `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Maps the new agent to `minimax/minimax-m2.5`. Provides free access to code review functionality.

841150ec209cce82f55caeade2a4544338a9d2e8.text: Small internal fix. Assistant's helper tasks now correctly follow the cost settings set by the main session.

f9f48ae256fd817de10158a33d10bb536eb71ae0.text: Internal testing tools now check a different version of the assistant. This change affects only how the team measures performance and does not change what you see or do in the product.

b222355616dbb009a330d53057729aac8becf671.text: The assistant switched to a new, faster brain for basic tasks. This change is internal and keeps free mode working correctly.

4b8bba75d06e4e6391c44a38228dc22ee1ca4609.text: The free plan now uses a different tool to check its own work, replacing an older editing assistant with a new reviewer. This change is small and internal, meaning you might notice slightly different results when the software fixes code, but the overall way you use it stays the same.

34d768eb96e9cdc03772e4e2dfed5c9d7c4525d0.text: Developers updated internal tests to match how the software currently behaves. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ba531540bdad0bb161148debb50a9b23aa6e1bce.text: The assistant now handles empty tool results gracefully, preventing errors when it receives no data from a background service.

6fc9d8c2bd75caf2584a33cc37e65e5eac947afc.text: A new assistant for checking code is now available for free. Users can ask it to review their work without paying.

11c57cc42a98cd1125768aad0b0baed8e947a8a4.text: The free writing assistant now uses a new underlying AI model and has a shorter name. This change is small and internal, so the way you use the feature stays exactly the same.

f538e7ffabb6b0c2bbcc1649706f8cd9f40de76f.text: Removed hidden debug logging for a text shortcut. This makes the system's internal output cleaner. You will not see any changes in how the text editor works.

13a411578d705e06f6f7487537f54e60bfa13d8f.text: The free version of the product now uses a different AI model. This means the assistant will think and answer using this new model when you use the free mode.

89baebf19ff27d4b885163ad349612a1c08d45b8.title: Add systeminformation dependency to CLI
89baebf19ff27d4b885163ad349612a1c08d45b8.summary: Added systeminformation ^5.30.7 to cli/package.json dependencies. Enables OS and hardware metric collection within the CLI runtime. Scope limited to the CLI package manifest.

1ad32d436b2433106ba0549bb663d2de61920e5e.title: Fix Bedrock assistant prefill error in CLI agents
1ad32d436b2433106ba0549bb663d2de61920e5e.summary: CLI agent definitions now send prefill context as user messages instead of assistant messages to resolve Bedrock API errors. The `create-cli-agent` helper explicitly excludes Amazon Bedrock from provider options. This change affects `claude-code-cli`, `codebuff-local-cli`, `codex-cli`, and `gemini-cli` definitions.

e2d1e227bce8efc8b39a011a6d32040293be0f62.title: Continue turn when agent emits only think tags
e2d1e227bce8efc8b39a011a6d32040293be0f62.summary: Added logic in `run-agent-step.ts` to detect responses containing only `<think>` tags and no other content. If such a response is received without tool calls, the agent now continues the turn instead of ending it. This prevents premature termination when the model outputs only internal reasoning. The change applies to the core agent runtime loop.

0e8d8adcfb2f995375dc80ebd5c80821864e4c67.title: CLI suggestion menu uses per-item same-line layout check
0e8d8adcfb2f995375dc80ebd5c80821864e4c67.summary: SuggestionMenu now checks if each item's description fits on the same line individually, replacing the previous all-or-nothing menu-wide check. This change calculates available width by subtracting button padding and compares it against maxLabelLength plus item description length. Affects cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx. Mixed-length items no longer force two-line layout for all items if one is too long.

74e25483f7660125e88f066816429ecb881fe44b.title: Skill tool prompt forbids phantom skills
74e25483f7660125e88f066816429ecb881fe44b.summary: Skill tool description and empty-state handling in `common/src/tools/params/tool/skill.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts` now explicitly instruct the model not to call unavailable skills. Previously, the `AVAILABLE_SKILLS_PLACEHOLDER` was silently removed when no skills were registered, allowing the model to hallucinate tool calls for non-existent skills. The update replaces the placeholder with 'There are no skills available. Do not use this tool because there are no skills to load.' and adds a guard clause to the base description. Also removed hardcoded agent name 'Buffy' from tool list header.

f4dbe3107e8cdb6cabb4ccfbf949ec634a6dae67.title: Claude subscription deprecation notice
f4dbe3107e8cdb6cabb4ccfbf949ec634a6dae67.summary: CLI banners and slash command labels now display deprecation warnings for Claude subscription support. FAQ updated with removal date and ban reports. Scope: `claude-connect-banner.tsx`, `slash-commands.ts`, `faq.mdx`. Migration path: `/subscribe` to Codebuff Strong.

ee3e0e3cc6e745ab5ceac079827315797956eb65.title: Update docs to Claude Opus 4.6
ee3e0e3cc6e745ab5ceac079827315797956eb65.summary: Documentation updates replace references to Claude Opus 4.5 with Claude Opus 4.6 across multiple pages. The changes affect the FAQ, model breakdown, and mode comparison tables to align with the new orchestrator and subagent models. Additionally, markdown table formatting is adjusted for consistency.

d6911b070e2fca4b06bb4d6446002f80b0901b5a.title: Fix abort handling in agent-runtime and SDK run
d6911b070e2fca4b06bb4d6446002f80b0901b5a.summary: Agent-runtime stream parsers now wrap consumption loops in try/finally blocks to ensure buffered text is flushed and message history is updated even when an AbortError is thrown mid-stream. The SDK's run.ts removes manual pending response tracking and cancellation context injection, relying on the runtime's robust finalization instead. Scope includes packages/agent-runtime (run-agent-step, tool-stream-parser, tools/stream-parser) and sdk/src/run.ts. This prevents loss of streamed content during user-initiated cancellations.

3a503134b62fc72842fc81e9118775ecfc141c6c.title: Revert CLI suggestion menu layout tweak
3a503134b62fc72842fc81e9118775ecfc141c6c.summary: Reverts `cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx` layout tweak. Restores per-item `itemFitsOnSameLine` check using `availableWidth` instead of global `useSameLine` based on `maxDescriptionLength`. Fixes alignment issues in CLI suggestion menu.

e561badadd00e446d412965c34523fc16b410a35.title: CLI feedback submits to new /api/v1/feedback endpoint
e561badadd00e446d412965c34523fc16b410a35.summary: CLI feedback now posts to `web/src/app/api/v1/feedback` instead of relying on local-only state. `feedback-submission.ts` handles the network call, while `common/src/schemas/feedback.ts` validates the payload. `feedback-container.tsx` tracks `isSubmitting` to lock input during the request. Category types are now strictly enforced via `FeedbackCategory` from `common/src/constants/feedback.ts`.

74e25483f7660125e88f066816429ecb881fe44b.text: The assistant no longer tries to use skills that are not available. This prevents it from making up actions when no extra features are loaded.

e2d1e227bce8efc8b39a011a6d32040293be0f62.text: The assistant now keeps working if it only shares its private thoughts without giving an answer. This prevents it from stopping too early.

e561badadd00e446d412965c34523fc16b410a35.text: Feedback you send from the command line now goes to the central system instead of staying only on your computer. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

89baebf19ff27d4b885163ad349612a1c08d45b8.text: The command-line tool now checks your computer's operating system and hardware details. This allows it to gather specific system information while running.

1ad32d436b2433106ba0549bb663d2de61920e5e.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant couldn't start a conversation correctly with one specific AI provider. This change is internal and doesn't affect how you use the product.

0e8d8adcfb2f995375dc80ebd5c80821864e4c67.text: The suggestion menu now arranges each option's text individually. This prevents one long description from forcing all other options into a two-line layout.

d6911b070e2fca4b06bb4d6446002f80b0901b5a.text: If you stop a response while it is typing, the text written so far now stays in the chat instead of disappearing.

3a503134b62fc72842fc81e9118775ecfc141c6c.text: The menu layout was adjusted to fix alignment issues. Suggestions now line up correctly.

f4dbe3107e8cdb6cabb4ccfbf949ec634a6dae67.text: The tool now warns that Claude subscription support is ending soon. To keep using it, you must switch to the new Codebuff Strong plan.

ee3e0e3cc6e745ab5ceac079827315797956eb65.text: The help pages now list the latest assistant model name. This is a small internal update that only changes the text you read, not how the tool works.

737e8a0c1fe7b13e9cad264c2e4b88be9667d343.title: Add claude-opus-4.6, kimi-k2.5, glm-4.7 to agent ModelName
737e8a0c1fe7b13e9cad264c2e4b88be9667d343.summary: ModelName union in agent-definition.ts gains anthropic/claude-opus-4.6, moonshotai/kimi-k2.5, and z-ai/glm-4.7 variants. Each model includes its :nitro alias in agents and .agents templates, while the common initial-agents-dir template omits the nitro suffix for kimi-k2.5 and glm-4.7. This updates the type definitions to recognize new upstream model identifiers for agent configuration. No runtime logic changes; strictly additive type expansion.

c961ffad7a8d6ce06e8900082b1529c9861bd7b5.title: Remove hardcoded tier description from Stripe subscription
c961ffad7a8d6ce06e8900082b1529c9861bd7b5.summary: Removed hardcoded `description` field from `subscription_data` in `web/src/app/api/stripe/create-subscription/route.ts`. Eliminates static tier pricing text from Stripe API payload.

37f5ddf350b79edc494586cbeca21757d11d91c3.title: Filter orphaned tool calls on abort in stream-parser
37f5ddf350b79edc494586cbeca21757d11d91c3.summary: Added logic to filter out tool calls without corresponding tool results when the signal is aborted in `processStream`. Prevents provider errors like "unexpected tool_use_id found in tool_result blocks" caused by race conditions where tool calls are added synchronously but results arrive asynchronously. Scope limited to `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`. Uses a `Set` of completed tool call IDs to verify existence before appending to message history.

46de4ded3f387148406e516df730a7f97de410b1.title: SDK 0.10.5 fixes missing tool calls
46de4ded3f387148406e516df730a7f97de410b1.summary: sdk/CHANGELOG.md adds 0.10.5 entry documenting fix for missing tool calls and results. 0.10.4 entry notes various agent runtime improvements. Scope limited to @codebuff/sdk package changelog.

6fc95937c99cd5afd2794e0a27809cbac58ef8cf.title: Delete unused subscription tier change route
6fc95937c99cd5afd2794e0a27809cbac58ef8cf.summary: Removed `web/src/app/api/stripe/change-subscription-tier/route.ts`. This endpoint handled Stripe subscription tier upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations but is no longer referenced. Scope limited to Web API routes; no client-side or database changes.

bb00fb7bc8e3c6cb156e14f0e4b7fd552583cd38.title: Ad info panel, disable button
bb00fb7bc8e3c6cb156e14f0e4b7fd552583cd38.summary: CLI ad banner now shows info panel on 'Ad' label click, with disable button. `AdBanner` accepts `onDisableAds`, `isFreeMode` props. `chat.tsx` tracks `adsManuallyDisabled` state. New file `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx` logic adds hover states, info panel UI.

ff9f6e8944d5a061af8a951291b9c34a5d1c5ab9.title: Wrap markdown table cells instead of truncating
ff9f6e8944d5a061af8a951291b9c34a5d1c5ab9.summary: Replaced truncateText with wrapText in cli/src/utils/markdown-renderer.tsx to enable word-wrapping for table cells. The renderTable function now calculates row heights based on wrapped content, ensuring long text remains visible across multiple lines rather than being cut off with an ellipsis. This change affects CLI markdown rendering, specifically table layouts.

096c4f88b360493a40e18fdd94aebc5d05e61ad1.title: Add grant-credits.ts script
096c4f88b360493a40e18fdd94aebc5d05e61ad1.summary: New internal script `scripts/grant-credits.ts` enables manual credit grants via CLI. Prompts for user email/ID, amount, and description; validates inputs; displays summary; requires confirmation. Inserts record into `credit_ledger` with type `admin`, priority 50, no expiration. Uses `@codebuff/internal/db` and `drizzle-orm`.

6db3bb59f43f6ad7b28ff85b560b176b8248717b.title: Fix Anthropic tool call ordering
6db3bb59f43f6ad7b28ff85b560b176b8248717b.summary: Refactored agent runtime to collect tool calls and results in `toolCallsToAddToMessageHistory` and `toolResultsToAddToMessageHistory` arrays instead of pushing directly to `messageHistory` or using `toolResultsToAddAfterStream`. This ensures correct interleaved ordering of assistant tool calls and tool results in the message history, fixing bugs with Anthropic's strict tool call/result pairing requirements. Scope covers `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`, `tool-stream-parser.ts`, `tools/stream-parser.ts`, and `tools/tool-executor.ts`. Tool calls are now pushed to `toolCallsToAddToMessageHistory` only when `excludeToolFromMessageHistory` is false, and results similarly gated, replacing the previous `skipDirectResultPush` flag.

737e8a0c1fe7b13e9cad264c2e4b88be9667d343.text: The assistant can now use three new models. This change adds them to the list of available options, so you can pick them when setting up an agent.

46de4ded3f387148406e516df730a7f97de410b1.text: The assistant now correctly shows when it uses external tools. This fixes a glitch where these actions were hidden from view.

c961ffad7a8d6ce06e8900082b1529c9861bd7b5.text: The subscription page no longer shows fixed pricing text. This means the displayed price now updates automatically if costs change.

6db3bb59f43f6ad7b28ff85b560b176b8248717b.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant's actions and their outcomes were listed out of order. This ensures the system correctly matches requests to results, preventing errors during complex tasks.

6fc95937c99cd5afd2794e0a27809cbac58ef8cf.text: The team removed an unused background tool that managed subscription changes. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product or affect your current plan.

37f5ddf350b79edc494586cbeca21757d11d91c3.text: Fixed a rare glitch where stopping an action could cause an error. The assistant now handles interrupted requests more smoothly.

75cfd15b3e81b44411fba88bf35b4f049acf1834.text: A small internal update makes the testing assistant work more efficiently by keeping a single, continuous session active. This prevents the assistant from restarting unnecessarily and ensures it only saves important information, which makes the testing process faster and smoother.

096c4f88b360493a40e18fdd94aebc5d05e61ad1.text: Support staff can now manually add credits to your account if needed.

ff9f6e8944d5a061af8a951291b9c34a5d1c5ab9.text: Long text in tables now wraps to multiple lines instead of being cut off. You can read full content without missing words.

bb00fb7bc8e3c6cb156e14f0e4b7fd552583cd38.text: Clicking the ad label now reveals an info panel and a button to turn ads off.

ef6c525a2328e66eee9363b5e1a89d06df76942f.title: /refer-friends replaces /referral with copyable link
ef6c525a2328e66eee9363b5e1a89d06df76942f.summary: The CLI slash command `/referral` was renamed to `/refer-friends`, with `referral` and `redeem` retained as aliases. The `ReferralBanner` component now fetches the user's specific referral code via the `/api/referrals` endpoint and renders a button to copy the unique referral link to the clipboard. This change affects the command registry, slash command data, and UI components (`bottom-banner.tsx`, `chat-input-bar.tsx`, `referral-banner.tsx`). `BottomBanner` gained a `border` prop to support the new full-border styling of the referral banner.

1fa1ede5b2915c94a438455edbcc05f4af9cf392.title: CI: Update sdk-release workflow Node version to 24
1fa1ede5b2915c94a438455edbcc05f4af9cf392.summary: The `.github/workflows/sdk-release.yml` workflow updates the `actions/setup-node` configuration from Node 20 to Node 24. This change targets the npm publishing job to resolve compatibility or execution issues encountered with the previous version. Scope is limited to the CI infrastructure for SDK releases.

e2175c4348d342580d5da89e75d4dfce79568b8e.title: Remove NPMTOKEN env from sdk-release workflow
e2175c4348d342580d5da89e75d4dfce79568b8e.summary: Removed NODE_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable from publish step in .github/workflows/sdk-release.yml. Workflow now relies on Trusted Publisher auth configured in npm site. Affects sdk-release CI only.

240a6d83a7bdb4d644e0e1a3396c85290725d325.title: Update CLI command test expectation for refer-friends
240a6d83a7bdb4d644e0e1a3396c85290725d325.summary: Updated `cli/src/commands/__tests__/command-args.test.ts` to expect 'refer-friends' instead of 'referral' in the command factory pattern test. This aligns the test suite with the current CLI command registration.

d16dd743087445adaf57103bdd5788486683d9e7.title: Simplify onboarding flow copy
d16dd743087445adaf57103bdd5788486683d9e7.summary: Shortened onboarding step titles and descriptions in web/src/components/onboard/onboarding-flow.tsx. Removed emoji and redundant phrasing from the referral code step. Scope limited to the web onboarding component.

8de679e7a997feac9bb6a84b921cb2a28af4ac34.title: Docs soften speed claims
8de679e7a997feac9bb6a84b921cb2a28af4ac34.summary: Replaced general 3x speedup claim with specific eval data in web/src/content/tips/what-makes-codebuff-unique.mdx. Changed headline to '100+ Seconds Faster Than Claude Code' and removed 'often completing tasks in 1/3 the time' in favor of 'often completing features in 1/3 the time'. Updated mechanism description to emphasize parallel agents, better file discovery, and reading related files in one go.

22fd5ee0dee41fc394c50853ba1146c5b41ceea9.title: CLI /subscribe command replaces /buy-credits
22fd5ee0dee41fc394c50853ba1146c5b41ceea9.summary: CLI command-registry.ts merges /buy-credits into /subscribe, opening new web/src/app/subscribe/page.tsx instead of /pricing or /profile. Help banners and subscription-limit prompts updated to reference /subscribe. Web pricing-client.tsx exports StrongHeroSection for compact reuse in standalone subscribe page; navbar, footer, and banners hide chrome on /subscribe.

6b1070f762c527e6f79877bd43d54a0f30f727c8.title: SDK build script hardens TypeScript declaration bundling
6b1070f762c527e6f79877bd43d54a0f30f727c8.summary: SDK build script `scripts/build.ts` now points to `tsconfig.build.json` for declaration bundling and exits with code 1 on failure instead of warning. `tsconfig.build.json` updates target to `ES2023`, lib to `ESNext`, adds `types: ["node"]`, and defines `baseUrl` and `paths` for `@codebuff` packages to ensure `index.d.ts` bundles correctly into `dist`. This fixes issues where type definitions were not being generated or bundled properly during SDK builds.

b19028b5468eafc23442f2293c16b224b5c362da.title: Free mode requests bypass credit depletion checks
b19028b5468eafc23442f2293c16b224b5c362da.summary: Chat completions API now allows requests with cost_mode FREE to proceed even when user credit balance is zero or subscription quotas are exhausted. The _post.ts handler imports isFreeMode from @codebuff/common/constants/free-agents to identify these requests and skips the totalRemaining <= 0 and fallbackToALaCarte enforcement blocks. This ensures free agent/model combinations remain accessible to users without active credits. Scope limited to web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts and corresponding tests.

62fd54667bd81aadcaace15ff17372b51b3869ff.title: Simplify buy credits panel
62fd54667bd81aadcaace15ff17372b51b3869ff.summary: Web buy credits panel simplified. Custom purchase amount removed. Fixed dollar options replace custom input. Scope: web payment, profile, auto-topup, hooks.

62fd54667bd81aadcaace15ff17372b51b3869ff.text: The credit purchase screen now offers fixed dollar amounts instead of a custom input box.

ef6c525a2328e66eee9363b5e1a89d06df76942f.text: The command to invite friends changed to /refer-friends, though the old name still works. The banner now shows a unique link that you can copy with one click to share with others.

e2175c4348d342580d5da89e75d4dfce79568b8e.text: The team changed how the software connects to a secure online store to release updates. This internal setup makes the release process safer and more automatic. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

240a6d83a7bdb4d644e0e1a3396c85290725d325.text: A small internal update fixes a test to match the current name for the friend referral command. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

d16dd743087445adaf57103bdd5788486683d9e7.text: The setup instructions are now shorter and clearer, with unnecessary symbols and repeated words removed. This makes the initial steps easier to read and follow.

1fa1ede5b2915c94a438455edbcc05f4af9cf392.text: The automated system used to publish new software updates was upgraded to use a newer, more reliable engine. This small internal change helps ensure that future releases are delivered smoothly and without technical hitches.

22fd5ee0dee41fc394c50853ba1146c5b41ceea9.text: The command to buy credits is now called /subscribe. Using it opens a simple subscription page without extra website buttons or menus.

6b1070f762c527e6f79877bd43d54a0f30f727c8.text: The tools that prepare the software for use have been fixed to correctly bundle and check type definitions. This means the product is more stable and less likely to have errors related to how its data is described.

b19028b5468eafc23442f2293c16b224b5c362da.text: Users can now use free chat options even if they have no credits left.

8de679e7a997feac9bb6a84b921cb2a28af4ac34.text: The description of how fast the tool is has been updated to match specific test results. It now says features are completed in one-third the time, rather than all tasks.

b3a26524d27f2ad674ba50bfdba5237632ad7dae.title: Allow Bearer token auth on preferences API
b3a26524d27f2ad674ba50bfdba5237632ad7dae.summary: PATCH and GET handlers in `web/src/app/api/user/preferences/route.ts` now accept Bearer tokens via `extractApiKeyFromHeader` and `getUserIdFromSessionToken`. This fixes CLI clients failing to update `fallbackToALaCarte` in production where NextAuth session cookies are unavailable. Web clients continue to use NextAuth session fallback. Scope limited to the preferences API route.

e1d8726dbfaf592e2d5ca2bdc5e02b1886782630.title: Pricing page metadata simplification
e1d8726dbfaf592e2d5ca2bdc5e02b1886782630.summary: Title and description metadata for `/pricing` updated. Title shortened to 'Pricing | Codebuff'. Description changed to 'Subscribe for higher usage limits, or pay as you go at 1¢ per credit. Enterprise plans available for organizations.' to reflect current model. Change affects `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` via `generateMetadata`.

96a8378aa63af776c02b36b1be57b10b592b8f47.title: Add skill loading instruction to implementation step prompt
96a8378aa63af776c02b36b1be57b10b592b8f47.summary: Adds a mandatory instruction to use the skill tool for loading relevant skills in the implementation step prompt. This change ensures the agent explicitly checks for and loads skills before proceeding with code implementation. The modification is contained within agents/base2/base2.ts.

bd60ddac9276ae1a04e46797b412364126f8e514.title: Add BuffBench remote trigger script and CI workflow
bd60ddac9276ae1a04e46797b412364126f8e514.summary: Added `trigger-buffbench.ts` script and `.github/workflows/buffbench.yml` to enable remote execution of the BuffBench eval suite. The workflow uses `workflow_dispatch` with a 360-minute timeout, setting up Bun 1.3.5 and injecting secrets via `generate-ci-env.ts`. The `evals/buffbench/main.ts` configuration was updated to run only the `base2` agent with `taskConcurrency` increased to 5. This change introduces a new `trigger-buffbench` npm script in `evals/package.json` for local invocation.

ea14ad4ae4a6f442690cac60e3cb7e4e382a2686.title: Hide input box during subscription limit mode
ea14ad4ae4a6f442690cac60e3cb7e4e382a2686.summary: CLI chat input bar now returns only `InputModeBanner` when `inputMode === 'subscriptionLimit'`. This prevents the input box and subscription limit banner from rendering simultaneously. Change affects `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`.

63531e11d69aaad066aa74634161ae571a5e89a2.title: Opus 4.6 replaces 4.5 in agent model definitions
63531e11d69aaad066aa74634161ae571a5e89a2.summary: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 replaces Opus 4.5 across CLI agent wrappers and editor orchestrators. Updates apply to claude-code-cli.ts, codex-cli.ts, gemini-cli.ts, and base2.ts, plus best-of-n selectors and implementors in agents-graveyard. Prompt formatting for <think> tags adjusted to match new model behavior.

699d843343ded107bec26c518ca069e881b2ee11.title: Remove Pure Usage subscription and stripepriceid
699d843343ded107bec26c518ca069e881b2ee11.summary: Drops `stripe_price_id` column from `user` table and removes `STRIPE_USAGE_PRICE_ID` env var. Migration `0041_nappy_nebula.sql` executes the column drop. Updates schema, env examples, and eval configs to reflect Pure Usage removal.

c5e6ef867a7fa08f4fbed10b840a35d41ce45172.title: Add anthropic/claude-opus-4.6 to OpenRouter mapping
c5e6ef867a7fa08f4fbed10b840a35d41ce45172.summary: Added 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.6' to OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP in common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts, mapping it to 'claude-opus-4-6'. This ensures the new Opus 4.6 model is correctly recognized when routed via OpenRouter.

63d3a7692d4a3c1f9bc668b4317f37c1c4ac9ef7.title: Simplify CLI credit spending toggle semantics
63d3a7692d4a3c1f9bc668b4317f37c1c4ac9ef7.summary: Refactors `subscription-limit-banner.tsx` and `usage-banner.tsx` to replace the complex "always use credits" checkbox and "switch to spend/pause" button with a direct `Credit spending: enabled/disabled` toggle. This change aligns the UI state with backend semantics by treating the `fallbackToALaCarte` flag as a simple boolean for credit spending enablement rather than a conditional fallback mechanism. The `usage-banner` now displays explicit status text and a single action button, while `subscription-limit-banner` conditionally renders credit continuation options only when spending is enabled.

e4c2bbb3dcaf0c767ed14fd0d41e900709612082.title: CLI blocks Escape/Backspace exit on subscription limit
e4c2bbb3dcaf0c767ed14fd0d41e900709612082.summary: Added `blockKeyboardExit` flag to `InputModeConfig` and set true for `subscriptionLimit` mode. `resolveChatKeyboardAction` now checks this flag before returning `exit-input-mode` or `backspace-exit-mode` actions. Removed `handleWait` function and Wait button from `SubscriptionLimitBanner` in `cli/src/components/subscription-limit-banner.tsx`. Enforced in `cli/src/utils/input-modes.ts` and `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts`.

e1d8726dbfaf592e2d5ca2bdc5e02b1886782630.text: The pricing page headline and description were shortened and updated. This small change makes the page easier to read.

96a8378aa63af776c02b36b1be57b10b592b8f47.text: The assistant now checks for helpful guides before writing code. This helps it use the right steps for your request.

699d843343ded107bec26c518ca069e881b2ee11.text: The product removed the option to pay only for usage. Users can no longer choose this specific subscription plan.

b3a26524d27f2ad674ba50bfdba5237632ad7dae.text: A small internal fix helps the command-line tool save your settings correctly. Regular website users see no change.

63531e11d69aaad066aa74634161ae571a5e89a2.text: The assistant now uses a newer version of its underlying brain. This update happens in the background and may slightly improve how it thinks and responds.

ea14ad4ae4a6f442690cac60e3cb7e4e382a2686.text: When you hit your usage limit, the text box disappears, leaving only the alert message.

e4c2bbb3dcaf0c767ed14fd0d41e900709612082.text: When you reach your usage limit, the app now blocks keys that would close the warning message.

bd60ddac9276ae1a04e46797b412364126f8e514.text: A new internal tool now allows automated performance tests to run remotely. This helps the team check how well the system works without manual effort.

c5e6ef867a7fa08f4fbed10b840a35d41ce45172.text: The assistant can now use a new, more capable model when accessed through a specific service. This update happens in the background and does not change how you interact with the product.

63d3a7692d4a3c1f9bc668b4317f37c1c4ac9ef7.text: The credit spending control now uses a simple on/off switch instead of confusing checkboxes and buttons. Turning it off pauses spending; turning it on resumes it.

5060a002502a7eeeac76ff122490f241cbaf594c.title: Add what-makes-codebuff-unique marketing doc
5060a002502a7eeeac76ff122490f241cbaf594c.summary: New MDX file `web/src/content/tips/what-makes-codebuff-unique.mdx` added to tips section. Details Codebuff's multi-agent architecture, tree-based file discovery, parallel editing, and ad revenue share. Internal documentation update only.

5fa8a029096d594c513b8ba482e41c67e5d0b26d.title: Add NEXTPUBLICWEBPORT to .env.example
5fa8a029096d594c513b8ba482e41c67e5d0b26d.summary: Added NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_PORT=3000 to .env.example. Ensures local development environment template includes required port configuration for the web interface. Scope limited to repository configuration file.

51f8943c9e8c68f14a91d0b0563872d581de292c.title: Subscription API accepts bearer token auth
51f8943c9e8c68f14a91d0b0563872d581de292c.summary: GET /user/subscription now supports bearer token authentication via extractApiKeyFromHeader, falling back to NextAuth session for web clients. Added getUserIdFromSessionToken in web/src/util/auth.ts to resolve userId from session token with expiry check (gt schema.session.expires). Referrals route refactored to use same helper instead of inline db.query.session.findFirst. Covers web API routes; no CLI picker or docs changes visible in diff.

ce23b852c37d3341bb1962973efddb129588ce52.title: Usage banner uses dynamic WEBSITEURL
ce23b852c37d3341bb1962973efddb129588ce52.summary: The CLI usage banner now renders the `See more on {WEBSITE_URL}` link instead of the hardcoded `codebuff.com` text. This change ensures the banner dynamically reflects the configured website URL, preventing stale or incorrect links if the domain changes. The modification is scoped to `cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx`.

75109377ca3c2600aa30493939eef98794842b21.title: Revert internal db:migrate to drizzle-kit push
75109377ca3c2600aa30493939eef98794842b21.summary: Reverted `db:migrate` script in `packages/internal/package.json` from `drizzle-kit migrate` back to `drizzle-kit push`. This undoes a prior refactor intended for safer production deployments. The change affects only the internal package's database tooling.

77ccc55d578796a0ef5a960c972d37396f3103b2.title: Remove where-codebuff-shines.mdx doc
77ccc55d578796a0ef5a960c972d37396f3103b2.summary: Deleted `web/src/content/tips/where-codebuff-shines.mdx` (161 lines). Content deemed obsolete as basic agent capabilities are now widely known. Internal repo cleanup only; no runtime or UI impact.

0c537d8c58401d1f7556324b6050a649c7557709.title: Move Stripe webhook helpers to helpers.ts
0c537d8c58401d1f7556324b6050a649c7557709.summary: Refactored Stripe webhook route to extract `isOrgCustomer` and `isOrgBillingEvent` into `_helpers.ts`. Resolves Next.js route export errors caused by non-route exports in `route.ts`. Imports updated in `web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` and tests.

6ab7d2d0c9ffbe0c67444a76f95286042633179a.title: Increase OpenRouter timeout for deep-thinking models
6ab7d2d0c9ffbe0c67444a76f95286042633179a.summary: Extended headers timeout to 10 minutes in web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts to handle delayed streaming starts for models like gpt-5. Uses undici Agent with headersTimeout set to 600000ms and bodyTimeout disabled. Applied via custom dispatcher in createOpenRouterRequest.

746093347cf3ab3a01ada4aeac298382cf134b3f.title: CLI terminal command preview uses full width
746093347cf3ab3a01ada4aeac298382cf134b3f.summary: Terminal command preview now uses full available width via separatorWidth or availableWidth override, replacing contentMaxWidth minus fixed padding. RunTerminalCommandComponent passes options.availableWidth to TerminalCommandDisplay. Affects CLI rendering of run_terminal_command tool output. New availableWidth prop allows caller-specified wrapping width.

0ce28d92c11130c01626a552834fb6f82950b74b.title: Add subscription limit banner and /subscribe command
0ce28d92c11130c01626a552834fb6f82950b74b.summary: CLI introduces `subscriptionLimit` input mode with auto-triggering banner via `useSubscriptionQuery` and new `/subscribe` command. `BottomStatusLine` refactors to display both Claude and Codebuff Strong statuses, while `MessageFooter` replaces static credit counts with dynamic `CreditsOrSubscriptionIndicator` showing subscription coverage. CI updates switch `web` package tests to `bun test` with explicit file discovery to support `bunfig.toml` preloads.

746093347cf3ab3a01ada4aeac298382cf134b3f.text: The app now shows command previews using the full width of the screen. This prevents text from wrapping unnecessarily, making commands easier to read.

5060a002502a7eeeac76ff122490f241cbaf594c.text: The team added an internal guide explaining how the assistant works and makes money. This is a behind-the-scenes update that does not change how you use the product.

51f8943c9e8c68f14a91d0b0563872d581de292c.text: The system now accepts a new type of login check for subscription details. This internal update helps the website verify users more flexibly.

0c537d8c58401d1f7556324b6050a649c7557709.text: A small internal fix cleaned up how the system checks for payments. You won't notice any difference.

ce23b852c37d3341bb1962973efddb129588ce52.text: The command-line tool now shows a website link that updates automatically if the company's web address changes. This ensures users always see the correct current website in the help text, rather than a fixed, potentially outdated link.

0ce28d92c11130c01626a552834fb6f82950b74b.text: The tool now shows a clear message when you run out of free usage and lets you buy a subscription directly from the command line. It also updates the status line to show your remaining credits or subscription coverage in real time.

6ab7d2d0c9ffbe0c67444a76f95286042633179a.text: The system now waits longer for complex answers to start streaming. This reduces errors when using advanced models that take more time to think.

77ccc55d578796a0ef5a960c972d37396f3103b2.text: Removed an outdated help article about basic assistant features. This cleanup does not affect how the product works for you.

5fa8a029096d594c513b8ba482e41c67e5d0b26d.text: A small internal setup change ensures the website's address settings are correctly prepared for new installations. This has no visible effect on how the product works for current users.

75109377ca3c2600aa30493939eef98794842b21.text: A small internal update changes how the system manages its database. This change affects only the technical setup behind the scenes and does not alter the features or behavior you see in the product.

c49789dacbe616b50b764519a6b9e1fba1124c78.title: Remove backfill-referral-legacy.sql script
c49789dacbe616b50b764519a6b9e1fba1124c78.summary: Deleted scripts/backfill-referral-legacy.sql. The manual backfill for referral_legacy grants in credit_ledger was already applied in production. No further action needed.

7a83297f47d8e25387f7e5bcc56e6d4e6e7e8e56.title: Gravity API error handling: parse JSON only after response.ok check
7a83297f47d8e25387f7e5bcc56e6d4e6e7e8e56.summary: `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` now checks `response.ok` before parsing JSON to prevent unhandled exceptions when Gravity API returns HTML error pages. Error responses are logged with raw text if content-type is not `application/json`. Added empty array guard: `ads.length === 0` returns `{ ad: null }` with debug log. Scope: server-side ads API only.

c564dac5d3681443df760b0752501d8c3de769b5.title: packages/internal db:migrate switches drizzle-kit push to migrate
c564dac5d3681443df760b0752501d8c3de769b5.summary: packages/internal/package.json db:migrate script calls drizzle-kit migrate instead of drizzle-kit push. Avoids push's direct schema sync for safer production deployments. Scoped to packages/internal. db:start still chains docker compose up, db:generate, then db:migrate.

34c7aaadc5259a9b329e41bcd1910351956cd4a4.title: Remove debug log from message queue
34c7aaadc5259a9b329e41bcd1910351956cd4a4.summary: Removed a `logger.debug` call in `use-message-queue.ts` that logged when the queue was blocked. This reduces console noise during CLI operation. The change is internal to the CLI's message processing logic.

fc1253a60a0463725587307ebed09941e93115bc.title: Enable Stripe invoice creation and tax id collection in checkout
fc1253a60a0463725587307ebed09941e93115bc.summary: Enabled `invoice_creation` and `tax_id_collection` in Stripe checkout sessions for both credit purchases and subscriptions. Added `customer_update` with auto name and address. Covers `web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts` and `web/src/app/api/stripe/create-subscription/route.ts`.

1147209cdb883e00f1cc2a0779c4fdb941e90eb6.title: Move referral backfill out of Drizzle migration
1147209cdb883e00f1cc2a0779c4fdb941e90eb6.summary: Referral legacy backfill removed from `0040_referral_legacy_backfill.sql` and moved to manual `scripts/backfill-referral-legacy.sql`. Drizzle journal updated to drop migration 40. PostgreSQL requires new enum values to be committed before use in subsequent statements, causing transaction failures in automated migrations. Operators must run the script via `psql` after deploying migration 0039.

efb9f5d4576330b8d6f3d7a68149e323987df9fa.title: fix(db): Remove trailing comma in migration journal JSON
efb9f5d4576330b8d6f3d7a68149e323987df9fa.summary: Removed trailing comma from `packages/internal/src/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json`. Prevents JSON parse errors in strict parsers. Affects internal DB migration metadata.

f9cdd1d365a762fde877ed7b8f186ba85c829dcb.title: Suppress flaky validate-agents network errors
f9cdd1d365a762fde877ed7b8f186ba85c829dcb.summary: CLI hook use-send-message.ts now returns an empty error array when validation fails with no specific errors, suppressing the generic network error message. This mitigates noise from flaky validate endpoint responses. Changes also harden ValidationErrorPopover.tsx against undefined error IDs by defaulting to empty strings and using index-based keys, and update sdk validate-agents.ts to default error.filePath to 'unknown' if missing.

f3e4216c22135a5d963d01eb1b9bcde68c9994f3.title: Split referrallegacy migration for PostgreSQL enum
f3e4216c22135a5d963d01eb1b9bcde68c9994f3.summary: Referral legacy backfill logic moved from 0039_quiet_franklin_storm.sql to new 0040_referral_legacy_backfill.sql. PostgreSQL forbids ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE and subsequent DML in same transaction; splitting resolves this. 0039 now sets is_legacy default to true directly, removing explicit UPDATE. Affects packages/internal/src/db/migrations.

415f5a7c7dc0d39a3021bc9a0ea30d5156d3571d.title: Referral bonuses shift to one-time 500 credits
415f5a7c7dc0d39a3021bc9a0ea30d5156d3571d.summary: Referral bonuses converted from monthly recurring to one-time grants, increasing amount from 250 to 500 credits. New `referral` grants never expire, while legacy recurring referrals marked with `is_legacy=true` migrate to `referral_legacy` type with priority 30. Changes affect `common/src/constants/limits.ts`, `packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts`, and new migration `0039_quiet_franklin_storm.sql`.

c49789dacbe616b50b764519a6b9e1fba1124c78.text: The company removed an old internal tool used to fix past referral records. This change does not affect how you use the product.

1147209cdb883e00f1cc2a0779c4fdb941e90eb6.text: We moved a small internal data update to run separately after the main system update. This prevents errors that could stop the update from finishing.

415f5a7c7dc0d39a3021bc9a0ea30d5156d3571d.text: Referral bonuses are now a one-time gift of 500 credits instead of a smaller monthly amount. These new credits never expire.

7a83297f47d8e25387f7e5bcc56e6d4e6e7e8e56.text: The app now checks for errors before processing data, preventing crashes when the service fails. Empty results are handled safely, keeping the product stable.

efb9f5d4576330b8d6f3d7a68149e323987df9fa.text: We fixed a small internal error in the database setup files. This change does not affect how you use the product.

c564dac5d3681443df760b0752501d8c3de769b5.text: The system now updates its data structure more carefully to prevent errors. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

34c7aaadc5259a9b329e41bcd1910351956cd4a4.text: The program stopped printing extra background notes to the screen. This makes the text easier to read while you work.

f3e4216c22135a5d963d01eb1b9bcde68c9994f3.text: A small internal change fixes a database error that could happen when saving referral records. Users will not notice any difference.

fc1253a60a0463725587307ebed09941e93115bc.text: The checkout process now automatically asks for tax information and generates invoices for credit purchases and subscriptions. This makes it easier for users to handle billing records without manual steps.

f9cdd1d365a762fde877ed7b8f186ba85c829dcb.text: The system now hides confusing network error messages that appear randomly when checking agent settings. You will see fewer unnecessary warnings during normal use.

f4578bf4f4a245399ea58b440a1a3b30bdcb6d04.title: SDK abort path tests for PromptResult handling
f4578bf4f4a245399ea58b440a1a3b30bdcb6d04.summary: Comprehensive tests added for abort paths in PromptResult handling across agent runtime and common utilities. Validates AbortError class behavior, isAbortError edge cases, and promptAborted/promptSuccess wrapper functions. Covers gemini-with-fallbacks, process-file-block, and n-parameter modules to ensure abort signals propagate correctly without triggering fallback chains.

7f7c6d6b2d01e8af50d71600da3e478db859d3e2.title: CLI slash/mention menu height scales to 15 on tall terminals
7f7c6d6b2d01e8af50d71600da3e478db859d3e2.summary: SuggestionMenu `maxVisible` in `chat-input-bar.tsx` now derives from `terminalHeight > 35 ? 15 : 10` instead of hardcoded 10. Applies to both `/` slash and `@` mention menus. Scope limited to CLI component; no model or API change.

b76866a5955f1c058321a4eaf2fd955a096acb09.title: Fix missing propose prefix in editor-implementor tool names
b76866a5955f1c058321a4eaf2fd955a096acb09.summary: Corrects `cb_tool_name` values in the `editor-implementor` prompt from `str_replace` and `write_file` to `propose_str_replace` and `propose_write_file`. This aligns the prompt instructions with the actual tool definitions, ensuring the agent uses the correct namespaced tools for proposing edits. The fix applies to the best-of-n editor agent implementation.

a175054234a1be11eaa0f31276842e32aa2c85ee.title: Add /theme:toggle command to CLI
a175054234a1be11eaa0f31276842e32aa2c85ee.summary: New /theme:toggle slash command flips between light and dark themes. Handler reads current theme from useThemeStore, sets the opposite name, and injects a system confirmation message. Registered in command-registry.ts and exposed in slash-commands.ts for autocomplete.

4e10365fd9f9fc1dba7c0ee557306cc1d31d7f12.title: Hide agent:opus and publish from CLI slash commands
4e10365fd9f9fc1dba7c0ee557306cc1d31d7f12.summary: Commented out `agent:opus` and `publish` entries in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. Removes these commands from the CLI picker. Internal cleanup of exposed agent/store commands.

fc2d2f13ba01421a10b7c1f3222460759f746ea5.title: SDK LLM functions return PromptResult type
fc2d2f13ba01421a10b7c1f3222460759f746ea5.summary: LLM functions in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` now return `PromptResult` type via `promptSuccess` and `promptAborted` helpers from `@codebuff/common/util/error`. Replaces raw `null`, `''`, `throw new Error`, and `messageId`/`content` returns with structured result objects. Scope: SDK LLM implementation (`promptAiSdkStream`, `promptAiSdk`, `promptAiSdkStructured`). `promptAiSdkStructured` no longer throws on user cancellation, returning `promptAborted` instead.

7970c2dee83b155434da93abdaad98ea2f0a0461.title: Remove browser auto-open from CLI plain login
7970c2dee83b155434da93abdaad98ea2f0a0461.summary: Plain login in cli/src/login/plain-login.ts no longer attempts to open a browser via the 'open' package. It now displays the login URL and instructs the user to open it manually. This simplifies the flow and removes dependency on local browser availability.

ad68b32f3a5e58be70437c75eb3719f3678fa6a5.title: /review command added to CLI with GPT-5 Agent integration
ad68b32f3a5e58be70437c75eb3719f3678fa6a5.summary: New /review slash command added to CLI. Command registry handler in command-registry.ts checks for args: if present, sends '@GPT-5 Agent Please review: <args>' directly; if absent, returns openReviewScreen flag. ReviewScreen component in review-screen.tsx provides selection UI for 'Uncommitted changes', 'This branch vs main', and 'Custom...' modes. State managed via zustand store in review-store.ts.
