Chat component in chat.tsx disables keyboard handlers when reviewMode active and wires handleReviewOptionSelect to submit prompt with current agentMode. Slash commands list updated in slash-commands.ts.

ed9b9413bf5867912f4283e6b2e1eb1ada9d16b5.title: Agent runtime uses AbortError class and PromptResult pattern
ed9b9413bf5867912f4283e6b2e1eb1ada9d16b5.summary: Abort handling in agent-runtime switched from generic Error throws to an AbortError class and PromptResult pattern. processFileBlock now returns a discriminated PromptResult instead of throwing, with write-file.ts converting aborts back to AbortError at the boundary. isAbortError() in common/src/util/error.ts now matches AbortError.name and prefixed messages. Covers common, agent-runtime, and SDK e2e mocks.

cb81a65a569238c6ed7ef25877e6156ed8c53da1.title: Add PromptResult type for explicit abort handling
cb81a65a569238c6ed7ef25877e6156ed8c53da1.summary: Added `PromptResult<T>` union type in `common/src/util/error.ts` and applied it to LLM contract types in `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts`. This distinguishes user-initiated aborts from errors in prompt functions. Includes `promptSuccess`, `promptAborted` helpers, and `ABORT_ERROR_MESSAGE` constant.

a175054234a1be11eaa0f31276842e32aa2c85ee.text: You can now switch between light and dark themes using a new command. This lets you change how the app looks without leaving your current screen.

fc2d2f13ba01421a10b7c1f3222460759f746ea5.text: The system now handles cancelled requests more gracefully, preventing unexpected errors when you stop a task.

f4578bf4f4a245399ea58b440a1a3b30bdcb6d04.text: The assistant now correctly stops when you cancel a request, preventing it from accidentally switching to a backup system. This change is internal and ensures the app behaves predictably when you interrupt a task.

4e10365fd9f9fc1dba7c0ee557306cc1d31d7f12.text: The app hid two options from its command menu. This cleanup keeps the menu tidy for you.

b76866a5955f1c058321a4eaf2fd955a096acb09.text: The assistant now correctly identifies the specific actions it should take to suggest changes to your text. This ensures that when it offers to edit or write content, the suggestions appear as intended without confusion.

ed9b9413bf5867912f4283e6b2e1eb1ada9d16b5.text: The assistant now handles interruptions more cleanly. If you stop a task, it shuts down properly instead of showing a confusing error.

cb81a65a569238c6ed7ef25877e6156ed8c53da1.text: The assistant now clearly tells you when you stop a request, separating it from unexpected failures. This small internal update makes error messages more accurate.

7f7c6d6b2d01e8af50d71600da3e478db859d3e2.text: The list of suggestions in the command menu now shows more options at once if your screen is tall. This helps you see more commands or names without scrolling.

7970c2dee83b155434da93abdaad98ea2f0a0461.text: The login tool now shows a web address instead of automatically launching your browser. You must click the link yourself to sign in.

ad68b32f3a5e58be70437c75eb3719f3678fa6a5.text: You can now type a command to ask the assistant to review your work. You choose what to review, and the assistant checks it for you.

befef2c6bbf198faa2e798f55b4ffe2cfb1c8a68.title: PromptResult abort handling in evals and admin tools
befef2c6bbf198faa2e798f55b4ffe2cfb1c8a68.summary: Refactor prompt consumers to handle PromptResult aborts. `evals/buffbench/pick-commits.ts` and `scripts/get-changelog.ts` now check `result.aborted` before accessing `result.value`. `web/src/app/api/admin/relabel-for-user/route.ts` uses `unwrapPromptResult` helper. Internal tooling only.

0ec9fa0acfde1fd0235ec3c1adf7e8b1091eaaf5.title: Update agent-runtime test mocks to PromptResult type
0ec9fa0acfde1fd0235ec3c1adf7e8b1091eaaf5.summary: Test mocks in agent-runtime fixtures now return `PromptResult` via `promptSuccess` instead of raw strings or objects. This aligns with the `promptAiSdk` and `promptAiSdkStructured` type signatures which expect a `PromptResult` wrapper. Changes affect `common/src/testing/fixtures/agent-runtime.ts` and various test files in `packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/`. No user-facing behavior changes.

7f9613cdda455a9edda444f35fb5079de51c03c9.title: cli-release-prod switch to trusted publishing
7f9613cdda455a9edda444f35fb5079de51c03c9.summary: The cli-release-prod workflow now uses Node.js 24 and removes the NODE_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable from the npm publish step. This change supports GitHub's trusted publishing mechanism, eliminating the need for a manual NPM_TOKEN secret. The update applies to .github/workflows/cli-release-prod.yml.

a24ae19af0e80221114f35ffed9b7cbc9e646176.title: Fix setoutput test assertion structure
a24ae19af0e80221114f35ffed9b7cbc9e646176.summary: Updated `set_output` test assertions in `implementor-helpers.test.ts` to wrap `chosenStrategy` and `reason` inside a `data` object. This aligns the test expectations with the actual tool call input schema. Scope limited to CLI test suite. No runtime behavior changes.

1bb1c6853036244ac1d440ccbe3cd1c6d96d6afa.title: Log API error response body, URL, and cause fields
1bb1c6853036244ac1d440ccbe3cd1c6d96d6afa.summary: ErrorObject now includes responseBody, url, isRetryable, requestBodyValues, and cause fields. getErrorObject extracts these from AI SDK APICallError and other extended error types. A safeStringify helper handles circular references and caps string output at 10000 chars. rawError serialization switches from JSON.stringify to safeStringify.

7eca73b597318beaafc519ee42999dce041609a0.title: Temporarily disable org billing via feature flag
7eca73b597318beaafc519ee42999dce041609a0.summary: ORG_BILLING_ENABLED flag disables org billing APIs and UI. Stripe webhook filters org events to prevent retry storms while keeping personal billing active. Subscription cancellation remains enabled. Changes in web/src/lib/billing-config.ts, API routes, and org billing pages.

37e11effc629201edc6776246bd6318ff94c3232.title: Prevent API fallbacks on user abort
37e11effc629201edc6776246bd6318ff94c3232.summary: Added `isAbortError` checks to `promptFlashWithFallbacks` in `gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` and `promptRelaceAI` in `relace-api.ts`. User-initiated aborts now propagate immediately instead of triggering fallback model calls. This prevents wasted API usage and latency when a user cancels a request. Updated JSDoc to clarify abort behavior.

61d4975f84aa6c9da41331ec5c4784451a64cc19.title: CLI @ file search uses fuzzy matching with directory entries
61d4975f84aa6c9da41331ec5c4784451a64cc19.summary: CLI suggestion engine replaces exact path filtering with fuzzyMatch scoring gaps, consecutive runs, and word boundaries. common/src/project-file-tree.ts exports getAllPathsWithDirectories and PathInfo to include directory nodes in candidates. cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts consumes PathInfo[] and adds isDirectory plus matchScore to MatchedFileInfo. Score formula: gaps*10 - maxConsecutive*5 - boundaryBonus*15 + firstIndex, lower is better.

2303714342ed6476a96c8e2855a5bdaf79d192d8.title: Add hardware-based CLI fingerprinting
2303714342ed6476a96c8e2855a5bdaf79d192d8.summary: New `use-fingerprint` hook and `fingerprint` utility generate deterministic hardware IDs via `node-machine-id` and `systeminformation`. Sync legacy fingerprint provides immediate auth responsiveness; async enhanced fingerprint replaces it if successful. `agent-runtime` core functions now handle `PromptResult` abort semantics via `unwrapPromptResult` and `isAbortError`. Scope covers CLI auth, shared analytics constants, and agent runtime prompt processing.

b45a8cca698a67999d6c8b35d9ad42cca6e76f99.title: Fix editor multi prompt to show the selected strategy and reason
b45a8cca698a67999d6c8b35d9ad42cca6e76f99.summary: Updates CLI to correctly parse `set_output` tool inputs for the editor multi-prompt feature. The `set_output` tool wraps its payload in a `data` property, so `agent-branch-wrapper.tsx` and `implementor-helpers.ts` were modified to access `input.data` instead of `input` directly. `constants.ts` adds `best-of-n-selector2` to `SIMPLE_TEXT_AGENT_IDS` to support the new selector. This ensures the selected strategy and reason are displayed correctly in the CLI.

befef2c6bbf198faa2e798f55b4ffe2cfb1c8a68.text: Internal tools now stop processing if a request is cancelled, preventing errors in the background. This change affects only the tools staff use to manage the product, not what you see or do.

a24ae19af0e80221114f35ffed9b7cbc9e646176.text: A small internal test update. It does not change how the product works for you.

37e11effc629201edc6776246bd6318ff94c3232.text: When you cancel a request, the system now stops immediately instead of trying other options. This saves time and prevents extra usage.

0ec9fa0acfde1fd0235ec3c1adf7e8b1091eaaf5.text: The testing setup for the assistant's internal tools was updated to match a new data format. This is a small, behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how the product works for users.

7eca73b597318beaafc519ee42999dce041609a0.text: We temporarily turned off billing for organizations. Personal billing still works.

7f9613cdda455a9edda444f35fb5079de51c03c9.text: The software now checks its identity automatically before releasing updates. This removes the need to manually store a secret password, making the release process safer and simpler.

61d4975f84aa6c9da41331ec5c4784451a64cc19.text: Typing partial names in the command line now suggests files and folders that match loosely rather than only exact prefixes. This helps find items faster when you do not remember the full name.

1bb1c6853036244ac1d440ccbe3cd1c6d96d6afa.text: The system now saves more details when an error happens, like the specific web address and the full message received. This helps support staff understand and fix issues faster.

b45a8cca698a67999d6c8b35d9ad42cca6e76f99.text: The tool now correctly displays the chosen method and explanation when generating text. This fixes a display error, so users see accurate information without extra steps.

2303714342ed6476a96c8e2855a5bdaf79d192d8.text: The app now identifies your computer using its unique hardware features. This makes signing in faster and keeps your data linked to the correct device.

0d9a8a2107a299ad81f12dde7a2e9f2b09143f5d.title: Fix MCP env resolution build
0d9a8a2107a299ad81f12dde7a2e9f2b09143f5d.summary: Fixed build error in MCP config loading by bypassing env architecture checks. Introduced dynamic key access `process['env']` to resolve `$VAR_NAME` references in `sdk/src/agents/load-mcp-config.ts`. Scope limited to SDK agent configuration loading. This workaround addresses linting or type constraints preventing direct `process.env` access during build.

4695192b8fd9050c351590b83511098b5ecbd078.title: LONGTEXTTHRESHOLD doubled to 2000
4695192b8fd9050c351590b83511098b5ecbd078.summary: cli/src/utils/strings.ts sets `LONG_TEXT_THRESHOLD` to 2000, doubling prior 1000 limit. Mechanism: pasted text exceeding threshold becomes attachment instead of inline insertion. Scope: CLI only. Detail: boundary check uses strictly greater than, so 2000 chars remain inline.

0e2633a858d947a582ba57248c1d5272229992b0.title: Simplify CodeDemo UI
0e2633a858d947a582ba57248c1d5272229992b0.summary: Refactored CodeDemo component in `web/src/components/docs/mdx/code-demo.tsx` to use a compact dark theme layout. Removed `Separator` dependency and language label header for non-mermaid code blocks. Copy button moved to inline right-aligned position with simplified styling. Scope limited to docs MDX rendering surface.

4f45568ffa49272ba10dcc2c4e50f1b1fd531ff6.title: Truncate skill descriptions to 50 chars in slash menu
4f45568ffa49272ba10dcc2c4e50f1b1fd531ff6.summary: Skill descriptions in the slash menu now truncate to 50 chars with ellipsis. Implemented via `truncateDescription` in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. Prevents UI overflow from verbose skill metadata.

4b01c207047d44f9acb47b8d4b7e5cafbc8b3fca.title: Refactor cancellation logic to preserve user messages on error
4b01c207047d44f9acb47b8d4b7e5cafbc8b3fca.summary: Cancellation handling in `sdk/src/run.ts` was refactored to explicitly include the user's message in the session state if `callMainPrompt` throws an error, ensuring the server-side omission is corrected locally. The `getCancelledAdditionalMessages` helper in `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/messages.ts` was removed, replaced by a new `addCancellationContext` function that mutates state directly to append partial assistant responses and interruption messages. This change affects the SDK's run loop and agent runtime message utilities.

84f283a51e6ac354b0a8f54ba40aa51229ad8422.title: Replace Lite mode with Free mode in docs
84f283a51e6ac354b0a8f54ba40aa51229ad8422.summary: Renamed 'Lite' mode to 'Free' in modes documentation, updating model references from editor-gpt-5 to editor-glm. Replaced CLI flags (`--lite`, `--max`, `--plan`) with slash commands (`/mode:default`, `/mode:max`, `/mode:plan`, `/mode:free`). Updated tags from 'lite' to 'free' in web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx.

5937834199b395521cd14e84a850d0e204c949af.title: Fix logger crash on circular JSON refs
5937834199b395521cd14e84a850d0e204c949af.summary: Added `safeStringify` in `cli/src/utils/logger.ts` to handle circular references during log serialization. Replaces circular objects with `'[Circular]'` using a `WeakSet` tracker instead of throwing. Prevents crashes in dev mode when logging complex state objects.

d6e7b7ea7418911b23b69894b06833c420876cca.title: MCP docs move to tips, lead with mcp.json
d6e7b7ea7418911b23b69894b06833c420876cca.summary: MCP Servers documentation relocated from web/src/content/agents/mcp-servers.mdx to web/src/content/tips/mcp-servers.mdx. New Quick Start section prioritizes global `mcp.json` configuration in `.agents/` over per-agent TypeScript definitions. Search order defined: project, parent, then global `~/.agents/mcp.json` with override semantics. Examples expanded to cover GitHub, multi-server, HTTP, and SSE configurations.

baebc5a012ae1bdee67470879e1c3764e7f5d652.title: Onboarding flow redesigned to single-page scroll
baebc5a012ae1bdee67470879e1c3764e7f5d652.summary: OnboardingFlow component replaced multi-step wizard with single-page scrollable layout using framer-motion. Removed package manager selection (npm/yarn/pnpm/bun) in favor of hardcoded npm install command. EnhancedCopyButton now displays 'Copied!' text feedback alongside check icon. Covers web/src/components/onboard/ and web/src/components/ui/.

94a7f9ff1c0c25651633bfc43107387ccfd5fc55.title: Remove Codebuff Best Practices docs page
94a7f9ff1c0c25651633bfc43107387ccfd5fc55.summary: Deleted web/src/content/tips/best-practices.mdx. Content duplicated existing docs on modes, gitignore, and link scraping. Removed corresponding e2e test reference in web/src/__tests__/e2e/docs.spec.ts.

94a7f9ff1c0c25651633bfc43107387ccfd5fc55.text: The product's help section removed a duplicate guide about best practices because that information already exists in other places. This small internal cleanup means users will not see a redundant page in the documentation.

0e2633a858d947a582ba57248c1d5272229992b0.text: The code examples on the documentation pages now look cleaner and use a darker background. This change is internal and only affects how the examples are displayed.

0d9a8a2107a299ad81f12dde7a2e9f2b09143f5d.text: Fixed a setup issue that stopped the assistant from reading certain settings. This helps the assistant work correctly when it needs to use external tools.

4695192b8fd9050c351590b83511098b5ecbd078.text: The limit for pasting long text directly into the chat has doubled to 2000 characters. Text longer than this now appears as a file attachment instead of inline text.

4f45568ffa49272ba10dcc2c4e50f1b1fd531ff6.text: Long skill descriptions in the menu now cut off after fifty characters. This keeps the menu tidy and prevents text from spilling over.

d6e7b7ea7418911b23b69894b06833c420876cca.text: Documentation moved to a Tips section. Quick start now highlights a global settings file for easier setup.

84f283a51e6ac354b0a8f54ba40aa51229ad8422.text: The name of the basic usage level changed from Lite to Free. You now switch between levels by typing commands into the chat instead of using special settings.

5937834199b395521cd14e84a850d0e204c949af.text: The program stopped crashing when recording certain types of information. You will no longer see unexpected errors while using the tool.

4b01c207047d44f9acb47b8d4b7e5cafbc8b3fca.text: When the assistant stops mid-response, it now remembers what you said. This prevents the system from forgetting your last message during an interruption.

baebc5a012ae1bdee67470879e1c3764e7f5d652.text: Setup guide is now one long page instead of separate steps. Package choice is fixed to one option.

cc4298ee5e138871f9e829f103f77bdc50ff2ce3.title: Add privacy.mdx advanced content page
cc4298ee5e138871f9e829f103f77bdc50ff2ce3.summary: New web/src/content/advanced/privacy.mdx defines privacy policy. Covers no third-party training, session logging, ad targeting, and backend routing. Future Privacy Mode noted. Internal docs addition.

986d6a349dc1d95a48794da2396fe718a9c54004.title: Fix infinite retries in CLI useActivityQuery hook
986d6a349dc1d95a48794da2396fe718a9c54004.summary: Fixed infinite retry loops in `cli/src/hooks/use-activity-query.ts` by separating timeout cleanup from state reset. The retry scheduling logic now calls `clearRetryTimeout` instead of `clearRetryState`, preventing accidental reset of `retryCounts`. Staleness checks now use `isEntryStale` to consider `errorUpdatedAt`, avoiding rapid refetch loops on persistent errors. Added `_retryTestHelpers` and `setErrorOnlyCacheEntry` to expose internal state for unit testing.

66d02a7ddb897fec57232e58e92d65efb1ddb8a4.title: Fix advisory lock bugs causing Discord bot to fail to start
66d02a7ddb897fec57232e58e92d65efb1ddb8a4.summary: Advisory lock logic in packages/internal/src/db/advisory-lock.ts updated to prevent Discord bot startup failures. Changes include coercing postgres boolean strings ('t'/'f') to native booleans, disabling connection recycling (max_lifetime: 0) to maintain session state, and adding guards against stacking health checks and premature lock loss triggers. This ensures reliable lock acquisition and monitoring for internal services.

bf9eddaba35d2a608d7600e78e602ed432fcff3f.title: CLI direnv integration
bf9eddaba35d2a608d7600e78e602ed432fcff3f.summary: Added `initializeDirenv` to CLI startup to load `.envrc` variables. Searches up to git root for `.envrc`, checks `direnv` availability (skips Windows), and applies exports via `direnv export json`. New file `cli/src/init/init-direnv.ts` handles logic; `cli/src/init/init-app.ts` triggers it before theme/project init. Blocked `.envrc` files log a warning prompting `direnv allow`.

3be3cc2d6566d12b7c78b7c50d84f8e17ee62964.title: Add Skills documentation
3be3cc2d6566d12b7c78b7c50d84f8e17ee62964.summary: New `skills.mdx` documents reusable instruction sets for Codebuff. Details directory structure under `.agents/` or `.claude/`, `SKILL.md` frontmatter requirements, discovery priority, and `/skill:name` slash command usage. Includes examples for git release and code review workflows.

2a3bf3c9cc9e7041dd804e4bc44a4378d235db42.title: Fix stale check in use-activity-query for error states
2a3bf3c9cc9e7041dd804e4bc44a4378d235db42.summary: Updated isEntryStale in cli/src/hooks/use-activity-query.ts to treat entries with recent errors as fresh. Logic now checks dataUpdatedAt first, then errorUpdatedAt if no successful data exists. Prevents rapid retries on persistent errors by respecting staleTime for error timestamps. Affects CLI activity polling mechanism.

585742806f8f389a76da2aff99d032e961f710dd.title: Update advisory-lock test to expect maxlifetime option
585742806f8f389a76da2aff99d032e961f710dd.summary: Updated `packages/internal/src/db/__tests__/advisory-lock.test.ts` to include `max_lifetime: 0` in the expected connection options assertion. This aligns the test with the current database adapter configuration, ensuring the advisory lock mechanism is validated against the actual parameters passed during connection setup.

df0ffb3bb12e8537878061ea497b0ba58c77acd3.title: CLI default tool renderer collapses unregistered tools
df0ffb3bb12e8537878061ea497b0ba58c77acd3.summary: The CLI `ToolBranch` component now defaults to collapsed state for tools lacking a registered custom renderer. Previously, collapse behavior relied solely on `shouldCollapseToolByDefault` or explicit `isCollapsed` flags, causing verbose output for fallback-rendered tools. This change moves the `renderToolComponent` check earlier in the render logic to determine `hasRegisteredComponent`. Scope is limited to `cli/src/components/blocks/tool-branch.tsx`. Tools with registered components retain their existing default collapse logic.

02f131b89966bff249f1e1c157234591b028d5cb.title: CLI init-direnv.ts added to process.env allowlist
02f131b89966bff249f1e1c157234591b028d5cb.summary: scripts/check-env-architecture.ts now permits cli/src/init/init-direnv.ts to access process.env. This resolves a CI failure where the architecture check blocked direnv variable loading. The change applies to the CLI package's restricted imports enforcement.

7eef4c4bcf2fad1756b3695692c844f23397deba.title: Support .agents/mcp.json for MCP server config
7eef4c4bcf2fad1756b3695692c844f23397deba.summary: SDK adds `loadMCPConfig` and `loadMCPConfigSync` to parse `mcp.json` in `.agents` directories. CLI `local-agent-registry` merges these servers into base agents, enabling user-defined MCP tools. Env vars in config (e.g., `$NOTION_TOKEN`) resolve at load time; missing vars throw errors. Files: `sdk/src/agents/load-mcp-config.ts`, `cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts`.

585742806f8f389a76da2aff99d032e961f710dd.text: A small internal update aligned a test with the current database configuration. This ensures the system correctly manages temporary data locks to prevent conflicts.

df0ffb3bb12e8537878061ea497b0ba58c77acd3.text: The command line interface now hides details for tools that do not have a custom display setup. This reduces clutter in the output.

bf9eddaba35d2a608d7600e78e602ed432fcff3f.text: The command-line tool now automatically loads your saved project settings when you start it. If you have set up environment variables for your work, they will apply without extra steps.

986d6a349dc1d95a48794da2396fe718a9c54004.text: Fixed a bug where the app could get stuck trying to reload information forever. You will no longer see endless loading screens when a connection fails.

7eef4c4bcf2fad1756b3695692c844f23397deba.text: You can now set up external tools by editing a simple text file in the `.agents` folder. The system will automatically load these tools and use their settings, including any secret keys you add, when you run your tasks.

02f131b89966bff249f1e1c157234591b028d5cb.text: A small internal fix stopped a safety check from blocking the tool that loads saved settings. This prevents errors when starting the command-line tool.

cc4298ee5e138871f9e829f103f77bdc50ff2ce3.text: A new internal document explains how user privacy is handled. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

3be3cc2d6566d12b7c78b7c50d84f8e17ee62964.text: The assistant now has a guide for saving reusable instructions. This lets users set up custom tasks, like code reviews, without needing to know technical details.

66d02a7ddb897fec57232e58e92d65efb1ddb8a4.text: Fixed a bug that stopped the assistant from starting. The service now launches reliably.

2a3bf3c9cc9e7041dd804e4bc44a4378d235db42.text: The app now waits longer before retrying failed data requests. This reduces repeated attempts when errors persist.

aac0817bae2921bcaf1fa91be5e98b906b79260e.title: Strip quotes from code search flags
aac0817bae2921bcaf1fa91be5e98b906b79260e.summary: Added quote-stripping logic to `flagsArray` in `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts` to handle cases where flags are passed with surrounding quotes (e.g., `"'foo.md'"` → `"foo.md"`). Since `spawn()` does not perform shell interpretation, this ensures ripgrep receives clean arguments. The change applies to the SDK's code search tool. An optional `logger` parameter was also added to `codeSearch` to log ripgrep spawn details.

d2ab2877a07a46bf2e58f1342b2c1925dde3bf16.title: spawnagents clarifies agenttype vs tool names
d2ab2877a07a46bf2e58f1342b2c1925dde3bf16.summary: Added explicit warning to `spawn-agents.ts` prompt instructing `agent_type` to accept only agent names, not tool names. Prevents misuse of `spawn_agents` for direct tool calls like `read_files` or `str_replace`. Scope limited to `common/src/tools/params/tool/spawn-agents.ts`. Reinforces existing guidance to call tools directly when not spawning agents.

ded7d682a8a671d9be16902cc4248528cffcfc62.title: Skip static generation for publisher and agent pages
ded7d682a8a671d9be16902cc4248528cffcfc62.summary: Removes generateStaticParams from web/src/app/publishers/[id]/page.tsx, web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/page.tsx, and web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx. Eliminates fetchAgentsForStaticParams and getCachedAgentsForStaticParams from web/src/server/agents-data.ts. Pages now render dynamically with 10-minute ISR revalidation, preventing build timeouts during static generation.

a207ad23c2e11b4963b3c78bb4b961eab5e182ca.title: Strong Subscription Backend
a207ad23c2e11b4963b3c78bb4b961eab5e182ca.summary: Added `Strong` subscription backend with three tiers ($100, $200, $500) defined in `common/src/constants/subscription-plans.ts`. New billing logic in `packages/billing/src/subscription.ts` handles block-based credit grants and weekly limits, integrated with Stripe webhooks in `subscription-webhooks.ts`. Grant priority for `subscription` set to 10 (highest) in `grant-priorities.ts`, preceding `free`, `referral`, and `ad` types. Database schema updated via migrations 0036-0038 to support subscription state and usage tracking.

5c129d57b23ad86db8cb9b7aacde501be26a9b4e.title: Thinking block collapse state now preview until next message
5c129d57b23ad86db8cb9b7aacde501be26a9b4e.summary: Thinking block UI replaces boolean isCollapsed with tri-state thinkingCollapseState ('expanded', 'preview', 'hidden') in types/chat.ts. Completed thinking blocks now show a 5-line preview instead of hiding content, driven by PREVIEW_LINE_COUNT in components/thinking.tsx. Scope limited to CLI components, hooks, and block utilities. Collapse-all operations map 'hidden' to thinkingCollapseState for thinking blocks while preserving isCollapsed for other block types.

5802e2b7bdcc4ff1fde7886bf0d390eee994c48b.title: Add codebuff login command for remote sessions
5802e2b7bdcc4ff1fde7886bf0d390eee994c48b.summary: Introduces `codebuff login` command to handle authentication outside the TUI, specifically for remote or SSH environments where clipboard integration fails. The new `runPlainLogin` function prints the login URL as plain text, allowing users to copy it via standard terminal selection. Updates `login-modal.tsx` to display a tip suggesting this command when `isRemoteSession()` detects an SSH connection. Implemented in `cli/src/login/plain-login.ts` with fallback logic for browser opening failures.

f1accc200beda280aa54011c8adfa8cc685d9355.title: AgentBranchWrapper setoutput lookup fixes max mode selection
f1accc200beda280aa54011c8adfa8cc685d9355.summary: AgentBranchWrapper now finds `set_output` tool block via `blocks.find` instead of assuming it is the last block. This ensures `implementationId` and `reason` are correctly extracted for max mode selection display. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/blocks/agent-branch-wrapper.tsx`.

389ccc13f7c34b2bf8d5fdd0580a7575e4dd6bcd.title: chore: remove agents/LESSONS.md
389ccc13f7c34b2bf8d5fdd0580a7575e4dd6bcd.summary: Deleted agents/LESSONS.md (1617 lines). Internal agent lessons from buffbench runs removed. Repo hygiene.

698b29200760a302869c6687ec3291d4f297bdb7.title: Collapsed tool output fills terminal width
698b29200760a302869c6687ec3291d4f297bdb7.summary: Collapsed tool call previews now stretch to full available terminal width. `tool-call-item.tsx` adds `width: '100%'` to the container and `wrapMode: 'word'` to the text node. This prevents premature truncation of preview text in wide terminals.

81e1be31c9ff2782d64d8f52e364e7d30548d8ed.title: Update file-picker test mocks to production spawnagents structure
81e1be31c9ff2782d64d8f52e364e7d30548d8ed.summary: Test mocks in agents/__tests__/file-picker.test.ts updated to match production spawn_agents output. Previous mocks lacked agentName and agentType fields, causing structural mismatch. Now wraps type and value inside agentName/agentType objects for accurate simulation.

389ccc13f7c34b2bf8d5fdd0580a7575e4dd6bcd.text: The team deleted an internal note file used by automated helpers. This change is purely for organization and has no effect on how the product works for you.

d2ab2877a07a46bf2e58f1342b2c1925dde3bf16.text: The assistant now clearly distinguishes between launching a helper and using a direct tool. This prevents errors when you ask it to perform a simple task, ensuring it acts correctly without confusion.

f1accc200beda280aa54011c8adfa8cc685d9355.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant sometimes showed wrong details for advanced options. This makes sure you see the right model and reason when you use those settings.

ded7d682a8a671d9be16902cc4248528cffcfc62.text: Publisher and agent pages now load on demand instead of being pre-built. This prevents the system from timing out during updates.

a207ad23c2e11b4963b3c78bb4b961eab5e182ca.text: The system now supports three paid subscription levels that provide more usage credits than free options. These paid credits are used first, ensuring your subscription benefits apply before any free or promotional credits.

aac0817bae2921bcaf1fa91be5e98b906b79260e.text: The assistant now correctly handles search requests when you include extra quotation marks around file names. This prevents errors and ensures searches work as expected.

5802e2b7bdcc4ff1fde7886bf0d390eee994c48b.text: Users can now sign in easily when working remotely by copying a simple link directly from the screen. This helps when automatic browser opening fails.

698b29200760a302869c6687ec3291d4f297bdb7.text: When you see a short summary of what the assistant did, it now uses the full width of your screen. This means you can read more of the summary without it getting cut off early.

81e1be31c9ff2782d64d8f52e364e7d30548d8ed.text: Internal test setup updated to match production data structure. No user-facing change.

5c129d57b23ad86db8cb9b7aacde501be26a9b4e.text: When the assistant finishes thinking, you now see a short preview of its reasoning instead of a collapsed line. This helps you understand how it reached its answer.

040c7041cf3f5140635b2492e337dacf384de2ee.title: Pre-validate spawnagents to prevent streaming invalid agents
040c7041cf3f5140635b2492e337dacf384de2ee.summary: Added pre-validation logic in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts` to filter out non-existent agents from `spawn_agents` calls before emitting the `tool_call` event. The executor now checks each agent against available templates and distinguishes between tool misuse and missing agents, returning specific error messages for invalid entries. If all agents are invalid, the tool call is aborted; if partial, it proceeds with only valid agents and emits an error chunk.

cc23c66e706d9816db3d96b53b50cf79385fa8f7.title: Remove main catch handler in CLI
cc23c66e706d9816db3d96b53b50cf79385fa8f7.summary: Removed `main().catch` block in `cli/src/index.tsx`, replacing it with `void main()`. Other process handlers now manage unhandled errors. Internal refactor.

a651504cd9ede56175ef9ff64e4a6b11e63238da.title: Fix file editing path traversal check
a651504cd9ede56175ef9ff64e4a6b11e63238da.summary: Replaced `containsPathTraversal` with `containsUpwardTraversal` in `sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts`. The new function normalizes `cwd` and checks for `..` to prevent false positives from legitimate paths containing double dots. This ensures accurate validation of the working directory before file changes.

d7b2ad8730aca61f27f58f37995ca05c83e5d68b.title: Update Jest config to exclude renamed playwright-runner.e2e.ts
d7b2ad8730aca61f27f58f37995ca05c83e5d68b.summary: Updated `web/jest.config.cjs` to ignore the renamed test file `playwright-runner.e2e.ts` instead of `playwright-runner.test.ts`. This ensures the Jest runner correctly excludes the e2e test from the unit test suite following its rename.

eb46bbff184fdb9b42ba8a4ed9d640eed47797b7.title: CLI clipboard OSC52 gated to remote SSH sessions
eb46bbff184fdb9b42ba8a4ed9d640eed47797b7.summary: Clipboard copy logic now checks SSH_CLIENT, SSH_TTY, or SSH_CONNECTION via isRemoteSession() in cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts. Local sessions prefer pbcopy/xclip/xsel/clip to avoid tmux OSC52 interference, falling back to OSC52. Remote sessions prefer OSC52 for client terminal clipboard integration. SSH environment variables added to CliEnv type in cli/src/types/env.ts and exposed via getCliEnv() in cli/src/utils/env.ts.

9389ab66cd4c47e106b2b4df3bf0d3bace3b0c69.title: Remove obsolete playwright-runner.test.ts
9389ab66cd4c47e106b2b4df3bf0d3bace3b0c69.summary: Deleted `web/src/__tests__/playwright-runner.test.ts`. File contained legacy Bun test wrapper spawning `bunx playwright test`. No active references remain. Internal cleanup only.

3a07ea51161e323d25c544e19dc49e6fb00bc2eb.title: SDK: Exclude reasoning deltas for OpenRouter/Codebuff
3a07ea51161e323d25c544e19dc49e6fb00bc2eb.summary: Added logic to skip yielding reasoning deltas when `exclude` is true in provider options for OpenRouter or Codebuff. This prevents internal reasoning text from leaking into stream outputs when explicitly disabled. The change is localized to `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` within the `promptAiSdkStream` function.

e32b581101f3fec2bbd000bd15aa0bbde2a77c51.title: Status-specific empty state labels for CLI proposal cards
e32b581101f3fec2bbd000bd15aa0bbde2a77c51.summary: ImplementorGroup now renders status-specific empty state labels (generating..., no changes, failed, cancelled) in proposal cards when fileStats.length === 0. Replaced two separate conditional blocks with single lookup into EMPTY_STATE_LABELS const. Scope: cli/src/components/blocks/implementor-row.tsx. Removed redundant 'waiting...' fallback; CompactFileStats no longer duplicates empty state check.

4215b8a2552107b82d15710d0839adeeaf8f7ff9.title: Add comprehensive clipboard tests for SSH-aware copy implementation
4215b8a2552107b82d15710d0839adeeaf8f7ff9.summary: Added `cli/src/utils/__tests__/clipboard.test.ts` covering `copyTextToClipboard` and `showClipboardMessage` mechanics. Tests verify subscription lifecycle, timer cancellation, empty-text early returns, and macOS `pbcopy` integration. Error paths for dual-method failure (platform tools + OSC52) are validated using mocked environments.

9054900a3f68da7de0acb4ae7d2047a95a3d9063.title: Revert agents deduplication refactor
9054900a3f68da7de0acb4ae7d2047a95a3d9063.summary: Reverts commit 'refactor(agents): deduplicate code and add documentation'. Removes shared helper functions (isObject, extractSpawnResults, etc.) from agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts and restores duplicated implementations inside handleStepsDefault and handleStepsMax to satisfy serialization constraints. Updates agents/context-pruner.ts to re-add 'DUPLICATE' warnings in comments for summarizeToolCall. Scope limited to internal agent logic files.

cc23c66e706d9816db3d96b53b50cf79385fa8f7.text: The way the app handles unexpected errors changed internally. Users should notice no difference.

4215b8a2552107b82d15710d0839adeeaf8f7ff9.text: The copy feature for remote connections now has thorough checks to make sure text saves correctly and error messages appear when needed. This improves reliability without changing how you use the app.

e32b581101f3fec2bbd000bd15aa0bbde2a77c51.text: The tool now shows clearer messages when a task produces no files, such as 'generating' or 'failed', instead of generic text.

a651504cd9ede56175ef9ff64e4a6b11e63238da.text: The app now checks file locations more accurately, so it won't block valid requests just because a name looks unusual. This internal fix helps ensure legitimate edits work smoothly.

d7b2ad8730aca61f27f58f37995ca05c83e5d68b.text: A small internal update ensures the system correctly ignores a renamed test file. This change does not affect how you use the product.

9054900a3f68da7de0acb4ae7d2047a95a3d9063.text: The assistant's internal file tools were updated to ensure they work correctly with the system's memory limits. This change fixes a technical issue behind the scenes and does not alter how you interact with the product.

040c7041cf3f5140635b2492e337dacf384de2ee.text: The system now checks if requested helper agents exist before starting tasks. If a helper is missing, it reports the error instead of failing silently or causing glitches.

eb46bbff184fdb9b42ba8a4ed9d640eed47797b7.text: Copying text works better when you connect remotely. Local use avoids glitches with special tools.

3a07ea51161e323d25c544e19dc49e6fb00bc2eb.text: The assistant now hides its internal thought process when you turn off that setting. This keeps the chat clean by showing only the final answer, not the reasoning steps behind it.

9389ab66cd4c47e106b2b4df3bf0d3bace3b0c69.text: The team removed an old, unused tool from the internal system. This change is for the developers only and does not affect how the product works.

d2d075805ca94adcb02e71fe10ad0ead8f35a163.title: Add /b/:hash redirect to go.trybeluga.ai
d2d075805ca94adcb02e71fe10ad0ead8f35a163.summary: Added redirect rule mapping /b/:hash to https://go.trybeluga.ai/:hash in web/next.config.mjs. Rule set to permanent: false. Scope limited to web config.

c70f2db602e84f2cf359b3c0afcac5f7c423abfd.title: Refactor agent context pruning and file picker
c70f2db602e84f2cf359b3c0afcac5f7c423abfd.summary: Refactored `agents/context-pruner.ts` and `agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts` to deduplicate code and add documentation. Extracted helper functions `isObject`, `extractSpawnResults`, `extractLastMessageText`, and `extractErrorMessage` in `file-picker.ts` to reduce repetition between `handleStepsDefault` and `handleStepsMax`. Updated JSDoc comments in `context-pruner.ts` to explicitly mark duplicated `summarizeToolCall` functions and their synchronization requirements.

017850d16cb9a501b22498e41f95630281cd8a4e.title: Preserve query params in affiliate redirects
017850d16cb9a501b22498e41f95630281cd8a4e.summary: Update `web/src/app/[sponsee]/page.tsx` to preserve incoming query parameters when redirecting to referral links. Previously, the redirect hardcoded only the `referrer` parameter, dropping any other query strings. The fix iterates over `searchParams` to rebuild the URL with all original keys and values before appending the `referrer`.

c933800c629cf3333831dc106304ec05f130035f.title: Add error handling and bounds checking to CLI and agents
c933800c629cf3333831dc106304ec05f130035f.summary: Hardened error handling in `agents/commander.ts` and `agents/thinker/thinker.ts` by validating missing parameters and assistant messages, yielding explicit error outputs instead of silent returns. `cli/src/chat.tsx` now catches promise rejections for image pasting and followup submissions, displaying transient clipboard messages on failure, while `cli/src/index.tsx` adds a global unhandled rejection handler to exit cleanly. Bounds checking in agent/file autocomplete prevents undefined access when `agentMatches` or `fileMatches` arrays are empty. SDK `run-state.ts` and `load-agents.ts` enrich debug logs with structured error objects during directory reads.

4b130fd1f9aae88598b93b00845ac841488c8c7a.title: Ctrl+T collapse-first toggle
4b130fd1f9aae88598b93b00845ac841488c8c7a.summary: Ctrl+T toggle inverts priority to collapse-first. Expands only when all blocks already collapsed. Affects `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-messages.ts` `handleToggleAll`.

629e391b0f39112acb57879f1e961bc40335ede4.title: JSON parse speedup, code-search race fix, BigQuery time bounds
629e391b0f39112acb57879f1e961bc40335ede4.summary: Rewrote partial JSON comma-backtracking to O(n) via `lastIndexOf` cursor in `partial-json-delta.ts`. `code-search.ts` stores `killTimeoutId` to prevent double-settlement and SIGKILL fallback on Windows. `getTracesWithoutRelabels` adds 30-day `created_at` bound and `@param` placeholders in `packages/bigquery/src/client.ts`. Covers common, SDK, and BigQuery.

ab76a003422420b5fc75e3c52c8003ebbf9e3d9c.title: CLI: extract store types to break circular dependency

This prevents failures when image paths are relative to a different working directory than the current `cwd`. The logic prioritizes pre-processed base64 data, falling back to disk processing only if `processedImage` is missing but status is 'ready'. Inline image paths detected in message content are processed separately, skipping any already handled by `pendingImages`.

62bfc2b932a5835c0fd87589df0c7ed95270d79d.title: Context pruner preserves last user images in summary
62bfc2b932a5835c0fd87589df0c7ed95270d79d.summary: Context pruner now extracts and retains `ImagePart`/`FilePart` objects from the most recent user message containing media before generating the `<conversation_summary>`. This prevents loss of visual context during aggressive pruning, ensuring the agent can reference images attached in the latest prompt even after older messages are condensed. The change is isolated to `agents/context-pruner.ts`, modifying the summary construction logic to append preserved media parts to the `UserMessage` content array.

e3b13bb549cad63cde06c932bab6b9f60450a0ca.title: Swap ad and referral grant priorities
e3b13bb549cad63cde06c932bab6b9f60450a0ca.summary: Reorders `GRANT_PRIORITIES` so `referral` (30) consumes before `ad` (40). Ensures one-time referral bonuses deplete ahead of renewable ad credits. Updates `common/src/constants/grant-priorities.ts` and `packages/billing/src/billing.knowledge.md`.

c1bf0a413a4381866be9c7a7b66c7f22f912a044.title: Hide copy button on empty user message in CLI
c1bf0a413a4381866be9c7a7b66c7f22f912a044.summary: Copy button suppressed when user message text is empty. `UserContentWithCopyButton` now checks `normalizedContent.length > 0` alongside `showCopyButton` in `cli/src/components/blocks/user-content-copy.tsx`. Scope limited to CLI user message blocks. Prevents rendering a non-functional copy affordance for whitespace-only or blank messages.

917fbccd9a4ced3c77b20ca144e2f252556275c9.title: Handle missing database in sitemap and static params fetch
917fbccd9a4ced3c77b20ca144e2f252556275c9.summary: Wrap fetchAgentsForSitemap and fetchAgentsForStaticParams in try/catch blocks in web/src/server/agents-data.ts. Return empty arrays and log warnings when database queries fail, preventing build crashes in CI environments without a database. Scope limited to server-side data fetching utilities. Static params fallback to runtime rendering when database is unavailable.

c707102f3545a81a8d29c3babaad2c42d6ac4240.title: CLI image attachment race condition and path fixes
c707102f3545a81a8d29c3babaad2c42d6ac4240.summary: ImageCard and ImageThumbnail skip processing/error states and use processedImage base64 to prevent race conditions. extractThumbnailColors accepts Buffer or string. validateAndAddImage uses resolvedPath for error reporting. Fixes inline image rendering in cli/src/components/image-card.tsx, cli/src/components/image-thumbnail.tsx, cli/src/utils/image-thumbnail.ts, and cli/src/utils/pending-attachments.ts.

8565c2d0deb416b5b1d8ac874a160b0d2c52c67b.title: Add build wrapper script for better error logging on Render
8565c2d0deb416b5b1d8ac874a160b0d2c52c67b.summary: Replaced the inline Next.js build command in package.json with a dedicated Bun script, web/scripts/build.ts. This wrapper captures full build output to build.log, filters noisy Contentlayer warnings from console display, and logs timing/memory stats. On failure, the full log is displayed to aid debugging on Render; on success, it triggers prebuild-agents-cache validation.

58a002be82a21979669f2369ca35ac3c81a508ce.text: The assistant now knows it cannot remember files or conversations from earlier steps. It must be given all needed information again to do its job correctly.

c1bf0a413a4381866be9c7a7b66c7f22f912a044.text: The copy button is now hidden for empty messages. This prevents a broken button from appearing when there is no text to copy.

62bfc2b932a5835c0fd87589df0c7ed95270d79d.text: The assistant now keeps the most recent images you upload, even when it shortens older chat history. This ensures it can still see and reference those pictures in your latest request.

977816fea610bf712feeec52af289d8cfd261ff4.text: A small internal fix cleaned up background test noise and standardized file paths on Mac.

8565c2d0deb416b5b1d8ac874a160b0d2c52c67b.text: This internal change helps the team spot and fix problems faster. It does not affect how the product works for users.

a9f900271908d9a3951b71c2cec947fb4e1a8ec3.text: The assistant now uses already-prepared image data instead of searching for the original file. This prevents errors when sending images if the file location has changed.

917fbccd9a4ced3c77b20ca144e2f252556275c9.text: The website now handles database errors more gracefully by showing an empty list instead of crashing. This prevents build failures in certain environments.

e3b13bb549cad63cde06c932bab6b9f60450a0ca.text: One-time referral bonuses now spend before renewable ad credits.

8cb6a827a8a3e377340841d9d1dd8eaa08552106.text: The system now records token counting requests in its internal activity log instead of sending them to a separate tracking service. This change is internal and does not affect how the feature works for users.

c707102f3545a81a8d29c3babaad2c42d6ac4240.text: Fixed a bug that caused images to sometimes fail to display or show errors in the command-line interface. Images now load reliably.

1dfb2cb4e583c9c41350c2306e1bbf9a10b8ce6b.title: openai-compatible generate missing tool call id
1dfb2cb4e583c9c41350c2306e1bbf9a10b8ce6b.summary: openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts generates missing tool call IDs via generateId() instead of throwing InvalidResponseDataError. Handles providers like GLM omitting IDs in streaming deltas. Internal package fix, no user-facing surface change.

fb0fd39bb4b0c3c78308e015328465970c37c42b.title: Remove readsubtree from file-lister agent
fb0fd39bb4b0c3c78308e015328465970c37c42b.summary: File-lister agent in agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts no longer uses the read_subtree tool. The toolNames array is cleared, preventing the agent from traversing the filesystem subtree. This change restricts the file-lister's capabilities to its core listing function.

a6526e0ba5aa3455b1ca4045b2d268af6cdf3d22.title: CLI handles native reasoning blocks in agent streams
a6526e0ba5aa3455b1ca4045b2d268af6cdf3d22.summary: CLI now parses native reasoning chunks for agent blocks instead of relying solely on think tag parsing. `block-operations.ts` adds `appendNativeReasoningToBlocks` and `closeNativeReasoningBlock` to manage `textType: 'reasoning'` states, while `stream-chunk-processor.ts` propagates `textType` to agent destinations. `sdk-event-handlers.ts` ensures reasoning blocks close before tool calls execute.

581659ac47ae5409e0f598807b3842d7487eb651.title: Refine askuser guidance in base2 agent
581659ac47ae5409e0f598807b3842d7487eb651.summary: Updated prompt instructions for the `ask_user` tool in `agents/base2/base2.ts`. The guidance now explicitly restricts usage to non-obvious choices, removing ambiguity about when to skip the step. This change applies to the base2 agent configuration.

e8d70e5016ac1950e34efe657bfe86360a5a2cef.title: Preserve partial responses on request cancel
e8d70e5016ac1950e34efe657bfe86360a5a2cef.summary: SDK `run.ts` preserves partial streamed content and appends interruption messages to `sessionState` when `signal.aborted` is true. CLI `send-message.ts` skips `handleRunCompletion` if `wasAbortedByUser` is set, preventing UI interference. Covers SDK core and CLI hooks.

7824e45e34da353dcdcc70c4cf54144f4d2d782f.title: CLI loads agents from ~/.agents global directory
7824e45e34da353dcdcc70c4cf54144f4d2d782f.summary: initializeAgentRegistry now scans ~/.agents in addition to project and parent directories via getDefaultAgentDirs(). Precedence order is cwd, parent, then home, allowing project agents to override global ones. buildAgentFilePathMap accepts an array of directories instead of a single path. This change affects cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts.

3e4406e582fdbde3d55264470fbdb1566ab8deca.title: Skip Gravity ads in compact non-free CLI layouts
3e4406e582fdbde3d55264470fbdb1566ab8deca.summary: use-gravity-ad.ts suppresses ad fetching, impression recording, and rendering when terminalHeight <= 17, gated by agentMode !== 'FREE'. Uses shouldHideAdsRef to guard async fetchAd and recordImpressionOnce calls. FREE mode retains mandatory ads on compact screens. Scope limited to CLI Gravity ad hook via use-terminal-layout and useChatStore selectors.

87f7793bb5a8970d47a8e54e171387551ae1c64a.title: GPT-5 general agent omits file-picker
87f7793bb5a8970d47a8e54e171387551ae1c64a.summary: GPT-5 general agent excludes `file-picker` from `spawnableAgents` and drops related guidance from `instructionsPrompt`. Prevents repeated full-file reads by GPT-5. Scoped to `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts` via conditional `buildArray` logic.

88c20d8c1cd5cfd16164b551ea88daea3360cec2.title: FREE mode replaces LITE, forces ads, zero-cost billing
88c20d8c1cd5cfd16164b551ea88daea3360cec2.summary: CLI and agent runtime introduce FREE mode, replacing LITE. `base2-free.ts` spawns `commander-lite` and `editor-glm` via `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast`. `--lite` flag deprecated in favor of `--free`. `getAdsEnabled` hardcodes `true` for FREE mode; `use-gravity-ad` sends mode to API to block credit grants. `AGENT_MODE_TO_COST_MODE` maps FREE to 'free' cost mode, passing `costMode` to `createRunConfig` for zero-credit allowlisted combos. Thinking block completion logic simplified in `thinking-block.tsx` and `message-updater.ts` to auto-collapse native reasoning on message end.

c1d136969c18ef32ecf0f4344f4f50bd7dae232c.title: Add skill support to CLI and agent runtime
c1d136969c18ef32ecf0f4344f4f50bd7dae232c.summary: Introduces a skill system allowing agents to load on-demand instructions via the new `skill` tool. CLI startup initializes a skill registry from `.agents/skills`, exposing each skill as a dynamic slash command (`/skill:<name>`) and a tool call. The `base2` agent now includes the `skill` tool, enabling it to fetch and apply skill context during execution. Covers core constants, CLI UI components, and SDK loading logic.

88c20d8c1cd5cfd16164b551ea88daea3360cec2.text: The basic free version now shows ads and does not use up your paid credits. The old 'lite' option is gone, replaced by this ad-supported mode.

3e4406e582fdbde3d55264470fbdb1566ab8deca.text: The app now hides ads in the command-line interface when the window is small. This only applies to paid accounts, so the free version still shows ads.

fb0fd39bb4b0c3c78308e015328465970c37c42b.text: The file lister can no longer browse through folders. It now only shows the files you ask for directly.

a6526e0ba5aa3455b1ca4045b2d268af6cdf3d22.text: The assistant now processes its internal thought steps more reliably. This helps keep its reasoning separate from its actions, so it can think clearly before doing work.

c1d136969c18ef32ecf0f4344f4f50bd7dae232c.text: The assistant can now use extra skills to help with specific tasks. You can activate these skills by typing a special command or letting the assistant choose them when needed.

1dfb2cb4e583c9c41350c2306e1bbf9a10b8ce6b.text: The assistant now automatically assigns a label to tool requests when the underlying system forgets to do so, preventing errors. This internal fix improves stability without changing how the product works for users.

e8d70e5016ac1950e34efe657bfe86360a5a2cef.text: If you stop a response while it is still typing, the text written so far is kept. The chat history now shows this partial answer instead of losing it.

7824e45e34da353dcdcc70c4cf54144f4d2d782f.text: The assistant now checks a central folder on your computer for custom instructions, in addition to the current project folder. This means you can set up agents once and use them across all your projects, but project-specific settings still take priority.

581659ac47ae5409e0f598807b3842d7487eb651.text: The assistant now only asks for your input when a choice is unclear, skipping unnecessary questions. This makes interactions faster and less disruptive.

87f7793bb5a8970d47a8e54e171387551ae1c64a.text: The general assistant can no longer automatically use the file-picker tool. This stops it from repeatedly reading entire files.

9ac31fc961a4bc7e606903940a41575986e05e3e.title: context-pruner captures strreplace and writefile diffs
9ac31fc961a4bc7e606903940a41575986e05e3e.summary: Context pruner now includes diff results from `str_replace` and `write_file` tool messages in its summary. This ensures the agent retains visibility of file changes made during execution. The logic truncates diffs exceeding 2000 characters to manage context window size. Implemented in `agents/context-pruner.ts`.

f8e5c97566f5e2a7b6308e872a6680af67a7a983.title: CLI routes terminal detection through getCliEnv
f8e5c97566f5e2a7b6308e872a6680af67a7a983.summary: Clipboard OSC52 sequences and terminal title builders now read TERM, TMUX, and STY via getCliEnv instead of direct process.env access. This fixes process.env enforcement errors by centralizing terminal detection variables in CliEnv type and utils/env.ts. Scope limited to CLI core: types/env.ts, utils/clipboard.ts, utils/env.ts, utils/terminal-title.ts. tmux/screen DCS passthrough logic remains unchanged, only the variable source shifts.

69aaa1afdea79b06bc74e93f2f8359dda18c92f0.title: General agent adds context-pruner and loops steps
69aaa1afdea79b06bc74e93f2f8359dda18c92f0.summary: General agent now runs `context-pruner` before each step via `spawn_agent_inline` and loops until `stepsComplete`. Prompts clarify lack of conversation history, requiring explicit context in `prompt` or `filePaths`. `instructionsPrompt` tightened to focus on parallel spawning. Scope limited to `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts`.

bb10b2d58731901f13f442a1d7875288169459b0.title: GLM 4.7 editor added for Lite mode
bb10b2d58731901f13f442a1d7875288169459b0.summary: New `editor-glm` agent definition added to `agents/editor/editor-glm.ts`, replacing `editor-gpt-5` in Lite mode. `createCodeEditor` in `agents/editor/editor.ts` updated to accept `'glm'` model option, mapping to `z-ai/glm-4.7`. `agents/base2/base2.ts` updated to spawn `editor-glm` instead of `editor-gpt-5` for Lite mode prompts. GLM and GPT-5 models skip `<think>` tag prompting in editor instructions.

a5c382cba60723c7dfb4344f08b88647597f9b3c.title: Reduce chat history load limit to 500 and skip empty chats
a5c382cba60723c7dfb4344f08b88647597f9b3c.summary: Chat history loading caps at 500 chats (down from 1000) and filters out entries with zero messages. Adjusted `BACKGROUND_CHATS` constant in `chat-history-screen.tsx` and added `messageCount > 0` check in `getAllChats` within `chat-history.ts`. This prevents UI clutter and unnecessary processing of empty chat logs.

5938b0ea4263eb3aba69afa997e50c666e945103.title: CLI updates terminal title per user input
5938b0ea4263eb3aba69afa997e50c666e945103.summary: The CLI now sets the terminal window title to the user's current input, prefixed with 'Codebuff: '. This uses OSC escape sequences written directly to `/dev/tty` to bypass OpenTUI's stdout capture. Titles are truncated to 60 characters and sanitized. The title resets to default on exit via `renderer-cleanup.ts`. tmux and screen passthrough are handled automatically.

456cd9e491d89f4f4162d9ded9bd4c7b372ad80f.title: Researcher agents switch to grok-4.1-fast
456cd9e491d89f4f4162d9ded9bd4c7b372ad80f.summary: researcher-docs and researcher-web agent definitions bump model from x-ai/grok-4-fast to x-ai/grok-4.1-fast. Scope limited to agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts and agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts. Only the model string changes; prompts, schemas, and IDs remain identical.

db4d9fd47ecbcf0c9e8c20f1195d3a717950af92.title: Add OSC52 clipboard support to CLI
db4d9fd47ecbcf0c9e8c20f1195d3a717950af92.summary: Added OSC52 escape sequence support to `cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts` for cross-platform clipboard copying, particularly over SSH or headless environments. The implementation attempts OSC52 first, falling back to platform-specific tools (`pbcopy`, `xclip`, `xsel`, `clip`) if it fails. Includes handling for tmux and GNU screen passthrough wrapping, with a 32KB payload limit.

d85c249c33b9f7060bef187ce95c6ca27c67f3e4.title: Add researcher-web and researcher-docs to free agents
d85c249c33b9f7060bef187ce95c6ca27c67f3e4.summary: Added 'researcher-web' and 'researcher-docs' to the FREE_TIER_AGENTS set in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. This grants these agents free tier access, expanding available research capabilities. The change affects the core agent constants used by CLI and Web surfaces.

9ac31fc961a4bc7e606903940a41575986e05e3e.text: The assistant now keeps track of file changes it makes during tasks. This helps it remember what it did, even if the list of changes is very long.

a5c382cba60723c7dfb4344f08b88647597f9b3c.text: The chat list now shows fewer recent conversations and hides empty ones, reducing clutter and speeding up loading.

db4d9fd47ecbcf0c9e8c20f1195d3a717950af92.text: The command-line tool can now copy text to your clipboard when you use it over a remote connection. If that doesn't work, it still tries standard local copy methods.

5938b0ea4263eb3aba69afa997e50c666e945103.text: The terminal window title now displays your current input. This helps you identify which session is active.

3a1a7407db87eb9399a8c6c9d0ec1e07e80be1ac.text: The app now clearly states that connecting your Claude subscription is not officially supported by Anthropic. This warning appears on pricing pages and help articles to keep you informed before you link your account.

69aaa1afdea79b06bc74e93f2f8359dda18c92f0.text: The assistant now clears old details before each task to stay focused and repeats steps until finished. It no longer remembers past chats automatically, so you must include all needed information in your request.

f8e5c97566f5e2a7b6308e872a6680af67a7a983.text: The app now checks your computer's settings in a safer way to decide how to handle copy-paste and window titles. This fixes errors that happened when those settings were missing or unusual. No new features were added.

bb10b2d58731901f13f442a1d7875288169459b0.text: The editor now uses a different AI model in Lite mode. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

d85c249c33b9f7060bef187ce95c6ca27c67f3e4.text: Two new research tools are now included in the free plan. This lets users access these web and document search features without paying extra.

456cd9e491d89f4f4162d9ded9bd4c7b372ad80f.text: The research assistant now uses a newer, faster brain. This small update may help it find answers quicker, but works the same way otherwise.

c2565033906c4cecd55c4a6686592043c9278430.title: Reorder agent slash commands in CLI picker
c2565033906c4cecd55c4a6686592043c9278430.summary: Moved `agent:gpt-5` and `agent:opus` entries earlier in the `SLASH_COMMANDS` array within `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. This change places agent spawning commands above utility commands like `feedback` and `publish` in the CLI autocomplete picker. The reorder improves discoverability for frequently used agent commands without altering their functionality or insertion text.

0ec370051bbc449cc1a5c9e6f27409a39074755e.title: GPT-5 Agent reasoning config and prompt tweaks
0ec370051bbc449cc1a5c9e6f27409a39074755e.summary: GPT-5 Agent reasoningOptions simplified: drop `enabled` and `exclude`, keep `effort: 'high'`. instructionsPrompt rephrased to mandate `file-picker` spawning when relevant. Scope: `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`, `.vscode/settings.json`. TS formatter switched to built-in language features.

4397bbce21cfa5d71613b14afd999451151da269.title: Docs and web search endpoints charge zero credits
4397bbce21cfa5d71613b14afd999451151da269.summary: Hardcoded `creditsToCharge = 0` in `docs-search` and `web-search` API handlers. Removed `PROFIT_MARGIN` import and base cost calculations. Scope limited to `web/src/app/api/v1/`. Note comment says 'Temporarily free'.

3a4698ee18389356fe27a47f5ecb111b39407018.title: Add env var substitution for MCP config
3a4698ee18389356fe27a47f5ecb111b39407018.summary: Adds substituteEnvInValue and substituteEnvInRecord helpers in common/src/mcp/client.ts to expand $VAR_NAME references within MCP configuration values. These helpers process stdio transport envs, and http/sse transport headers, interpolating strings like 'Bearer $TOKEN'. If a referenced environment variable is undefined, the original literal string is preserved.

1aee04f6146e1a59321904e111fb04c6e80d5830.title: Add /agent:opus slash command, rename gpt-5-agent to agent:gpt-5
1aee04f6146e1a59321904e111fb04c6e80d5830.summary: cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts adds agent:opus (Opus agent) and renames gpt-5-agent to agent:gpt-5. IDs and labels switch to colon format. Descriptions change from Mention to Spawn. Affects CLI slash command picker only.

210383f7118a24e3a1116589360867c2ff64113e.title: Fallback commander to commander-lite in spawnagents
210383f7118a24e3a1116589360867c2ff64113e.summary: Adds transformSpawnAgentsInput to rewrite agent_type from 'commander' to 'commander-lite' when the former is unavailable in spawnableAgents. Applied in tool-executor.ts before UI streaming and handler execution to ensure consistent agent resolution. Scope limited to packages/agent-runtime. Transformation checks availability via getMatchingSpawn, falling back only if commander-lite exists; otherwise validation handles the error.

707cfbdfd246191b5c2d7fc504c17cdd3ff1d922.title: gpt-5-agent instructs parallel agent spawning
707cfbdfd246191b5c2d7fc504c17cdd3ff1d922.summary: Added `instructionsPrompt` to `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`. Directs model to use `spawn_agents` for parallel execution, prioritizing `file-picker` and batch reads. Scope limited to `gpt-5-agent` definition.

abaf6a1f5f527cefccbffbe1290a64ae4d56158c.title: Opus agent added to general agent factory
abaf6a1f5f527cefccbffbe1290a64ae4d56158c.summary: New `opus-agent` definition added alongside `gpt-5-agent` in `agents/general-agent/`. Both now share a factory `createGeneralAgent` in `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts`, replacing the standalone `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`. `base2.ts` spawns both `opus-agent` and `gpt-5-agent` when `isDefault || isMax`.

a31f085d483da7af1cd15b0786989c67e7d75b4f.title: Fix /gpt-5-agent slash command to insert @GPT-5 Agent
a31f085d483da7af1cd15b0786989c67e7d75b4f.summary: The /gpt-5-agent slash command now inserts '@GPT-5 Agent ' into the input field, replacing the previous '@gpt-5-agent ' string. This corrects the agent mention format to match the expected UI display. The change is scoped to cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts and cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts, with refactoring in cli/src/chat.tsx to share insertText logic. The command remains a UI shortcut and does not execute a backend action.

dd9233db8bf1da33155ac59fdb56f2787a42b1df.title: Gravity ads cache and cycle when fetches stop
dd9233db8bf1da33155ac59fdb56f2787a42b1df.summary: cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts caches fetched ads and cycles them when new fetches stop, replacing the hard rotation pause after 3 ads without activity. The hook tracks idle state via isUserActive with a 30s threshold, pausing new fetches while continuing to serve cached ads. Controller state is consolidated into a single ref, replacing multiple refs and useCallback chains.

4397bbce21cfa5d71613b14afd999451151da269.text: Searching documentation and the web now costs zero credits. This internal change temporarily makes those features free to use.

210383f7118a24e3a1116589360867c2ff64113e.text: If the main assistant cannot run, it now automatically switches to a simpler backup assistant. This keeps things working instead of failing, but the backup may be less capable.

abaf6a1f5f527cefccbffbe1290a64ae4d56158c.text: The assistant can now use a new model alongside the existing one. This gives the system more options for handling your requests.

c2565033906c4cecd55c4a6686592043c9278430.text: Agent commands moved up in the menu. You see them before other options now.

1aee04f6146e1a59321904e111fb04c6e80d5830.text: The assistant gained a new option to use a different model. The names of these options changed format. This only affects the list of commands you see when typing in the tool.

3a4698ee18389356fe27a47f5ecb111b39407018.text: The assistant can now automatically use secret keys stored on your computer when connecting to other services. If a key is missing, the setup remains unchanged.

dd9233db8bf1da33155ac59fdb56f2787a42b1df.text: Ads now stay on screen longer when you stop using the tool. This removes the annoying gap between ads.

707cfbdfd246191b5c2d7fc504c17cdd3ff1d922.text: The assistant now splits large tasks into smaller pieces and works on them at the same time. This helps it finish reading many files or answering complex questions faster.

a31f085d483da7af1cd15b0786989c67e7d75b4f.text: The command now inserts the correct name for the assistant, matching how it appears on screen. This is a small fix to make the text look right.

0ec370051bbc449cc1a5c9e6f27409a39074755e.text: The assistant now has clearer rules for when to open a file picker. This small update helps it choose the right tool for your request.

2f5d2bb93997374602839e7dbfff2de2b8719926.title: Tweak /new description
2f5d2bb93997374602839e7dbfff2de2b8719926.summary: Updated the description for the `/new` slash command in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. The text now reads 'Clear the conversation history and start a new chat' instead of 'Start a fresh conversation session'.

e70fc1ca89bf5cd55b9d363c6e664f22f2d77c8b.title: Remove CLI options section from README
e70fc1ca89bf5cd55b9d363c6e664f22f2d77c8b.summary: Removed the 'CLI Options' section from README.md, deleting documentation for flags like `--lite`, `--max`, `--ask`, and `--print`. Renamed 'File Explorer Agent' to 'File Picker Agent' in the agent workflow description. This cleanup reduces redundancy and aligns the documentation with current CLI behavior.

3dc91a3b5150512e5dd6a50f2dd0b7ece1ffe63e.title: Advisory lock health check verifies ownership via pglocks
3dc91a3b5150512e5dd6a50f2dd0b7ece1ffe63e.summary: Advisory lock health check now queries pg_locks to verify specific lock ownership instead of just checking connection liveness. Interval reduced from 30s to 10s to detect lost locks faster. Covers packages/internal/src/db/advisory-lock.ts. Triggers lost callback if lock is no longer held despite active connection.

0b7270dbdf852a3793ab1360616c298a9c72dbe1.title: Set TSX default formatter to vscode.typescript-language-features
0b7270dbdf852a3793ab1360616c298a9c72dbe1.summary: Changed `.vscode/settings.json` to set `editor.defaultFormatter` for `typescriptreact` from `esbenp.prettier-vscode` to `vscode.typescript-language-features`. This aligns TSX formatting with the built-in TypeScript language service. Scope limited to repo-wide VS Code settings. No action required.

eb114327c233844252811cb7f72e018741ef385f.title: Fix login modal clipboard errors and enable text selection
eb114327c233844252811cb7f72e018741ef385f.summary: Login modal replaces TerminalLink with selectable text and removes direct browser open to fix clipboard errors. `useClipboard` tracks selection state for visual feedback, while `copyTextToClipboard` discards stderr via `stdio` options to prevent TUI corruption on headless servers. Keyboard handlers now fire-and-forget async copy operations. Changes affect CLI components and hooks, specifically `login-modal.tsx`, `use-clipboard.ts`, and `clipboard.ts`.

62aab4646bf93c3a7250f17ab807832f6ec950dd.title: /gpt-5-agent inserts @gpt-5-agent mention
62aab4646bf93c3a7250f17ab807832f6ec950dd.summary: Added /gpt-5-agent slash command to cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts with insertText '@gpt-5-agent '. cli/src/chat.tsx now checks selected.insertText before executing, splicing text into inputValue and updating cursorPosition. SlashCommand interface gains optional insertText field. Insertion bypasses onSubmitPrompt, leaving the mention for further input.

ad6b2bc5fef693393229939e7dc73b212d15902e.title: CLI login modal adds explicit copy button and SSH URL display
ad6b2bc5fef693393229939e7dc73b212d15902e.summary: Replaced auto-clipboard copy on browser launch with an explicit `Copy link (c)` button and persistent URL display in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx`. The modal now shows the login URL immediately after pressing Enter, catering to SSH users where `open()` fails to launch a browser. Clipboard failures are silently handled since the URL is always visible for manual copying. Scope limited to CLI core login flow.

54212111ae03462e4a07daa3346cdd26ae6da731.title: Hide landing page knowledge and competition sections
54212111ae03462e4a07daa3346cdd26ae6da731.summary: Comment out FeatureSection and CompetitionSection in web/src/app/home-client.tsx. Removes 'Better and Better Over Time' knowledge feature and competition comparison from landing page. Scope limited to web app home-client.tsx. Sections hidden via JSX comments, not deleted.

1ad96664363a1ba4ea7428cb82a6234ecf01ba04.title: Rename gpt-5-thinker to gpt-5-agent with file edit tools
1ad96664363a1ba4ea7428cb82a6234ecf01ba04.summary: Renamed agent `thinker-gpt-5` to `gpt-5-agent` in `agents/base2/base2.ts` and `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`. Added `read_subtree`, `str_replace`, and `write_file` to `toolNames` and enabled high-effort reasoning. Updated spawner prompt to reflect general-purpose deep-thinking role.

9982f5a561976355256ecea412861e4c9d7db730.title: Update hero tagline and subheading in web UI
9982f5a561976355256ecea412861e4c9d7db730.summary: Hero tagline changed from 'Supercharge Your AI Coding' to 'Better agents. Better code.' in `web/src/components/ui/hero.tsx`. Subheading updated to claim '100+ seconds faster than Claude Code with higher-quality output'.

1ad96664363a1ba4ea7428cb82a6234ecf01ba04.text: The thinking assistant was renamed to better match its job. It gained new tools to read and edit files while thinking more deeply.

2f5d2bb93997374602839e7dbfff2de2b8719926.text: The text explaining the 'new chat' button changed. It now clearly states that using it will erase previous messages and start fresh.

e70fc1ca89bf5cd55b9d363c6e664f22f2d77c8b.text: The product guide removed outdated instructions about settings that no longer exist and renamed a feature to match how it actually works. This change only updates the text users read, so the software itself behaves exactly the same.

54212111ae03462e4a07daa3346cdd26ae6da731.text: The landing page no longer shows sections about knowledge features and competition comparisons. This is a small internal change that only affects what new visitors see.

eb114327c233844252811cb7f72e018741ef385f.text: The login screen now lets you select and copy text without errors. This makes logging in smoother, especially when using the command line.

62aab4646bf93c3a7250f17ab807832f6ec950dd.text: Typing a specific command now automatically adds a mention to the text box, letting you continue writing without submitting the message immediately.

0b7270dbdf852a3793ab1360616c298a9c72dbe1.text: The system now uses its built-in tool to organize code, replacing a separate helper. This internal change affects how developers write code, but you will not notice any difference in the product.

9982f5a561976355256ecea412861e4c9d7db730.text: The website's main text was updated to say it is faster and produces better results than a competitor.

3dc91a3b5150512e5dd6a50f2dd0b7ece1ffe63e.text: The system now checks more often if it still holds a key safety lock. This helps it notice and fix problems faster.

ad6b2bc5fef693393229939e7dc73b212d15902e.text: When signing in from a remote computer, the login link now stays on the screen with a copy button. This helps you sign in even if your web browser does not open automatically.

17b2faee10d38e7fa62cff639e53f4301b87efdc.title: Move agents to agents-graveyard
17b2faee10d38e7fa62cff639e53f4301b87efdc.summary: Move agents to agents-graveyard. Rename `agents/` to `agents-graveyard/` in repo. Internal refactor.

02c7a7881109b432b27948add88d805127f1447b.title: File-picker agents exempt from credit billing
02c7a7881109b432b27948add88d805127f1447b.summary: Lightweight utility agents (file-picker, file-picker-max, file-lister) now bypass credit consumption when costs are under 5 credits. New `isFreeAgent` helper in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` parses agent IDs to identify free-tier agents, preventing unexpected charges for BYOK users. `web/src/llm-api/helpers.ts` updates `consumeCreditsForMessage` to return the actual billed amount, while `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` overwrites response costs with a fake value derived from billed credits to ensure SDK consistency.

fcf9b5e0e6941dee5525d40ba7b0eb2bbd95d96b.title: Fix base2 agent spawn typo
fcf9b5e0e6941dee5525d40ba7b0eb2bbd95d96b.summary: Corrected agent name in base2.ts prompt instructions. `reviewer-editor-gpt-5` changed to `code-reviewer-multi-prompt` for max mode. Ensures correct agent spawning logic.

46b2addbb1aaf17bbcd1414c252fc42cd4c8bf53.title: Fix imports in agents-graveyard and eval-task-generator
46b2addbb1aaf17bbcd1414c252fc42cd4c8bf53.summary: Corrected relative import paths for agents in `agents-graveyard` to point to `../../agents/` instead of `../`. Updated `eval-task-generator.ts` to import `file-explorer` and `find-all-referencer` from `agents-graveyard` instead of `agents`. Scope covers `agents-graveyard` files and `evals/buffbench`. Resolves broken module resolution after file moves.

02cb2e5dec72fa2cd02ca6759644f7429f3a6dc4.title: Rename CLI task-complete component to task-completed
02cb2e5dec72fa2cd02ca6759644f7429f3a6dc4.summary: Renamed `cli/src/components/tools/task-complete.tsx` to `task-completed.tsx` to match the `task_completed` tool name. Updated `registry.ts` import path. Removed outdated docstring comment.

11c14d9693c7f917299bcfe143218701ec49f651.title: Add thinker-gpt-5 agent
11c14d9693c7f917299bcfe143218701ec49f651.summary: Added `thinker-gpt-5` agent definition in `agents/thinker/thinker-gpt-5.ts` using model `openai/gpt-5.2`. Base2 agent (`agents/base2/base2.ts`) now includes `thinker-gpt-5` in spawnable lists for default and max modes. Prompts updated to mark `thinker-gpt-5` as a last resort for complex problems.

ed0e89912bdc9cf6a9f142aaeca9309a8754f745.title: Remove spawnagents match log in CLI SDK event handlers
ed0e89912bdc9cf6a9f142aaeca9309a8754f745.summary: Deleted state.logger.info call in handleSubagentStart within cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts. Log emitted tempId, realAgentId, agentType, hasParentAgentId on spawnAgentMatch. Scope limited to CLI SDK event handling. No functional change to block resolution.

036646e54d2c99d09c563b83e871401975df327e.title: CLI help banner structured layout
036646e54d2c99d09c563b83e871401975df327e.summary: Refactored cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx from a single text string to a component tree. Introduced SectionHeader and Shortcut components using useTheme for consistent styling. Organized content into Shortcuts, Features, and Credits sections with flexbox layouts. Added /usage command visibility in credits section.

830dba304fb3ad006f48dc4fbdb92f4a43ee1ff5.title: Ctrl+T toggles collapse/expand all in CLI chat
830dba304fb3ad006f48dc4fbdb92f4a43ee1ff5.summary: New Ctrl+T keyboard shortcut collapses or expands all collapsible blocks (thinking, agent, tool, agent-list) across all AI responses in the CLI chat view. `handleToggleAll` in `use-chat-messages.ts` calls `setAllBlocksCollapsedState` from new `cli/src/utils/collapse-helpers.ts`, which recursively walks message trees and flips `isCollapsed` on every collapsible block. If any block is expanded, Ctrl+T collapses all; otherwise it expands all. Wired through `keyboard-actions.ts` as a priority-11 action dispatched via `use-chat-keyboard.ts` `onToggleAll`, surfaced in `help-banner.tsx` shortcuts list.

26d1d5313ea418fe17cbba0019e09fda3a4d2238.title: Fix stale state in multiline-input during IME rapid keystrokes
26d1d5313ea418fe17cbba0019e09fda3a4d2238.summary: MultilineInput now reads from synchronous refs for value and cursor position during text insertion. This prevents stale closure errors when IME sends rapid multi-character events, ensuring each keystroke builds on the previous state. Affects `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. Refs are updated synchronously before `onChange` to bypass React batching delays.

830dba304fb3ad006f48dc4fbdb92f4a43ee1ff5.text: Pressing Ctrl+T now hides or shows all the detailed steps in the chat window at once. This helps you quickly switch between seeing just the final answers and reviewing how the assistant reached them.

02cb2e5dec72fa2cd02ca6759644f7429f3a6dc4.text: The assistant now uses a clearer name for the task that marks work as finished. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

26d1d5313ea418fe17cbba0019e09fda3a4d2238.text: Fixed a bug where typing quickly with a foreign keyboard could cause text to disappear or appear in the wrong order. Now, every keystroke is recorded correctly, so your text stays accurate.

fcf9b5e0e6941dee5525d40ba7b0eb2bbd95d96b.text: A small internal fix corrected the name of an assistant used for reviewing code. This ensures the right helper is chosen when using the advanced review mode.

17b2faee10d38e7fa62cff639e53f4301b87efdc.text: The team moved some old assistant features to a separate storage area. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

ed0e89912bdc9cf6a9f142aaeca9309a8754f745.text: The app stopped saving a hidden note about how it starts background helpers. This cleanup has no effect on how the product works for you.

02c7a7881109b432b27948add88d805127f1447b.text: Simple file tools now cost nothing if they are cheap to run. This prevents unexpected charges for users who bring their own access keys.

036646e54d2c99d09c563b83e871401975df327e.text: The help screen now displays information in organized sections. This makes shortcuts and features easier to find.

46b2addbb1aaf17bbcd1414c252fc42cd4c8bf53.text: The assistant can now find some older tools that were moved to a new location. This fixes an issue where the assistant could not use those tools to help with tasks.

11c14d9693c7f917299bcfe143218701ec49f651.text: The assistant can now use a new, more powerful model to solve difficult problems. It will only use this option when other methods fail, so answers for complex tasks may improve.

56c6c89e0bbe5b442de910c19144193edd842de6.title: Billing test mocks return AdvisoryLockTransactionResult shape
