93fed7acb54103cc815ec637f2fce59ddc608c6c.title: Introduce <think> tag instruction to base2 agent prompts
93fed7acb54103cc815ec637f2fce59ddc608c6c.summary: The `.agents/base2/base2.ts` prompt configuration now injects instructions for using `<think>` tags for moderate reasoning. This change applies across `isFast`, `isDefault`, and `isMax` modes, replacing the previous default-only instruction to spawn the thinker agent for complex problems with a tiered approach: use tags for quick/moderate problems, spawn the thinker agent for anything more complex. The `isMax` mode receives an additional directive to use `<think>` tags constantly.

b661d92a033829829f2e951d64d11ce5ab9f7eaa.title: Fix thinking block width margin for nested agents
b661d92a033829829f2e951d64d11ce5ab9f7eaa.summary: Adjusted width offsets in `thinking-block.tsx` to prevent layout jumps, using 12px for nested agents vs 8px for top-level. Collapsed `thinking.tsx` rendering to merge '...' indicator into preview text, removing separate column layout. Updated `message-block.tsx` to pass `isNested` prop and refine strategy label styling.

3e5877af04452de8571ca740dd94d34c0127f73f.title: Commander agent adds rawOutput flag
3e5877af04452de8571ca740dd94d34c0127f73f.summary: Added `rawOutput` boolean to `commander.ts` input schema. When true, agent returns full terminal command output via `set_output`, skipping LLM summarization step. Internal change affecting agent definition and execution flow.

75dc6adbd550325abae26c02c5e043db59d9bab4.title: Collapse code-searcher and minor agents by default
75dc6adbd550325abae26c02c5e043db59d9bab4.summary: Added commander-lite, code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher to COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_AGENT_IDS in cli/src/utils/constants.ts. Reduces CLI output noise for minor agents. Scope limited to CLI constants.

a769cf4ed37e181a5d9d727c67c7ff433b584c37.title: Inline copy icon for user messages
a769cf4ed37e181a5d9d727c67c7ff433b584c37.summary: Refactors `CopyIconButton` into a presentational `CopyButton` and `useCopyButton` hook in `cli/src/components/copy-icon-button.tsx`. User message copy actions now render inline within text content rather than as a separate block, managed by `message-block.tsx` and `message-footer.tsx`. The footer builds copy text from content and text blocks before early returns to ensure hook stability.

2f68dbcb44c47a3bb0de581b2fc4b52c94875c73.title: commander collapsed by default
2f68dbcb44c47a3bb0de581b2fc4b52c94875c73.summary: commander agent added to COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_AGENT_IDS in cli/src/utils/constants.ts. UI collapses this agent view by default on CLI load. Scope limited to CLI constants.

96a4cd5c691a14a39fbfe73bf3a1c2c1ebf38c0e.title: XML tool parsing and structured output for editor agents
96a4cd5c691a14a39fbfe73bf3a1c2c1ebf38c0e.summary: Agent runtime implements stream-xml-parser for robust XML tool extraction. Editor agents (best-of-n, multi-prompt) shift to structured output using propose_write_file/propose_str_replace tools instead of raw text parsing. CLI registry maps propose_* tools to existing renderers; implementor display names updated to show strategy prompts. Covers packages/agent-runtime, .agents/editor, cli/src/components/tools, and cli/src/utils.

a3c31fe3eef97c4ca79b6db1427ae5b50e70bb5d.title: Docs sidebar UX and code highlighting fixes
a3c31fe3eef97c4ca79b6db1427ae5b50e70bb5d.summary: Mobile docs sidebar now includes a visually hidden title for accessibility and prevents interaction with non-link section headers. Code highlighting logic in `code-demo.tsx` was refactored to correctly extract and apply line and token properties, avoiding React key conflicts. Tailwind configuration switched to ES module imports for plugins.

b661d92a033829829f2e951d64d11ce5ab9f7eaa.text: The assistant's reasoning display now stays steady when it works on complex tasks, preventing the text from jumping around. This makes the process easier to follow without changing what the assistant actually does.

75dc6adbd550325abae26c02c5e043db59d9bab4.text: The tool now hides the details of small background tasks by default. This makes the output easier to read.

e25bb873f43b98638d6adb5e98f9102c22186fa6.text: The command-line tool now displays agent details with less empty space around them. This makes the information look more compact and easier to read.

3e5877af04452de8571ca740dd94d34c0127f73f.text: The assistant now has a setting to show the full results of a task instead of a short summary. This is an internal change that does not affect how you use the product today.

2f68dbcb44c47a3bb0de581b2fc4b52c94875c73.text: A specific assistant view now starts folded up when the tool opens. You can click to expand it if needed.

d695bf8a37aa4c4c8b5c13d56b347d2d0288d39c.text: The app now uses a shared set of colors for its text. This makes the look consistent and easier to change later.

a769cf4ed37e181a5d9d727c67c7ff433b584c37.text: A copy button now appears directly next to text messages instead of below them. This makes it easier to copy specific parts of a conversation.

93fed7acb54103cc815ec637f2fce59ddc608c6c.text: The assistant now shows its step-by-step reasoning for medium tasks instead of hiding it. This helps you follow how it solved the problem.

96a4cd5c691a14a39fbfe73bf3a1c2c1ebf38c0e.text: The assistant now uses a more reliable method to understand and process file changes. This makes the tool less likely to make mistakes when editing your work.

a3c31fe3eef97c4ca79b6db1427ae5b50e70bb5d.text: The mobile menu is now easier for screen readers to use and prevents accidental clicks on non-link headers. Code examples display correctly without visual glitches. These are small internal fixes that improve the documentation's usability.

05edece1025a55155583ebf785527d020ccf7ecc.title: Pin lodash and upgrade esbuild in SDK
05edece1025a55155583ebf785527d020ccf7ecc.summary: SDK and Common packages updated. lodash pinned to 4.17.21, esbuild upgraded to ^0.25.0. Ensures deterministic builds and modern bundler support.

f84768cdf76cefcd313629a3ae7eeb97e051b9f3.title: Upgrade Next.js to 15.5.9
f84768cdf76cefcd313629a3ae7eeb97e051b9f3.summary: Next.js dependency upgraded from 14.2.25 to 15.5.9 in web/package.json. This major version bump introduces React 19 support, Turbopack improvements, and breaking changes in routing and server components. Scope limited to web package dependencies. Verify build and runtime behavior against Next.js 15 migration guide.

0ced308f91700a9f6d7f376a08f190cc7bca3e4d.title: Add base2-evals agent definition
0ced308f91700a9f6d7f376a08f190cc7bca3e4d.summary: New internal agent `base2-evals` defined in `.agents/base2/base2-evals.ts`. Extends `createBase2` with `noAskUser: true` to prevent ask tool usage during evaluation orchestration. Scoped to repo internal tooling.

142aa82d0af8e6072bec419d6dcac60303836915.title: Lock react and next versions without carets
142aa82d0af8e6072bec419d6dcac60303836915.summary: Pinned react and react-dom to 18.3.1 and their types to 18.3.26/18.3.7 in web/package.json. Removed caret ranges to enforce exact dependency resolution and prevent unintended minor/patch updates.

2322b7a1c5f6744d284f7cd524d33e4eec3ffc66.title: Migrate web app to Next.js 15 with async params
2322b7a1c5f6744d284f7cd524d33e4eec3ffc66.summary: The web frontend upgrades to Next.js 15, requiring dynamic route parameters to be awaited as Promises in both pages and API routes. This migration updates `web/package.json` to enforce specific React type versions via overrides and modifies numerous files under `web/src/app` to handle the new async params structure. The change ensures compatibility with Next.js 15's breaking change regarding dynamic route segments.

a8b27b0b515f609e4a64a2e3e3def342d136df16.title: Revert editor-multi-prompt2 to editor-multi-prompt
a8b27b0b515f609e4a64a2e3e3def342d136df16.summary: Reverts agent routing from `editor-multi-prompt2` back to `editor-multi-prompt` in base2 configurations. Updates `editor-implementor.ts` to use `gpt-5.1` instead of `gpt-5.2` and removes the hardcoded extra `editor-implementor-gpt-5` spawn in `editor-multi-prompt.ts`. CLI display logic in `implementor-helpers.ts` reverts the label to `GPT-5`.

e8889743c35d14d3e1dce50c5f4e6a4fb5723ee4.title: Remove codebuff.json config, repurpose /init for knowledge.md
e8889743c35d14d3e1dce50c5f4e6a4fb5723ee4.summary: Deleted `codebuff.json` support and its Zod schemas. `/init` now creates a starter `knowledge.md` instead of JSON config. Agent prompts drop `fileChangeHooks` logic, relying solely on knowledge files for verification protocols.

c905bee12e1bb67dc7d8d5779e871b2e315ec8d8.title: CLI analytics refactor to PostHog alias pattern
c905bee12e1bb67dc7d8d5779e871b2e315ec8d8.summary: Refactored CLI analytics to use PostHog's alias pattern for pre-login tracking, introducing `analytics-core.ts` for shared types and client creation. Updated `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts` to manage anonymous IDs and link them to user IDs upon identification. Server-side analytics in `common/src/analytics.ts` now consume shared core utilities. Added dependency injection support for testing in both CLI and server modules.

da195774d6bbcaef8fd202be64a8c675eb00fbda.title: Web agent page redirects to latest version
da195774d6bbcaef8fd202be64a8c675eb00fbda.summary: Added new web page at web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/page.tsx. Queries schema.agentConfig for latest version by created_at desc. Redirects to versioned URL /publishers/{id}/agents/{agentId}/{version}. generateMetadata sets canonical URL to versioned page.

2322b7a1c5f6744d284f7cd524d33e4eec3ffc66.text: The website's underlying system was updated to match new standards. Users should see no changes in how the product works.

142aa82d0af8e6072bec419d6dcac60303836915.text: We locked the website's building tools to exact versions to stop unexpected updates. This keeps the site stable and prevents surprise breakage.

05edece1025a55155583ebf785527d020ccf7ecc.text: The software now uses more reliable tools to build itself. This keeps the product stable and ready for future updates.

e8889743c35d14d3e1dce50c5f4e6a4fb5723ee4.text: The assistant now uses a simple text document for setup instructions instead of a complex settings file. This change simplifies how you customize the tool's behavior.

0ced308f91700a9f6d7f376a08f190cc7bca3e4d.text: A small internal change stops one assistant from asking questions while checking other assistants' answers. You won't notice any difference.

c905bee12e1bb67dc7d8d5779e871b2e315ec8d8.text: The program now links anonymous activity to your account when you sign in. This improves the accuracy of usage statistics without changing how the product works for you.

da195774d6bbcaef8fd202be64a8c675eb00fbda.text: Links to agent pages now go directly to the newest version. Users see the latest content without extra steps.

a8b27b0b515f609e4a64a2e3e3def342d136df16.text: The product switched back to a previous version of its writing assistant. The assistant now uses a different underlying model and displays a simpler name.

f84768cdf76cefcd313629a3ae7eeb97e051b9f3.text: The website's underlying tools were updated to a newer version. You might notice small improvements in speed and reliability, but no features or layouts changed.

1ac0923d47a048c8e0030e8f5cb25a901b2e9fb7.text: The billing page loads faster by reusing saved data. Internal tools and test settings were updated to improve stability.

1ae077607ebcd74d3be2a464383163ac6e9260de.title: Type MCP tool content mapping
1ae077607ebcd74d3be2a464383163ac6e9260de.summary: Added explicit type annotation `(typeof content)[number]` to the map callback in `callMCPTool` within `common/src/mcp/client.ts`. This resolves TypeScript inference issues for the MCP tool content array. The change ensures correct type checking for `c.type` discriminants.

6d5bdef3f6479d606c79e8b0539da7774a272fdb.title: gpt-5.1 restored in code editor lite mode
6d5bdef3f6479d606c79e8b0539da7774a272fdb.summary: gpt-5.1 replaces gpt-5.2 as the default model for lite mode in the code editor. The `createCodeEditor` factory now maps `gpt-5` to `openai/gpt-5.1` instead of `openai/gpt-5.2`. Change scoped to `.agents/editor/editor.ts`.

d8e58ef8a1ca185fabff999e600f1e3cd4d310cd.title: Copy button hover state closes on click
d8e58ef8a1ca185fabff999e600f1e3cd4d310cd.summary: CopyIconButton now calls hover.closeNow() after successful copy to prevent persistent hover state. MessageBlock moves CopyIconButton from timestamp row to inline content area for user messages. Renames SimpleContent to UserContentWithCopyButton with showCopyButton prop. Affects cli/src/components/copy-icon-button.tsx and cli/src/components/message-block.tsx.

c119924adde2adf1c18a026d98240bebd563d2c7.title: base2-max-evals agent disables askuser and suggestfollowups
c119924adde2adf1c18a026d98240bebd563d2c7.summary: New agent definition `base2-max-evals` extends `createBase2` with `noAskUser: true`, stripping `ask_user` and `suggest_followups` from its toolset. `createBase2` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` gains the `noAskUser` option, conditionally filtering these tools and omitting the corresponding system prompt guidance. This ensures the evals orchestrator runs autonomously without interactive prompts. Internal change to `.agents/base2` definitions only.

cdbf0ac186158369f2a0a744f25ce56b78f4bd70.title: Move xml-parser to common, drop backend and npm-app from CI matrix
cdbf0ac186158369f2a0a744f25ce56b78f4bd70.summary: parseToolCallXml moved to common/src/util/xml-parser.ts. packages/internal re-exports from @codebuff/common. web trace-processing imports direct from common. backend and npm-app removed from .github/workflows/ci.yml matrix.

be87a2d06d2b7f35b5da169bd7aefc4d6da9203f.title: Reduce editor token waste
be87a2d06d2b7f35b5da169bd7aefc4d6da9203f.summary: Prompt tweaks in editor-implementor2.ts ban final summaries to save tokens, as only file changes are passed on. editor-multi-prompt2.ts reorders strategies array to put default first. Internal prompt and logic adjustments in .agents/editor/best-of-n/ files.

becdfc24ad1cdef4db1f1e73d0138ae098d87fc0.title: Analytics env config now injected instead of lazy-loaded
becdfc24ad1cdef4db1f1e73d0138ae098d87fc0.summary: common/src/analytics.ts now accepts explicit clientEnv config via initAnalytics and configureAnalytics, replacing lazy require of @codebuff/common/env. web/src/lib/server-init.ts passes env to initAnalytics. Analytics config is stored in module-level analyticsConfig and PostHog client is initialized only when envName is prod.

b4dd83faf2eb1c5d5e60489c8387f81d8b3a539a.title: Upgrade Zod to v4 and Contentlayer to v2 across workspace
b4dd83faf2eb1c5d5e60489c8387f81d8b3a539a.summary: Bumped `zod` from `3.25.67`/`^3.24.1` to `^4.0.0` across `cli`, `common`, `evals`, `web`, and root `package.json`, including root `overrides`. Replaced `contentlayer`/`next-contentlayer` with `contentlayer2`/`next-contentlayer2` in `web/package.json` and updated the import in `web/next.config.mjs`. Added `postgres` dependency to `packages/internal`. Scope covers CLI, Web, Evals, and Shared/Core packages.

6b4ec78c720a54ba6603924840420f20036fa492.title: Docs update: MDX content and config
6b4ec78c720a54ba6603924840420f20036fa492.summary: Documentation files in `web/src/content/advanced/` and root `README.md`/`CONTRIBUTING.md` updated to reflect current architecture and remove deprecated content. `web/contentlayer.config.ts` and `web/src/components/docs/mdx/mdx-components.tsx` migrated from `contentlayer` to `contentlayer2`. `web/src/content/advanced/config.mdx` deleted. Agent model references in `how-does-it-work.mdx` expanded to list specific orchestrators and subagents.

eafae3baf8a8c76c7baf5da8c1f1deda373e37a6.title: pluralize includeCount option
eafae3baf8a8c76c7baf5da8c1f1deda373e37a6.summary: Add `includeCount` option to `pluralize` in `common/src/util/string.ts`. Enables label-only output (e.g., 'question') by omitting the numeric prefix when `false`. `cli/src/components/blocks/ask-user-branch.tsx` uses this for skipped/answer headers.

d8e58ef8a1ca185fabff999e600f1e3cd4d310cd.text: The copy button no longer stays highlighted after you click it. This fixes a minor visual glitch in the chat interface.

be87a2d06d2b7f35b5da169bd7aefc4d6da9203f.text: The assistant now skips writing final summaries during editing tasks to save resources. It also tries the standard editing method first before others.

c119924adde2adf1c18a026d98240bebd563d2c7.text: A small internal update stops the evaluation tool from asking questions or suggesting follow-ups during automated checks.

becdfc24ad1cdef4db1f1e73d0138ae098d87fc0.text: The system now receives its data tracking setup directly when it starts up, rather than loading it later. This internal change makes the startup process more predictable and stable, but users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

1ae077607ebcd74d3be2a464383163ac6e9260de.text: Internal code cleanup to fix type checking. No user-visible changes.

b4dd83faf2eb1c5d5e60489c8387f81d8b3a539a.text: The team updated the tools that check user input and build the website. This is a small internal change, so the product looks and works the same for you.

cdbf0ac186158369f2a0a744f25ce56b78f4bd70.text: The system now reads tool instructions in one shared place instead of separate spots. This cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

6d5bdef3f6479d606c79e8b0539da7774a272fdb.text: The code editor now uses a different AI model by default. This small internal update may change how suggestions or completions appear.

2dea1fa6086fdf5f3cd63e75019e388a7bfed451.title: Update base2 system prompt to use askuser tool
2dea1fa6086fdf5f3cd63e75019e388a7bfed451.summary: The base2 agent system prompt was updated to explicitly instruct the use of the `ask_user` tool for important decisions or guidance. This replaces the generic instruction to 'stop and ask' with a specific tool invocation, emphasizing context gathering first. The change applies to `.agents/base2/base2.ts`.

1ddd94d3131fb162a60154fd08fdf34753f58dae.title: CLI followup suggestions send directly with input preserved
1ddd94d3131fb162a60154fd08fdf34753f58dae.summary: Followup suggestion clicks now call `onSubmitPrompt` directly with `preserveInputValue: true` instead of `setInputValue`. Previous behavior only filled the input box; new behavior dispatches the prompt while retaining the user's current input text. Scope limited to `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/components/tools/suggest-followups.tsx`. Hover state logic in `FollowupLine` updated to require `!isClicked`.

c7e5ac5c9632319d3cba4aebe761309f32c656b0.title: CLI auth revalidation and env var migration
c7e5ac5c9632319d3cba4aebe761309f32c656b0.summary: Auth revalidation triggers on token change via SHA-256 hashed query keys in `use-auth-query.ts`. `API_KEY_ENV_VAR` deprecation forces migration to `getCiEnv().CODEBUFF_API_KEY` across `auth.ts`, `index.tsx`, and hooks. Logger context updates consolidate into helper functions in `use-auth-state.ts`.

0c39f78ab53aa4ff4957ec4ea87c1e91e7373053.title: Add blocked user id in chat completions
0c39f78ab53aa4ff4957ec4ea87c1e91e7373053.summary: Added '5972546e-648d-4da6-991f-17c42b037329' to BLOCKED_USER_IDS in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts. Blocked users receive fake overloaded error. Change scoped to completions API.

af236d6388eb1416df385631d1e23f7f0ca94306.title: Add GPT-5.2 and propose tools to editor agents
af236d6388eb1416df385631d1e23f7f0ca94306.summary: GPT-5.2 replaces GPT-5.1 in `editor-implementor` and `best-of-n` selectors. New `propose_str_replace` and `propose_write_file` tools allow agents to draft changes without immediate application, enabling review workflows. `editor-multi-prompt2` becomes the default max-tier editor, spawning both Opus and GPT-5.2 implementors. Context pruning logic updated to remove redundant subagent spawn messages.

d9a397e6693692820f72b3ffc33effc80f27cdda.title: Fix tool block reordering in CLI UI
d9a397e6693692820f72b3ffc33effc80f27cdda.summary: Refactored `moveSpawnAgentBlock` in `cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts` to preserve block order. Added `checkBlockIsUnderParent` to detect existing nesting, preventing unnecessary extraction and re-appending. Updates in place if the block is already under the correct parent or if no parent is specified. Covers CLI UI message rendering.

f5e983617b6b009dbe5b9977c689f63dbcc69167.title: Block specific user ID from chat completions API
f5e983617b6b009dbe5b9977c689f63dbcc69167.summary: Added `BLOCKED_USER_IDS` check in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` to reject requests from a specific user ID. Returns a 503 `upstream_timeout` error to mask the block. Scope limited to the chat completions API endpoint.

c95af8ff33cfdb30ca51128342f2fce9340074de.title: Remove keyboard hints for open/close and esc/ctrl-c
c95af8ff33cfdb30ca51128342f2fce9340074de.summary: Removed '←→ open/close •' and 'Esc/^C skip' from `KEYBOARD_HINTS` in `cli/src/components/ask-user/constants.ts`. Retained '↑↓ navigate •' and 'Enter select'. This simplifies the ask-user prompt UI by stripping deprecated or redundant navigation shortcuts.

ae954b5a7e2e340c5b47c21c7af5f0eaffd3d44b.title: Enforce package boundaries with typed env accessors and test defaults
ae954b5a7e2e340c5b47c21c7af5f0eaffd3d44b.summary: CLI and core packages replace direct `process.env` reads with typed `getCliEnv()` and `getSystemProcessEnv()` accessors, enforcing package boundaries and preventing cross-package env pollution. `common/src/env.ts` now injects `TEST_ENV_DEFAULTS` during test runtimes and uses `safeParse` for validation, while `bunfig.toml` adds a preload hook to ensure these defaults apply before SDK execution. Scope covers `cli/src/utils/env.ts`, `common/src/env.ts`, and test fixtures like `agent-runtime.ts`. New env vars `ZED_TERM`, `ZED_SHELL`, and `CODEBUFF_SCROLL_MULTIPLIER` are added to the `CliEnv` type, and `parseGitignore` now silently skips unreadable ignore files.

4a1ada9b8f349517688429aa120711147b1b7fe4.title: Extract v1 route helpers for web-search and docs-search
4a1ada9b8f349517688429aa120711147b1b7fe4.summary: New `web/src/app/api/v1/_helpers.ts` centralizes JSON parsing, API key auth, and credit charging logic previously duplicated in `docs-search/_post.ts` and `web-search/_post.ts`. `packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/codebuff-web-api.ts` refactors `callWebSearchAPI` into a generic `callCodebuffV1` handler with typed field extractors. `linkup-api.ts` exports `LinkupEnv` and extracts header serialization to `headersToRecord`.

2dea1fa6086fdf5f3cd63e75019e388a7bfed451.text: The assistant now uses a dedicated feature to ask for guidance when facing important decisions, ensuring it gathers necessary context before proceeding.

0c39f78ab53aa4ff4957ec4ea87c1e91e7373053.text: One specific account is blocked from using the chat feature and sees a fake 'overloaded' error.

f5e983617b6b009dbe5b9977c689f63dbcc69167.text: Access to the chat feature was restricted for one specific account. Users of that account will see a temporary error message instead of a block notice.

d9a397e6693692820f72b3ffc33effc80f27cdda.text: Fixed a display issue where message blocks were reordered incorrectly. This ensures the chat history stays in the correct order.

c7e5ac5c9632319d3cba4aebe761309f32c656b0.text: The app now checks your login status more reliably when your access details change. You must update your saved access key to a new location to keep using the service.

4a1ada9b8f349517688429aa120711147b1b7fe4.text: Behind the scenes, the system now handles search requests more consistently. Users should see no immediate difference in how the assistant works.

1ddd94d3131fb162a60154fd08fdf34753f58dae.text: Clicking a suggested follow-up question now sends it immediately, while keeping any text you already typed in the box.

ae954b5a7e2e340c5b47c21c7af5f0eaffd3d44b.text: The app now checks its settings more carefully to avoid conflicts. This makes the experience more stable.

af236d6388eb1416df385631d1e23f7f0ca94306.text: The assistant now uses a newer model and can suggest changes for you to review before applying them. This makes editing safer and more accurate.

c95af8ff33cfdb30ca51128342f2fce9340074de.text: The program stopped showing extra key instructions for opening, closing, or skipping questions. It still shows how to move and choose answers. This makes the screen less cluttered.

45d06c8428e1e2dc262240d4cea3e1e48c80c88e.title: Fix typecheck in use-usage-query test
45d06c8428e1e2dc262240d4cea3e1e48c80c88e.summary: Updated `use-usage-query.test.ts` to use `as unknown as ClientEnv` instead of direct casting for `clientEnv` mock. This resolves a typecheck failure caused by strict type incompatibility between the mock object and `ClientEnv` interface. Scope limited to CLI test file.

30856999a66a5eeea585d77aa8651d66e6d89d53.title: fetchUsageData test uses DI instead of process.env
30856999a66a5eeea585d77aa8651d66e6d89d53.summary: fetchUsageData test passes clientEnv via DI instead of deleting process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL. Refactors test to avoid mutating global env. Updates cli/src/hooks/__tests__/use-usage-query.test.ts.

8fc366616feebd867e5c469c404b7bb2223f897c.title: Fix direnv allow prompt in init-worktree script
8fc366616feebd867e5c469c404b7bb2223f897c.summary: Scripts/init-worktree.ts now invokes direnv allow via bash -c with explicit cd, replacing the previous runCommand call that failed to pass correct directory context. The change ensures direnv sees the intended worktree path, preventing silent failures or incorrect environment loading. Scope limited to internal tooling scripts. Error handling distinguishes between missing bash and other failures, resolving the promise regardless of outcome.

5fff2286a0731b3d49e37103aacc010af4a54c5b.title: Remove redundant CLI indentLevel prop
5fff2286a0731b3d49e37103aacc010af4a54c5b.summary: Deleted `indentLevel` prop from `ThinkingBlock`, `ToolBranch`, and `AgentBody` in `cli/src/components`. Subagents are already wrapped in boxes, making the extra left-margin calculation redundant. Width calculations now use base `availableWidth` without subtracting `indentLevel * 2`.

b61898eefd0b58773daa08d6fda070349cc2cb5d.title: Add env dependency injection architecture
b61898eefd0b58773daa08d6fda070349cc2cb5d.summary: New env dependency injection architecture replaces direct process.env access with typed getters (getCliEnv, getBaseEnv) across CLI, SDK, and Common. This enables explicit environment mocking in tests and strict type safety for terminal/IDE detection vars. Scope covers cli/src/utils/env.ts, common/src/env-process.ts, and sdk/src/env.ts. Key detail: CliEnv type extends BaseEnv with specific vars like KITTY_WINDOW_ID, VSCODE_PID, and CODEBUFF_IS_BINARY for precise binary/dev mode branching.

a61071b5cda4641493bb22d6fa4f4382765163d0.title: ask-user redesigns option focus, keyboard hints, shared constants
a61071b5cda4641493bb22d6fa4f4382765163d0.summary: The ask-user CLI form overhauls option rendering: focused options now use `theme.primary` background with inverted text and bold attributes, while selection state drives color independently. `getOptionLabel`, `OTHER_OPTION_INDEX`, and a new `KEYBOARD_HINTS` array move to `constants.ts`, de-duplicating helpers from `index.tsx` and `accordion-question.tsx`. Question numbering and option indentation are computed dynamically from `questionPrefix.length` rather than hardcoded. Hover-focus suppression via `suppressNextHoverFocusRef` and terminal-focus gating through `useChatStore` prevent unintended focus changes during mouse interaction.

a769e88e81d9efc26ef8f4567fc0a35723348b03.title: Fix env var inheritance for bun script subprocesses
a769e88e81d9efc26ef8f4567fc0a35723348b03.summary: Updated .bin/bun to explicitly pass --env-file flags to subprocesses, ensuring tools like drizzle-kit inherit environment variables. Bun's native .env loading fails to propagate vars to child script processes, causing runtime errors in worktree environments. Scope covers the bun wrapper and scripts/init-worktree.ts, which now merges base branch HEAD to guarantee latest tooling sync. Precedence order remains .env.local then .env.development.local.

715d336aefb50a08038ad8e61600ef78a49e2722.title: Add copy button to user messages in CLI MessageBlock
715d336aefb50a08038ad8e61600ef78a49e2722.summary: Adds `CopyIconButton` to user message headers in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`. Button appears for non-bash commands alongside timestamp/error indicators and for bash commands alongside timestamp/cwd metadata. Updates component layout to include copy functionality in both message contexts.

008d91d863e7bf116e83aaf241e191f2d94628d6.title: Remove bunx --bun flag from internal drizzle-kit scripts
008d91d863e7bf116e83aaf241e191f2d94628d6.summary: Reverts `bunx --bun` wrapper in `packages/internal/package.json` for `db:generate`, `db:migrate`, and `db:studio`. Scripts now call `drizzle-kit` directly. Corresponding documentation explaining `.env.local` loading behavior in `packages/internal/knowledge.md` is deleted. Affects internal database tooling only.

bc4b22cd288f7e377c95386b69528cb760453a5b.title: Fix drizzle-kit env loading via bunx --bun
bc4b22cd288f7e377c95386b69528cb760453a5b.summary: Switched `db:generate`, `db:migrate`, and `db:studio` scripts in `packages/internal/package.json` to use `bunx --bun drizzle-kit`. This forces execution via Bun runtime, ensuring `.env.local` variables like `DATABASE_URL` load correctly, as Node.js does not auto-load these files. Consequently, the `clear_inherited_env_vars` function and `CODEBUFF_SKIP_ENV_CLEAR` flag were removed from `.bin/bun`, `scripts/dev.ts`, and `scripts/start-services.ts`. New internal documentation in `packages/internal/knowledge.md` details this requirement for future database scripts.

30856999a66a5eeea585d77aa8651d66e6d89d53.text: A small internal update makes the system more stable by stopping it from changing global settings during checks.

008d91d863e7bf116e83aaf241e191f2d94628d6.text: A small internal update changed how database tools start up. This has no effect on the product you use.

a769e88e81d9efc26ef8f4567fc0a35723348b03.text: A small internal fix ensures the system correctly shares settings with background tools, preventing errors in certain setups.

45d06c8428e1e2dc262240d4cea3e1e48c80c88e.text: Fixed an internal error in a test file for the command-line tool. This change is small and only affects how the software is tested, not how you use it.

bc4b22cd288f7e377c95386b69528cb760453a5b.text: The database tools now start up more reliably. This small internal fix prevents occasional connection errors when the system checks for updates.

a61071b5cda4641493bb22d6fa4f4382765163d0.text: The tool now highlights the selected option with a distinct background and color. It also moves the text to prevent overlap, keeping the list neat and easy to read.

5fff2286a0731b3d49e37103aacc010af4a54c5b.text: The assistant removed extra left spacing in its response boxes. This cleans up the layout so text aligns better with the box edges.

8fc366616feebd867e5c469c404b7bb2223f897c.text: The internal setup tool now correctly locates the project folder before loading its environment variables. This prevents silent failures where the workspace would start with missing or incorrect settings.

b61898eefd0b58773daa08d6fda070349cc2cb5d.text: The program now checks your computer's settings more carefully to identify which applications you are using. This internal improvement helps the software run more reliably without changing how you use it.

715d336aefb50a08038ad8e61600ef78a49e2722.text: A copy button now appears next to your messages in the command line interface. This lets you quickly grab the text of a message without manually selecting it.

1a2cf0fbe4bde70934185dd2a9319a10ab848d63.title: CLI message pagination added
1a2cf0fbe4bde70934185dd2a9319a10ab848d63.summary: CLI chat now uses message pagination to improve performance with long conversations. A `LoadPreviousButton` component is added to `cli/src/components/load-previous-button.tsx`, and `cli/src/chat.tsx` implements state for `visibleMessageCount` and `hiddenMessageCount` to slice messages. The default batch size is 15 messages.

1e59edaedf642587724767fd23812abc1f5da98c.title: Revert @opentui to 0.1.56 in CLI
1e59edaedf642587724767fd23812abc1f5da98c.summary: Reverts @opentui/core and @opentui/react from ^0.1.60 to ^0.1.56 in cli/package.json. The update to 0.1.60 was reverted, likely due to instability or regressions introduced by the newer version. This change affects only the CLI package dependencies.

84bf61ed7ef12adce11980d82bde80f3c77afce0.title: Bump @opentui/core and react to 0.1.60
84bf61ed7ef12adce11980d82bde80f3c77afce0.summary: Updated `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/react` from `^0.1.56` to `^0.1.60` in `cli/package.json`. This dependency bump targets the CLI terminal UI rendering engine. Scope limited to CLI package dependencies. No breaking changes or feature additions noted.

487d9b5ada641db3ce0661b0c27bba7b1aea7373.title: Upgrade drizzle and move to internal package
487d9b5ada641db3ce0661b0c27bba7b1aea7373.summary: Drizzle dependencies upgraded and relocated from common/package.json to packages/internal/package.json. drizzle-kit bumped to 0.31.8 and drizzle-orm to 0.45.1. Scope limited to package.json files in common and packages/internal.

bc6c3285b51a0a3b9102806c5e632bda264fc4e9.title: CLI batched message updater with guaranteed cleanup
bc6c3285b51a0a3b9102806c5e632bda264fc4e9.summary: CLI streaming now uses createBatchedMessageUpdater, queuing AI message updates and flushing them at a 100ms interval via setInterval. This reduces state churn during rapid token streams. The updater exposes flush and dispose methods, with dispose called in a finally block in use-send-message.ts to guarantee interval cleanup even if completion or error handlers throw. Post-dispose updates fall back to immediate application.

d60f4be4a11b1da19a0c5dfc2bcbb4b7fd1cb997.title: Fix custom option selection in CLI ask-user form
d60f4be4a11b1da19a0c5dfc2bcbb4b7fd1cb997.summary: Selecting the custom option in the CLI ask-user form now explicitly clears `selectedIndex` and `selectedIndices`. The `accordion-question.tsx` component updates the custom option symbol to use checkbox styling for multi-select questions. This resolves state conflicts when toggling between predefined choices and custom text input.

a1cf20b4930cb261ed1152d55236ffa8a9177ca8.title: CLI: set followup prompt to input instead of sending
a1cf20b4930cb261ed1152d55236ffa8a9177ca8.summary: Followup prompts now populate the input field via `setInputValue` instead of auto-submitting with `onSubmitPrompt`. This allows users to review and edit suggestions before execution. Clicked items remain interactive for re-selection, and terminal width checks prevent layout overflow on narrow screens.

e26fdf1bdbbec7ca5f1928250c43247520484f58.title: CLI: preserve pending images on followups
e26fdf1bdbbec7ca5f1928250c43247520484f58.summary: Chat submit logic now snapshots and restores `pendingImages` from `useChatStore` when `preserveInputValue` is true, preventing loss during `routeUserPrompt` execution. `ask-user` components default missing answers to empty objects to avoid undefined errors. Scope: `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/ask-user/index.tsx`. Images cleared before prompt routing, restored in `finally` block if store remains empty.

efb4ec60987bddaebc096cf506546b4b487c2ec8.title: Remove comments in suggest-followups
efb4ec60987bddaebc096cf506546b4b487c2ec8.summary: Deleted redundant inline and block comments in cli/src/components/tools/suggest-followups.tsx and cli/src/components/ask-user/index.tsx. Covers CLI component internals only. No behavior changes, no refactors, no logic edits.

55668e77242f539867994ee0e9589c7517c02533.title: Remove quickjs-sandbox, fix sessions route import
55668e77242f539867994ee0e9589c7517c02533.summary: Deleted packages/agent-runtime/src/util/quickjs-sandbox.ts (339 lines). Fixed import in web/src/app/api/user/sessions/route.ts: moved eq, and, not from drizzle-orm/expressions to drizzle-orm. Agent runtime loses QuickJS sandbox capability; sessions API import path corrected.

a1cf20b4930cb261ed1152d55236ffa8a9177ca8.text: Suggested follow-up questions now appear in the text box instead of sending automatically. This lets you review or edit them before submitting.

bc6c3285b51a0a3b9102806c5e632bda264fc4e9.text: The app now groups small updates together instead of processing each one instantly, which makes responses feel smoother. It also ensures that background tasks stop cleanly, even if an error occurs.

d60f4be4a11b1da19a0c5dfc2bcbb4b7fd1cb997.text: Fixing a bug where choosing the 'Other' option in the question form sometimes kept old answers active. Now, clicking 'Other' correctly clears previous selections so you can type freely.

84bf61ed7ef12adce11980d82bde80f3c77afce0.text: The software that draws text and colors on your screen was updated to a newer, more stable version. This is a small, internal change that should make the program run more smoothly without changing how you use it.

1a2cf0fbe4bde70934185dd2a9319a10ab848d63.text: The app now shows older messages in smaller groups instead of loading everything at once. This helps the chat run faster when you have a long history.

487d9b5ada641db3ce0661b0c27bba7b1aea7373.text: The software's internal database tools were updated and moved to a new location. This is a background maintenance change that improves stability without adding new features for you.

55668e77242f539867994ee0e9589c7517c02533.text: The assistant lost its built-in code testing tool. A small fix keeps your session history working correctly.

e26fdf1bdbbec7ca5f1928250c43247520484f58.text: Photos you attach to a message no longer disappear when the app sends it. You can see your images in the chat history, even if you sent them quickly.

1e59edaedf642587724767fd23812abc1f5da98c.text: The command-line tool switched back to an earlier version of a display library because the newer one caused problems. This fixes glitches in how the tool looks and behaves.

efb4ec60987bddaebc096cf506546b4b487c2ec8.text: The team cleaned up internal notes in the code that suggests follow-up questions. This change does not affect how the feature works or looks for you.

91060649741d99fd1441980999feee963757a83d.title: CLI: suggest-followups click state persists by toolCallId
91060649741d99fd1441980999feee963757a83d.summary: Followup click state now persists per toolCallId via clickedFollowupsMap in chat-store.ts. SuggestFollowups component uses shared Button and declarative hover state, replacing local terminal-width truncation with fixed labelColumnWidth. markFollowupClicked signature changed to accept toolCallId.

ba9dc9b36ea82fdfdd28d57e5a11e0247658aa2b.title: Redesign ask-user to accordion layout
ba9dc9b36ea82fdfdd28d57e5a11e0247658aa2b.summary: The CLI `ask-user` component replaces the multi-step wizard with a single-screen accordion layout. All questions now render simultaneously as expandable/collapsible sections, eliminating the need for sequential navigation and a separate confirmation screen. This change removes `confirm-screen.tsx`, `other-text-input.tsx`, `progress-indicator.tsx`, and `question-header.tsx`, introducing `accordion-question.tsx` and `question-option.tsx` to handle the new structure. The update simplifies the UI state management and provides a more compact overview of all pending questions.

d3b4b34c177bf28f8f82d02e3afc8c3a06cf6f48.title: CLI: Gate Agent Mode Toggle Hover and Mute Directory Link
d3b4b34c177bf28f8f82d02e3afc8c3a06cf6f48.summary: AgentModeToggle now ignores hover and click events when the terminal input is unfocused, preventing accidental mode changes. The directory link in the header uses theme.muted color. Changes affect cli/src/app.tsx and cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx. State check relies on inputFocused from useChatStore.

2bb979ff71df8b46a33d306f51f2138ed47ff3e5.title: CLI ask-user branch uses second-person pronouns
2bb979ff71df8b46a33d306f51f2138ed47ff3e5.summary: The `ask-user-branch.tsx` component now displays 'You skipped the questions' and 'Your answers' instead of third-person 'User' labels. This aligns the CLI's direct interaction UI with standard second-person address. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/blocks/ask-user-branch.tsx`. No logic changes, only string literals.

4495f6e886c38895dbb5bb817693a06d49643bb7.title: Add mock handlers for ignore files in SDK tests
4495f6e886c38895dbb5bb817693a06d49643bb7.summary: Added mock handlers for .codebuffignore and .manicodeignore in initial-session-state.test.ts. Prevents file not found errors during test execution. Scope limited to SDK test suite. Tests now return empty strings for these paths and mark them as existing.

ae711f9e5b384f72d415333d5c13a5dd558ea0ac.title: Redesign ask-user UI, disable past followups
ae711f9e5b384f72d415333d5c13a5dd558ea0ac.summary: Refactored `ask-user` component to use `setAnswerForQuestion` and `goToNextUnanswered` helpers, simplifying state updates. Implemented non-interactive display for past followups in `suggest-followups` via `PastFollowupItem`. Added `isLastMessage` prop propagation through `message-block` and `message-with-agents`. Created `getLatestFollowupToolCallId` in `chat-store` to identify active followup tools.

195d99303cf451f51a3b55bc4c8e54ac214f2d60.title: Fix SDK dts-bundle-generator module resolution errors
195d99303cf451f51a3b55bc4c8e54ac214f2d60.summary: SDK build script now treats @codebuff/common, @codebuff/agent-runtime, and @codebuff/code-map as external libraries in dts-bundle-generator config. Source imports in sdk/src/index.ts switched from relative paths to package specifiers. tsconfig.json updated with baseUrl and paths mapping to resolve these specifiers during type checking.

66a0ba3d04a5bc1cfa6c2a189303258d0e313351.title: Refactor CLI tool rendering and unify submit logic
66a0ba3d04a5bc1cfa6c2a189303258d0e313351.summary: Replaced bespoke ReadDocs and ReadFiles renderers with shared SimpleToolCallItem, enforcing strict type checks on input paths and trimming strings. Extracted onSubmitPrompt in chat.tsx to handle queue activation and input preservation logic centrally. Updated chat-input-bar.tsx to use skip() from useAskUserBridge instead of manual skipped answer construction. Scope limited to CLI components; no backend or model changes.

2bb979ff71df8b46a33d306f51f2138ed47ff3e5.text: The program now speaks directly to you. Instead of saying 'User skipped questions', it says 'You skipped questions'. This is a small wording change.

d3b4b34c177bf28f8f82d02e3afc8c3a06cf6f48.text: The switch that changes how the assistant behaves now ignores mouse clicks and hovers unless you are actively typing in the text box, preventing accidental mode changes. The folder link in the header is now dimmer to match the rest of the interface.

ae711f9e5b384f72d415333d5c13a5dd558ea0ac.text: The assistant now shows past follow-up questions as read-only text instead of interactive buttons, preventing you from accidentally answering old prompts. This is a small interface cleanup that makes the chat history easier to scan.

ba9dc9b36ea82fdfdd28d57e5a11e0247658aa2b.text: Questions now appear all at once on one screen instead of one by one. You can open or close each section to answer them, and a separate confirmation page is no longer needed.

195d99303cf451f51a3b55bc4c8e54ac214f2d60.text: Fixed a technical issue with how the assistant finds related tools. This internal change helps the software run more smoothly.

6b4ec78c720a54ba6603924840420f20036fa492.text: The help pages now show the latest information and removed old notes. The assistant's instructions were updated to list specific helpers it can use.

91060649741d99fd1441980999feee963757a83d.text: The app now remembers which follow-up suggestions you clicked, keeping them separate for each conversation step. This ensures the correct suggestions stay marked as selected.

4495f6e886c38895dbb5bb817693a06d49643bb7.text: The system now checks for specific hidden files during internal tests to prevent errors. This change only affects how the software is tested, so it does not change how the product works for you.

eafae3baf8a8c76c7baf5da8c1f1deda373e37a6.text: Skipped questions now show just the label, like 'question', without a number in front.

7c90418da5d2db3838bea9bd580ba77dea941db1.title: Lighten muted foreground for docs prose contrast
7c90418da5d2db3838bea9bd580ba77dea941db1.summary: Muted foreground color lightened to #b8b8bf equivalent (240 3% 73%) to improve dark mode contrast. Docs MDX paragraph components now explicitly apply text-muted-foreground. Replaces manual prose-invert variable override in globals.css. Affects web docs rendering surfaces.

e3945fed7a6b0cd294cd5a0bae769838feae2c9d.title: Replace Bun-specific fs.exists with stat-based helper
e3945fed7a6b0cd294cd5a0bae769838feae2c9d.summary: Removes `fs.exists` from `CodebuffFileSystem` and introduces `fileExists` using `fs.stat` in `common/src/util/file.ts`. Updates call sites in `project-file-tree.ts`, `scaffolding.ts`, and `change-file.ts` to use the new helper, ensuring Node compatibility.

9f05d5e37cd1d2cb1f08fcb363cd8757202763a5.title: docs: consolidate tips pages
9f05d5e37cd1d2cb1f08fcb363cd8757202763a5.summary: Deleted keyboard-shortcuts.mdx and other-use-cases.mdx. Merged use-case examples into where-codebuff-shines.mdx. Updated tags to include 'use cases' and 'commands'.

ed58bd74ecf1901d0f22f956616a6079f57baf37.title: Update editor's choice agents in store client
ed58bd74ecf1901d0f22f956616a6079f57baf37.summary: Replaces 'base', 'base-lite', and 'base-max' with 'base2', 'base2-lite', 'base2-max', and 'base2-plan' in EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS. Removes 'find-food' from the list. This update occurs in web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx.

8f6eccc8d6c7c475f435c2bffe0fbff757dfcd96.title: CLI flags --lite --max --plan set initial agent mode
8f6eccc8d6c7c475f435c2bffe0fbff757dfcd96.summary: Added `--lite`, `--max`, and `--plan` CLI flags to `cli/src/index.tsx` to specify the initial `AgentMode`. The parsed mode flows through `App` to `Chat`, which applies it via `setAgentMode` on mount. Last flag wins if multiple are provided.

6378076019964299f2a88220770f254a0f93eef4.title: Docs typography: lighter body, tighter headers
6378076019964299f2a88220770f254a0f93eef4.summary: Docs body text lightened via `--tw-prose-invert-body: #b8b8bf` in `globals.css` for dark mode contrast. Header margins tightened in `.prose-compact`: h1 1.0em/0.8em, h2 0.8em/0.8em, h3 0.6em/0.6em, h4-h6 0.4em/0.4em. `mdx-components.tsx` removes `text-muted-foreground` from `p` className.

63b9a612692835b63c3e08e91ef8e251fc059dbe.title: Remove publish-sdk shortcut from SDK
63b9a612692835b63c3e08e91ef8e251fc059dbe.summary: Removed publish-sdk and publish-dry-run npm scripts from sdk/package.json. CI workflow sdk-release.yml now calls scripts/publish.ts directly. sdk/PUBLISHING.md updated to reference bun run release. Internal tooling change only.

a730d3cbc353019224567e0313077f1d444ef515.title: Update SDK release workflow to use bun run verify
a730d3cbc353019224567e0313077f1d444ef515.summary: The `.github/workflows/sdk-release.yml` file changed the build step from `bun run build:verify` to `bun run verify`. This aligns the CI workflow with the correct script name in the SDK package. The change affects the automated release pipeline for the SDK.

eab9fde59dc664d510cc806e19ad273592b7e0b1.title: docs: correct plan mode usage and update mode comparison table
eab9fde59dc664d510cc806e19ad273592b7e0b1.summary: Help documentation updated to reflect `/mode:plan` as the sole activation method for plan mode, replacing incorrect `--plan` flag references. Mode comparison table expanded with 'How to activate' column and removed 'Best For' text. Links in quick-start and best-practices pages corrected to point to `/docs/tips#modes`.

d665703accecfcf2b72d2e5a10a3797cec6c52b0.title: Update modes documentation in web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx
d665703accecfcf2b72d2e5a10a3797cec6c52b0.summary: Documentation for modes updated in `web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx`. Removed outdated startup flags (`--lite`, `--max`) and session switching instructions (`Ctrl+M`) from the main description, replacing them with a concise Markdown table. Clarified Lite mode description to specify GPT-5 usage via `editor-gpt-5` agent and removed reference to followup suggestions. Added `codebuff --plan` example to Plan mode section.

7c90418da5d2db3838bea9bd580ba77dea941db1.text: Text in dark mode became lighter and easier to read. This small visual change helps users see documentation clearly without straining their eyes.

a730d3cbc353019224567e0313077f1d444ef515.text: Internal team fixed a small error in the automated system that prepares the product for release. This ensures the next version is delivered smoothly.

9f05d5e37cd1d2cb1f08fcb363cd8757202763a5.text: The help pages about using the tool were combined into one guide. You can now find all the tips in a single place.

e3945fed7a6b0cd294cd5a0bae769838feae2c9d.text: The software now checks for files in a way that works with more computer systems. This small internal fix helps prevent errors when the assistant tries to find files.

ed58bd74ecf1901d0f22f956616a6079f57baf37.text: The list of recommended tools changed. Users see newer options and one old tool is gone.

8f6eccc8d6c7c475f435c2bffe0fbff757dfcd96.text: You can now choose the assistant's starting behavior mode when launching the app. If you pick multiple modes, the last one selected takes effect.

6378076019964299f2a88220770f254a0f93eef4.text: The appearance of the documentation pages was updated to make the text easier to read. The main text now uses a lighter color, and the headings have less space around them, allowing more content to fit on the screen.

eab9fde59dc664d510cc806e19ad273592b7e0b1.text: Help pages now show the correct way to start plan mode. The comparison table explains how to activate each mode. Links in quick-start and best-practices pages now point to the right place.

63b9a612692835b63c3e08e91ef8e251fc059dbe.text: We updated how the team releases the software. You will not notice any changes.

d665703accecfcf2b72d2e5a10a3797cec6c52b0.text: The help guide for different working styles was updated to be clearer and shorter. It now explains exactly which tools each style uses and how to start them.

33a6741d49fa451cda5b90755833124051e6e83c.title: Docs refresh: model tables, AGENTS.md support, modes to help
33a6741d49fa451cda5b90755833124051e6e83c.summary: Rewrote what-models.mdx to detail orchestrator/subagent model mappings (Opus 4.5, GPT-5.1, etc.) and documented AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md support in FAQ. Moved modes docs from tips to help section, updating cross-references in quick-start, best-practices, and keyboard-shortcuts. Standardized Discord links to codebuff.com/discord across footer and config pages.

ff2c0cb4afb9c5fc195e64c8601e1dd89f959932.title: Remove mobile max-width constraint from docs code demo
ff2c0cb4afb9c5fc195e64c8601e1dd89f959932.summary: Removed `max-w-80 md:max-w-full` classes from `web/src/components/docs/mdx/code-demo.tsx`. Mermaid and code blocks now use `w-full` unconditionally on mobile. Fixes constrained width on small screens.

ff334f0754e4c38e916726d4c5abe1107d32795c.title: Docs: Rename sidebar section and trim quick-start
ff334f0754e4c38e916726d4c5abe1107d32795c.summary: Sidebar label changed from 'Quick Start' to 'Getting Started' in `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`. Quick-start guide `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx` removed the `codebuff --create` starter template instructions and closing remark. Agent docs `web/src/content/agents/creating-new-agents.mdx` simplified `instructionsPrompt` text. Internal documentation cleanup only.

fb28635df30c05560253479bdc0eca8834578deb.title: FAQ: Add data training policy, remove starter templates
fb28635df30c05560253479bdc0eca8834578deb.summary: Updated web/src/content/help/faq.mdx to add a section clarifying that model providers do not train on user codebase or chat data. Removed the 'What should I try first?' section containing starter template commands. Reordered sections to place open source licensing before data storage details.

2307e67c59b431d1eea7c06cded952f4eac3c4d9.title: Rename Getting Started to Quick Start and streamline docs
2307e67c59b431d1eea7c06cded952f4eac3c4d9.summary: The documentation sidebar section 'Getting Started' is renamed to 'Quick Start' in `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`. Multiple advanced documentation pages, including `config.mdx`, `how-does-it-work.mdx`, and `sdk.mdx`, undergo significant copy editing to reduce verbosity and improve technical clarity. The SDK example model identifier updates from 'anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522' to 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5'. These changes affect the Web documentation surface only.

90adb08db264ee8eda935219b117163dc7391e3d.title: Rename service scripts to up/down/ps
90adb08db264ee8eda935219b117163dc7391e3d.summary: Shortened `start-services`, `stop-services`, and `status-services` to `up`, `down`, and `ps` in package.json. Internal script files remain unchanged, but console output in `scripts/start-services.ts` and `scripts/status-services.ts` now references the new commands. Documentation in `knowledge.md` updated to reflect the new aliases.

14d9ad5b0cac963b14491bd5fc3d7ea634b07602.title: Add development workflow docs
14d9ad5b0cac963b14491bd5fc3d7ea634b07602.summary: knowledge.md gains Development Workflow section. Documents `bun dev`, `bun start-services`, `bun start-cli`, `bun stop-services`. Lists services (db, studio, sdk, web), log paths in `debug/console/`, worktree port config via `.env.development.local`. `stop-services` is worktree-safe.

bcc048163c83d0fd4387a65d618b83d057caa839.title: Add bun status-services command to check dev service health
bcc048163c83d0fd4387a65d618b83d057caa839.summary: New scripts/status-services.ts implements `bun status-services` to verify running state of db, studio, sdk, and web. Checks Docker container status for `manicode-db`, queries `lsof` for web/studio ports, reads PIDs from `debug/console/services.json`, and hits `/api/healthz`. Registered in package.json scripts and documented in knowledge.md alongside existing start/stop commands.

a49d960c315177906c541d3a90a7b20997248dce.title: Add eval error fixtures for agent run failures and tool restrictions
a49d960c315177906c541d3a90a7b20997248dce.summary: New JSON fixtures in `evals/` capture error states for `Failed to start agent run` and tool availability violations (e.g., `read_files` not available). These files, including `evals/add-input-apis-judge-gemini-agent-output-error.json` and multiple `evals/buffbench/*-base2-lite-error-*.json`, provide trace data for evaluation harnesses. The `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx` file was also updated, though the specific content change is not visible in the diff.

7599418572c1441af7650256cd7f765a9c1fd5ad.title: Migrate dev scripts to TypeScript
7599418572c1441af7650256cd7f765a9c1fd5ad.summary: Replaced Bash service scripts (dev.sh) with TypeScript equivalents (dev.ts, start-services.ts, stop-services.ts) executed via Bun. Added CODEBUFF_SKIP_ENV_CLEAR flag to .bin/bun wrapper to prevent clearing inherited env vars when launched by TS scripts. Updates package.json scripts and removes old shell dependencies. Internal tooling change; no user-facing behavior modification.

ff334f0754e4c38e916726d4c5abe1107d32795c.text: The help guide was renamed to "Getting Started" and simplified. You will find clearer, shorter instructions when you open the documentation.

7599418572c1441af7650256cd7f765a9c1fd5ad.text: The team updated the tools that help run the product in the background. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ff2c0cb4afb9c5fc195e64c8601e1dd89f959932.text: On phones, diagrams and code snippets now stretch across the full screen width. This removes the narrow box they used to fit inside, making them easier to read.

fb28635df30c05560253479bdc0eca8834578deb.text: The help page now explains that your code and chats are not used to train the AI. It also removed a section about starting templates and rearranged other topics.

a49d960c315177906c541d3a90a7b20997248dce.text: This internal update adds test examples for errors to help check the assistant's reliability. It does not change how the product works for users.

90adb08db264ee8eda935219b117163dc7391e3d.text: Internal tools now use shorter names for starting, stopping, and checking services. This change does not affect how you use the product.

bcc048163c83d0fd4387a65d618b83d057caa839.text: A small internal update lets the team quickly check if the main parts of the product are running correctly.

33a6741d49fa451cda5b90755833124051e6e83c.text: Help pages moved to a new section. Contact links updated.

14d9ad5b0cac963b14491bd5fc3d7ea634b07602.text: The team wrote new internal guides to help developers set up and manage their local tools more easily. This change is small and only helps the people who build the product, not the users of the product.

2307e67c59b431d1eea7c06cded952f4eac3c4d9.text: The guide's first section is now called 'Quick Start.' Several help pages were shortened and clarified. The example code uses a newer AI model.

2e33a27c5b4118b01ad61c6fb66d0344f4ae9acc.title: Strengthen subagent allowed tools prompt
2e33a27c5b4118b01ad61c6fb66d0344f4ae9acc.summary: Updated `getAgentPrompt` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts` to strengthen the `instructionsPrompt` addendum for subagents using `useParentTools`. The prompt now explicitly warns that previously referenced tools may only be available to the parent agent and that using unlisted tools will result in errors, replacing the previous binary check for empty tool lists. Destructured `toolNames`, `spawnableAgents`, and `outputSchema` from `agentTemplate` to streamline prompt construction.

f9c8712d131c51eb2678735a6b5c4573287e30cd.title: Bun wrapper env loading and dev.sh help
f9c8712d131c51eb2678735a6b5c4573287e30cd.summary: The bun wrapper now clears inherited env vars from .env files instead of sourcing them, allowing Bun to load .env files natively with correct precedence. scripts/dev.sh gains a --help flag displaying usage, services, and log paths. Internal tooling scripts only.

804b82f7f33e98081bab24a56f5900b97b9306d0.title: Move deprecated base2 agent variants to graveyard directory
804b82f7f33e98081bab24a56f5900b97b9306d0.summary: Moved multiple base2 agent definitions (alloy, alloy2, task-researcher, thinking variants) from .agents/base2/ to .agents-graveyard/. Updated relative import paths in moved files to point back to active .agents/ modules. Deleted base2-fast-schooled.ts.

a1ebbd7f835934b07411fc56b44a5f6b067d59c3.title: Enable suggestfollowups tool in lite mode
a1ebbd7f835934b07411fc56b44a5f6b067d59c3.summary: The `suggest_followups` tool and its corresponding prompt instructions are now enabled in `lite` mode, previously restricted to non-lite modes. This change modifies the conditional logic in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to allow follow-up suggestions for all modes except `fast`. The `isLite` flag is passed to the prompt builder to ensure consistent behavior.

101c8e6373bf89d48089d1a3415284ca4ca0e6e5.title: Remove SUBAGENTSPAWN message injection
101c8e6373bf89d48089d1a3415284ca4ca0e6e5.summary: Reverted logic that injected a 'Subagent spawned' system message into child agent history. Removed `SUBAGENT_SPAWN` tag handling from context pruner and message construction in `spawn-agent-utils.ts`. Scope limited to `agent-runtime` and internal agent tooling. Child agents now receive filtered parent history without synthetic spawn markers.

aa2cc38ce520b8ada2de9b10e604f38b4ccd018c.title: Subagent spawn injects tagged system message for context pruning
aa2cc38ce520b8ada2de9b10e604f38b4ccd018c.summary: Spawned subagents now receive a user message tagged SUBAGENT_SPAWN indicating the agent type, replacing the previous implicit spawn tool call. The context pruner in .agents/context-pruner.ts was updated to identify and remove the last SUBAGENT_SPAWN tagged message when trimming history. This mechanism ensures the spawn event remains visible in the message history for the agent's reasoning while allowing the pruner to explicitly manage its lifecycle.

13fc2cfee4abcf05831876306a576f0712a2c6f9.title: code-reviewer switches to opus, drops code-reviewer-opus
13fc2cfee4abcf05831876306a576f0712a2c6f9.summary: code-reviewer agent now uses anthropic/claude-opus-4.5. Separate code-reviewer-opus definition removed. base2.ts references updated to 'code-reviewer' across all spawn prompts. InstructionsPrompt clarifies subagent role and prohibits tool usage.

b57c75e9cf2999ad20b2fcf006ae127d321935fb.title: CLI command factory pattern with graceful arg handling
b57c75e9cf2999ad20b2fcf006ae127d321935fb.summary: Refactored CLI command handling to use a factory pattern (`defineCommand`) that gracefully ignores arguments for commands not configured to accept them, replacing previous error-message logic. Updated keyboard handlers to distinguish between 'select' (execute) and 'complete' (fill input) actions for single-match slash/mention menus, preventing accidental execution on Tab. Added `reset` alias to `/new`, removed `bug`/`report` aliases from `/feedback`, and adjusted publish store to stay on selection step when pre-selecting agents.

86940e3ca7662f0c32805c5120ee221e1f891fa6.title: Slash command menu executes on selection
86940e3ca7662f0c32805c5120ee221e1f891fa6.summary: Slash command menu items execute on click or Tab, replacing text insertion. Tab auto-executes single matches unless noTabAutoExecute set. defineCommand factory enforces arg validation; aliases render in menu labels.

2e33a27c5b4118b01ad61c6fb66d0344f4ae9acc.text: The assistant now clearly warns that it cannot use tools meant only for its parent. This prevents errors when it tries to access unavailable features.

aa2cc38ce520b8ada2de9b10e604f38b4ccd018c.text: The assistant now marks helper tasks with a special note. This helps the system keep conversations tidy without losing track of what the helpers are doing.

804b82f7f33e98081bab24a56f5900b97b9306d0.text: The system moved several unused assistant options to a storage area. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

b57c75e9cf2999ad20b2fcf006ae127d321935fb.text: The tool now ignores extra text you type if a command does not need it, preventing errors. Pressing Tab fills in a suggestion instead of running it, so you can choose commands safely.

f9c8712d131c51eb2678735a6b5c4573287e30cd.text: The tool now reads configuration files in a way that prevents settings from clashing. A new help command lists available options and where to find logs.

a1ebbd7f835934b07411fc56b44a5f6b067d59c3.text: The assistant now suggests follow-up questions even when using the simplified version of the product. Previously, this feature was only available in the full version.

86940e3ca7662f0c32805c5120ee221e1f891fa6.text: Picking a command from the menu now runs it immediately instead of just typing it out. This makes starting tasks faster and reduces extra steps.

66a0ba3d04a5bc1cfa6c2a189303258d0e313351.text: The tool's internal cleanup makes it handle file requests and message sending more reliably. This small change improves stability without altering how you use the product.

13fc2cfee4abcf05831876306a576f0712a2c6f9.text: The assistant now uses a more powerful model for reviewing code. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

101c8e6373bf89d48089d1a3415284ca4ca0e6e5.text: A small internal change removed a hidden note from the chat history of background helpers. This cleanup stops the system from adding unnecessary labels when creating new helpers.

8f83669556f66cac14c3fefc3f4fde1d70f6a37f.title: Agent Runtime tool-executor emits error for restricted tools
8f83669556f66cac14c3fefc3f4fde1d70f6a37f.summary: packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts now emits an error event instead of a tool_call/result pair when an agent attempts to use a restricted tool. This prevents the CLI from displaying unauthorized tool calls and ensures the stream parser converts the error to a user message for API compliance. The `tool_call` event is only emitted after the permission check passes in both `executeToolCall` and `executeCustomToolCall`.

6bd4adab84518b8638e6bedbbf4dddaddb1e402b.title: Fix USERINPUTPROMPT placeholder match
6bd4adab84518b8638e6bedbbf4dddaddb1e402b.summary: USER_INPUT_PROMPT placeholder resolution corrected in packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts. isUserInputMessage now requires parseUserMessage to return defined, filtering out user messages lacking structured input. Scope limited to agent-runtime templates.

e5b83fdee5888c8f1ae6350f39dc58c17b045fe2.title: Set NEXTPUBLICCODEBUFFAPPURL in worktree init script
e5b83fdee5888c8f1ae6350f39dc58c17b045fe2.summary: init-worktree.ts now writes NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL=http://localhost:${webPort} to the root .env.development.local. This ensures CLI and SDK components in git worktrees target the local web server instead of production. The web-specific .env.development.local retains the variable for clarity, though the root file applies globally due to Bun's highest-precedence loading. Documentation updated with instructions for running SDK E2E tests against the local server.

2c50c159687b37f3321892a8e64d2a56fee493f0.title: Context pruner removes instructions prompt, fixes empty tool list
2c50c159687b37f3321892a8e64d2a56fee493f0.summary: Context pruner strips last `INSTRUCTIONS_PROMPT` tagged message before token counting. Subagent prompt generation handles empty `toolNames` gracefully. Scope: `.agents/context-pruner.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts`. Detail: Pruner now runs before orphan tool cleanup, removing redundant instructions.

c70c387429ae44627e8946895102985eeba9625b.title: Sync staging release scripts with production
c70c387429ae44627e8946895102985eeba9625b.summary: Updated `cli/release-staging` to align binary storage and installation logic with production standards. `index.js` now uses `~/.config/manicode` for binaries and metadata instead of the package directory, and `package.json` delegates `postinstall` to a new `postinstall.js` script that handles cleanup and prints a welcome message. `preuninstall` script added for binary removal.

86724105737b59ed3925580caf9370c6a88e946c.title: Hide working indicator during askuser
86724105737b59ed3925580caf9370c6a88e946c.summary: Status indicator logic in `cli/src/utils/status-indicator-state.ts` now accepts `isAskUserActive`. When true, it forces `kind: 'idle'`, suppressing "working..." and "thinking..." messages. `cli/src/chat.tsx` passes `isAskUserActive: askUserState !== null` to the state calculator. This prevents redundant spinner text while the CLI awaits user input.

5164e122767a5152917146c3ec843735d5686874.title: Externalize code-map esbuild fix Render build
5164e122767a5152917146c3ec843735d5686874.summary: Removed code-map re-export from sdk/src/index.ts. Added @codebuff/code-map and esbuild to externals in web/next.config.mjs. Prevents bundling tree-sitter WASM files. Fixes Render build failure.

66d6c24784a3ad3957c99c778db91e84c80cb0a1.title: Remove unused env vars, fix dev.sh healthz URL
66d6c24784a3ad3957c99c778db91e84c80cb0a1.summary: Removed NEXT_PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PARTNER_ID from common/src/env-schema.ts and duplicate GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION_ID from packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts. Consolidated NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL in scripts/dev.sh. Scope: env schemas, dev script.

f194a6ef6209225032bae93d1e2ed9dc22de5318.title: Replace editor-best-of-n-opus with editor-multi-prompt agent
f194a6ef6209225032bae93d1e2ed9dc22de5318.summary: New `editor-multi-prompt` agent replaces `editor-best-of-n-opus` in the max-tier agent configuration. It spawns multiple `editor-implementor-opus` agents with distinct strategy prompts, then uses `best-of-n-selector-opus` to choose the optimal implementation. Defined in `.agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-multi-prompt.ts`, it requires an array of short prompts specifying different approaches (e.g., caching vs minimal changes). The base agent prompts in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` are updated to reference this new editor agent for non-trivial code changes.

67f392b73e9fdf36e30a5dd617111234600aed47.title: suggestfollowups tool adds clickable next-step prompts to CLI
67f392b73e9fdf36e30a5dd617111234600aed47.summary: New `suggest_followups` tool enables the agent to present clickable followup prompts in the CLI chat interface. Replaces manual typing for next steps. Registered in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts` with handler in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/suggest-followups.ts`. State managed via `suggestedFollowups` in `chat-store.ts`; clicks trigger `codebuff:send-followup` event routed through `chat.tsx`. Excluded from Lite mode via `!isLite` flag in `base2.ts`.

67f392b73e9fdf36e30a5dd617111234600aed47.text: The assistant now suggests clickable follow-up questions to guide your next steps. This saves you from typing prompts manually.

86724105737b59ed3925580caf9370c6a88e946c.text: The program stops showing 'thinking' messages when it is waiting for your answer. This avoids confusing or redundant text on the screen.

8f83669556f66cac14c3fefc3f4fde1d70f6a37f.text: The assistant now hides restricted tools instead of showing them in the chat. This keeps the conversation clean and ensures unauthorized actions are not displayed.

e5b83fdee5888c8f1ae6350f39dc58c17b045fe2.text: Internal setup changes ensure new workspaces automatically connect to the local development server instead of the live production site. This prevents accidental testing against the wrong environment.

f194a6ef6209225032bae93d1e2ed9dc22de5318.text: The system now tries several different approaches to fix problems and picks the best one. This helps the assistant give more reliable answers without you needing to do anything.

c70c387429ae44627e8946895102985eeba9625b.text: The app now stores its files in a standard location on your computer, matching the production version. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the app.

2c50c159687b37f3321892a8e64d2a56fee493f0.text: The assistant now removes old, duplicate instructions before processing, and handles cases where no tools are available without errors. This small internal fix helps the assistant stay focused and prevents it from getting stuck.

6bd4adab84518b8638e6bedbbf4dddaddb1e402b.text: The assistant now correctly identifies when you provide structured input, so it will not try to answer empty or unformatted messages.

66d6c24784a3ad3957c99c778db91e84c80cb0a1.text: The system cleaned up unused settings and fixed a small internal check. This has no visible change for users.

5164e122767a5152917146c3ec843735d5686874.text: A small internal update fixes a technical problem that caused the service to fail during startup. You should not notice any change in how the product works.

c9855cb2e23f3f6c1294779c24b17f3fce386cbb.title: Add tools to callMainPrompt call sites
c9855cb2e23f3f6c1294779c24b17f3fce386cbb.summary: Added required `tools` property to `callMainPrompt` invocations in `sdk/src/run.ts` and `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` to fix type errors. Updated `ParamsExcluding` in `websocket-action.ts` to exclude `tools`. Modified `WebSocketMiddleware` handler type to accept `void | Promise<void>`.

4c7721f34f02a4ad41a357671b21077134aa9790.title: Scope NEXTPUBLICCODEBUFFAPPURL to web package in worktrees
4c7721f34f02a4ad41a357671b21077134aa9790.summary: Scripts init-worktree.ts now writes NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL to web/.env.development.local instead of root .env.development.local. CI workflows (npm-app-release-legacy.yml, npm-app-release-prod.yml, sdk-release.yml) removed the global env-overrides for NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_BACKEND_URL to prevent localhost leakage into SDK integration tests. This ensures worktree port overrides apply only to the web package, while SDK tests continue using production backends.

7553fa892a4883169f33406bd58c70cc07737792.title: Fix agent-runtime test types and mocks
7553fa892a4883169f33406bd58c70cc07737792.summary: Added missing `tools` and prompt fields to test mocks in `packages/agent-runtime`. Refactored `loop-agent-steps` test to verify `stepsComplete` propagation via generator yield instead of module mocking. Ensures type safety and correct runtime behavior assertions.

ea9359be498583c1243a988d5e0f24d75c3c4744.title: Fix web lint errors
ea9359be498583c1243a988d5e0f24d75c3c4744.summary: Fixed web lint errors in multiple files. Changes include replacing empty catch blocks with comments, fixing conditional hook usage, correcting const conditions, adding displayName, and updating type annotations. Affected files: web/src/__tests__/e2e/store-hydration.spec.ts, web/src/__tests__/e2e/store-ssr.spec.ts, web/src/app/admin/traces/utils/trace-processing.ts, web/src/app/analytics.knowledge.md, web/src/app/api/admin/admin-auth.ts, web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts, web/src/app/api/agents/validate/route.ts, web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts, and others.

67927deabf1e7c17f14dc4a40e14675ddaa51550.title: Add context pruner test for saved run state overflow
67927deabf1e7c17f14dc4a40e14675ddaa51550.summary: Added a test case in `context-pruner.test.ts` to verify pruning of saved run state when total tokens (messages + system prompt) exceed the limit. Includes new fixture `run-state-context-overflow2.json`.

fb495cc7011369f4879cba7a2f713464a66d3351.title: Fix context pruner to pass system prompt and tools
fb495cc7011369f4879cba7a2f713464a66d3351.summary: Context pruner now receives system prompt and tool definitions to calculate effective message budget. `AgentState` types in `.agents/types/agent-definition.ts`, `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts`, and `common/src/types/session-state.ts` enforce non-optional `systemPrompt` and `toolDefinitions`. `run-agent-step.ts` passes `tools` to pruner, while `spawn-agent-inline.ts` propagates parent system prompt and tools to child agents. `getInitialAgentState` and `createAgentState` initialize these fields to empty string and object respectively.

9b5726e3d5abbd49741ca2d372762ea3d6f573fa.title: Convert cleanup-worktree.sh to TypeScript
9b5726e3d5abbd49741ca2d372762ea3d6f573fa.summary: Replaced `scripts/cleanup-worktree.sh` with `scripts/cleanup-worktree.ts`. New script adds port killing logic, verification checks, and `zod` validation for worktree names. Updates `package.json` to invoke `bun scripts/cleanup-worktree.ts`.

815680200858cf794d4d933963073d133036449f.title: Add harder BuffBench eval sets for codebuff, manifold, plane, saleor
815680200858cf794d4d933963073d133036449f.summary: New JSON eval datasets and generation scripts added to `evals/buffbench/` targeting complex multi-agent orchestration tasks. Includes `eval-codebuff2.json`, `eval-manifold2.json`, `eval-plane2.json`, and `eval-saleor2.json`. Scripts `main-hard-tasks.ts` and `filter-supplemental-files.ts` facilitate dataset creation. These sets test lightweight orchestrator modes and constrained editor agents against real-world repo modifications.

ad5815a052e41a708572f75b0f8e23fb3f334e5c.title: Remove legacy backend and npm-app
ad5815a052e41a708572f75b0f8e23fb3f334e5c.summary: Deletes legacy backend and npm-app packages, consolidating logic into core CLI and SDK. Updates `.agents/LESSONS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `ROADMAP.md` to reflect new structure. Removes obsolete test placeholders in `evals`, `scripts`, and `sdk`. Agent loading logic in `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts` refactored to drop legacy imports.

bc4fcd1010aebb128c6059d556a1035f7c2e0b75.title: Add hard evals for Codebuff, Manifold, Plane, Saleor
bc4fcd1010aebb128c6059d556a1035f7c2e0b75.summary: New evals/buffbench/eval-codebuff-hard.json, eval-manifold-hard.json, eval-plane-hard.json, eval-saleor-hard.json add harder commit-based tasks. evals/buffbench/pick-commits.ts selects commits via prompting. Internal eval coverage only.

4c7721f34f02a4ad41a357671b21077134aa9790.text: Developers updated internal settings to keep test environments separate from live services. This change has no visible effect on users.

ea9359be498583c1243a988d5e0f24d75c3c4744.text: Developers cleaned up internal code to remove errors. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

815680200858cf794d4d933963073d133036449f.text: The team added tougher test scenarios for the assistant's coding tools. These tests check how well the system handles complex tasks in real software projects. This internal change aims to improve accuracy but does not add new features for users today.

c9855cb2e23f3f6c1294779c24b17f3fce386cbb.text: The assistant now correctly receives the list of available actions when called, preventing internal errors. This is a small, behind-the-scenes fix that improves stability without changing how you use the product.

7553fa892a4883169f33406bd58c70cc07737792.text: Internal test checks were updated to ensure the assistant's logic handles all steps correctly. No visible changes to the product.

ad5815a052e41a708572f75b0f8e23fb3f334e5c.text: The program removed old, unused parts of its system. This cleanup does not change how you use the product, but it makes the software simpler to maintain.

9b5726e3d5abbd49741ca2d372762ea3d6f573fa.text: A behind-the-scenes tool for removing old project folders now checks for errors before deleting. This change reduces the risk of accidental data loss.

67927deabf1e7c17f14dc4a40e14675ddaa51550.text: The team added a safety check to ensure the assistant correctly handles very long conversation histories. This helps keep responses accurate and stable when users discuss complex topics over many messages.

fb495cc7011369f4879cba7a2f713464a66d3351.text: The assistant now correctly counts its instructions and available tools when deciding how much information to keep in memory. This ensures it does not accidentally forget important rules or capabilities during long conversations.

cd38d63bce75c5439f033ec51998cad44bcbffe0.title: Refine shared analytics logging and error handling
cd38d63bce75c5439f033ec51998cad44bcbffe0.summary: Centralizes analytics payload construction in `common/src/util/analytics-log.ts` and adds structured error logging to `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts` via `setAnalyticsErrorLogger`. The CLI logger now delegates event ID extraction and user ID resolution to shared helpers, while the Web logger adopts the same payload generation for production tracking. This reduces duplication and ensures consistent PostHog event formatting across surfaces.

d7cba2cc21eed8d693491421d0b8c9cbdba71cfe.title: Add git checkout warning to knowledge.md
d7cba2cc21eed8d693491421d0b8c9cbdba71cfe.summary: Added 'Preserving Uncommitted Changes' section to knowledge.md. Warns against using git checkout HEAD -- or git restore to exclude files from commits, as this destructively discards uncommitted work. Recommends only git add the specific files to include. Scope: Internal documentation guidelines.

c83b8ba2fa481d42879f80038b28283cebea37c5.title: Remove speed pressure from thinker selector prompt
