bc04de28acb5cb3bbf9180e5929842f84a9046ff.summary: Relocates `./state/theme-store` import in `cli/src/index.tsx` to execute after `parseArgs()` completes. Prevents theme store watchers from initializing before CLI arguments are fully parsed. Affects CLI startup sequence only.

0d19b1be85e87eafb2ec32c5d731ee09fb3086eb.title: Optimize CLI message updates with deep equality checks
0d19b1be85e87eafb2ec32c5d731ee09fb3086eb.summary: Refactored `updateBlocksRecursively` and `applyMessageUpdate` in `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` to skip state updates when nested block content or message properties remain unchanged. Added `isEqual` from `lodash` to perform deep comparisons on agent blocks and tool outputs. This prevents unnecessary re-renders in the CLI interface when streaming data updates do not affect the visual state.

c6b9afa2061bd4a1e20b1640ed273858e0765870.title: CLI adds scroll-to-bottom button and redesigns status indicator
c6b9afa2061bd4a1e20b1640ed273858e0765870.summary: The CLI chat interface now includes a scroll-to-bottom button and a redesigned status indicator featuring an elapsed timer and connection status. `StatusIndicator` and `ElapsedTimer` components were updated to use `formatElapsedTime` and `useConnectionStatus`, while `AgentModeToggle` switched to a fragment-based layout to fix OpenTUI reconciliation errors with `ShimmerText`. These changes affect `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/status-indicator.tsx`, and `cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx`.

fa87d73983c909cfd039bc223e85eb217b2280dc.text: The text inside the typing box now gets shorter when the window is small. This keeps the message clear instead of getting cut off.

3f283b469cdf95cb53f9da13fee4fa0f0e8cf2bb.text: The app now waits to load color settings until you start it, instead of trying to guess them in the background. This keeps the interface from flickering or showing the wrong colors when you first open the program.

afb3870ca35334872116e92b1f1b0f3ceaa753ea.text: A small internal update ensures tests run reliably. This change does not affect the product you use.

bc04de28acb5cb3bbf9180e5929842f84a9046ff.text: The program now waits to finish reading your instructions before loading its appearance settings. This small internal fix prevents potential startup issues.

75e0a738128fe57be202cf9b403e42f207e06416.text: The timer and completion time now appear on the right side of each message block. This is a small visual change that makes the text easier to read.

c6b9afa2061bd4a1e20b1640ed273858e0765870.text: The chat window now has a button to jump back to the latest message. The status bar shows how long you have been waiting and if the connection is active.

be3bf719cea9eb6056368160455dac26887536c4.text: The assistant now saves more effort when rewriting files. It replaces the whole file unless you ask for a partial edit.

0d19b1be85e87eafb2ec32c5d731ee09fb3086eb.text: The program now checks if the text it receives is actually different from what is already on the screen. If the content has not changed, it skips updating the display. This makes the interface run more smoothly and use less power.

091a2224796cd4bf8b98b7561f666bbde22af57f.text: The command that shows the current version now waits longer before giving up. This helps it work better when the system is slow to start up.

5d539472c0038e5019f142b8538a527e89b251b9.text: The app now checks message types before showing them, removing a risky shortcut that could have caused glitches. This small internal fix helps the chat interface stay stable and display text and tools correctly.

b5a5f6e375c9b0abef4e16a74ccf0e2cc234c397.title: CLI multiline input scrolls to cursor
b5a5f6e375c9b0abef4e16a74ccf0e2cc234c397.summary: Multiline input component now auto-scrolls to the cursor row rather than the bottom. Uses `getCursorRow` to calculate position based on effective columns and newlines, clamping scroll position within viewport bounds. Affects `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`.

888fac9bec031b5d160889fac2d5f3071313237c.title: base2.ts gpt-5 prompt requires tool call per message
888fac9bec031b5d160889fac2d5f3071313237c.summary: Updated implementation step prompt in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to instruct gpt-5 models to include at least one tool call (`<codebuff_tool_call>`) per message response. This addresses a potential issue where gpt-5 might not trigger tool usage consistently. The change is scoped to the `isGpt5` conditional logic within the prompt builder.

cb7d3aa0f60c0ea94da9b4f1a9898a349744d3fb.title: Add spawnagents example to agent runtime prompts
cb7d3aa0f60c0ea94da9b4f1a9898a349744d3fb.summary: Added an example `spawn_agents` tool call to the spawnable agents instructions in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/prompts.ts`. This clarifies that agents must be spawned via the tool rather than called directly. Uses `getToolCallString` from `@codebuff/common/tools/utils` to generate the example.

455874924d4ae278e1ea8afc13e5025873ad2e53.title: Fix unit tests for sdk
455874924d4ae278e1ea8afc13e5025873ad2e53.summary: Fix unit tests for sdk. Adjust formatting in `sdk/src/run-state.ts` to resolve test failures.

b6eea3716ecb53691384d61f333dc6ce17667df1.title: Clarify lastIndexOf negative index comment in multiline-input
b6eea3716ecb53691384d61f333dc6ce17667df1.summary: Replaces vague comment with precise explanation of `lastIndexOf` behavior in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. Notes that negative second argument converts to 0, requiring special case for `cursorPosition === 0`. Scope limited to CLI multiline input component.

2d79849a40a137eb84bf61e6b7d8e51e972859e8.title: Add 60s timeout to CI integration tests
2d79849a40a137eb84bf61e6b7d8e51e972859e8.summary: Added `--timeout=60000` to `bun test` commands in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Prevents integration tests from hanging indefinitely by enforcing a 60-second limit. Affects both `.agents` and standard package test executions.

3e8ea0f28e6db2832558a3ccd7aa75929ca6539b.title: Refactor MessageBlock and AgentBranchItem with memoization
3e8ea0f28e6db2832558a3ccd7aa75929ca6539b.summary: Refactored `MessageBlock` to extract `ContentWithMarkdown` into a separate memoized component, reducing unnecessary re-renders during streaming. `AgentBranchItem` now wraps in `memo` and switches `content` prop to `children` for standard React composition. `useWhyDidYouUpdate` hook updated to check `process.env.ENVIRONMENT === 'dev'` instead of `NODE_ENV === 'development'`.

99498b7342b838644ac48dee536b7a57c8273ca4.title: Fix up/down arrow cursor movement across wrapped lines in multiline
99498b7342b838644ac48dee536b7a57c8273ca4.summary: MultilineInput now correctly moves cursor up/down across wrapped lines by calculating visual rows and respecting paragraph boundaries. Previous logic blindly added/subtracted effective columns, causing jumps to wrong lines when text wrapped or contained newlines. Cursor highlighting also excludes newline characters to prevent visual glitches. Affects cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx.

b4a129b65bdf8777fdb4d314efaa6d31284f8dc9.title: Fix multiline input column calculation at cursor position 0
b4a129b65bdf8777fdb4d314efaa6d31284f8dc9.summary: Corrects `prevNewlineExclusive` calculation in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` when `cursorPosition` is 0. Previously, `value.lastIndexOf('\n', -1)` incorrectly matched the first character due to JS `lastIndexOf` behavior with negative indices. This caused erroneous column wrapping at the start of the input.

3cfb35fb609c2e9ac0e2c897ca407f4db182905e.title: Fix cursor column calculation when scrolling down through newlines
3cfb35fb609c2e9ac0e2c897ca407f4db182905e.summary: Corrects cursor positioning in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` when navigating down across wrapped lines. The previous logic for calculating the current column relative to the last newline was flawed, causing misalignment. The fix introduces `prevNewlineExclusive` to accurately compute the column offset. This ensures the cursor lands on the correct character when moving down through soft-wrapped text.

3e8ea0f28e6db2832558a3ccd7aa75929ca6539b.text: The app now updates text more efficiently while the assistant is typing, which can make the interface feel smoother. This is a small internal improvement that doesn't change how you use the product.

b5a5f6e375c9b0abef4e16a74ccf0e2cc234c397.text: When typing multiple lines, the text box now automatically scrolls to keep your cursor visible. This prevents the screen from jumping to the bottom unexpectedly while you edit.

3cfb35fb609c2e9ac0e2c897ca407f4db182905e.text: When you scroll down through long lines of text, the cursor sometimes lands in the wrong spot. It now stays aligned with the character you are trying to reach.

b6eea3716ecb53691384d61f333dc6ce17667df1.text: The team improved the instructions for the text box to explain how the cursor moves. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

b4a129b65bdf8777fdb4d314efaa6d31284f8dc9.text: Fixed a bug where text wrapping was incorrect when the cursor was at the very beginning of a multiline input field.

455874924d4ae278e1ea8afc13e5025873ad2e53.text: This small internal update fixed hidden checks for the software's core functions. You will not notice any change in how the product works.

99498b7342b838644ac48dee536b7a57c8273ca4.text: The text cursor now moves correctly up and down when lines wrap. This prevents the cursor from jumping to the wrong place while editing long text.

cb7d3aa0f60c0ea94da9b4f1a9898a349744d3fb.text: The assistant now has clearer instructions on how to start helper tasks. This helps it work more reliably when multiple steps are needed.

2d79849a40a137eb84bf61e6b7d8e51e972859e8.text: Internal tests now stop if they run too long. This helps catch problems sooner.

888fac9bec031b5d160889fac2d5f3071313237c.text: We made a small internal update to help the assistant use its tools more reliably.

8b10157d92388092ef2d4bc4e20589a7bc49808e.title: Add sdk package to CI test matrix
8b10157d92388092ef2d4bc4e20589a7bc49808e.summary: Added `sdk` to the package matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` for both unit and integration test jobs. Ensures SDK changes are validated in CI. No user-facing impact.

50e90d8ed74eead0002e97eaeec12b29f0947de0.title: Rename codebuff to openaiCompatible in messages tests
50e90d8ed74eead0002e97eaeec12b29f0947de0.summary: Tests updated to expect `openaiCompatible` provider key and `cache_control` snake_case property. Aligns assertions with production code changes renaming `codebuff` to `openaiCompatible` and standardizing cache control keys. Scope limited to `common/src/util/__tests__/messages.test.ts`. No runtime impact; ensures test suite reflects current provider option structure.

98b22699c3de87a21a8c6d0907c3a42980e40ec5.title: Indent base2-plan example answers
98b22699c3de87a21a8c6d0907c3a42980e40ec5.summary: Added two-space indentation to example answer options in base2-plan prompt. Affects .agents/base2/base2.ts. Ensures consistent formatting for user-facing clarification prompts.

d4b49a10f72b3943cde3bd016878c1fd850e8415.title: Prompt caching integration test for SDK
d4b49a10f72b3943cde3bd016878c1fd850e8415.summary: Added `sdk/src/__tests__/run.integration.test.ts` verifying prompt caching cost reduction. Test asserts second request with `previousRun` is cheaper than first. Scope limited to SDK integration tests.

487c6b962e0ff6e633458cb3e5656315422e2c48.title: Switch base2 agents to default plan mode
487c6b962e0ff6e633458cb3e5656315422e2c48.summary: Seven `base2` agent definitions in `.agents/base2/` now pass `'default'` to `createBase2` instead of `'fast'`. This change aligns the agent configurations with the updated plan mode default. The affected agents include `base2-alloy`, `base2-gpt-5-single-step`, `base2-alloy2`, `base2-plan-step`, `base2-plan`, `base2-read-moar`, and `base2-with-file-researcher`.

2ff2d8eec8ff45929540bff08232b4e4464f8563.title: Add useWhyDidYouUpdateById hook to MessageBlock
2ff2d8eec8ff45929540bff08232b4e4464f8563.summary: Added `useWhyDidYouUpdateById` hook to `MessageBlock` in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`. This hook logs re-render reasons for debugging, currently disabled by default (`enabled: false`). Refactored `MessageBlock` to use the new hook alongside existing memoization. Scope limited to CLI component rendering logic.

3632965d8c5f95cd92596b7df827c31e8fb01d5f.title: Shorten CLI chat input placeholder
3632965d8c5f95cd92596b7df827c31e8fb01d5f.summary: Input placeholder text in cli/src/chat.tsx shortened to "Enter a coding task or / for commands". Reduces visual clutter in the CLI prompt. Scope limited to cli/src/chat.tsx.

5712cb17067e2ae1a07b70d879c7a920ac185ac7.title: CLI: support system theme in JetBrains and Zed detection
5712cb17067e2ae1a07b70d879c7a920ac185ac7.summary: Added logic to handle IDE theme settings configured to "system". `extractJetBrainsTheme` returns null when `LafManager` autodetect is true, and `extractZedTheme` returns null when mode is "system", triggering `detectPlatformTheme` fallback. This change affects `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`.

a258347b81604e4f996497ba4f8ca0f511829816.title: Fix SDK prompt caching provider keys
a258347b81604e4f996497ba4f8ca0f511829816.summary: Prompt caching failed because `codebuff` provider key mismatched `openaiCompatible` in `withCacheControl`. Switched provider key to `openaiCompatible` and renamed `cacheControl` to `cache_control` in `common/src/util/messages.ts`. Added explicit provider routing orders for Claude models in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`.

487c6b962e0ff6e633458cb3e5656315422e2c48.text: The assistant now uses a standard thinking mode instead of a faster, simpler one for certain tasks. This is a small internal update that may make responses slightly more thorough.

98b22699c3de87a21a8c6d0907c3a42980e40ec5.text: Example answers in prompts now use two-space indentation. This ensures consistent formatting for user-facing clarification prompts.

d4b49a10f72b3943cde3bd016878c1fd850e8415.text: The system now checks that repeating a conversation costs less than starting a new one.

2ff2d8eec8ff45929540bff08232b4e4464f8563.text: A hidden internal tool was added to help developers spot issues faster. This change does not affect how the assistant works or looks for you.

50e90d8ed74eead0002e97eaeec12b29f0947de0.text: Internal checks were updated to match recent naming changes. This update does not affect how the product works for users.

fe344e336954a2f3fb7ec20e5b5f8669b7569448.text: The team fixed a small internal error in how the assistant processes text. You will not notice any changes.

a258347b81604e4f996497ba4f8ca0f511829816.text: Fixed a setting that prevented the assistant from remembering previous conversation parts. This change makes responses faster and cheaper by reducing the amount of information the assistant needs to re-read each time.

5712cb17067e2ae1a07b70d879c7a920ac185ac7.text: The app now respects your computer's overall light or dark mode setting when using specific editors. You do not need to manually match themes in each program.

3632965d8c5f95cd92596b7df827c31e8fb01d5f.text: The text shown in the chat input box was shortened to reduce visual clutter.

8b10157d92388092ef2d4bc4e20589a7bc49808e.text: The team added the software toolkit to their automatic testing routine. This helps catch errors in the toolkit's code early. The product's features and user experience remain unchanged.

b3dc3e37428c442b82fdc9aa8e1304ed8d259fc9.title: Fix typo in base2 explore prompt
b3dc3e37428c442b82fdc9aa8e1304ed8d259fc9.summary: Corrected 'mulitple' to 'multiple' in the EXPLORE_PROMPT constant. Affects agent context gathering instructions in .agents/base2/base2.ts.

aa16ab568526a0366456d84cfe7d74dfc841e6b0.title: Rename best-of-n editor agents to editor-best-of-n
aa16ab568526a0366456d84cfe7d74dfc841e6b0.summary: Renamed internal agent IDs and files from `best-of-n-editor` to `editor-best-of-n` (and GPT-5 variants) in `.agents/base2/`. Updated `base2.ts` spawn logic and prompts, plus `base2-gpt-5-worker.ts` tool references, to match new identifiers. Files renamed: `best-of-n-editor.ts` to `editor-best-of-n.ts` and `best-of-n-editor-gpt-5.ts` to `editor-best-of-n-gpt-5.ts`. No user-facing behavior change; internal consistency fix for agent naming convention.

7d0192f5e45bdc2972b13d8e0ea0df75fd2c2d26.title: base2 prompt tweak
7d0192f5e45bdc2972b13d8e0ea0df75fd2c2d26.summary: Internal prompt adjustment in base2.ts. Changed instruction from strict orchestration to helpful assistant with judgement-based sub-agent/tool use. Scope limited to .agents/base2/base2.ts. No user-facing behavior or API changes.

077b984e2c24e294057024b154b7e72f74ee5027.title: base2 agent switches to default profile
077b984e2c24e294057024b154b7e72f74ee5027.summary: The `base2` agent definition in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` now uses `createBase2('default')` instead of `createBase2('fast')`. This internal change aligns the agent's configuration with the standard profile. Scope limited to the `base2` agent module.

914c148586a723bad73aa7b5123e0db034f4dea3.title: base2 prompt tweak: spawn directive removed
914c148586a723bad73aa7b5123e0db034f4dea3.summary: Removed unconditional `spawn best-of-n-editor` directive from `buildImplementationStepPrompt` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`. Added `or until you require more information from the user` termination clause to `isMax` prompt. Affects internal agent orchestration prompts only.

5b0687dec0c2a62f9337e1c47c5b03f0f1e6093f.title: Simplify base2 system prompt, add Codebuff meta-info
5b0687dec0c2a62f9337e1c47c5b03f0f1e6093f.summary: Refactored system prompt in .agents/base2/base2.ts. Removed legacy layering instructions, consolidated mandates, and added Codebuff product context (modes, credits, /usage command). Introduced isSonnet flag to conditionally apply specific response guidelines.

c295ccc5cf329b479bb39230b11b3a10e9dfdf80.title: base2 agent prompt refactor: toolresult guard added
c295ccc5cf329b479bb39230b11b3a10e9dfdf80.summary: Adds instruction to never write <tool_result> tags. Moves buildImplementationStepPrompt above buildPlanOnlyInstructionsPrompt in .agents/base2/base2.ts. Refactor only; no behavior change to model routing or user-facing commands.

a9d2c6d98e6eedaad2e8a51a891427487fd486fc.title: Replace file-picker-max with file-picker using Grok 4 Fast
a9d2c6d98e6eedaad2e8a51a891427487fd486fc.summary: The internal file-picker-max agent was deleted and its references replaced by the standard file-picker agent. The file-picker model switched from google/gemini-2.5-flash to google/gemini-2.0-flash-001 with low-effort reasoning disabled, while the file-lister helper agent updated its model to x-ai/grok-4-fast and increased maxTokens to 500_000. This change affects the base2 orchestrator agents, task-researcher variants, and file-explorer subsystems in the .agents directory.

946bf225ab7b2e053524aa25771b29338303fb5f.title: CLI hooks extracted from chat.tsx
946bf225ab7b2e053524aa25771b29338303fb5f.summary: Three hooks split out from `chat.tsx`: `use-exit-handler.ts` (CtrlC/SIGINT exit flow with analytics flush), `use-message-virtualization.ts` (windowing logic for 60+ top-level messages), `use-suggestion-menu-handlers.ts` (slash/mention menu key handling). Exit handler tracks `nextCtrlCWillExit` state with 2s timeout; clears input on first CtrlC when text present, flushes analytics before `process.exit(0)` on second. Virtualization hook computes `shouldVirtualize`, `virtualTopLevelMessages`, `hiddenTopLevelCount` from `MAX_VIRTUALIZED_TOP_LEVEL=60` and `VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN=12`. Suggestion menu handlers expose `selectSlashItem`, `selectAgentItem`, and `handleSlashMenuKey`/`handleMentionMenuKey` with modifier-key guards.

480358465d3d5ec1266aded222aff5c88af41c89.title: Add best-of-n thinker subagent
480358465d3d5ec1266aded222aff5c88af41c89.summary: Introduces `thinker-best-of-n` and `thinker-selector` agents to orchestrate parallel thinking. Uses `spawn_agents` to generate N candidate solutions, then `thinker-selector` evaluates and picks the best output. Registered in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` for default and GPT-5 model contexts. Supports model-specific variants via `createThinkerBestOfN` factory.

b3dc3e37428c442b82fdc9aa8e1304ed8d259fc9.text: A small spelling error in an internal instruction was fixed. This update has no visible effect on how you use the product.

7d0192f5e45bdc2972b13d8e0ea0df75fd2c2d26.text: The assistant now uses its own judgment to decide when to call for help or use tools, instead of following strict rules. This small internal change does not affect how you use the product.

aa16ab568526a0366456d84cfe7d74dfc841e6b0.text: The names of some internal helpers were cleaned up. This does not change how the product works.

914c148586a723bad73aa7b5123e0db034f4dea3.text: The assistant now stops and asks for help when it needs more information, instead of trying to fix everything on its own. This change is internal and may make interactions feel more natural.

a9d2c6d98e6eedaad2e8a51a891427487fd486fc.text: The system now uses a different tool to find files, switching to a newer model for better results. This internal update helps the assistant work more smoothly but does not change how you use the product.

946bf225ab7b2e053524aa25771b29338303fb5f.text: The app's internal organization was cleaned up to make it run more smoothly. This helps the interface stay responsive when you have many messages on screen and ensures the app closes correctly without losing data.

077b984e2c24e294057024b154b7e72f74ee5027.text: The assistant's default settings were adjusted to match the standard profile. This internal change may affect how it responds.

5b0687dec0c2a62f9337e1c47c5b03f0f1e6093f.text: The assistant's internal instructions were simplified and updated with clearer information about how the tool works. This is a small background change that will not affect what you see or do.

c293aca107f890c0d45d6739e4905bbb80e97aac.title: Deprecate peak surcharge in FreebuffFreebucksInfo
c293aca107f890c0d45d6739e4905bbb80e97aac.summary: The `peak` field in `FreebuffFreebucksInfo` is marked deprecated. New servers omit this field because Flash now uses Luminal's flat rate. The change resides in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. The field remains for backward compatibility with older server responses.

c293aca107f890c0d45d6739e4905bbb80e97aac.text: The extra charge for busy times is gone because the service now uses one flat rate. You will see simpler pricing.

f941269ace1a9ecac6f0de8a96938ca50068ae2b.title: CLI plan mode UI update
f941269ace1a9ecac6f0de8a96938ca50068ae2b.summary: Plan mode UI updated. Base2 prompt now mandates <PLAN> tags for specs. Chat layout moved build buttons to message blocks. Scrubber logic switched to <PLAN> tags. Scope: CLI chat components, hooks, base2 prompt.

fce7b21c829808cae74ece664cd88565d64521f9.title: CLI thinking block rendering refactor and plan tag scrubbing
fce7b21c829808cae74ece664cd88565d64521f9.summary: Refactored `Thinking` component in `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx` to normalize content to single line, pad to 3 preview lines, and simplify styling. Added `scrubPlanTags` utility in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` to strip `<cb_plan>` tags from reasoning text. Updated `useSendMessage` to auto-collapse thinking blocks only once per block ID, including subagents. Removed inline reasoning printing from `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

f0321ee36eea5dab0eec2c4bc99b5408c0f2a278.title: Commander agent prompt and step logic refinement
f0321ee36eea5dab0eec2c4bc99b5408c0f2a278.summary: Updated Commander agent in .agents/commander.ts to clarify role as output analyzer rather than command executor. Added explicit 'Do not use any tools!' instruction and changed yield step from 'STEP_ALL' to 'STEP'. Minor formatting fixes to timeout description.

10a77c9cf193eaa4205656f7aff9ba657d7bc8e2.title: New collapsible Thinking component for CLI
10a77c9cf193eaa4205656f7aff9ba657d7bc8e2.summary: Added `Thinking` component in `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx` to render reasoning output with collapse/expand toggle. `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` auto-collapses thinking blocks on `reasoning` events. Component uses `@opentui/core` `TextAttributes`, `useTheme`, `useTerminalDimensions`, and `getLastNVisualLines` for truncated preview in collapsed state.

03bd11c7d7d276931f10e49513dff20319e0e137.title: CLI status indicator shows thinking animation during response wait
03bd11c7d7d276931f10e49513dff20319e0e137.summary: The CLI `StatusIndicator` component now displays a 'thinking...' animation when `isWaitingForResponse` is true, replacing the previous logic that relied solely on a 1-second timer threshold. This change ensures the visual feedback accurately reflects the agent's state while processing a request, rather than just the time elapsed since the timer started. The update touches `cli/src/chat.tsx` to pass the new prop and `cli/src/components/status-indicator.tsx` to handle the conditional rendering. The `isActive` state now triggers the shimmer effect based on the explicit waiting flag.

5777780057dc74a595b0d9d7634c7dfb4504a184.title: Read files display simplifies to comma-separated list
5777780057dc74a595b0d9d7634c7dfb4504a184.summary: Read files tool output now renders all paths as single comma-separated list with fixed 7-char indent. Replaces complex multi-line/inline splitting logic. Affects `cli/src/components/tools/read-files.tsx`. Removes `string-width` dependency for indent calculation.

66451f5c10be4bf5ef4445575053e7f4be81cc89.title: CLI agent mode FAST renamed DEFAULT
66451f5c10be4bf5ef4445575053e7f4be81cc89.summary: CLI agent mode identifier FAST renamed to DEFAULT across UI labels, state, and routing. Internal agent ID base2-fast replaced by base2. Covers chat.tsx, agent-mode-toggle.tsx, build-mode-buttons.tsx, use-chat-input.ts, use-send-message.ts, chat-store.ts, and utils/constants.ts. Toggle cycle now DEFAULT -> MAX -> PLAN.

c4ae9046d992101cf08c8780ffd3cd49d1e9abeb.title: best-of-n-editor filters commentary from agent output
c4ae9046d992101cf08c8780ffd3cd49d1e9abeb.summary: The best-of-n editor now extracts only tool calls from the chosen implementation before applying them via STEP_TEXT. Added `extractToolCallsOnly` helper in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-editor.ts` for both Sonnet and GPT-5 handlers. This prevents agent commentary from being processed as part of the code changes. The regex targets `<codebuff_tool_call>` blocks, ignoring surrounding text.

657f72bd15ce1bc648fffc72988c939288f14a71.title: CLI user prompts italicized and accent bar added
657f72bd15ce1bc648fffc72988c939288f14a71.summary: User prompts in CLI `agent-branch-item` now use a vertical accent bar (`theme.userLine`) and italic text, replacing the previous column layout. `message-block` applies `TextAttributes.ITALIC` to user message content to match this styling. Changes affect `cli/src/components/agent-branch-item.tsx` and `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`. The accent bar uses `flexDirection: 'row'` with `alignItems: 'stretch'` for proper alignment.

d6111d5d918a09727fdc1734bf302be69d88d531.title: base2-fast uses z-ai/glm-4.6:nitro
d6111d5d918a09727fdc1734bf302be69d88d531.summary: base2 agent mode 'fast' now resolves model to z-ai/glm-4.6:nitro. 'default' mode added, routing to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5. 'best-of-n-editor' subagent only spawns in 'default' mode. Implementation prompt validation instructions branch on 'isMax' instead of 'isFast'.

66451f5c10be4bf5ef4445575053e7f4be81cc89.text: The 'Fast' mode label was renamed to 'Default'. This change only affects how the option is displayed in the interface; the underlying behavior remains the same.

d6111d5d918a09727fdc1734bf302be69d88d531.text: The assistant now uses a different, faster option when you select the quick mode. A new standard mode is also available that uses a more capable option and includes extra editing tools.

5777780057dc74a595b0d9d7634c7dfb4504a184.text: When the assistant shows which files it read, the list now appears as a simple line of names separated by commas instead of a complex layout.

10a77c9cf193eaa4205656f7aff9ba657d7bc8e2.text: The assistant's step-by-step reasoning now appears in a collapsible box. You can hide or show these details to keep the conversation clean.

03bd11c7d7d276931f10e49513dff20319e0e137.text: The command line tool now shows a 'thinking' animation while it waits for a response. This gives you clearer feedback that the system is working, instead of relying only on how much time has passed.

fce7b21c829808cae74ece664cd88565d64521f9.text: The assistant's reasoning display is cleaner and shows less clutter. Internal planning notes are removed from the visible text.

f0321ee36eea5dab0eec2c4bc99b5408c0f2a278.text: The assistant now focuses on reviewing results instead of running commands. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

c4ae9046d992101cf08c8780ffd3cd49d1e9abeb.text: The assistant now ignores its own explanatory text and only applies actual commands when editing code. This prevents unnecessary comments from accidentally becoming part of the final result.

657f72bd15ce1bc648fffc72988c939288f14a71.text: The text you type into the tool now appears in italics with a small colored line next to it. This makes your messages easier to spot in the conversation history.

f941269ace1a9ecac6f0de8a96938ca50068ae2b.text: The assistant now clearly separates its step-by-step plans from regular chat messages. This makes it easier to review, approve, or track progress on complex tasks without getting lost in conversation.

41b07800279d9b3cd7e6d95caceb91e633167bdf.title: Move cursor clamping to chat-store setter
41b07800279d9b3cd7e6d95caceb91e633167bdf.summary: Cursor position clamping moved from MultilineInput useEffect to chat-store setInputValue setter. Prevents redundant state updates and ensures cursor stays within text bounds during external value changes. Affects cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx and cli/src/state/chat-store.ts.

61bec3cb33c0182c25640c2d39b15877a9d7f62b.title: Add CLI glob tool component
61bec3cb33c0182c25640c2d39b15877a9d7f62b.summary: Added `GlobComponent` to CLI tool registry. Renders glob calls as single-line summaries showing pattern and cwd. Agent definition updated to use structured output mode with `set_output` tool.

ce635357394cb1f60be837d9ad79c5bc49669d42.title: writetodos prompt restricts usage to multi-step tasks
ce635357394cb1f60be837d9ad79c5bc49669d42.summary: The write_todos tool description and base2 agent prompt now explicitly instruct the model to skip todo creation for trivial tasks, single-line edits, or simple questions. This change targets unnecessary overhead in the planning phase for simple requests. Updates apply to common/src/tools/params/tool/write-todos.ts and .agents/base2/base2.ts.

f28057f901036082dd2ff8f8177006cbc5760abc.title: ElapsedTimer initializes synchronously from startTime
f28057f901036082dd2ff8f8177006cbc5760abc.summary: ElapsedTimer now calculates initial elapsed seconds synchronously via a lazy useState initializer, replacing the hardcoded 0 default. This prevents hydration mismatches and ensures correct time display during SSR or initial render. Scope limited to cli/src/components/elapsed-timer.tsx. The calculation uses Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000) when startTime is present.

c913ed8c68b019f84669210ee5cf73f7203db1c9.title: Unify cursor and text state in CLI multiline input
c913ed8c68b019f84669210ee5cf73f7203db1c9.summary: Refactored `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` to remove the separate `setCursorPosition` prop and action, replacing it with a unified `onChange` handler that updates both `text` and `cursorPosition` simultaneously. This change ensures cursor navigation (word, line, home, end) and external state updates use the same mechanism, applying `clamp` to prevent out-of-bounds cursor positions. The `setCursorPosition` action was removed from `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`, and `cli/src/chat.tsx` was updated to pass the combined state object to the input component.

4b5f5e457dba3f9e2a25d53c69f5b72dcb13e8b1.title: CLI elapsed timer extracted to isolated component
4b5f5e457dba3f9e2a25d53c69f5b72dcb13e8b1.summary: New `cli/src/components/elapsed-timer.tsx` isolates the per-second tick, replacing the `ElapsedTimeTracker` passed through `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `message-block.tsx`, `message-renderer.tsx`, and `status-indicator.tsx`. Components now accept a `timerStartTime` number instead of the full tracker object, preventing parent re-renders on every tick. `status-indicator.tsx` shows `thinking...` for the first second, then delegates to `ElapsedTimer`.

146adf8a068a1ce7195e80c2e4bfb3c0c3ca2a3c.title: Memoize markdownOptions in CLI message-renderer
146adf8a068a1ce7195e80c2e4bfb3c0c3ca2a3c.summary: Wrap `paletteForMessage` and `markdownOptions` in `useMemo` inside `MessageWithAgents` in `cli/src/components/message-renderer.tsx`. Prevents recreation of the markdown options object on every render, reducing unnecessary downstream re-renders. Internal performance optimization for CLI message rendering.

31feeceadd86485c98003c47fe88d70126e4d4c9.title: SDK adds AGENTS.md fallback to knowledge file selection
31feeceadd86485c98003c47fe88d70126e4d4c9.summary: SDK run-state now selects knowledge files with priority knowledge.md > AGENTS.md > CLAUDE.md per directory. Replaces simple suffix matching with grouped candidate resolution in `selectKnowledgeFilePaths`. Affects `sdk/src/run-state.ts` and associated tests. Ensures projects using AGENTS.md are recognized without explicit configuration.

036b4859567e2ca468d8644d2cbaf8d1fa7d71b6.title: Replace any with KeyEvent in CLI handlers
036b4859567e2ca468d8644d2cbaf8d1fa7d71b6.summary: Type `any` replaced with `KeyEvent` in `chat.tsx`, `multiline-input.tsx`, and `use-login-keyboard-handlers.ts`. Modifier checks drop `key.alt` for `key.option` to match `@opentui/core` definition. Scope limited to CLI keyboard event handling. `hasModifier` logic now relies exclusively on `ctrl`, `meta`, and `option` flags.

b16e005e1b3bd77421ba974aafeb73bb8893ed06.title: CLI slash menu navigation
b16e005e1b3bd77421ba974aafeb73bb8893ed06.summary: Slash menu navigation logic updated in cli/src/chat.tsx. Removed disabled state effects for suggestion/history navigation. Implemented explicit bounds checking for up/down key handling to prevent wrapping. Multiline input component cleaned up in cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx by removing unused imports.

ce635357394cb1f60be837d9ad79c5bc49669d42.text: The assistant stops making task lists for simple questions or small edits. This cuts out unnecessary planning steps, making responses to basic requests faster.

b16e005e1b3bd77421ba974aafeb73bb8893ed06.text: Arrow keys in the command menu now stop at the top and bottom lists instead of looping. This prevents unexpected jumps when browsing suggestions.

c913ed8c68b019f84669210ee5cf73f7203db1c9.text: The tool now updates text and cursor position together to prevent errors when editing multiple lines.

61bec3cb33c0182c25640c2d39b15877a9d7f62b.text: The assistant now shows a simple summary when it searches for files. This makes it easier to see what it is doing.

41b07800279d9b3cd7e6d95caceb91e633167bdf.text: The text cursor now stays in the right place when the app changes the text for you. This prevents the cursor from jumping around unexpectedly while you type.

31feeceadd86485c98003c47fe88d70126e4d4c9.text: The assistant can now automatically find and use project instructions saved in a specific text file, even if you did not tell it where to look.

146adf8a068a1ce7195e80c2e4bfb3c0c3ca2a3c.text: The app now remembers how to display text messages instead of re-deciding on every update. This small internal change helps the chat interface stay smoother and more responsive.

036b4859567e2ca468d8644d2cbaf8d1fa7d71b6.text: The program now checks keyboard shortcuts more carefully to avoid mistakes. This small update helps the app respond correctly when you press certain keys.

f28057f901036082dd2ff8f8177006cbc5760abc.text: The timer now shows the correct time immediately when the screen loads, rather than briefly displaying zero before updating.

4b5f5e457dba3f9e2a25d53c69f5b72dcb13e8b1.text: The app now updates the elapsed time counter without refreshing the rest of the screen. This makes the interface run more smoothly while you wait for responses.

8ee35b48155c024476c8963b4dadd383875c02c4.title: CLI drops onKeyIntercept helpers object
8ee35b48155c024476c8963b4dadd383875c02c4.summary: MultilineInput `onKeyIntercept` signature reduces to `(key: any) => boolean`. Handlers in `chat.tsx` (`handleSlashMenuKey`, `handleAgentMenuKey`, `handleSuggestionMenuKey`) now read/write `inputValue` and `setInputValue` directly instead of using the passed `helpers` object. Affects `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. `setInputValue` calls include `lastEditDueToNav: false` to preserve cursor behavior.

0007756071883bcf3c29a5b1688553d3341adea9.title: Revert useCallback for onToggleCollapsed
0007756071883bcf3c29a5b1688553d3341adea9.summary: Reverts `useCallback` wrapping of `onToggleCollapsed` in `use-message-renderer.tsx`. The toggle handler is now passed as an inline arrow function to `MessageBlock`. This change affects only the CLI message rendering hook.

11055c5b2ae76d97bb98e8cdbe228840919bdd34.title: useElapsedTime memoizes timer object
11055c5b2ae76d97bb98e8cdbe228840919bdd34.summary: useElapsedTime hook now returns a memoized timer object via useMemo. Prevents unnecessary re-renders in components consuming the hook due to object identity changes. Scope: cli/src/hooks/use-elapsed-time.ts. Dependency array includes start, stop, elapsedSeconds, startTime.

8eb9652270172c6fbf8d37f3c4026d7d619e4a39.title: Refactor onToggleCollapsed to useCallback in message renderer
8eb9652270172c6fbf8d37f3c4026d7d619e4a39.summary: Extracted inline onToggleCollapsed handler into useCallback in cli/src/hooks/use-message-renderer.tsx. Prevents function recreation on every render, stabilizing prop identity for MessageBlock. Scope limited to CLI hook logic; no external API changes.

1516b58d45de70d316a6ab19e4a0870a6a658d15.title: Enable nav up/down within input
1516b58d45de70d316a6ab19e4a0870a6a658d15.summary: CLI chat input now supports cursor movement up/down lines via arrow keys. `historyNavEnabled` splits into `historyNavUpEnabled` and `historyNavDownEnabled`, gating navigation only when cursor is at input start/end. `multiline-input.tsx` handles bare up/down keys to adjust `cursorPosition` by effective columns, while `use-keyboard-handlers.ts` delegates history vs line movement based on new state flags. Text wrapping in `multiline-input.tsx` changes from 'word' to 'char' to support precise column calculation.

674e32910ecd258cdbe5a385d3840d4e213ebf8a.title: MessageBlock memoized
674e32910ecd258cdbe5a385d3840d4e213ebf8a.summary: MessageBlock component wrapped in React.memo. Prevents unnecessary re-renders during streaming. Affects cli/src/components/message-block.tsx. Internal optimization.

a052fba50746d6bf94672c616798d2bece86b6e4.title: Refactor onToggleCollapsed to useCallback in useMessageRenderer
a052fba50746d6bf94672c616798d2bece86b6e4.summary: Extracted the `onToggleCollapsed` handler into a `useCallback` hook within `useMessageRenderer`. This change reduces inline closure creation and stabilizes the callback identity across renders. The refactor applies to `cli/src/hooks/use-message-renderer.tsx`, affecting agent message rendering logic.

dcc0065a1c0ba72393551fd5c6456a307d8fee71.title: Refactor CLI message rendering into component
dcc0065a1c0ba72393551fd5c6456a307d8fee71.summary: Replaced `useMessageRenderer` hook with `MessageRenderer` component in `cli/src/components/message-renderer.tsx`. Updated `cli/src/chat.tsx` to import and render the new component directly. Logic for agent collapsing and message tree traversal moved to component scope.

8e9cece8db39ed643d192cde78ced48c799c5b56.title: CLI: Split App and Chat components
8e9cece8db39ed643d192cde78ced48c799c5b56.summary: Refactored `cli/src/index.tsx` to import `App` from new `cli/src/app.tsx`, moving header/logo rendering there. `Chat` now accepts `headerContent` prop, decoupling it from `useLogo` and `useAgentInitialization`. Removed `cli/src/hooks/use-agent-initialization.tsx` as its logic migrated to `App`. Scope limited to CLI core rendering structure.

dcc0065a1c0ba72393551fd5c6456a307d8fee71.text: The program now shows your chat history using a new internal method. This change does not affect how you use the app.

8ee35b48155c024476c8963b4dadd383875c02c4.text: The text input area now handles key presses directly instead of relying on a separate helper tool. This internal cleanup does not change how you type or navigate suggestions.

1516b58d45de70d316a6ab19e4a0870a6a658d15.text: Arrow keys now move the cursor between lines in the chat box. This lets you edit multi-line messages more easily.

480358465d3d5ec1266aded222aff5c88af41c89.text: The assistant now generates multiple answers to a question at the same time and selects the best one. This helps provide more accurate and reliable responses.

674e32910ecd258cdbe5a385d3840d4e213ebf8a.text: The app now skips redrawing text messages when they do not change. This small internal update makes the interface smoother while the assistant writes.

8eb9652270172c6fbf8d37f3c4026d7d619e4a39.text: The assistant now remembers which message parts are open or closed more reliably, preventing the display from resetting unexpectedly while you interact with it.

0007756071883bcf3c29a5b1688553d3341adea9.text: A small internal cleanup in the chat display logic. You won't notice any difference in how the app looks or works.

8e9cece8db39ed643d192cde78ced48c799c5b56.text: The program's visual layout was reorganized internally. This change does not affect how the tool works or what it can do.

a052fba50746d6bf94672c616798d2bece86b6e4.text: An internal code cleanup makes the chat interface run more smoothly by reducing unnecessary work when messages expand or collapse. You might see slightly faster responses, but nothing looks different.

11055c5b2ae76d97bb98e8cdbe228840919bdd34.text: The timer now uses a saved value instead of making a new one every time. This stops the screen from refreshing unnecessarily.

f949ce7dcdca3fbf5acfd0c4b50009fbd789d7bd.title: CLI mode divider
f949ce7dcdca3fbf5acfd0c4b50009fbd789d7bd.summary: New `ModeDivider` component renders centered horizontal lines with bold mode labels when `agentMode` changes or on first message. `useSendMessage` inserts a `mode-divider` content block into the chat store when `lastMessageMode` differs from current mode. State tracks `lastMessageMode` in `chat-store.ts` to prevent duplicate dividers. Scope limited to CLI chat rendering via `use-message-renderer.tsx`.

679d23dc5fcdad5543477f223b21280d6ca45ebb.title: Force dark theme in Ghostty terminal
679d23dc5fcdad5543477f223b21280d6ca45ebb.summary: Adds `detectTerminalOverrides` to force 'dark' theme when Ghostty is detected via `TERM_PROGRAM`, `TERM`, or `GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR`. Ghostty renders light theme text too dark, hurting legibility. Update `detectSystemTheme` priority chain: Terminal override > IDE > OSC > Platform > Default. Affects `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`.

a0085a3c128147a52a879fc1ecf718a7282a6134.title: Add clientDisconnected and state to OpenRouter logger
a0085a3c128147a52a879fc1ecf718a7282a6134.summary: Updates `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` to include `clientDisconnected` and `state` in the warning logger payload during stream cancellation. This provides context for the 'Client cancelled stream' event. Internal logging change only.

400db03e92a8848649af577a846aaf7c148f3134.title: CLI tool group spacing fix
400db03e92a8848649af577a846aaf7c148f3134.summary: Fixes tool group spacing by detecting subsequent renderable blocks. `message-block.tsx` now conditionally applies `marginBottom: 1` only if non-`end_turn` tools or text/html/agent blocks follow. This prevents extra vertical whitespace at the end of tool groups.

0c1b219571909c4932fd6328deec7b88ee754405.title: Simplify theme detection priority logic in CLI
0c1b219571909c4932fd6328deec7b88ee754405.summary: Refactored `detectSystemTheme` in `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts` to use a dedicated `detectPreferredTheme` helper. This replaces the previous nullish coalescing chain with explicit early-return checks for Terminal overrides, IDE, OSC, and Platform themes. The priority order remains Terminal > IDE > OSC > Platform > Default. This change is internal to the CLI utility layer.

a43a7a69148fc5b39586299cab0dc1e8b5ff137d.title: CLI handles missing agent run output
a43a7a69148fc5b39586299cab0dc1e8b5ff137d.summary: use-send-message.ts now checks for null/undefined output before accessing type. Prevents runtime crash when agent run returns no output. Scope: CLI hook. Detail: Logs 'No output from agent run' if output is missing.

8c25c4e0597948c76d8db36b53f4d4e17f225767.title: Fix VSCode and Zed theme auto-detection
8c25c4e0597948c76d8db36b53f4d4e17f225767.summary: VSCode theme detection now handles window.autoDetectColorScheme by parsing preferredDarkColorTheme and preferredLightColorTheme, falling back to platform detection if inference fails. Zed theme detection moves system mode fallback to detectZedTheme after extractZedTheme returns null, ensuring platform theme is used when specific mode themes are absent. Removed unused CHAT_THEME_ENV_KEYS and loadThemeOverrides, simplifying chatThemes to use DEFAULT_CHAT_THEMES directly. Updated IDE_THEME_INFERENCE to include 'vs dark' and 'vs light' keywords.

76f9687c51cbf21fb6654f1e21c52c9dfd3d2129.title: CLI: disable slash menu during history navigation
76f9687c51cbf21fb6654f1e21c52c9dfd3d2129.summary: Added mutual exclusion between slash command suggestions and input history navigation in the CLI. Implemented `lastEditDueToNav` state in `chat-store` to track programmatic updates from history arrows versus manual typing. `chat.tsx` uses this flag to toggle `suggestionMenuDisabled` and `historyNavEnabled`, preventing the menu from intercepting arrow keys or appearing when recalling commands. Refactored `setInputValue` across `router.ts`, `multiline-input.tsx`, and `use-chat-input.ts` to accept an `InputValue` object containing text, cursor position, and the navigation flag.

18d6ffd7d8e9762ec350f7ab9a560124ed8db487.title: CLI auto-collapses root agents but remembers manual opens
18d6ffd7d8e9762ec350f7ab9a560124ed8db487.summary: Chat interface now auto-collapses previous agent toggles on new message send, except those manually opened by user. Tracks user intent via `userOpenedAgents` state in `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `use-message-renderer.tsx`. Root-level agents identified by `MAIN_AGENT_ID` in `cli/src/utils/constants.ts`.

d67e0b6ead13e3ef7fe0832f83b64d18f7a680c8.title: Fix CLI typecheck in StatusIndicator timer test
d67e0b6ead13e3ef7fe0832f83b64d18f7a680c8.summary: Updated `cli/src/components/__tests__/status-indicator.timer.test.tsx` to pass the required `nextCtrlCWillExit` prop to `StatusIndicator` and cleaned up unused imports. This resolves TypeScript compilation errors caused by a mismatch between the test mock and the component's current interface. Scope limited to CLI test suite.

76f9687c51cbf21fb6654f1e21c52c9dfd3d2129.text: Pressing the up or down arrows to see past commands no longer triggers the suggestion menu. This makes navigating through history smoother and prevents the menu from blocking your view.

18d6ffd7d8e9762ec350f7ab9a560124ed8db487.text: The chat interface now automatically hides previous agent options when you send a new message, unless you manually opened them first. This keeps your view clean while respecting your specific choices.

a43a7a69148fc5b39586299cab0dc1e8b5ff137d.text: The command-line tool no longer crashes if the assistant sends back an empty response. Instead, it shows a clear message that no output was received.

8c25c4e0597948c76d8db36b53f4d4e17f225767.text: The editor now picks the right light or dark colors automatically. If it cannot decide, it uses your computer's setting.

0c1b219571909c4932fd6328deec7b88ee754405.text: The app now checks for theme settings in a clearer order, looking first at terminal overrides, then editor settings, system preferences, and finally defaults. This internal cleanup helps the app pick the right dark or light mode more reliably.

f949ce7dcdca3fbf5acfd0c4b50009fbd789d7bd.text: The app now shows a visual line to mark when the assistant switches modes. This helps you see when the behavior changes.

d67e0b6ead13e3ef7fe0832f83b64d18f7a680c8.text: A small internal update fixed a test error in the command-line tool. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

679d23dc5fcdad5543477f223b21280d6ca45ebb.text: The app now automatically switches to a dark theme when used with a specific terminal, because light text was too hard to read. This improves visibility without requiring any settings changes.

a0085a3c128147a52a879fc1ecf718a7282a6134.text: When you stop a response early, the system now records why it happened. This helps staff fix problems faster. You will not notice any difference.

400db03e92a8848649af577a846aaf7c148f3134.text: Extra blank space at the end of some messages is gone. The text looks cleaner and more compact.

8475a8bccf2f7d0b319d0d4405eb0433ac848c40.title: CLI type safety refactor: remove as any, strict event typing
8475a8bccf2f7d0b319d0d4405eb0433ac848c40.summary: Refactored CLI type definitions and event handling to eliminate `as any` casts and improve type safety. `ContentBlock` union types in `cli/src/types/chat.ts` were split into named exports (`TextContentBlock`, `ToolContentBlock`, etc.), and `ToolName` usage was adjusted in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts` to satisfy strict typing via `satisfies`. In `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, `handleEvent` now uses type guards (`'agentId' in event`, `'totalCost' in event`) instead of unsafe property access, and subagent event matching was simplified to `subagent_start`/`subagent_finish` only, removing legacy hyphenated variants. A new `SetElement` utility type was added to `cli/src/types/utils.ts` to support strict tool name filtering in `isHiddenToolName`.

52ed28ba9766edc71d2f027357185ccc3cd2b399.title: Tweak file-list prompt in file-lister
52ed28ba9766edc71d2f027357185ccc3cd2b399.summary: Updated the system prompt in `.agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts` to explicitly instruct the agent to include all subdirectories (e.g., `src`) in file paths. This change addresses observed failures where agents omitted intermediate directory components. The modification is internal, affecting only the file explorer agent's behavior.

aeed81aef003d1668fe467fc4ae47f5745292c01.title: Consolidate Ctrl-C message into StatusIndicator
aeed81aef003d1668fe467fc4ae47f5745292c01.summary: Moved the 'Press Ctrl-C again to exit' message from `chat.tsx` into `StatusIndicator` in `status-indicator.tsx`. Updated `useHasStatus` hook to accept an object parameter including `nextCtrlCWillExit`. This centralizes status line rendering logic and simplifies `chat.tsx` by removing manual conditional text nodes.

4e832e9df2f2ed8bfd9f0b1e071fe656f9de575f.title: Ctrl-C cancels agent response; run() returns sessionState on abort
4e832e9df2f2ed8bfd9f0b1e071fe656f9de575f.summary: Ctrl-C now aborts streaming agent responses in CLI, marking the last text block with '[response interrupted]' and resetting queue/streaming state. SDK run() no longer throws AbortError; it returns a RunState with sessionState preserved and output.type='error' on cancellation, enabling follow-up runs via previousRun. Changes touch cli/src/hooks/use-keyboard-handlers.ts, cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts, sdk/src/run.ts, plus README and examples.

3b28978c436e50c74fd077f81f9d174468906777.title: use-send-message.ts replaces 'in' operator with has()
3b28978c436e50c74fd077f81f9d174468906777.summary: Switches from 'in' operator to has() helper for agentId and value checks in use-send-message.ts. Avoids potential runtime errors or type narrowing issues with the 'in' operator. Scope limited to cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts.

72c6c8f8de5e5e816d91ded74abe1b3c77617555.title: Refine file-lister prompts to suppress commentary
72c6c8f8de5e5e816d91ded74abe1b3c77617555.summary: Updated `.agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts` system prompts to explicitly forbid introductory commentary, analysis, and English text, enforcing newline-separated file paths only. Renamed `<example_output>` tags to `<example_response>` and added reinforcement instructions to ensure strict output format compliance.

5a4ed18334dbf0456bbb5e6428e56667206f3751.title: Ctrl-C cancels CLI runs
5a4ed18334dbf0456bbb5e6428e56667206f3751.summary: SDK `run()` throws `AbortError` on cancellation instead of returning `ErrorOr` result. CLI `use-send-message` hook handles `AbortError` to update UI state and append `[response interrupted]`. Removes explicit abort listener logic in favor of centralized error handling. Covers `sdk/src/run.ts`, `sdk/src/client.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`.

bc5157ced863b21ffa37b02fcad1e48c8342f034.title: Improve terminal tool component
bc5157ced863b21ffa37b02fcad1e48c8342f034.summary: Terminal tool component in `cli/src/components/tools/run-terminal-command.tsx` now displays command in bold next to bullet point, with output indented below. Output truncation limits display to 5 lines with mouse-clickable 'Show X more lines' toggle. Uses `useState` for expand/collapse state, `useTheme` for color styling, and `TextAttributes.BOLD` for command emphasis. Collapsed preview retains `$ ${command}` format.

31b8421b918c662073ba0cfd8a090465c6944856.title: Fix writetodos end-turn logic for multiple calls
31b8421b918c662073ba0cfd8a090465c6944856.summary: The `hasOnlyFinishedTodos` check in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` now evaluates all tool calls instead of strictly requiring a single call. This prevents premature turn termination when multiple `write_todos` calls are present but only some are completed. Logic updated to ensure turn ends only if every call is `write_todos` and at least one call contains fully completed todos.

fdd062321c48cef702d2cbe04a635f597f994f4c.title: OSC 10/11 terminal color detection
fdd062321c48cef702d2cbe04a635f597f994f4c.summary: Added `terminal-color-detection.ts` to query terminal foreground/background colors via OSC escape sequences for theme detection. Updated `theme-system.ts` to prioritize OSC detection over platform defaults and added Zed terminal support. `login-modal.tsx` adjusted to use `theme.surface` instead of `theme.background`.

8475a8bccf2f7d0b319d0d4405eb0433ac848c40.text: The tool's internal checks were made stricter to catch errors earlier. You likely see no difference, but the app is less likely to crash unexpectedly.

bc5157ced863b21ffa37b02fcad1e48c8342f034.text: The assistant now makes commands easier to read by highlighting them and neatly arranging their results. Long outputs are hidden by default, but you can click to see the rest.

3b28978c436e50c74fd077f81f9d174468906777.text: The assistant's message handling was improved to prevent potential errors. This small internal change helps the app run more smoothly.

4e832e9df2f2ed8bfd9f0b1e071fe656f9de575f.text: Pressing Ctrl-C now stops the assistant's response immediately. The conversation history remains intact, allowing you to continue the chat without restarting.

aeed81aef003d1668fe467fc4ae47f5745292c01.text: The warning shown when you press Ctrl-C was moved to a central location. This makes the code cleaner and easier to maintain, with no visible changes for users.

52ed28ba9766edc71d2f027357185ccc3cd2b399.text: The tool now shows full file locations, including folders inside folders. This helps it find things more accurately.

72c6c8f8de5e5e816d91ded74abe1b3c77617555.text: The file lister now strictly outputs only file paths, without any extra text or commentary. This internal cleanup makes results cleaner and easier to read.

5a4ed18334dbf0456bbb5e6428e56667206f3751.text: Pressing Ctrl-C now cleanly stops the assistant's response. You will see a clear note that the reply was interrupted.

fdd062321c48cef702d2cbe04a635f597f994f4c.text: The app now asks your terminal for its colors to match your theme automatically. This fixes visual glitches in login screens and supports more terminal types.

31b8421b918c662073ba0cfd8a090465c6944856.text: The assistant now finishes its task only after completing all planned steps, rather than stopping early when multiple tasks are active.

7a92255c84bb12116cedcce01d791551450178c5.title: Switch CLI multiline input cursor to left-aligned block
7a92255c84bb12116cedcce01d791551450178c5.summary: MultilineInput cursor character changed from ┃ to ▍ for left-aligned rendering. Highlight condition simplified by removing cursorPosition > 0 check, allowing cursor display at line start. Affects cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx.

98903bec6fbb617384e7dfc9e0c1eb9ac5255df0.title: Thread includeToolCall through CLI and agent-runtime
98903bec6fbb617384e7dfc9e0c1eb9ac5255df0.summary: includeToolCall flag moved from toolBlock.input to top-level toolBlock in cli/src/components/message-block.tsx and threaded through cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts. packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts now sets includeToolCall: false when excludeToolFromMessageHistory is true, propagating via cli/src/types/chat.ts and common/src/types/print-mode.ts. Covers CLI and Agent Runtime. Conditional spread ensures flag only appears when explicitly false.

784785824d15d26fae0f40c43b0a06bcab44e51e.title: Remove exitWarning state from CLI chat
784785824d15d26fae0f40c43b0a06bcab44e51e.summary: Refactored cli/src/chat.tsx to remove exitWarning state and exitArmedRef, replacing them with nextCtrlCWillExit for status line rendering. This simplifies the Ctrl+C exit warning logic by eliminating redundant state tracking and effects. Scope limited to CLI chat component internals. Status line now directly checks nextCtrlCWillExit boolean instead of string state.

ffe4ccbdfd72127b58e5aed20dc32d2fcb2be84e.title: CLI: Cursor position reset on history navigation
ffe4ccbdfd72127b58e5aed20dc32d2fcb2be84e.summary: Cursor position is now explicitly managed via chat store state instead of local component state. `useInputHistory` hook accepts `setCursorPosition` and updates it to the end of the string when navigating history entries with up/down arrows. Changes affect `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-input-history.ts`, and `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`. This ensures the cursor visually jumps to the end of recalled commands, preventing it from remaining at arbitrary positions from previous edits.

290eaa6a4eaba7f6caf35094ddebe04932a7a6a9.title: CLI chat requires double Ctrl+C to exit
290eaa6a4eaba7f6caf35094ddebe04932a7a6a9.summary: CLI chat now requires two consecutive Ctrl+C presses to exit. First press clears input or shows 'Press Ctrl+C again to exit' warning; second press exits. Warning auto-clears after 2 seconds. Changes in cli/src/chat.tsx handleCtrlC callback.

2bce10880445870d060d38cb8ecf697097480b68.title: Hide tool calls in internal agent outputs
2bce10880445870d060d38cb8ecf697097480b68.summary: Added includeToolCall: false to set_output calls in editor, file-explorer, and best-of-n agents. Prevents raw tool call traces from appearing in final agent responses. Refactored n calculation in best-of-n editor for consistency.

e986021ad3703043db335b6e60ab5d8c54d0d3fb.title: CLI multiline input wrap and toggle width fix
e986021ad3703043db335b6e60ab5d8c54d0d3fb.summary: New `cli/src/utils/text-layout.ts` adds `computeInputLayoutMetrics` and `measureLines` for precise text wrapping. `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` uses measured viewport width instead of heuristic padding to prevent early wraps. `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts` recalculates `agentToggleLabel` width based on actual rendered collapsed box dimensions.

7dc922dcf77abcdc873fd44378bab6bfb8345690.title: Improve build mode buttons layout and theme consistency
7dc922dcf77abcdc873fd44378bab6bfb8345690.summary: Refactored `BuildModeButtons` to use a horizontal `flexDirection: 'row'` layout with `justifyContent: 'space-between'`, replacing the previous vertical column structure. Implemented responsive behavior via `useTerminalDimensions` to hide the 'Ready to build?' label on narrow terminals (<55 chars). Switched hardcoded `#ffffff` colors to `theme.foreground` and applied `BORDER_CHARS` for consistent styling. Updated file `cli/src/components/build-mode-buttons.tsx`.

3c4d47aa33f92d6dbde97c28f2db636c0242cf4f.title: SDK run() returns success/failure union
3c4d47aa33f92d6dbde97c28f2db636c0242cf4f.summary: CodebuffClient.run() now returns a discriminated union of success/failure objects instead of resolving directly to RunState. Callers must check `.success` before accessing `.value` or `.error`. Documentation and examples updated to reflect this breaking API change.

d3730a17be04a5374b39d72e9a80ae519ee3a23a.title: SDK run() returns ErrorOr; CLI Esc/ctrl-c aborts cleanly
d3730a17be04a5374b39d72e9a80ae519ee3a23a.summary: sdk/src/run.ts and sdk/src/client.ts replace thrown AbortError with ErrorOr<RunState> return type. checkAborted returns Failure object instead of throwing. cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts adds abort listener to append '[response interrupted]' to last text block. cli/src/hooks/use-keyboard-handlers.ts fixes Esc handler fallthrough with early return. SDK exports ErrorOr type via sdk/src/index.ts.

784785824d15d26fae0f40c43b0a06bcab44e51e.text: The chat interface now uses a simpler method to handle exit warnings. This internal cleanup does not change how the product looks or feels to users.

7a92255c84bb12116cedcce01d791551450178c5.text: The typing cursor in the chat box is now a small block that sits at the start of the line. This fixes a visual glitch where the cursor would disappear when you started typing at the very beginning of a line.

290eaa6a4eaba7f6caf35094ddebe04932a7a6a9.text: Pressing Ctrl+C once now shows a warning or clears your text instead of closing the chat immediately. You must press it a second time to exit, which helps prevent accidental closures.

e986021ad3703043db335b6e60ab5d8c54d0d3fb.text: The text input area now fits more words on each line without breaking them early. This makes long messages easier to read and edit.

3c4d47aa33f92d6dbde97c28f2db636c0242cf4f.text: The assistant now clearly separates success from failure when it runs. This change helps the system report errors more accurately.

7dc922dcf77abcdc873fd44378bab6bfb8345690.text: Build mode buttons now sit side by side. The label hides on narrow screens. Colors match the theme.

98903bec6fbb617384e7dfc9e0c1eb9ac5255df0.text: A small internal update ensures that when a tool is excluded from chat history, a specific setting is correctly passed along to prevent it from being shown.

2bce10880445870d060d38cb8ecf697097480b68.text: The assistant now hides its internal search steps from you. You see only the final answer, not the raw list of actions it took to find it.

d3730a17be04a5374b39d72e9a80ae519ee3a23a.text: Pressing the escape key or control-c now stops the assistant immediately and cleanly. The chat shows a clear message that the response was interrupted.

ffe4ccbdfd72127b58e5aed20dc32d2fcb2be84e.text: When you press the up or down arrow to view previous commands, the text cursor now automatically moves to the end of the line. This prevents the cursor from staying in a random spot where you last edited, making it easier to continue typing.

21fe632860e31ca5497fe0ea131e1162e260ae9a.title: CLI: Refine inline code styling
21fe632860e31ca5497fe0ea131e1162e260ae9a.summary: Updated inline code styling in the CLI. Removed theme-specific inline code foreground overrides from message-block.tsx and use-message-renderer.tsx, relying on new defaults in markdown-renderer.tsx and theme-system.ts. Default inline code foreground changed to #86efac in markdown-renderer.tsx; dark/light theme inline code foreground set to #fa8329 and codeMonochrome disabled in theme-system.ts.

4aef18cc3fa49ed4c38db78add715137ce20f537.title: Strip debug logging from CLI auth and chat flows
4aef18cc3fa49ed4c38db78add715137ce20f537.summary: Removed verbose `logger.info` calls from `use-auth-query.ts`, `use-auth-state.ts`, `use-login-polling.ts`, `login-flow.ts`, `chat.tsx`, and `login-modal.tsx`. `registry.ts` switched from `logger.error` to `console.error` for component rendering failures. Scope limited to CLI internal state management and login polling logic.

9a55c28f22dfb904ba25abe6c007982f3e6dea5d.title: Fix codesearch flag parsing to preserve argument pairs
9a55c28f22dfb904ba25abe6c007982f3e6dea5d.summary: Removed flag deduplication in `codeSearch` within `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`. Previous logic used `new Set` to deduplicate flags, which broke space-separated argument pairs like `-g *.ts`. Flags are now split and filtered without deduplication to ensure correct parsing.

bcca78c3594ba2ca964e7ec992f928d9e97e7295.title: CLI: Suppress tool calls with includeToolCall false
bcca78c3594ba2ca964e7ec992f928d9e97e7295.summary: MessageBlock now checks for `includeToolCall: false` in tool input and returns null. Prevents rendering of specific tool calls in CLI. Affects `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`. Internal rendering logic change.

919d8e7a2332edd48fb0d3cbf90e69f3ba808bb5.title: Remove asdf event log
919d8e7a2332edd48fb0d3cbf90e69f3ba808bb5.summary: Removed debug logger.info call for 'asdf event' in handleStreamChunk within cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts. This cleans up internal logging noise in the CLI message sending flow. Scope limited to CLI hook implementation.

de236d698f9b83773b4fe50cfb93f0ed1600ff5e.title: CLI input wrapped in bordered box
de236d698f9b83773b4fe50cfb93f0ed1600ff5e.summary: Chat input now renders inside a single-line bordered box via `BORDER_CHARS`. `agent-branch-item.tsx` imports shared constants from new `ui-constants.ts`, removing local border definitions. Scope limited to CLI UI components. Border styling centralized for consistency.

a711a7583540b23033f83b5523764dd2c0ea41fb.title: CLI: cleanup message rendering, diff viewer, tool registry,
a711a7583540b23033f83b5523764dd2c0ea41fb.summary: Removed unused string-width import and formatPreview helper from message-block.tsx. Simplified diffText handling in diff-viewer.tsx by removing fallback split. Replaced console.error with structured logger.error in registry.ts for tool rendering errors. Updated str-replace.tsx to pass empty string instead of null when diff is missing, preventing early return.

8a0e27f107fb54c23a1ed815ee1cc1d3112b2a61.title: CLI input placeholder text updated
8a0e27f107fb54c23a1ed815ee1cc1d3112b2a61.summary: Placeholder text in `cli/src/chat.tsx` changed from "Share your thoughts and press Enter…" to "Type your coding task or '/' to see available commands". This clarifies the input behavior and command discovery. Scope limited to CLI chat interface.

37c9c1dac1d2f4124aeb8b199a2f86d355650aee.title: CLI: Disable exitOnCtrlC in startApp
37c9c1dac1d2f4124aeb8b199a2f86d355650aee.summary: The `startApp` function in `cli/src/index.tsx` now passes `exitOnCtrlC: false` to the `render` call from `@opentui/react`. This prevents the CLI from terminating immediately upon receiving a Ctrl+C signal, allowing the application to handle the interrupt gracefully. The change is scoped to the CLI entry point. This modification alters the default behavior of the interactive terminal UI.

761b299c12816ce2a9b58686ccac78b167e3b347.title: Add backslash Enter for multiline input
761b299c12816ce2a9b58686ccac78b167e3b347.summary: Backslash Enter now inserts newline in CLI multiline input. Checks char before cursor for backslash; strips it on Enter. Modifies cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx. Adds isBackslashEnter flag and string slicing logic.

8a0e27f107fb54c23a1ed815ee1cc1d3112b2a61.text: The text shown in the input box changed to explain how to use it. It now tells you to type a task or use a slash to see commands.

4aef18cc3fa49ed4c38db78add715137ce20f537.text: The app no longer shows extra technical messages while you log in or chat. This keeps the screen clean for you.

de236d698f9b83773b4fe50cfb93f0ed1600ff5e.text: The text box where you type messages now has a clear border around it. This is a small visual update that makes the input area easier to see.

9a55c28f22dfb904ba25abe6c007982f3e6dea5d.text: A small internal fix ensures that when you give the assistant specific instructions to search for files, it now reads them correctly. This means your search requests are processed as intended, without accidentally ignoring parts of your command.

761b299c12816ce2a9b58686ccac78b167e3b347.text: You can now type text across multiple lines in the command tool by pressing the backslash key and then the Enter key.

a711a7583540b23033f83b5523764dd2c0ea41fb.text: Internal cleanup improved how text and errors are shown in the command-line tool. Users will see clearer previews and fewer confusing error messages.

919d8e7a2332edd48fb0d3cbf90e69f3ba808bb5.text: The app stopped recording extra internal notes while sending messages. This change is small and only affects how the app works behind the scenes.

37c9c1dac1d2f4124aeb8b199a2f86d355650aee.text: The command-line tool now ignores the Ctrl+C key combination, allowing it to close properly instead of stopping abruptly. This makes the experience smoother when you want to exit the program.

bcca78c3594ba2ca964e7ec992f928d9e97e7295.text: The application now hides certain internal background actions from the main text view. This keeps the conversation cleaner and easier to read.

21fe632860e31ca5497fe0ea131e1162e260ae9a.text: The color of small text snippets in the command line interface changed to look cleaner and match the app's theme better.

df345ddbcb03cc1b7e10855913e205d76dc4291a.title: Remove Prompt/Response labels from CLI agent branch items
df345ddbcb03cc1b7e10855913e205d76dc4291a.summary: Removes explicit 'Prompt' and 'Response' text labels from the CLI agent branch view in `cli/src/components/agent-branch-item.tsx`. The prompt text now uses italic attributes directly, simplifying the visual hierarchy. Scope limited to CLI rendering components.

569aa21fe301a74f85f40a3ccb2076ccdbf45035.title: Add taskcompleted tool UI renderer
569aa21fe301a74f85f40a3ccb2076ccdbf45035.summary: New `TaskCompleteComponent` renders the `task_completed` tool result as a bold "Task Complete" bullet in the CLI. Handles `task_completed` tool blocks via `defineToolComponent`. Affects `cli/src/components/tools/task-complete.tsx`. Uses `@opentui/core` `TextAttributes.BOLD` for styling.

585c22ba39a874ac9a437274cc8875f2e1da5898.title: Stop collapsing agents by default in CLI
585c22ba39a874ac9a437274cc8875f2e1da5898.summary: Agents expand by default in CLI. `use-send-message.ts` removed `setCollapsedAgents` calls. `agent-branch-item.tsx` replaced `RaisedPill` with text, removed `branchChar`. Scope: CLI only.

fa06a9fe2aa8d9b4b1b09c3ad88fc78b4014c9f7.title: CLI streams reasoning separately from text
fa06a9fe2aa8d9b4b1b09c3ad88fc78b4014c9f7.summary: CLI `use-send-message.ts` now handles `reasoning_chunk` events distinct from text, rendering them in grey. `stream-parser.ts` removes the hacky `think_deeply` tool wrapping for reasoning, passing raw chunks. `sdk/run.ts` buffers reasoning and emits `reasoning_chunk` to `handleStreamChunk`. `ContentBlock` type adds `textType` to distinguish reasoning from standard text.

2f9ad386ab476a4e9b7bc43a37d47d5e8be99e5a.title: Remove branching UI from CLI
2f9ad386ab476a4e9b7bc43a37d47d5e8be99e5a.summary: Removed branching characters and indent logic from CLI components. Simplified message-block.tsx, tool-call-item.tsx, and related files. Internal refactor.

d0266ee4a01b4e765a74390bf49da765c45f4561.title: Build mode buttons use bordered hover styling
d0266ee4a01b4e765a74390bf49da765c45f4561.summary: Build mode buttons in `cli/src/components/build-mode-buttons.tsx` switched from solid `backgroundColor` fills to `borderStyle: 'single'` with `theme.secondary` borders, brightening to `#ffffff` on hover. Added `useState` to track `hoveredButton` and a prompt text "Ready to build? Choose your mode:" above the button row. Scope limited to CLI build mode UI.

38c345fddae2e93c0411fd400c8b9f1158694321.title: Refactor CLI chat hooks into separate modules
38c345fddae2e93c0411fd400c8b9f1158694321.summary: Split monolithic logic from `cli/src/chat.tsx` into dedicated hooks: `use-agent-initialization`, `use-auth-state`, `use-chat-input`, `use-terminal-dimensions`, and `use-validation-banner`. This reduces component complexity by isolating state management, terminal dimension calculations, and agent initialization side effects. The change is internal to the CLI package, affecting `cli/src/hooks/` and `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Each new hook encapsulates specific responsibilities, such as handling auth query mutations or calculating input width based on terminal dimensions.

3a4bb9426497e14f22ec68a982cf95cee262406b.title: CLI: Add edit tool diff viewer for strreplace and writefile
3a4bb9426497e14f22ec68a982cf95cee262406b.summary: New `DiffViewer` component renders unified diffs for `str_replace` and `write_file` tool outputs. `str-replace.tsx` parses `unifiedDiff` or `patch` keys from tool output, while `write-file.tsx` delegates rendering to `StrReplaceComponent` via registry update in `registry.ts`. Colors distinguish added (`#B6BD73`) and removed (`#BF6C69`) lines, with hunk headers filtered out. Covers CLI tool UI surfaces only.

014d91c6c14489fa1861747ac8679e353693fd72.title: readsubtree label corrected to List deeply
014d91c6c14489fa1861747ac8679e353693fd72.summary: The read_subtree tool UI now displays 'List deeply' instead of 'Read subtree' to match standard tool naming conventions. The rendering logic was simplified to a single-line bullet format, removing the previous multi-line path list and collapsible header behavior. This change applies to cli/src/components/tools/read-subtree.tsx. The component now prioritizes the input.path field for the display description, falling back to the first valid entry in the paths array or '.' if neither is present.

d96c8279b4cb496a7023016d4921ef1679aa3aa6.title: Add reasoning stream support to CLI print mode
d96c8279b4cb496a7023016d4921ef1679aa3aa6.summary: Added `printModeReasoningSchema` to `common/src/types/print-mode.ts` and integrated reasoning chunk handling in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The CLI now renders reasoning text in gray before the main response, stopping the spinner on first reasoning chunk. Stream state tracking moved to instance variables (`streamStarted`, `textStreamStarted`) to manage interleaved reasoning and text output correctly.

3a4bb9426497e14f22ec68a982cf95cee262406b.text: When the assistant changes a file, you now see a clear side-by-side view of what was added and what was removed. This makes it easier to check exactly what changed without reading through the whole file.

fa06a9fe2aa8d9b4b1b09c3ad88fc78b4014c9f7.text: The assistant now shows its step-by-step thinking in grey text, separate from its final answer. This makes it easier to see how it reached a conclusion.

df345ddbcb03cc1b7e10855913e205d76dc4291a.text: The chat view no longer shows the words 'Prompt' and 'Response'. The user's text now appears in italics to tell it apart from the assistant's reply.

2f9ad386ab476a4e9b7bc43a37d47d5e8be99e5a.text: The tool removed the branching lines and extra spacing from its text display. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the output look simpler.

569aa21fe301a74f85f40a3ccb2076ccdbf45035.text: When a task finishes, the computer now shows a clear bold message saying it is done.

014d91c6c14489fa1861747ac8679e353693fd72.text: The tool's label now says 'List deeply' instead of 'Read subtree' to match standard naming. The display was simplified to a single line, removing the collapsible list view.

585c22ba39a874ac9a437274cc8875f2e1da5898.text: The tool now shows all assistant steps by default instead of hiding them.

d0266ee4a01b4e765a74390bf49da765c45f4561.text: The buttons for choosing how to build now have a cleaner outline style that lights up when you hover over them. A new message asks you to pick a mode, making the choice clearer.

38c345fddae2e93c0411fd400c8b9f1158694321.text: The team reorganized the internal structure of the chat tool to make it easier to maintain. This is a behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how you use the product.

bddfb8a52d16bf2c1b157382e392a17f8e9af54d.title: Add readsubtree CLI tool component
bddfb8a52d16bf2c1b157382e392a17f8e9af54d.summary: New read_subtree component added to CLI tool registry. Displays input paths via SimpleToolCallItem. Registered in cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts.

291adef5277d360edd064523a5171b088904db0a.title: Add writetodos component
291adef5277d360edd064523a5171b088904db0a.summary: CLI gains `write_todos` tool UI in `cli/src/components/tools/write-todos.tsx`. Renders task lists with `✓` for completed and `☐` for pending items. Registered in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts`.

847f968f43424f8b480acb2864cb1fe87a89d7b0.title: Hide agent display name unless agentId set
847f968f43424f8b480acb2864cb1fe87a89d7b0.summary: Agent display name hidden in CLI chat UI unless agentId specified. showAgentDisplayName flag gates rendering in cli/src/chat.tsx. Affects agent status line visibility.

ab11cea0583ddddae98eaa8372fb81275098170d.title: Fix multiline input text color attributes
ab11cea0583ddddae98eaa8372fb81275098170d.summary: The `textStyle` object in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` now unconditionally sets the `attributes` key, resolving a bug where text color attributes were inconsistently applied. Previously, `attributes` were only added conditionally based on placeholder state or explicit `textAttributes`, leaving them undefined in other cases. The fix ensures `TextAttributes.DIM` is used for placeholders, while falling back to `textAttributes ?? TextAttributes.NONE` otherwise. This change affects only the CLI's multiline input component.

b333641ff8b0d0fd63202d8ac7f10a6fe2ff72b8.title: Adjust Zed scroll multiplier in chat-scroll-accel
b333641ff8b0d0fd63202d8ac7f10a6fe2ff72b8.summary: Zed scroll multiplier changed from 1 to 0.37 in cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts. This internal tweak affects chat scroll acceleration within the Zed terminal environment.

57ae36c28b8174a97dde7812300b081ce25de107.title: agent-mode-toggle hover open delay set to 0
57ae36c28b8174a97dde7812300b081ce25de107.summary: OPEN_DELAY_MS in cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx reduced from 100 to 0. Removes hover latency for agent mode expansion. Affects CLI interface responsiveness.

ba8c00dcdcf6d6d2c97e557a16a33b2ccc1566b9.title: Lower CLI logo breakpoint to 20 columns
ba8c00dcdcf6d6d2c97e557a16a33b2ccc1566b9.summary: The CLI `useLogo` hook now displays the `LOGO_SMALL` variant at terminal widths of 20 columns or more, replacing the previous 40-column threshold. This adjustment ensures the compact logo renders on narrower terminals instead of falling back to the plain text `CODEBUFF` string. The change applies to the CLI rendering logic in `cli/src/hooks/use-logo.tsx`.

9d1236be79902dc836b6797e2feaad2589a5b5d7.title: CLI tool branch alignment and dense agent lists
