fc82d19e497c6cb5d7a9fb7f9362d60fcaa5e28d.text: The company deleted a few internal experiments that were not part of the final product. This cleanup makes the system simpler and more reliable for everyone.

f9c384c1ddecc100847e3fd3dfad6e4d26493264.title: Move web-search handler to agent-runtime
f9c384c1ddecc100847e3fd3dfad6e4d26493264.summary: The `handleWebSearch` function moved from `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/web-search.ts` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/web-search.ts`. Imports in `backend/src/tools/handlers/list.ts` updated to reference the new `@codebuff/agent-runtime` path. Handler logic remains identical, only import order for `PROFIT_MARGIN` and `searchWeb` changed.

9cf3f71d19f8fc28ffecb62a7c5de8bb89325538.title: linkup-api moved to agent-runtime package
9cf3f71d19f8fc28ffecb62a7c5de8bb89325538.summary: Refactored linkup-api module. Moved from backend/src/llm-apis to packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-apis. Updated import path in web-search.ts to @codebuff/agent-runtime/llm-apis/linkup-api. Internal reorganization for better package structure.

4c1fe710d55891ad27f33e05383da23dbd17c0b9.title: Move templates README to agent-runtime
4c1fe710d55891ad27f33e05383da23dbd17c0b9.summary: Relocated `templates/README.md` from `backend/src` to `packages/agent-runtime/src`. This aligns documentation with the agent-runtime package structure. Scope limited to internal file organization; no functional code changes.

dee5ab80efce7b2c3804119e08625f535adafb0c.title: Add consumeCreditsWithFallback to test agent runtime
dee5ab80efce7b2c3804119e08625f535adafb0c.summary: Added consumeCreditsWithFallback stub to TEST_AGENT_RUNTIME_IMPL in common/src/testing/impl/agent-runtime.ts. This fixes failures in backend/src/__tests__/web-search-tool.test.ts caused by missing billing dependency in the test harness. The new stub throws 'consumeCreditsWithFallback not implemented in test runtime' when called. Scope limited to shared testing utilities and backend test suite.

055e24174462a2fdeb8f37c6a5d6ab10d98d5e9b.title: Inject consumeCreditsWithFallback into web-search tool
055e24174462a2fdeb8f37c6a5d6ab10d98d5e9b.summary: Refactored billing dependency injection for web-search. Added consumeCreditsWithFallback to AgentRuntimeDeps contract and BACKEND_AGENT_RUNTIME_IMPL. Updated web-search handler to accept the function via params instead of direct import. Changed return type to ErrorOr<CreditFallbackResult> using success/failure helpers. Files: backend/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts, backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/web-search.ts, common/src/types/contracts/agent-runtime.ts, common/src/types/contracts/billing.ts, packages/billing/src/credit-delegation.ts.

c74876de415f83449ed4ebafb9bc9a69547fed27.title: Refactor str-replace handler to agent-runtime package
c74876de415f83449ed4ebafb9bc9a69547fed27.summary: Moved `handleStrReplace` from `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/str-replace.ts` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/str-replace.ts`. Updated imports in `backend/src/tools/handlers/list.ts` to source from `@codebuff/agent-runtime`. Adjusted internal imports within `str-replace.ts` to use relative paths for `processStrReplace` and `write-file` utilities. Scope limited to backend tool handler registry and agent-runtime package structure.

f9c384c1ddecc100847e3fd3dfad6e4d26493264.text: The code for searching the web was moved to a different part of the system. This internal change does not affect how you use the app or search results.

4c1fe710d55891ad27f33e05383da23dbd17c0b9.text: The team moved an internal guide to a different folder to keep things organized. Nothing changed for you. The app works exactly the same.

9cf3f71d19f8fc28ffecb62a7c5de8bb89325538.text: Internal cleanup moved the web search tool to a different place in the system. You will not notice any changes.

d30b47d7279219b4f0c8421c3a880385f2119fdb.text: A small internal fix resolved a technical check error. This change had no effect on how the product works for users.

dee5ab80efce7b2c3804119e08625f535adafb0c.text: This is an internal fix for the testing system. It does not change how the product works for users.

d110a2c2f3d458cfef54d4fd5c9a5a6eb697c2e2.text: The system now splits large requests into smaller pieces and handles them simultaneously. This improves speed and organization for complex tasks.

055e24174462a2fdeb8f37c6a5d6ab10d98d5e9b.text: The system now checks your balance more reliably when you use web search. This small internal fix helps prevent errors if your credits run low during a request.

d07d04a7a916e8569ee9f892c2c14325d8de2ccf.text: The team reorganized the internal code that runs the AI assistant. This change does not affect how you use the product.

8c3b36f7c1966b098f6f7514282be5af680ae228.title: Move find-files handler to agent-runtime
8c3b36f7c1966b098f6f7514282be5af680ae228.summary: The `find-files` tool handler moves from `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/`. Relative imports replace `@codebuff/agent-runtime` aliases for local dependencies. The `insertTrace` call to BigQuery for training blob uploads is removed from the handler logic. This aligns the handler with the agent-runtime package structure.

3993fdebb9d5ac92f999e36b31e3b7a08d23dd68.title: Inject fetch into linkup-api and web-search
3993fdebb9d5ac92f999e36b31e3b7a08d23dd68.summary: The `searchWeb` function and `handleWebSearch` tool handler now accept an injected `fetch` parameter. This change threads the fetch implementation from the tool handler down to the Linkup API client, replacing implicit global usage. Updates affect `backend/src/llm-apis/linkup-api.ts` and `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/web-search.ts`.

2390bdf93655cfb1a8b845ac37328d3d04b6cae2.title: Remove BigQuery trace insertion from request-files-prompt
2390bdf93655cfb1a8b845ac37328d3d04b6cae2.summary: Removed `insertTrace` calls and associated type imports from `packages/agent-runtime/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts`. Agent runtime no longer stores file selection traces in BigQuery. Eliminates `GetRelevantFilesTrace` and `GetExpandedFileContextForTrainingTrace` construction in `getRelevantFiles` and `getRelevantFilesForTraining`.

f3235c212106a1406707a8add71b16cdad01aef9.title: Migrate process-str-replace to agent-runtime
f3235c212106a1406707a8add71b16cdad01aef9.summary: Refactor moves `process-str-replace` from `backend/src` to `packages/agent-runtime/src`. The `str-replace.ts` handler now imports from `@codebuff/agent-runtime/process-str-replace` instead of a local relative path. This aligns the module with other agent-runtime tools like `think-deeply` and `write-file`.

9e0f3be93e18a8e8f31cc12e5d3a8f0335c8ed52.title: Add LESSONS.md
9e0f3be93e18a8e8f31cc12e5d3a8f0335c8ed52.summary: New .agents/LESSONS.md file documents agent execution lessons from buffbench runs. Covers issues like brittle test assertions, missing cross-browser CSS, and inconsistent tool input sanitization. Provides specific fixes for each identified problem to improve future agent performance.

89e2d03b6a4c4a7814164710cb2ba630889c5b02.title: Add CLI binary download proxy endpoint
89e2d03b6a4c4a7814164710cb2ba630889c5b02.summary: Added Next.js API route at web/src/app/api/releases/download/[version]/[filename]/route.ts to proxy CLI binary downloads. This endpoint redirects requests to GitHub releases, decoupling client URLs from backend storage locations. The change allows future migration of download sources without breaking existing CLI versions.

1c72ab87bf40bd2711815869577aa2238562f7f1.title: Add lessons extractor for buffbench evals
1c72ab87bf40bd2711815869577aa2238562f7f1.summary: Introduces `lessons-extractor.ts` to generate actionable insights from agent performance traces using `openai/gpt-5`. Refactors `truncateTrace` into `trace-utils.ts` for shared use by the new extractor and existing `trace-analyzer.ts`. Adds `extractLessons` flag to `run-buffbench.ts` to conditionally trigger lesson generation and save outputs to `agent-lessons/`. Suppresses logging of `Invalid JSON` errors in `agent-runner.ts` to reduce noise during extraction.

e680e801eb6a0e4bd87f22094c8a7a40d96cabaa.title: Inject trackEvent into AgentRuntimeDeps
e680e801eb6a0e4bd87f22094c8a7a40d96cabaa.summary: Added `trackEvent` to `AgentRuntimeDeps` and `PromptAiSdk` contracts, removing direct `@codebuff/common/analytics` imports from `message-cost-tracker.ts` and `run-agent-step.ts`. Decouples analytics from core runtime and LLM APIs via dependency injection. Updated backend, testing, and evals implementations to supply the new dep. Also moved `handleCreatePlan` import in `list.ts` to use `@codebuff/agent-runtime` path.

6228a229e658078389efd88abab51065b7d00d39.title: Remove benchify integration and batch strreplace
6228a229e658078389efd88abab51065b7d00d39.summary: Removes benchify dependency and `backend/src/tools/batch-str-replace.ts`. Deletes two-phase deferred `str_replace` execution logic from `backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` and `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Simplifies diff line counting in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` by removing metadata exclusion logic. Drops `BENCHIFY_API_KEY` from `packages/internal/src/env.ts`.

cac2c9b2c6ede78dada49844cb4f58a0baaee901.summary: Relocated `buildSpawnableAgentsDescription` from `backend/src/templates/prompts.ts` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/prompts.ts`. Registered in `.agents/base2/base2-with-pro-planner.ts` `spawnableAgents` list, enabling Buffy orchestrator to spawn this planner after context gathering. Planner operates tool-free, outputting single best plan per priority-ordered principles. Scope limited to internal agent definitions; no user-facing UI or CLI changes.

fb08bf54f6dd19d6ea8727fe6da1fca4faf3aa98.title: Add base2-with-task-researcher agent and update task-researcher schema
fb08bf54f6dd19d6ea8727fe6da1fca4faf3aa98.summary: New `base2-with-task-researcher.ts` defines 'Buffy the Orchestrator', a Claude Sonnet 4.5 agent that manages complex coding tasks via layered sub-agent spawning. `task-researcher.ts` updated to enforce structured output requiring `analysis`, `keyFacts`, and `relevantFiles`, while enabling `includeMessageHistory` and removing `maxContextLength` param. Old `base2-implementor.ts` renamed to `base2-implementor-gpt-5.ts`.

d861dc21bf4b63a13e4c1eae719837196a78dc98.title: initialSessionState adds legacy cwd string overload
d861dc21bf4b63a13e4c1eae719837196a78dc98.summary: Overloaded initialSessionState in sdk/src/run-state.ts to accept legacy (cwd, options) signature alongside options object. Added InitialSessionStateOptions type and dynamic fs import fallback when options.fs missing. Maintains backward compatibility for SDK consumers while normalizing internal destructuring.

86d981315fe864093d732c007fa4349d5acdebfa.title: Terminal command output truncated past 50k chars
86d981315fe864093d732c007fa4349d5acdebfa.summary: run-terminal-command.ts now truncates stdout to 50,000 characters using truncateStringWithMessage with remove: 'MIDDLE'. This prevents excessive output from overwhelming the context window. stderr remains untruncated and is combined with stdout as before.

7b98d5a0e3364e3c56c6d58d821e30fb7b648725.title: Inject databaseAgentCache into AgentRuntimeDeps
7b98d5a0e3364e3c56c6d58d821e30fb7b648725.summary: Refactored `AgentRuntimeDeps` to include `databaseAgentCache` as a required dependency, replacing the global `databaseAgentCache` variable in `agent-registry.ts`. This change updates `getAgentTemplate` and `clearDatabaseCache` to accept the cache map via parameters, ensuring consistent state management across backend, testing, and evals implementations. Files modified include `backend/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts`, `common/src/testing/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, `common/src/types/contracts/agent-runtime.ts`, and `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts`.

7eb244c919d6518e82f039c463133a7a355c207b.title: Remove redundant agent registry mock in loop-agent-steps.test.ts
7eb244c919d6518e82f039c463133a7a355c207b.summary: Deleted unused `getAgentTemplate` mock and type import from `backend/src/__tests__/loop-agent-steps.test.ts`. The mock module definition was unnecessary for the current test setup, causing lint or TS errors. Change is internal to the backend test suite. No user-facing behavior affected.

c255a2bbd523436e2bbb6a25512dd6423bd9e5d2.title: Agent runner debug flag and judge timeout extension
c255a2bbd523436e2bbb6a25512dd6423bd9e5d2.summary: Added `DEBUG_ERROR` flag to `evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts` for dumping error traces to JSON files. Increased judge and trace analyzer timeouts from 10 to 20 minutes in `judge.ts` and `trace-analyzer.ts`. Scope limited to internal evals infrastructure.

3212f215c6793cc65f8922d41ff7c5e10062898c.title: Move agent-registry to @codebuff/agent-runtime
3212f215c6793cc65f8922d41ff7c5e10062898c.summary: Refactors agent registry imports to use @codebuff/agent-runtime package instead of local backend templates. Extracts fetchAgentFromDatabase into new backend/src/templates/agent-db.ts. Updates imports across backend API, websockets, tools, and evals scaffolding. Resolves circular dependency in spawn-agent-utils by replacing dynamic import with static loopAgentSteps import.

0d1a74e3de45c233e1f518a9bdc94a416a09880b.title: New agent architecture: research-implement-orchestrator and
0d1a74e3de45c233e1f518a9bdc94a416a09880b.summary: Introduced `research-implement-orchestrator` (Claude Sonnet 4.5) and `base2-implementor` (GPT-5) to decompose coding tasks into research and implementation layers. `base2-implementor` orchestrates specialized sub-agents for planning, editing, and reviewing, while `task-researcher` generates structured reports on key facts and relevant files. Eval configs updated to test these new agents against `add-custom-tools` task.

7eb244c919d6518e82f039c463133a7a355c207b.text: A small, internal cleanup removed an unused test setup. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

3212f215c6793cc65f8922d41ff7c5e10062898c.text: The system now finds assistant information in a better place. This change fixes a background error and makes the app more stable for you.

9c60bc01fa615522d05499dc45aa413a107712e1.text: The assistant can now use a new model to make better plans. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

c255a2bbd523436e2bbb6a25512dd6423bd9e5d2.text: The system now records more error details and waits longer for checks to finish. This change affects only internal tools and will not change how the product works for you.

d861dc21bf4b63a13e4c1eae719837196a78dc98.text: The software now handles older ways of setting up a session while still supporting newer methods. This keeps things working smoothly for existing users without breaking anything.

7b98d5a0e3364e3c56c6d58d821e30fb7b648725.text: The system now uses a shared internal storage area to manage assistant settings, replacing a disconnected copy. This ensures the assistant sees the same information everywhere.

6177ad13446602a647f90b7447ce49be89ddec9b.text: The software now includes hidden tools that help support staff find and fix problems faster. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

fb08bf54f6dd19d6ea8727fe6da1fca4faf3aa98.text: The assistant now uses a smarter planner that breaks big jobs into smaller steps and checks its own work before finishing. This helps it handle more complicated tasks without getting lost.

0d1a74e3de45c233e1f518a9bdc94a416a09880b.text: The system now splits work into two parts: first, it looks up the right information, then it builds the result. This internal update aims to improve how tasks are handled, but you will not see any new buttons or features.

aa2cedb69ceb573cde804829eac85ced67e05ff2.title: CI test matrix includes web and agent-runtime packages
aa2cedb69ceb573cde804829eac85ced67e05ff2.summary: CI workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` updated to add `web` and `packages/agent-runtime` to the test and integration test matrices. Previously these packages were excluded from automated test runs. This change ensures code changes in these packages trigger appropriate test jobs.

8117d9d38c6e5e712c2e9fb8a0f32f662984ffa2.title: Move MCP tool data to agent-runtime
8117d9d38c6e5e712c2e9fb8a0f32f662984ffa2.summary: Relocates `getMCPToolData` from `backend/src/mcp/util.ts` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/mcp.ts`. Updates imports in `run-agent-step.ts` and `tool-executor.ts` to source from `@codebuff/agent-runtime/mcp`. This centralizes MCP logic within the agent runtime package. No functional changes or API surface modifications.

b8d1c1eb3eea562d91b2038767ce3d370853d6e5.title: Add cli to CI matrix
b8d1c1eb3eea562d91b2038767ce3d370853d6e5.summary: Added cli package to CI test and integration test matrices in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Matrix entries sorted alphabetically. Ensures cli tests run automatically on CI.

665d6022eb08caca66b00ac076e5da283a2906c1.title: Move xml-stream-parser to agent-runtime/tool-stream-parser
665d6022eb08caca66b00ac076e5da283a2906c1.summary: Relocated `xml-stream-parser` to `@codebuff/agent-runtime/tool-stream-parser`. Updated `backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` to import `processStreamWithTags` from the new package path. This consolidates stream parsing logic within the agent-runtime package.

cd0c35051e06f99ef6f16b38f52c458c23b070ba.title: Move handler-function-type into agent-runtime
cd0c35051e06f99ef6f16b38f52c458c23b070ba.summary: Refactored `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` type definition. Moved from `backend/src/tools/handlers/handler-function-type` to `@codebuff/agent-runtime/tools/handlers/handler-function-type`. Updated imports across multiple tool handler files in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/`.

d5b458960a05d53f4ede8f930fc739d625c84aab.title: Print all scores in buffbench evals
d5b458960a05d53f4ede8f930fc739d625c84aab.summary: run-buffbench.ts now prints all overall scores for distribution analysis. The loop filters out runs with commit errors, formats valid scores to one decimal, and logs them per agent ID. Affects evals/buffbench/run-buffbench.ts.

1d2ae571961279f98a2be3003238aca5b288809e.title: fix web test
1d2ae571961279f98a2be3003238aca5b288809e.summary: Updated completions.test.ts to assert against NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL instead of hardcoded localhost. Fixes flaky test caused by environment mismatch.

994b0984be13875ea91f877f5378f78ff29e6114.title: Move prompt-agent-stream to agent-runtime package
994b0984be13875ea91f877f5378f78ff29e6114.summary: Moved prompt-agent-stream.ts and constants.ts from backend/src to packages/agent-runtime/src. run-agent-step.ts updated to import getAgentStreamFromTemplate from '@codebuff/agent-runtime/prompt-agent-stream'. Internal refactor to consolidate agent runtime logic into dedicated package. No user-facing behavior change.

4d3e9e5c93a2bd32cd0bcd7fc8ff5a734ffbb2e6.title: Fix text block aggregation and extend streaming coverage
4d3e9e5c93a2bd32cd0bcd7fc8ff5a734ffbb2e6.summary: Corrects text block aggregation by removing premature state resets and enforcing trimmed text emission. Streaming coverage extends to flush pending sections specifically when active tags and partial text exist. Changes isolated to sdk/src/run.ts.

8117d9d38c6e5e712c2e9fb8a0f32f662984ffa2.text: The assistant's internal tooling for connecting to external data was moved to a central location. This is an invisible housekeeping change with no impact on how you use the product.

cd0c35051e06f99ef6f16b38f52c458c23b070ba.text: The assistant's internal organization was cleaned up. You will see no difference.

994b0984be13875ea91f877f5378f78ff29e6114.text: The code that helps the assistant think and respond was moved to a cleaner location. This is an internal change, so the product works exactly the same.

ac5e30fa879ae975f6c86c1c2981ac1be6d1307e.text: The assistant now handles your current conversation details more reliably by keeping them in a shared central place. This internal update improves stability without changing how you interact with the product.

d5b458960a05d53f4ede8f930fc739d625c84aab.text: Internal reporting now shows every test result for performance analysis. This helps the team understand overall quality, but nothing changes for you.

b8d1c1eb3eea562d91b2038767ce3d370853d6e5.text: The command-line tool is now tested automatically during updates. This change is internal and does not affect the user experience.

aa2cedb69ceb573cde804829eac85ced67e05ff2.text: Automatic checks now cover the main application and its core services. This helps catch errors earlier before updates reach you.

4d3e9e5c93a2bd32cd0bcd7fc8ff5a734ffbb2e6.text: Text messages now combine correctly and appear without extra spaces. This prevents the assistant from sending broken or messy sentences.

1d2ae571961279f98a2be3003238aca5b288809e.text: A small internal fix makes a test check the correct web address instead of a local one. This stops the test from failing randomly when the environment changes.

665d6022eb08caca66b00ac076e5da283a2906c1.text: The system reorganized its internal files to group related tools together. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

b9f1f1bc94b9dda5e2e28c8fc191663a7c899b33.title: Reduce log spam in agent traces
b9f1f1bc94b9dda5e2e28c8fc191663a7c899b33.summary: Removed or commented out debug/info logs in `run-programmatic-step.ts`, `analytics.ts`, `bigquery/client.ts`, and `billing/balance-calculator.ts`. This reduces noise in agent traces to improve readability. No user-facing behavior changes.

98ec8fd6847c39221b548818d3fac2e4e667fbe0.title: Add three base2 agent variants
98ec8fd6847c39221b548818d3fac2e4e667fbe0.summary: Added `.agents/base2/base2-code-reviewer.ts`, `.agents/base2/base2-no-review.ts`, and `.agents/base2/base2-validator.ts`. These files define `createBase2` functions returning `SecretAgentDefinition` objects for the 'Buffy the Orchestrator' agent, using `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`. The variants differ in their `spawnableAgents` lists: `base2-code-reviewer` includes `code-reviewer`, `base2-no-review` excludes it, and `base2-validator` includes both `code-reviewer` and `validator`. All three share the same core system prompt, tool names (`spawn_agents`, `read_files`, `str_replace`, `write_file`), and input schema.

0188a3e52aab3b723a4170dd6cd81535630648f6.title: Move agent template types to @codebuff/agent-runtime
0188a3e52aab3b723a4170dd6cd81535630648f6.summary: Relocated `AgentTemplate`, `PLACEHOLDER`, and `placeholderValues` types from `backend/src/templates/types.ts` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/types.ts`. Backend modules including `main-prompt.ts`, `mcp/util.ts`, and `tools/stream-parser.ts` now import these types from the new `@codebuff/agent-runtime` package path. This refactoring decouples core agent runtime types from the backend implementation, facilitating shared usage across packages.

81989198a08ab9417a41f3498a92be3807a3617e.title: Debounce clipboard selection and show text preview
81989198a08ab9417a41f3498a92be3807a3617e.summary: Added a 2-second debounce to `useClipboard` to prevent rapid-fire copies during text selection. Replaced generic 'Copied to clipboard' message with a truncated preview of the copied text. The hook now listens to the `selection` event instead of `selectionchange` and uses `getSelectedText()` from the renderer.

39bfc0cc2dd3a8f910d2f1a1fcc5681ebb8e8e4e.title: Add structured outputs support to OpenRouter example script
39bfc0cc2dd3a8f910d2f1a1fcc5681ebb8e8e4e.summary: scripts/fat-sdk-openrouter-example.ts now uses generateObject with a Zod schema instead of generateText. Provider config sets supportsStructuredOutputs: true. Model target switched to openai/gpt-5.

fe47289c0a28ad2b706bbc7e997df9f9bdd669a0.title: countTokens import moved to agent-runtime
fe47289c0a28ad2b706bbc7e997df9f9bdd669a0.summary: Internal import path for `countTokens` changed from `@codebuff/backend/util/token-counter` to `@codebuff/agent-runtime/util/token-counter`. Eval scripts `judge-git-eval.ts` and `post-eval-analysis.ts` updated to reflect module relocation. No runtime behavior change.

82bbc8350e2fc94430b3718e49f54aa8f6c0326b.title: BuffBench error logs include commit ID
82bbc8350e2fc94430b3718e49f54aa8f6c0326b.summary: Error output in `evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts` now prefixes messages with `[${commit.id}:${agentId}]`. The `handleEvent` filter suppresses both `tool_call` and `tool_result` events for `set_messages`. Planner instructions in `.agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-planner.ts` were simplified to remove inline agent spawning steps. Meta-analysis logging was removed from `evals/buffbench/run-buffbench.ts`.

05ccf5598533c54b5979d13a0f2b4f00029c83b0.title: Add taskIds option to runBuffBench for selective eval runs
05ccf5598533c54b5979d13a0f2b4f00029c83b0.summary: runBuffBench now accepts taskIds to filter eval commits by ID. New main-single-eval.ts demonstrates single-task execution. Missing IDs throw errors listing available tasks. Affects evals/buffbench subsystem.

8fc654f7a2f037c92fc27a1d25c0bead9e674ba5.title: Move token-counter to agent-runtime
8fc654f7a2f037c92fc27a1d25c0bead9e674ba5.summary: Relocated `token-counter.ts` from `backend/src/util` to `packages/agent-runtime/src/util`. Updated imports in `relace-api.ts`, `process-file-block.ts`, `run-agent-step.ts`, and system prompt files to use `@codebuff/agent-runtime/util/token-counter`. This centralizes token counting logic within the agent runtime package. No functional changes to the counter implementation.

efd1a5d5e6922c7a5e43243a6e5dcde8bbad3187.title: Move util/messages and llm-apis/claude to agent-runtime
efd1a5d5e6922c7a5e43243a6e5dcde8bbad3187.summary: Moved `util/messages` and `llm-apis/claude` from `backend` to `packages/agent-runtime`. Updated imports across `backend/src` and `scripts` to reference the new `@codebuff/agent-runtime` paths. `TextBlock` in `claude.ts` now requires the `type` field.

81989198a08ab9417a41f3498a92be3807a3617e.text: The app now waits briefly before copying selected text to avoid accidental duplicates. It also shows a short preview of the copied text instead of a generic message.

fe47289c0a28ad2b706bbc7e997df9f9bdd669a0.text: A small internal change moved one tool to a new location. Nothing about how the product works changed for you.

b9f1f1bc94b9dda5e2e28c8fc191663a7c899b33.text: The assistant stopped writing extra notes about its background tasks. This makes the activity logs easier to read for support teams, but nothing changes for how you use the product.

8fc654f7a2f037c92fc27a1d25c0bead9e674ba5.text: The team moved a small internal tool to a new location to keep the system organized. This change does not affect how the assistant works or what it can do for you.

05ccf5598533c54b5979d13a0f2b4f00029c83b0.text: The internal testing system can now run checks on specific items instead of all of them at once. This helps the team focus on one part of the product without waiting for a full test suite.

39bfc0cc2dd3a8f910d2f1a1fcc5681ebb8e8e4e.text: The assistant now uses a new model that can organize its answers into clear, structured formats. This is an internal update, so you might see slightly more consistent responses when the system needs specific data.

98ec8fd6847c39221b548818d3fac2e4e667fbe0.text: The assistant now has three different working styles for handling tasks. These internal changes adjust how it checks its own work, without affecting what users see.

0188a3e52aab3b723a4170dd6cd81535630648f6.text: The team moved a core piece of the assistant's brain to a shared location. This internal cleanup helps the software work better across different parts of the product.

82bbc8350e2fc94430b3718e49f54aa8f6c0326b.text: Small internal update. Error logs now include a unique identifier to help the team track issues faster. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ba5281b3054f1290fbc934619d9e17aca373e8d8.title: Fix SDK text typing and adjust tests
ba5281b3054f1290fbc934619d9e17aca373e8d8.summary: Introduces `TextPrintEvent` type to correctly constrain `lastTextEventByAgent` map in `sdk/src/run.ts`. Replaces generic `PrintModeEvent` with specific `Extract<PrintModeEvent, { type: 'text' }>` definition. Updates internal state tracking to ensure type safety for text emission events. Covers `sdk/src/run.ts` and related test files.

fbdebe60bc0fc3a04443a51827454085a7df8f95.title: Add toolName to toolresult chunks in batch-str-replace
fbdebe60bc0fc3a04443a51827454085a7df8f95.summary: Added toolName to tool_result payloads in backend/src/tools/batch-str-replace.ts. The field is populated from toolResultPart.toolName, errorResult.toolName, and benchifyToolResult.toolName. This aligns the chunk structure with expected type definitions, ensuring consumers can identify the originating tool.

8165bf4a66ae41e58a1037fbb2909eaedb8efd8d.title: Refactor eval AgentStep to PrintModeEvent
8165bf4a66ae41e58a1037fbb2909eaedb8efd8d.summary: Switch eval AgentStep to be all printmode events. Refactor `agent-runner.ts` to push raw `PrintModeEvent` objects to trace, removing manual `flushStep` aggregation logic. Update `trace-analyzer.ts` to handle truncation directly on `tool_result` event types instead of aggregated step objects.

7584c09b880d1c005a7c1350be3091c8867b7ef9.title: SDK run.ts emits buffered text mid-run
7584c09b880d1c005a7c1350be3091c8867b7ef9.summary: The `run` function in `sdk/src/run.ts` now emits accumulated text sections immediately upon receiving non-text chunks (like tool calls) or agent switches, rather than waiting for the final flush. This is achieved by introducing `emitPendingSection` and `sectionStartIndexByAgent` to track and slice buffered text for each agent key. The change ensures that intermediate text generated by subagents or preceding tool calls is visible to the `handleEvent` consumer in real-time. Tests for this behavior are added in `sdk/src/__tests__/run-text-emission.test.ts`.

28578ec0a98bd4991dfefe79704d7509e1e5a5fc.title: @codebuff/sdk 0.4.3 to 0.4.4
28578ec0a98bd4991dfefe79704d7509e1e5a5fc.summary: SDK version bumped to 0.4.4 in sdk/package.json. Patch-level release with no functional changes.

c3a229c24ad50508a592891522f21c1d23de690c.title: Add toolName to PrintModeToolResult
c3a229c24ad50508a592891522f21c1d23de690c.summary: toolName added to PrintModeToolResult schema in print-mode.ts. tool-executor.ts propagates toolName in tool_result chunks. Enables precise tool identification in print mode. Internal type and executor update.

9093076a9c83e5ce7e9a695f709aae7ba4397dda.title: Add code-searcher directory-lister glob-matcher to gpt-5 agents
9093076a9c83e5ce7e9a695f709aae7ba4397dda.summary: Updated spawnableAgents in .agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-planner.ts and .agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-worker.ts to include code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher. The planner swapped file-picker and find-all-referencer for file-picker-max and the new tools, while the worker replaced find-all-referencer. base2.ts stepPrompt updated to reference code-reviewer and validator alongside existing agents.

61b97f51de9ff2574515b5ed332852db6d82444e.title: Add JSDoc to Source type
61b97f51de9ff2574515b5ed332852db6d82444e.summary: Added JSDoc comments to `Source<T>` in `common/src/types/source.ts`. Describes the union as accepting values, promises, or functions returning them. Internal documentation only.

d75bbf2e220f6459116eda5a1da3dbbf1c1455cd.summary: The `/api/v1/chat/completions` endpoint now supports non-streaming requests via `generateText` and inserts message rows into BigQuery. `handleOpenRouterStream` was refactored into `handleOpenRouterNonStream` and `handleOpenRouterStream`, with `insertMessageBigquery` added to the route dependencies. `MessageRow` type moved to `common/src/types/contracts/bigquery.ts`, and `getAgentRunFromId` return type changed from `undefined` to `null`.

742227da10913c4864e05563894dc6636d1b29ed.title: Add staging binary release pipeline for CLI
742227da10913c4864e05563894dc6636d1b29ed.summary: New GitHub Actions workflows `cli-release-staging.yml` and `cli-release-build.yml` enable automated binary builds for PRs tagged `[codebuff-cli]`. Staging metadata is generated in `cli/release-staging/package.json` and consumed by a reusable build matrix targeting linux, darwin, and win32 via `bun`. The CLI package now includes a `build:binary` script and ignores the `bin` directory.

61b97f51de9ff2574515b5ed332852db6d82444e.text: The developers added internal notes to the code to explain how it works. This change does not affect how the product looks or functions for users.

9093076a9c83e5ce7e9a695f709aae7ba4397dda.text: The assistant's internal search tools were updated to help it find information more effectively. This small change should make it easier for the assistant to locate relevant details when answering questions.

7584c09b880d1c005a7c1350be3091c8867b7ef9.text: Text responses now appear instantly as they are generated, rather than waiting until the entire task finishes.

2c3cef47c8f80c63e7e3054ef68fb7e81674fc43.title: Tweak validator, codebase-commands-explorer, move file-lister-max to
2c3cef47c8f80c63e7e3054ef68fb7e81674fc43.summary: Moved file-lister-max.ts to .agents-graveyard/ and updated its import paths to point to .agents/constants and .agents/types. Adjusted codebase-commands-explorer prompts to prioritize linting over running, and focus on top-level/sub-package commands. Modified validator.ts to remove max attempts constraint and make codebase-commands-explorer spawning conditional.

66d488101b9299b3b48fe0a907c205d336cfdc65.title: SDK tsconfig adds bun-types to types
66d488101b9299b3b48fe0a907c205d336cfdc65.summary: Added bun-types to the types array in sdk/tsconfig.json alongside node. Fixes SDK typecheck failures when using Bun as the runtime. Scope limited to sdk/tsconfig.json. No API changes.

3d9c6f950d4316fd3ade1592cedc305759083b26.title: code-reviewer prompt enforces critical-only feedback
3d9c6f950d4316fd3ade1592cedc305759083b26.summary: System prompt in .agents/reviewer/code-reviewer.ts restructured to prioritize critical feedback and explicitly suppress praise or strengths sections. New instructions mandate brevity and a single-sentence approval if no improvements are found. Scope limited to internal reviewer agent prompt configuration.

a7f0d37e617bdd35f08684e595b68dd9ab2fa8b2.title: SDK 0.4.3 strips tool-call XML from non-streamed responses
a7f0d37e617bdd35f08684e595b68dd9ab2fa8b2.summary: SDK 0.4.3 introduces `stripToolCallPayloads` and exports `processToolCallBuffer` to filter `<codebuff_tool_call>` segments from non-streamed text. CLI `use-send-message` now consumes the shared SDK helper instead of local buffering logic, preventing XML leakage in final message blocks. `message-block.tsx` render keys simplified to stable IDs, removing content-length/stream-state dependencies. `run.ts` applies sanitization to accumulated text and hardens `agentId` property checks.

94b2449a8e687af2090225001ed7a82e5bd2ee57.title: Add agent steps endpoint
94b2449a8e687af2090225001ed7a82e5bd2ee57.summary: Added `POST /api/v1/agent-runs/{runId}/steps` to record individual agent execution steps. Implemented in `web/src/api/v1/agent-runs/[runId]/steps.ts` with Zod validation for step metadata like `stepNumber`, `credits`, and `status`. Includes auth checks via API key extraction and analytics event tracking for validation errors. Route handler created at `web/src/app/api/v1/agent-runs/[runId]/steps/route.ts`. Also renamed `chat-completions.ts` to `chat/completions.ts` and updated `tsconfig.json` to include test files in compilation.

51003b6481c11dec1f8774b062fd13a541cb0923.title: Pass agent definitions to Buffbench trace and meta analyzers
51003b6481c11dec1f8774b062fd13a541cb0923.summary: Buffbench evals now inject full agent definitions and type references into trace and meta-analyzer contexts. The agent-runner accepts pre-loaded definitions instead of fetching them per-commit, while run-buffbench loads them once from .agents. This enables analyzers to correlate agent behavior with specific configurations, tools, and prompts. New meta-analyzer.ts aggregates cross-task performance insights.

cc2883fecaaa85f7851fa637d0588641ee402a1e.title: Add base2-gpt-5-planner agent for hybrid orchestration
cc2883fecaaa85f7851fa637d0588641ee402a1e.summary: Introduced `base2-gpt-5-planner` and `base2-with-gpt-5-planner` agents. `base2-gpt-5-planner` uses `openai/gpt-5` for planning, while `base2-with-gpt-5-planner` orchestrates it alongside `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` for execution. This hybrid approach separates planning and coding tasks. Files: `.agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-planner.ts`, `.agents/base2/base2-with-gpt-5-planner.ts`.

01bfdc23bd9397068024c9bf4e2f4d9814b6f718.title: Add FINISH action to /api/v1/agent-runs
01bfdc23bd9397068024c9bf4e2f4d9814b6f718.summary: The /api/v1/agent-runs endpoint now accepts a FINISH action, enabling clients to report run completion, failure, or cancellation. This update introduces the agentRunsFinishSchema, validates status and credit metrics, and triggers AGENT_RUN_COMPLETED analytics events. Database access is refactored in web/src/api/v1/agent-runs.ts to use an injected CodebuffPgDatabase type, while backend/src/agent-run.ts adopts a ParamsOf utility for cleaner signature typing.

dfcc0c1cd89e33166928cf814c16441c9a486715.title: Fix streaming text deduplication in CLI and SDK
dfcc0c1cd89e33166928cf814c16441c9a486715.summary: Streaming text now deduplicates correctly in CLI and SDK using a new mergeTextSegments function and shared tool-xml-filter module. Previous logic failed to handle overlapping chunks or full replacements, causing duplicated or missing text in agent responses. Changes affect cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts and sdk/src/run.ts, with logic extracted to sdk/src/tool-xml-filter.ts. The update introduces root stream buffering and agent-specific accumulators to maintain state across chunks.

6d5d85a97e7ba2b986693b1be3634ec15c18fc17.title: SDK fsSource input
6d5d85a97e7ba2b986693b1be3634ec15c18fc17.summary: SDK accepts `fsSource` input via new `CodebuffFileSystem` type. Core functions `getProjectFileTree`, `parseGitignore`, `ensureDirectoryExists`, `isDir`, `stagePatches` now require injected `fs` object. Scope covers `common/src/types/filesystem.ts`, `npm-app` CLI, browser-runner, credentials, project-files. Callers must pass `fs` instance explicitly.

51003b6481c11dec1f8774b062fd13a541cb0923.text: The system now remembers each assistant's specific settings and instructions during tests. This helps the team see exactly how different setups affect performance.

6d5d85a97e7ba2b986693b1be3634ec15c18fc17.text: The tool now lets you choose where to find files, like a specific folder or online drive. This makes it more flexible for different setups.

cc2883fecaaa85f7851fa637d0588641ee402a1e.text: The assistant now splits work between two AI tools, one for planning and one for writing code. This internal change may improve how it handles complex tasks.

dfcc0c1cd89e33166928cf814c16441c9a486715.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant's text would sometimes repeat or skip words while typing. You now see the full, correct message without errors.

a7f0d37e617bdd35f08684e595b68dd9ab2fa8b2.text: Internal cleanup. Fixed a bug where hidden system codes leaked into chat messages. Users now see clean text.

94b2449a8e687af2090225001ed7a82e5bd2ee57.text: The system now records each step the assistant takes during a task. This helps the team track progress and fix issues, but you will not notice any immediate change in how the assistant works.

66d488101b9299b3b48fe0a907c205d336cfdc65.text: The software now works better with a specific type of computer environment. This fixes a background error that could stop the product from running correctly.

3d9c6f950d4316fd3ade1592cedc305759083b26.text: The internal review tool now gives only serious feedback. It skips praise or minor notes to keep things short.

2c3cef47c8f80c63e7e3054ef68fb7e81674fc43.text: The assistant now checks code quality before running tasks and focuses on main commands. Some unused tools were removed, and the assistant stops trying after failures are handled differently.

01bfdc23bd9397068024c9bf4e2f4d9814b6f718.text: The system now records when a task finishes, fails, or is canceled. This helps track progress and usage for each run.

32abf6230e9f62adabba5d625c3e33466a661c7f.title: Add ErrorOr preference to knowledge.md
32abf6230e9f62adabba5d625c3e33466a661c7f.summary: Added Error Handling Philosophy section to knowledge.md. Mandates ErrorOr<T> return types over throwing errors. References success/failure helpers in common/src/util/error.ts.

3196d7975658d2aa215bde9d557f885ff429629e.title: Add validator and code-reviewer agents to base2 workflow
3196d7975658d2aa215bde9d557f885ff429629e.summary: Replaces generic reviewer with specialized code-reviewer and validator agents in base2 orchestration. code-reviewer (Claude Sonnet 4.5) critiques edits; validator (Claude Sonnet 4.5) runs build/test/typecheck loops with auto-fix. Updated base2.ts spawnableAgents list and step prompts to reflect new two-stage post-edit workflow. codebase-commands-explorer switched to Grok Code Fast 1, expanded tool access (read_files), and simplified spawnable agents to core primitives.

55554e156bd1b0faed217016f6c55e4279db6b50.title: Disable usePaste hook in CLI multiline input
55554e156bd1b0faed217016f6c55e4279db6b50.summary: The `usePaste` hook in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` is commented out, removing clipboard paste handling from the multiline input component. The import statement for `usePaste` is also commented out to prevent unused variable warnings. This change disables paste functionality specifically for the CLI's multiline text input.

fdf4a4665e57388edd0c51de149cdb41a68bbd26.title: code-search docs teach multi-extension ripgrep flags
fdf4a4665e57388edd0c51de149cdb41a68bbd26.summary: code-search tool descriptions update `-t ts` example to `-t ts -t js` to show multi-extension filtering. Scope: `.agents/file-explorer/code-searcher.ts`, `backend/src/tools/definitions/tool/code-search.ts`, `common/src/tools/params/tool/code-search.ts`, `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/tools.ts`. Detail: `ListDirectoryParams` JSDoc clarifies return shape as separate file and directory arrays.

80fc1effeb4b5a468c6e767ff3a73a08e0f25ecc.title: Fix code search flags docs
80fc1effeb4b5a468c6e767ff3a73a08e0f25ecc.summary: Code search tool documentation updated to use `--type-not py` instead of `--type-not test` as the example for excluding file types. This change affects the `flags` parameter description and examples in `backend/src/tools/definitions/tool/code-search.ts`, `common/src/tools/params/tool/code-search.ts`, `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/tools.ts`, and `.agents/file-explorer/code-searcher.ts`. The correction ensures the example aligns with valid ripgrep type names, as `test` is not a standard type but `py` is.

28d09e3c03b10bd8e7c228d543f199df7d6eefd2.title: Fix CLI paste handling and input focus
28d09e3c03b10bd8e7c228d543f199df7d6eefd2.summary: Re-enable bracketed paste support in `MultilineInput` via new `use-opentui-paste` hook. Add `bun-strip-ansi` polyfill for Bun 1.2+ compatibility. Insert `yieldToEventLoop` in `use-send-message` to ensure UI updates before focus changes.

58b1334d6359b8685011bf063a677132bd80010c.title: Add chat completions analytics events
58b1334d6359b8685011bf063a677132bd80010c.summary: Replaced generic SSE endpoint tracking with specific `CHAT_COMPLETIONS_*` events in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Refactored `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/route.ts` to delegate logic to new `web/src/api/v1/chat-completions.ts` module, injecting dependencies for better testability. Added `GetUserUsageDataFn` contract in `common/src/types/contracts/billing.ts` and `HandleOpenRouterStreamFn` in `llm.ts`. Covers API request, auth, validation, credit, stream start, and error states.

646511e0d12ebd50eb5af606a791b94a75a1eec0.title: Fix typecheck errors
646511e0d12ebd50eb5af606a791b94a75a1eec0.summary: Typecheck errors fixed. `useSearchParams`, `usePathname`, `useParams` returns now guarded with nullish coalescing fallbacks (`new URLSearchParams()`, `/docs`, `/`, `{}`, `''`). Covers `web/src/app` pages (admin, docs, orgs, payment, profile, publishers), `web/src/components` (footer, login, organization, sign-in, ui). Mechanism: Next.js hooks may return `null` in static rendering or edge cases; fallbacks satisfy strict TypeScript checks.

1f3b425d12af04a4f15409814f92d25504d156d3.title: CLI migrates from custom OpenTUI fork to official v0.1.27
1f3b425d12af04a4f15409814f92d25504d156d3.summary: CLI dependencies `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/react` replaced custom `CodebuffAI/opentui` fork with official `^0.1.27` packages. Migration removes `build:opentui` script and `setup-cli-symlinks.ts` postinstall hook. `usePaste` hook lost; terminal paste now handled as regular key input via native mechanism. Affects `cli/package.json` and root `package.json`.

646511e0d12ebd50eb5af606a791b94a75a1eec0.text: Fixed a small internal error to keep website pages working correctly.

3196d7975658d2aa215bde9d557f885ff429629e.text: The assistant now uses two separate helpers to check its own work before finishing. This helps catch mistakes earlier, so the final result is more reliable.

58b1334d6359b8685011bf063a677132bd80010c.text: The system now tracks specific details about chat interactions, such as when a request starts or encounters an error, rather than using generic monitoring. This helps the service understand usage patterns and identify issues more accurately, though it does not change how the chat interface looks or behaves for users.

28d09e3c03b10bd8e7c228d543f199df7d6eefd2.text: The assistant now handles pasted text more reliably and keeps the input box ready for typing. Small fix for smoother use.

55554e156bd1b0faed217016f6c55e4279db6b50.text: Paste functionality is now disabled in the text input box. You cannot use keyboard shortcuts to paste text into this specific area.

efd1a5d5e6922c7a5e43243a6e5dcde8bbad3187.text: The assistant's core message handling and model connection code moved into a shared library. This internal cleanup helps the team reuse these parts elsewhere without changing how the assistant behaves for you.

80fc1effeb4b5a468c6e767ff3a73a08e0f25ecc.text: The instructions for excluding specific file types from search results were corrected to use valid examples. This ensures the tool accurately follows user commands to skip unwanted files.

32abf6230e9f62adabba5d625c3e33466a661c7f.text: Internal change: the team set a new rule for how the software handles problems, aiming for steadier behavior.

1f3b425d12af04a4f15409814f92d25504d156d3.text: The tool now uses standard official components instead of a custom version. This makes it easier to update and maintain in the future.

fdf4a4665e57388edd0c51de149cdb41a68bbd26.text: The assistant now searches for multiple file types at once. This helps it find relevant code faster.

0260e2a5776f290b8693d0b81ec1aa0f78a639c1.title: Fix web build SSR error with custom error page
0260e2a5776f290b8693d0b81ec1aa0f78a639c1.summary: Added custom `_error.tsx` page and disabled TypeScript build errors in `next.config.mjs` to resolve SSR failures. The new error component handles both server-side status codes and client-side errors via `getInitialProps`. Scope covers the `web` package build configuration and page routing.

25caee5f6a0cfe5a2f08ab65bddc753f6e8a4327.title: file-picker-max model switch to Gemini 2.0 Flash
25caee5f6a0cfe5a2f08ab65bddc753f6e8a4327.summary: file-picker-max agent definition updated to use google/gemini-2.0-flash-001 instead of anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. reasoningOptions added with enabled false and effort low. System prompt placeholder changed from FILE_TREE_PROMPT_SMALL to FILE_TREE_PROMPT. Instructions tightened to enforce extremely short reports.

cce5484debd0b561480c6f163fb9f6a09ebdd39a.title: Backend survives uncaught exceptions
cce5484debd0b561480c6f163fb9f6a09ebdd39a.summary: Removed process.exit(1) and server.close() from uncaughtException handler in backend/src/index.ts. Backend now logs errors without terminating. Prevents accidental service downtime from transient exceptions.

bf2128663225a641e746c2dd341ebd21c9664d3b.title: Fix CLI symlink setup for OpenTUI native packages
bf2128663225a641e746c2dd341ebd21c9664d3b.summary: setup-cli-symlinks.ts now installs dependencies and builds native/lib targets for @opentui/core before linking. It dynamically symlinks all native packages from core/node_modules/@opentui to root node_modules/@opentui. This ensures CLI runtime loads native bindings correctly when packages are unbuilt.

10088392e2eb8b537251237bfe6aec441e246e20.title: Add analytics tracking to web API endpoints
10088392e2eb8b537251237bfe6aec441e246e20.summary: Introduced `TrackEventFn` contract and new `AnalyticsEvent` enums for agent runs and user profile endpoints. Updated `agentRunsPost` and `meGet` handlers to emit events for requests, validation errors, and creation success/failure. Scope covers `common` constants/types and `web` API routes (`/api/v1/agent-runs`, `/api/v1/me`).

da1da217cf3aa677c6c5ebb0bc695444c445417c.title: Add FILETREEPROMPTLARGE for file-lister
da1da217cf3aa677c6c5ebb0bc695444c445417c.summary: New FILE_TREE_PROMPT_LARGE placeholder added to agent types and template strings, configured with 190k token budget and search mode. file-lister agent now uses this large prompt variant instead of default FILE_TREE_PROMPT. base2 agent references updated from file-picker to file-picker-max. Truncation logic moved unimportant file filtering before token counting to ensure consistent budget application.

1bd41f380e7a779b9e3c3ef1fd975816f87337fb.title: Add /api/v1/agent-runs endpoint for run tracking
1bd41f380e7a779b9e3c3ef1fd975816f87337fb.summary: New POST /api/v1/agent-runs endpoint initializes agent runs with server-generated UUIDs. Validates action 'START' via Zod, authenticates via API key, and inserts into schema.agentRun with status 'running'. Test users bypass DB insertion. Handles ancestor run IDs for nested execution contexts.

897473eb30202ae3a838084cfd3ce2d284ae7c1b.title: Add base2-hybrid-max and base2-gpt-5-worker agent definitions
897473eb30202ae3a838084cfd3ce2d284ae7c1b.summary: New agent definitions `base2-hybrid-max` and `base2-gpt-5-worker` added to `.agents/base2/`. `base2-hybrid-max` extends `createBase2('max')` and mandates inline spawning of the `base2-gpt-5-worker` agent for planning and editing, while `base2-gpt-5-worker` uses `openai/gpt-5` and orchestrates sub-agents like `file-picker` and `reviewer-gpt-5`. Existing `base2.ts` instructions updated to pluralize `file-picker-max` references.

e62f7f30b8093b074c0d08bd04b7bccc28d6ebfe.title: base2 replaces find-all-referencer with code-searcher,
e62f7f30b8093b074c0d08bd04b7bccc28d6ebfe.summary: The base2 agent's spawnableAgents array swaps find-all-referencer for code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher. The commander agent's model changes from x-ai/grok-4-fast to anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. Internal agent definitions updated in .agents/base2/base2.ts and .agents/commander.ts.

1bd41f380e7a779b9e3c3ef1fd975816f87337fb.text: The system now records a unique tracking number whenever an automated task begins. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

cce5484debd0b561480c6f163fb9f6a09ebdd39a.text: The system now logs errors without shutting down, so brief glitches no longer cause downtime.

0260e2a5776f290b8693d0b81ec1aa0f78a639c1.text: The website now shows a friendly error page if something goes wrong during loading. This change fixes a technical build issue and improves reliability for users.

bf2128663225a641e746c2dd341ebd21c9664d3b.text: The command-line tool now prepares its internal components before running. This fixes a problem where the tool could fail to start.

897473eb30202ae3a838084cfd3ce2d284ae7c1b.text: The assistant now uses a new, more powerful brain for big tasks. It can also call on smaller helpers to finish work faster and check its own answers.

10088392e2eb8b537251237bfe6aec441e246e20.text: The system now records when you start tasks or check your profile. This helps the team understand how the product is used and where it fails.

e62f7f30b8093b074c0d08bd04b7bccc28d6ebfe.text: The internal tools used by the assistant to find and list files were replaced with a new set of search functions. Additionally, the assistant's underlying reasoning model was switched to a different provider. These are behind-the-scenes adjustments that do not change how you interact with the product.

25caee5f6a0cfe5a2f08ab65bddc753f6e8a4327.text: The file picker now uses a different, faster assistant to generate shorter reports.

da1da217cf3aa677c6c5ebb0bc695444c445417c.text: The assistant can now list a much larger number of files without cutting off the list. This change fixes how it counts text, ensuring the full list appears instead of a shortened version.

7d5ccad401dae506717949a460f7e959b2e3c7ca.title: Wrap mock type in NonNullable in me-route.test.ts
7d5ccad401dae506717949a460f7e959b2e3c7ca.summary: Type for mockUserData in web/src/__tests__/api/v1/me-route.test.ts wrapped in NonNullable. Awaited<GetUserInfoFromApiKeyOutput<...>> previously allowed undefined, causing type friction in Record<string, ...> definition. Change confined to test file, no runtime impact.

0dda1c76174ec6037b663966e6af6886394d0473.title: Add v1 agent retrieval endpoints
0dda1c76174ec6037b663966e6af6886394d0473.summary: New API routes expose versioned and latest agent retrieval under /api/v1/agents/[publisherId]/[agentId]. These endpoints wrap existing internal handlers via re-exported GET functions. Scope covers web/src/app/api/v1/agents/[publisherId]/[agentId]/[version]/route.ts and web/src/app/api/v1/agents/[publisherId]/[agentId]/latest/route.ts. Implementation delegates directly to the legacy paths without logic changes.

d26bf8e242bed2c7c71975e35cc0b9ca0d2c8198.title: Replace any with Awaited GetUserInfoFromApiKeyOutput in me-route test
d26bf8e242bed2c7c71975e35cc0b9ca0d2c8198.summary: The mockUserData type in web/src/__tests__/api/v1/me-route.test.ts changed from Record<string, any> to Record<string, Awaited<GetUserInfoFromApiKeyOutput<(typeof VALID_USER_INFO_FIELDS)[number]>>> to enforce strict typing. This aligns the test mock with the actual return type of the GetUserInfoFromApiKeyOutput function. The change is internal to the test suite.

e0d80a3514989074c0e470e87bec8a4d6359fc74.title: Restore unconditional endTurn assignment in loopAgentSteps
e0d80a3514989074c0e470e87bec8a4d6359fc74.summary: loopAgentSteps now sets shouldEndTurn = endTurn unconditionally, removing the if (endTurn) guard. This restores the behavior where the loop ends only when handleSteps explicitly returns endTurn: true, preventing sticky termination state. Change affects backend/src/run-agent-step.ts; test coverage in backend/src/__tests__/loop-agent-steps.test.ts.

9b46bc04cdb409495679b51318f9608cf1d7ec9d.title: Fix gitignore pattern rebasing in file tree
9b46bc04cdb409495679b51318f9608cf1d7ec9d.summary: Refactored `parseGitignore` in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` to use a new `rebaseGitignorePattern` helper. This correctly handles recursive pattern semantics (e.g. `logs` -> `base/**/logs`) and anchored patterns (e.g. `/foo` -> `base/foo`) relative to the project root, fixing previous issues where nested `.gitignore` files were not respected in the file tree.

de8997f72f16d19ca4777f92a437418d4e13c860.title: Initial CLI app with proper TUI
de8997f72f16d19ca4777f92a437418d4e13c860.summary: New `cli` package introduces a terminal UI with chat components, multiline input, and branch items. Backend updates propagate `parentAgentId` and `forwardToPrompt` flags through subagent streaming and spawn handlers to support nested agent contexts in the new interface. Files include `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`, and `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts`.

64a1b8036aef020f928c091d19a11d0af0f5adf3.title: Add file-lister-max agent definition
64a1b8036aef020f928c091d19a11d0af0f5adf3.summary: New agent definition `file-lister-max` added to `.agents/file-explorer/`. Uses `anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5` to identify relevant files via a two-phase prompt strategy. Phase 1 lists up to 12 paths; Phase 2 refines the list after reading. `handleSteps` generator parses the final assistant message to trigger `read_files`.

f7c340aab452931c75307b6363ed59de1bfa79ba.title: Revert handleSteps endTurn assignment
f7c340aab452931c75307b6363ed59de1bfa79ba.summary: Reverts direct assignment of `endTurn` to `shouldEndTurn` in `loopAgentSteps` within `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. The logic now conditionally sets `shouldEndTurn` to true only if `endTurn` is truthy, restoring previous behavior while unit tests are fixed.

b1a181070db578e9feec494db57db5c8a4b10f4f.title: Move meGet out of web/src/app
b1a181070db578e9feec494db57db5c8a4b10f4f.summary: Refactored `meGet` implementation to `web/src/api/v1/me.ts`. `web/src/app/api/v1/me/route.ts` now imports the function, separating logic from Next.js route handlers. No API behavior changes.

1b6e682c0a89942a889cbddd445fe81d890dd139.title: New /api/v1/me endpoint for user info retrieval
1b6e682c0a89942a889cbddd445fe81d890dd139.summary: Added web/src/app/api/v1/me/route.ts exposing GET /api/v1/me. Requires Authorization header with API key; supports optional fields query param (id, email, discord_id) defaulting to id. Updated web/src/db/user.ts to export VALID_USER_INFO_FIELDS and refactor getUserInfoFromApiKey to use shared contract types from @codebuff/common/types/contracts/database.

9b46bc04cdb409495679b51318f9608cf1d7ec9d.text: The app now correctly identifies which files to hide based on project settings, including those in subfolders. This ensures the file list accurately reflects what should be visible or ignored.

e0d80a3514989074c0e470e87bec8a4d6359fc74.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant sometimes stopped answering too early. This small internal change ensures replies finish normally.

b1a181070db578e9feec494db57db5c8a4b10f4f.text: The team moved a small piece of internal plumbing to a cleaner spot in the system. This makes the code easier to maintain for the engineers. Nothing changes for you.

d73d54376969f1c711478bbd0f076f9a04560729.summary: New `.agents/file-explorer/file-picker-max.ts` defines `file-picker` agent using `anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5`. Agent spawns to locate relevant codebase files without string search or tools. Uses `find_files` tool call in `handleSteps`.

6e6d41107830b54a82cd3be498f3a8baa5db6838.title: Remove WebSocket mock from backend tests
6e6d41107830b54a82cd3be498f3a8baa5db6838.summary: Strips unused `WebSocket` imports and mock state from `cost-aggregation.test.ts` and `tool-call-schema.test.ts`. Updates `generateMockProjectStructureAnalysis` and `generateMockDependencyAnalysis` signatures to drop the `ws` parameter. Internal test cleanup only; no production logic or API changes.

ecf924606661762161d8d5d2b0452ef4d160d7f3.title: Remove messageId from fast-rewrite params
ecf924606661762161d8d5d2b0452ef4d160d7f3.summary: Removed messageId from fastRewrite params and promptRelaceAI call. Updated ParamsExcluding type to exclude only initialCode. Fixes process-file-block.test.ts.

37c11e061c11fc8dbe15f726031695a51d8c28f0.title: file-picker model switch to gemini-2.5-flash
37c11e061c11fc8dbe15f726031695a51d8c28f0.summary: file-picker agent definition in .agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts changes model from x-ai/grok-4-fast to google/gemini-2.5-flash. Reverts internal agent configuration to previous stable model. Scope limited to file-explorer subsystem. No public API or CLI surface changes.

69ae07ebe7fab548c6f441ee3e6ed5185b3a5b8d.title: Relace apply moves to OpenRouter
69ae07ebe7fab548c6f441ee3e6ed5185b3a5b8d.summary: Relace apply switched to OpenRouter via `promptAiSdk` with model `relace/relace-apply-3`, replacing direct `instantapply.endpoint.relace.run` fetch. `ai-sdk.ts` parses `providerMetadata.openrouter.usage` for cache tokens and cost overrides, and `relace-api.ts` drops `saveMessage` and `messageId` params. Covers backend LLM APIs. `saveMessage` now receives `cacheReadInputTokens`, `cacheCreationInputTokens`, and `costOverrideDollars` from OpenRouter metadata.

464324b550f6aba1e190312a19d58ab656e51a85.title: Fix handleSteps premature termination and tool call gating
464324b550f6aba1e190312a19d58ab656e51a85.summary: backend/src/run-agent-step.ts assigns `shouldEndTurn = endTurn` directly, removing the conditional block that previously forced early termination. backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts passes `fromHandleSteps: true` to the execution context, allowing tool calls from handleSteps. Scope limited to backend agent loop logic.

245b514c5b58cf559f26b3bcd2498d628f7527a6.title: file-picker-max spawns haiku file-lister for readfiles
245b514c5b58cf559f26b3bcd2498d628f7527a6.summary: file-picker-max replaces direct find_files call with spawn_agents invocation of new file-lister agent using anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. file-lister returns newline-separated paths via last_message output, which file-picker-max parses and passes to read_files. Scope limited to .agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts (new) and .agents/file-explorer/file-picker-max.ts. file-picker-max now declares toolNames: ['spawn_agents'] and spawnableAgents: ['file-lister'] instead of empty arrays.

e99abbdeb5d459542a4979625d0d14ff56808962.title: Refactor backend to inject sendAction and standardize params
e99abbdeb5d459542a4979625d0d14ff56808962.summary: Backend functions now accept spread parameters to inject context like `sendAction` and `logger`, replacing explicit argument lists. This change touches `admin/grade-runs.ts`, `admin/relabelRuns.ts`, `client-wrapper.ts`, and `fast-rewrite.ts`. The `sendAction` function in `client-wrapper.ts` was exported and renamed to `sendActionWs` to support this dependency injection pattern. This refactoring reduces boilerplate and standardizes how internal services pass request context and logging utilities.

6e6d41107830b54a82cd3be498f3a8baa5db6838.text: Developers cleaned up unused code in their internal testing system. This change does not affect how you use the product.

6d95a81104b3f62a14beadcffd6cb0eab419d5a8.text: Fixed a small internal label for the file explorer tool. No change to how you use the product.

88a7f782a2c1b545f9e6b6d1a92023f8b7b8d5e0.text: The team removed some leftover instructions from a background test that were no longer needed. This small internal cleanup does not change how the product works or looks for you.

464324b550f6aba1e190312a19d58ab656e51a85.text: The assistant stopped working correctly during certain tasks. It now finishes its job properly instead of quitting early.

4b1215d5e827cb3b6d069682841176ee6b5b6e64.title: base2 restore example response to instructionsPrompt and drop editor
4b1215d5e827cb3b6d069682841176ee6b5b6e64.summary: Moved example response into instructionsPrompt and removed editor subagent from base2.ts and base2-gpt-5.ts. Editor performs worse at editing and is not used most of the time. Internal agent orchestration config only.

d48ebf681c5a0562cb88e1498778c0cc3a9f5458.title: Update base2 agent prompt to remove final summary requirement
d48ebf681c5a0562cb88e1498778c0cc3a9f5458.summary: Modified `stepPrompt` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to explicitly state 'No need to provide any final summary' and simplified the generate-plan agent description. This change aligns the base2 orchestrator's instructions with the updated workflow, removing redundant summary generation steps. The scope is limited to the internal base2 agent configuration.

a04b4ef7af0fd5fd59ded735f008f14e910b3766.title: fromHandleSteps flag bypasses tool allowlist
a04b4ef7af0fd5fd59ded735f008f14e910b3766.summary: Added fromHandleSteps boolean to ExecuteToolCallParams in backend/src/tools/tool-executor.ts and passed from runProgrammaticStep.ts. The flag bypasses agentTemplate.toolNames restriction checks for both standard and custom tool calls. This allows handlesteps to execute any tool regardless of template configuration. Default value is false.

861960dc6938e82b0e5b3f12a1ecab1fc5979158.title: Move generate-plan-max to graveyard
861960dc6938e82b0e5b3f12a1ecab1fc5979158.summary: generate-plan-max and plan-selector moved to .agents-graveyard/planners. Import paths in moved files updated to reference .agents/constants and .agents/types. agent-builder.ts drops these from examplesAgentsContent, adding reviewer.ts instead.

f7c57c7e89408f1a139d22610d244941f2c11032.title: Move Base2 layer prompting into system prompt
f7c57c7e89408f1a139d22610d244941f2c11032.summary: Refactored `createBase2` to consolidate orchestration guidelines into the `systemPrompt` string. Previously, layer definitions, agent sequencing rules, and response constraints resided in `instructionsPrompt`, now reduced to a single sentence. This change affects `.agents/base2/base2.ts` and ensures all strategic directives for sub-agent spawning are delivered via the primary system context.

bdcd0fc3a36048a7ff5e8c5fda9b3e10bfc3bef3.title: Add gpt-5 agent definitions
bdcd0fc3a36048a7ff5e8c5fda9b3e10bfc3bef3.summary: New internal agent definitions for `base2-gpt-5`, `editor-gpt-5`, `generate-plan-gpt-5`, and `reviewer-gpt-5` targeting `openai/gpt-5`. These files extend existing base definitions with the new model ID. `base2-gpt-5` explicitly spawns the new `editor-gpt-5` and `reviewer-gpt-5` agents.

b1e58232082fb2f114b1c486a0c981745684c05e.title: base2-max agent added
b1e58232082fb2f114b1c486a0c981745684c05e.summary: New `base2-max` agent defined in `.agents/base2/base2-max.ts`. Spawns `base2-gpt-5-single-step` via `spawn_agent_inline`. Internal repo change.

19acb929ebaae28264fb92fb0bd56a25c68e7f3f.title: Remove inline-file-picker-max from base2 agent config
19acb929ebaae28264fb92fb0bd56a25c68e7f3f.summary: base2 agent config removes `inline-file-picker-max` from `toolNames` and `spawnableAgents`. Prompts updated to reference `file-picker` directly, eliminating conditional `isMax` logic for this tool. Scope limited to `.agents/base2/base2.ts`.

8f793a4b3b41fc7a86511f7e6fa231b545b8b055.title: Move editor code mandates into base2 prompts
8f793a4b3b41fc7a86511f7e6fa231b545b8b055.summary: Base2 agent now registers `editor` subagent and embeds a new `# Code Editing Mandates` section covering conventions, library verification, style mimicry, minimal changes, code reuse, and refactoring awareness. Editor agent's `instructionsPrompt` drops the duplicated `# Core Mandates` block to rely on the shared base2 context. Changes touch `.agents/base2/base2.ts` and `.agents/editor/editor.ts` only. Mandate text preserves editor-specific rules like package installation via `run_terminal_command` and front-end polish directives.

742227da10913c4864e05563894dc6636d1b29ed.text: The system now automatically creates test versions of the app for Windows, Mac, and Linux when developers submit code changes. This helps catch problems earlier, so you get more stable updates.

b1e58232082fb2f114b1c486a0c981745684c05e.text: The assistant can now use a new, more powerful model for single-step tasks. This is an internal update, so you might notice slightly better answers, but the app works the same.

4b1215d5e827cb3b6d069682841176ee6b5b6e64.text: The assistant now follows a single set of instructions for editing tasks, instead of switching to a separate editor tool. This internal change helps it make edits more accurately.

861960dc6938e82b0e5b3f12a1ecab1fc5979158.text: The team removed two old planning tools that were no longer useful. This cleanup does not change how the assistant works for you.

bdcd0fc3a36048a7ff5e8c5fda9b3e10bfc3bef3.text: The internal assistant tools now connect to a new underlying model. This change is small and happens behind the scenes. You might see slightly different text responses.

d330ec21c78cd3b88bff915bafe6dafe8d9cdfe4.summary: handleWriteFile in backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/write-file.ts changed from IIFE arrow to function declaration. satisfies CodebuffToolHandlerFunction<'write_file'> now applies via separate statement. Internal refactor only; no behavior change.

4f7221a406ad35eb6f8444b49d15036222211f63.title: Fix typechecker in test and evals agent runtime
4f7221a406ad35eb6f8444b49d15036222211f63.summary: Updated `Object.freeze` calls to use generic type parameters (`Object.freeze<T>`) in `common/src/testing/impl/agent-runtime.ts` and `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts`. Added `sendSubagentChunk` stub to `TEST_AGENT_RUNTIME_SCOPED_IMPL`.

d543e4aa6aa049189aeb74afd361f8bc98fc0659.title: Add handleStepsLogChunkWs to evals scaffolding
d543e4aa6aa049189aeb74afd361f8bc98fc0659.summary: evals/scaffolding.ts now imports handleStepsLogChunkWs and wires it into AgentRuntimeScopedDeps. Fixes typecheck errors from missing handler. Internal evals surface only.

346e77adce08731d6bf9ac9c362e654d9f0ca7e2.title: Inject handleStepsLogChunk into AgentRuntimeScopedDeps
346e77adce08731d6bf9ac9c362e654d9f0ca7e2.summary: Added `handleStepsLogChunk` to `AgentRuntimeScopedDeps` and `client.ts` contracts, replacing direct `sendAction` calls in `run-programmatic-step.ts`. This decouples step logging from WebSocket transport by injecting a scoped handler via `WebSocketMiddleware`. Updates include new `handleStepsLogChunkWs` in `client-wrapper.ts` and test stubs in `agent-runtime.ts`.

3814d1cad684519d2dce53f17619410e1b29fd3b.title: Refactor handleStrReplace to function declaration
3814d1cad684519d2dce53f17619410e1b29fd3b.summary: Converted `handleStrReplace` in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/str-replace.ts` from an arrow function expression to a standard function declaration. Replaced `satisfies` on the arrow function with a standalone `satisfies` check after the declaration. Internal refactor; no user-facing behavior change.

e5879d2f4bd205356764f6dda873c715018fc0b6.title: Inject sendSubagentChunk into AgentRuntimeScopedDeps
e5879d2f4bd205356764f6dda873c715018fc0b6.summary: Refactored `sendSubagentChunk` from inline implementation in `stream-parser.ts` to an injected dependency via `AgentRuntimeScopedDeps`. New `sendSubagentChunkWs` wrapper in `client-wrapper.ts` standardizes WebSocket action dispatching. Updated `evals/scaffolding.ts` to provide the new dependency, ensuring test parity with production runtime.

d4f542a4d618996ec6ca33ea4946c74356e3b646.title: Remove unused WebSocket type from backend agent steps
d4f542a4d618996ec6ca33ea4946c74356e3b646.summary: Removed unused `WebSocket` type imports and parameters from `main-prompt.ts`, `run-agent-step.ts`, `batch-str-replace.ts`, and `find-files.ts`. Eliminates dead code paths and simplifies function signatures by dropping the `ws` dependency where it was never utilized. Internal refactor; no user-facing behavior change.

5f818783ccab888062b1eb7844c09409d94d235d.title: Inject requestFiles and requestOptionalFile into tool handlers
5f818783ccab888062b1eb7844c09409d94d235d.summary: Refactors backend tool handlers to accept `requestFiles` and `requestOptionalFile` functions as injected dependencies rather than importing them directly. This decouples `str-replace`, `read-files`, and `find-files` from specific WebSocket implementations, allowing `getFileReadingUpdates` and related utilities to operate via passed-in parameters. Scope covers `backend/src/client-wrapper.ts` (new WS helpers), `backend/src/get-file-reading-updates.ts`, and multiple tool handlers in `backend/src/tools/`. `requestFilesWs` now ensures file contents end with a newline via `ensureEndsWithNewline` before returning.

5e38e4869cf7477ce6189a7abd4f9d7a0da75f67.title: Add BuffBench nightly evals
5e38e4869cf7477ce6189a7abd4f9d7a0da75f67.summary: Nightly CI runs `run-buffbench-nightly` instead of `run-eval-set`. New `evals/buffbench/main-nightly.ts` executes `runBuffBench` on `base` and `base2` agents, then emails formatted scores. Scope: `.github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml`, `evals/package.json`, new nightly script. Email content includes average score, cost, duration, and valid run count per agent.

729d891be7a8e6beb6d962382628e5376162ec1e.title: Inject requestMcpToolData dependency into Agent Runtime
729d891be7a8e6beb6d962382628e5376162ec1e.summary: Backend refactors MCP tool data fetching to use dependency injection via `requestMcpToolData` in `AgentRuntimeScopedDeps` instead of direct WebSocket coupling. `getMCPToolData` in `backend/src/mcp/util.ts` now accepts the injected function, removing the `ws` parameter. `backend/src/client-wrapper.ts` implements `requestMcpToolDataWs` for production, while `common/src/testing/impl/agent-runtime.ts` provides a test stub. This decouples MCP logic from transport details for better testability.

d543e4aa6aa049189aeb74afd361f8bc98fc0659.text: A small internal update fixed a missing connection that prevented certain testing tools from working correctly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

346e77adce08731d6bf9ac9c362e654d9f0ca7e2.text: The assistant's logging system was updated to use a more flexible connection method. This internal change helps the system stay stable and makes it easier to add new features later.

3814d1cad684519d2dce53f17619410e1b29fd3b.text: The team cleaned up the code behind the text-replacement tool. This change does not affect how the feature works for users.

e5879d2f4bd205356764f6dda873c715018fc0b6.text: This internal change improves how the system sends messages, making it easier to test and maintain. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

5e38e4869cf7477ce6189a7abd4f9d7a0da75f67.text: The system now automatically tests the assistant's performance every night and sends a report to the team. This helps the team track how well the assistant works and how much it costs to run.

d330ec21c78cd3b88bff915bafe6dafe8d9cdfe4.text: A small internal cleanup to the file-saving tool. The product works exactly the same.

4f7221a406ad35eb6f8444b49d15036222211f63.text: Small internal cleanup. No visible changes.

729d891be7a8e6beb6d962382628e5376162ec1e.text: A small internal update changes how the assistant fetches external information. This improves reliability and makes future updates easier, with no visible change to how you use the product.

cc871c3c835ad344f4f51c437f8aa3bc7b100b57.summary: Removed injected instructions prompt from base context in .agents/context-pruner.ts. Current messages array now pops the final element before token counting. Test coverage updated in .agents/__tests__/context-pruner.test.ts.

ae7e7fb598e0d1cc9e37b1c1c0ec2b54b4d54f21.title: base-max swaps decomposing-planner for generate-plan
ae7e7fb598e0d1cc9e37b1c1c0ec2b54b4d54f21.summary: base-max agent definition replaces decomposing-planner with generate-plan. Scope limited to .agents/base/base-max.ts. Minor internal adjustment to agent capabilities.

f5f93713789c21f2ccfe6a70c615baa5a3cea544.title: Add SSE endpoint request analytics event
f5f93713789c21f2ccfe6a70c615baa5a3cea544.summary: Added `SSE_ENDPOINT_REQUEST` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum and implemented tracking in `/api/v1/chat/completions` route. 153681c8a1aa91f75817abf50fbac465832bd87b.title: Reviewer prompt injects original user request
153681c8a1aa91f75817abf50fbac465832bd87b.summary: The reviewer agent definition in `.agents/reviewer/reviewer.ts` now includes the original user prompt via `PLACEHOLDER.USER_INPUT_PROMPT`. This change addresses a gap where the reviewer lacked context on the initial request, ensuring feedback aligns with user intent. The `instructionsPrompt` was updated to wrap this input in `<user_message>` tags and added a directive to verify all user requirements are met. Internal change to agent prompt structure.

721bcf993bc17667d80d7a4216fbc6e06e7f0dd7.title: Move SSEENDPOINTREQUEST to api analytics category

Existing dashboards filtering by `web.sse_endpoint_request` need query updates.

86a36594559cec23d4854b9b692970c1798efbc2.title: generate-plan-thinking agent retired to graveyard
86a36594559cec23d4854b9b692970c1798efbc2.summary: generate-plan-thinking agent moved to .agents-graveyard/planners. Agent spawned decomposing-thinker and independent-thinker to generate five alternative plans, then selected the optimal one via set_output. Internal change only; no user-facing surfaces affected.

883bea2568b66aba1b71481d795898d2f879ffb3.title: Refactor BuffBench evals and Base2 agent definition
883bea2568b66aba1b71481d795898d2f879ffb3.summary: Renamed `commitConcurrency` to `taskConcurrency` in `runBuffBench` options and removed manual result writing from `main.ts`. Updated `createBase2` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to return `Omit<SecretAgentDefinition, 'id'>`, moving `id` assignment to the export site. 99bbe8a0f1e12a65d4886899760bfff6a70c84d0.summary: Refactored tool execution to inject `requestToolCall` as a dependency rather than importing it directly from `websocket-action`. Added `backend/src/client-wrapper.ts` implementing `requestToolCallWs` with timeout handling and WebSocket subscription logic. Updated `main-prompt.ts`, `tool-executor.ts`, and `batch-str-replace.ts` to accept `RequestToolCallFn` via `AgentRuntimeScopedDeps` types. This decouples core agent logic from specific WebSocket transport implementations, facilitating testability and alternative client bindings.
