d95fe720bdf34f2f88719ba73aa0de98350d46ae.summary: README.md rewritten around multi-agent architecture with new demo.gif and multi-agents.png assets. common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/agent-guide.md added as 211-line reference covering AgentDefinition structure, tool names, and handleSteps generator control flow. local-development.md added documenting Bun, direnv, Infisical, and Docker setup steps. npm-app/src/cli.ts touched alongside initial-agents-dir/README.md restructured for context-window rationale.

c2c9848af041c2011b6589328393a5d8f5c8869e.title: Add CI workflow to mirror initial-dot-agents templates
c2c9848af041c2011b6589328393a5d8f5c8869e.summary: New GitHub Actions workflow mirrors `common/src/templates/initial-dot-agents` to a separate `.agents` repository via `git subtree push`. Triggered on pushes to `main` affecting the template directory. Requires `SUBTREE_PUSH_TOKEN` secret for authentication.

a9ca04b8a0da3dc5646552969c1b57709e3fa505.text: The team made a small internal update to how they check the system for errors. If a problem appears, the team can now look into it more easily.

034b52f03bfbaf7cdaf0b292c6088cd5d296ee03.text: We updated how the system shares updates with its team. This change helps the process run smoothly and keeps the product working as expected.

9e19fbf894b5f10371930ea53d5c7639c857589c.text: A small internal update fixed the formatting of a standard guide file to follow proper rules.

d95fe720bdf34f2f88719ba73aa0de98350d46ae.text: The project updated its main information pages and added new guides to help users understand how the software works and how to set it up. This means clearer instructions are available for anyone wanting to learn about the system or start using it locally.

2952abb9dde8e89d899676a39e41e44145536af4.text: The system now looks in the right folder for its setup files. This small fix ensures the software works as intended.

26a93a855408c78025e1ef53df7e3bda586fe022.text: A small internal update fixes a broken link used to copy files to another location. This change does not affect how you use the product.

9262fa52938d34fe8f183cebb2185ab96660e167.text: Referral credits can now be claimed only through the command-line tool, not automatically on the website. The sign-in process was updated to keep track of your referral link so you do not lose your credit.

a7ac818af6f9aa81ebece365873a822421f10e6e.text: A small internal update improved how the system checks for security keys and fixed a connection address, ensuring updates sync correctly. It also removed an unnecessary debugging step that only appeared when things broke.

c2c9848af041c2011b6589328393a5d8f5c8869e.text: The company set up an automatic system to keep a special template library updated. This is an internal change and does not affect how you use the product.

1eef5bf54585e7ff8deeb5403b902fb1a6fcc3c7.title: Add 'agnet' and 'agnets' aliases to /agents command
1eef5bf54585e7ff8deeb5403b902fb1a6fcc3c7.summary: Added 'agnet' and 'agnets' to the aliases array for the /agents command in npm-app/src/menu.ts. This change improves discoverability and reduces user friction by accepting common alternate spellings. The update applies to the CLI interactive menu. No migration or breaking changes.

73ba6801279b8482b646f55d0a0846323981057c.title: SDK types path fix and version bump to 0.1.28
73ba6801279b8482b646f55d0a0846323981057c.summary: Updated `@codebuff/sdk` version to 0.1.28. Corrected `types` and `exports.types` paths from `./dist/esm/index.d.ts` to `./dist/esm/sdk/src/index.d.ts` to resolve type resolution issues. Scope limited to `sdk/package.json`.

9364db9653d1210879f1f7dc508b8be3bd734548.title: Refine git eval prompts for full spec completion
9364db9653d1210879f1f7dc508b8be3bd734548.summary: Judge and runner prompts in evals/git-evals require full spec satisfaction, explicitly listing tests and docs. Judge prompt drops redundant 'trace of' phrasing. Affects judge-git-eval.ts and run-git-evals.ts.

2d0bc7154793daea53cb4b79828b72e047072b22.title: Fix /agents submenu to show all agents
2d0bc7154793daea53cb4b79828b72e047072b22.summary: The /agents submenu now displays all loaded agents instead of just those in .agents/templates. This was achieved by switching from manual directory scanning to using `getLocalAgentInfo()` and iterating over `loadedAgents`. The logic for mapping agent IDs to file paths was updated to search recursively using `getAllTsFiles`. Changes are localized to `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/agents.ts` and `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

8e2cecaf295f155d6c5ec1894dc757be51a460c8.title: SDK 0.1.27 adds build verification to dry-run
8e2cecaf295f155d6c5ec1894dc757be51a460c8.summary: The @codebuff/sdk package version bumps to 0.1.27. The publish-dry-run script now executes bun run build:verify before running the publish script. This change ensures build integrity checks are performed during dry-run publishing. The update is scoped to sdk/package.json.

7cc677c2a299a34f680f541d5d94fc34e534e6d4.title: Judge prompt restricts scoring to spec
7cc677c2a299a34f680f541d5d94fc34e534e6d4.summary: Updated `buildAnalysisPrompt` in `evals/git-evals/judge-git-eval.ts` to explicitly instruct the judge to score only against the provided spec. Added a note preventing point deductions for out-of-spec items like unit tests or documentation. This ensures evaluation fairness by aligning scoring criteria with the agent's actual access constraints.

de15d859394629a94bb7c44e107776bb94122867.title: Add syntax highlighting to docs code demos
de15d859394629a94bb7c44e107776bb94122867.summary: Docs code blocks now render with syntax highlighting via `prism-react-renderer`. `code-demo.tsx` implements language alias mapping, leading whitespace trimming, and theme overrides for bash and plain text. Change scoped to `web` package.

738047948da8bafa663ee8dd22e2e59b133ab679.title: Remove efficiency metric from git evals
738047948da8bafa663ee8dd22e2e59b133ab679.summary: Drops efficiency scoring from git-evals pipeline, including judge prompt, types, and reporting. Removes average_efficiency and efficiencyScore from FullEvalLog and JudgingAnalysisSchema in types.ts. Strips efficiency from email summaries, post-eval analysis, and console output. Eliminates timing/cost context injection in judge prompt.

4d4c11a1815e6f6aae3b2d54412259d47f310bbd.title: Bundle SDK for node target
4d4c11a1815e6f6aae3b2d54412259d47f310bbd.summary: SDK build switched to Bun bundler, generating dual ESM/CJS outputs with dynamic externals. Replaced tsup and manual package.json manipulation. Code-map updated to support runtime WASM loading via init-node.ts, removing static imports. Publish script simplified to build, verify, publish.

1eef5bf54585e7ff8deeb5403b902fb1a6fcc3c7.text: The assistant now understands common misspellings of the command to list agents. This small update makes the tool easier to use without changing how it works.

8e2cecaf295f155d6c5ec1894dc757be51a460c8.text: The system now checks that the software is built correctly before trying to release it. This small internal update helps prevent errors during the release process.

7cc677c2a299a34f680f541d5d94fc34e534e6d4.text: This internal change fixes how the system grades work. It now ignores helpful extras, like extra notes, that were not asked for. This makes the scores fairer.

738047948da8bafa663ee8dd22e2e59b133ab679.text: The internal system that checks how well the assistant follows instructions no longer measures how quickly or cheaply it works. This small internal cleanup does not change how the product behaves for you.

2d0bc7154793daea53cb4b79828b72e047072b22.text: The menu now lists every available assistant, not just a few from one folder. You see the full selection without extra steps.

9364db9653d1210879f1f7dc508b8be3bd734548.text: We updated internal instructions for how the assistant checks its own work. This helps ensure it completes all required steps before finishing a task.

73ba6801279b8482b646f55d0a0846323981057c.text: Fixed a small internal issue that helps the product work correctly with other tools. This update does not change how you use the product.

de15d859394629a94bb7c44e107776bb94122867.text: Code examples in the documentation now use colors to make the text easier to read.

fd01d8267659545f5826743424545c7610ca2a23.title: SDK 0.1.22
fd01d8267659545f5826743424545c7610ca2a23.summary: Version bump to 0.1.22 in `sdk/package.json`. No functional changes.

375ac3d8a8093a24b304b474797c00d9d89fe3c0.title: CodeDemo horizontal scroll fix
375ac3d8a8093a24b304b474797c00d9d89fe3c0.summary: Aligns padding and separator margins in `code-demo.tsx` to stabilize layout. Moves `px-4` from header/content to container, removing redundant horizontal margins from `Separator`. Fixes horizontal scrollbar issues across breakpoints in docs.

18a48d5e1a06d51a3825c5e3d9d6a745686e1446.title: Replace terminal wrapper with Card component in Agents Quick Start
18a48d5e1a06d51a3825c5e3d9d6a745686e1446.summary: The Agents overview Quick Start section now uses the standard `Card` component instead of a raw terminal wrapper. This aligns the documentation with the project's UI design system and improves readability. The change is scoped to `web/src/content/agents/overview.mdx`. The new card displays the `codebuff init-agents` command within a structured `CardContent` block.

7cacb9278a28ef9cf803ee44ca5fa20eb8c7befc.title: Remove security-page-restructure-plan.md
7cacb9278a28ef9cf803ee44ca5fa20eb8c7befc.summary: Deleted internal planning document `security-page-restructure-plan.md`. File contained roadmap for splitting security page into `/api-keys` and `/profile`. Purely internal artifact removal; no code or user-facing behavior changed.

bd29c2bed79f3b2476277f51e4e5778fef4e0b3e.title: SDK README examples wrap code in async main function
bd29c2bed79f3b2476277f51e4e5778fef4e0b3e.summary: Top-level await usage in `sdk/README.md` examples replaced with `async function main()` wrapper. Ensures snippets are valid in CommonJS or strict module contexts without relying on top-level await support. Affects basic and advanced usage documentation.

6110c51f2dffffc23fb6da01a37c49b92ff1b1ec.title: Agents types revert to local codebuff-message
6110c51f2dffffc23fb6da01a37c49b92ff1b1ec.summary: Agent definition and tool types now import `Message` from local `./codebuff-message` instead of `@codebuff/sdk`. New Zod v4 schemas for messages, content parts, data content, JSON values, and provider metadata added to `.agents/types` and `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types`. This decouples agent templates from the external SDK dependency. `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/init-agents.ts` updated to reflect these local type imports.

02344853f4f34e9dde1a248d9550cc16a147ef0b.text: A background process that copies files was turned off because it stopped new updates from reaching the website. This fix helps ensure the site works correctly without affecting how you use it.

7cacb9278a28ef9cf803ee44ca5fa20eb8c7befc.text: The company removed an internal note about future page changes. Nothing changed for users.

fd01d8267659545f5826743424545c7610ca2a23.text: The software received a routine update. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works or looks.

18a48d5e1a06d51a3825c5e3d9d6a745686e1446.text: The setup guide now uses a standard design layout for its instructions. This small internal update makes the text easier to read.

6110c51f2dffffc23fb6da01a37c49b92ff1b1ec.text: The assistant now uses its own built-in rules for understanding messages, instead of relying on outside tools. This makes the software more stable and self-sufficient.

ba774d8acf8e4a056c909ec349e40dd903eca391.text: The team organized the assistant's internal data structures into a single, cleaner location. This is a small background update that does not change how you use the product.

375ac3d8a8093a24b304b474797c00d9d89fe3c0.text: A small internal update fixed a layout issue that sometimes caused an unwanted sideways scrollbar to appear on code examples.

a3a0eed769e93b41a159c422b2aea6797ceb5dbb.text: A small internal update stops a background process from showing parts of a private security key in its logs. This reduces the chance of that secret information leaking, but nothing about how you use the product changes.

bd29c2bed79f3b2476277f51e4e5778fef4e0b3e.text: Example instructions were rewritten to work reliably in more places. This is a small internal fix with no effect on how you use the product.

ca45080a3851f24c32b1dd46f90f0bfe88953620.title: Remove legacy evals infrastructure
ca45080a3851f24c32b1dd46f90f0bfe88953620.summary: Deleted evals directory containing e2e-cat-app-script.ts, swe-bench-eval.ts, swe-bench-ids.ts, and test-repos.json. Removed SWE-Bench integration scripts, instance ID mappings, and repo configuration files. Internal cleanup of obsolete evaluation tooling.

c32a36384842682ad1d7ef25f2d1e62b8e60b765.title: SDK custom-tool import path fix
c32a36384842682ad1d7ef25f2d1e62b8e60b765.summary: custom-tool.ts imports ToolResultOutput from '../../common/src/types/messages/content-part' instead of '@codebuff/common/types/messages/content-part'. Fixes SDK import resolution. Scope limited to sdk/src/custom-tool.ts.

4131f72b6d59d7515ddb9b7e4bd0dafafd86f182.title: Agent types import Message from @codebuff/sdk
4131f72b6d59d7515ddb9b7e4bd0dafafd86f182.summary: Agent definition and tool types now import `Message` from `@codebuff/sdk` instead of local files. Local type definitions (`codebuff-message.ts`, `content-part.ts`, etc.) are removed from `.agents/types` and the `initial-agents-dir` template. This deduplicates message schema definitions, relying on the SDK as the single source of truth for agent types. The change affects both the internal agent configuration and the scaffolding generated by `init-agents`.

19e85ab18e8d389872435c9d4876a8b648ce0353.title: Add evals README documenting commit reimplementation framework
19e85ab18e8d389872435c9d4876a8b648ce0353.summary: New evals/README.md details the Git Commit Reimplementation Evaluation system. It describes the multi-turn interactive process where a prompting agent guides coding agents to reconstruct real git commits, followed by AI judging across completion, efficiency, code quality, and overall dimensions. The doc covers architecture components (orchestrators, runners for Codebuff/Claude, judging via Gemini 2.5 Pro), usage commands, data formats, and directory structure.

05f7587f6a80520989c64fe28c8910a77783005e.title: Remove pluralize import from code-map parse.ts
05f7587f6a80520989c64fe28c8910a77783005e.summary: The `pluralize` utility import was removed from `packages/code-map/src/parse.ts`. The debug log statement in `getFileTokenScores` was updated to use a template literal directly instead of calling `pluralize`. This change simplifies the dependency graph for the code-map package.

10584871295dd90cfc84bf2a76fb1051c99eab71.title: Rename constants to old-constants in backend and agents
10584871295dd90cfc84bf2a76fb1051c99eab71.summary: Internal refactor renames `@codebuff/common/constants` imports to `@codebuff/common/old-constants` across backend services and agent factories. This isolates legacy constant definitions from the active `constants` module, likely preparing for a split between old and new model/config definitions. Scope covers `.agents/factory/*`, `backend/src/admin/*`, and core API handlers like `usage.ts` and `org.ts`. No user-facing behavior changes; purely structural import path updates.

77b060911448e40458034948f955dd521353dc99.title: model-utils.ts import switched to old-constants
77b060911448e40458034948f955dd521353dc99.summary: model-utils.ts now imports models from old-constants instead of constants. This aligns the dynamic require call with the type import, ensuring the explicitly defined models set is populated from the correct source. Scope is limited to common/src/util/model-utils.ts. The change fixes a mismatch where the type was sourced from old-constants but the runtime value was pulled from constants.

43ec3102480107f0f837840bafe08c699eca1fd1.title: Suppress websocket console logs unless verbose
43ec3102480107f0f837840bafe08c699eca1fd1.summary: WebSocket client error and warning logs in `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts` now require `VERBOSE_LOGGING` to be enabled. This prevents console noise from reconnection failures, stale transaction IDs, and unknown message types during normal operation. The change applies to the shared core websocket layer used by all surfaces.

4131f72b6d59d7515ddb9b7e4bd0dafafd86f182.text: The system now uses one shared set of rules for how the assistant reads and sends messages. This internal cleanup reduces duplicate instructions but does not change how you use the product.

ca45080a3851f24c32b1dd46f90f0bfe88953620.text: The company removed old, unused tools that checked how well the software worked. This is a small cleanup inside the system. Nothing changes for you.

10584871295dd90cfc84bf2a76fb1051c99eab71.text: Programmers renamed internal labels to separate old settings from new ones. This cleanup changes nothing for you.

19e85ab18e8d389872435c9d4876a8b648ce0353.text: The team wrote an internal guide explaining how they test the software's ability to write code. This helps them measure quality but does not change what you see or do in the product.

05f7587f6a80520989c64fe28c8910a77783005e.text: A small internal cleanup removed an unnecessary tool from the code. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

c6fb1afec11328d13b53737412783f6da3c8867e.text: The assistant now formats text with bold, italics, and lists in the command-line interface, making responses easier to read. This is an internal improvement that does not change what the assistant can do, only how it looks.

c32a36384842682ad1d7ef25f2d1e62b8e60b765.text: Fixed a hidden technical issue in how the system finds certain tools. This change is internal and does not affect everyday use.

43ec3102480107f0f837840bafe08c699eca1fd1.text: The app now hides background error messages about connection issues unless you turn on detailed logging. This reduces clutter in your browser console without affecting normal use.

796a2a5971b0c45e630360f1e0f69eb34bdf3332.text: A small internal update to the software's background engine.

ecad4a3decacc57e3f282a29ebb95c7e300a55da.title: Add cost breakdown to eval email
ecad4a3decacc57e3f282a29ebb95c7e300a55da.summary: Added cost and runtime metrics to `formatEvalSummaryForEmail`. Computes average/total cost and runtime from `overall_metrics`. Includes detailed per-set cost breakdown and efficiency ratios in the email body.

3d8f7b75f56b6c5d4630fe9807b52bb2830fe6dc.title: Track credits and runtime in git evals
3d8f7b75f56b6c5d4630fe9807b52bb2830fe6dc.summary: Git evals now record `totalCostUsd` and `runtime_sec` per run, aggregating them into `average_cost_usd` and `average_runtime_sec` overall metrics. `Runner['run']` returns `totalCostUsd`, derived from `chunk.total_cost_usd` in `ClaudeRunner` and `creditsUsed / 100` in `CodebuffRunner`. `EvalRunJudged` and `FullEvalLog` types updated in `evals/git-evals/types.ts`. `runSingleEval` accumulates costs from `codebuffResult.totalCostUsd` across prompts.

f2cffd61c66eb9ac5e9522464891bf06bba9dd96.title: Add package.json to initial agents directory template
f2cffd61c66eb9ac5e9522464891bf06bba9dd96.summary: Added package.json to common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir. This file defines metadata for custom Codebuff agents, specifying name, version, description, and Apache-2.0 license. Ensures proper package context for agent files in new projects.

2ca05c66a2592ffc8ff059f3ac5040dc66923bf2.title: Add cost info to git eval judge prompt
2ca05c66a2592ffc8ff059f3ac5040dc66923bf2.summary: Added [COST_INFORMATION] block to judge-git-eval.ts prompt. Displays total cost in USD with two decimal places. Internal change affecting eval scoring context.

6ebb174737994de585f600048ff23914815abe74.title: Enable codesearch and runfilechangehooks in SDK
6ebb174737994de585f600048ff23914815abe74.summary: SDK client now implements code_search via @vscode/ripgrep and stubs run_file_change_hooks as no-op. New types PublishedToolName and PublishedClientToolName restrict overrideTools to published client tools. code_search enforces project directory boundaries and truncates output at 10000 chars.

02996cd58b1a38df836194073a3f9dbe9bf5ac08.title: Fix PostHog exitCode tracking for terminal commands
02996cd58b1a38df836194073a3f9dbe9bf5ac08.summary: Corrects `runTerminalCommand` to spread `value[0].value` instead of `value` when calling `trackEvent` for `TERMINAL_COMMAND_COMPLETED`. Ensures `exitCode` and related metrics are captured in PostHog analytics. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/terminal/run-command.ts`.

091316b99d0fb730930f36691bf6f3c2bbf33f8f.title: Add Apache 2.0 license to initial agents template
091316b99d0fb730930f36691bf6f3c2bbf33f8f.summary: Added `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/LICENSE` containing Apache License 2.0 text. Ensures agent templates distributed by Freebuff carry explicit licensing terms. Scope limited to shared core templates; no runtime logic or user-facing behavior changes.

7fd14d1556b60aa5488858b150a8428c0355afd9.title: calculate-monthly-usage script shows user details
7fd14d1556b60aa5488858b150a8428c0355afd9.summary: The `calculate-monthly-usage` script now joins `schema.user` to fetch `name`, `email`, and `handle`. The top 10 users list displays these details instead of just the user ID. Also fixes `getCurrentMonthLocal` to use 0-based month indexing correctly.

f2cffd61c66eb9ac5e9522464891bf06bba9dd96.text: The assistant now includes a setup file for custom agents. This helps new projects recognize and use these agents correctly.

2ca05c66a2592ffc8ff059f3ac5040dc66923bf2.text: The system now shows the cost of its work in dollars. This is an internal change, so you won't see any difference in how the product works.

ecad4a3decacc57e3f282a29ebb95c7e300a55da.text: A small internal change now includes cost and time details in evaluation emails. This gives users a clearer view of how much resources were used.

02996cd58b1a38df836194073a3f9dbe9bf5ac08.text: Fixed a small internal issue to ensure command completion data is recorded accurately. No visible change to the product.

4d4c11a1815e6f6aae3b2d54412259d47f310bbd.text: The software was rebuilt with a simpler, more modern packaging method. This change is internal and does not alter how you use the product.

7fd14d1556b60aa5488858b150a8428c0355afd9.text: Internal reports now show user names and emails alongside usage data. This change only affects how staff view information, not how you use the product.

091316b99d0fb730930f36691bf6f3c2bbf33f8f.text: The company added clear legal terms to the starting templates for agents. This change does not affect how you use the product.

fe49e6f8c4af3655f2676b7dd28421d97664083a.text: The team removed unused text instructions from the system. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the product works for you.

6ebb174737994de585f600048ff23914815abe74.text: The assistant can now search your project files and limits results to prevent overwhelming you. File change notifications are currently disabled.

3d8f7b75f56b6c5d4630fe9807b52bb2830fe6dc.text: The system now tracks how much time and credits each test uses, then shows the average cost and runtime. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

4ce916cb53ff52e8e5744ae41e72f03ee56e408a.title: Tests reference MAXAGENTSTEPSDEFAULT constant
4ce916cb53ff52e8e5744ae41e72f03ee56e408a.summary: Test assertions in `common/src/json-config/__tests__/constants.test.ts` now import and use `MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT` from `src/constants/agents` instead of hardcoded value `12`. This decouples test expectations from the literal default value, ensuring tests reflect the actual constant used by the config schema. Scope is limited to test files within the shared core package.

eb115012aa8c6a80a4369c0e1ea8b8ed69360262.title: init-agents command added
eb115012aa8c6a80a4369c0e1ea8b8ed69360262.summary: Added `init-agents` CLI command to `npm-app/src/index.ts`. Logic extracted from `agents.ts` into new `init-agents.ts` module. `createExampleAgentFiles` shared between `/agents` and `init-agents`. Refactors template import handling.

ae5c7311d4cad4e9f4ae4ac8d92ef8ee82cbb2b4.title: Skip stop sequences for grok-code-fast
ae5c7311d4cad4e9f4ae4ac8d92ef8ee82cbb2b4.summary: OpenRouter chat handler now omits stop parameters when modelId matches x-ai/grok-code-fast-1. Completion module received formatting cleanup. Change scoped to packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk/chat/index.ts and completion/index.ts. Conditional spread prevents upstream rejection of stop sequences for this specific model.

234f95f91a19ccacd0567ecd1b3647cba28f2d2b.title: Unify maxAgentSteps constant in SDK and evals
234f95f91a19ccacd0567ecd1b3647cba28f2d2b.summary: SDK and eval runners now import MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT from common/constants/agents. Replaces hardcoded 20 in codebuff.ts and DEFAULT_MAX_AGENT_STEPS in client.ts. Centralizes step limit logic across SDK and git-evals.

940603121fe01781a65343348e9a187dc69c7603.title: Fix import path in agent-template-validation.ts
940603121fe01781a65343348e9a187dc69c7603.summary: Corrects `DynamicAgentValidationError` import in `common/src/util/agent-template-validation.ts`. Replaces absolute `src/templates/...` path with relative `../templates/...`. Ensures proper module resolution within shared core utilities.

048bf594aca2b45cea30481bbadd2fdcf1455da0.title: Unify max agent steps default to 25
048bf594aca2b45cea30481bbadd2fdcf1455da0.summary: MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT set to 25 in common/src/constants/agents.ts, replacing divergent values 40 and 12. json-config/constants.ts and default.ts now import this constant, removing hardcoded literals. npm-app/src/client.ts refactors to reuse loaded config for stepsRemaining.

b133712e7c3c310c96fb3228a82bdc71a2983774.title: SDK 0.1.20 adds result.output, optional cwd, extraToolResults
b133712e7c3c310c96fb3228a82bdc71a2983774.summary: Bumps @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.20. `result.output` now exposes agent output from awaited `client.run(...)` calls. `cwd` becomes optional in `CodebuffClient` constructor. `extraToolResults` parameter added to `run()` for additional context.

c5338b079aa0319f21dc0fa68f8f7c4003ec3d4b.title: Add AgentOutput schema to SDK and backend
c5338b079aa0319f21dc0fa68f8f7c4003ec3d4b.summary: Introduced `AgentOutput` schema in `common/src/types/session-state.ts`, replacing ad-hoc result structures. `loopAgentSteps` and `mainPrompt` now return this typed output alongside `SessionState`, standardizing how agent results are propagated to the WebSocket layer. The `prompt-response` action in `common/src/actions.ts` accepts an optional `output` field, while `spawn-agents.ts` removes `formatAgentResult` in favor of direct output consumption. This unifies error and success handling across CLI, Web, and Desktop surfaces.

0877d4fc8a5d95fa8771ee023cc57ce37ffb52b5.title: Add base2-lite agent using grok-code-fast-1
0877d4fc8a5d95fa8771ee023cc57ce37ffb52b5.summary: New base2-lite agent configuration added under .agents/lite/. Uses anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522 for orchestration but swaps editor and reviewer sub-agents to x-ai/grok-code-fast-1 and openai/gpt-5-chat respectively. Includes base2-factory.ts for shared definition logic. Affects internal agent definitions only.

ae5c7311d4cad4e9f4ae4ac8d92ef8ee82cbb2b4.text: The assistant now handles a specific coding model without sending extra instructions that caused errors. This internal fix makes responses more reliable for that model.

4ce916cb53ff52e8e5744ae41e72f03ee56e408a.text: The program's built-in safety checks were updated to use the correct limit for how many steps an assistant can take. This internal fix ensures the system behaves consistently without changing how you use the product.

940603121fe01781a65343348e9a187dc69c7603.text: A small internal fix corrected how a tool finds its instructions. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

234f95f91a19ccacd0567ecd1b3647cba28f2d2b.text: The limit on how many steps the assistant can take is now managed in one central place. This keeps the rules consistent across different parts of the product.

eb115012aa8c6a80a4369c0e1ea8b8ed69360262.text: A new setup step helps create example files for custom tools. This change is internal and does not affect normal use.

5ab58c3f0247fba60a2a89e3eb2fe4d3a8fff883.title: Remove noisy debug logs in spawn-agents handler
5ab58c3f0247fba60a2a89e3eb2fe4d3a8fff883.summary: Removed `logger.debug` calls for subagent cost aggregation and parent agent total cost updates in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts`. These frequent logs had narrow debugging value. Internal refactor only; no behavior change.

f1ca0081d2611880668eafe846e91e9f96a1b28f.title: Canceled user input returns empty array in tool-executor
f1ca0081d2611880668eafe846e91e9f96a1b28f.summary: Canceled user input now returns [] instead of '' in tool-executor.ts. This aligns the return type with expected array structures for tool results. Scope limited to backend/src/tools/tool-executor.ts.

ef53dba9eb42f6f2a6d30bf39716bb2c5ae31c9e.title: Remove Windows dev machine credentials from WINDOWS.md
ef53dba9eb42f6f2a6d30bf39716bb2c5ae31c9e.summary: Strikethrough applied to email and passwords for Gmail, GitHub, and Shadow.tech in `WINDOWS.md`. Added note indicating credentials are no longer valid. Scope limited to `WINDOWS.md`.

7ed7df84f61b9005335e70c0832624136e40fb7d.title: Remove leaked credentials from WINDOWS.md
7ed7df84f61b9005335e70c0832624136e40fb7d.summary: Deleted plaintext credentials (Gmail, GitHub, Shadow.tech passwords) and associated login instructions from WINDOWS.md. This removes sensitive internal access details from the public repository documentation. Scope limited to WINDOWS.md.

6ca447150510855e9b41813a4da1f13b3ea608a7.title: Relax setMessagesParams schema to z.any()
6ca447150510855e9b41813a4da1f13b3ea608a7.summary: Replaced strict message validation with `z.any()` in `common/src/tools/params/tool/set-messages.ts`. This change removes the requirement for messages to be a loose object with specific role/content fields, allowing arbitrary message structures to pass through. The modification acts as a temporary fix to prevent validation errors from blocking message setting.

c843bdf400fd6e53f65a28448561938e60c13222.title: Validate agent subagents against local and database sources
c843bdf400fd6e53f65a28448561938e60c13222.summary: Agent validation now checks spawnable agents against both locally defined templates and published agents in the database. `validateSpawnableAgents` was made async and `fetchAgent` was added to query the database for missing agent IDs. The `agent-registry` no longer skips subagent validation, and the `/publish` and `/validate` web APIs use the new `validateAgentsWithSpawnableAgents` function.

2c1a76aa597223d1c5191df56e4f5babbe66f89a.title: Delete duplicate agent validation file
2c1a76aa597223d1c5191df56e4f5babbe66f89a.summary: Removed `common/src/templates/dynamic-agent-functions.ts` (130 lines) containing `collectAgentIds` and `validateAgents`. Analysis notes indicate this file was a duplicate, implying its logic exists elsewhere. Scope limited to `common` package templates directory.

abb844f031249653287d333e3bdd455c4aca35ce.title: Remove validateInputSchema flag from executeToolCall
abb844f031249653287d333e3bdd455c4aca35ce.summary: Revert `validateInputSchema` option in `ExecuteToolCallParams`. `executeToolCall` now always invokes `parseRawToolCall` for input validation, removing the bypass path. Updates `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts` and `backend/src/tools/tool-executor.ts` to enforce strict schema parsing for all tool calls.

875deb4b45b35556f32c131b989a028e77f36fd7.title: Add publisher constant to deep-thinking agents
875deb4b45b35556f32c131b989a028e77f36fd7.summary: Added `publisher` field to AgentDefinition in six deep-thinking agent files. Files: .agents/deep-thinking/deep-thinker.ts, deepest-thinker.ts, gemini-thinker-high.ts, gemini-thinker.ts, gpt5-thinker.ts, sonnet-thinker.ts. Import `publisher` from ../constants and set on definition object.

ef53dba9eb42f6f2a6d30bf39716bb2c5ae31c9e.text: Old login details for a work computer were marked as invalid in an internal note. This change does not affect how you use the product.

f1ca0081d2611880668eafe846e91e9f96a1b28f.text: This internal fix ensures the assistant returns the correct data format when a user cancels an input. You likely won't notice any change, as this only helps the system work more reliably behind the scenes.

2c1a76aa597223d1c5191df56e4f5babbe66f89a.text: The team removed a duplicate check for assistant settings. This cleanup makes the system simpler and does not change how the product works for you.

c843bdf400fd6e53f65a28448561938e60c13222.text: The system now checks both local and saved agent lists before allowing new agents to start. This prevents errors when using agents that are not properly registered.

5ab58c3f0247fba60a2a89e3eb2fe4d3a8fff883.text: The system stopped writing extra internal notes about how much each part of a task costs. This cleanup only affects the behind-the-scenes records, so the product works exactly the same for you.

77b060911448e40458034948f955dd521353dc99.text: The app now loads the correct list of models. This fixes a small internal mismatch. You may see no visible change.

7ed7df84f61b9005335e70c0832624136e40fb7d.text: Staff removed sensitive login details from a public document. This change does not affect the product's features or your experience.

abb844f031249653287d333e3bdd455c4aca35ce.text: The system now strictly checks the information sent to its tools every time. This prevents it from trying to do things it cannot understand.

6ca447150510855e9b41813a4da1f13b3ea608a7.text: The app now accepts a wider variety of message formats. This prevents errors that previously blocked you from sending messages.

b586383b9e0c3122140d7f2f73f2b6e9c1a96c45.title: Structured tool messages and includeToolCall flag
b586383b9e0c3122140d7f2f73f2b6e9c1a96c45.summary: Agent message types migrated from loose string arrays to Zod-validated structured objects, introducing a dedicated `tool` role with `toolName`, `toolCallId`, and `output` fields. A new `includeToolCall` boolean flag added to `ToolCall` types allows suppressing tool invocation records in message history. Context pruner and planner agents updated to handle the new object format, replacing string-based content checks with typed property access. Core agent definitions now import `Message` from new `codebuff-message.ts` schema file instead of defining it inline.

1177729cc42b278ee64bfd68f73d0ab5cc3fd62a.title: Remove debug log from convertCbToModelMessages
1177729cc42b278ee64bfd68f73d0ab5cc3fd62a.summary: Deleted `console.log` call in `common/src/util/messages.ts` within `convertCbToModelMessages`. This removes noisy JSON serialization of aggregated content blocks during message conversion. Scope limited to core message utility; no functional changes to model output or API behavior.

5aca4d9c7c0c1802ddc96ad312f0b44e6cd9e219.title: Increase nightly evals concurrency
5aca4d9c7c0c1802ddc96ad312f0b44e6cd9e219.summary: The `--concurrency` flag in the `Run nightly evals` step of `.github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml` increased from 3 to 10. This change aims to speed up the nightly evaluation process by running more evals in parallel. Scope limited to CI workflow configuration.

fdd3f221a877cdc55a321cdd7829f2a2d217e2a6.title: Increase nightly-evals workflow timeout to 9 hours
fdd3f221a877cdc55a321cdd7829f2a2d217e2a6.summary: The `timeout-minutes` configuration in `.github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml` increased from 360 to 540 minutes. This extends the allowed runtime for the `run-nightly-evals` job on `ubuntu-latest` runners. Scope limited to CI workflow configuration.

d9ff4b06d44698241aea455e6ba097906ef9aa9e.title: Fix background process visual bug in dev-process-manager
d9ff4b06d44698241aea455e6ba097906ef9aa9e.summary: Corrects result access in `npm-app/src/dev-process-manager.ts` from `result` to `result[0].value` before checking `processId`. This resolves a visual bug where successful background process starts were incorrectly flagged as failures in the console output.

e00a1e06009e7eb2f7f418a9296140633d181869.title: Skip zod validation for programmatic tool steps
e00a1e06009e7eb2f7f418a9296140633d181869.summary: Added `validateInputSchema` flag to `executeToolCall` in `backend/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`, defaulting to true but disabled for `runProgrammaticStep`. When false, raw input bypasses `parseRawToolCall` and is cast directly to `CodebuffToolCall`. Relaxed `content` schema in `common/src/tools/params/tool/set-messages.ts` to `z.string()` only, removing array-of-objects support.

33e23801370cb00e7d4dbb58e875492087b73b78.title: Relicense Codebuff SDK to Apache-2.0
33e23801370cb00e7d4dbb58e875492087b73b78.summary: Root `package.json` switches `license` from `UNLICENSED` to `Apache-2.0`. `sdk/package.json` updates from `MIT` to `Apache-2.0`. Redundant `UNLICENSED` fields removed from 8 private workspaces (`backend`, `common`, `evals`, `packages/bigquery`, `packages/billing`, `packages/code-map`, `packages/internal`, `scripts`, `web`).

89d2af15b727726b51ca33f8b2c29abb0eb63a16.title: Add Apache 2.0 license and NOTICE
89d2af15b727726b51ca33f8b2c29abb0eb63a16.summary: Added LICENSE and NOTICE files to the repository root. LICENSE contains the full text of the Apache License, Version 2.0. NOTICE identifies the project as Codebuff with a 2025 copyright attribution.

ae7bedbbd480b89e8ce8e152c5328766b5d09e82.title: CLI logout returns success for invalid tokens
ae7bedbbd480b89e8ce8e152c5328766b5d09e82.summary: The `/api/auth/cli/logout` endpoint now returns `{ success: true }` instead of a 401 `INVALID_AUTH_TOKEN_MESSAGE` when no active session is found. This change treats logout attempts with already invalid or expired tokens as a successful no-op to prevent confusing error messages in the npm app. The update is scoped to `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/logout/route.ts`.

1f4061f2d40dc0cb129feb4b0f2e084df4a051d6.title: Fix .env.worktree precedence in bun wrapper
1f4061f2d40dc0cb129feb4b0f2e084df4a051d6.summary: The .bin/bun wrapper now loads .env.worktree after Infisical cache to ensure worktree overrides take precedence. Added finalize_and_exec and load_worktree_env functions to standardize secret loading across all execution paths. Updated knowledge.md to document the correct precedence order and project-root lookup behavior. This fixes issues where cached Infisical values would incorrectly override worktree-specific configurations like ports.

d9ff4b06d44698241aea455e6ba097906ef9aa9e.text: A small internal fix corrects how the system checks if a background task started successfully. Users will now see accurate status messages instead of false failure warnings.

1177729cc42b278ee64bfd68f73d0ab5cc3fd62a.text: Removed internal debug logs that recorded message data during processing. This change does not affect how the assistant works or what it says.

ae7bedbbd480b89e8ce8e152c5328766b5d09e82.text: When you sign out, the system now quietly finishes the action even if your login session has already ended. This prevents confusing error messages from appearing.

fdd3f221a877cdc55a321cdd7829f2a2d217e2a6.text: The automatic quality checks that run overnight were given more time to finish. This small internal change helps the system complete its routine reviews without stopping early.

1f4061f2d40dc0cb129feb4b0f2e084df4a051d6.text: Fixed a small internal issue where saved settings sometimes ignored newer project-specific configurations. This ensures the software correctly uses the right ports and settings for each project.

5aca4d9c7c0c1802ddc96ad312f0b44e6cd9e219.text: The team sped up an internal daily check by running more tasks at once. This background process does not change how the product works for you.

e00a1e06009e7eb2f7f418a9296140633d181869.text: The assistant now skips a safety check when processing certain internal tasks, allowing it to handle message updates more efficiently.

b586383b9e0c3122140d7f2f73f2b6e9c1a96c45.text: The assistant now records tool usage with clear labels and can hide these records when needed. This keeps conversation history tidy and focused on what matters to you.

11ddecd052ee57018e7fc77b93f704732caab76f.title: Remove debug log in websocket-action.ts
11ddecd052ee57018e7fc77b93f704732caab76f.summary: Deleted duplicate logger.info call in backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. The removed line logged 'TEST! USER INPUT' alongside the standard prompt log. Internal cleanup only.

5aed73e0eec402149ee94c56ec5c47fffa660d20.title: Bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.18
5aed73e0eec402149ee94c56ec5c47fffa660d20.summary: Version bump for @codebuff/sdk from 0.1.17 to 0.1.18. No functional code changes included in this commit. Update applies to sdk/package.json.

cd5eb8dbf2a3758f4f676093c2db1f2f76014f5b.title: Update subagent streaming test expectations for divider chunks
cd5eb8dbf2a3758f4f676093c2db1f2f76014f5b.summary: Adjusts `subagent-streaming.test.ts` to account for additional labeled divider chunks in the streaming output. Assertion counts increase from 2 to 4, and specific chunk checks shift to indices 2 and 3. This aligns tests with current backend behavior where dividers wrap subagent messages.

d853317e31570975cdd20ae4112be189ace1a1bc.title: Add --agent flag to evals
d853317e31570975cdd20ae4112be189ace1a1bc.summary: Added `--agent` flag to `run-eval-set` command, defaulting to 'base'. Replaced hardcoded `agentType` in `EvalConfig` with dynamic `agent` value passed through `runGitEvals` and `run-single-eval-process`. Updates `agent_model` in `GitEvalResultRequest` to use this new flag. Scope: `evals/git-evals` subsystem.

ad994723e7d3e52dd280a5a26510dc186736b5d9.title: Remove fingerprintid column from message table schema
ad994723e7d3e52dd280a5a26510dc186736b5d9.summary: Migration 0026 drops the `fingerprint_id` column, its foreign key constraint, and associated index from the `message` table. The `insertMessageRecord` function in `message-cost-tracker.ts` no longer writes `fingerprint_id` to the database. This change affects the backend cost tracking logic and the shared database schema definitions.

11ddecd052ee57018e7fc77b93f704732caab76f.text: Removed an internal note from the logs. This cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

5aed73e0eec402149ee94c56ec5c47fffa660d20.text: The underlying helper software received a minor internal update. Users will not notice any changes in how the product works.

048bf594aca2b45cea30481bbadd2fdcf1455da0.text: The assistant now stops after 25 steps by default, replacing inconsistent limits of 40 and 12. This internal adjustment ensures a uniform experience for all users.

0877d4fc8a5d95fa8771ee023cc57ce37ffb52b5.text: The software now uses different tools to help it think and check work. This change only affects how the system operates in the background and does not change what you see.

b133712e7c3c310c96fb3228a82bdc71a2983774.text: The assistant now shows its results more clearly. You can choose where it looks for files, and add extra notes to help it understand.

d853317e31570975cdd20ae4112be189ace1a1bc.text: This small internal update lets the system choose different assistant versions for testing without needing code changes. Regular users won't notice any difference, but it helps the team compare how well different models perform.

150007805900c05738188ccf169b33ff8045376c.text: The assistant can now use a new model. It also shows results more clearly. Help guides are easier to find.

c5338b079aa0319f21dc0fa68f8f7c4003ec3d4b.text: The assistant now uses a standard format for its answers. This ensures all features display results consistently.

cd5eb8dbf2a3758f4f676093c2db1f2f76014f5b.text: This small internal update fixes a test to match how the assistant currently displays messages. You will not notice any change in how the product works.

9f4f26545c911b5dcb860eb774cbfac43f1fa61f.title: Fix DEFAULTBACKENDURL typo in SDK
9f4f26545c911b5dcb860eb774cbfac43f1fa61f.summary: Corrects DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL from 'manidoce-backend.onrender.com' to 'manicode-backend.onrender.com' in sdk/src/constants.ts. The previous value contained a character swap in the hostname. This ensures the SDK defaults to the correct production backend endpoint.

de2d2380c074572ed332d5cb81ee7d2b69c90496.title: changes.ts error logging uses errorToObject
de2d2380c074572ed332d5cb81ee7d2b69c90496.summary: Refactored error logging in `applyChanges` within `npm-app/src/utils/changes.ts` to use `errorToObject` from `@codebuff/common/util/object`. This ensures error objects are serialized correctly in console output during patch application failures. Scope limited to `npm-app` utility module. Internal change; no user-facing behavior or API surface modifications.

cd831b628e9adc60d03b577c5e9d86a998ce3c39.title: Fix negative dash length in spawn-agent-utils
cd831b628e9adc60d03b577c5e9d86a998ce3c39.summary: Clamp dash length to zero in `executeAgent` to prevent `RangeError` when agent names exceed width. Fixes start and end notification formatting in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts`. Uses `Math.max(0, ...)` for dash calculation.

9742a0a8dccd1d750dbb8fad1d1647be43409cc3.title: Stream single agent output with labeled dividers
9742a0a8dccd1d750dbb8fad1d1647be43409cc3.summary: Refactored agent spawning to stream outputs for any single child agent, removing hardcoded allowlists. `executeAgent` now accepts `isOnlyChild` flag to inject labeled start/end dividers into the stream. `runProgrammaticStep` emits tool calls to client immediately. Files: `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`, `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-inline.ts`, `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts`, `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts`.

abd66bda3d2e0248408b51d66e441f99f7869239.title: Add posthog-node dependency to common package
abd66bda3d2e0248408b51d66e441f99f7869239.summary: Added 'posthog-node' (^5.8.0) to dependencies in common/package.json. This integrates server-side analytics capabilities into the shared core module. Scope limited to common package manifest.

0efeedbe8c1cb6f2aca0c99effc40a0d0b9c9889.title: CodebuffRunner creates client per request
0efeedbe8c1cb6f2aca0c99effc40a0d0b9c9889.summary: CodebuffRunner now instantiates a new CodebuffClient for every run instead of caching a single instance. This change removes the persistent client state, ensuring fresh connections and error handling contexts per execution. The modification applies to the evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts file. Clients are explicitly closed via client.closeConnection() after each run completes.

d2192cf8639ebcecf8d3e68a0a6b548cdba7f469.title: Patch failures returned as tool result, not thrown
d2192cf8639ebcecf8d3e68a0a6b548cdba7f469.summary: Patch application errors in `applyChanges` now return `false` as a `patchFailed` array item instead of throwing. `handleUpdateFile` and `changeFile` consume this array to append 'Failed to write to ${file}; the patch failed to apply' to the tool result string. This prevents unhandled exceptions from crashing the agent loop when a diff context mismatch occurs. Covers `npm-app` tool handlers and `sdk` change-file tool.

a77c87dba037907d63c95bc2c098367fa65601f9.title: Replace custom object utils with lodash
a77c87dba037907d63c95bc2c098367fa65601f9.summary: Replaced custom `hasKey` and `deepEqual` utilities in `common/src/util/object.ts` with `lodash`'s `has` and `isEqual`. This refactoring reduces code duplication by leveraging existing dependencies. The change affects `common/src/util/messages.ts` where these utilities are used for cache control and message aggregation logic.

da474825cb8e031deb16d2d81ac46b9c4281d0ec.title: Eval runner logs invalid tool errors instead of throwing
da474825cb8e031deb16d2d81ac46b9c4281d0ec.summary: Eval runner `codebuff.ts` logs error events via `console.log` instead of throwing, preventing crash on invalid tool call. `xml-stream-parser.ts` increases invalid JSON error message content truncation limit from 50 to 200 chars. `messages.ts` and `run-git-evals.ts` replace custom `deepCopy` with `lodash` `cloneDeep` to preserve types/functions. `object.ts` removes unused `deepCopy` export.

d2192cf8639ebcecf8d3e68a0a6b548cdba7f469.text: If the assistant fails to update a file, it now reports the error clearly instead of stopping unexpectedly. This keeps the conversation running smoothly when changes cannot be applied.

de2d2380c074572ed332d5cb81ee7d2b69c90496.text: The app now records clearer notes when updates fail. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

875deb4b45b35556f32c131b989a028e77f36fd7.text: The internal records for six thinking tools now include a 'publisher' label. This small administrative update helps track which company made each tool, with no change to how the product works for users.

abd66bda3d2e0248408b51d66e441f99f7869239.text: The team added a tool to track how the software is used. This helps them understand which features are popular and where the system might need improvement. You will not see any changes in the product.

9742a0a8dccd1d750dbb8fad1d1647be43409cc3.text: When the assistant uses a single helper task, the results now appear with clear start and end markers. This makes it easier to follow what the assistant is doing without needing to read technical details.

0efeedbe8c1cb6f2aca0c99effc40a0d0b9c9889.text: The assistant now starts a fresh connection for every task instead of reusing an old one. This small internal update helps prevent errors caused by leftover data from previous requests.

cd831b628e9adc60d03b577c5e9d86a998ce3c39.text: Fixed a bug where long names broke the layout of assistant messages. This ensures notifications display correctly.

9f4f26545c911b5dcb860eb774cbfac43f1fa61f.text: A small typo in a web address was fixed. The software now connects to the correct main server.

a77c87dba037907d63c95bc2c098367fa65601f9.text: The team replaced custom tools for checking data with standard, reliable ones. This internal cleanup makes the code easier to maintain without changing how the product works for you.

1d7bf55bcc427808e96678fbbab73ab3087ec01d.title: Add TEST! log to websocket prompt handler
1d7bf55bcc427808e96678fbbab73ab3087ec01d.summary: Added a duplicate logger.info call with 'TEST!' prefix in backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. This change introduces redundant logging for user prompts within the onPrompt handler. Scope limited to backend websocket actions. No functional behavior change; purely diagnostic logging addition.

a9ff22ff4fe1c03e32c3bcb5475bf0b508641381.title: Fix typecheck in common/src/util/messages.ts
a9ff22ff4fe1c03e32c3bcb5475bf0b508641381.summary: Corrected import path for ProviderMetadata in common/src/util/messages.ts. Replaced 'src/...' with relative '../types/...' to resolve typecheck failure. Scope limited to Shared/Core.

98f4e7b93c14e93d9259202c583942543e63c662.title: Base2 agent config fixes
98f4e7b93c14e93d9259202c583942543e63c662.summary: Base2 factory adds add_message to toolNames and updates step-limit prompt to require plain text. Editor stepLimit increased from 15 to 20. Covers .agents/base2/base2-factory.ts and .agents/base2/editor.ts.

bc7aab720aeae87e38ce76e5b50b05d3d849a17a.title: GPT-5 Quick Thinker adds publisher field, experimental mode uses base2
bc7aab720aeae87e38ce76e5b50b05d3d849a17a.summary: The `gpt5-thinker` agent definition now imports and sets `publisher` from `../constants`, aligning it with the standard agent template. In `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, the `experimental` cost mode maps to the literal string `'base2'` instead of `AgentTemplateTypes.base_experimental`. Scope covers `.agents/deep-thinking/gpt5-thinker.ts` and `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The `base2` value is a raw string, not an enum member.

c563016ebe857b18e8b013cd94480b0d886d263c.title: Cache control moved to last content block
c563016ebe857b18e8b013cd94480b0d886d263c.summary: Refactored `withCacheControl` and `withoutCacheControl` in `common/src/util/messages.ts` to operate on generic objects with `providerOptions` instead of `CodebuffMessage`. `convertCbToModelMessages` now applies cache control to the final content block of the last message, rather than the entire message object. This ensures Anthropic/OpenRouter ephemeral caching targets the correct granularity.

9a0d9dde91e6e1e9f77b647b1044da90ecf9de04.title: Remove ungenerated evals from git-evals specs
9a0d9dde91e6e1e9f77b647b1044da90ecf9de04.summary: Deleted all entries with spec 'Failed to generate specification due to error' from `evals/git-evals/eval-plane.json` and `evals/git-evals/eval-saleor.json`. These entries contained broken or incomplete file states from failed generation runs. Removing them cleans up the eval dataset by excluding invalid or non-runnable test cases.

3ab02d5c226224e860018e1fa2b27d78eec69a85.title: Fix setmessages filter in codebuff eval runner
3ab02d5c226224e860018e1fa2b27d78eec69a85.summary: CodebuffRunner now filters set_messages tool calls by checking event.toolName instead of event.toolCallId. Previous logic failed to match the tool name, causing set_messages calls to incorrectly enter the toolCalls array. Scope limited to evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts. Correct property access ensures internal message-setting calls are properly excluded from eval traces.

3f1dc4edc04175607be6144602133fe45182c03d.title: Increase MAXAGENTSTEPSDEFAULT to 40
3f1dc4edc04175607be6144602133fe45182c03d.summary: The default `MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT` constant in `common/src/constants/agents.ts` increased from 25 to 40. This adjustment compensates for the context-pruner consuming half of the available steps, ensuring sufficient headroom for agent execution. This change affects the core shared configuration used by the agent loop.

c563016ebe857b18e8b013cd94480b0d886d263c.text: The system now saves conversation data more efficiently by marking only the final part of the last message for quick recall. This speeds up responses without changing how you use the assistant.

9a0d9dde91e6e1e9f77b647b1044da90ecf9de04.text: The system stopped using broken test cases that failed to load correctly. This internal cleanup helps the product work more reliably, though you won't see any direct changes.

a9ff22ff4fe1c03e32c3bcb5475bf0b508641381.text: A small internal fix corrected how the app finds some data. You won't notice a change.

1d7bf55bcc427808e96678fbbab73ab3087ec01d.text: The system now records extra internal notes when you send a message to the assistant. These notes help the team check how the service works. You will not see any change in how the product behaves.

3f1dc4edc04175607be6144602133fe45182c03d.text: The assistant can now take more actions before stopping. This helps it finish complex tasks that need extra steps.

89d2af15b727726b51ca33f8b2c29abb0eb63a16.text: The team added official permission documents to the project. This clarifies how the software can be used and credits the creators. It does not change how the product works for you.

bc7aab720aeae87e38ce76e5b50b05d3d849a17a.text: The thinking assistant now displays who published it, matching other tools. An experimental setting uses a new cost label. These are small internal updates with no visible change to how you use the product.

33e23801370cb00e7d4dbb58e875492087b73b78.text: The software's usage rules changed to a standard open format. This update affects how developers share the underlying code, not how you use the product.

3ab02d5c226224e860018e1fa2b27d78eec69a85.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system records certain background actions. This ensures the assistant's activity logs are accurate, with no direct change to what you see or do.

98f4e7b93c14e93d9259202c583942543e63c662.text: The assistant can now better understand and follow instructions, and it is allowed to take a few more steps to finish tasks.

0c135314b791f927b4e2a3e55a0e9d12a815a341.title: Remove unused mock from agent-validation.test.ts
0c135314b791f927b4e2a3e55a0e9d12a815a341.summary: Removed unused mockModule for @codebuff/backend/util/file-resolver in common/src/__tests__/agent-validation.test.ts. Cleanup of dead test setup code. Scope limited to test file. No behavior change.

2a4a206c48d09a29bf24d0f9a20faefcb7e97f19.title: Fix import path in common/src/util/object.ts
2a4a206c48d09a29bf24d0f9a20faefcb7e97f19.summary: Corrected relative import path for JSONValue type in `common/src/util/object.ts`. Replaced `src/types/json` with `../types/json` to resolve typecheck errors. Affects shared core utilities only.

d378eecee8ec9136a58f5371624ea8c51a70984e.title: Remove trace and fileStates from eval process console output
d378eecee8ec9136a58f5371624ea8c51a70984e.summary: Strips `trace` and `eval_commit.fileStates` from the `Final result` log in `evals/git-evals/run-single-eval-process.ts`. The full `result` object remains available via `process.send` for IPC consumers. This reduces console noise during eval execution.

d310a1da69393a91e18c009964025c4cc54700ed.title: Editor prompt bans code comments; scout prompt tightens output;
d310a1da69393a91e18c009964025c4cc54700ed.summary: Editor instructions now forbid all code comments unless the user explicitly requests them, replacing the prior 'sparingly' guidance. Scout agent prompt prohibits narrating spawn parameters and bans irrelevant info, end-of-turn summaries, and follow-up questions in responses. base2-factory prompt changed final-summary rule from 'maybe one sentence' to a strict single completion sentence. ModelName type in agent-definition.ts adds openai/gpt-5-chat alongside existing gpt-5 variants.

9c17f38817bbadd8830df8289915003fce9b8081.title: Remove applyAndRevertChangesSequentially from evals scaffolding
9c17f38817bbadd8830df8289915003fce9b8081.summary: Deleted `applyAndRevertChangesSequentially` helper and its `applyAndRevertChanges` import from `evals/scaffolding.ts`. The function implemented a promise queue to serialize file change operations, which is no longer required. Scope limited to internal evals tooling.

bc640140ba10e9abbeb99e6ec3a0c221813071e2.title: Remove debug and file-resolver utilities, clean logger imports
bc640140ba10e9abbeb99e6ec3a0c221813071e2.summary: Deleted `backend/src/util/debug.ts` and `backend/src/util/file-resolver.ts` to remove unused filesystem-dependent helpers. `backend/src/util/logger.ts` dropped an unused `AsyncLocalStorage` import from `async_hooks`. Internal cleanup; no user-facing behavior change.

13e5f01636d1faf4e9a9cd2f62f469b1ab0fb924.title: Base2 prompting tweaks
13e5f01636d1faf4e9a9cd2f62f469b1ab0fb924.summary: Base2 agent prompts updated to enforce conciseness and clarify editor spawning. `base2-factory.ts` adds a rule to suppress final summaries unless a single sentence is needed. `editor.ts` allows direct spawning for easy tasks without prior scouting or planning, and mandates specific content (answer, changes, checks) in `set_output` summaries.

0a565ba2fd828697f63a1666d4336967a2fb3d19.title: Move cache control into convertCbToModelMessages
0a565ba2fd828697f63a1666d4336967a2fb3d19.summary: Cache control injection moved from `getMessagesSubset` to `convertCbToModelMessages` via new `includeCacheControl` flag on `promptAiSdkStream`, `promptAiSdk`, `promptAiSdkStructured`, and `getAgentStreamFromTemplate`. `run-agent-step.ts` now passes `supportsCacheControl(model)` at call time instead of post-hoc message mutation. `withCacheControl` uses `deepCopy` and a new `withoutCacheControl` strips stale `anthropic`/`openrouter` cache entries. `CodebuffMessage` schemas in `common/src/types/messages/codebuff-message.ts` gained shared `auxiliaryDataSchema` for `providerOptions`, `timeToLive`, `keepDuringTruncation`.

e4b82f2d61967aa88a2658d6672e40d3f96a0d01.title: Fix eval log stripping and import order
e4b82f2d61967aa88a2658d6672e40d3f96a0d01.summary: Corrects trace and fileStates stripping in run-git-evals.ts and removes dead code in run-single-eval-process.ts. Fixes comma-operator bug in single eval process and sorts imports in git evals runner. Affects evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts, evals/git-evals/run-single-eval-process.ts. Internal refactor.

ad994723e7d3e52dd280a5a26510dc186736b5d9.text: The system stopped saving a hidden tracking tag for each message. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

bc640140ba10e9abbeb99e6ec3a0c221813071e2.text: Developers removed unused tools from the software's internal workings. You will see no change in how the product works.

0c135314b791f927b4e2a3e55a0e9d12a815a341.text: The team removed unused code from their internal testing setup. This change has no effect on how the product works for you.

d378eecee8ec9136a58f5371624ea8c51a70984e.text: The system now hides extra background details in its internal records. This makes the logs cleaner for the team, with no change to how the product works for you.

9c17f38817bbadd8830df8289915003fce9b8081.text: Removed an unused internal helper that serialized file changes. This change is small and internal, with no impact on product features.

e4b82f2d61967aa88a2658d6672e40d3f96a0d01.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system records and organizes background tasks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2a4a206c48d09a29bf24d0f9a20faefcb7e97f19.text: A small internal fix corrected how parts of the system find data types. This resolved background errors without changing how you use the product.

d310a1da69393a91e18c009964025c4cc54700ed.text: The assistant now writes less cluttered answers and avoids adding notes inside the text unless you ask. It also uses a newer, more capable brain for some tasks.

13e5f01636d1faf4e9a9cd2f62f469b1ab0fb924.text: The assistant now keeps its final messages shorter and handles simple editing tasks more quickly.

0a565ba2fd828697f63a1666d4336967a2fb3d19.text: The system now handles data storage more efficiently behind the scenes. This internal cleanup helps the assistant run smoother without changing how you use it.

b1c932d3ae4a39eef370a42f26af09a0cced29c0.title: Clarify parallel execution in spawnagents tool description
b1c932d3ae4a39eef370a42f26af09a0cced29c0.summary: Updated the `spawn_agents` tool description in `common/src/tools/params/tool/spawn-agents.ts` to explicitly state that spawned agents run in parallel and independently. The new text instructs users to invoke `spawn_agents` with a single agent per call if sequential execution is required. This change affects the core tool parameters definition, ensuring the LLM understands the concurrency model.

ddcb7593efc6020e53cff6e078c3a80ba3eb8175.title: Profile sign-in gate and SDK doc update
ddcb7593efc6020e53cff6e078c3a80ba3eb8175.summary: Profile page now gates on auth status, rendering `ProfileLoggedOut` card for unauthenticated users instead of empty state. `SignInButton` accepts optional `onClick` for analytics and preserves `referral_code` in localStorage during non-login flows. SDK README prerequisites condensed to single line linking API keys page. Covers `web/src/app/profile` components and `sdk/README.md`.

cd8111d1d5f25cde8bacdd7a96153a2e0acc3fc6.title: Replace custom patch implementation with diff library
cd8111d1d5f25cde8bacdd7a96153a2e0acc3fc6.summary: Deleted custom `applyPatch` logic in `common/src/util/patch.ts` and migrated to `diff` library (v8.0.2) for both `npm-app` and `sdk`. Added explicit error handling for failed patches (`newContent === false`) in `npm-app/src/utils/changes.ts` and `sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts`. Removed unused `applyAndRevertChanges` function.

b18932b4b7c3d1e2b66fa0ceac9c382ece0bd330.title: Confirmation dialog input clear via useEffect
b18932b4b7c3d1e2b66fa0ceac9c382ece0bd330.summary: ConfirmationInputDialog in `web/src/components/ui/confirmation-input-dialog.tsx` clears `inputValue` via `useEffect` on `isOpen` change. Replaces redundant `setInputValue('')` call in `handleOpenChange`. Internal refactor for consistent state management.

6fb0494b34834fad98b268ce430968f4c42f5985.title: Remove legacy Message type and transformMessages
6fb0494b34834fad98b268ce430968f4c42f5985.summary: Codebase now exclusively uses `CodebuffMessage` from `@codebuff/common/types/messages/codebuff-message`. The legacy `Message` type and `transformMessages` utility in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` were deleted, removing ~100 lines of conversion logic. Imports across backend services (`relabelRuns`, `fast-rewrite`, `gemini-with-fallbacks`, etc.) updated to the new path. `saveAgentRequest` debugging helper removed.

2e6102cc872545c0d074083a07500383beeef66d.title: 30-minute timeout added to git eval tasks
2e6102cc872545c0d074083a07500383beeef66d.summary: runGitEvals wraps individual commit eval promises in withTimeout at 30 minutes (60_000 * 30). Prevents hung eval tasks from blocking the concurrency limiter indefinitely. Change scoped to evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. Timeout applies per-commit, inside the pLimit(20) concurrency boundary.

3656683d7651195e4cc1864e405d32b7ac19d1cd.title: Revert session state to CodebuffMessageSchema
3656683d7651195e4cc1864e405d32b7ac19d1cd.summary: Session state imports `CodebuffMessageSchema` from `./message` instead of `codebuffMessageSchema` from `./messages/codebuff-message`. Reverts recent schema path and casing changes in `common/src/types/session-state.ts`. Affects core shared types for agent session persistence. `AgentStateSchema.messageHistory` array type now references the original schema export.

6e7401cf6d5da75b46dd1c87bad082f7698c0504.title: Shared INVALIDAUTHTOKENMESSAGE constant replaces scattered auth error
6e7401cf6d5da75b46dd1c87bad082f7698c0504.summary: Added `INVALID_AUTH_TOKEN_MESSAGE` to `common/src/constants.ts` with explicit logout guidance. Replaced hardcoded 'Invalid authentication token', 'Invalid auth token', and 'Invalid session' strings in `backend/src/api/org.ts`, `packages/internal/src/utils/auth.ts`, and `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/logout/route.ts`. `backend/src/api/usage.ts` conditionally uses the new message only when `authToken` is present, preserving generic failure text otherwise.

653c32d27e6381fca316eb93fb06bf392342b0a6.title: Refactor sessions route with helpers and add error logging
653c32d27e6381fca316eb93fb06bf392342b0a6.summary: The DELETE /api/sessions endpoint in web/src/app/api/sessions/route.ts was refactored to extract revokeStandardSessions and revokeApiTokens helpers. Session revocation now handles raw tokens or sha256 hashes, restricts deletion to web/cli types, and unclaims CLI fingerprints within a transaction. PAT revocation remains separate. The catch block now logs errors via logger.error before returning 500.

7c2cb2b0bdf6644394975a621161b7434a7ad7d3.title: scripts/run-tests-summary replaces inline test hooks
7c2cb2b0bdf6644394975a621161b7434a7ad7d3.summary: New `scripts/run-tests-summary` script replaces inline `find | xargs | grep` commands in `codebuff.json` file-change hooks. Script aggregates Bun test output into single success line while preserving verbose failure logs. Affects `backend`, `npm-app`, and `common` unit test hooks.

6fb0494b34834fad98b268ce430968f4c42f5985.text: The software now uses a single, consistent format for handling information, replacing an older method. This cleanup simplifies the system behind the scenes without changing how the product works for you.

653c32d27e6381fca316eb93fb06bf392342b0a6.text: The system now cleans up old login records more carefully and keeps a better record of any problems.

2e6102cc872545c0d074083a07500383beeef66d.text: A 30-minute limit was added to background checks on recent changes. This prevents stuck tasks from slowing down the system.

7c2cb2b0bdf6644394975a621161b7434a7ad7d3.text: A small internal update simplifies how the system checks its own work behind the scenes. This change does not affect what you see or do in the product.

b18932b4b7c3d1e2b66fa0ceac9c382ece0bd330.text: The app now clears the text box in confirmation dialogs automatically when they open. This is a small internal cleanup that keeps the behavior consistent.

cd8111d1d5f25cde8bacdd7a96153a2e0acc3fc6.text: The software now uses a standard, well-tested method for making changes to files, replacing a custom-built one. This improves reliability and reduces the chance of errors when updates are applied.

ddcb7593efc6020e53cff6e078c3a80ba3eb8175.text: The profile page now shows a clear sign-in prompt for guests. This prevents an empty screen and keeps your sign-up link working.

b1c932d3ae4a39eef370a42f26af09a0cced29c0.text: The assistant now knows that multiple tasks start at the same time unless you ask for them one by one. This helps it follow your instructions more accurately when you need steps to happen in a specific order.

6e7401cf6d5da75b46dd1c87bad082f7698c0504.text: The app now shows the same clear message when your login expires, instead of different confusing errors.

3656683d7651195e4cc1864e405d32b7ac19d1cd.text: The app’s way of saving conversation history was switched back to its previous format. This change fixes how the assistant remembers past messages.

ed219d95f7545ae4d8625d0ea5e45d91cf3f63ab.title: SDK v0.1.17 adds API key retrieval and custom tools
ed219d95f7545ae4d8625d0ea5e45d91cf3f63ab.summary: Version bump to 0.1.17 in @codebuff/sdk. Adds support for retrieving API keys via Codebuff website and providing custom tools. Updates types and documentation.

88e41fc12e11640490384eec7417c1f97588e79d.title: Eval runner skips setmessages tool calls
88e41fc12e11640490384eec7417c1f97588e79d.summary: CodebuffRunner in evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts filters out tool_call events where toolCallId equals 'set_messages'. Prevents internal message-state updates from polluting captured tool-call traces during eval runs. Scope limited to the Codebuff eval runner. Import ordering cleaned up alongside the logic change.

8d9b622db70eb7529fbf3ef5c456d40717ae4d48.title: Add CodebuffMessage Zod schemas
8d9b622db70eb7529fbf3ef5c456d40717ae4d48.summary: New CodebuffMessage types in common/src/types/messages/codebuff-message.ts, replacing legacy schema in session-state.ts. Includes content-part, data-content, provider-metadata, and json.ts. Tool call string logic in tools/utils.ts now defaults endsAgentStep to false if undefined.

70eef53debcc406accb01d6b24f70df38fa264b7.title: Trim prompt logging in websocket-action.ts
70eef53debcc406accb01d6b24f70df38fa264b7.summary: Prompt logging now truncates to 100 chars and passes structured metadata. `logger.info` call updated in `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`. Reduces log noise from large prompts. Internal change only.

3940bc5bf3da0fce00aec33aa5dcbac74ee4a769.title: base2 agent relies on sub-agents and adds step limit
3940bc5bf3da0fce00aec33aa5dcbac74ee4a769.summary: Added 'Rely on agents' and 'Don't mastermind' instructions to base2 factory prompts, directing the orchestrator to delegate planning and execution to spawned sub-agents rather than reading code sections itself. Introduced a maxSteps=10 guard in handleSteps: when the step limit is hit, an add_message tool call injects a user prompt forcing the agent to summarize progress and end its turn. Change isolated to .agents/base2/base2-factory.ts, affecting internal orchestration logic without altering user-facing CLI or Web surfaces.

43c739b354b8e516e4486cf2558a7c3c8a0f0762.title: Update SDK readme with API key instructions
43c739b354b8e516e4486cf2558a7c3c8a0f0762.summary: The `sdk/README.md` now directs users to create a Codebuff account and get an API key directly from the profile page. The previous instructions to install the CLI and run `codebuff login` to read credentials from the local filesystem have been removed. Code examples now use `process.env.CODEBUFF_API_KEY` instead of parsing `~/.config/manicode/credentials.json`.

1a1affad6eebbc262b25acf84fd0c595bee03648.title: Refine base2 agent prompts and spawnable agents
1a1affad6eebbc262b25acf84fd0c595bee03648.summary: Updated system and instructions prompts for base2 agents (Buffy, editor) to include core mandates like proactiveness, clarity, and strict convention adherence. Expanded editor's spawnableAgents to include 'web-researcher' and 'docs-researcher', replacing 'researcher'. Added explicit Git Changes context injection via PLACEHOLDER.GIT_CHANGES_PROMPT in Buffy's system prompt. Renamed 'Current Git Changes' to 'Git Changes' in backend prompt generation.

ae64084bdbcd643a79633f8cfa8d055be46fcac6.title: Revert eval prompting to Vercel AI SDK
ae64084bdbcd643a79633f8cfa8d055be46fcac6.summary: Reverts `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` to use `promptAiSdkStructured` instead of `CodebuffClient` for agent prompting. Removes SDK client initialization, `getUserCredentials` imports, and explicit `sdkClient.closeConnection` calls. Directly invokes `@codebuff/backend/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk` with `models.gemini2_5_flash` and `AgentDecisionSchema`.

e8eef4d62176ab5156b486e6d83d2f72c334f468.title: Evals migrate to Codebuff SDK for prompting
e8eef4d62176ab5156b486e6d83d2f72c334f468.summary: Git evals replace direct `promptAiSdkStructured` calls with `CodebuffClient` via new `prompting-agent.ts`. This aligns evaluation harnesses with production SDK paths. Changes affect `evals/git-evals/` and `sdk/src/client.ts` (renamed `promptIdValues` to `promptIdToHandlers`).

3940bc5bf3da0fce00aec33aa5dcbac74ee4a769.text: The AI assistant now works better by sharing tasks with smaller helpers instead of doing everything alone. It also stops after a set number of steps to prevent endless work, ensuring it gives you a clear summary when finished.

ed219d95f7545ae4d8625d0ea5e45d91cf3f63ab.text: Users can now manage access credentials and add custom tools through the website.

8d9b622db70eb7529fbf3ef5c456d40717ae4d48.text: The system's internal data rules were updated to be clearer and more consistent. This is a small background change that makes the assistant more reliable without adding new visible features.

ae64084bdbcd643a79633f8cfa8d055be46fcac6.text: The system now uses a different tool to help the assistant make decisions. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

43c739b354b8e516e4486cf2558a7c3c8a0f0762.text: The instructions for signing in have changed. You now copy a key from your account profile page instead of using a special program to log in.

e8eef4d62176ab5156b486e6d83d2f72c334f468.text: The system now uses a single shared method for its internal testing and live operations. This small internal change ensures the testing environment matches the real product experience.

70eef53debcc406accb01d6b24f70df38fa264b7.text: The system now shortens saved records of user requests to reduce clutter. This internal update does not change how the product works for you.

88e41fc12e11640490384eec7417c1f97588e79d.text: The testing system now ignores certain internal messages. This helps engineers check the assistant's behavior more accurately.

1a1affad6eebbc262b25acf84fd0c595bee03648.text: The assistant now has clearer instructions to be helpful and accurate. It can also better see what files changed recently to give you more relevant help.

da474825cb8e031deb16d2d81ac46b9c4281d0ec.text: The system now records errors instead of stopping, so tests can continue even if a tool fails. It also handles data copying more accurately.

c28e7b1820d0657418acc4f285ea6d80b2edc8a8.title: Scout gains readfiles, Editor filters successful edits
c28e7b1820d0657418acc4f285ea6d80b2edc8a8.summary: Scout agent (Lewis & Clark) gains read_files tool to directly inspect codebase files. System prompt reinforces read-only constraint, explicitly instructing not to offer code changes. Editor agent now filters editToolResults to only include entries containing 'successfully' and 'Changes made:' before yielding set_output. Scope: .agents/base2/scout.ts, .agents/base2/editor.ts.

f6731aa54fd5f414e9c9d148276feebb65bf232e.title: readdocs maxtokens default 20000
f6731aa54fd5f414e9c9d148276feebb65bf232e.summary: read_docs max_tokens default raised 10k to 20k in common/src/tools/params/tool/read-docs.ts. Zod schema adds .default(20_000) before .optional(), updating describe text to match. Floor of 10k for lower values unchanged. Core tool params only.

bba8333cc83d2193e71d39cbe23fad873e5f70b9.title: Editor step limit prompt directs setoutput
bba8333cc83d2193e71d39cbe23fad873e5f70b9.summary: Step limit prompt in `.agents/base2/editor.ts` now directs agent to use `set_output` tool for progress summary, replacing generic summary request. Ensures structured output capture at step limit. Affects internal editor agent behavior.

466a687e9c749e65862c670f434c21391a9e382c.title: Tool call timeouts resolve error result instead of rejecting
466a687e9c749e65862c670f434c21391a9e382c.summary: Timeouts in `requestToolCall` resolve with `{ success: false, error: ... }` instead of rejecting. Prevents agent crashes on tool timeouts. Scope: `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`.

57f0d403bc1b0ef1e365250d45cce469d1853bb1.title: Scout and planner switch to openai/gpt-5-chat
57f0d403bc1b0ef1e365250d45cce469d1853bb1.summary: Scout and planner agents now use openai/gpt-5-chat, replacing google/gemini-2.5-flash and google/gemini-2.5-pro respectively. The scout definition drops reasoningOptions (effort: 'low', exclude: true) as gpt-5-chat handles reasoning natively. Changes touch .agents/base2/scout.ts, .agents/base2/planner.ts, and common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts where openai/gpt-5-chat is added to ModelName.

124fcefd042d4100e46408a1420e80fabb78874c.title: Add web-researcher and docs-researcher agents
124fcefd042d4100e46408a1420e80fabb78874c.summary: Introduced web-researcher and docs-researcher agents to the scout agent's spawnable list, enabling targeted web and technical documentation searches. These new agents use Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and are defined in `.agents/web-researcher.ts` and `.agents/docs-researcher.ts` with corresponding factories in `.agents/factory/`. The `read-docs` tool parameters were updated to make `topic` required and clarify library name expectations.

76a16fb5e9be7d60ed8ae7a599594f30df481d43.title: Add openroutergpt5chat constant and tweak Peter Plan prompt
76a16fb5e9be7d60ed8ae7a599594f30df481d43.summary: Added `openrouter_gpt5_chat` mapping to `openai/gpt-5-chat` in `common/src/constants.ts`. Updated `planner-factory.ts` spawner prompt for 'Peter Plan' to recommend usage for complex tasks requiring thinking, softening previous discouragement. Changes affect core model registry and agent planning behavior.

6032016de28fabc85399c603fd51e1bfc8ff129a.title: Per-subagent cost attribution
6032016de28fabc85399c603fd51e1bfc8ff129a.summary: Backend tracks `agentId` in `message-cost-tracker` and `ai-sdk` streams. Client `subagent-storage` accumulates `creditsUsed` per agent via new `addCreditsByAgentId`. CLI `subagent-list` and `traces` render yellow credit counts for active subagents. `MessageCostResponseSchema` gains optional `agentId` field.

2cc0ca11dba0871a5942ca10a900f91d78806dfb.title: Planner switches to gpt-5-high for complex tasks
2cc0ca11dba0871a5942ca10a900f91d78806dfb.summary: Planner agent updated to use gpt-5-high model specifically for complex tasks.
