The `planner-gpt-5-high` definition is removed and replaced by a generic `planner` in `base2-gpt-5-high.ts`. `planner-factory.ts` now configures the planner with `structured_output`, adds `read_files`/`set_output` tools, and spawns `web-researcher`/`docs-researcher` instead of `gemini-thinker-high`. `docs-researcher.ts` spawner prompt clarified to target major public libraries/frameworks.

7466d3853b0137fcc88e3d7c0d73074a79e73ae0.title: Fix types in read-docs tool definition
7466d3853b0137fcc88e3d7c0d73074a79e73ae0.summary: Added `topic` parameter to MongoDB example in `backend/src/tools/definitions/tool/read-docs.ts`. This aligns the tool definition with the expected type signature, resolving type errors. Scope limited to backend tool definitions and associated tests.

bba8333cc83d2193e71d39cbe23fad873e5f70b9.text: When the assistant reaches its limit for a task, it now uses a specific format to summarize its progress. This helps the system capture the update correctly.

76a16fb5e9be7d60ed8ae7a599594f30df481d43.text: The assistant gained access to a new thinking model. Planning behavior now recommends this model for complex tasks.

7466d3853b0137fcc88e3d7c0d73074a79e73ae0.text: A small internal fix corrected a missing detail in how the assistant reads documents. Users will not notice any change.

f6731aa54fd5f414e9c9d148276feebb65bf232e.text: The assistant can now read longer documents at once. This helps it handle more information without cutting off text.

57f0d403bc1b0ef1e365250d45cce469d1853bb1.text: The assistant's planning and research tools now use a different underlying AI model. This change is internal and aims to improve how the assistant thinks and plans, without altering visible features.

6032016de28fabc85399c603fd51e1bfc8ff129a.text: The system now tracks spending for each helper task separately. Users can see exactly how many credits each helper used, making it easier to understand where costs come from.

124fcefd042d4100e46408a1420e80fabb78874c.text: The assistant can now search the web and technical guides more effectively. This means you get faster, more accurate answers when looking for online information.

c28e7b1820d0657418acc4f285ea6d80b2edc8a8.text: The assistant can now directly inspect files to better understand the codebase. It also filters out failed attempts when reporting changes, ensuring only successful updates are shown.

466a687e9c749e65862c670f434c21391a9e382c.text: If a tool takes too long to respond, the system now reports an error instead of crashing. This keeps the assistant running smoothly when tools are slow.

48bced48506177dfe8170f46a138fdc18811097c.title: fix: auto-topup occasional test failures due to missing mock
48bced48506177dfe8170f46a138fdc18811097c.summary: Added mock for `@codebuff/common/util/logger` in `backend/src/__tests__/auto-topup.test.ts` to resolve occasional test failures. The `beforeEach` block now stubs `logger` methods and `withLoggerContext` to prevent undefined references during auto-topup execution.

ccb934efb2f26f8c1f85e0baa24cc52d21294136.title: Fallback to local auth token in codebuff evals runner
ccb934efb2f26f8c1f85e0baa24cc52d21294136.summary: CodebuffRunner now derives apiKey from process.env[API_KEY_ENV_VAR] or getUserCredentials()?.authToken fallback. Eliminates hardcoded auth dependency in evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts. Covers internal evals harness only. Uses @codebuff/common/constants API_KEY_ENV_VAR and @codebuff/npm-app/credentials getUserCredentials.

e3b8150c100550555473d49f6bb6a2e8a284fa54.title: Backend error logging and agent step validation
e3b8150c100550555473d49f6bb6a2e8a284fa54.summary: Added debug logging to `mainPrompt` and enhanced error reporting in `runProgrammaticStep` and `websocket-action`. `runProgrammaticStep` now validates tool availability against agent templates and logs structured error objects, while `websocket-action` uses `getErrorObject` for consistent logging.

02b675499b82ee25ee56883fba8f11c0e23317f6.title: Scout agent model switch to Flash 2.5
02b675499b82ee25ee56883fba8f11c0e23317f6.summary: Scout agent model changed from gemini-2.5-pro to gemini-2.5-flash. Reasoning options removed. System prompt clarified to read-only capacity. Instructions updated to enforce thinking tags and parallel agent spawning. Researcher and file-explorer prompts refined for clarity.

e3b921fb1f45cee450366c1857f317c4aa700367.title: Add initCommand to git evals
e3b921fb1f45cee450366c1857f317c4aa700367.summary: Adds optional `initCommand` to `EvalData` and `setupTestRepo` to execute repo-specific setup commands like `bun install` during eval scaffolding. `run-git-evals.ts` and `run-single-eval.ts` pass this command through to the setup function. `setup-test-repo.ts` implements execution via `execFileSync` with a 240s timeout and error handling. Scope limited to internal evals in `evals/git-evals/`.

68bf922740c07889ebec41c5baf8b20276eb4a45.title: Add scout agent to base2, grant editor researcher access
68bf922740c07889ebec41c5baf8b20276eb4a45.summary: New `scout` agent (`Lewis & Clark`) added to `base2` factory spawnable list for quick codebase and web questions using `google/gemini-2.5-pro`. `editor` agent gains `researcher` in its `spawnableAgents` and updated `spawnerPrompt` to reflect web search capabilities. `researcher` agent loses `read_files` and `code_search` tools, restricting it to `web_search` and `read_docs`. `base2` system prompt updated to name the orchestrator 'Buffy'.

d6c91af4a750ea1fe31cd5be1b235db36ac9d682.title: Subagent cost aggregation tracks credits in agent state
d6c91af4a750ea1fe31cd5be1b235db36ac9d682.summary: Agent state now includes `creditsUsed` field, initialized to 0 in `createAgentState` and `spawn-agent-inline`. `saveMessage` returns `creditsUsed` number instead of void/null. `promptAiSdkStream`/`promptAiSdk`/`promptAiSdkStructured` accept optional `onCostCalculated` callback, invoked after `saveMessage` resolves. `runAgentStep` passes callback to accumulate costs into `agentState.creditsUsed`. `handleSpawnAgents` aggregates `creditsUsed` from fulfilled and failed subagent results into parent state. Scope: backend agent execution and cost tracking subsystems.

9757c03ed1ba4909a173c2faf0d12868e49a6ea3.title: Replace native confirm with custom ConfirmationDialog
9757c03ed1ba4909a173c2faf0d12868e49a6ea3.summary: Native `window.confirm` calls replaced with custom `ConfirmationDialog` component in API key management. This change addresses poor UI consistency and lack of styling control by implementing a reusable dialog component. Scope covers `web/src/components/ui/confirmation-dialog.tsx` (new) and `web/src/app/profile/components/api-keys-section.tsx`. The new component supports configurable title, description, confirm text, destructive variant, and processing state.

1df6ce209f2c5387d3e0fda01c81aa7c2dc296b8.title: Standardize session type handling in web profile
1df6ce209f2c5387d3e0fda01c81aa7c2dc296b8.summary: Refactored `web/src/app/api/user/sessions/route.ts` to filter PATs via DB query instead of runtime loop, and updated `sessionType` to return raw DB value. Modified `web/src/app/profile/components/security-section.tsx` to expect 'web'/'cli' types and memoized session filtering. Added `deleteSessions` helper and `Session` type definition.

83db70c36f9187592256af5cd7782e2b7d758c51.title: Adjust docs sidebar positioning and footer visibility logic
83db70c36f9187592256af5cd7782e2b7d758c51.summary: Docs sidebar fixed position threshold increased to 72px scroll and top offset adjusted to 16px in web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx. Profile sections (API keys, referrals, security) updated with rounded-lg and overflow-x-auto classes for better table display. Footer logic in web/src/components/footer.tsx now includes community links in public paths visibility check.

e3b921fb1f45cee450366c1857f317c4aa700367.text: Internal testing tools can now prepare projects before checking them. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

48bced48506177dfe8170f46a138fdc18811097c.text: A small internal fix stops occasional test failures when checking the auto-top-up feature. No user-facing behavior changed.

d6c91af4a750ea1fe31cd5be1b235db36ac9d682.text: The system now accurately tracks the total cost of all tasks performed by the assistant and its helpers. This ensures your usage credits are calculated correctly based on the full work done.

9757c03ed1ba4909a173c2faf0d12868e49a6ea3.text: Confirmation pop-ups for deleting API keys now use a custom design that matches the rest of the app. This change is internal and makes the interface look more consistent, with no change to how the feature works.

ccb934efb2f26f8c1f85e0baa24cc52d21294136.text: The internal testing tool now uses a saved login credential if a specific setting is missing. This change affects only the team's background checks and does not change how the product works for users.

68bf922740c07889ebec41c5baf8b20276eb4a45.text: The assistant now uses a new model to answer questions about code and the web. The research helper can no longer read local files, so it only searches online. These updates improve how the system organizes and answers requests.

02b675499b82ee25ee56883fba8f11c0e23317f6.text: The assistant switched to a faster, lighter version of its underlying model. This change is internal and may make responses quicker, but does not alter what the assistant can do.

83db70c36f9187592256af5cd7782e2b7d758c51.text: The documentation menu now stays in place more reliably as you scroll. Small tables in your account settings display better without cutting off content. Community links now appear in the footer on public pages.

e3b8150c100550555473d49f6bb6a2e8a284fa54.text: The system now checks that required tools are available before running tasks. If a problem occurs, it records clearer details for support teams. This internal improvement helps diagnose issues faster without changing how you use the product.

45903e821e643794b1b06143aad1e97636d8df00.title: Refactor base2 orchestration and editor output handling
45903e821e643794b1b06143aad1e97636d8df00.summary: Updated base2 agent prompts to enforce upfront information gathering, reducing redundant agent spawning. Modified editor agent to mandate `set_output` tool usage for final summaries, injecting `PLACEHOLDER.KNOWLEDGE_FILES_CONTENTS` into the system prompt. Logic now extracts structured `output` from agent state instead of parsing the last assistant message content. Changes confined to `.agents/base2/base2-factory.ts` and `.agents/base2/editor.ts`.

027e8428279173140bdc3e9fea47749a558c554a.title: Add API Keys section to profile and migrate redirects
027e8428279173140bdc3e9fea47749a558c554a.summary: Introduced a dedicated API Keys section in the profile navigation and moved Personal Access Token management there. Updated `next.config.mjs` to permanently redirect `/api-keys`, `/usage`, and `/referrals` to specific profile tabs. Refactored `web/src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts` to replace "Personal Access Token" terminology with "API Key" in logs and responses. New components like `api-keys-section.tsx` and `profile-section.tsx` handle the UI restructuring.

87c3cc7a100f195cf54de5f8299843acc86049d4.title: Editor agent prompt updated for task scope and endturn
87c3cc7a100f195cf54de5f8299843acc86049d4.summary: Updated `spawnerPrompt` in `.agents/base2/editor.ts` to explicitly define scope as 'small to medium sized tasks' or plan-driven complex work. Added mandatory `end_turn` invocation immediately after `set_output` to enforce clean session termination. Refined principles to emphasize following existing codebase patterns.

53c29980b8ba74855d7e0261996f51aebe900f7f.title: Server shutdown grace period 5 to 30 min
53c29980b8ba74855d7e0261996f51aebe900f7f.summary: backend/src/index.ts SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_MS constant 30 * 60 * 1000 replaces hard-coded 300000 timeout. handleShutdown async, awaits Promise before process.exit(1). SIGTERM/SIGINT backend only.

f67bfb8e16211d8aa1ff308ad50cf1d031a3c53d.title: setoutput and other tools no longer force next agent step
f67bfb8e16211d8aa1ff308ad50cf1d031a3c53d.summary: Added set_output, set_messages, add_message, add_subgoal, update_subgoal, and create_plan to TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP in common/src/tools/constants.ts. Prevents unnecessary agent loop iterations when these state-mutation tools are called. Internal logic change affecting agent step control.

0094be01347708db547e416e30d97909d0cfe9fd.title: Decouple CodebuffMessage from ModelMessage
0094be01347708db547e416e30d97909d0cfe9fd.summary: Added convertCbToModelMessages helper in common/src/util/messages.ts to map CodebuffMessage arrays to ModelMessage types. Applied this conversion in promptAiSdkStream, promptAiSdk, and promptAiSdkStructured within backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts. This isolates internal message structures from the Vercel AI SDK's expected types, currently acting as a passthrough.

630fab418b2ab2b8c5f5e30702ff71321f4bb30a.title: Docs and profile mobile layout fixes
630fab418b2ab2b8c5f5e30702ff71321f4bb30a.summary: Docs layout sidebar switches from fixed to scroll-aware positioning via useEffect tracking window.scrollY > 64. Profile section header stacks vertically on mobile with flex-col, and mobile nav becomes fixed bottom bar. CodeDemo components gain overflow-x-auto containers and padding adjustments; remark plugin defaults unspecified code blocks to 'text' language. Footer logic refactored to render only on publicPaths, replacing pathname.startsWith('/docs') check.

b359e568dff8dcb23b90b1488b191576da8825e7.title: Expose PublicAgentState and update Message type for multimodal content
b359e568dff8dcb23b90b1488b191576da8825e7.summary: Added `PublicAgentState` export and `getPublicAgentState` helper in `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts` to safely pass agent state to step generators. The `Message` interface in `agent-definition.ts` and `tools.ts` now supports multimodal content (text/image arrays) instead of just strings. `SetMessagesParams` and `StrReplaceParams` updated to reflect these type changes, with `allowMultiple` added to string replacement tools. This affects core agent types, backend execution, and tool parameter definitions.

2b90ca3ebfd5ac5e18391024c3a9728b1351185c.title: Drop custom CSRF checks in sessions route
2b90ca3ebfd5ac5e18391024c3a9728b1351185c.summary: Removed custom `isSameOrigin` validation from `web/src/app/api/sessions/route.ts`. Authentication now relies exclusively on `getServerSession(authOptions)` to align with the API keys route and reduce attack surface. The change affects only the DELETE `/api/sessions` handler.

5b71cc05c54a3e992f6280aca02f9af35af0b838.title: Add graceful shutdown for eval processes
5b71cc05c54a3e992f6280aca02f9af35af0b838.summary: Signal handlers for SIGINT and SIGTERM added to eval runners. Ctrl-C now triggers terminateAllEvalChildren to kill child processes. Covers run-eval-set.ts, run-git-evals.ts, and run-single-eval-process.ts. Windows uses taskkill /T, POSIX uses process.kill(-pid).

53c29980b8ba74855d7e0261996f51aebe900f7f.text: The server now waits up to 30 minutes to finish tasks before shutting down, instead of just 5 minutes. This gives ongoing work more time to complete during maintenance.

630fab418b2ab2b8c5f5e30702ff71321f4bb30a.text: The app now adjusts its layout for smaller screens, keeping menus and text readable without horizontal scrolling. Footer visibility is also cleaner on internal pages.

027e8428279173140bdc3e9fea47749a558c554a.text: API key management moved to a dedicated profile section. Old links now redirect automatically. The wording changed from Personal Access Token to API Key.

87c3cc7a100f195cf54de5f8299843acc86049d4.text: The editing assistant now follows clearer rules to handle tasks of the right size and finish its work cleanly. This helps it stay focused and avoid leaving tasks half-done.

2b90ca3ebfd5ac5e18391024c3a9728b1351185c.text: The app now uses a single, standard method to verify your identity when you remove a session. This internal security update simplifies the process and reduces potential risks without changing how you use the product.

b359e568dff8dcb23b90b1488b191576da8825e7.text: The assistant can now process and respond to images, not just text. This change is internal, so you might notice the assistant handling picture-based requests better.

f67bfb8e16211d8aa1ff308ad50cf1d031a3c53d.text: The assistant no longer pauses unnecessarily after updating its own notes or plans. This makes interactions feel slightly smoother and faster.

0094be01347708db547e416e30d97909d0cfe9fd.text: The assistant now uses a standard format to talk to its underlying AI models. This change keeps the system organized and makes it easier to update the AI in the future.

45903e821e643794b1b06143aad1e97636d8df00.text: The system now collects all necessary information before starting work and uses a standardized way to share final results. This reduces repeated steps and ensures you receive clear, reliable summaries.

0ff0cf5a75037625ba733bd9066d586fe6fd5364.title: Token counter allows all special tokens
0ff0cf5a75037625ba733bd9066d586fe6fd5364.summary: countTokens in backend/src/util/token-counter.ts now passes { allowedSpecial: 'all' } to encode. This prevents errors when text contains special tokens. Internal change to token counting logic.

0c809f7c46ee2979c87f1042e4cb3163c2493ba9.title: Fix session type migration logic in 0025milkylilacheney.sql
0c809f7c46ee2979c87f1042e4cb3163c2493ba9.summary: Corrects SQL logic in migration 0025_milky_lila_cheney.sql to properly identify CLI sessions. The WHERE clause now requires fingerprint_id IS NOT NULL instead of IS NULL, ensuring sessions with valid fingerprints and far-future expiration are marked as 'cli'. This fix applies to the common/src/db/migrations directory.

921a9dd7cedb6e3960e0634ccfed1392bfe65202.title: Switch terminal command detection to openai/gpt-4.1-nano
921a9dd7cedb6e3960e0634ccfed1392bfe65202.summary: Terminal command safety checks now use openai/gpt-4.1-nano instead of gpt-4o-mini. Cost tracking updated with new model rates ($0.1/$0.4 per M tokens). Model constant added to common/src/constants.ts.

c2bc8bb0d5595c79cbd8aba647ba40ede710ac4f.title: Add Claude Code runner to git evals
c2bc8bb0d5595c79cbd8aba647ba40ede710ac4f.summary: Git evals now support `--coding-agent claude` via new `ClaudeRunner` in `evals/git-evals/runners/claude.ts`. The runner uses `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` query API with bypass permissions. Eval commands and CI workflows updated to accept the new agent flag and renamed backend env vars.

ece4c4eeccde7d28b329a9b1e4cbf98bb03c4e01.title: Simplify base2 agent orchestration prompts
ece4c4eeccde7d28b329a9b1e4cbf98bb03c4e01.summary: Refactored `base2-factory.ts` system and instruction prompts to remove rigid step-by-step workflows. Replaced numbered phases with flexible conditional spawning logic for planner, editor, and reviewer. Removed explicit `stepPrompt` fallback in favor of autonomous iteration guidance. Covers internal agent definition configuration only.

b705b7fe7d3472c6a391bb2f2b385fa2d1268fce.title: Secure API keys, session hashing, CSRF, schema updates
b705b7fe7d3472c6a391bb2f2b385fa2d1268fce.summary: Hardened API key and session endpoints with same-origin CSRF enforcement and SHA-256 session ID hashing. Database schema updated via migration 0025 to simplify session types to 'web', 'pat', and 'cli' with automated backfill logic. New crypto utilities and confirmation dialogs added to the UI layer to support secure identity verification and session management.

eae7f3081d5c6ab32780795d8f4ef127ab28d74d.title: Unify session revocation via DELETE /api/sessions
eae7f3081d5c6ab32780795d8f4ef127ab28d74d.summary: Consolidated session and token revocation logic into a single `DELETE /api/sessions` endpoint, removing legacy per-id routes like `/api/api-keys/[id]` and `/api/user/sessions/[id]`. This refactor supports batch operations via `sessionIds` and `tokenIds` arrays while enforcing origin checks and distinguishing between web and PAT sessions. The security UI in `web/src/app/security/page.tsx` now uses tabs to separate web and CLI sessions, updating the client to use the new unified API.

5197a531b9409439ad93600a00e89158be331ae6.title: Refactor api-keys auth to NextAuth server session
5197a531b9409439ad93600a00e89158be331ae6.summary: Removed custom CSRF checks and Bearer token validation from `web/src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts`. GET and POST handlers now rely exclusively on `getServerSession` for authentication. This standardizes the auth flow and reduces attack surface by eliminating manual origin checks and direct session table queries.

62182905e81dde741de93c24aeb40f94a4fbe710.title: Streamline base2 prompting, add @AgentName routing, rename json output
62182905e81dde741de93c24aeb40f94a4fbe710.summary: Base2 agent prompts restructured with Principles/Guidance sections, toolNames reduced to spawn_agents/end_turn, and @AgentName mention routing added. Editor and planner spawner/instructions prompts simplified. Output mode 'json' renamed to 'structured_output' in AgentDefinition type. Covers .agents/base2/{base2-factory,editor,planner-factory}.ts and common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts. Editor spawnerPrompt now advertises file-edit and terminal tools; planner accepts general questions, not just coding tasks.

0c809f7c46ee2979c87f1042e4cb3163c2493ba9.text: Fixed a small internal error that incorrectly labeled certain background connections. This ensures the system recognizes these sessions properly, preventing potential confusion in how usage is tracked.

2cc0ca11dba0871a5942ca10a900f91d78806dfb.text: The assistant now uses a smarter planning method for difficult tasks. It can read more files and research information more effectively.

921a9dd7cedb6e3960e0634ccfed1392bfe65202.text: The assistant switched to a newer, cheaper model to check if commands are safe. This change helps lower costs without affecting how the product works for you.

0ff0cf5a75037625ba733bd9066d586fe6fd5364.text: The system can now count words in messages that use special symbols without crashing. This is a small internal fix to improve stability.

5197a531b9409439ad93600a00e89158be331ae6.text: The system now uses a single, standard method to check who you are. This makes the sign-in process more secure and consistent.

c2bc8bb0d5595c79cbd8aba647ba40ede710ac4f.text: Internal testing tools now support a new coding assistant. This change does not affect how you use the product.

62182905e81dde741de93c24aeb40f94a4fbe710.text: The assistant now routes tasks to specific experts when you name them, and it can handle general questions instead of just coding. Internal instructions were simplified to make responses clearer and more consistent.

b705b7fe7d3472c6a391bb2f2b385fa2d1268fce.text: The app now checks login details more securely to prevent unauthorized access. It also simplifies how different types of user sessions are stored and managed.

ece4c4eeccde7d28b329a9b1e4cbf98bb03c4e01.text: The internal instructions for the AI agents were simplified to allow more flexible decision-making instead of following rigid steps. This change is technical and does not affect how you use the product.

eae7f3081d5c6ab32780795d8f4ef127ab28d74d.text: The system now uses a single, simplified method to remove active logins and access keys. This change cleans up internal code and does not alter how you sign out or manage your devices.

bd85fa06b5d6adc6457dfcf033579f8d2e51d477.title: Fix stepsComplete propagation in loopAgentSteps
bd85fa06b5d6adc6457dfcf033579f8d2e51d477.summary: run-agent-step.ts now passes shouldEndTurn to stepsComplete in loopAgentSteps, fixing programmatic step execution after LLM finishes. backend/src/run-agent-step.ts updated. Test added in backend/src/__tests__/loop-agent-steps.test.ts. bunfig.toml excludes evals/test-repos/** from test execution.

901ca6899cbc872fa49a34441ff149cd456d88a8.title: Reviewer agent effort set to low
901ca6899cbc872fa49a34441ff149cd456d88a8.summary: The reviewer agent's reasoning effort changed from 'high' to 'low' in .agents/reviewer.ts. This adjustment likely aims to increase the speed of the review process. The change applies to the internal reviewer agent configuration.

05fa4aa455136cec4d95383868f095d8f9bd247e.title: Reduce backend log spam
05fa4aa455136cec4d95383868f095d8f9bd247e.summary: Removed verbose info/debug logs in request-files-prompt.ts, gemini-with-fallbacks.ts, run-programmatic-step.ts, and tool-executor.ts. Consolidated tool call/result logging in tool-executor.ts to single debug statements including input. Eliminates redundant per-step and per-tool-call log entries.

4afa6da12eb885834b4ce6a4b4a951da09253784.title: Feed error messages into agent message history
4afa6da12eb885834b4ce6a4b4a951da09253784.summary: Appends `errorMessage` to `state.agentState.messageHistory` in `runProgrammatic-step.ts`. Provides context for debugging by injecting errors directly into the agent's message flow.

b821dbafc27aa028944e94613927765c31d1e50c.title: Fix gpt-5-planner agent type and workflow
b821dbafc27aa028944e94613927765c31d1e50c.summary: Corrected `agent_type` in `planner-gpt-5-high.ts` from `gemini-thinker-high` to `thinker-gpt-5-high`. Updated orchestration workflow in `base2-factory.ts` to explicitly mandate spawning a planner for non-trivial changes. Added `displayName` to `base2-gpt-5-high.ts` definition. Internal fix for agent routing and planning logic.

1b4978feea857b27c5598daf0233612b35cfbaa7.title: Remove debug logs from backend tools
1b4978feea857b27c5598daf0233612b35cfbaa7.summary: Deleted `logger.debug` calls in `find-files.ts`, `read-files.ts`, and `set-output.ts`. Commented out token usage logging in `search-system-prompt.ts`. Reduces log spam during agent execution.

ce6025467273f41d5cddf171d9fd287dca57fcd1.title: Fix gpt-5-high planner spawn logic
ce6025467273f41d5cddf171d9fd287dca57fcd1.summary: Refactor `plannerFactory` to hardcode `gemini-thinker-high` spawnable agent, removing dynamic `thinkerAgent` param. `planner-gpt-5-high.ts` implements custom `handleSteps` generator, explicitly spawning `file-explorer`, reading paths, then delegating to `gemini-thinker-high`. `planner.ts` updated to match new factory signature. Internal `.agents/base2` subsystem only.

5c24bec1121904e88098db764a25ff597fb953e7.title: Add gpt-5-high agent suite and refactor planner factory
5c24bec1121904e88098db764a25ff597fb953e7.summary: Introduced new `gpt-5-high` agent definitions (`base2`, `planner`, `editor`, `reviewer`, `thinker`) using `openai/gpt-5` with high reasoning effort. Refactored the base2 planner into a reusable `plannerFactory` to support multiple model configurations while preserving existing `planner` behavior. Updated `spawn-agents.ts` to stream client output for `editor-gpt-5-high` alongside the standard editor.

f0605b5664fecfd89a9ec8d12a364fd983f7079b.title: Remove check-new-files-necessary pre-filter
f0605b5664fecfd89a9ec8d12a364fd983f7079b.summary: Deleted backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts and its invocation in backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts. The LLM-based gate that skipped file retrieval for follow-up or command-only prompts is gone. requestRelevantFiles now always proceeds to key file extraction. Scope limited to backend find-files module.

05fa4aa455136cec4d95383868f095d8f9bd247e.text: The system now records fewer unnecessary details in its internal notes. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

b821dbafc27aa028944e94613927765c31d1e50c.text: The assistant now correctly routes tasks to a specialized planning model. This improves how it organizes complex requests.

bd85fa06b5d6adc6457dfcf033579f8d2e51d477.text: Fixed an internal issue that sometimes stopped the assistant from finishing its tasks. This change is small and happens behind the scenes.

f0605b5664fecfd89a9ec8d12a364fd983f7079b.text: The assistant now always checks for relevant files when you ask a question. This removes a previous step that sometimes skipped file searches, ensuring it looks for information more consistently.

1df6ce209f2c5387d3e0fda01c81aa7c2dc296b8.text: The system now sorts login history more efficiently behind the scenes. This small update ensures your account security details load faster and stay accurate.

1b4978feea857b27c5598daf0233612b35cfbaa7.text: The assistant stopped writing extra notes to itself while it works. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product behaves.

ce6025467273f41d5cddf171d9fd287dca57fcd1.text: The assistant now uses a specific thinking model to find files and answer questions. This change affects only internal operations and does not change how you use the product.

4afa6da12eb885834b4ce6a4b4a951da09253784.text: The assistant can now see past error messages in its conversation memory. This helps it understand context better when troubleshooting issues.

901ca6899cbc872fa49a34441ff149cd456d88a8.text: The internal tool that checks work now uses less effort to review items. This change aims to make reviews faster.

5c24bec1121904e88098db764a25ff597fb953e7.text: The assistant can now use a more powerful reasoning model for tasks like planning and editing. This update improves the quality of its responses without changing how you interact with it.

aa1d37418a39f6e98eb01aee009c4b79062841dc.title: Add eslint-fix-imports hook and refine prettier command in
aa1d37418a39f6e98eb01aee009c4b79062841dc.summary: Added `eslint-fix-imports` hook to `codebuff.json` to run `npx eslint --fix --quiet` on changed TS/JS files. Updated `prettier-format` command to use `--list-different` for targeted writes and added `set -o pipefail`. Scope is limited to repository configuration in `codebuff.json`.

4a977e1da6526fee1fbec27c7adbf6b03a6a85c7.title: Add stepsComplete logging to programmatic step execution
4a977e1da6526fee1fbec27c7adbf6b03a6a85c7.summary: Added logger.info call in run-programmatic-step.ts to record stepsComplete value before template execution. Removed stray comment from run-agent-step.ts. Changes confined to backend step execution files. Logging includes structured metadata and formatted message string.

20174678342a313b374697d6b9fa2d706fefb35b.title: Add comment to run-agent-step.ts
20174678342a313b374697d6b9fa2d706fefb35b.summary: Added a placeholder comment in backend/src/run-agent-step.ts. This change was made to test the server deployment pipeline. Scope is limited to the backend agent execution step. No functional logic or interface definitions were altered.

aaa5ff99477225fbd40e8e6324ad3ab559396213.title: fix type error in GlitchText
aaa5ff99477225fbd40e8e6324ad3ab559396213.summary: Added explicit return in useEffect and reformatted animate prop in `web/src/components/ui/terminal/glitch-text.tsx`. Fixes type error by ensuring consistent return types in effect hook. Scope limited to Web UI component.

1369f2367c82b7d9d228b2bcf3651ce999e05db0.title: Add Creative Catalyst agent and CLI easter eggs
1369f2367c82b7d9d228b2bcf3651ce999e05db0.summary: Introduced Chloe the Creative Catalyst agent in .agents/creative-catalyst.ts and added CLI easter eggs for confetti, matrix rain, and typewriter effects in npm-app/src/cli.ts. New web component web/src/components/ui/terminal/glitch-text.tsx provides glitch text effects. Documented in CREATIVE_FEATURES_DEMO.md.

1e1c59120f7f451fea7d048e4687cfbb9c317c93.title: Add writeToClient stub to spawn agent tests
1e1c59120f7f451fea7d048e4687cfbb9c317c93.summary: Added writeToClient: () => {} to mock contexts in backend/src/__tests__/spawn-agents-permissions.test.ts. Fixes type errors for handleSpawnAgentInline. Internal test refactor.

572a6be6c629b26e453415738c14a1aed3798ef4.title: Inline agent inherits onReponseChunk
572a6be6c629b26e453415738c14a1aed3798ef4.summary: Inline agent execution now passes parent's writeToClient to child's onResponseChunk, removing no-op handler and expireMessages import. Handler signature updated to accept string | PrintModeEvent chunks. Scope: backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts, backend/src/tools/handlers/handler-function-type.ts, backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-inline.ts.

dd30e468c06834f763d571ea1e541e74bf2c4c16.title: Add stepsComplete signal to handleSteps generator protocol
dd30e468c06834f763d571ea1e541e74bf2c4c16.summary: The `handleSteps` generator protocol now receives a `stepsComplete` boolean in the yield return value, allowing agent loops to break cleanly when the step limit is reached. Previously, hitting `stepsRemaining <= 0` would inject a system message and end the turn, but the generator state remained active; now, `runProgrammaticStep` propagates this flag, and built-in agents like `base.ts` and `thinking-base.ts` check it to exit their `while(true)` loops. The `STEP_ALL` mode is also refactored from a special generator value to a separate `agentIdToStepAll` set, enabling `stepsComplete` to clear that state and resume normal stepping. Additionally, `StrReplaceParams` gains an optional `allowMultiple` flag for batch replacements.

c695f86e44302c6a1e0f2d23567241b6c845b879.title: Add Base Agent v2 orchestration suite
c695f86e44302c6a1e0f2d23567241b6c845b879.summary: Base Agent v2 introduced in .agents/base2/ to orchestrate coding tasks via specialized sub-agents. New planner, editor, and reviewer definitions replace monolithic logic with a structured workflow (plan -> edit -> review). Context pruner updated to aggressively trim history after inline spawns to save tokens. Includes new gemini-thinker-high agent for deep reasoning steps.

20174678342a313b374697d6b9fa2d706fefb35b.text: A small internal change was made to test the system's setup. This does not affect how the product works or what users can do.

5b71cc05c54a3e992f6280aca02f9af35af0b838.text: Stopping the evaluation process now closes all related background tasks cleanly, preventing leftover programs from running.

4a977e1da6526fee1fbec27c7adbf6b03a6a85c7.text: The system now records a small internal note when automated tasks finish. This helps support teams understand issues. You will not see any changes.

c695f86e44302c6a1e0f2d23567241b6c845b879.text: The assistant now splits complex tasks into planning, editing, and reviewing steps. This structured approach helps it handle work more carefully and efficiently.

aaa5ff99477225fbd40e8e6324ad3ab559396213.text: A small internal fix corrected a technical error in the text animation. Users will not notice any changes.

1369f2367c82b7d9d228b2bcf3651ce999e05db0.text: The product gained a new creative helper and playful visual effects like confetti and glitch text.

572a6be6c629b26e453415738c14a1aed3798ef4.text: The main assistant can now directly send updates to your screen when it uses a helper tool. This change is internal and improves how information flows, but you might not notice a difference.

dd30e468c06834f763d571ea1e541e74bf2c4c16.text: The assistant now stops more cleanly when it reaches its step limit, preventing it from getting stuck. This change is internal and improves how the assistant manages its tasks.

1e1c59120f7f451fea7d048e4687cfbb9c317c93.text: A small internal update fixes a technical error in the testing system. This change does not affect how you use the product.

aa1d37418a39f6e98eb01aee009c4b79062841dc.text: Small internal update. Improved how the system checks and formats code. No visible changes to the product.

ced6aa30219243e2304681e623d3134977354137.title: Fix unit tests
ced6aa30219243e2304681e623d3134977354137.summary: Updated assertions in `process-str-replace.test.ts` to match actual message array structure and formatting. Replaced loose string checks with strict length and index validation for multi-occurrence errors. Adjusted quote styles and line breaks to satisfy linter rules.

49132b99b0c133860cea38b62c4bafe6a0d676e3.title: process-str-replace allowMultiple match fix
49132b99b0c133860cea38b62c4bafe6a0d676e3.summary: process-str-replace.ts returns original oldStr when allowMultiple=true with count > 1, bypassing indentation-aware retry. Fixes unit test failures in process-str-replace.test.ts. Scope limited to backend string replacement utility.

f79f1b75132acd589995ecf7adf2a44901453491.title: Spawn agent params default to empty object
f79f1b75132acd589995ecf7adf2a44901453491.summary: Updated `validateAgentInput` in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts` to default `params` to an empty object `{}` before parsing. This fixes spawnable agent failures when no params are provided, ensuring schema validation handles undefined inputs gracefully. Scope limited to backend agent spawning utilities.

466c455d78fea41a66873789406f843560bbe4d4.title: SDK: handle prompt-error server action
466c455d78fea41a66873789406f843560bbe4d4.summary: Added `onPromptError` handler to `WebSocketHandlerOptions` and subscribed to `prompt-error` events in `websocket-client.ts`. `CodebuffClient` now routes `prompt-error` actions to `handlePromptResponse`, rejecting pending promises with combined error messages using `buildArray` from `@codebuff/common/util/array`. This ensures SDK consumers receive proper error feedback instead of hanging on failed prompts.

4c4b2ec64c3e14e1143e5372e719f7949e1d2abe.title: SDK 0.1.15 adds custom tool definitions and README examples
4c4b2ec64c3e14e1143e5372e719f7949e1d2abe.summary: Bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.15. Add customToolDefinitions parameter to CodebuffClient.run() for extending agent capabilities with Zod-validated tools. Update sdk/README.md with basic and advanced usage examples, including image handling and custom agent definitions.

bc04df62c7aaf1201e61e5588044f22eef564b2e.title: Log full template object in run-programmatic-step
bc04df62c7aaf1201e61e5588044f22eef564b2e.summary: Expanded logging in `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts` to include the entire `template` object alongside its ID. Changed log key from `template` to `templateId` for the ID, and added `template` for the full object. Internal change affecting backend observability.

498c89b1a43c97cbf97df366d5ee615e50383f1c.title: Fix unparsable token in OpenRouter type definitions
498c89b1a43c97cbf97df366d5ee615e50383f1c.summary: Corrected unparsable token in OpenRouter type definitions. Replaced invalid character in `logitBias` documentation example with `<|end-of-text|>`. Affects `openrouter-chat-settings.ts` and `openrouter-completion-settings.ts` in `packages/internal`. Removes trailing semicolons in type definitions.

65a8db449db3809e03ada37ec516914e545f762b.title: Fix context pruner message removal
65a8db449db3809e03ada37ec516914e545f762b.summary: Updated context pruner to remove exactly three messages (assistant tool call, input params, user instructions) instead of just the last assistant message. Removed expireMessages call for userPrompt in spawn-agent-inline handler. Prevents accidental deletion of user instructions prompt and leftover temporary messages.

00ed17e9cd503aaa66cc502fc402c3c502902968.title: strreplace allowMultiple flag blocks ambiguous edits
00ed17e9cd503aaa66cc502fc402c3c502902968.summary: Added `allowMultiple` boolean to `str_replace` tool params, defaulting to false. `processStrReplace` now counts `old` string occurrences; >1 without the flag returns an error requesting a more specific string. Updated tool definitions in `backend/src/tools/definitions/tool/str-replace.ts` and `common/src/tools/params/tool/str-replace.ts` to reflect the new schema and remove XML tag closing instructions.

2c0e585b275840a69052df127bce5defc5ebf18f.title: SDK v0.1.16 fixes getCustomToolDefinition typo and updates API
2c0e585b275840a69052df127bce5defc5ebf18f.summary: Renamed `getCustomToolDefinintion` to `getCustomToolDefinition` and exported corrected name from `sdk/src/index.ts`. `description` is now required in `CustomToolDefinition` type and function params; `endsAgentStep` default flipped to `true`. `sdk/README.md` updated to reflect new signature and import path. Breaking change for users relying on optional `description` or default `false` for `endsAgentStep`.

00ed17e9cd503aaa66cc502fc402c3c502902968.text: The assistant now stops if a requested text replacement could apply to multiple places. It asks for more specific instructions instead of guessing, preventing accidental errors.

bc04df62c7aaf1201e61e5588044f22eef564b2e.text: The system now saves more details about its internal tasks. This small change helps the team find and fix problems faster.

ced6aa30219243e2304681e623d3134977354137.text: Internal checks for this text tool were fixed to match how it actually works. This change does not affect what users see.

f79f1b75132acd589995ecf7adf2a44901453491.text: A small internal fix helps the assistant start new tasks correctly when no extra settings are given. Users will see fewer errors when trying to launch these tasks.

65a8db449db3809e03ada37ec516914e545f762b.text: The system now correctly keeps your instructions and temporary notes during certain tasks, instead of accidentally deleting them. This small internal fix ensures the assistant follows your directions more reliably.

49132b99b0c133860cea38b62c4bafe6a0d676e3.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system replaces text when multiple changes are requested. This ensures replacements happen exactly as expected without affecting the visible interface.

498c89b1a43c97cbf97df366d5ee615e50383f1c.text: Fixed a small internal error in text settings that could cause issues. No changes to how you use the product.

466c455d78fea41a66873789406f843560bbe4d4.text: The software now detects when a request fails and shows an error message instead of waiting forever. This means you get feedback right away if something goes wrong.

4c4b2ec64c3e14e1143e5372e719f7949e1d2abe.text: The assistant now lets you add custom tools to extend its capabilities. The guide also shows new examples for using images and creating custom agents.

2c0e585b275840a69052df127bce5defc5ebf18f.text: The custom tool feature received a spelling fix and now requires a description. The tool automatically stops the assistant's step by default.

7acf918dcddb0a623710ba35082eca31ca0ac68f.title: Default context-pruner params to empty object
7acf918dcddb0a623710ba35082eca31ca0ac68f.summary: Updates `.agents/factory/base.ts` to default `params` to `{}` when spawning `context-pruner` agents. Prevents potential `undefined` errors in downstream tool execution if `params` is not explicitly provided. Internal factory logic only; no user-facing behavior change.

abc2602ba7df9873f05f1b6ab88caf02f7af5a88.title: SDK 0.1.10
abc2602ba7df9873f05f1b6ab88caf02f7af5a88.summary: @codebuff/sdk bumped to 0.1.10. Routine version increment. Only sdk/package.json changed.

3842eba2a9c4cf5c59779d475c9d182b92d7fa08.title: Include tree-sitter query files in @codebuff/sdk 0.1.11
3842eba2a9c4cf5c59779d475c9d182b92d7fa08.summary: Updated `@codebuff/sdk` to version `0.1.11`. Added `../packages/code-map/src/tree-sitter-queries` to the `files` array in `sdk/package.json`. Ensures tree-sitter query assets are bundled in the published SDK package.

6106bf7416a58fc36e2e2180ebdb86dd9658540a.title: SDK 0.1.13 fixes code-map type import
6106bf7416a58fc36e2e2180ebdb86dd9658540a.summary: Bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.13. Rename packages/code-map/src/types.d.ts to types.ts and update imports in index.ts and languages.ts to resolve SDK build breakage from importing .d.ts files.

d9bdc235bfc28d405c9051f360e5889ff2c31402.title: Prefer spawnagents over spawnagentinline
d9bdc235bfc28d405c9051f360e5889ff2c31402.summary: Agent base prompts now explicitly mandate `spawn_agents` and forbid `spawn_agent_inline` unless specified. `spawn_agent-inline.ts` tool description adds guidance to reserve inline spawning for special cases. Scope limited to `.agents/prompts/base-prompts.ts` and `backend/src/tools/definitions/tool/spawn-agent-inline.ts`. Mechanism relies on prompt steering to reduce context bloat from inline message history preservation.

a914f537d153bc0c7967231c2e911515022a5daa.title: Add maxContextLength parameter to agent context pruning
a914f537d153bc0c7967231c2e911515022a5daa.summary: Introduced a `maxContextLength` parameter to the input schema for `context-pruner` and `base` agents. This allows dynamic configuration of the token limit, replacing the previous hardcoded 200,000 token threshold. The `base` agent factory now forwards this parameter to the `context-pruner` during inline spawning. This change affects internal agent definitions in `.agents/context-pruner.ts` and `.agents/factory/base.ts`.

c5c546abac213b43b02a44e6488a8116e04b26d6.title: SDK 0.1.12 adds build step to copy tree-sitter queries
c5c546abac213b43b02a44e6488a8116e04b26d6.summary: The SDK build script now includes a `copy-scm-files` step to ensure `.scm` query files and `readme.md` from `../packages/code-map/src/tree-sitter-queries` are present in the `dist` output. This fixes missing asset errors by explicitly copying these non-TypeScript files alongside the compiled code. The change is scoped to `sdk/package.json`, bumping the version to 0.1.12.

c59351ec41cab33bcb4535910d6be3bf3cd01f2a.title: Remove .ts extensions from code-map imports, bump SDK to 0.1.14
c59351ec41cab33bcb4535910d6be3bf3cd01f2a.summary: Removed `.ts` file extensions from relative imports in `packages/code-map/src/index.ts` and `packages/code-map/src/languages.ts` to align with standard module resolution. This change prevents potential build failures or resolution errors in environments that do not support explicit TypeScript extensions in import specifiers. The `@codebuff/sdk` package version was bumped to `0.1.14` to include these fixes.

ef9914ece072339229d796de949244cf5b381d2f.title: SDK initialSessionState populates fileTree, tokenScores, tokenCallers
ef9914ece072339229d796de949244cf5b381d2f.summary: SDK `initialSessionState` and `generateInitialRunState` now async, invoking `getFileTokenScores` to populate `fileTree`, `fileTokenScores`, and `tokenCallers` from `projectFiles` instead of leaving them empty. `parseTokens` accepts an optional `readFile` callback to source code from memory rather than disk, returning null-safe empty structures on failure. `languages.ts` adds a fallback `Language.load` path for WASM resolution errors. `@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm` and `web-tree-sitter` added as SDK dependencies.

552f74d95ca2a9be9a5be74d209437d5961b6fb7.title: Refactor spawn agent handlers with shared utils and tests
552f74d95ca2a9be9a5be74d209437d5961b6fb7.summary: Consolidates duplicated validation and execution logic from `spawn-agents.ts`, `spawn-agents-async.ts`, and `spawn-agent-inline.ts` into a new `spawn-agent-utils.ts` module. Functions like `validateSpawnState`, `validateAndGetAgentTemplate`, and `executeAgent` are extracted to reduce code redundancy and ensure consistent error handling across spawn modes. Adds `spawn-agents-permissions.test.ts` to cover permission checks. Scope limited to backend tool handlers.

c59351ec41cab33bcb4535910d6be3bf3cd01f2a.text: A small internal update fixed a problem that could stop the app from working on some computers.

d9bdc235bfc28d405c9051f360e5889ff2c31402.text: The assistant now avoids copying chat history when starting a new task. This keeps responses clearer and prevents the conversation from becoming cluttered.

6106bf7416a58fc36e2e2180ebdb86dd9658540a.text: A small internal fix repairs a broken connection in the software's background tools. This prevents errors when the assistant tries to access code maps.

7acf918dcddb0a623710ba35082eca31ca0ac68f.text: The system now automatically sets missing settings to a safe default value to prevent errors. This is a small internal fix and does not change how the product works for you.

a914f537d153bc0c7967231c2e911515022a5daa.text: The assistant can now adjust how much conversation history it remembers based on the situation. This replaces a fixed limit, allowing it to handle longer chats more flexibly.

ef9914ece072339229d796de949244cf5b381d2f.text: The assistant now loads your file list and code details at the start of each session. This means it can see your project's structure right away, without needing extra steps to find files.

c5c546abac213b43b02a44e6488a8116e04b26d6.text: The app now includes extra files needed for it to work correctly. This fixes errors where some features were missing.

552f74d95ca2a9be9a5be74d209437d5961b6fb7.text: Developers cleaned up the behind-the-scenes code that starts new assistant tasks. This internal housekeeping makes the system more reliable and consistent, though you will not notice any changes to the features you use.

3842eba2a9c4cf5c59779d475c9d182b92d7fa08.text: The software now includes extra instructions for reading code. This helps the assistant understand projects better.

abc2602ba7df9873f05f1b6ab88caf02f7af5a88.text: A small internal update keeps the background parts of the product working smoothly. You will not see any changes.

acc61e3c1e835d7b8cccecc9206b82610f86b195.title: Fix agent cache key mismatch in agent-registry
acc61e3c1e835d7b8cccecc9206b82610f86b195.summary: Agent template caching in `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts` now uses `dbAgent.id` as the cache key instead of the requested `agentId`. This ensures cache hits only occur when the stored agent ID matches the lookup key, preventing potential mismatches or stale data retrieval. The change applies to both Codebuff-parsed and standard published agent fetches.

b02e0dc13c89be729db385f032d7aa2c9716b15e.title: Filter system messages in spawn-agents history
b02e0dc13c89be729db385f032d7aa2c9716b15e.summary: System messages are now excluded from conversation history passed to spawned agents in both sync and async handlers. This prevents parent system prompts from leaking into child agent contexts. Updated in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts` and `spawn-agents-async.ts`.

32031c5c322d983799c40181e0f7450c1f34da31.title: Add updated evals
32031c5c322d983799c40181e0f7450c1f34da31.summary: Added updated evals (#242). Covers Web, CLI, and Desktop via FREEBUFF_MODELS plus README tables; 1.2 keeps its fast all-round row.

48dbd251d56a5b9e1a5a225d472fc1490cf7de66.title: Fix typecheck for dynamic-agent-template
48dbd251d56a5b9e1a5a225d472fc1490cf7de66.summary: Updated type definition in common/src/types/__tests__/dynamic-agent-template.test.ts to allow string literals alongside published tools. The toolNames type now includes (string & {}) union to resolve typecheck errors. This ensures compatibility with dynamic agent template definitions.

3010303cb12101d62bdce70ed5c34520780a74ad.title: Filter reasoning tokens when exclude flag set
3010303cb12101d62bdce70ed5c34520780a74ad.summary: Removed hardcoded `includeReasoning: true` from OpenRouter language model config. Added logic in `promptAiSdkStream` to skip `reasoning-delta` chunks if `options.providerOptions?.openrouter?.reasoning?.exclude` is true. Imported `OpenRouterProviderOptions` type in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. Ensures reasoning tokens are manually stripped when exclusion is requested.

584bcc4789235699a30cc12d7dc9fb116854e467.title: Add deep-thinking agent orchestration system
584bcc4789235699a30cc12d7dc9fb116854e467.summary: New multi-agent framework in `.agents/deep-thinking/` spawns parallel sub-agents (GPT-5, Sonnet, Gemini) to synthesize complex analysis. `deepest-thinker.ts` decomposes problems into four aspects, delegating to `deep-thinker.ts`, which coordinates three specialized thinkers to merge perspectives. The `agent-builder.ts` removes verbose step-by-step prompting, relying on atomic tool usage and default end_turn behavior. This structure enables recursive, multi-model reasoning for high-complexity tasks.

0d765207f7655da140fd151321189db7228110ab.title: Context Pruner Agent Added
0d765207f7655da140fd151321189db7228110ab.summary: New `context-pruner` agent added to `.agents/` to reduce token usage by pruning old tool results and messages before each step. Base agent updated to spawn this inline via `spawn_agent_inline` in `factory/base.ts`. CI workflows and root `package.json` updated to include `.agents` in test matrices. `tool-renderers.ts` modified to suppress UI output for `spawn_agent_inline`.

686e581799bbadecea340e54e102ca2837c812b5.title: Fix spawn-agent-inline version matching
686e581799bbadecea340e54e102ca2837c812b5.summary: Refactors spawn-agent-inline to use getMatchingSpawn for resolving agent types against parentAgentTemplate.spawnableAgents. Replaces direct string inclusion checks with version-aware matching logic. Ensures spawned agents correctly resolve to their specific template versions rather than failing on strict type equality. Updates backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-inline.ts.

19bd7164da35526b4cfcc1117edad79e4c2f54d1.title: SDK applies Zod schema to custom tool input
19bd7164da35526b4cfcc1117edad79e4c2f54d1.summary: SDK custom tool handlers now receive validated `Output` types instead of raw `Input`, enforced via `zodSchema.parse` in `sdk/src/client.ts`. `sdk/src/custom-tool.ts` updates `handler` signatures to match this transformation. `backend/src/tools/tool-executor.ts` ensures `endsAgentStepParam` is stripped from a cloned input object before parsing, preventing mutation issues.

1ada6a5e7e9e376dbc88aefefdd09eb4c1f13404.title: SDK adds custom tool support to agent prompt and stream parser
1ada6a5e7e9e376dbc88aefefdd09eb4c1f13404.summary: Custom tools defined in `fileContext.customToolDefinitions` are injected into agent prompts via `getToolsInstructions` and `getShortToolInstructions`, replacing strict `ToolName[]` types with `readonly string[]`. The stream parser registers `customToolCallback` for each custom tool, delegating execution to `executeCustomToolCall` in `tool-executor.ts`. `paramsSection` now accepts both Zod and raw JSON schemas, converting JSON to Zod via `convertJsonSchemaToZod` for validation. `add-message.ts` and `set-messages.ts` tool descriptions were re-indented.

48dbd251d56a5b9e1a5a225d472fc1490cf7de66.text: The system now correctly recognizes custom tools, preventing errors when using dynamic templates.

0d765207f7655da140fd151321189db7228110ab.text: The assistant now cleans up old conversation details before answering. This helps it stay fast and focused.

b02e0dc13c89be729db385f032d7aa2c9716b15e.text: The assistant now hides its private setup instructions from other assistants it creates during tasks. This small internal fix keeps conversations cleaner and prevents confusing mix-ups.

acc61e3c1e835d7b8cccecc9206b82610f86b195.text: A small internal update fixes how the system remembers saved assistant settings. This ensures you always see the correct version of your assistant, preventing it from showing old or mismatched information.

584bcc4789235699a30cc12d7dc9fb116854e467.text: The assistant now uses multiple internal models working together to analyze complex questions more thoroughly. This update improves answer quality for difficult tasks without changing how you use the product.

3010303cb12101d62bdce70ed5c34520780a74ad.text: The system now hides the assistant's private thinking notes when the setting is turned off. This keeps the reply clean and stops the assistant from showing its internal steps.

32031c5c322d983799c40181e0f7450c1f34da31.text: The team updated how they check the assistant's quality across web, mobile, and desktop apps. This internal test helps ensure the assistant stays reliable for everyday users.

19bd7164da35526b4cfcc1117edad79e4c2f54d1.text: The system now checks custom tool inputs before using them. This prevents errors and keeps the assistant stable.

686e581799bbadecea340e54e102ca2837c812b5.text: The system now correctly identifies and loads the right version of helper tools when starting new tasks. This prevents errors where the wrong tool version might be used.

f2a7d15f5ca801f2139496acfe7800dd7c51c926.title: CodebuffClient drops binary check
f2a7d15f5ca801f2139496acfe7800dd7c51c926.summary: CodebuffClient constructor removes execFileSync check for CODEBUFF_BINARY in PATH. Eliminates hard dependency on global codebuff installation for SDK initialization. Affects sdk/src/client.ts; binary resolution deferred.

7133b2f649a9e3311b571632646c6f2e3a93793b.title: Agent spawn matching uses parsed IDs
7133b2f649a9e3311b571632646c6f2e3a93793b.summary: Exported parseAgentId from backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts. Updated handleSpawnAgents in backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts to validate spawn permissions via getMatchingSpawn using parsed publisher, agent, and version IDs. Replaced strict string equality checks for spawnableAgents. Handles partial ID matching when version or publisher is omitted.

d09d4774246ba3f251b78c7f13a40a984753381e.title: Make reasoningOptions optional in AgentTemplate
d09d4774246ba3f251b78c7f13a40a984753381e.summary: Changed `reasoningOptions` to optional in `common/src/types/agent-template.ts`. Fixes typechecker errors where reasoning configuration was not strictly required.

f07e8f30470ae9041baebdcbe1ae3ccf7ce964cc.title: Docs: reasoningOptions agent field
f07e8f30470ae9041baebdcbe1ae3ccf7ce964cc.summary: Documents `reasoningOptions` for agent definitions in `agent-reference.mdx` and `customizing-agents.mdx`. Covers `enabled`, `exclude`, and `effort` fields using OpenRouter-style reasoning token budgets. Notes that unsupported models ignore these options. Adds usage examples for tuning reasoning effort.

4cb06d0fd7555769708e20cfe6d06e19b5b3c846.title: Extract agent ID parsing utils to shared common module
4cb06d0fd7555769708e20cfe6d06e19b5b3c846.summary: Moved `parseAgentId` from `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts` to new `common/src/util/agent-id-parsing.ts`. Added `parsePublishedAgentId` for strict publisher/agent validation and updated `spawn-agents.ts` to handle optional fields. Refactors backend to rely on shared utilities for consistent agent ID parsing.

b132de6aa8ab904338a5cc3479ec30d9dd1e1e9b.title: Add reasoningOptions to agent templates
b132de6aa8ab904338a5cc3479ec30d9dd1e1e9b.summary: Introduced `reasoningOptions` in `AgentDefinition` and `DynamicAgentDefinitionSchema` to control OpenRouter reasoning tokens via `max_tokens` or `effort`. Backend `prompt-agent-stream.ts` maps these options to `providerOptions.openrouter.reasoning`, replacing hardcoded Gemini thinking configs. Scope covers core types, backend stream logic, and template definitions.

47b52b66e011bdec337bd279e9beb35d33ff0e83.title: Export getMatchingSpawn for spawn-agents unit tests
47b52b66e011bdec337bd279e9beb35d33ff0e83.summary: Exported getMatchingSpawn in backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts. Change enables direct unit testing of agent matching logic without invoking full tool handler. Covers backend spawn-agents subsystem. New test file backend/src/__tests__/spawn-agents-permissions.test.ts added.

582891870f26b9fc499527a009946fea0134a78c.title: Docs sidebar uses fixed positioning
582891870f26b9fc499527a009946fea0134a78c.summary: web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx wraps DocSidebar in a container div and switches className from sticky top-[24px] to fixed top-24. Height calculation adjusts to calc(100vh-12rem) with z-40 to maintain proper alignment and symmetric spacing during scroll. Change affects only the Web docs surface.

8ebf7637f295f2dc14d8bb2d9b10b1e847410674.title: SDK v0.1.9
8ebf7637f295f2dc14d8bb2d9b10b1e847410674.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk version to 0.1.9. Internal release increment. No functional changes.

91a9d936f55f85cdf8d5ee357fae8a78b9baa364.title: Docs sidebar gradient fades and custom scrollbar
91a9d936f55f85cdf8d5ee357fae8a78b9baa364.summary: Added dynamic top/bottom gradient fades and custom scrollbar styles to the docs sidebar. Implemented scroll detection via `useRef` and `useEffect` in `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx`. Updated `web/src/styles/globals.css` with `.custom-scrollbar` rules for Webkit and Firefox.

f2a7d15f5ca801f2139496acfe7800dd7c51c926.text: The assistant can now start working even if a required tool is missing from your computer. It will find or load the tool later when you actually use it.

d09d4774246ba3f251b78c7f13a40a984753381e.text: The assistant's settings now allow reasoning options to be left blank without causing errors. This internal fix ensures smoother operation when configuring the assistant.

582891870f26b9fc499527a009946fea0134a78c.text: The documentation menu now stays pinned to the side of your screen as you scroll through long pages. This small visual update makes it easier to navigate the site without the menu disappearing.

47b52b66e011bdec337bd279e9beb35d33ff0e83.text: The team made a small internal change to how the software checks which helpers to use. You will not notice any difference.

7133b2f649a9e3311b571632646c6f2e3a93793b.text: The system now checks agent permissions more flexibly, allowing partial matches when identifying agents. This means users can launch agents without needing to specify every detail, making the process smoother and less error-prone.

8ebf7637f295f2dc14d8bb2d9b10b1e847410674.text: A small update to the tool that helps the app work. It does not change how the app looks or acts for you.

4cb06d0fd7555769708e20cfe6d06e19b5b3c846.text: The system now uses one shared rule for reading agent names. This keeps agent settings consistent across different parts of the app.

b132de6aa8ab904338a5cc3479ec30d9dd1e1e9b.text: The assistant now has a new setting to control how much thinking effort it uses before answering. This allows it to either spend more time reasoning for complex tasks or answer faster for simple ones.

f07e8f30470ae9041baebdcbe1ae3ccf7ce964cc.text: The guide now explains how to set thinking levels for the assistant, letting it spend more or less effort on a task. This helps control how deep the assistant thinks, though some models ignore these settings.

a2265d31bda94aa882d816dd4560a3c13a165405.title: Revert agent-validation.ts to POST method
a2265d31bda94aa882d816dd4560a3c13a165405.summary: Reverts `npm-app/src/utils/agent-validation.ts` to use `POST` for `/api/agents/validate`. The previous change to `GET` conflicted with the endpoint's expectation of a JSON body containing `agentDefinitions`. Scope limited to the validation utility in the npm-app package.

9050e5a178333d1a3b2a39a9d675223c90981c31.title: Fix SDK maxAgentSteps reset
9050e5a178333d1a3b2a39a9d675223c90981c31.summary: SDK `CodebuffClient` now explicitly sets `sessionState.mainAgentState.stepsRemaining` to the resolved `maxAgentSteps` value, preventing the agent step counter from resetting every run. Introduced `DEFAULT_MAX_AGENT_STEPS` constant in `common/src/json-config/constants.ts` to replace the hardcoded default in `CodebuffConfigSchema`. Applied to `sdk/src/client.ts` and `common/src/json-config/constants.ts`.

c3980e0c4d91cd62081f361d57730807f994ee25.title: Clarify context-manager vs specialty agents
c3980e0c4d91cd62081f361d57730807f994ee25.summary: Documentation in `web/src/content/agents/customizing-agents.mdx` clarifies the distinction between context-manager agents and specialty reviewer agents. Adds a comparison table, a design checklist for shaping agents around task breakdown and context control, and usage tips for spawning reviewers.

756f7f0d55ed5907cba2f201026efc2d4a9d84c0.title: AgentTemplateSchemaDisplay truncates long JSON schemas in docs
756f7f0d55ed5907cba2f201026efc2d4a9d84c0.summary: AgentTemplateSchemaDisplay now truncates JSON output exceeding 25 lines, rendering a collapsible UI with expand/collapse controls. Implements useState and Collapsible components to manage view state, replacing static CodeDemo rendering for long schemas. Affects web/src/components/docs/mdx/schema-display.tsx. Truncation adds '// ... truncated' comment and preserves full content on expansion.

d0101564a997051fe25cbc8600a5359912f8e58e.title: Agent docs cleanup and formatting fixes
d0101564a997051fe25cbc8600a5359912f8e58e.summary: Refined agent documentation across web/src/content/agents/*. Finalized content in agent-reference.mdx by adding <MarkdownTable> wrappers for yield values and fixing spacing in code blocks. Removed obsolete or duplicate sections in creating-new-agents.mdx and customizing-agents.mdx, specifically deleting a large MarkdownTable and checklist from the latter to consolidate guidance on context window management.

a7967b63be343ae69f6464c2f5c27f038ef97a16.title: SDK auto-parses knowledgeFiles from projectFiles
a7967b63be343ae69f6464c2f5c27f038ef97a16.summary: The SDK `initialSessionState` function now automatically populates `knowledgeFiles` by filtering `projectFiles` for paths ending in `knowledge.md` or `claude.md` if `knowledgeFiles` is undefined. This change simplifies initialization by removing the need to manually extract these specific files. The behavior is scoped to `sdk/src/run-state.ts` and documented in `sdk/CHANGELOG.md`. Note that existing explicit `knowledgeFiles` inputs remain unaffected, ensuring backward compatibility.

03d3b0b2a559d13fa06550416fde331e5ea7e242.title: Set TypeScript target to ES2022 across packages
03d3b0b2a559d13fa06550416fde331e5ea7e242.summary: Updated tsconfig target to ES2022 in base and specific package configs. This change resolves a contentlayer warning. Affected files include tsconfig.base.json, packages/bigquery/tsconfig.json, packages/billing/tsconfig.json, packages/code-map/tsconfig.json, and packages/internal/tsconfig.json.

4880892de0b267bd0f50271e280591f09984c903.title: agent-validation.ts switch fetch to GET
4880892de0b267bd0f50271e280591f09984c903.summary: Changed HTTP method from POST to GET in `validateAgentDefinitionsIfAuthenticated`. The request still sends `JSON.stringify({ agentDefinitions })` in the `body`. Affects `npm-app/src/utils/agent-validation.ts`. Sending a body with GET is non-standard and may be stripped by some HTTP clients or proxies.

448c29417a9d25d287d1e27c28247c7e33e9b8a0.title: Docs sync and smooth hash navigation
448c29417a9d25d287d1e27c28247c7e33e9b8a0.summary: Docs content synchronized for Codebuff vs Claude Code comparison and agent guides. Web docs layout and heading components implement smooth scrolling for hash targets via `hashchange` listeners and `history.pushState`. Updates affect `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx`, `web/src/components/docs/copy-heading.tsx`, and related MDX files.

be3205147ce0ee22439c930c3d0f9c5de54f691e.title: SWE-Bench evals skipped
be3205147ce0ee22439c930c3d0f9c5de54f691e.summary: SWE-Bench evals disabled via `describe.skip` in `evals/swe-bench.test.ts`. Prevents accidental execution of heavy benchmark tests during local runs. Scope limited to Evals subsystem.

d0101564a997051fe25cbc8600a5359912f8e58e.text: Help guides were cleaned up to remove duplicate advice and fix formatting issues. This makes the instructions easier to read and follow.

9050e5a178333d1a3b2a39a9d675223c90981c31.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant's step counter reset incorrectly. This ensures the assistant uses the correct number of steps as configured, preventing unexpected behavior during tasks.

a2265d31bda94aa882d816dd4560a3c13a165405.text: Fixed a mistake that broke the assistant's ability to check new settings. The app now works as expected.

448c29417a9d25d287d1e27c28247c7e33e9b8a0.text: Documentation content updated. Clicking links now scrolls smoothly to sections.

a7967b63be343ae69f6464c2f5c27f038ef97a16.text: The assistant automatically finds and uses your knowledge files, so you no longer need to set them up manually. This saves you time and reduces the chance of errors.

03d3b0b2a559d13fa06550416fde331e5ea7e242.text: We updated the system to use a newer standard for its internal tools. This small, behind-the-scenes change fixes a technical warning without affecting how you use the product.

be3205147ce0ee22439c930c3d0f9c5de54f691e.text: The system now automatically stops running certain heavy background tests during normal use. This change is internal and does not affect how you experience the product.

4880892de0b267bd0f50271e280591f09984c903.text: A small internal change adjusted how the system checks agent settings. This change does not affect how you use the product.

756f7f0d55ed5907cba2f201026efc2d4a9d84c0.text: Long technical lists in the help pages now shrink into a small box with a button to see the full details. This keeps the pages tidy and makes them easier to read.

c3980e0c4d91cd62081f361d57730807f994ee25.text: The guide now clearly explains how to choose between different types of helpers. This helps users set up tasks more effectively by matching the right helper to the job.

a892fb6c7929c2032d066c164c2fa4164bb162ed.title: Adjust web TS target to ES2022
a892fb6c7929c2032d066c164c2fa4164bb162ed.summary: Scoped web app TypeScript target to ES2022 while restoring base tsconfig to ES2023 for cross-package consistency. Removed explanatory comments and disabled options from tsconfig.base.json. Updated web/tsconfig.json target from es6 to ES2022.

a3dd658db8918e671462b308acebea0fa7ad771d.title: Fork OpenRouter AI SDK into internal package
a3dd658db8918e671462b308acebea0fa7ad771d.summary: Replaced @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider dependency with local @codebuff/internal/openrouter-ai-sdk fork. Implements custom chat/completion handlers, message converters, and schema validation in packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk. Backend imports updated in openrouter.ts to use internal provider. Re-enabled cost override logic in ai-sdk.ts for OpenRouter usage accounting.

647453e06d65bb13a105495c642cfbe337e6ed40.title: Fix typechecks in openrouter-ai-sdk types
647453e06d65bb13a105495c642cfbe337e6ed40.summary: Import path for ReasoningDetailUnion in packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk/types/openrouter-chat-completions-input.ts switched from alias @/src/schemas/reasoning-details to relative ../schemas/reasoning-details. Semicolons removed across all type definitions. Resolves typecheck failures in the internal openrouter-ai-sdk package. No runtime behavior change.

f4ad445c3bf782b024d0def158181c0ac492f1fa.title: agents-typecheck script routes through .agents typecheck
f4ad445c3bf782b024d0def158181c0ac492f1fa.summary: The `agents-typecheck` command in `codebuff.json` now invokes `bun run typecheck` with `cwd` set to `.agents`, replacing the direct `bun x tsc --noEmit -p .agents/tsconfig.json` call. This change aligns the agent type-checking script with the local `package.json` configuration in the `.agents` directory, ensuring consistent tooling and dependency resolution. The modification is scoped to `codebuff.json` and does not affect user-facing CLI or Web surfaces.

4a6592fd618e1061f9a2c285c0de8d725af04ab0.title: Migrate tool call types to common package
4a6592fd618e1061f9a2c285c0de8d725af04ab0.summary: Moved `CodebuffToolCall` and `ClientToolCall` definitions from `backend/src/tools/constants.ts` to `@codebuff/common/tools/list`. Deleted `loopMainPrompt` and removed `ClientToolCall` return type from `mainPrompt`. Updated imports across handler files to use the shared type definitions.

74d8596771e6c2b379adfa53f09a02eed0efbc27.title: Add .agents workspace to monorepo
74d8596771e6c2b379adfa53f09a02eed0efbc27.summary: Added `.agents` to the `workspaces` array in `package.json`. This enables local agents development and isolated typechecking within the monorepo. Scope is limited to root package configuration.

7d1f2e244237cc544b5e843e338dc7dfe1104e66.title: Add local package.json for isolated agents workspace
7d1f2e244237cc544b5e843e338dc7dfe1104e66.summary: Introduced `.agents/package.json` to define the `@codebuff/agents` package, establishing an isolated workspace for agent-related code. This change excludes the root `tsconfig.base.json`, allowing independent configuration and typechecking via a local `bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` script. The new file sets the module type to ESM and marks the package as private, ensuring it remains internal to the repository structure.

cd9cd6a6b5319406034db4db7032e58ccb439a1a.title: Update agent docs to reflect TypeScript definitions and new fields
cd9cd6a6b5319406034db4db7032e58ccb439a1a.summary: Agent documentation updated to reflect migration from JSON templates to TypeScript files in `.agents/`. Core schema docs now include `spawnerPrompt` and `outputSchema`, with `includeMessageHistory` defaulting to `false`. Examples demonstrate programmatic control via `handleSteps` generator functions and fully qualified `spawnableAgents` IDs.

755448ffd8131e6c0c7892583473715014d94fc7.title: Update GPT-5 base prompts
755448ffd8131e6c0c7892583473715014d94fc7.summary: Revised GPT-5 conditional prompt strings in `.agents/prompts/base-prompts.ts`. Replaced specific 'chain tools' instructions with broader 'Proactive Execution' and 'comprehensive tool usage' directives. Adjusted `end_turn` semantics to emphasize feedback signaling over termination.

4a6592fd618e1061f9a2c285c0de8d725af04ab0.text: Internal code cleanup. No changes to how you use the product.

7d1f2e244237cc544b5e843e338dc7dfe1104e66.text: The system now keeps its internal helpers in a separate space. This change does not affect how you use the product.

755448ffd8131e6c0c7892583473715014d94fc7.text: The assistant now uses a new set of instructions to decide when to act and when to stop. This helps it be more proactive and better at knowing when to give you feedback instead of just ending the conversation.

647453e06d65bb13a105495c642cfbe337e6ed40.text: We fixed a small internal error that stopped the system from checking its own rules. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for you.

a3dd658db8918e671462b308acebea0fa7ad771d.text: The service switched to its own copy of the AI connection tool. This lets it track usage costs more accurately. Users will not see any immediate changes.

a892fb6c7929c2032d066c164c2fa4164bb162ed.text: A small internal update adjusts how the app processes instructions to match modern standards. You will not notice any changes to the product.

f4ad445c3bf782b024d0def158181c0ac492f1fa.text: The team updated an internal tool that checks code for mistakes. This change does not affect how you use the product.

cd9cd6a6b5319406034db4db7032e58ccb439a1a.text: Internal instructions for the assistant were updated to match new technical standards. This change is small and does not affect how the product works for users.

74d8596771e6c2b379adfa53f09a02eed0efbc27.text: This small internal update helps the team build better features faster. You won't notice any immediate changes to the app.

1ada6a5e7e9e376dbc88aefefdd09eb4c1f13404.text: The assistant can now use custom tools you define. It understands new actions and processes results automatically.

13b1f3ae04f848402bdbd5f455cb205acebcdeaa.title: Fix types in agent registry test
13b1f3ae04f848402bdbd5f455cb205acebcdeaa.summary: Updated return object in `agent-registry.test.ts` to include `dynamicTemplates`. Aligns test mock with expected type structure.

fe9143b324e5fad508bd34f3ffe90b460f2f1f17.title: Switch reviewer agent model to qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507
fe9143b324e5fad508bd34f3ffe90b460f2f1f17.summary: Internal reviewer agent configuration updated in .agents/reviewer.ts. Model identifier changed from openai/gpt-oss-120b:nitro to qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507:nitro. This affects the code review automation logic only.

b42476c552d0ea10ff3bb036699a3ae64df01929.title: Reviewer runs file change hooks before critique
b42476c552d0ea10ff3bb036699a3ae64df01929.summary: Reviewer instructionsPrompt reordered in .agents/factory/reviewer.ts. run_file_change_hooks execution moved to step 1, preceding code critique. Ensures hook results inform feedback rather than trailing analysis.

0ed7999b5a74286322fb3a42554d848752671a0a.title: Clarify endturn intent for GPT-5
0ed7999b5a74286322fb3a42554d848752671a0a.summary: Updated `end_turn` tool description and `base-prompts.ts` to discourage premature turn ending for GPT-5. GPT-5 guidance now encourages longer single-turn execution and chaining tools. `end_turn` description explicitly forbids using it as a mid-work stop token or to 'check in'.

53531399f18cd7b498f3d385fb42a4380d6c9f6a.title: Remove Placeholders from agent definitions
53531399f18cd7b498f3d385fb42a4380d6c9f6a.summary: Deleted PLACEHOLDER constants and types from agent-definition.ts. Updated tool call docs to use input instead of args. Made WebSearchParams.depth optional in tools.ts.

ebb53ada6c7b34aa51da776c3c6eae118664469e.title: Update validate-agent-name.test.ts
ebb53ada6c7b34aa51da776c3c6eae118664469e.summary: Test mocks for validateAgentNameHandler now include x-codebuff-api-key headers by default. Added coverage for 403 API key required errors on missing headers. Scope limited to backend/src/api/__tests__/validate-agent-name.test.ts. Ensures handler auth checks remain verified in test suite.

978879f488e5800a3e67f1c2a141380b6286e4c7.title: Add closeConnection method to CodebuffClient
978879f488e5800a3e67f1c2a141380b6286e4c7.summary: CodebuffClient gains `closeConnection` method. Invokes `websocketHandler.close` to terminate connections. Scope: `sdk/src/client.ts`, `sdk/README.md`, `sdk/CHANGELOG.md`. Bumped version 0.1.9.

d700210b1282dc119a2469349100b7cfb26cd0ae.title: Update reviewer agent model to gpt-oss-120b:nitro
d700210b1282dc119a2469349100b7cfb26cd0ae.summary: The reviewer agent definition in .agents/reviewer.ts now uses openai/gpt-oss-120b:nitro instead of openai/gpt-5. This internal change updates the model string passed to the reviewer helper function. The scope is limited to the agent configuration file.

31bb570f2bd80ee28e9abeee1294558c53859c18.title: Fix agent publishing with undefined system prompts
31bb570f2bd80ee28e9abeee1294558c53859c18.summary: Agent publishing now handles undefined system prompts by defaulting them to empty strings in `validateSingleAgent`. The `validateAgents` function returns `dynamicTemplates` to preserve validated configs. Publish requests use loose `z.record` schemas, with strict validation moved to `validateAgents` in the web API route. CLI matching logic simplified to ignore template keys.

fe9143b324e5fad508bd34f3ffe90b460f2f1f17.text: The system that checks software updates now uses a different thinking tool. This change only affects internal processes and does not change how the product works for you.

ebb53ada6c7b34aa51da776c3c6eae118664469e.text: The system now checks for a security key when verifying agent names. This update keeps internal tests accurate.

0ed7999b5a74286322fb3a42554d848752671a0a.text: The assistant now avoids stopping work too early to ask if you are still there. It continues using tools and finishing tasks in one go for smoother results.

91a9d936f55f85cdf8d5ee357fae8a78b9baa364.text: The documentation menu now shows soft shadows at the top and bottom to hint at more content, and the side scroll bar looks cleaner. This is a small visual update to make the menu easier to read.

978879f488e5800a3e67f1c2a141380b6286e4c7.text: The app can now close its network connection when finished. This frees up resources and ensures a clean shutdown.

d700210b1282dc119a2469349100b7cfb26cd0ae.text: The internal tool that checks work now uses a different, updated thinking engine. This small change improves how it reviews tasks behind the scenes.

b42476c552d0ea10ff3bb036699a3ae64df01929.text: A small internal change moves checks for file updates to happen before the assistant reviews your work. This helps the assistant give feedback based on the latest changes.
