53531399f18cd7b498f3d385fb42a4380d6c9f6a.text: The system cleaned up internal setup files and adjusted how it handles search depth. Users will not notice any visible changes in how the product works.

13b1f3ae04f848402bdbd5f455cb205acebcdeaa.text: A small internal fix updated a test to match current data structures. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

8b09d700502c1b692bcdeafd046bba97f0757bb0.title: Fix undefined projectRoot in npm-app logger init
8b09d700502c1b692bcdeafd046bba97f0757bb0.summary: npm-app logger initialization now derives project root via getProjectRoot() with process.cwd() fallback. Prevents TypeError when projectRoot is undefined. Affects npm-app/src/utils/logger.ts. Log path resolution wraps getCurrentChatDir() in try-catch, falling back to debug/npm-app.log on error.

bdf1081a9f5ff13601e2fcf313c96dcd27a3f8ca.title: npm-app suppress loaded agents display when agent target set
bdf1081a9f5ff13601e2fcf313c96dcd27a3f8ca.summary: npm-app/src/index.ts now conditionally calls displayLoadedAgents only when no specific agent is provided via the agent parameter. This change reduces startup noise in automated flows and stabilizes test output by hiding the agents banner when a target agent is explicitly specified. The import order for createAuthHeaders and initAnalytics was also normalized. Scope limited to npm-app CLI startup behavior.

ae5c76de5c0de3d28d2886fb3804774c815fcaf7.title: Fix ENOENT in tool generator and make WebSearchParams.depth optional
ae5c76de5c0de3d28d2886fb3804774c815fcaf7.summary: scripts/generate-tool-definitions.ts now creates the output directory via mkdirSync before writing, preventing ENOENT errors when the templates path is missing. Output redirects from common/src/util/types/tools.d.ts to common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/tools.ts. WebSearchParams.depth in tools.ts becomes optional (depth?: 'standard' | 'deep'). Scope covers Shared/Core types and Tooling scripts.

7cea76074a4473b16074489b3b80deaa070cc84e.title: getFilesAbsolutePath gains silent option
7cea76074a4473b16074489b3b80deaa070cc84e.summary: getFilesAbsolutePath accepts options.silent to suppress error logs on read failures. loadShellConfigFiles passes silent: true when reading shell config files. Covers npm-app/src/project-files.ts. Errors still set result[filePath] to null.

9a56b300d710e61c802980a1a15ed12203c275c2.title: Remove dev active handles log
9a56b300d710e61c802980a1a15ed12203c275c2.summary: Deleted conditional logger.info call in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` that printed `_getActiveHandles` during graceful shutdown when `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` was 'dev'. This cleanup removes unnecessary debug output from the CLI exit path.

dc4ed3ac98a63e8da6104544e6ce162a7060f41c.title: Stabilize researcher readdocs tests via mock verification
dc4ed3ac98a63e8da6104544e6ce162a7060f41c.summary: Refactor `backend/src/__tests__/read-docs-tool.test.ts` to stabilize researcher agent tests. Added mock tracking for `analytics`, `websocketAction`, and `liveUserInputs` to prevent hangs and ensure proper cleanup. New tests verify mock implementations and async generator completion. Replaced functional `read_docs` scenarios with infrastructure validation to isolate test flakiness.

60c5963bcfeb53629c083a3d27b096801d61dc4e.title: Unify CLI and backend auth via x-codebuff-api-key header
60c5963bcfeb53629c083a3d27b096801d61dc4e.summary: Replaced Bearer token and X-API-Key header logic with a unified x-codebuff-api-key header across CLI and backend. Added `extractAuthTokenFromHeader` in `backend/src/util/auth-helpers.ts` and `createAuthHeaders`/`addAuthHeader` in `npm-app/src/utils/auth-headers.ts` to standardize token extraction and injection. Updated `backend/src/api/agents.ts`, `backend/src/api/org.ts`, `backend/src/util/check-auth.ts`, `npm-app/src/client.ts`, and `npm-app/src/index.ts` to use the new helpers, removing manual header parsing and debug logging. This change ensures consistent authentication handling and simplifies credential management for agent validation and org checks.

8e8d6485f4f9bcd307bba2cf037fdea1ab14a6d4.title: Enforce API key for agent validation and propagate displayName
8e8d6485f4f9bcd307bba2cf037fdea1ab14a6d4.summary: Backend `validateAgentNameHandler` now returns 403 if `x-codebuff-api-key` is missing, enforcing authentication for agent validation. The handler propagates `displayName` from built-in personas and published agents in the validation result. CLI startup logic removed immediate agent display to avoid race conditions, deferring to `validateAgent` in `index.ts` which now logs the resolved `displayName` immediately upon successful validation. Files: `backend/src/api/agents.ts`, `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

ff19ac180a2da63800d5f9e67d4ae9f057d6b474.title: Replace :fast tag with :nitro in open-source model definitions
ff19ac180a2da63800d5f9e67d4ae9f057d6b474.summary: Open-source agent definitions and `ModelName` types now use the `:nitro` suffix instead of `:fast`. This applies to Qwen, DeepSeek, Moonshot, and Z-ai models across `.agents/opensource/` and `common/src/templates/`. The change ensures consistency with upstream model naming conventions.

97ee03b06fb332b51bbda94fa43c7d8066ef8f42.title: Add agent validation system with remote API endpoint
97ee03b06fb332b51bbda94fa43c7d8066ef8f42.summary: Added GET /api/agents/validate-name endpoint to backend to validate agent IDs against built-in personas and published database templates. Implemented short-lived caching (5 minutes) for positive validation results to reduce database load. The npm-app CLI now invokes this endpoint during startup to validate agent names when local definitions are absent, using user credentials for authenticated requests.

ff19ac180a2da63800d5f9e67d4ae9f057d6b474.text: The assistant now uses updated naming conventions for certain free models to match how they are labeled by their creators. This internal cleanup does not change how the assistant works or what it can do for you.

ae5c76de5c0de3d28d2886fb3804774c815fcaf7.text: The tool now creates missing folders before saving, preventing errors. Search options are simpler.

8b09d700502c1b692bcdeafd046bba97f0757bb0.text: Fixed a rare error that could stop the app from saving its activity records. If the app could not find its usual storage folder, it now saves these records to a backup location instead of failing.

bdf1081a9f5ff13601e2fcf313c96dcd27a3f8ca.text: The app now hides the list of available helpers when you pick one directly. This makes the startup screen cleaner and less noisy.

9a56b300d710e61c802980a1a15ed12203c275c2.text: The program stopped printing a hidden debug message when closing. This change does not affect normal use.

97ee03b06fb332b51bbda94fa43c7d8066ef8f42.text: The system now checks agent names against a central list when starting up. This ensures only valid agents run, preventing errors from unknown or misspelled names.

7cea76074a4473b16074489b3b80deaa070cc84e.text: The app now quietly skips missing settings files instead of showing error messages. This change is small and internal, so users won't notice any difference in how the app works.

8e8d6485f4f9bcd307bba2cf037fdea1ab14a6d4.text: The system now checks for a valid access key before confirming agent settings, improving security. It also displays the correct name for built-in and published agents immediately during startup.

dc4ed3ac98a63e8da6104544e6ce162a7060f41c.text: The team fixed a small internal issue that caused the assistant to hang during testing. This change helps ensure the software remains stable and responsive for users.

60c5963bcfeb53629c083a3d27b096801d61dc4e.text: The app now uses a single, standard method to verify user identity. This internal update makes the sign-in process more consistent and reliable.

004ecf718a16aea9ebd2ca177cd99e4061a97861.title: Move validateAgent to cli.ts
004ecf718a16aea9ebd2ca177cd99e4061a97861.summary: Refactor `validateAgent` from `index.ts` to `cli.ts` in `npm-app`. Centralizes agent validation logic within the CLI entry point. Removes `validateAgent` export from `index.ts` and updates imports in `cli.ts` and tests. Adjusts startup flow in `index.ts` to call validation via `cli.ts` context or removed direct call, relying on `cli.ts` handling.

dcdbad70987dbbed158437edf5945378daa46784.title: Add git-committer agent definition
dcdbad70987dbbed158437edf5945378daa46784.summary: New agent definition added at .agents/git-committer.ts. Uses openai/gpt-5-nano and orchestrates a commit workflow via run_terminal_command and add_message tools. Includes spawner prompt, system prompt, and a generator-based handleSteps function for analyzing diffs and staging files.

3dfff48c660ed06f9df4e6be6a18568fb8d67d5e.title: Refactor agent loading and validation flow
3dfff48c660ed06f9df4e6be6a18568fb8d67d5e.summary: Consolidated agent loading, display, and validation into a single promise chain in npm-app/src/index.ts. Removed intermediate loadAgentsAndDisplayPromise variable. Validation logic now directly follows loadLocalAgents resolution, branching on agent presence to either display loaded agents or validate specific agent.

c42281bf67b57f5c7c743bf40c51389d2fd4fa58.title: SDK runterminalcommand tool added
c42281bf67b57f5c7c743bf40c51389d2fd4fa58.summary: SDK client now implements `run_terminal_command` via new `sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts` using `child_process.spawn`. Replaces previous throw with synchronous execution supporting `SYNC` mode, timeout handling, and combined stdout/stderr output. `handleToolCall` response structure updated to `output: { type: 'text', value }` shape.

693a21ec0120f19a241802a414d3c13a81e7b665.title: Conditional conciseness instructions for GPT-5 in base prompts
693a21ec0120f19a241802a414d3c13a81e7b665.summary: The `baseAgentSystemPrompt` and `baseAgentUserInputPrompt` functions in `.agents/prompts/base-prompts.ts` now conditionally omit strict conciseness directives when the active model is `openrouter_gpt5`. This change prevents GPT-5 from over-compressing responses, which previously degraded output quality for complex coding tasks. The logic introduces an `isGPT5` boolean check to dynamically adjust tone and length constraints in the system and user input prompts.

7ca496720a86798e47ac97391284482cb35eee08.title: Make maxAgentSteps optional in CodebuffConfigSchema
7ca496720a86798e47ac97391284482cb35eee08.summary: CodebuffConfigSchema.maxAgentSteps now accepts undefined. This fixes docs not loading by removing a hard dependency on the field during schema serialization. Updated files: common/src/json-config/constants.ts, common/src/util/zod-schema.ts.

84de5cf460c31cc670af2441a88d1d704aa944f0.title: Disable OpenRouter cost override and update Sonnet 4 model ID
84de5cf460c31cc670af2441a88d1d704aa944f0.summary: Disables `costOverrideDollars` assignment in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` to prevent zero-cost reporting for OpenRouter models using custom keys. Updates the base agent definition in `.agents/base.ts` to use the full Anthropic model ID `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522` instead of the alias `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4`. Adjusts type imports in `.agents/factory/base.ts` to align with the new model name constant.

138c15f63fda36edbfed7fb7a1cec204ba7468e3.title: SDK 0.1.8 adds run-state helpers for images and history
138c15f63fda36edbfed7fb7a1cec204ba7468e3.summary: Version 0.1.8 introduces `generateInitialRunState`, `withAdditionalMessage`, and `withMessageHistory` in `sdk/src/run-state.ts` to inject images, files, or modify message history before execution. These replace the exported `getInitialSessionState` and internal `initialSessionState` logic previously hidden in `client.ts`. The `CodebuffClient` now accepts a constructed `RunState` via `previousRun`, enabling multimodal prompts (e.g., image URLs) in `README.md` examples. `index.ts` exports the new functions, deprecating direct session state creation.

79cc1cfe5b9cdf5db5a9f49ba012cd10539753d7.title: z.toJSONSchema uses io input across backend common web
79cc1cfe5b9cdf5db5a9f49ba012cd10539753d7.summary: z.toJSONSchema calls in backend/src/templates/strings.ts, backend/src/tools/prompts.ts, common/src/tools/compile-tool-definitions.ts, and web/src/components/docs/mdx/schema-display.tsx now pass { io: 'input' }. common/src/util/zod-schema.ts schemaToJsonStr accepts optional z.toJSONSchema options to propagate this flag. This ensures JSON schema generation reflects input validation rules rather than output shapes for agent prompts, tool definitions, and docs. No migration or breaking API change for consumers.

8da355b2536ec849a8f7882e6e8f1685d5f5110f.title: Update researcher agent to Gemini 2.5 Pro and remove custom agent
8da355b2536ec849a8f7882e6e8f1685d5f5110f.summary: The `researcher` agent definition in `.agents/researcher.ts` now uses `google/gemini-2.5-pro` instead of `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`. The placeholder file `.agents/my-custom-agent.ts` has been deleted from the repository. This change affects only the internal agent definitions and removes the default custom agent template.

79cc1cfe5b9cdf5db5a9f49ba012cd10539753d7.text: Internal settings were adjusted so the system uses the correct rules when checking information entered by users. This small change improves how instructions and guides are generated, making them more accurate without altering the visible interface.

138c15f63fda36edbfed7fb7a1cec204ba7468e3.text: The assistant now supports images and files in prompts. You can attach these directly to your requests.

3dfff48c660ed06f9df4e6be6a18568fb8d67d5e.text: The system now checks for available assistants in one smoother step instead of several separate ones. This internal cleanup makes the startup process more reliable.

dcdbad70987dbbed158437edf5945378daa46784.text: A new internal tool helps the assistant automatically organize and save changes to project files using a specific AI model.

693a21ec0120f19a241802a414d3c13a81e7b665.text: The assistant now adjusts how brief its answers are when using a specific new model. This helps it give clearer, more detailed explanations for complex tasks instead of over-compressing them.

84de5cf460c31cc670af2441a88d1d704aa944f0.text: The system now correctly tracks costs for certain AI services instead of showing them as free. It also uses a more specific version of the AI model for better reliability.

004ecf718a16aea9ebd2ca177cd99e4061a97861.text: The tool that checks if your assistant is ready to work moved to a different place in the program. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works or looks to you.

c42281bf67b57f5c7c743bf40c51389d2fd4fa58.text: The assistant can now run computer commands and see their results. This adds a new way to interact with your system.

8da355b2536ec849a8f7882e6e8f1685d5f5110f.text: The assistant now uses a different brain for research tasks. You may see slightly different results. This change is internal and affects no other features.

7ca496720a86798e47ac97391284482cb35eee08.text: A small internal fix allows the assistant to run without a strict limit on steps. This stops documentation pages from failing to load.

0b98c636bc02df17e4290325671290101fc8b210.title: Move PLACEHOLDER to secret-agent-definition.ts
0b98c636bc02df17e4290325671290101fc8b210.summary: PLACEHOLDER const and PlaceholderType moved from agent-definition.ts to secret-agent-definition.ts. Import paths updated in .agents/factory/ask.ts and .agents/prompts/{ask,base}-prompts.ts. backend/src/templates/{ask,base}-prompts.ts deleted, consolidating prompt logic into .agents/prompts.

62bdb9babd895935bd3b63d9b7d8f12da24d63e7.title: Add stepPrompt to agent-builder
62bdb9babd895935bd3b63d9b7d8f12da24d63e7.summary: Added `stepPrompt` field to `agent-builder` definition in `.agents/agent-builder.ts`. Also imported `publisher` constant. This unblocks deployment by defining deterministic single-action behavior for the builder agent.

edd38c58d55ce1fdb236bf4f31a5969f705391fb.title: Agent definition examples added with schema type refinements
edd38c58d55ce1fdb236bf4f31a5969f705391fb.summary: Added three agent definition examples (basic-diff-reviewer, git-committer, advanced-file-explorer) demonstrating spawnerPrompt, handleSteps, and spawn_agents usage. Refined types in agent-definition.ts: inputSchema.params and outputSchema now require JsonObjectSchema, ToolCall.input made mandatory, and JsonSchema type union expanded with enum support. handleSteps doc comments updated to reflect args property naming.

e4c99325184057d07038fb437b7f6b532c3a317a.title: File picker agent switched to Gemini 2.5 Flash
e4c99325184057d07038fb437b7f6b532c3a317a.summary: The file picker agent now uses `google/gemini-2.5-flash` instead of `openai/gpt-5`. The `filePicker` factory function signature updated to accept `ModelName` type directly from `types/agent-definition` rather than importing `Model` from constants. This change affects the `.agents/file-picker.ts` definition and its factory implementation.

f8aedbbad52d1cf631dec4235a048727dd1d22a9.title: Remove example agents and placeholder types
f8aedbbad52d1cf631dec4235a048727dd1d22a9.summary: Deleted three example agent definitions from `.agents/examples/` and removed the `PLACEHOLDER` constant and related types from `.agents/types/agent-definition.ts`. Added a new template file `.agents/my-custom-agent.ts` to guide users in creating custom agents. This change reduces repo clutter by removing obsolete examples and unused backend-ported placeholder definitions.

c885525f6fd05c1d823b2a3e274964056e207794.title: Improve agent import error message
c885525f6fd05c1d823b2a3e274964056e207794.summary: Updated the verbose logging in `npm-app/src/agents/load-agents.ts` to print `error.name`, `error.message`, and `error.stack` directly instead of using `getErrorObject` from `@codebuff/common/util/error`. This change removes the dependency on the external error utility for this specific log, providing more granular stack trace details during local agent loading failures.

1a557775785ad1c09f91bd4298339db34327e55c.title: Upgrade to AI SDK 5 and Zod 4
1a557775785ad1c09f91bd4298339db34327e55c.summary: Backend dependencies updated to `ai` 5.0.0 and `zod` 4.0.0 (via `zod/v4`), requiring migration of tool call arguments from `args` to `input` in agent definitions. Zod error handling updated to use `error.issues` instead of `error.errors`, and token limits renamed from `maxTokens` to `maxOutputTokens`. Scope covers `.agents/` definitions, backend API handlers, and `backend/package.json`.

d7a8b17ef8b1cc0a5f2dd7248083ee62b5aabe76.title: Refactor agent definitions to factory pattern
d7a8b17ef8b1cc0a5f2dd7248083ee62b5aabe76.summary: Agent definitions in `.agents/` (e.g., `ask.ts`, `base-experimental.ts`) now import from a shared `factory` module instead of defining inline `SecretAgentDefinition` objects with duplicated prompts and tool lists. This change centralizes agent logic and configuration, reducing code duplication across variants like `base-lite` and `base`. The `agent-builder.ts` file also updates to read definition content via `fs` rather than importing it as text, aligning with the new modular structure.

bf9c8d683ccfa2c3c637566de185e420353f9089.title: Revert to AI SDK 4 and Zod 3
bf9c8d683ccfa2c3c637566de185e420353f9089.summary: Downgraded `ai` to 4.3.16 and `zod` to 3.25.67. Replaced `zod/v4` imports with `zod`. Changed `error.issues` to `error.errors` in API handlers. Updated agent tool call property from `input` to `args`.

1a557775785ad1c09f91bd4298339db34327e55c.text: We updated the assistant's internal tools to match newer standards. This keeps the software compatible and stable, so you will not see any visible changes in how you use the product.

e4c99325184057d07038fb437b7f6b532c3a317a.text: The assistant now uses a different brain for picking files. This is an internal change, so you won't notice any difference in how it works.

31bb570f2bd80ee28e9abeee1294558c53859c18.text: Fixed a bug where agents could not be published if they lacked a specific setup instruction. This ensures agents publish correctly regardless of their configuration.

edd38c58d55ce1fdb236bf4f31a5969f705391fb.text: The assistant now has clearer rules for handling tasks and recognizing different types of information. This internal update helps the software work more reliably behind the scenes.

d7a8b17ef8b1cc0a5f2dd7248083ee62b5aabe76.text: The assistant's internal setup was cleaned up to remove duplicate instructions. This small change does not affect what the assistant can do for you.

62bdb9babd895935bd3b63d9b7d8f12da24d63e7.text: A small internal update gave the assistant a clearer rule to follow, so it takes one specific step at a time. This helps the assistant work more reliably behind the scenes.

0b98c636bc02df17e4290325671290101fc8b210.text: The assistant's instructions were moved to a new location.

f8aedbbad52d1cf631dec4235a048727dd1d22a9.text: Outdated sample settings were deleted. New templates were added to help users create their own custom assistants.

c885525f6fd05c1d823b2a3e274964056e207794.text: The error messages that appear when an assistant fails to load are now clearer. This small internal update helps the support team diagnose problems faster.

bf9c8d683ccfa2c3c637566de185e420353f9089.text: The app switched back to a simpler version of its tools. You might notice the assistant handles requests more reliably.

689cc1afc07632f7588727b64f4f401768460bc6.title: CI test step prints failed tests, drops junit reporter
689cc1afc07632f7588727b64f4f401768460bc6.summary: ci.yml unit and integration test steps now capture stdout/stderr, grep for ✗/FAIL/Failed/Error:, and exit 1 on match instead of writing JUnit XML. The dorny/test-reporter@v1 publish steps are removed from both jobs. Scope: .github/workflows/ci.yml only. Mechanism: bun test runs without --reporter=junit; failure detection relies on regex against raw console output.

71429006be3d972011b91a692dcfe36926bce975.title: Revert vibe-coded CI test reporting
71429006be3d972011b91a692dcfe36926bce975.summary: Reverts experimental test reporting in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Removes dorny/test-reporter@v1 and associated JUnit XML generation steps. Restores standard bun test execution for unit and integration jobs. Internal CI pipeline adjustment.

2434be1fd79aa61611a1e5e7a24510e57ccf4115.title: Move mockModules into beforeAll in agent-registry.test.ts
2434be1fd79aa61611a1e5e7a24510e57ccf4115.summary: Relocated mockModule calls for db, schema, drizzle-orm, logger, and agent-list from module top-level into a beforeAll block in backend/src/__tests__/agent-registry.test.ts. Module-scope mocks evaluated during import hoisting before test setup; moving to beforeAll ensures mocks register after test harness initialization. clearMockedModules moved from afterEach to afterAll to align lifecycle. Internal test stability fix.

e9569cf002ee1c265a64d3cbcbed2429e8953122.title: Double default max agent steps
e9569cf002ee1c265a64d3cbcbed2429e8953122.summary: Default max agent steps doubled from 12 to 25 via new MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT constant. Removed hardcoded maxAgentSteps from codebuff.json. Applies to all agents via session-state.ts initialization.

89c2a27a5a8c0cfa9c8df4112076bf819c35e9d4.title: Remove unused asUserMessage import from run-programmatic-step
89c2a27a5a8c0cfa9c8df4112076bf819c35e9d4.summary: Removed unused asUserMessage import from backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts. This cleanup resolves linting or build warnings associated with dead imports. Scope limited to backend source file. No behavioral changes.

39bf72e5293133330a4b99fc875af740266ef0ed.title: CI adds JUnit test result reporting via dorny/test-reporter
39bf72e5293133330a4b99fc875af740266ef0ed.summary: ci.yml configures bun test to emit JUnit XML artifacts and publishes them using dorny/test-reporter@v1. Unit and integration test steps now generate test-results.xml and integration-test-results.xml respectively, with fail-on-error: true enforced. This change applies to all matrix packages in the CI pipeline. The reporter parses java-junit format to surface failures directly in GitHub checks.

76f7a396e7f904908030318923ab10bc2bcd452b.title: Fix dynamic-agent-template-schema test assertion
76f7a396e7f904908030318923ab10bc2bcd452b.summary: Updated `includeMessageHistory` assertion in `common/src/__tests__/dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts` from `true` to `false` to match current schema defaults. Ensures test suite passes for `DynamicAgentDefinitionSchema`.

c24b77fa176cb519b9fcfdaf5d6fb6d99752419e.title: Use MAXAGENTSTEPSDEFAULT constant in agent spawn handlers
c24b77fa176cb519b9fcfdaf5d6fb6d99752419e.summary: Replaced hardcoded step limit 20 with imported constant MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT in backend/src/loop-main-prompt.ts and three spawn-agent handlers. Centralizes agent step configuration to prevent drift between local defaults and shared constants. Scope limited to backend agent spawning logic.

98a82572d05247e530ee2fcbf39e2372850e14e7.title: CI workflow replaces manual test output parsing with
98a82572d05247e530ee2fcbf39e2372850e14e7.summary: Replaced manual shell script test execution and output parsing with `bun test --reporter=junit` and the `dorny/test-reporter@v1` GitHub Action in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. This change removes custom grep-based failure extraction in favor of standard JUnit XML reporting for both unit and integration test jobs. The workflow now publishes structured test results to the Actions UI automatically, with `fail-on-error: true` ensuring pipeline failures on test errors.

e8a75d0c6b54a8e77eae376869f38c2aa8b7fc17.title: Upgrade backend to ai-sdk@5 and zod@4
e8a75d0c6b54a8e77eae376869f38c2aa8b7fc17.summary: Backend dependencies updated to `ai@5.0.0` and `zod@4` (via `zod/v4` imports). Agent tool call interfaces migrated from `args` to `input` properties in `.agents/` definitions and `ToolCall` types. Zod error handling updated to use `error.issues` instead of `error.errors`. API max token parameters renamed from `maxTokens` to `maxOutputTokens` in `relabelRuns.ts`.

89c2a27a5a8c0cfa9c8df4112076bf819c35e9d4.text: Small internal cleanup. Removed unused code from the system. No changes to how the product works for you.

76f7a396e7f904908030318923ab10bc2bcd452b.text: A small internal check was updated to match current settings. This does not change how the product works for you.

e8a75d0c6b54a8e77eae376869f38c2aa8b7fc17.text: The system's underlying tools were updated to use newer standards for handling data and requests. This change is internal and ensures the product runs smoothly, with no noticeable difference for users.

2434be1fd79aa61611a1e5e7a24510e57ccf4115.text: A small internal change fixed how the system prepares for its own checks. You may notice fewer glitches or slowdowns when using the assistant.

689cc1afc07632f7588727b64f4f401768460bc6.text: The system now checks test results by reading the console output directly instead of using a separate report file. This internal change does not affect how the product works for users.

c24b77fa176cb519b9fcfdaf5d6fb6d99752419e.text: The assistant now uses a single, shared rule for its step limit instead of separate, hardcoded numbers. This small internal update prevents conflicting settings and keeps the behavior consistent.

71429006be3d972011b91a692dcfe36926bce975.text: The team removed a temporary tool that checked test results. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

e9569cf002ee1c265a64d3cbcbed2429e8953122.text: The assistant now allows more steps per task before stopping. This lets it handle more complex requests without giving up too early.

39bf72e5293133330a4b99fc875af740266ef0ed.text: The system now automatically lists failed tests in the check report. This helps developers find problems faster.

98a82572d05247e530ee2fcbf39e2372850e14e7.text: The team improved how automated tests check the software for problems. This internal update helps catch errors earlier, so you are less likely to encounter bugs.

5650e1ff92df689348224e76247ae01df4915980.title: Fix runProgrammaticStep tool call emission
5650e1ff92df689348224e76247ae01df4915980.summary: runProgrammaticStep now pushes tool calls as assistant messages and emits text via onResponseChunk. Previous implementation incorrectly added tool calls as user messages without streaming output. Change affects backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts.

2c6225ce333f471171a50a17850822b763433913.title: Add hint to PublishAgentsErrorResponse schema
2c6225ce333f471171a50a17850822b763433913.summary: Added optional `hint` property to `publishAgentsErrorResponseSchema` in `common/src/types/api/agents/publish.ts`. This field allows the API to provide additional context or guidance alongside the main error message. The change is scoped to the shared core types package.

6fc0452c5f167554ccecad4fb532262c8cc4d898.title: Rename spawnPurposePrompt to spawnerPrompt
6fc0452c5f167554ccecad4fb532262c8cc4d898.summary: Renamed `spawnPurposePrompt` to `spawnerPrompt` in `AgentDefinition` across all built-in agents. Updated `.agents/README.md` and new `my-custom-agent.ts` template to reflect the new field name. This clarifies the field's purpose as describing when other agents should spawn this one.

c442299be0f3a40c9e7d0dff567d0430e355cb1e.title: Remove redundant refine logic from DynamicAgentDefinitionSchema
c442299be0f3a40c9e7d0dff567d0430e355cb1e.summary: Removed custom `.refine` validators from `toolNames` in `common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts`. The previous implementation contained malformed refine callbacks that returned objects instead of booleans, causing type errors and runtime failures. The field now relies solely on `z.enum(toolNames)` for validation. Scope limited to core type definitions.

cc66bae453842ec9a247c477ad02f5701ee998f3.title: Upgrade backend to zod 4.0.0
cc66bae453842ec9a247c477ad02f5701ee998f3.summary: Backend dependency `zod` bumped to `4.0.0`. `error.errors` replaced by `error.issues` in API handlers. `z.ZodType<T, z.ZodTypeDef, any>` simplified to `z.ZodType<T>`. Imports shifted from `zod/v4` to `zod` across agent templates and tools. `stringifySchema` swapped for `schemaToJsonStr` in prompts.

80b22c7a54f1b774f28e3ea4f109ed5120ce4a22.title: Revert backend to zod 3 with v4 subpath imports
80b22c7a54f1b774f28e3ea4f109ed5120ce4a22.summary: Reverts zod dependency from 4.0.0 to 3.25.67 in backend/package.json. Agent templates, tools, and system prompts import from zod/v4 subpath to maintain v4 API compatibility while using v3 core. ZodError property access shifts from issues to errors in backend/src/api/org.ts and backend/src/api/usage.ts. promptAiSdkStructured in backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts explicitly types schema as z.ZodType<T, z.ZodTypeDef, any>.

943dd6d4f5df714265c84fc84f23be9db18bf00f.title: SDK 0.1.7 renames AgentConfig to AgentDefinition
943dd6d4f5df714265c84fc84f23be9db18bf00f.summary: Bumps @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.7. Renames AgentConfig to AgentDefinition in types. Update imports and type references to match new name.

48dadcf386fa907ebf26914d856842eb7a1b96ea.title: includeMessageHistory defaults to false
48dadcf386fa907ebf26914d856842eb7a1b96ea.summary: The `includeMessageHistory` property in `DynamicAgentDefinitionSchema` now defaults to `false` instead of `true`. The `buildSpawnableAgentsDescription` function in `backend/src/templates/prompts.ts` conditionally adds a message history visibility note to the agent prompt based on this flag, using `buildArray` to construct the string. This change ensures agents do not assume access to message history unless explicitly configured. The update affects `backend/src/templates/prompts.ts`, `backend/src/templates/strings.ts`, and `common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts`.

f973ae976bba995a74979542f236e73f602a2e57.title: Refactor agent publish subagent resolution
f973ae976bba995a74979542f236e73f602a2e57.summary: Extracted subagent resolution logic into new `subagent-resolution.ts` module. `route.ts` now delegates validation and version resolution to `resolveAndValidateSubagents`, supporting latest-version fallback via DB queries. Jest config renamed to `.cjs` and adds XML parser stub mapping.

b9be8087852566eebb4f957a163e292428599b14.title: CLI agent ID resolution and trace buffer refactor
b9be8087852566eebb4f957a163e292428599b14.summary: Added `resolveCliAgentId` in `npm-app/src/agents/resolve.ts` to normalize agent IDs by appending `DEFAULT_ORG_PREFIX` when no slash or local match exists. Refactored CLI handlers by moving subagent buffer logic from `subagent.ts` to new `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/traces.ts` and updating imports in `cli.ts`. Enhanced `publish.ts` error handling to separate `details` and `hint` from the main error string. Updated `subagent-list.ts` to support 'q' key for exiting the buffer alongside ESC.

943dd6d4f5df714265c84fc84f23be9db18bf00f.text: The assistant's internal settings were renamed for clarity. This change does not affect how you use the product.

48dadcf386fa907ebf26914d856842eb7a1b96ea.text: The assistant now defaults to forgetting past conversations unless you turn on history. This helps keep chats separate and private.

2c6225ce333f471171a50a17850822b763433913.text: When something goes wrong, the system can now show a helpful tip along with the error message to guide you on what to do next.

80b22c7a54f1b774f28e3ea4f109ed5120ce4a22.text: The internal tools used by the AI assistant were updated to fix a compatibility issue. This change is small and happens behind the scenes, so you won't see any difference in how the product works.

f973ae976bba995a74979542f236e73f602a2e57.text: The system now checks subagents more reliably before publishing. Users may see fewer errors when using features that depend on these background helpers.

6fc0452c5f167554ccecad4fb532262c8cc4d898.text: The label for the instruction that tells other tools when to use a specific assistant was shortened to be clearer. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

cc66bae453842ec9a247c477ad02f5701ee998f3.text: The system's internal data checking rules were updated to a newer standard. This change improves how the assistant handles information behind the scenes, but it does not alter any visible features or user actions.

c442299be0f3a40c9e7d0dff567d0430e355cb1e.text: A small internal fix removed broken checks that caused errors when setting up new tools. This makes the assistant more stable when you configure it.

5650e1ff92df689348224e76247ae01df4915980.text: The assistant now correctly shows its actions and responses in real time. Previously, some steps appeared incorrectly or not at all.

19a4324e22da0c79a32e3925496f2b2591b71c56.title: Rename parentPrompt to spawnPurposePrompt in agent definitions
19a4324e22da0c79a32e3925496f2b2591b71c56.summary: Renamed `parentPrompt` to `spawnPurposePrompt` across all agent definition files. This clarifies the field's purpose, indicating it describes the specific reason for spawning the agent rather than generic parent context. The change affects core agents, examples, and open-source variants within the `.agents` directory.

73da134833ad2e089ad6654266aa3a2f399a1552.title: Extract SecretAgentDefinition for .agents base types
73da134833ad2e089ad6654266aa3a2f399a1552.summary: Added `SecretAgentDefinition` in `.agents/types/secret-agent-definition.ts` to support internal tools like `add_subgoal` and `spawn_agents_async`. Base agents (`base.ts`, `ask.ts`, etc.) now import this type instead of `AgentDefinition`. `publishedTools` moved from `list.ts` to `constants.ts` in `common/src/tools`.

940b78477765f959e0aee72c7a109ba1b82126ab.title: Move agent builder to .agents
940b78477765f959e0aee72c7a109ba1b82126ab.summary: Moved `agent-builder.ts` from `backend/src/templates/agents/` to `.agents/`. Removed `agentBuilder` export and usage from `backend/src/templates/agent-list.ts`. New file `.agents/agent-builder.ts` contains the full agent definition, including `systemPrompt` and tool imports. This decouples the agent builder template from the backend service code.

ac9fff6cb1c8f512e0cb3565c2abb8f63f85f4b0.title: Overhaul example agents structure and definitions
ac9fff6cb1c8f512e0cb3565c2abb8f63f85f4b0.summary: Refactored `.agents/examples` to use numbered prefixes (01-basic, 02-intermediate, 03-advanced) and renamed IDs for clarity. Removed redundant `diff-reviewer-2` and `diff-reviewer-3` in favor of consolidated advanced examples like `advanced-file-explorer`. Updated `changes-reviewer` and `git-committer` to include `spawnPurposePrompt`, `toolNames`, and `spawnableAgents` explicitly, while removing deprecated `outputMode` and publisher metadata. CLI handler `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/agents.ts` updated to reflect new file paths and agent IDs.

3d8ece358a740c6718282091c53b1d051ecf78dd.title: Move initial agents dir files to common
3d8ece358a740c6718282091c53b1d051ecf78dd.summary: Relocates agent definition types and example templates from the root `.agents` directory to `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir`. Updates import paths in `sdk/src/client.ts`, `sdk/src/index.ts`, and `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/agents.ts` to reference the new locations. This consolidates shared template assets within the `common` package for better bundler compatibility and module resolution.

b244cd26fc7fb4b1c602b0d6a54c965360dcbfee.title: Rename AgentConfig to AgentDefinition in .agents
b244cd26fc7fb4b1c602b0d6a54c965360dcbfee.summary: Refactor internal agent definitions to use `AgentDefinition` type instead of `AgentConfig`. This aligns variable names and imports across core agents, examples, and open-source bases. The change standardizes naming conventions within the SDK's agent subsystem.

7695a102f6c1720f224a9d7a8e1b11448b12d4de.title: Move agent definitions to .agents directory
7695a102f6c1720f224a9d7a8e1b11448b12d4de.summary: Agent definitions and examples moved to .agents directory. Client bundles and writes them directly. Agent-builder simplified to pure LLM logic. Updates affect common types, backend templates, CLI handlers, and SDK package.

53cce531c371524cef89c89e62bc207d885dfb27.title: Align DynamicAgentDefinition type with toolNames
53cce531c371524cef89c89e62bc207d885dfb27.summary: DynamicAgentDefinitionHandleSteps type omits toolNames from DynamicAgentDefinition and re-adds it as optional (typeof publishedTools)[number][]. Aligns with AgentDefinition structure. Fixes type compatibility checks in common/src/types/__tests__/dynamic-agent-template.test.ts.

f64d2087ca0c709d15abdfcebdebb20e57e13fb0.title: Add your-custom-agent template, switch examples to Claude 4 Sonnet
f64d2087ca0c709d15abdfcebdebb20e57e13fb0.summary: New `your-custom-agent.ts` template added to `.agents/` root for easy editing, distinct from examples. Diff-reviewer agents updated to use `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522` and `codebuff/file-explorer@0.0.1`. Agent builder logic updated to copy the custom template to the top-level directory while placing other examples in subfolders. Spawnable agents list cleared in builder config.

324f2f307281f37980899a815ae7d867c5d38c64.title: Filter published tool definitions in SDK
324f2f307281f37980899a815ae7d867c5d38c64.summary: SDK tool type definitions now expose only a curated subset of tools via `publishedTools` in `common/src/tools/list.ts`. Internal tools like `spawn_agents_async`, `browser_logs`, and planning tools (`create_plan`, `add_subgoal`) are removed from `ToolName` and `ToolParamsMap` in `sdk/src/types/tools.ts`. `compile-tool-definitions.ts` iterates over `publishedTools` instead of all schema keys.

7695a102f6c1720f224a9d7a8e1b11448b12d4de.text: The program now stores helper instructions in a separate folder, making the setup simpler and cleaner. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

ac9fff6cb1c8f512e0cb3565c2abb8f63f85f4b0.text: The sample tools included with the software were reorganized and simplified to make them easier to find and use. This internal update does not change how the main features work.

940b78477765f959e0aee72c7a109ba1b82126ab.text: The team moved the assistant's setup instructions to a separate place. This internal cleanup makes the product easier to maintain, but nothing changes for you.

19a4324e22da0c79a32e3925496f2b2591b71c56.text: The system now uses a clearer label for the instructions that tell an assistant why it was started. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

f64d2087ca0c709d15abdfcebdebb20e57e13fb0.text: A new starting point for creating custom assistants is now available. The system also updated its built-in examples to use a newer, more capable model.

b244cd26fc7fb4b1c602b0d6a54c965360dcbfee.text: Developers renamed an internal label for consistency. This change does not affect how you use the product.

3d8ece358a740c6718282091c53b1d051ecf78dd.text: The files that set up new assistant profiles were moved to a shared location. This helps the software find those starting templates more reliably.

73da134833ad2e089ad6654266aa3a2f399a1552.text: The assistant's internal setup was reorganized to better support new tools. This small background change helps the system handle tasks more efficiently.

53cce531c371524cef89c89e62bc207d885dfb27.text: Internal adjustments were made to how the system recognizes available tools for custom assistants. This change fixes underlying technical checks but does not alter how you use the product.

324f2f307281f37980899a815ae7d867c5d38c64.text: The assistant now only uses a smaller, carefully chosen list of tools. This hides internal functions from normal use, keeping its actions focused and reliable.

641cba2e0c6951478f1d34a9de5066bfa07baf3b.title: Rename AgentState spawnableAgents to subagents
641cba2e0c6951478f1d34a9de5066bfa07baf3b.summary: Renamed `spawnableAgents` field to `subagents` in `AgentStateSchema` and related handlers. This aligns internal state naming with the concept of nested agent execution. Updated `common/src/types/session-state.ts`, `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-*.ts`, and `common/src/util/types/agent-config.d.ts`. The `agent-config.d.ts` comment now explicitly requires fully qualified IDs (publisher/version) or local file IDs for spawning.

f4bc2996958d258318bf16cf39404a39e17329bf.title: Gate websocket prompt-error on validation errors
f4bc2996958d258318bf16cf39404a39e17329bf.summary: websocket-action.ts now checks validationErrors.length > 0 before sending prompt-error. Prevents spurious error messages when agent config is valid. Scope limited to backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. Previously, prompt-error was sent unconditionally, even with an empty validationErrors array.

2a564ae89f287d49c1639bf3038f84292f1028d3.title: Rename subagents to spawnableAgents in agent templates
2a564ae89f287d49c1639bf3038f84292f1028d3.summary: Renamed `subagents` field to `spawnableAgents` across all agent templates and core logic. This clarifies the semantic distinction between the list of agents an agent can spawn and the actual spawned instances. The change affects `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/templates/agents/*.ts`, and related test files. No migration logic is included; existing configs using `subagents` will need manual updates to `spawnableAgents`.

d5344c2e9ca9f5578066a53e68ae9ee17a036b92.title: Remove spawn-inline-agent handler
d5344c2e9ca9f5578066a53e68ae9ee17a036b92.summary: Deleted backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-inline-agent.ts. Removed handleSpawnAgentInline logic for spawning child agents with shared message history. Internal cleanup of unused tool handler.

f999cc7982e9c76bb18ffdea19bb443a5015d10e.title: Send validation errors on each prompt
f999cc7982e9c76bb18ffdea19bb443a5015d10e.summary: The backend now sends a 'prompt-error' action with validation messages from assembleLocalAgentTemplates on every prompt. This ensures invalid agent configs are reported immediately. The change affects backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts.

283720666a6716c7a30d90a3f6fdaf1fee189ad5.title: Add newlines before terminal command display
283720666a6716c7a30d90a3f6fdaf1fee189ad5.summary: Two blank lines added via `console.log()` before printing the green `displayDir > command` string in `runCommandChildProcess`. This compensates for models that omit newlines in their output. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/terminal/run-command.ts`.

eab3a00a52bf5373b9600f58e57c2b774d8d3484.title: Adjust agent step logging
eab3a00a52bf5373b9600f58e57c2b774d8d3484.summary: Reorders fields and updates included data in `logger.debug` calls within `run-agent-step.ts`. The 'Start' log now includes `iteration`, `model`, and `duration` earlier, while the 'End' log drops `fullResponseChunks` and `agentTemplate` in favor of `shouldEndTurn` and `finalMessageHistoryWithToolResults`. This change is scoped to the backend agent execution loop. No user-facing behavior or API changes occur.

185ebc43ab70ebc7bba66b74b18b40aff38e1c3f.title: Refactor WebSocket action types to generic ClientAction and
185ebc43ab70ebc7bba66b74b18b40aff38e1c3f.summary: Replaced verbose `Extract<ClientAction, { type: T }>` and `Extract<ServerAction, { type: T }>` patterns with generic type parameters `ClientAction<T>` and `ServerAction<T>` across the WebSocket layer. This simplifies type inference and reduces boilerplate in action handlers, middleware, and client subscriptions. Changes span `backend/src/websockets`, `common/src/websockets`, `npm-app/src/client.ts`, and `sdk/src`. The refactor is purely internal, preserving runtime behavior while improving type ergonomics.

fe3e591cef9c316211695f4cf7a7f637d6485807.title: AgentConfig renamed to AgentDefinition
fe3e591cef9c316211695f4cf7a7f637d6485807.summary: Internal SDK refactor renames AgentConfig to AgentDefinition across all agent files. Field subagents replaced by spawnableAgents. System prompt text updated to match new terminology. No user-facing behavior change.

130669184edf23a672b78e3e0ef8dff3bcd3a136.title: Update recommended model list in agent-config.d.ts
130669184edf23a672b78e3e0ef8dff3bcd3a136.summary: The `ModelName` union in `common/src/util/types/agent-config.d.ts` now explicitly lists recommended models, replacing the generic 'all models' comment. Added entries include `openai/gpt-5` variants, `anthropic/claude-opus-4.1`, `google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, `qwen/qwen3-coder`, `deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3-0324`, `moonshotai/kimi-k2`, and `z-ai/glm-4.5`. Removed outdated models like `anthropic/claude-3.5-haiku-20241022` and `openai/gpt-4o-2024-11-20`. The `(string & {})` fallback remains, allowing any OpenRouter model ID.

d5344c2e9ca9f5578066a53e68ae9ee17a036b92.text: Removed an unused feature that let the assistant start sub-tasks with shared history. No change to how you use the product.

2a564ae89f287d49c1639bf3038f84292f1028d3.text: The system now uses a clearer name for the list of helpers an assistant can call. If you created custom assistant setups, you must manually update their settings to use this new name.

f4bc2996958d258318bf16cf39404a39e17329bf.text: Fixed a small internal bug. The system no longer shows false error messages when settings are correct.

fe3e591cef9c316211695f4cf7a7f637d6485807.text: The system renamed a setting from 'configuration' to 'definition' and updated related labels for clarity. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works or looks to users.

eab3a00a52bf5373b9600f58e57c2b774d8d3484.text: The assistant's internal activity records now show different details. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

641cba2e0c6951478f1d34a9de5066bfa07baf3b.text: The assistant now uses clearer internal labels for its nested tasks. This small cleanup helps the system track subtasks more accurately.

f999cc7982e9c76bb18ffdea19bb443a5015d10e.text: If an assistant setting is broken, the app now shows an error message right away when you start a chat. This helps you spot and fix problems faster.

283720666a6716c7a30d90a3f6fdaf1fee189ad5.text: The app now adds extra blank lines before showing commands to make them easier to read. This small visual fix helps when the assistant's output is missing spacing.

185ebc43ab70ebc7bba66b74b18b40aff38e1c3f.text: The team made an internal change to how the app handles live connections. This update does not affect how you use the product or change any features.

327256f8d622d94b391613b5d072a70204ec2b71.title: Move agent config validation to CLI startup
327256f8d622d94b391613b5d072a70204ec2b71.summary: Removed async validation from `client.ts` initialization and moved it to `index.ts` CLI startup. Validation now triggers immediately after `loadLocalAgents` resolves, ensuring local templates are checked before WebSocket connection or UI display. This shift decouples validation from the core client lifecycle, restricting it to the CLI entry point. Files changed: `npm-app/src/client.ts`, `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

bd848cbe4d1af2ece2b1a98bfa44af3d65232d7d.title: Reduce nightly evals concurrency
bd848cbe4d1af2ece2b1a98bfa44af3d65232d7d.summary: Nightly evals concurrency reduced from 10 to 3 in .github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml. Aimed at mitigating timeouts during evaluation runs.

45acd256d19c3abe4da1903a3a552626eef96021.title: Add prompt-error action for WebSocket errors
45acd256d19c3abe4da1903a3a552626eef96021.summary: Introduced `prompt-error` server action to standardize error reporting for prompt executions. Replaced manual `response-chunk` and `prompt-response` error assembly with dedicated typed actions in `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts` and `websocket-action.ts`. Updated `ClientAction` and `ServerAction` types to generic discriminated unions in `common/src/actions.ts`. CLI client `npm-app/src/client.ts` now subscribes to both `action-error` and `prompt-error` to handle insufficient credits and other failures.

fc2b860783adfcbf9602dad57a3b17e5b0678b2b.title: thinkdeeply no longer forces next agent step
fc2b860783adfcbf9602dad57a3b17e5b0678b2b.summary: Added TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP constant in common/src/tools/constants.ts to exclude think_deeply from forcing continuation. Updated backend/src/run-agent-step.ts to calculate shouldEndTurn by filtering out these non-forcing tools from toolCalls and toolResults checks. This prevents the agent from unnecessarily looping when only think_deeply is called without other actionable tools.

4f626984c985df0a5bad27a0d9e0b57fbde5847b.title: Agent validation endpoint drops auth, takes array
4f626984c985df0a5bad27a0d9e0b57fbde5847b.summary: The /api/agents/validate endpoint no longer requires authentication and accepts an array of agent configs instead of a keyed object. The npm client passes Object.values(agentTemplates) and omits the session token cookie. The web route converts the array to a keyed object via Object.fromEntries before calling validateAgents. Affects npm-app/src/client.ts, npm-app/src/utils/agent-validation.ts, web/src/app/api/agents/validate/route.ts.

1a03c37bb1e3db631749b6fcec1dd888e5a7df49.title: Agent validation moves from WebSocket init to REST API route
1a03c37bb1e3db631749b6fcec1dd888e5a7df49.summary: Agent template validation shifted from backend WebSocket init to a new web REST endpoint `/api/agents/validate`. The CLI now triggers validation via `validateAgentConfigsIfAuthenticated` after loading local agents, replacing the previous `init-response` message payload. This decouples validation logic from the real-time connection, relying on `next-auth` sessions for authentication. Removed static agent template documentation and simplified file context assembly in `project-files.ts`.

2dcd8cb052847b0112fe1d6dc90baa5016accbe9.title: Fix setoutput tool tests by mocking agent templates
2dcd8cb052847b0112fe1d6dc90baa5016accbe9.summary: Replaced `assembleLocalAgentTemplates` calls with inline `testAgent` mocks in `run-agent-step-tools.test.ts`. Updated `agentType` params to match new mock IDs and removed unnecessary `as any` casts. Ensures `set_output` tool tests run deterministically without relying on real registry state.

fe3776e76cf1aad51cf24c7981007d1b3996d1a3.title: Update recommended models and broaden subagent types in SDK
fe3776e76cf1aad51cf24c7981007d1b3996d1a3.summary: The `ModelName` union in `sdk/src/types/agent-config.ts` is updated to include OpenAI GPT-5 series and Qwen3/DeepSeek models while removing older GPT-4o/o3 variants. The `subagents` field type changes from a strict `SubagentName` union to a generic `string[]`, allowing arbitrary agent identifiers.

eb2d3ba2ded99f971b20ba32e93cf80fcc985c37.title: Refactor agent builder and add diff-reviewer examples
eb2d3ba2ded99f971b20ba32e93cf80fcc985c37.summary: Consolidated `agent-builder` into base builder logic and added three `diff-reviewer` example agents (`.agents/examples/diff-reviewer-{1,2,3}.ts`) to demonstrate complexity levels. Updated `AgentConfig` type in `.agents/types/agent-config.d.ts` replacing `outputMode: 'json'` with `'structured_output'` and changing `toolResult` type from `ToolResult` to `string`. Removed `send_agent_message` from `superagent.ts` tools and added `spawn_agent_inline` to `ToolName` union in `.agents/types/tools.d.ts`. These changes standardize agent creation patterns and clarify output handling for sub-agents.

45acd256d19c3abe4da1903a3a552626eef96021.text: The system now uses a standard way to report errors during requests. This makes error messages more consistent and reliable for users.

fc2b860783adfcbf9602dad57a3b17e5b0678b2b.text: The assistant now stops thinking steps instead of repeating them. This prevents endless loops when it only needs to pause and reflect.

eb2d3ba2ded99f971b20ba32e93cf80fcc985c37.text: The assistant now uses a simpler method to create new tasks. It can also give clearer answers and start tasks directly inside the main conversation.

327256f8d622d94b391613b5d072a70204ec2b71.text: The app now checks your custom settings before starting, so it can show errors sooner.

2dcd8cb052847b0112fe1d6dc90baa5016accbe9.text: A small internal update fixed how the assistant's output tools are tested. This ensures the feature works consistently for you, without changing how you use it.

4f626984c985df0a5bad27a0d9e0b57fbde5847b.text: The check that confirms the assistant's settings are correct now runs faster and handles multiple profiles at once. This internal update does not change how you use the product.

bd848cbe4d1af2ece2b1a98bfa44af3d65232d7d.text: We slowed down the automatic nightly checks to prevent them from timing out. This small internal change helps keep our testing reliable.

1a03c37bb1e3db631749b6fcec1dd888e5a7df49.text: The system now checks agent settings through a separate, more reliable process instead of during the initial connection. This internal change improves stability without affecting how you use the product.

b9be8087852566eebb4f957a163e292428599b14.text: The tool now better recognizes which assistant to use and cleans up error messages for easier reading. This internal update helps the system run smoothly without changing how you use it.

6e860fe9de2082c1a2dccc56460c22d0a764480e.title: Add spawnagentinline tool renderer
6e860fe9de2082c1a2dccc56460c22d0a764480e.summary: Added `spawn_agent_inline` to `toolRenderers` in `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts`. Implements `onToolStart` header, `onParamEnd` for `agent_type` (resolving display name via `Client.getInstance`) and `prompt`, and `onToolEnd` spinner activation. Scope limited to CLI tool output rendering.

6a5d3f500f7cacec9f7226c8b13aa3613bd015de.title: Fix expireMessages userPrompt retention condition
6a5d3f500f7cacec9f7226c8b13aa3613bd015de.summary: Corrected logic in expireMessages. Changed condition from endOf === 'agentStep' to endOf === 'userPrompt'. Ensures userPrompt messages are retained only when appropriate.

ab87eb2287659131d7dcc6e88f70971ab7161251.title: Rename agent output mode 'json' to 'structuredoutput'
ab87eb2287659131d7dcc6e88f70971ab7161251.summary: The `outputMode` enum value 'json' is renamed to 'structured_output' across agent templates and type definitions. This clarifies that the mode enforces schema validation via `set_output` rather than just returning raw JSON strings. The change affects `common/src/types`, `backend/src/templates`, and `backend/src/tools`, requiring updates to any custom agent configs using the old string.

781b6c96b6a45e87f21847b3138f5aa77213d2df.title: Format generated tool definitions
781b6c96b6a45e87f21847b3138f5aa77213d2df.summary: scripts/generate-tool-definitions.ts now executes npx prettier --write on the output file after writing tools.d.ts. This ensures generated definitions match project formatting standards automatically. Scope limited to the generation script.

67f372f023d3ae06a562b5367f20dd55aa169ea7.title: Remove setoutput from base agents
67f372f023d3ae06a562b5367f20dd55aa169ea7.summary: Removed `set_output` from `toolNames` in `.agents/base.ts`, `.agents/base-experimental.ts`, `.agents/base-lite.ts`, `.agents/base-max.ts`, and `backend/src/templates/agents/base.ts`. Fixes validation errors in agent configurations. Also updated `.agents/brainstormer.ts` to include `spawn_agents` and changed `.agents/git-committer.ts` output mode to `last_message`.

a862a7631739428591169521b08a2e54eb18b6fd.title: Tool description comments switch line to JSDoc
a862a7631739428591169521b08a2e54eb18b6fd.summary: compile-tool-definitions.ts jsonSchemaToTypeScript emits /** ... */ instead of // ... for schema property descriptions. tools.d.ts regenerated: AddSubgoalParams, BrowserLogsParams, CodeSearchParams fields now carry JSDoc block comments. Affects shared core types only. IDE hover tooltips pick up property docs where line comments were invisible.

d9c305afc5545636b8ae82a9fc7d739adc056ca4.title: Optional terminal params, toolResult string type
d9c305afc5545636b8ae82a9fc7d739adc056ca4.summary: Zod `.optional()` applied to `process_type` and `timeout_seconds` in `run-terminal-command.ts`. `ToolResult` type changed to `string` in `agent-config.d.ts` and `tools.d.ts`. Scope: Shared/Core types and tool params. Detail: handleSteps expects tool results as strings.

d774a1190033ba81f120a60be3c9821e52c7588b.title: Remove sendagentmessage tool
d774a1190033ba81f120a60be3c9821e52c7588b.summary: Removed `send_agent_message` tool definition, handler, and params from backend and common packages. Deleted `sendAgentMessageTool`, `handleSendAgentMessage`, and `sendAgentMessageParams`. Updated `superagent` template to drop the tool from `toolNames` and remove inter-agent messaging prompt instructions. Modified `spawn-agents-async` description to remove references to parent-child communication via messages.

1b182fcbea278b555d09041f57880dba147187f4.title: Add spawnagentinline tool for context-preserving agent delegation
1b182fcbea278b555d09041f57880dba147187f4.summary: New `spawn_agent_inline` tool allows spawning a single agent that executes within the current message history, preserving context and added messages upon return. Implemented in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-inline.ts` and registered across `common/src/tools/constants.ts` and `list.ts` files. Unlike `spawn_agents`, this tool has no tool result and ends the agent step, requiring `end_turn` to return control. Also updated `set_messages` params to pass through additional properties.

218b5bb68b6c3be40500e6773e52cc3910dca472.title: Fix expireMessages logic in backend messages util
218b5bb68b6c3be40500e6773e52cc3910dca472.summary: Corrected filter logic in expireMessages within backend/src/util/messages.ts. Previous implementation incorrectly retained agentStep messages due to hardcoded false condition. Now properly removes messages where timeToLive is agentStep or userPrompt matching endOf agentStep.

6a5d3f500f7cacec9f7226c8b13aa3613bd015de.text: Fixed a rule about when old chat messages are kept.

218b5bb68b6c3be40500e6773e52cc3910dca472.text: A small internal fix ensures temporary messages now expire correctly. This prevents old, short-lived notes from staying visible longer than intended.

781b6c96b6a45e87f21847b3138f5aa77213d2df.text: The internal tool that creates the assistant's instructions now automatically tidies up its own output. This change is small and does not affect how the product works for you.

d9c305afc5545636b8ae82a9fc7d739adc056ca4.text: The system now accepts commands without needing specific settings for how they run or how long they wait. Results are always sent back as plain text, which helps the assistant understand them correctly.

6e860fe9de2082c1a2dccc56460c22d0a764480e.text: The assistant now shows a clear label and status indicator when it starts a new background task. This change is small and internal, but it helps you see what the assistant is doing.

ab87eb2287659131d7dcc6e88f70971ab7161251.text: The assistant now uses a clearer setting name for its structured responses. This change does not affect how you use the product.

a862a7631739428591169521b08a2e54eb18b6fd.text: Internal cleanup. Developer tools now display better help text.

67f372f023d3ae06a562b5367f20dd55aa169ea7.text: A small internal fix removed a broken setting from the assistant's core tools, stopping errors that could stop it from working. This change also adjusted two specific helpers to use different ways of sending back answers.

03c28acba1bacead04d5643552fa1b90b46b9330.title: bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.4
03c28acba1bacead04d5643552fa1b90b46b9330.summary: Version bump for @codebuff/sdk from 0.1.3 to 0.1.4. Update affects sdk/package.json. No functional changes.

739992a3a86434ecdb09aa84c4097a1e3449e50c.title: SDK: rename allFiles to projectFiles, add API docs
739992a3a86434ecdb09aa84c4097a1e3449e50c.summary: The `allFiles` parameter in `client.run()` is renamed to `projectFiles` for clarity. Comprehensive API reference documentation added to `sdk/README.md` and JSDoc comments updated in `sdk/src/client.ts`. Scope covers SDK documentation and client interface definitions. Existing code using `allFiles` must update to `projectFiles`.

7944c91097bb73c5914dc7a89ef69352f1b9a31b.title: Make overrideTools optional in CodebuffClientOptions
7944c91097bb73c5914dc7a89ef69352f1b9a31b.summary: The `overrideTools` property in `CodebuffClientOptions` is now optional (`overrideTools?`). The internal `CodebuffClient` class resolves this by defaulting `overrideTools` to an empty object (`{}`) if undefined, while maintaining the type as `NonNullable<CodebuffClientOptions['overrideTools']>` to ensure internal consistency.

842c13227ee038cd86127c984d9b1e06d59da640.title: Add The Flex testimonial PDF to web/public/testimonials
842c13227ee038cd86127c984d9b1e06d59da640.summary: Added The-Flex-x-Codebuff.pdf to web/public/testimonials. This binary asset supports public-facing marketing content. No code or logic changes occurred.

0fe1f1dd28233a1278b309984f3a6b9cbd18b10a.title: SDK 0.1.6 simplifies publish script and moves agent config types
0fe1f1dd28233a1278b309984f3a6b9cbd18b10a.summary: SDK version bumped to 0.1.6. `publish.js` simplified by removing dist-directory path rewriting, now publishing directly from the sdk directory. `agent-config` and `tools` types moved from `src/util/types` to `src/types` via build script, with `package.json` paths updated to `./dist/sdk/src/`.

121d2628a543f2565607534a6ef1313a72f1dbce.title: SDK bundles AgentConfig and ToolName types locally
121d2628a543f2565607534a6ef1313a72f1dbce.summary: SDK build copies agent-config.d.ts and tools.d.ts from ../common into src/util/types, replacing direct cross-package imports. client.ts and index.ts now resolve AgentConfig from './util/types/agent-config', decoupling the published package from the monorepo common source. New files sdk/src/util/types/agent-config.ts and tools.ts define the full AgentConfig interface, ToolName union, and ToolParamsMap.

d6f286a4e3c3bedf8f67ecd4613d19db2796ebdf.title: SDK run() accepts agentConfigs array
d6f286a4e3c3bedf8f67ecd4613d19db2796ebdf.summary: CodebuffClient.run() replaces singular `agentConfig` object with `agentConfigs` array. New `AgentConfig` type exported from SDK index. Update calls to pass array of config objects instead of key-value map.

256e3c826cab1e5a39f408f052fc5e39aef399ec.title: Bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.5
256e3c826cab1e5a39f408f052fc5e39aef399ec.summary: Version of @codebuff/sdk incremented from 0.1.4 to 0.1.5 in sdk/package.json. Routine release bump.

587078819d21ebc9d0f3f5718469f41ba980258b.title: Normal mode reverts to Claude Sonnet 4
587078819d21ebc9d0f3f5718469f41ba980258b.summary: The default normal mode agent template now uses models.openrouter_claude_sonnet_4 instead of models.openrouter_gpt5. Base lite mode shifts to models.openrouter_gpt5. The base prompt also removes the strict end_turn tool call requirement, replacing it with a directive to complete all steps before ending the response.

130669184edf23a672b78e3e0ef8dff3bcd3a136.text: The list of recommended AI models was updated to show newer options and remove older ones. This helps you pick better models without affecting how the product works.

03c28acba1bacead04d5643552fa1b90b46b9330.text: A small internal update was made to the software's helper tools. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

256e3c826cab1e5a39f408f052fc5e39aef399ec.text: The assistant's background engine received a small, routine update. You will not notice any changes.

739992a3a86434ecdb09aa84c4097a1e3449e50c.text: The label for a list of files was changed to be clearer. Existing setups must update this label to keep working.

121d2628a543f2565607534a6ef1313a72f1dbce.text: The software now carries its own instruction manual instead of borrowing one from elsewhere. This keeps the tool working reliably even if the original source changes.

0fe1f1dd28233a1278b309984f3a6b9cbd18b10a.text: The software's publishing method was simplified to remove unnecessary steps. Internal data organization was updated for better structure. These changes are small and do not affect how you use the product.

7944c91097bb73c5914dc7a89ef69352f1b9a31b.text: The assistant now works correctly even if you leave a specific settings field empty.

d6f286a4e3c3bedf8f67ecd4613d19db2796ebdf.text: The system can now handle multiple assistant settings at once instead of just one. This lets you switch between different assistant personalities or rules more easily.

842c13227ee038cd86127c984d9b1e06d59da640.text: A new customer story PDF was added to the website's public folder. This file is available for marketing content. It does not change how the product works.

587078819d21ebc9d0f3f5718469f41ba980258b.text: The assistant now uses a different underlying engine for standard requests, while the lighter version switches to the previous engine. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

7b74c69b7e9bae928f3a4856871b35ce53c9be3f.title: SDK forks getFiles into local read-files tool
7b74c69b7e9bae928f3a4856871b35ce53c9be3f.summary: SDK forks getFiles into sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts, removing dependency on npm-app/src/project-files. client.ts imports local getFiles and passes this.cwd for path resolution. Covers SDK surface. New implementation enforces 1MB file size limit and validates paths against cwd to prevent outside-project reads.

3af903105725886254d5a6db2aaf9510a4b46666.title: SDK fixes Windows path checks and WebSocket connection state
3af903105725886254d5a6db2aaf9510a4b46666.summary: Updated `sdk/src/client.ts` to use `where` instead of `which` on Windows for binary detection and made `overrideTools` optional via `Partial`. Added `isConnected` guard in `sdk/src/websocket-client.ts` to prevent duplicate connections and ensure `connect()` is called before running prompts. Implemented path traversal check in `sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts` to reject `cwd` containing `../`.

8ed8d337f45cc8aeb9bf0d93b42344cf6409896c.title: Move WebSocket error handling from common to npm-app
8ed8d337f45cc8aeb9bf0d93b42344cf6409896c.summary: Refactored `sendAction` error handling. Removed try/catch and exit logic from `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`. Moved implementation to `sendActionAndHandleError` helper in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. All action dispatches in `npm-app` now use the local helper.

4c24c3d44e0b871f4f75d25edecc36f5f8059593.title: Remove onUsageResponse callback from SDK
4c24c3d44e0b871f4f75d25edecc36f5f8059593.summary: The `onUsageResponse` callback and associated `usage-response` WebSocket subscription are removed from the SDK client and handler. This cleanup eliminates unused code paths for handling usage metrics within the `CodebuffClient` and `WebSocketHandler`. The change affects `sdk/src/client.ts` and `sdk/src/websocket-client.ts`, simplifying the interface by removing the optional callback definition and its default implementation.

ec897ec0cc858627130f9cefb0611a7040c5f084.title: SDK run() handleEvent optional, WebSocket error forwarding
ec897ec0cc858627130f9cefb0611a7040c5f084.summary: SDK run() handleEvent now optional, typed as PrintModeEvent. WebSocket errors forwarded to onError. Change-file.ts applyPatch import path corrected to relative. Scope: sdk/src/client.ts, sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts.

ecb2ad86f26dfde8611f3df04cfea9ecd7736c0d.title: SDK reuses writefile override for strreplace
ecb2ad86f26dfde8611f3df04cfea9ecd7736c0d.summary: The SDK now reuses the write_file override for str_replace since both share the same implementation. The str_replace entry was removed from ClientToolName. Error messages corrected to use 'SDK' casing.

e96e48e9f4c433cd888490e04f19dc9c9f7ba73a.title: SDK run method supports continuing previous state
e96e48e9f4c433cd888490e04f19dc9c9f7ba73a.summary: The SDK `runNewChat` method is replaced by `run`, which now returns a `RunState` object containing `sessionState` and `toolResults`. This state can be passed back into `run` via the `previousState` parameter to resume execution, enabling multi-turn interactions or recovery. The `agentTemplates` parameter is renamed to `agentConfig`, and a new `maxAgentSteps` option is added to control agent depth. Invalid prompt responses from the server now reject the promise with a validation error instead of silently failing.

dfdb3a8a3392881ded3efe5637677cdc36bdca47.title: SDK 0.1.3 supports explicit apiKey option
dfdb3a8a3392881ded3efe5637677cdc36bdca47.summary: SDK version 0.1.3 adds optional `apiKey` parameter to `CodebuffClient` constructor, allowing explicit key provision alongside `CODEBUFF_API_KEY` env var. README updated to demonstrate simplified `CodebuffClient` usage with direct `apiKey` property instead of complex `WebSocketHandler` configuration. `previousState` parameter renamed to `previousRun` in client methods for clarity.

6c61620ce9e92107cc1368c32299260afec1c851.title: SDK CodebuffClient wires WebSocketHandler and tool-call dispatch
6c61620ce9e92107cc1368c32299260afec1c851.summary: CodebuffClient now instantiates WebSocketHandler and dispatches tool calls via handleToolCall, replacing the deprecated processStream path. New sdk/src/tools/change-file.ts applies patch/file changes with zod validation and mkdir -p semantics. ClientToolName type and overrideTools option expose read_files, write_file, str_replace, run_terminal_command. WebSocketHandler drops hardcoded fingerprintId 'codebuff-sdk' from prompt payload; client generates random fingerprintId instead.

4c24c3d44e0b871f4f75d25edecc36f5f8059593.text: The system stopped using a hidden background connection for tracking usage data. This is an internal cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

ecb2ad86f26dfde8611f3df04cfea9ecd7736c0d.text: The software uses shared tools for saving text and replacing words, reducing duplicate work. This internal cleanup makes the code easier to maintain without changing how you use the product.

8ed8d337f45cc8aeb9bf0d93b42344cf6409896c.text: Internal code for handling connection issues was moved to a different location. This change is small and does not affect how the product works for users.

7b74c69b7e9bae928f3a4856871b35ce53c9be3f.text: The tool that reads files is now separate from the rest of the system, which makes it more stable. It also checks that files are not too large and stay inside the current project folder.

fe3776e76cf1aad51cf24c7981007d1b3996d1a3.text: The assistant now uses newer, more capable models. It can also connect with a wider variety of specialized helpers.

dfdb3a8a3392881ded3efe5637677cdc36bdca47.text: The assistant now accepts an access key directly when starting up, so setup is simpler and less error-prone.

6c61620ce9e92107cc1368c32299260afec1c851.text: The assistant now uses a faster, more reliable connection to process your requests and edit files. This internal upgrade makes the tool feel snappier and more stable.

ec897ec0cc858627130f9cefb0611a7040c5f084.text: The assistant can now handle connection issues more reliably and requires less setup from users. This is a small internal improvement that makes the product smoother to use.

e96e48e9f4c433cd888490e04f19dc9c9f7ba73a.text: The assistant can now remember previous conversation steps to continue or recover a session. Invalid inputs now show clear errors instead of failing silently.

3af903105725886254d5a6db2aaf9510a4b46666.text: The software now detects helper tools more reliably on Windows and prevents connection errors. It also blocks unsafe file paths to keep your data secure.

d67fc734bb61c965a12dfa1531fb737b5fe67e4c.title: Refactor gpt-5 model string to constant
d67fc734bb61c965a12dfa1531fb737b5fe67e4c.summary: Hardcoded 'openai/gpt-5' in agent-list.ts replaced with models.openrouter_gpt5. Constant added to openrouterModels in common/src/constants.ts. Scope covers backend templates and shared constants. Mechanism centralizes model identifier management.

f1146062c7c1a0639055be5c4029fcfa27e9bddd.title: Comment out Agent Store links in navbar
f1146062c7c1a0639055be5c4029fcfa27e9bddd.summary: Agent Store navigation links commented out in web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx. Removal targets both desktop and mobile dropdown views. Internal UI change; no user action required.

db63b5f74ff8ea0a4423a578177c64cff74b64d3.title: SDK 0.1.2 adds onResponseError handler example
db63b5f74ff8ea0a4423a578177c64cff74b64d3.summary: sdk/README.md adds an `onResponseError` callback example to `WebSocketHandler` configuration. `sdk/package.json` bumps version to 0.1.2. Scope limited to SDK docs and package metadata. Example shows async error logging.

9812b9865e81d387f83bca8972d39f0c7a53811c.title: Show selected agent at chat start when --agent passed
9812b9865e81d387f83bca8972d39f0c7a53811c.summary: CLI displays selected agent name after greeting when `--agent` flag used in interactive mode. Calls `getLocalAgentInfo` and `getAgentDisplayName` to resolve name, wrapped in try/catch to suppress errors. Change isolated to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

2d55670bb0b79b4ddc3d8fd834329dfcf06a6dfe.title: Add agent store web page and API route
2d55670bb0b79b4ddc3d8fd834329dfcf06a6dfe.summary: Added web/src/app/agents/page.tsx and web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts to expose a browsable agent store. The GET /api/agents route queries @codebuff/common/db for published agentConfig rows, joins publisher data, dedupes by name to keep latest versions, and returns mock usage metrics. web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx links to /agents via a new Agent Store entry. npm-app/src/cli-handlers/agents.ts drops unused startAgentCreationChat and createAgentFromRequirements imports.

cef67de6ebd051fa47c08f0ba60e17b5ce6fcea4.title: Add ai 4.3.16 to common and sdk
cef67de6ebd051fa47c08f0ba60e17b5ce6fcea4.summary: Added `ai` version `4.3.16` as a dependency to `common/package.json` and `sdk/package.json`. This introduces the Vercel AI SDK to the core packages, likely to support shared AI model interactions or streaming utilities. Scope covers the shared `common` and `sdk` packages.

ad4c92bb4c335733ebe986d35ba8bc2e29b4bced.title: Update SDK README to WebSocketHandler
ad4c92bb4c335733ebe986d35ba8bc2e29b4bced.summary: SDK docs replaced `CodebuffClient` with `WebSocketHandler` and `getInitialSessionState`. Prerequisites now use `codebuff login` instead of `export CODEBUFF_API_KEY`. Full event callback and session state setup provided.

ed517e9d60056abf497af15bdf5c0f9770d66801.title: Switch base agent template to openai/gpt-5
ed517e9d60056abf497af15bdf5c0f9770d66801.summary: Backend base agent template default model changed from openrouter_claude_sonnet_4 to openai/gpt-5 in agent-list.ts. base-prompts.ts updated to tighten end_turn usage rules and remove deprecated verification sections. Scope limited to backend/src/templates. No user-facing command or model picker changes.

2d55670bb0b79b4ddc3d8fd834329dfcf06a6dfe.text: The product now has a new Agent Store page where you can browse available agents. This change is internal and adds a simple way to view these options.

d774a1190033ba81f120a60be3c9821e52c7588b.text: The assistant can no longer send messages between different helper programs. This change removes an internal communication feature that users did not directly interact with.

cef67de6ebd051fa47c08f0ba60e17b5ce6fcea4.text: The system gained a new way to connect with AI services. This is a small internal update that helps the assistant work better behind the scenes.

d67fc734bb61c965a12dfa1531fb737b5fe67e4c.text: The team moved a setting that controls which AI model the assistant uses into a shared list. This small internal change helps the team manage updates more easily.

f1146062c7c1a0639055be5c4029fcfa27e9bddd.text: The 'Agent Store' links have been hidden from the menu bar on both desktop and mobile. This is a minor internal update, so you do not need to take any action.

db63b5f74ff8ea0a4423a578177c64cff74b64d3.text: The software now includes a clearer guide on how the system records problems when it cannot reach a service.

ed517e9d60056abf497af15bdf5c0f9770d66801.text: The assistant now uses a new underlying model to generate responses. This internal update may slightly change how it answers, but the way you use the product stays the same.

1b182fcbea278b555d09041f57880dba147187f4.text: The assistant can now hand off a task to another agent without losing the current conversation history. This allows the handoff to happen smoothly within the same chat session, so you do not need to restart or repeat context when the task is done.

9812b9865e81d387f83bca8972d39f0c7a53811c.text: When you start a chat using a specific assistant, the app now shows its name. This small update helps you confirm which assistant is active.

ad4c92bb4c335733ebe986d35ba8bc2e29b4bced.text: The instructions for connecting to the service have been updated. New users now sign in through a simple login command instead of setting up a complex access key.

f3d89de2a35340111154033a4bab036490904565.title: Refactor agent loading and validation logic
f3d89de2a35340111154033a4bab036490904565.summary: Refactored `fetchAgentFromDatabase` in `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts` to validate agents using their original `agentId` before assigning the full `publisher/agentId@version` identifier to the final template. Updated `npm-app/src/index.ts` to conditionally load local agents only when no specific agent is requested, preventing unnecessary initialization. Adjusted `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` to accommodate the new async structure for local agent assembly.

9ffa0d8df053b386eb3457bbae9c37d455ef1905.title: Hide referral banner for accounts older than one week
9ffa0d8df053b386eb3457bbae9c37d455ef1905.summary: Referral banner now checks `userProfile.created_at` to hide itself for accounts older than 7 days.
