New `useUserProfile` hook fetches `/api/user/profile` with 5-minute `staleTime` and caches in localStorage under `codebuff-user-profile`. Banner component gates visibility on `isNewAccount` computed from the profile timestamp. Scope: `web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx`, `web/src/hooks/use-user-profile.ts`, `web/src/app/api/user/profile/route.ts`.

cc12e138692a984c4bc908a1ce1845a37ef8abd0.title: WebSocketHandler optional callbacks
cc12e138692a984c4bc908a1ce1845a37ef8abd0.summary: SDK exports WebSocketHandler and getInitialSessionState from index.ts. WebSocketHandlerOptions callbacks onWebsocketError, onWebsocketReconnect, onRequestReconnect, onResponseError, onCostResponse, onUsageResponse, onResponseChunk, onSubagentResponseChunk, onPromptResponse are now optional. Internal fields use Required<WebSocketHandlerOptions> for type safety. Affects sdk/src/index.ts and sdk/src/websocket-client.ts.

3c1b2b086848c2d4ffbaf4442545f54be1727fa4.title: Print mode accepts APIKEYENVVAR for auth
3c1b2b086848c2d4ffbaf4442545f54be1727fa4.summary: CLI print mode now checks `process.env[API_KEY_ENV_VAR]` alongside `client.user` to bypass auth errors. Updated error message in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` instructs users to set the env var or run `codebuff login`. Scope limited to CLI entry point. Import `API_KEY_ENV_VAR` from `@codebuff/common/constants`.

46ea9eb5635acaa15255b77420c4e8b89931f061.title: Remove temp type from WebSocket client
46ea9eb5635acaa15255b77420c4e8b89931f061.summary: Removed `asdf` type from `sdk/src/websocket-client.ts`. This was a temporary utility type excluding specific `ServerAction` types. No functional impact on WebSocket handling.

aa6d5ba9ac074fe76f7cba4c875e6ca9fa8d1a43.title: Update open source agent models and types
aa6d5ba9ac074fe76f7cba4c875e6ca9fa8d1a43.summary: Open source agent configurations updated: `researcher.ts` switches to `z-ai/glm-4.5:fast`, `thinker.ts` to `qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507:fast`. Type definitions in `agent-config.d.ts` and `tools.d.ts` refined for `ToolResult` and parameter formatting. `tool-renderers.ts` refactored to remove `AGENT_PERSONAS` dependency, using local `SpawnAgentConfig` interface.

76cd22a649c0739b4c7d22097f191382d9771365.title: Enable middle-out transform for OpenRouter
76cd22a649c0739b4c7d22097f191382d9771365.summary: OpenRouter API integration now includes `transforms: ['middle-out']` in the extra body payload. This change activates middle-out context handling to improve long conversation stability. The update applies to the backend `openrouter.ts` file, affecting all OpenRouter model requests.

73bf4a3584ba7e5a4ef5df05163390abb2032e0f.title: Fix subagent resolution for --agent flag
73bf4a3584ba7e5a4ef5df05163390abb2032e0f.summary: Backend now skips dynamic subagent injection when `agentId` is provided, preventing `--agent` from modifying configured subagents. CLI unconditionally loads local agents to ensure config availability for this check. Updated `.agents/file-explorer.ts` to use local `file-picker` reference instead of versioned `codebuff/file-picker`.

c30879321093563c4b43bbb5f121323ce12bb704.title: SDK sendInput replaces init action
c30879321093563c4b43bbb5f121323ce12bb704.summary: WebSocketHandler gains sendInput and cancelInput methods, injecting apiKey into prompt and cancel-user-input actions. The legacy init action and its generate-commit-message schema variant are removed from common/src/actions.ts. This shifts authentication from explicit init calls to implicit injection via getInputDefaultOptions in sdk/src/websocket-client.ts.

7b17f6ed1a64395d1a122323932488f7bd0c21cc.title: SDK v0.1.0: WebSocketHandler replaces CodebuffClient
7b17f6ed1a64395d1a122323932488f7bd0c21cc.summary: SDK bumped to v0.1.0. New `WebSocketHandler` in `sdk/src/websocket-client.ts` replaces deprecated `CodebuffClient`. `common/src/actions.ts` removes `ResponseCompleteSchema`, `tool-call`, `terminal-command-result`, `npm-version-status`, and `commit-message-response` server actions. `sdk/src/types.ts` deleted; options inlined. `sdk/src/constants.ts` adds `WEBSOCKET_URL`, `BACKEND_URL`, `WEBSITE_URL` with dev/prod branching.

9ffa0d8df053b386eb3457bbae9c37d455ef1905.text: The referral banner now hides for accounts older than one week. This change is internal and small.

aa6d5ba9ac074fe76f7cba4c875e6ca9fa8d1a43.text: The assistant now uses different, faster thinking engines to answer questions. Internal updates also improve how it shows results.

73bf4a3584ba7e5a4ef5df05163390abb2032e0f.text: The assistant now correctly uses the specific helper you select, ignoring other automatic settings. This ensures the tool works exactly as you configured it.

76cd22a649c0739b4c7d22097f191382d9771365.text: Small internal update. Long chats stay stable now.

3c1b2b086848c2d4ffbaf4442545f54be1727fa4.text: The print tool now checks for a saved login key in your system settings, so it can start working without asking you to sign in again. If it still fails, the error message tells you to add that key or log in.

46ea9eb5635acaa15255b77420c4e8b89931f061.text: A temporary internal setting was removed. This change has no effect on how the product works for you.

cc12e138692a984c4bc908a1ce1845a37ef8abd0.text: The live connection system now handles errors and reconnections more flexibly. Users may experience smoother recovery if the connection drops or encounters issues.

f3d89de2a35340111154033a4bab036490904565.text: The system now checks digital assistants more carefully before loading them. This small internal update helps prevent errors when starting up.

0148b8f7a7cce8f7bfeb7e02f2281fb053e248f7.title: Reduce file-picker agent prompt verbosity
0148b8f7a7cce8f7bfeb7e02f2281fb053e248f7.summary: The `instructionsPrompt` in `backend/src/templates/agents/file-picker.ts` was updated to request an "extremely concise analysis" instead of a "short analysis". This change aims to minimize output verbosity from the file-picking agent. The modification affects the core prompt logic used by the agent to identify relevant files.

a9ac1c4375bec000469115abdd72bb4b90e06663.title: Skip flaky read-docs-tool tests
a9ac1c4375bec000469115abdd72bb4b90e06663.summary: Two tests in read-docs-tool.test.ts now use test.skip. Root cause: flakiness. Scope: backend tests only. TODO: fix read-docs-tool.test.ts.

94e3b0c38f1e25cb8eff0890400ffdd0ce93f2bf.title: DynamicAgentTemplateSchema adds tool/outputMode validation rules
94e3b0c38f1e25cb8eff0890400ffdd0ce93f2bf.summary: Added two refine checks to DynamicAgentTemplateSchema in common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts. First, if 'set_output' is in toolNames, outputMode must be 'json'. Second, if subagents array is non-empty, 'spawn_agents' must be in toolNames. These validations enforce correct tool configuration for JSON output and subagent spawning.

f6bcb4ef5b599144e3d956a8690f2a5a26bc0480.title: Move agent config validation to server
f6bcb4ef5b599144e3d956a8690f2a5a26bc0480.summary: Relaxed client-side Zod schemas in `common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts` and `common/src/util/file.ts` to accept `any` types, shifting strict validation to the server. `npm-app/src/agents/load-agents.ts` removes local `DynamicAgentConfigSchema.parse` calls, storing raw configs with stringified `handleSteps` instead. Error messages in `common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts` now include agent display names and IDs for better context. Covers Core shared types, CLI loader, and validation utilities.

63a113df6b6604e45ed0ea4731e62df896ea2088.title: Local agent templates load once in CLI bootstrap
63a113df6b6604e45ed0ea4731e62df896ea2088.summary: Local agent templates now load once via `loadLocalAgents` in `npm-app/src/index.ts` `readyPromise`. Removed duplicate `loadLocalAgents` calls from `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` `getProjectFileContext` and `npm-app/src/cli.ts` `Promise.all`. `CLI` constructor and `initialize` signatures updated to accept `Promise<[ProjectFileContext, void, void]>`. Scope limited to npm-app CLI bootstrap.

fddfb181b3a65de0b44bcccf214b962ac228916e.title: Fix tool definitions output path
fddfb181b3a65de0b44bcccf214b962ac228916e.summary: Updated `generate-tool-definitions.ts` to write to `common/src/util/types/tools.d.ts` instead of `common/src/util/tools.d.ts`. This aligns the generator with the actual location of the type definitions. Reformatted `tools.d.ts` to single-line union and quoted keys.

be46935411f83652527754ff8dd39713f6dfb7f6.title: Add loopAgentSteps STEP behavior tests
be46935411f83652527754ff8dd39713f6dfb7f6.summary: New test file backend/src/__tests__/loop-agent-steps.test.ts validates loopAgentSteps STEP handling. Covers programmatic agents yielding STEP (triggering single LLM call) and completing via end_turn (zero LLM calls). Internal repo change only.

485bea43a8e879f9baeb76a501d311138e5819cb.title: toolResult string replaces wrapper object
485bea43a8e879f9baeb76a501d311138e5819cb.summary: Tool results return strings directly, removing `ToolResult` wrapper. `run-programmatic-step.ts` extracts `.result` before passing to generator. Type definitions in `common/src/types/agent-template.ts` and `agent-config.d.ts` updated to `string | undefined`. `thinking-base.ts` drops `end_turn` check inside loop.

117ab40956c9ab02b23ad4d8b937ec63d95b7e6b.title: Remove agent name normalization and override types
117ab40956c9ab02b23ad4d8b937ec63d95b7e6b.summary: Deleted `normalizeAgentName` and `normalizeAgentNames` from `common/src/util/agent-name-normalization.ts`, removing implicit stripping of the `CodebuffAI/` org prefix. Removed `common/src/types/agent-overrides.ts` and associated validation logic in `agent-template-validation.ts`. Updated `agent-name-resolver.ts` and `agent-validation.ts` to use raw agent IDs without normalization. Web docs components `AgentOverrideSchemaDisplay` removed from `web/src/components/docs/mdx/`.

343d7841cc1159d658bb8c2bd204d56b3848b58a.title: Remove redundant prompts and output schemas from .agents configs
343d7841cc1159d658bb8c2bd204d56b3848b58a.summary: Removed explicit `systemPrompt` template injections (e.g. `{CODEBUFF_TOOLS_PROMPT}`, `{CODEBUFF_AGENTS_PROMPT}`) and `stepPrompt` fields from multiple agent configs in `.agents/`. Deleted `outputSchema` and `outputMode` definitions from `git-committer.ts` and `agent-builder.ts` (renamed from `sonnet4-agent-builder.ts`). Simplified `handleSteps` logic in `changes-reviewer.ts`, `file-explorer.ts`, and `file-picker.ts` by removing optional chaining on tool results and unused variable assignments. Renamed `sonnet4-agent-builder.ts` to `agent-builder.ts` and updated its internal `id` and tool list.

a9ac1c4375bec000469115abdd72bb4b90e06663.text: Two unreliable internal checks were temporarily paused because they failed randomly. This change affects only the development team and does not impact how the product works for you.

0148b8f7a7cce8f7bfeb7e02f2281fb053e248f7.text: A small internal update asked the file-picking assistant to be more concise. This means it may give shorter, more direct answers when helping you find files.

343d7841cc1159d658bb8c2bd204d56b3848b58a.text: The assistant's internal instructions were simplified and cleaned up. This is a small technical change that should not affect how you use the product.

be46935411f83652527754ff8dd39713f6dfb7f6.text: Developers added internal checks to ensure the assistant handles specific instructions correctly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

fddfb181b3a65de0b44bcccf214b962ac228916e.text: The software now saves its internal instructions in the correct folder. This is a small fix that keeps things running smoothly for you.

63a113df6b6604e45ed0ea4731e62df896ea2088.text: The program now loads custom assistant settings only once at startup. This small internal update prevents unnecessary work but does not change how the product looks or feels.

117ab40956c9ab02b23ad4d8b937ec63d95b7e6b.text: The system now uses assistant names exactly as you enter them, without automatically hiding or changing company prefixes. This means names you see will match what you typed, making it clearer which assistant is which.

f6bcb4ef5b599144e3d956a8690f2a5a26bc0480.text: The program now checks agent settings on the server instead of the computer. This means the computer accepts more types of settings, and the server decides if they are correct.

485bea43a8e879f9baeb76a501d311138e5819cb.text: The system now shares plain text instead of a complex format. This small internal update makes the assistant's responses simpler and cleaner.

1def93b5a3ebe3aa0d55ee3ba4f4508c004392e1.title: Fix relative import in agents.ts
1def93b5a3ebe3aa0d55ee3ba4f4508c004392e1.summary: Corrected the `AgentTemplateTypes` import in `common/src/constants/agents.ts` from `src/types/session-state` to `../types/session-state`. This fixes module resolution failures when building or running tests that depend on this constants file.

c05cc909d0b6427286daa5622135a086cfb7cf99.title: Reduce PROFITMARGIN to 5.5% in message-cost-tracker
c05cc909d0b6427286daa5622135a086cfb7cf99.summary: PROFIT_MARGIN constant lowered from 0.3 to 0.055 in backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts. Adjusts internal cost calculation logic to reflect a tighter margin.

59edf2216b0c8b3f1209b1f22345d11cb491c797.title: Fix import path in dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts
59edf2216b0c8b3f1209b1f22345d11cb491c797.summary: Corrected import path for `AgentTemplateTypes` in `common/src/__tests__/dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts`. Changed from absolute path `src/types/session-state` to relative path `../types/session-state`. Fixes typecheck errors in the shared core test suite.

5f8870d7261d3e0a42b499f5c52611770ab2a654.title: Fix ToolCall type for agent-config
5f8870d7261d3e0a42b499f5c52611770ab2a654.summary: ToolCall type in agent-config.d.ts changed from interface to mapped type. This ensures strict association between toolName and args in handleSteps generator. Affects .agents/types and common/src/util/types. file-picker.ts updated to handle potential undefined prompt.

dcf97aec60eba6d59bc9c1fed9e354426aba1ff5.title: SDK 0.0.3 updates publish script files field
dcf97aec60eba6d59bc9c1fed9e354426aba1ff5.summary: Bumps @codebuff/sdk version to 0.0.3. Modifies sdk/scripts/publish.js to replace wildcard file patterns (*.js, *.d.ts) with explicit directory entries (sdk/, common/) in the package.json files field. This ensures all built artifacts from the sdk and common subdirectories are correctly included in the published package. Scope limited to sdk/package.json and sdk/scripts/publish.js.

bd373f80a8158ef1b961df7d31f0721a7ca65b8e.title: Unescape newlines in .agents prompts
bd373f80a8158ef1b961df7d31f0721a7ca65b8e.summary: Added `scripts/convert-escaped-newlines.ts` to unescape `\n` sequences in `.agents` prompt files. This fixes rendering issues in `ask.ts`, `base*.ts`, `file-picker.ts`, and `knowledge-keeper.ts` where system prompts were stored as single-line strings with escaped newlines. The change ensures prompts are formatted correctly for agent execution.

cb67c9918f45e21abf10f92a106c691ae9086bad.title: SDK v0.0.2 replaces workspace dep with zod
cb67c9918f45e21abf10f92a106c691ae9086bad.summary: Bumps @codebuff/sdk to v0.0.2. Drops @codebuff/common workspace dependency for zod ^3.23.8. Switches imports to relative paths ../../common/src/... in client.ts, process-stream.ts, and types.ts. Publish script updates main/types/exports to ./sdk/src/index.js/.d.ts. processStream refactored to return new Promise directly.

cdd2732feb413f5349b2793f739418b81643e26d.title: Rename sonnet4agentbuilder to agentbuilder
cdd2732feb413f5349b2793f739418b81643e26d.summary: Renamed `sonnet4_agent_builder` to `agent_builder` in `AGENT_PERSONAS`. Updated `common/src/constants/agents.ts` and all consumer files in `backend/src/templates/agents/` (ask, base, file-picker, planner, researcher, reviewer, superagent, thinker, thinking-base) to use the new key. Changed `AGENT_PERSONAS` type constraint from `Record<string, ...>` to `Partial<Record<keyof typeof AgentTemplateTypes, ...>>` for stricter typing.

3191ed4ac57c59d4757a76ad30a2528bb2c7ee49.title: Initial @codebuff/sdk v0.0.1 package setup and publishing scripts
3191ed4ac57c59d4757a76ad30a2528bb2c7ee49.summary: New `@codebuff/sdk` package added with `CodebuffClient` and `runNewChat` for programmatic agent interaction. Includes `scripts/publish.js` to transform workspace deps into peer deps and prepare `dist/` for npm. Configured `tsconfig.json` for standalone compilation with declaration maps. Requires global `codebuff` CLI and `CODEBUFF_API_KEY`.

39fe906737675184504341cc8944ff08505797d9.title: Add open-source model agent suite
39fe906737675184504341cc8944ff08505797d9.summary: New agent configs in `.agents/opensource/` define a base orchestrator and specialized subagents (coder, file-picker, researcher, reviewer) using only open-source models like `qwen3-coder` and `gpt-oss-120b`. This provides a free, local-capable alternative to proprietary backends. Changes affect core agent definitions and model utility constants.

5f8870d7261d3e0a42b499f5c52611770ab2a654.text: The assistant now strictly matches each tool to its required details before running. This prevents errors when selecting tools. The change is small and internal.

772fb6736f8b613bb5a5f2cff480336b26a3220b.title: CODEBUFFAPIKEY env var support
772fb6736f8b613bb5a5f2cff480336b26a3220b.summary: Core constants export API_KEY_ENV_VAR to allow CODEBUFF_API_KEY bypass login. Client and SDK use process.env check before user token. c35393f6a7ed440d91bdc773b0808a28c4219fa0.title: Add getErrorObject util
c35393f6a7ed440d91bdc773b0808a28c4219fa0.summary: New getErrorObject function in common/src/util/error.ts extracts message, stack, and name from error objects. Provides standardized error serialization for shared core utilities.

ca3a556f4227a0de6fda1901881bb725210d9c76.title: Rename PrintModeObject to PrintModeEvent
ca3a556f4227a0de6fda1901881bb725210d9c76.summary: Renamed `PrintModeObject` type and `printModeObjectSchema` to `PrintModeEvent` and `printModeEventSchema` across backend, common, and SDK packages. Updated `onResponseChunk` callbacks in `run-agent-step.ts`, `spawn-agents.ts`, and `client.ts` to use the new type. Adjusted `AgentTemplateType` definition in `session-state.ts` to use `(string & {})` for better type inference.

1e55a7a09e3b4a2387941c0bafd712a2a9350e68.title: SDK: CODEBUFFBINARY moved to constants.ts
1e55a7a09e3b4a2387941c0bafd712a2a9350e68.summary: CODEBUFF_BINARY constant relocated to sdk/src/constants.ts from sdk/src/client.ts and sdk/src/process-stream.ts. Eliminates duplicate declarations across SDK modules. Affects only internal SDK package structure. Import paths updated in client.ts and process-stream.ts to reference shared constant.

e28dd1d7e1d77283c7e6b5c9d0c88c0a5e14ef2f.title: SDK: require prompt in print mode
e28dd1d7e1d77283c7e6b5c9d0c88c0a5e14ef2f.summary: SDK `runNewChat` and `continueChat` now take `prompt` and `params` directly instead of an `input` object. `InputType` removed from `sdk/src/types.ts`. 69e985100095577f03f64e32462eda928a5b5b12.title: Rename internal agent identifiers to kebab-case
69e985100095577f03f64e32462eda928a5b5b12.summary: Internal agent identifiers `file_picker` and `file_explorer` renamed to `file-picker` and `file-explorer` across types, configs, and CLI docs. 53f1a6ced6c797b7892183aefea9c197d806b383.title: Replace Claude Opus 4 with Opus 4.1
53f1a6ced6c797b7892183aefea9c197d806b383.summary: Model constant `anthropic/claude-4-opus-20250522` replaced with `anthropic/claude-opus-4.1` in `common/src/constants.ts` and `openrouterModels`. d44ef2aadf36cdee2acc6f6eb8f77e9a5a01f4ad.title: Fix <|endoftext|> literal in logitBias JSDoc

53f1a6ced6c797b7892183aefea9c197d806b383.text: The product now uses a newer version of its underlying intelligence. This change is internal and does not alter how you interact with the assistant.

ca3a556f4227a0de6fda1901881bb725210d9c76.text: Internal labels were renamed for clarity.

e28dd1d7e1d77283c7e6b5c9d0c88c0a5e14ef2f.text: The tool now requires a message to start or continue a chat. This change only affects how other programs connect to it, so your experience stays the same.

69e985100095577f03f64e32462eda928a5b5b12.text: The software team updated how the assistant labels its internal helpers to match a new standard. This change is small and internal. You will not see any difference in how the assistant works.

f4018046b52024b6ed2cfee6490a386ced1dbc39.text: This small internal update renamed a label for clarity. It does not change how the product works for you.

c35393f6a7ed440d91bdc773b0808a28c4219fa0.text: The app now collects error details in a consistent way. This internal improvement helps support staff diagnose problems faster, but you will not notice any change in how the product works.

02d9b66bb03af49cd3065afe48de04a50a7657f9.title: Add initial @codebuff/sdk package with CodebuffClient stub
02d9b66bb03af49cd3065afe48de04a50a7657f9.summary: Introduced @codebuff/sdk v1.0.0 as a private workspace package. d0e77491636ca5e0183ecf1f8f1c3580bacb8a7c.title: Fix researcher websearch args key
d0e77491636ca5e0183ecf1f8f1c3580bacb8a7c.summary: Researcher agent templates updated in .agents/researcher.ts and backend/src/templates/agents/researcher.ts. 6e38dc70e63b946baf6670a2ddb020327e66d3e5.title: Agents pin subagent versions via shared constant
6e38dc70e63b946baf6670a2ddb020327e66d3e5.summary: Agent configs in `.agents/` now import a shared `version` constant from `.agents/version.ts` to explicitly pin subagent dependencies. 1c316bcad2efcdbee05d33df22ed000f37001826.title: Centralize agent publisher and version in constants
1c316bcad2efcdbee05d33df22ed000f37001826.summary: Refactored agent configuration to import `publisher` and `version` from a new shared `.agents/constants.ts` file, replacing hardcoded strings and the deprecated `.agents/version.ts`. 49d43ad4489917dd30d71a10d88f829ac9d90f2d.title: Always throw AI SDK errors in prod

d0e77491636ca5e0183ecf1f8f1c3580bacb8a7c.text: The research assistant now uses the correct format when searching the web. This small internal fix helps it find information more reliably.

894cacff0897a61b5df730cbcefcaae4677c9038.text: The assistant's internal instructions were rearranged to match a new format. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

6e38dc70e63b946baf6670a2ddb020327e66d3e5.text: The system now locks specific versions of helper tools to ensure they always match correctly. This internal update keeps the assistant stable and prevents minor glitches.

1c316bcad2efcdbee05d33df22ed000f37001826.text: The team updated internal labels to keep assistant details consistent. This small change has no effect on how you use the product.

8b4782c66064526f3ff5f82aae8c8929ded7ea3d.title: baselite agent model set to openrouter/horizon-beta
8b4782c66064526f3ff5f82aae8c8929ded7ea3d.summary: base_lite template model updated from gemini2_5_flash to openrouter/horizon-beta in backend/src/templates/agent-list.ts. Import order for baseAgentBuilder adjusted. Internal config change for lite mode agent.

27272da6d21cab1375cfd7b5ff31a7c6d2f13af4.title: Update eval superagent instructions
27272da6d21cab1375cfd7b5ff31a7c6d2f13af4.summary: Enhanced `run-git-evals.ts` to render detailed agent steps including tool calls and results, replacing simple response text. Added explicit instruction to the superagent judge that file changes require tool calls, preventing false positives for completion. This improves the accuracy of automated eval judgments by providing richer context and clearer constraints.

31524dd2ffe0d4987c964b7d785081ce4d5afaf2.title: Evals CI concurrency raised to 100
31524dd2ffe0d4987c964b7d785081ce4d5afaf2.summary: The `run-eval-set` command in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` now uses `--concurrency 100` instead of 10. This change aims to speed up the evaluation process by increasing the number of parallel evaluations. Scope is limited to the CI workflow configuration.

0044ee481f88e5f33ccde6a3d81413644d471545.title: Add Windows multiline git commit prompt guidance
0044ee481f88e5f33ccde6a3d81413644d471545.summary: Updated system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts` to include specific instructions for multiline git commits on Windows. The prompt now advises ending each line with `^` to ensure correct parsing of the commit message body. This change addresses potential shell interpretation issues on Windows environments.

1638023eef33dd1e87ff9c4f1571f66e060b801d.title: evals.yml concurrency reduced to 10
1638023eef33dd1e87ff9c4f1571f66e060b801d.summary: Eval workflow concurrency limit reduced from 100 to 10. Change applied to .github/workflows/evals.yml run-eval-set command. Mitigates resource contention or rate limits during evaluation runs.

e4304f0610695fca33e934ace145d997ecb1ddfb.title: Git evals continue without prompt
e4304f0610695fca33e934ace145d997ecb1ddfb.summary: run-git-evals.ts no longer throws when agent decides 'continue' with missing next_prompt. Sets next_prompt to 'continue' string instead. Affects evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. Prevents eval crashes on superagent prompt omission.

ac3eab66b6c015a00474ab4c9b5b10d2457b0f07.title: Update strreplace tool example to show tab indentation
ac3eab66b6c015a00474ab4c9b5b10d2457b0f07.summary: The str_replace tool definition example in backend/src/tools/definitions/tool/str-replace.ts now includes a replacement case with tab characters. This demonstrates proper handling of indented code blocks during string replacement. The change affects only the tool's documentation example, not its functional logic.

98ac67e34a64b23585f31ca07cd74afa2d4f07bc.title: Add typecheck for tool call strings
98ac67e34a64b23585f31ca07cd74afa2d4f07bc.summary: getToolCallString now enforces strict Zod types for parameters when the tool name is a known ToolName, rejecting invalid keys or shapes at compile time. Example prompts in base-prompts.ts and prompts.ts were updated to use str_replace instead of write_file to match current tool schemas. send-agent-message, spawn-agents, and spawn-agents-async examples now pass native objects instead of JSON.stringify'd strings to params. This change affects backend tool definitions and common utilities, improving developer experience by catching tool usage errors before runtime.

4934f12749986fd4767c3ddad91e151ac2d851c2.title: Remove cbeasp from agent builder templates
4934f12749986fd4767c3ddad91e151ac2d851c2.summary: Removed cb_easp: false flags from agent builder template definitions in base-agent-builder.ts. Deleted unused AGENT_PERSONAS import. Internal cleanup of agent template configuration.

8b4782c66064526f3ff5f82aae8c8929ded7ea3d.text: The assistant's default thinking engine changed. This is a small internal update. You do not need to change anything.

ac3eab66b6c015a00474ab4c9b5b10d2457b0f07.text: A small internal update shows how the assistant handles indented text. This helps the assistant replace text accurately when it includes spaces or tabs.

1638023eef33dd1e87ff9c4f1571f66e060b801d.text: The system now runs fewer evaluation tasks at once. This keeps things stable and prevents slowdowns.

31524dd2ffe0d4987c964b7d785081ce4d5afaf2.text: The team increased the number of tests run at the same time for internal checks. This speeds up the evaluation process for the product's features.

27272da6d21cab1375cfd7b5ff31a7c6d2f13af4.text: An internal tool now checks work more carefully by requiring proof of actions, not just text claims. This helps the system accurately judge if tasks are truly finished.

4934f12749986fd4767c3ddad91e151ac2d851c2.text: The assistant's setup was cleaned up internally. This change fixes how the assistant is built behind the scenes and does not affect how you use the product.

98ac67e34a64b23585f31ca07cd74afa2d4f07bc.text: The system now checks instructions for tools more strictly to catch mistakes early. This internal cleanup helps prevent errors when the assistant tries to perform actions.

0044ee481f88e5f33ccde6a3d81413644d471545.text: A small internal update helps the system understand multi-line commit messages on Windows. You might see fewer errors when saving text that spans several lines.

e4304f0610695fca33e934ace145d997ecb1ddfb.text: The assistant now continues tasks automatically if it forgets to ask for the next step, instead of stopping with an error. This fixes a rare crash and keeps the workflow moving smoothly.

9d120f68d2646f2a13a56e363472b375ef11d7cc.title: Remove parent instructions validation from agent template validation
9d120f68d2646f2a13a56e363472b375ef11d7cc.summary: Removed `validateParentInstructions` and `formatParentInstructionsError` calls from `validateSingleAgent` in `common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts`. The validation block checking `template.parentInstructions` against `dynamicAgentIds` is deleted. Imports for these functions are also removed. This fixes a typecheck error.

e756fd3d88d54df8ca3e5ea9e07c6da455462d0f.title: Add handleSteps to file-explorer, file-picker, researcher agents
e756fd3d88d54df8ca3e5ea9e07c6da455462d0f.summary: handleSteps generator functions added to .agents/file-explorer.ts, .agents/file-picker.ts, and .agents/researcher.ts. file-explorer now orchestrates parallel file_picker spawns via spawn_agents tool. file-picker and researcher define explicit tool call sequences (find_files, web_search) ending in STEP_ALL. Internal agent config refactor.

851284e3c574f5f4f61264b329b2ba7d230b0fda.title: Preload agent info before @ menu
851284e3c574f5f4f61264b329b2ba7d230b0fda.summary: Preload `getLocalAgentInfo()` before `setTimeout` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Await promise inside timeout callback to prevent race conditions when displaying agent menu.

df2f2a8040b7751091a8e3040f0ec99fa7e097d1.title: Rename agentawarebase to baseagentbuilder
df2f2a8040b7751091a8e3040f0ec99fa7e097d1.summary: Renamed the internal agent template identifier and file from `agent_aware_base` to `base_agent_builder`. Updated `AgentTemplateTypes`, `AGENT_PERSONAS`, and related imports across backend templates and CLI handlers. This aligns naming conventions with existing builder patterns.

9e04d20f836041f6c884094f69f6c3ed300525b7.title: Fix tool call type in agent template
9e04d20f836041f6c884094f69f6c3ed300525b7.summary: Replaces `any` with `ToolCall` in `StepGenerator` yield type within `common/src/types/agent-template.ts`. Corrects generic tool call typing to enforce proper structure minus `toolCallId`. Internal type refinement in shared core.

18c6dc71deb8b178a046d0dc2cc3519094ebd5fb.title: file-explorer agent id uses AgentTemplateTypes enum
18c6dc71deb8b178a046d0dc2cc3519094ebd5fb.summary: Replaced hardcoded string literal with AgentTemplateTypes.file_explorer enum reference in backend/src/templates/agents/file-explorer.ts. Eliminates drift risk between agent ID definitions and template type constants. Scope limited to backend agent templates.

96d4ec940f3afb32bfae952aa445e2ef1da0b6b1.title: Publish multiple agents at once
96d4ec940f3afb32bfae952aa445e2ef1da0b6b1.summary: CLI publish command now accepts multiple agent IDs. Shared Zod schemas in common/src/types/api/agents/publish.ts define batch request/response payloads. Web API route and CLI handler updated to process arrays of DynamicAgentTemplate. Error responses include availablePublishers and validationErrors for each agent in the batch.

9a98a9628e12ff6a1307e44d61b40004daba75a2.title: publisher field required for agent publishing
9a98a9628e12ff6a1307e44d61b40004daba75a2.summary: Publishing agents now requires a `publisher` field in the agent config. The `--publisher` CLI flag and `publisherId` API parameter are removed. The publish route validates that all agents in a request share the same publisher ID.

ffc7b7d5eff47b4575e8f6a2c85155504c373787.title: Remove CLI edit agent flow, relocate type defs

Updated `.agents/sonnet4-agent-builder.ts` to read from the new type paths.

851284e3c574f5f4f61264b329b2ba7d230b0fda.text: The app now loads assistant details in advance to prevent the menu from appearing empty or outdated. This small internal fix makes the interface more reliable when you open the assistant list.

9e04d20f836041f6c884094f69f6c3ed300525b7.text: The assistant now strictly checks the format of its internal action instructions. This ensures tools are called correctly and reduces errors. It is a small internal fix.

df2f2a8040b7751091a8e3040f0ec99fa7e097d1.text: The team renamed an internal label for the assistant's setup tools. This change is small and invisible, so users will notice no difference.

9d120f68d2646f2a13a56e363472b375ef11d7cc.text: The system stopped checking a rule about how parent agents guide child agents. This fixes an internal error. You will not notice any change.

96d4ec940f3afb32bfae952aa445e2ef1da0b6b1.text: Users can now publish several agents at the same time instead of one by one. The system checks each agent individually and reports any errors for specific agents without stopping the entire process.

18c6dc71deb8b178a046d0dc2cc3519094ebd5fb.text: The system now uses a standard label for the file explorer. This small internal update prevents errors without changing how you use the product.

e756fd3d88d54df8ca3e5ea9e07c6da455462d0f.text: The assistant now breaks complex tasks into clear, step-by-step actions, making it easier to follow and trust its work.

d44ef2aadf36cdee2acc6f6eb8f77e9a5a01f4ad.text: The software now reads its own instructions more reliably. You will not notice any changes.

ece31b407f89f68ecb8b30bd1f5c6b2e8c38308d.title: Add handleSteps to agent builder config
ece31b407f89f68ecb8b30bd1f5c6b2e8c38308d.summary: Implemented `handleSteps` generator in `.agents/sonnet4-agent-builder.ts` to define agent creation and editing execution flow. This function orchestrates directory setup, template copying, and prompt injection based on `editMode` params. It ensures `/agents` command functionality by providing the missing step logic to the `AgentConfig`.

c4dc5d0473febb6d35718cfd66a6a51d65ecf28d.title: agent-builder template cleanup
c4dc5d0473febb6d35718cfd66a6a51d65ecf28d.summary: Removed `params` object from `inputSchema` in `.agents/sonnet4-agent-builder.ts`, leaving only `prompt` string. Updated system prompt to remove redundant type definition block. Fixed import paths in `backend/src/templates/agents/agent-builder.ts` to point to `common/src/util/types/` instead of `common/src/util/`.

2637bb80b7ac6d1705dcaf06445567cad5a15abf.title: Added example agents for code review, testing, and docs
2637bb80b7ac6d1705dcaf06445567cad5a15abf.summary: Added three new example agent configurations to common/src/util/example-agents/ to demonstrate progressive complexity. Each defines specific tool sets, input/output schemas, and system prompts for their respective tasks.

81bf172a7a092b9f8f23cbb16c3c0bb358bf46a1.title: agent-registry test type annotation
81bf172a7a092b9f8f23cbb16c3c0bb358bf46a1.summary: Added Record<string, AgentTemplate> type annotation to mockStaticTemplates in backend/src/__tests__/agent-registry.test.ts. Removed mockModule('../templates/agent-list') call. Internal test cleanup.

859ad7e54b51989ecc9de21310bc696b4f363f20.title: Add agent registry unit tests
859ad7e54b51989ecc9de21310bc696b4f363f20.summary: Added comprehensive unit tests for agent registry in backend/src/__tests__/agent-registry.test.ts. Tests cover getAgentTemplate priority order (local over database), database caching behavior, clearDatabaseCache, and assembleLocalAgentTemplates validation. Mocks @codebuff/common/db, drizzle-orm, and agent-validation modules.

881fb5fbfe4559d46b200b3d4e61a7338ced2ea6.title: Agent-aware-base replaces sonnet4-agent-builder
881fb5fbfe4559d46b200b3d4e61a7338ced2ea6.summary: New `agent_aware_base` template replaces `sonnet4_agent_builder` as primary agent creation handler. Base agent now spawns specialized builders dynamically. Files: `backend/src/templates/agents/agent-aware-base.ts`, `common/src/constants/agents.ts`, `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/agents.ts`. fd9f50be684550f2b3fbcfa836b96452fa2eb901.title: Genericize agent examples and config types
fd9f50be684550f2b3fbcfa836b96452fa2eb901.summary: Renamed example agents to `example-1.ts` through `example-3.ts` and updated backend loader to filter by `example-` prefix. Removed `parentPrompt`, `systemPrompt`, `instructionsPrompt`, and `stepPrompt` from `AgentConfig` interface. Added `sonnet4-agent-builder.ts` with new prompt structure. Scope covers `.agents/`, `backend/`, and `common/`.

98d7fdcc7c3e742db22596b70712dfc747597d9a.title: Fix slash command filtering to include commands with empty commandText
98d7fdcc7c3e742db22596b70712dfc747597d9a.summary: Updated `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to include commands with empty `commandText` in slash command filtering and added alias support. Modified `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to define `baseCommand` and `aliases` for commands like `login`, `logout`, `usage`, and `trace` (renamed from `subagent`). Adjusted `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/subagent-list.ts` and `subagent.ts` to reflect the terminology change from 'subagent' to 'trace' in user-facing messages and comments. This ensures commands like `/help` and `/usage` are correctly recognized and autocompleted despite having empty `commandText`.

c30879321093563c4b43bbb5f121323ce12bb704.text: The app now handles security checks automatically when you ask it to do something, removing a step you previously had to trigger yourself. This makes the process smoother and less likely to fail.

2637bb80b7ac6d1705dcaf06445567cad5a15abf.text: The product now includes three ready-to-use examples for reviewing code, creating tests, and writing documentation. These examples show how to set up different tasks step by step, from simple to more complex, helping you understand how to customize the assistant for your needs.

ece31b407f89f68ecb8b30bd1f5c6b2e8c38308d.text: The internal system for creating and editing AI agents now has a clear set of steps to follow. This small update fixes a missing piece so that the agent creation tool works correctly.

859ad7e54b51989ecc9de21310bc696b4f363f20.text: Added internal tests to check the system's assistant setup. No visible change to the product.

98d7fdcc7c3e742db22596b70712dfc747597d9a.text: Fixed a bug where some menu commands were hidden. Shortcuts now work correctly.

c4dc5d0473febb6d35718cfd66a6a51d65ecf28d.text: This internal update cleans up the template used to create custom AI assistants. It simplifies how instructions are sent to the assistant and fixes a technical path error. You will see no immediate change in how you use the product.

881fb5fbfe4559d46b200b3d4e61a7338ced2ea6.text: The system now creates specialized helpers automatically instead of using one fixed builder. Existing setups must update to use the new main assistant.

81bf172a7a092b9f8f23cbb16c3c0bb358bf46a1.text: Internal test cleanup. No user impact.

7b17f6ed1a64395d1a122323932488f7bd0c21cc.text: The tool now uses a more stable connection method for real-time updates. Some outdated message types were removed to clean up communication. These are internal improvements that make the software run smoother.

03001d7e21f8e7ad13ba01a5e0d290fa5282efd7.title: agents/publish API adds cookie then token auth fallback
03001d7e21f8e7ad13ba01a5e0d290fa5282efd7.summary: web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts now checks session cookie first, then falls back to checkAuthToken({ authToken }) on request body authToken. Previously cookie-only; CLI or non-browser publishers hitting 401 could not publish. Scope: web API route only. authToken is required field in publishAgentRequestSchema, validated via checkAuthToken from @codebuff/internal; 401 returned if both cookie and token fail.

b83e6d1c5d5899528fc2cd4e01db6b1af930507b.title: Charles agent sardine to tuna
b83e6d1c5d5899528fc2cd4e01db6b1af930507b.summary: Charles agent config in `.agents/charles.ts` swaps sardine for tuna across `displayName`, `systemPrompt`, `instructionsPrompt`, `stepPrompt`, and `prompt` description. `import` becomes `import type` for `AgentConfig`. Internal agent metadata only; no runtime behavior change. Model `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522` unchanged.

14b097934387989e9a4817ec58ed27d5328a4ca4.title: Agent page shows full ID with copy button
14b097934387989e9a4817ec58ed27d5328a4ca4.summary: Agent detail page now displays the full `publisher/agent@version` ID alongside an `EnhancedCopyButton`. The version is derived by sorting `allVersions` by `created_at` descending. This replaces the previous partial ID display and adds a `pointer-events-none` style to the version badge to prevent interaction conflicts.

26dcb4d0824f6f614e1a3c71b3adb051b0dd4a1a.title: publish.ts sends authToken in body instead of Cookie header
26dcb4d0824f6f614e1a3c71b3adb051b0dd4a1a.summary: The `publishAgentTemplate` function in `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/publish.ts` now includes `authToken` in the POST request body, replacing the previous `Cookie` header approach. This change aligns with backend expectations for authentication data placement. The update affects the CLI publish handler for agent templates.

3102f4b997c556abb4927abb8f962063ed2b521e.title: Add backend agent configs to .agents directory
3102f4b997c556abb4927abb8f962063ed2b521e.summary: New agent configuration files added to `.agents/` for `ask`, `base-experimental`, `base-lite`, and others. These define models (e.g., `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05`), tool sets, and system prompts for backend orchestration. Updates `backend/src/templates/agent-list.ts` and `common/src/types/session-state.ts` to register these agents. Excludes agent builder per notes.

e5faeba512eac048bb1c87d21798262a5342e445.title: agent-validation rejects empty schema objects
e5faeba512eac048bb1c87d21798262a5342e445.summary: convertInputSchema now throws on empty or non-object inputPromptSchema and paramsSchema instead of silently skipping. Validation checks typeof and Object.keys length before Zod conversion. Error messages updated to require non-empty JSON schema objects. Affects common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts.

e9162fbe8f71f75ae9158b80a87370ec035f8289.title: pluralize() f/fe rule reorder + credit/user noun casing
e9162fbe8f71f75ae9158b80a87370ec035f8289.summary: common/src/util/string.ts pluralize() now checks f/fe endings before y and sibilant rules. 434a95f4e3ce4356ef0633e6edac259e23aa45fe.title: Agent registry loads DB agents with versioned IDs and validation
434a95f4e3ce4356ef0633e6edac259e23aa45fe.summary: fetchAgentFromDatabase in backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts now accepts a parsed ID object, treats 'latest' as a version wildcard, and stamps loaded agents with publisher/agent-id@version before passing them through validateSingleAgent. common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts drops its outer try/catch, moves collectAgentIds and duplicate-ID detection into validateAgents, and switches validateSingleAgent to an options-object signature. common/src/templates/dynamic-agent-functions.ts is a new file exporting collectAgentIds and validateAgents for standalone dynamic-template loading. 061bb95cd6de361b5b374ab07c811a1e6f49453f.summary: Unit tests in backend and common packages replace hardcoded string literals for agent IDs with `AgentTemplateTypes` enum values. Imports updated in `main-prompt.test.ts`, `parent-instructions.test.ts`, and `dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts`. This aligns test fixtures with the shared type definitions, ensuring consistency when agent IDs change. Note: `base_max` ID in `main-prompt.test.ts` was corrected to `base-max`.

03001d7e21f8e7ad13ba01a5e0d290fa5282efd7.text: The publishing feature now accepts a second type of login key. This lets more tools post updates without failing.

3102f4b997c556abb4927abb8f962063ed2b521e.text: The system now includes new instructions for different assistant modes, allowing them to use updated tools and thinking styles. These internal changes help the assistants respond more effectively to your requests.

26dcb4d0824f6f614e1a3c71b3adb051b0dd4a1a.text: The tool now sends login details in a different way. This keeps the publishing feature working correctly. You will not see any changes.

e5faeba512eac048bb1c87d21798262a5342e445.text: The system now blocks empty or invalid setup details instead of ignoring them. You will see a clear error if you leave required settings blank, preventing confusing failures later.

b83e6d1c5d5899528fc2cd4e01db6b1af930507b.text: The assistant's internal name changed from Sardine to Tuna. This is a small, behind-the-scenes update that does not change how the assistant works or what it can do for you.

14b097934387989e9a4817ec58ed27d5328a4ca4.text: The agent detail page now shows the full identifier for each agent and includes a button to copy it. This makes it easier to share or reference specific agents without guessing at partial names.

39fe906737675184504341cc8944ff08505797d9.text: The assistant can now use free, open-source models instead of paid ones. This lets you run it on your own computer without needing an internet connection or subscription.

8a13db603118abb3ff149c90e632db543548a0eb.title: Restore default export in changes-reviewer
8a13db603118abb3ff149c90e632db543548a0eb.summary: Added `export default config` to `.agents/changes-reviewer.ts`. Restores the missing default export required by the agent configuration loader.

428d4a2077143f3dd8bbc36d824fc8f3f3c84876.title: Reorder agent config types and update changes-reviewer
428d4a2077143f3dd8bbc36d824fc8f3f3c84876.summary: Refactored `agent-config.d.ts` by moving prompt fields (`parentPrompt`, `systemPrompt`, etc.) out of the core `AgentConfig` interface and reordering type definitions in `tools.d.ts`. Updated `.agents/changes-reviewer.ts` to align with new config structure, explicitly setting `includeMessageHistory: false` and reordering instructions. Scope covers shared core types and the internal changes-reviewer agent. No user-facing behavior changes; purely internal type hygiene and config alignment.

cafe220ad4f83aa24c5829b4cc9cb7353ebf4ee6.title: CLI --publisher flag for agent publishing
cafe220ad4f83aa24c5829b4cc9cb7353ebf4ee6.summary: Added --publisher flag to CLI publish command. Backend API now accepts optional publisherId to select specific publisher profile. Database query updated to fetch user-owned and org-admin publishers via joins instead of single latest lookup. Covers npm-app CLI definitions, handlers, and web API route.

32e9eaced0261c508a6633c9520e33c843c90288.title: Agent detail page displays publisher ID instead of name
32e9eaced0261c508a6633c9520e33c843c90288.summary: Agent detail page renders `@{publisherData.id}` instead of `@{publisherData.name}` in the publisher credit line. Change addresses org/publisher feedback regarding attribution visibility. Affects `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx`.

6afaedf2780868da8f1e615d1c61b6447edd597a.title: Simplify publishers page version display
6afaedf2780868da8f1e615d1c61b6447edd597a.summary: Replaced the multi-version button grid on the publishers page with a single 'Latest: vX' text line. Removed the `VersionButton` component and its import from `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/page.tsx`. This change reduces visual clutter and simplifies the UI by focusing on the latest version rather than listing up to six.

bf5e301c79b4133c9ec854ab295d20c80b16fc29.title: Publishers API agent count uses selectDistinct
bf5e301c79b4133c9ec854ab295d20c80b16fc29.summary: The `/api/publishers` GET handler switches from `select({ count: ... })` to `selectDistinct({ id: ... })` to count distinct agent IDs, excluding versions. The Web UI publishers page removes static counts from `Personal Publishers` and `Organization Publishers` headers, relying on `pluralize` from `@codebuff/common/util/string` for agent labels. Changes cover `web/src/app/api/publishers/route.ts` and `web/src/app/publishers/page.tsx`. The API now returns the length of distinct `schema.agentConfig.id` results.

8bb59e8230290449320080bd9ac6b9474da8830d.title: Consolidate publisher creation into /publishers route
8bb59e8230290449320080bd9ac6b9474da8830d.summary: The separate `/publishers/new` page is deleted, merging the multi-step creation wizard directly into the `/publishers` page component. Organization settings and user dropdown links now point to `/publishers` (with optional `org` param) instead of `/publishers/new`. The `BillingStatus` component was removed from the organization settings page, leaving Publisher Management as the primary section. This consolidation reduces route complexity and centralizes publisher profile creation logic within a single file.

4f44503c013b7a94ff1a6e6467767916a8e70b0b.title: Restore /publishers/new route for publisher creation
4f44503c013b7a94ff1a6e6467767916a8e70b0b.summary: Reverts previous routing change, restoring dedicated `/publishers/new` page for publisher creation. `web/src/app/publishers/new/page.tsx` reintroduced with multi-step form (ownership, basic info, profile details). `web/src/app/publishers/page.tsx` simplified to list-only view. Org settings link updated to `/publishers/new?org={id}&type=organization`. Navbar `Publishers` dropdown item removed.

428d4a2077143f3dd8bbc36d824fc8f3f3c84876.text: Developers organized the assistant's internal instructions more clearly. This is a small behind-the-scenes cleanup that does not change how the product works for you.

ffc7b7d5eff47b4575e8f6a2c85155504c373787.text: The tool removed a confusing way to change custom helpers and switched to a simpler method for creating them. This internal cleanup makes the setup process smoother without changing what the helpers do.

4f44503c013b7a94ff1a6e6467767916a8e70b0b.text: The page for adding a new publisher has been restored to its original location. This means you can still create a publisher through the organization settings, but the shortcut in the top menu is gone.

cafe220ad4f83aa24c5829b4cc9cb7353ebf4ee6.text: People who manage multiple publishing profiles can now choose which one to use when sending updates.

32e9eaced0261c508a6633c9520e33c843c90288.text: The page now shows the publisher's name instead of a code number. This makes it easier to see who published the content.

8bb59e8230290449320080bd9ac6b9474da8830d.text: The 'create new publisher' form now sits on the main publisher list page. You no longer visit a separate page to add a publisher.

9a98a9628e12ff6a1307e44d61b40004daba75a2.text: Publishing an assistant now requires specifying the publisher within its settings. Command-line options and API parameters for this detail are removed. The system checks that all assistants in a single request share the same publisher.

8a13db603118abb3ff149c90e632db543548a0eb.text: A small internal fix restored the assistant's default settings. You should see no visible change.

8be0ee4da114042c498c476f9636e2bd19ce0561.title: Fix ToolResult type definition in agent-config
8be0ee4da114042c498c476f9636e2bd19ce0561.summary: Corrects the `ToolResult` interface in `agent-config.d.ts` by replacing the legacy `success`/`data`/`error` shape with `toolName`, `toolCallId`, and `result` fields. This aligns the type definition with the actual runtime output of tool executions. The change applies to both `.agents/types/agent-config.d.ts` and `common/src/util/agent-config.d.ts`.

d207ff68dfbf510eba4f15c6cc46e761542d8fe8.title: Publisher creation flow moved to /publishers
d207ff68dfbf510eba4f15c6cc46e761542d8fe8.summary: New /publishers page replaces /publishers/new. Org settings link updated to /publishers?org=...&type=organization. Multi-step form handles personal and organization publisher profiles.

dd600ffc724ef2fde296d49ca596f6bd7b0ebe14.title: Refactor publisher creation with modular steps and live ID validation
dd600ffc724ef2fde296d49ca596f6bd7b0ebe14.summary: Publisher onboarding flow split into `basic-info-step`, `ownership-step`, and `profile-details-step` components, replacing monolithic form logic. New `/api/publishers/validate` endpoint enables real-time ID availability checks via `useDebounce`. Shared validation rules moved to `lib/validators/publisher.ts` for reuse across client and server. `web/src/app/publishers/page.tsx` now orchestrates state and step transitions.

64b95a78547e1abc8015aa371bc89af4e516d578.title: Add changes-reviewer agent config
64b95a78547e1abc8015aa371bc89af4e516d578.summary: New `.agents/changes-reviewer.ts` defines `changes-reviewer` agent (v0.0.1, `x-ai/grok-4`). Spawns on demand to review diffs. Uses `git diff HEAD --name-only`, `git status --porcelain`, `git diff HEAD` to collect changed and untracked files, then `read_files` for review. Scope: internal repo tooling only.

a447f95766f235935ce322c14e524b8cbe24b51c.title: tools.d.ts reorder
a447f95766f235935ce322c14e524b8cbe24b51c.summary: Reorder `ToolName` union and `ToolParamsMap` interface to top of `common/src/util/tools.d.ts`. Update `common/src/tools/compile-tool-definitions.ts` to generate these types before individual tool interfaces. Change `backend/src/templates/agents/agent-builder.ts` to read `tools.d.ts` directly from disk instead of calling `compileToolDefinitions()`.

3205731013904f23094a12865f5ef90d9627bfd9.title: Add org publisher API and agent versioning UI
3205731013904f23094a12865f5ef90d9627bfd9.summary: New API route /api/orgs/[orgId]/publishers fetches organization publishers with agent counts. Publisher profile pages now group agents by name and display version history via new agent detail routes. UI components updated to support version selection and JSON viewing for agents.

75420684d805f178a5c0f7e11c47fe5fcf46d9eb.title: Publishers support org ownership
75420684d805f178a5c0f7e11c47fe5fcf46d9eb.summary: Publisher entities now accept `org_id` and `created_by` columns, with `user_id` made nullable. Migration 0028 drops the old user constraint, adds foreign keys to `org` and `user`, and updates schema types. Covers `common/src/db`, `web/src/lib/publisher-permissions.ts`, API routes, CLI `publish.ts`, and UI. `created_by` is NOT NULL; `org_id` optional.

410255d3bae0bcbd08a406fcbb9782f9d246456a.title: Refactor agent template registry and resolution
410255d3bae0bcbd08a406fcbb9782f9d246456a.summary: Agent template resolution shifted from a global `agentRegistry` to localized `localAgentTemplates` passed via options, removing dynamic imports and circular dependency risks. The `agent-registry.ts` file now implements a database-backed cache for remote agents alongside static templates, parsing IDs as `publisher/agent@version`. `mainPrompt` and `runAgentStep` were updated to accept `localAgentTemplates` directly, eliminating the need for `getAllAgentTemplates` calls in hot paths.

9113967080b38198f9593ea40eeb98e8cae7997a.title: Fix avatar upload to save data URL to DB
9113967080b38198f9593ea40eeb98e8cae7997a.summary: Avatar uploads in `web/src/app/publishers/page.tsx` now persist `data:` URLs directly to the database instead of relying on a separate upload step that failed to save. `web/src/components/ui/avatar-upload.tsx` was updated to convert files to base64 data URLs via `FileReader` immediately upon selection. This removes the `uploadAvatar` helper and associated state from the publisher creation flow, ensuring the `avatar_url` field in the submit payload contains the actual image data.

64b95a78547e1abc8015aa371bc89af4e516d578.text: The internal review tool now checks recent changes automatically. This helps catch mistakes before updates reach users. It is a small, behind-the-scenes improvement.

75420684d805f178a5c0f7e11c47fe5fcf46d9eb.text: Publishers can now be owned by organizations. This lets teams manage shared publishing accounts more easily.

3205731013904f23094a12865f5ef90d9627bfd9.text: The publisher list now shows how many assistants each one offers. Assistant pages group similar assistants together and let you see past versions.

d207ff68dfbf510eba4f15c6cc46e761542d8fe8.text: The page for creating publisher profiles has moved to a new location. You can now set up both personal and organization profiles in one place.

dd600ffc724ef2fde296d49ca596f6bd7b0ebe14.text: The sign-up process is now broken into smaller, easier steps. You can check if your publisher name is available instantly while typing.

a447f95766f235935ce322c14e524b8cbe24b51c.text: The system now organizes its internal instructions more efficiently. This is a small technical cleanup that does not change how the product works for you.

8be0ee4da114042c498c476f9636e2bd19ce0561.text: The internal description of how tool results are recorded was corrected to match the actual data produced. This small, internal fix ensures the system accurately tracks which tool was used and what it returned.

7873f8311694903fc425caf3cc04cfae57fc1fc4.title: Remove unused details field from DynamicAgentValidationError
7873f8311694903fc425caf3cc04cfae57fc1fc4.summary: Removed `details` from `DynamicAgentValidationError` interface and `validateAgents` logic in `common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts`. Updated `web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts` to stop concatenating `details` into error messages. Scope covers shared core types and web API surface. Change eliminates redundant data structure.

b97e8c1d7690a052b1d1d3035ee58ef5f8686273.title: Drop keepDuringTruncation from run-agent-step user message
b97e8c1d7690a052b1d1d3035ee58ef5f8686273.summary: Removed `keepDuringTruncation: true` from the user message payload in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. This aligns with the 'fix types' intent, likely resolving a type mismatch or unnecessary property in the message object definition. Scope is limited to the backend agent execution logic.

fd549691e1225ea3bc1950707b849b0660aef58a.title: Enforce explicit json outputMode for outputSchema
fd549691e1225ea3bc1950707b849b0660aef58a.summary: DynamicAgentTemplateSchema now rejects templates where outputSchema is present but outputMode is not explicitly 'json'. Removed implicit defaulting logic in validateSingleAgent that previously coerced undefined outputMode to 'json' when outputSchema existed. This change affects common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts and common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts. Existing templates relying on implicit behavior must be updated to explicitly set outputMode: 'json'.

9616ee028343f0afa46ce10206604a4dbb2bf11d.title: Replace DynamicAgentService with validateAgents function
9616ee028343f0afa46ce10206604a4dbb2bf11d.summary: The stateful DynamicAgentService class was removed and replaced by a pure validateAgents function in common/src/templates/agent-validation.ts. This eliminates the async loadAgents method and internal class state, switching to synchronous validation logic. The change propagates to backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts and web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts, updating imports and call sites to use the new functional API.

9c5d2d175e9dec606c18996cffd1f4858360b23f.title: Add hot reloading for local agents
9c5d2d175e9dec606c18996cffd1f4858360b23f.summary: Local agent loading switched from dynamic `import()` to `require()` with cache invalidation (`delete require.cache[fullPath]`) to enable hot reloading of `.agents` files. `npm-app/src/agents/load-agents.ts` implements this mechanism, while `npm-app/src/client.ts` integrates `loadLocalAgents` into session initialization. `npm-app/src/cli.ts` refactors user input forwarding to use `this.forwardUserInput`. `.agents/brainstormer.ts` updated to use `import type` for `AgentConfig`.

5b00580593d2c47f24f40c05b5f72666e3b6dc7a.title: Replace CoreMessage with CodebuffMessage
5b00580593d2c47f24f40c05b5f72666e3b6dc7a.summary: Backend type definitions migrated from `CoreMessage` (Vercel AI SDK) to `CodebuffMessage` (`@codebuff/common/types/message`). Refactor removes dependency on external SDK types for internal message handling. Updates affect `fast-rewrite.ts`, `request-files-prompt.ts`, `message-cost-tracker.ts`, and `ai-sdk.ts`. Utility functions renamed: `getCoreMessagesSubset` becomes `getMessagesSubset`, `coreMessagesWithSystem` becomes `messagesWithSystem`. Dead code `check-for-loop.ts` deleted.

3d810733f24820330c90e528a36c949fce46bb32.title: Add keepDuringTruncation flag to preserve key messages during context
3d810733f24820330c90e528a36c949fce46bb32.summary: CodebuffMessageSchema gains optional keepDuringTruncation boolean. trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit now calculates required tokens for flagged messages first, then removes unflagged messages to fit the remaining budget, replacing removed blocks with 'Previous message(s) omitted due to length'. run-agent-step.ts sets keepDuringTruncation: true for user prompts, instructions, and step prompts, while defaulting history to false. This ensures critical context survives aggressive shortening.

7873f8311694903fc425caf3cc04cfae57fc1fc4.text: The app stopped carrying extra, unused error information when checking agent settings. This makes no difference to how the product works or looks for users.

434a95f4e3ce4356ef0633e6edac259e23aa45fe.text: The system now checks new assistant settings more carefully before using them. If a setting is broken, the system ignores it instead of stopping everything.

3d810733f24820330c90e528a36c949fce46bb32.text: The assistant now protects important instructions from being cut out when the conversation gets too long. This ensures it remembers what you asked for, even if older chat history is removed to save space.

9c5d2d175e9dec606c18996cffd1f4858360b23f.text: The assistant now notices changes to its local custom rules without needing a restart. This small internal update lets the system reload these settings automatically while running.

5b00580593d2c47f24f40c05b5f72666e3b6dc7a.text: The system updated its internal message handling to use its own standard format. This change is invisible to you and does not affect how you use the product.

9616ee028343f0afa46ce10206604a4dbb2bf11d.text: The system now checks agent settings instantly, without loading them in the background. This makes the process faster and simpler for you.

b97e8c1d7690a052b1d1d3035ee58ef5f8686273.text: A small internal cleanup removed an unnecessary instruction from the assistant's memory settings. This change does not affect how you use the product.

061bb95cd6de361b5b374ab07c811a1e6f49453f.text: Internal tests now use a shared list of assistant names instead of typing them out each time. This makes the tests more reliable if names change, but you won't notice any difference in how the product works.

fd549691e1225ea3bc1950707b849b0660aef58a.text: The assistant now requires a specific setting to format its answers as structured data. If your custom instructions relied on automatic formatting, you must update them to explicitly choose that option.

2662f7293d022e8ac34e3f8d864764ab5a5eec4c.title: Add publisherid to agentconfig primary key
2662f7293d022e8ac34e3f8d864764ab5a5eec4c.summary: Migration 0027 replaces `agent_config` primary key with composite `(publisher_id, id, version)`. Drops old `agent_config_id_version_pk`. Ensures agent config uniqueness per publisher. Schema in `common/src/db/schema.ts` updated.

db27f2647832129d0e6c2a9aa47e371c75d64f2c.title: Remove unused agent imports from npm-app client
db27f2647832129d0e6c2a9aa47e371c75d64f2c.summary: Removed unused imports `AGENT_NAME_TO_TYPES` and `UNIQUE_AGENT_NAMES` from `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Also applied trailing comma fixes to function arguments and array literals throughout the file for consistency. This cleanup reduces bundle size slightly and aligns code style.

f49314023bf975ad86703ecb51e01505d994ea66.title: Run prettier on all files
f49314023bf975ad86703ecb51e01505d994ea66.summary: Applied prettier formatting to codebase. Changed quote styles, indentation, and line breaks in .agents/charles.ts, .agents/types/tools.d.ts, and backend/README.md. Updated markdown spacing in .github/knowledge.md, WINDOWS.md, and authentication.knowledge.md. Fixed missing newline at end of .github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml.

2646a8f0111a6be37bda72472e595afb8da3b1dd.title: agent-builder move types into .agents/types subdirectory
2646a8f0111a6be37bda72472e595afb8da3b1dd.summary: agent-builder.ts relocates agent type definitions from the root `.agents` directory to `.agents/types`. `TEMPLATE_TYPES_PATH` and `TOOL_DEFINITIONS_PATH` now resolve against `TYPES_DIR`, and the `mkdir` command targets this new subdirectory. Generated agent templates must import `AgentConfig` from `./types/agent-config`. Updates prompt instructions and file path constants in `backend/src/templates/agents/agent-builder.ts`.

7e79c46ba0f7f6e3c4d607e71e98154f679615b8.title: Enforce ESLint import ordering and type-only imports across backend
7e79c46ba0f7f6e3c4d607e71e98154f679615b8.summary: Refactored import statements in numerous backend files to comply with ESLint rules, specifically moving type-only imports to `import type` syntax and reordering modules. This change affects core API handlers, admin utilities, and agent managers like `backend/src/api/usage.ts` and `backend/src/async-agent-manager.ts`. The update ensures consistent code style and potentially improves build-time type checking by explicitly separating runtime dependencies from type definitions.

aa1411205856175ee44107e466698d6d05977cea.title: determineNextVersion now rejects provided versions not greater than
aa1411205856175ee44107e466698d6d05977cea.summary: Replaced getMaximumVersion with isGreater in packages/internal/src/utils/version-utils.ts to enforce strict version incrementing. determineNextVersion now throws an error if providedVersion is less than or equal to the latest published version, instead of silently selecting the maximum. This prevents accidental downgrades or no-ops in agent versioning.

97c88e135c82741c1d3935b2b1708ecb470d9223.title: Refactor agent prompt placeholder injection in backend
97c88e135c82741c1d3935b2b1708ecb470d9223.summary: Replaced hardcoded TOOLS_PROMPT injection logic in `getAgentPrompt` with a generic `additionalPlaceholders` map in `backend/src/templates/strings.ts`. Now supports injecting `AGENTS_PROMPT` into system prompts if missing, alongside existing `TOOLS_PROMPT` behavior. Scope limited to backend template processing. The new loop appends any missing placeholders from the map to the end of the prompt string.

9ed2ed7bb5d876e51add2e2a94b369ab7232f959.title: Move .agents type defs to types dir
9ed2ed7bb5d876e51add2e2a94b369ab7232f959.summary: Relocated `agent-config.d.ts` and `tools.d.ts` to `.agents/types/`. Updated imports in `brainstormer.ts`, `charles.ts`, `git-committer.ts`, and `knowledge-keeper.ts`. Made `stepPrompt` optional in `AgentConfig`. Commented out `parentInstructions` in `brainstormer.ts`.

aa1411205856175ee44107e466698d6d05977cea.text: The system now blocks attempts to set an agent's version to a number that is not higher than the current one. This prevents accidental mistakes where the version stays the same or goes backward.

6afaedf2780868da8f1e615d1c61b6447edd597a.text: The publishers page now shows only the newest version, replacing the cluttered list of older ones. This makes the screen cleaner and easier to read for everyday users.

97c88e135c82741c1d3935b2b1708ecb470d9223.text: The assistant's internal instructions are now added more flexibly. This small, behind-the-scenes change helps the system include necessary information automatically, improving how it responds without affecting what you see.

f49314023bf975ad86703ecb51e01505d994ea66.text: The software's internal text was automatically standardized. This change affects only the underlying code structure and does not alter how the product works or what it does for you.

2662f7293d022e8ac34e3f8d864764ab5a5eec4c.text: A small internal update ensures that each assistant setting belongs to only one publisher. This prevents duplicate or conflicting configurations.

9ed2ed7bb5d876e51add2e2a94b369ab7232f959.text: A small internal update reorganized how the software finds its instructions. This does not change how you use the product.

7e79c46ba0f7f6e3c4d607e71e98154f679615b8.text: Internal code cleanup. No changes to features or performance.

bf5e301c79b4133c9ec854ab295d20c80b16fc29.text: The list of publishers now shows the correct number of people. This fixes a small counting error on the page.

db27f2647832129d0e6c2a9aa47e371c75d64f2c.text: The team removed extra, unused instructions from the assistant's setup and tidied up the code format. This internal cleanup slightly reduced the app's size and improved consistency, but you will not notice any difference in how it works.

2646a8f0111a6be37bda72472e595afb8da3b1dd.text: The system now stores its building blocks in a tidier folder. This is an internal cleanup that makes the software easier to maintain, with no visible changes to how you use the product.

71c4ce12f25622b9d168de56a3d08a2a57cbbc63.title: Remove unused version regex constant
71c4ce12f25622b9d168de56a3d08a2a57cbbc63.summary: Removed the unused `versionRegex` constant from `packages/internal/src/utils/version-utils.ts`. This change cleans up dead code in the internal utils package. No functional impact on version parsing or agent version determination logic.

4910cdaee920ba5099266043301c7e6e67819379.title: Add @AgentName spawn directive to base prompt
4910cdaee920ba5099266043301c7e6e67819379.summary: Added instruction to `backend/src/templates/base-prompts.ts` requiring agent spawning when users mention `@AgentName`. This ensures the model respects explicit user requests to invoke specific sub-agents. Scope limited to backend prompt templates. The directive mandates spawning all mentioned agents.

e25b24b2a4d4c19eed5b79143ac0402cf1a8cf33.title: Refactor version handling to structured object
e25b24b2a4d4c19eed5b79143ac0402cf1a8cf33.summary: Version logic in `packages/internal` shifts from string parsing to a structured `Version` object with `major`, `minor`, `patch` fields. `getLatestAgentVersion` now returns a `Version` object instead of a string or null, defaulting to `{ major: 0, minor: 0, patch: 0 }` if no version exists. The `web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts` consumer updates to accept the `Version` type and uses `stringifyVersion` before inserting into the database. This internal refactor improves type safety and comparison logic via `getMaximumVersion`.

dbdbac636d7ae581f4c058f33979eb1fcbdceafd.title: Publisher profile system and agent publishing CLI
dbdbac636d7ae581f4c058f33979eb1fcbdceafd.summary: Added publisher profile management via new web routes (`/api/publishers`, `/api/upload/avatar`) and UI pages for creating/editing profiles. CLI `publish` command updated to send structured validation errors and stack traces, replacing generic logger calls that masked errors. Shared types `Publisher`, `CreatePublisherRequest`, and `PublisherProfileResponse` added to `common`. Avatar uploads stored in `web/public/uploads/`, now gitignored. Project root initialization moved to `initializeProjectRootAndWorkingDir` helper in `npm-app`.

73849f7511c1b59e7586ab39650efb47c94102c4.title: agent-builder injects tool definitions
73849f7511c1b59e7586ab39650efb47c94102c4.summary: agent-builder.ts now calls compileToolDefinitions() during template construction. Injects 'Available Tools Type Definitions' section into prompt context alongside existing agent types. Refactors tool definition compilation from execution step to initialization scope.

6f5aee81b4c78d66bcf85944861dc0598de7254b.title: stepPrompt optional in agent config schema
6f5aee81b4c78d66bcf85944861dc0598de7254b.summary: stepPrompt field changed from required to optional in DynamicAgentConfigSchema and AgentConfig interface. Reflected in common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts and common/src/util/agent-config.d.ts. Allows agent configs to omit stepPrompt when not needed for specific model behaviors.

8f909aeaecb926b608bc3896a07231f5b864a9ca.title: Inject TOOLSPROMPT into agent system prompts
8f909aeaecb926b608bc3896a07231f5b864a9ca.summary: getAgentPrompt now appends PLACEHOLDER.TOOLS_PROMPT to systemPrompt strings in backend/src/templates/strings.ts. If the placeholder is absent, it is concatenated with a double newline; if the prompt is undefined, it defaults to the placeholder. This ensures tool instructions are always present in the final formatted prompt. Refactor also groups type imports and adds trailing commas.

fd9f50be684550f2b3fbcfa836b96452fa2eb901.text: The assistant's internal setup was simplified and renamed for clarity. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

73849f7511c1b59e7586ab39650efb47c94102c4.text: The system now shows the assistant its available tools when it starts, rather than checking later. This internal update helps the assistant understand its options more clearly.

4910cdaee920ba5099266043301c7e6e67819379.text: The assistant now knows to use a specific helper whenever you type its name with an @ symbol. This small internal update ensures your direct requests to use a particular helper are respected.

6f5aee81b4c78d66bcf85944861dc0598de7254b.text: Agents can now work without a specific instruction step.

dbdbac636d7ae581f4c058f33979eb1fcbdceafd.text: Users can now create and edit publisher profiles with custom avatars. Publishing tools report specific errors instead of hiding them, making problems easier to identify and fix.

410255d3bae0bcbd08a406fcbb9782f9d246456a.text: The system now finds the right assistant instructions faster and more reliably. This change is internal and improves stability without altering visible features.

e25b24b2a4d4c19eed5b79143ac0402cf1a8cf33.text: Internal changes improved how the system checks version numbers. Users will not notice any difference.

8f909aeaecb926b608bc3896a07231f5b864a9ca.text: The assistant now always includes its tool instructions when generating responses. This ensures it can reliably use available features.

71c4ce12f25622b9d168de56a3d08a2a57cbbc63.text: The software team removed a small piece of unused internal code. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

842c56b34bdd131145c280d8d410ecab658571e6.title: Add eslint-plugin-unused-imports dev dependency
842c56b34bdd131145c280d8d410ecab658571e6.summary: Added eslint-plugin-unused-imports ^4.1.4 to devDependencies in package.json. Provides linting rules for detecting and removing unused imports. Internal tooling change only, no runtime impact.

ffee261accfd719fa2ea10622016ce4737a638db.title: Allow empty system prompt in runAgentStep
ffee261accfd719fa2ea10622016ce4737a638db.summary: runAgentStep now defaults system prompt to empty string instead of throwing on missing prompt. getAgentPrompt result uses nullish coalescing operator. Removes hard requirement for system prompt in backend/src/run-agent-step.ts.

5c7a3cf95f6bc2a60703d872d3492fe833edc650.title: Remove loadFileContents from agent loader
5c7a3cf95f6bc2a60703d872d3492fe833edc650.summary: Removed `loadFileContents` from `npm-app/src/agents/agent-utils.ts` and its usage in `load-agents.ts`. Prompt fields (`systemPrompt`, `instructionsPrompt`, `stepPrompt`) now pass through directly or default to empty strings instead of resolving file paths. This simplifies the agent loading mechanism by eliminating redundant filesystem lookups for prompt content.

43075290fbe734dd5b7cdcc5dda1b1fb9d70b9e6.title: publish loads credentials directly
43075290fbe734dd5b7cdcc5dda1b1fb9d70b9e6.summary: CLI publish handler now reads auth tokens via new getUserCredentials helper instead of Client singleton. Eliminates client initialization dependency for this command. Covers npm-app/src/cli-handlers/publish.ts and npm-app/src/credentials.ts. Parameter renamed agentName to agentId to match template lookup logic.

5359944010043c475dd37e61bb50dc22480f81b7.title: Update ESLint and Prettier config for import rules
5359944010043c475dd37e61bb50dc22480f81b7.summary: ESLint config now enforces import ordering with 'type' group and flags unused imports via eslint-plugin-unused-imports. Prettier trailingComma set to 'all'. VS Code save action changed from organizeImports to fixAll.eslint. npm-app src import restriction removed.

7d744484d7507c720877f3377ac9ba2bbc200611.title: Fix pgstatstatements drop error in Drizzle config
7d744484d7507c720877f3377ac9ba2bbc200611.summary: Added tablesFilter to common/src/db/drizzle.config.ts to exclude pg_stat_statements and pg_stat_statements_info from migrations. This prevents "cannot drop view pg_stat_statements_info because extension pg_stat_statements requires it" errors during schema sync. Also updated .agents/agent-config.d.ts to enforce lowercase, numeric, and hyphen-only constraints for agent IDs.

7c98630f058946cec393077942e0d9217d856554.title: Publish Agent Part 1
7c98630f058946cec393077942e0d9217d856554.summary: Introduces `agent_config` table and `publisher` user linkage, replacing `agent_template`. Updates schema, migrations, and dynamic agent loading logic. Scope includes `common/src/db/schema.ts`, `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts`, and new API routes for publishing. Migration `0026_chilly_mockingbird.sql` renames tables and adds `user_id` foreign key with cascade delete.

6e9f603bbf62aa250c6665f099a26cca423c257d.title: Refactor run-agent-step.ts: type-only imports and trailing commas
6e9f603bbf62aa250c6665f099a26cca423c257d.summary: backend/src/run-agent-step.ts updated to use `import type` for type-only symbols (AgentRegistry, AgentResponseTrace, etc.) and added trailing commas to function arguments. This aligns with TypeScript best practices for tree-shaking and code style consistency. Scope limited to backend agent execution logic.

81841a49cb41c0dfb6d5cef978e1e78681db165b.title: CLI: publish flag becomes subcommand
81841a49cb41c0dfb6d5cef978e1e78681db165b.summary: The `--publish` CLI flag is removed from `cliOptions` in `npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts` and replaced with a `publish` subcommand handled in `npm-app/src/index.ts`. The parser now checks `args[0] === 'publish'` instead of `options.publish`, extracting the agent name from `args[1]`. This change prevents the publish argument from being incorrectly parsed as initial user input by adding an `isCommand` guard before setting `initialInput`. Scope limited to CLI entry point and definition files.

5359944010043c475dd37e61bb50dc22480f81b7.text: The system now automatically cleans up and organizes its internal instructions when saved. This is a small internal change that does not affect how the product works for you.

7c98630f058946cec393077942e0d9217d856554.text: The system now tracks which assistant settings belong to which user, ensuring your custom tools and models load correctly for you. This internal update improves how the app manages personalized assistant configurations.

43075290fbe734dd5b7cdcc5dda1b1fb9d70b9e6.text: This internal update improves how the tool checks your login details during publishing. You will not notice any changes, but it makes the process more reliable.

5c7a3cf95f6bc2a60703d872d3492fe833edc650.text: The assistant no longer checks separate files to find its instructions. This small internal update speeds up how it loads tasks.

ffee261accfd719fa2ea10622016ce4737a638db.text: The assistant no longer requires a specific setup instruction to start working. This internal change allows it to run even if that instruction is missing.

842c56b34bdd131145c280d8d410ecab658571e6.text: A small internal update helps the team's tools automatically catch leftover bits of code. You won't notice any changes.

6e9f603bbf62aa250c6665f099a26cca423c257d.text: The assistant's internal setup was cleaned up. This small change makes the system run smoother and more reliably.
