70fe182b1cb2be918bd0e2afa142c2294b1fdd27.text: The team moved a small internal tool to a new folder. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

a3673d4fd91b47f3b7608ca5ac280213e0619fd9.text: A small internal update fixes how the system connects to private data sources during testing. This ensures the assistant can reliably access necessary information without getting stuck on security checks.

db5d4f0c2380c1f7611e751b59ca245bfbd7acd2.text: The app now checks if a required background tool is missing and stops trying to use it. This prevents errors on computers that do not have the tool installed.

fa845457b7f7ee385a2742e9514707aea22d876b.title: Clean up evals console logs
fa845457b7f7ee385a2742e9514707aea22d876b.summary: Trims verbose status messages in `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` and `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`. Removes references to 'sequentially' and hardcoded concurrency limits ('max 20') from `console.log` calls to reduce noise. Scope limited to internal evaluation scripts.

1f3755c0c96867ce04ebd78d17c16f61052cc7d2.title: infisical-run executor loads TS directly
1f3755c0c96867ce04ebd78d17c16f61052cc7d2.summary: Switched `@codebuff/build-tools:infisical-run` implementation from `./dist/executors/infisical-run/executor.js` to `./executors/infisical-run/executor.ts`. Removed `dependsOn: ["@codebuff/build-tools:build"]` from the `evals` project target to eliminate build dependency for eval execution. This change affects `build-tools/executors.json` and `evals/project.json`. The executor now relies on runtime TypeScript compilation rather than pre-built artifacts.

ae93fb9037b77824d4f83612a95332ecd9808060.title: Eval data paths use absolute paths in run-eval-set.ts
ae93fb9037b77824d4f83612a95332ecd9808060.summary: Updated `evalDataPath` in `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` to use `path.join(__dirname, ...)` instead of relative strings. This ensures eval JSON files are resolved correctly regardless of the current working directory when running the script. Scope limited to internal eval runner configuration.

abc62735a6c1356953de5dc78deb7bb0a394fd7b.title: Fix duplicated chat directory in npm-app worker context
abc62735a6c1356953de5dc78deb7bb0a394fd7b.summary: Refactored `project-files.ts` to enforce a singleton `currentChatId` and pass this ID to the `project-context.ts` worker via `postMessage`. The worker now calls `setChatIdFromExternal` to align its state with the main thread before processing files. This prevents race conditions where the worker and main thread generated different timestamp-based IDs, causing writes to duplicate chat directories.

1807375bb53c78d2a9eb6c1134ebf0ee1058d28f.title: Pass modelConfig to git evals child process
1807375bb53c78d2a9eb6c1134ebf0ee1058d28f.summary: The `fork` call in `runGitEvals` now serializes `modelConfig` to JSON and passes it as the fifth argument to the child process. This fixes a broken merge by ensuring the eval runner has access to the correct model configuration. The change is isolated to `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` and does not affect public APIs or user-facing behavior.

7cbac9a2d89aa8b248701d95de168616cb50c26b.title: Evals: hardcode API endpoint
7cbac9a2d89aa8b248701d95de168616cb50c26b.summary: In evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts, API_BASE now hardcodes http://localhost:3000/. Previous fallback to NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL removed. Scope limited to internal eval runner.

9da3544686236b416ac81189fc7db12c5a165403.title: Fix evals git setup to reset repos missing .git directory
9da3544686236b416ac81189fc7db12c5a165403.summary: setupTestRepo in evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts now checks for .git existence instead of just repoDir. If directory exists but lacks .git, it recursively deletes the folder before cloning. Prevents clone failures when previous runs left partial or corrupted test repos.

bcd24d28ecd1f45921ad9f729c7cbf458b5590a1.title: Add explicit build-tools dependency to infisical-run targets
bcd24d28ecd1f45921ad9f729c7cbf458b5590a1.summary: Added `@codebuff/build-tools:build` to `dependsOn` for all `@codebuff/build-tools:infisical-run` targets across backend, common, evals, npm-app, packages/billing, and web project.json files. This ensures the build-tools executor is compiled before any task attempts to invoke it, preventing race conditions or missing executor errors during Nx task execution.

47e63753ac5af6cc5cd5ee6019db93c2341299cf.title: Reorder git checkpoint nested repo handling
47e63753ac5af6cc5cd5ee6019db93c2341299cf.summary: The `gitAddAllIgnoringNestedRepos` function in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` was refactored to change the execution order of git operations. `gitAddAll` now runs after identifying modified files and removing them from the index, rather than before. This ensures nested repo `.git` directories are backed up and restored correctly relative to the file staging process.

fdcdf800aad9c6dffb6e1c35e61ffa8eb87c2ee7.title: Remove explicit build-tools dependency from infisical-run targets
fdcdf800aad9c6dffb6e1c35e61ffa8eb87c2ee7.summary: Reverts the addition of `dependsOn: ["@codebuff/build-tools:build"]` to all `infisical-run` executor targets across backend, common, evals, npm-app, billing, and web projects. The explicit dependency was removed from `project.json` files, likely resolving build graph issues or redundancy introduced in a previous fix. This change affects the Nx build orchestration for these specific targets.

abc62735a6c1356953de5dc78deb7bb0a394fd7b.text: Fixed a bug where chat files were saved to duplicate folders. Your chat history now stores in one correct location.

bcd24d28ecd1f45921ad9f729c7cbf458b5590a1.text: A small internal fix prevents occasional startup errors when running the software.

ae93fb9037b77824d4f83612a95332ecd9808060.text: A small internal fix ensures the evaluation system finds its data files correctly, no matter where the script is run from. This change does not affect how the product behaves for users.

1807375bb53c78d2a9eb6c1134ebf0ee1058d28f.text: A small internal fix ensures the system checks model accuracy using the correct settings. This change has no visible effect on the product.

fa845457b7f7ee385a2742e9514707aea22d876b.text: Internal cleanup work reduced unnecessary text in the system's background logs. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

47e63753ac5af6cc5cd5ee6019db93c2341299cf.text: Internal fix reorders how the app saves files during checkpoints. Nested project folders now back up correctly. No user-visible changes.

7cbac9a2d89aa8b248701d95de168616cb50c26b.text: Internal testing tools now always check the local copy of the app, not the live version. This change affects only how developers test features and does not impact your experience.

9da3544686236b416ac81189fc7db12c5a165403.text: A small internal fix improves how test data is set up. It prevents errors from leftover files that could make the system unstable.

fdcdf800aad9c6dffb6e1c35e61ffa8eb87c2ee7.text: The system stopped checking a specific internal setup step before starting certain tasks. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

1f3755c0c96867ce04ebd78d17c16f61052cc7d2.text: The tool now reads its instructions directly, skipping a separate preparation step. This internal change makes the system run more simply.

7f4759152d3d6155ab17a1e6aef97fa839f11efb.title: Limit buffbench concurrency to 10
7f4759152d3d6155ab17a1e6aef97fa839f11efb.summary: Reduced global concurrency limit in `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` from 20 to 10. Call to `setGlobalConcurrencyLimit` updated. Import statements reformatted for readability.

97c512708414a56938ebbe864642895fdbd2246b.title: Fix escaped commit message parsing in evals.yml
97c512708414a56938ebbe864642895fdbd2246b.summary: Refactored commit message check in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` to use environment variable `COMMIT_MESSAGE` instead of direct interpolation `${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}`. Prevents YAML injection and parsing errors from special characters in commit messages. Scope limited to CI workflow evaluation trigger logic.

c4c187769c73e73062c9573a1486dbd5787d7679.title: Cap git evals concurrency to 20
c4c187769c73e73062c9573a1486dbd5787d7679.summary: Git evals now limit concurrent processes to 20 via a global `p-limit` instance shared across repositories. `run-eval-set.ts` initializes the limiter, and `run-git-evals.ts` enforces it, replacing previous unbounded parallel execution. Dependency `p-limit` added to `evals/package.json`. This prevents resource exhaustion during large-scale evaluation runs.

7d08f24b7939469a6bb9807a009b11e887bee60a.title: evals task dependsOn build-tools:build
7d08f24b7939469a6bb9807a009b11e887bee60a.summary: Added dependsOn constraint to evals task in evals/project.json. Ensures @codebuff/build-tools:build completes before infisical-run executes run-eval-set.ts. Scope limited to evals project configuration.

0275ec9804c5514f3ff2beb4f2eb9faed02d7ff8.title: Introduce @codebuff/build-tools infisical-run executor
0275ec9804c5514f3ff2beb4f2eb9faed02d7ff8.summary: Added `@codebuff/build-tools:infisical-run` Nx executor to standardize Infisical CLI usage across `backend`, `common`, and `evals` project targets. The executor checks for `infisical` availability via `command -v` and falls back to direct execution if missing, removing inline shell conditionals from `package.json` scripts. Updated `backend/project.json`, `common/project.json`, and `evals/project.json` to delegate `start`, `dev`, `db:*`, and `*git-evals` commands to this new executor.

cedfe34b881aed3644851cf55fdabfa29b6ba164.title: evals workflow always runs on GH Actions
cedfe34b881aed3644851cf55fdabfa29b6ba164.summary: Removed job-level if condition from .github/workflows/evals.yml, ensuring the workflow triggers on every push. Added a 'Check commit message' step to set should_run_evals output based on [buffbench] presence. Applied conditional execution to all subsequent steps (Setup Bun, Cache, Install, Env, Run evals) to skip heavy operations if flag is false. Adds final 'Workflow completed' step to guarantee job success even when evals are skipped.

5bc5336e85d1d696c5ad4cef471144dde8d91046.title: Eval test repo directory naming flattened
5bc5336e85d1d696c5ad4cef471144dde8d91046.summary: Changed `setupTestRepo` in `evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts` to use a flat directory name `${repoName}-${commitSha}` instead of nested `repoName/commitSha`. This simplifies path construction for test repositories. Scope limited to internal eval setup logic.

6c31588bc5e211b48a3a96148febfa2bfd5237c8.title: Wrap evals.yml conditionals in expression syntax
6c31588bc5e211b48a3a96148febfa2bfd5237c8.summary: Updated `if` conditions in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` to use `${{ ... }}` expression syntax. GitHub Actions now requires explicit expression delimiters for step conditionals to prevent parsing ambiguities. Affects CI evaluation pipeline steps including setup, caching, and execution.

3feed691233fe92ca9c52ed90ce0ee8ee9f2d0ba.title: Refactor eval model config and add metrics
3feed691233fe92ca9c52ed90ce0ee8ee9f2d0ba.summary: Eval harness now supports explicit `modelConfig` (agent/reasoning models) passed to `mainPrompt`, overriding default cost-mode selection. `getAgentStream` signature updated to return stream directly, shifting model resolution logic to `common/constants` via new `getModelFromShortName` helper. `GitEvalMetadata` schema extended with `avgCompletion`, `avgEfficiency`, `avgCodeQuality`, `avgDuration`, and `avgTurns` fields. Eval runner aggregates these metrics from trace data before database insertion.

61268ac205708796f1b4f18854e1300bc3aec722.title: Add result logging to run-single-eval-process
61268ac205708796f1b4f18854e1300bc3aec722.summary: Added console.log for final eval result in run-single-eval-process.ts. Import order for fs adjusted. Improves visibility into eval process outcomes.

c4c187769c73e73062c9573a1486dbd5787d7679.text: The system now limits the number of background tasks running at once to prevent it from slowing down or crashing during heavy use. This small internal change helps keep the product stable.

6c31588bc5e211b48a3a96148febfa2bfd5237c8.text: This small internal update fixed how automated checks start. It does not change what you see or use.

97c512708414a56938ebbe864642895fdbd2246b.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system reads certain messages to prevent errors. This change is invisible to you, but it helps keep the service running smoothly.

7f4759152d3d6155ab17a1e6aef97fa839f11efb.text: The system now processes fewer tasks at once to prevent overload. This internal change helps keep things running smoothly.

cedfe34b881aed3644851cf55fdabfa29b6ba164.text: The system now checks every update for a specific tag before running complex tests, skipping them if the tag is missing. This saves time and resources during routine updates without affecting the product's features.

5bc5336e85d1d696c5ad4cef471144dde8d91046.text: The system now uses simpler names for internal test folders. This change only affects how the software checks itself behind the scenes.

0275ec9804c5514f3ff2beb4f2eb9faed02d7ff8.text: The system now handles setup checks automatically instead of using messy manual instructions. This internal cleanup makes the software easier to maintain but does not change how you use it.

7d08f24b7939469a6bb9807a009b11e887bee60a.text: The system now checks that all necessary setup steps finish before running tests. This prevents occasional failures when starting internal evaluations.

61268ac205708796f1b4f18854e1300bc3aec722.text: A small internal update makes the system record the outcome of certain evaluations. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

3feed691233fe92ca9c52ed90ce0ee8ee9f2d0ba.text: The system now tracks average performance metrics like completion and efficiency for better insights. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

d94df780116b6156f0a7b77744a009d7b905d6b8.title: Git evals print completion immediately
d94df780116b6156f0a7b77744a009d7b905d6b8.summary: run-git-evals.ts prints completion status inside the message handler rather than after Promise.allSettled. Removes the pre-allocated evalRuns array in favor of filtering fulfilled results post-execution. Affects evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. Logging now occurs per-commit during async execution, decoupling output order from final aggregation.

a150b4e20295d8f907ba8d42f155d5c673decfcd.title: Skip nested repo backup if .git missing
a150b4e20295d8f907ba8d42f155d5c673decfcd.summary: Checkpoint file manager skips nested repos without .git directory. `git rm --cached` wrapped in try-catch to log errors. Prevents crashes during backup of non-git subdirectories.

ac79e41ed0b901cae39368732e5b81fff7238729.title: Eval runner delays exit by 2s to prevent race conditions
ac79e41ed0b901cae39368732e5b81fff7238729.summary: The `run-single-eval-process.ts` script in the `evals/git-evals` directory now delays process termination by 2 seconds using `setTimeout` before calling `process.exit(0)`. This change mitigates race conditions where child processes might not have fully flushed output or completed cleanup tasks before the parent process terminates. The scope is limited to the internal evaluation harness.

45ccb2377f64a4ca6a029156117dd0f8eb46a462.title: start-web script now runs start-db first
45ccb2377f64a4ca6a029156117dd0f8eb46a462.summary: start-web script updated to bun start-db && bun --cwd web dev. Ensures database initialization before web dev server launch. Scope: package.json scripts.

df27c6b9e9aef7642b9eda8e0bf51b528f74ac9f.title: Print error from git evals
df27c6b9e9aef7642b9eda8e0bf51b528f74ac9f.summary: Adds `console.error` logging for error messages in `run-git-evals.ts`. Logs stack trace and full message object before rejecting. Removes manual stack assignment to error object.

c54707e4cb86937db504b0d826f53eea9f804b10.title: Remove partial json save in git evals
c54707e4cb86937db504b0d826f53eea9f804b10.summary: Removes partial JSON result saving logic from run-git-evals.ts. Eliminates intermediate file writes during evaluation runs. Updates run-eval-set.ts to restore email sending flag and remove hardcoded limits.

d376339de7eb134ec935207ad6aa19b2868f9d8a.title: Add repo name to git eval log
d376339de7eb134ec935207ad6aa19b2868f9d8a.summary: Git eval runner now prefixes `Starting` log line with `testRepoName` variable. Distinguishes evals across multiple repos in parallel runs. Affects `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`.

28470c3a9e8357389394996924268aed29a67730.title: Fix arg list too long in git evals fork
28470c3a9e8357389394996924268aed29a67730.summary: Git evals fork now passes `evalCommit` via temp file path instead of JSON string argument. Prevents `E2BIG` when commit data exceeds OS arg length limits. Affects `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` and `run-single-eval-process.ts`. Temp file cleanup runs on child message receipt.

cf98ac954a3a21f6fb791b77cf3bde6fd0770b41.title: Parallelize git evals
cf98ac954a3a21f6fb791b77cf3bde6fd0770b41.summary: Refactored `run-eval-set.ts` to execute git evaluations in parallel using `Promise.allSettled` instead of sequential loops. Updated `run-git-evals.ts` to improve log naming by sanitizing commit messages and including repo names in log directories. CI timeout for evals reduced from 360 to 180 minutes in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` to accommodate parallel execution speedups.

3287b282081f25efe4bb87a438c8108859d0c07e.title: Parallel git evals via child process fork
3287b282081f25efe4bb87a438c8108859d0c07e.summary: Git evals now run in parallel by forking child processes via `run-single-eval-process.ts` instead of sequential execution. `setupTestRepo` isolates checkouts per commit SHA and skips re-cloning if the directory exists. `run-eval-set.ts` uncomments the 'manifold' eval and removes the 'codebuff' limit. Internal test infrastructure change; no user-facing impact.

d376339de7eb134ec935207ad6aa19b2868f9d8a.text: Internal logging change. Helps distinguish test runs.

c54707e4cb86937db504b0d826f53eea9f804b10.text: The system now waits to save all results at once instead of saving them piece by piece. This internal cleanup ensures evaluation data is complete and consistent.

df27c6b9e9aef7642b9eda8e0bf51b528f74ac9f.text: Internal change. The system now records clearer error details when a background check fails. This helps the support team diagnose problems faster.

ac79e41ed0b901cae39368732e5b81fff7238729.text: The internal tool now waits briefly before closing. This prevents lost data during background checks. No visible change for users.

3287b282081f25efe4bb87a438c8108859d0c07e.text: Internal testing tools now run checks at the same time instead of one after another. This speeds up team work, but changes nothing for you.

cf98ac954a3a21f6fb791b77cf3bde6fd0770b41.text: The system now checks updates in batches instead of one by one, making the process faster. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

28470c3a9e8357389394996924268aed29a67730.text: Fixed a rare crash when processing very large data sets.

45ccb2377f64a4ca6a029156117dd0f8eb46a462.text: The startup process now prepares the data storage before loading the application. This small internal change ensures the system starts reliably.

d94df780116b6156f0a7b77744a009d7b905d6b8.text: Internal change. Progress updates now appear as each check finishes, not all at once at the end.

a150b4e20295d8f907ba8d42f155d5c673decfcd.text: The app now skips saving folders that are not part of the project history. This prevents errors when backing up certain internal files.

11e80bd9328da522db4e8cc400514c22a75e3d4a.title: Sonnet restored as default agent model; Gemini moved to experimental
11e80bd9328da522db4e8cc400514c22a75e3d4a.summary: Agent mode defaults for normal and max cost settings revert to Sonnet, while Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview shifts to experimental. This adjustment in common/src/constants.ts prioritizes Sonnet for standard agent operations. The change affects core model resolution logic for agent tasks.

43ca5a4369d2c74e7dcb209b0cab1db2cecdfff6.title: Relax NEXTPUBLICBACKENDURL validation in env.ts
43ca5a4369d2c74e7dcb209b0cab1db2cecdfff6.summary: Changed NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL schema from z.string().url() to z.string().min(1) in env.ts. The strict URL check rejected valid non-standard backend endpoints. Scope limited to client environment validation. Next step: verify deployment configs.

e71a0c76c384f58a533c7df9415092a95a800006.title: Add git eval leaderboard
e71a0c76c384f58a533c7df9415092a95a800006.summary: Added `git_eval_results` table via migration `0020_young_sleeper.sql` to store git evaluation metrics. Includes new API route `web/src/app/api/git-evals/route.ts` and UI page `web/src/app/evals/page.tsx` for displaying results. Eval runner scripts `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` and `run-eval-set.ts` handle execution and data population.

5f1ed18014f89acdedf814cf55b5b51da417f550.title: Add 6 hour timeout to evals CI workflow
5f1ed18014f89acdedf814cf55b5b51da417f550.summary: Added `timeout-minutes: 360` to the `run-evals` job in `.github/workflows/evals.yml`. This enforces a 6-hour limit on evaluation runs triggered by commits containing `[buffbench]`. The change applies only to the CI workflow configuration.

d725527ba6f5b22819ba432096aec4fd9b2cddb9.title: Fix AI SDK error serialization
d725527ba6f5b22819ba432096aec4fd9b2cddb9.summary: ai-sdk.ts now stringifies object errors via JSON.stringify instead of casting to string. Prevents '[object Object]' in thrown exceptions. Internal fix in vercel-ai-sdk stream handler.

950cd5b9b5e7ee83e66fb9e5869eaaf0c185bb27.title: Remove unused @/env path mapping from tsconfig.base.json
950cd5b9b5e7ee83e66fb9e5869eaaf0c185bb27.summary: Removed the `@/env` path mapping from `tsconfig.base.json`. This cleanup eliminates an unused alias that pointed to a non-existent or unimported `./env.ts` file. The change affects the base TypeScript configuration used across the repo, ensuring path aliases reflect actual imports. No runtime behavior changes.

d38f9086cbe320727643780ba29111952f098661.title: web: start bypasses Nx
d38f9086cbe320727643780ba29111952f098661.summary: web/package.json start and discord:start scripts now invoke next start and bun run scripts/discord/index.ts directly. web/project.json start and discord:start executors removed. Eliminates Nx indirection for local web and discord service startup.

18f6326560ecc0e2ad9f6488a4a3ed7666fed0ec.title: Fix web build perf via env string coercion and dynamic route flags
18f6326560ecc0e2ad9f6488a4a3ed7666fed0ec.summary: Next.js config coerces all env values to strings via Object.fromEntries, replacing manual PORT handling. Admin org routes force dynamic rendering with export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'. Feed API Substack schema allows nullable cover_image. Changes confined to web/next.config.mjs and web/src/app/api routes.

08d9ecfdfbc411d9281fe3a7476b732bc412485b.title: Add Evals GitHub Actions workflow
08d9ecfdfbc411d9281fe3a7476b732bc412485b.summary: New `.github/workflows/evals.yml` triggers `bun run --cwd evals run-eval-set` on pushes containing `[buffbench]` in commit message. Uses `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` (1.2.12) and `actions/cache@v3` for `node_modules`. Injects secrets via `scripts/generate-ci-env.js` and `jq`, setting `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT=test`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_INFISICAL_UP=true`, and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN`.

668035297dccf48b348d35b23ec1fb68661d6851.title: Parallel research tool spawns read-only sub-agents before planning
668035297dccf48b348d35b23ec1fb68661d6851.summary: Adds a `research` tool that accepts a JSON array of prompts to run parallel information-gathering tasks. Each sub-agent uses `loopMainPrompt` in `lite` mode with `readOnlyMode: true`, suppressing analytics and restricting to read-only tools. `main-prompt.ts` now uses a `MainPromptOptions` object; ASK-mode instructions direct agents to use `research` instead of answering directly. `create_plan` instructions mandate running `research` first. `end_turn` removed from `TOOLS_WHICH_END_THE_RESPONSE` in favor of `research`.

d725527ba6f5b22819ba432096aec4fd9b2cddb9.text: This small internal fix ensures the assistant shows clear error messages instead of confusing text when a problem occurs.

08d9ecfdfbc411d9281fe3a7476b732bc412485b.text: Internal update: automated quality checks now run when specific changes are submitted. This helps catch errors before they reach you.

950cd5b9b5e7ee83e66fb9e5869eaaf0c185bb27.text: We cleaned up a small internal setting that was no longer needed. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

43ca5a4369d2c74e7dcb209b0cab1db2cecdfff6.text: The software now accepts a wider range of internal addresses for its backend service. This fixes a problem where valid but unusual connections were previously rejected.

e71a0c76c384f58a533c7df9415092a95a800006.text: The system now tracks performance for specific tasks. This allows users to see how well the software handles these activities.

d38f9086cbe320727643780ba29111952f098661.text: The team removed an extra step from the process that starts the website and chat bot. This internal cleanup makes the services launch slightly faster and more directly.

5f1ed18014f89acdedf814cf55b5b51da417f550.text: A small internal update limits evaluation runs to six hours. This prevents long processes from running indefinitely.

11e80bd9328da522db4e8cc400514c22a75e3d4a.text: The assistant now uses its standard model for most tasks, while a newer experimental model is hidden from general use. This change improves reliability for everyday requests.

18f6326560ecc0e2ad9f6488a4a3ed7666fed0ec.text: The website now loads faster and more reliably by simplifying how it handles internal settings. Users will experience a smoother, quicker browsing session.

2b543527d01642e2324fed04cadf4a46d17e674f.title: Add ESLint deps and clean task to appease npm-app build
2b543527d01642e2324fed04cadf4a46d17e674f.summary: Added eslint-config-prettier, eslint-plugin-import, and typescript-eslint to devDependencies to resolve npm-app build errors. Introduced a clean target in project.json to remove dist and dist-env directories. Scope limited to root package.json and project.json configuration.

754532c99e33cdd53f0bd03a821801d75d8f3635.title: Add instructions param to writefile tool
754532c99e33cdd53f0bd03a821801d75d8f3635.summary: Added `instructions` parameter to `write_file` tool schema and implementation. Propagates user intent to `processFileBlock` and `fastRewrite` for better edit accuracy. Updates CLI renderer to display instructions alongside file paths.

19ca4cb6372db69115d8ea599697dc06ab2a23c1.title: Fix npm-app deploy env injection and tsconfig
19ca4cb6372db69115d8ea599697dc06ab2a23c1.summary: Refactored `npm-app/clean-package.js` to dynamically parse client-side environment keys from `env.ts` instead of hardcoding `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefixes, ensuring correct variable injection into `dist/index.js`. Updated `prepublishOnly` script to run `nx clean` and wrap execution with `infisical run --env=prod`, moving secrets handling out of the root `deploy:npm-app` script. Added `common` to root `tsconfig.json` references and adjusted `common` and `backend` tsconfigs for incremental builds and path resolution.

e489a748c481fd8b8ceb5058f18569b352f6cb49.title: Fix npm-app build order for tsc-alias and add dependency
e489a748c481fd8b8ceb5058f18569b352f6cb49.summary: Reordered npm-app build commands to run `tsc-alias` after copying `common` and `code-map` dists. Added `tsc-alias` to root `package.json` dependencies. This ensures path aliases resolve correctly in the final bundle. Affects `npm-app/project.json` and `package.json`.

04a2166f8b5c70a58a0466038bcd58ea7978c4e7.title: Add NEXTPUBLICBACKENDURL to env schema
04a2166f8b5c70a58a0466038bcd58ea7978c4e7.summary: Added `NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` to the client-side environment validation in `env.ts`. This ensures the backend URL is explicitly required and validated for the npm-app. The `package.json` for `npm-app` also received a new `start-js` script to build and run the JavaScript output.

4408b769103ee2e3aa047eb0b7536a7ee198c638.title: start-js script updated to include clean-package step
4408b769103ee2e3aa047eb0b7536a7ee198c638.summary: The `start-js` script in `npm-app/package.json` now executes `bun run clean-package.js` after building. This step was missing, causing stale artifacts to persist during the transition to the JavaScript entrypoint. The change ensures a clean state before `node` launches `dist/index.js` via `tsconfig-paths`. Scope limited to `npm-app` build scripts.

c5dd22f472223c5d2350c99c64094b5c323a6345.title: Revert git-evals COSTMODE to normal
c5dd22f472223c5d2350c99c64094b5c323a6345.summary: Reverts COST_MODE constant from 'experimental' to 'normal' in evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. This change affects the internal evaluation harness for Git-based tasks. The modification ensures evaluations run under standard cost parameters rather than experimental settings.

da92ba9d348e354fa12c8b2bd24d530b80ab0356.title: Downgrade tsc-alias to 1.7.0
da92ba9d348e354fa12c8b2bd24d530b80ab0356.summary: tsc-alias pinned to 1.7.0 in package.json. Reverts ^1.8.16 range to resolve CI build error. Scoped to repo build config.

9007dc17e64b15a73ec007cf443d64ccba17b765.title: Fix evals import paths and add infisical wrapper
9007dc17e64b15a73ec007cf443d64ccba17b765.summary: Relative import paths replace absolute module aliases in `evals/git-evals/*` and `evals/scaffolding.ts`. Package scripts in `evals/package.json` now conditionally wrap execution with `infisical run` if the binary exists. `scaffolding.ts` adds a default export for helper functions.

f7d34f17c69f0bb8e2aa5e69238a0d3a689906c1.title: Log vercel ai sdk stream errors
f7d34f17c69f0bb8e2aa5e69238a0d3a689906c1.summary: Added error logging for 'error' chunks in vercel ai sdk stream responses. Uses `logger.error` to record the chunk. Throws the error in non-prod environments to surface issues during development. Covers `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`.

4408b769103ee2e3aa047eb0b7536a7ee198c638.text: The startup process now clears old files before loading new ones. This prevents errors caused by leftover data from previous versions.

754532c99e33cdd53f0bd03a821801d75d8f3635.text: The assistant now receives clearer instructions when saving or updating files. This helps it make more accurate changes based on what you want.

f7d34f17c69f0bb8e2aa5e69238a0d3a689906c1.text: The system now records errors that occur during AI responses to help developers fix issues faster. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for users.

19ca4cb6372db69115d8ea599697dc06ab2a23c1.text: The app now automatically finds and loads the right settings for different environments, fixing a bug where some features might not work correctly. This ensures the app behaves as expected without requiring any action from you.

2b543527d01642e2324fed04cadf4a46d17e674f.text: Internal build tools were updated to fix errors during the software preparation process. A cleanup step was added to remove old files before new ones are created. Users will see no change in the product itself.

c5dd22f472223c5d2350c99c64094b5c323a6345.text: The internal system that checks how well the assistant understands tasks now uses standard settings instead of experimental ones. This is a small technical cleanup. You likely will not notice any change in how the assistant works.

e489a748c481fd8b8ceb5058f18569b352f6cb49.text: The team fixed a small internal setup step for the application. This ensures the software builds correctly and stays stable.

da92ba9d348e354fa12c8b2bd24d530b80ab0356.text: The team fixed a problem that stopped the software from being built correctly. This change only affects how the product is prepared for release, so users will not notice any difference in how it works.

9007dc17e64b15a73ec007cf443d64ccba17b765.text: This is a small internal update that fixes how the system loads data and automatically handles security keys. You will not notice any changes.

04a2166f8b5c70a58a0466038bcd58ea7978c4e7.text: The app now checks for a missing connection address before starting. This small internal fix prevents errors when the app runs.

05394e89a84b9932395cba16a38eb702afef1198.title: db:migrate uses nx target with optional infisical
05394e89a84b9932395cba16a38eb702afef1198.summary: common/package.json db:migrate now delegates to nx run common:db-migrate. common/project.json defines db-migrate executor running drizzle-kit push directly if infisical is absent, otherwise via infisical run. Scope limited to common package scripts and Nx project config.

a43570ec04636f7a38125ca46b18939316455c86.title: Update o3 cost
a43570ec04636f7a38125ca46b18939316455c86.summary: Update o3 cost in backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts. Adjusted TOKENS_COST_PER_M entries for models.o3 and models.o3pro. Internal cost tracking update.

f662f6b5e19599bd4cd3d6de0b9c4adadad06a03.title: Move unproductive loop check above file changes output
f662f6b5e19599bd4cd3d6de0b9c4adadad06a03.summary: Relocated `checkForUnproductiveLoop` logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to execute before `Applying file changes...` output and `agentContextPromise` resolution. Prevents loop termination messages from appearing after file processing side effects have already started. Internal refactor of `mainPrompt` execution order.

347deaaf718b8a84bd948c15c626ba291f04242b.title: Add o3 pro max mode
347deaaf718b8a84bd948c15c626ba291f04242b.summary: Introduces `o3` and `o3pro` model support, routing them via `openai.responses` in `ai-sdk.ts` instead of `languageModel`. `thinking-stream.ts` updates stop sequences to include `<write_file>` and injects a distinct prompt for o3 models that enforces early termination when the next action is clear. `common/src/constants.ts` adds short names for `flash-2.5` and `opus-4`.

d51f479a1a409ac7291317650365fafbab6a97a4.title: Disable Gemini thought streaming in AI SDK
d51f479a1a409ac7291317650365fafbab6a97a4.summary: Set `includeThoughts` to `false` in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. Prevents Gemini's internal reasoning steps from appearing in the stream output. Affects the Vercel AI SDK provider configuration for Google models.

8990d2ea0de5d84de0fc91ea0857b743a45edd20.title: Fix infisical check in drizzle-kit push
8990d2ea0de5d84de0fc91ea0857b743a45edd20.summary: Updated `common/project.json` to use POSIX-compliant `>/dev/null 2>&1` redirection instead of Bash-specific `&> /dev/null` for infisical detection. This ensures the drizzle-kit push command executes correctly across different shell environments. The change applies to the `common` package build configuration.

0348b5a9490bec7f2bc5a156e3663ceabeb3a26c.title: web discord scripts run via nx with infisical fallback
0348b5a9490bec7f2bc5a156e3663ceabeb3a26c.summary: web/package.json routes discord:start and discord:register through nx run web:<target> instead of direct infisical run calls. web/project.json adds nx:run-commands targets for start, discord:start, and discord:register. Each target checks command -v infisical and falls back to bare next start or bun run scripts/discord/*.ts when infisical is absent. Scope limited to web package scripts and project.json targets.

a353ad008ce4a61ca8c343ba237f74e33a682389.title: writefile prompt mandates deletion comments
a353ad008ce4a61ca8c343ba237f74e33a682389.summary: write_file tool instructions and main-prompt.ts now require explicit deletion comments for all code removals, not just blocks. fast-apply model fails to infer deletions from omission alone. Scope: backend/src/tools.ts, backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Example updated to show `// Delete the console.log line from here` instead of implicit omission.

471b9d3f1713c130974280eb79b85d938e7e4ded.title: Add sonnet35 and o3pro model constants
471b9d3f1713c130974280eb79b85d938e7e4ded.summary: Added claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 and o3-pro-2025-06-10 to claudeModels and openaiModels. Updated shortModelNames to map 'sonnet-3.5' and 'sonnet-3.6' to the new sonnet3_5 constant, and 'sonnet-4' to sonnet. Refactored providerModelNames to dynamically generate mappings from provider model objects instead of hardcoded entries. Changes confined to common/src/constants.ts.

a5423aef9cac05dd20553c49818748e32620efa2.title: Replace manual env setup with Infisical
a5423aef9cac05dd20553c49818748e32620efa2.summary: Migrated environment variable management to Infisical, removing `.env.example` and `@t3-oss/env-core` validation. CI workflows now generate env vars via `scripts/generate-ci-env.js` and `jq` instead of dumping secrets to `.env.local`. Local dev requires Infisical CLI login; `backend/src/env.mjs` deleted in favor of `@/env` alias.

471b9d3f1713c130974280eb79b85d938e7e4ded.text: The assistant can now use two new AI models. This gives it access to different ways of answering questions.

05394e89a84b9932395cba16a38eb702afef1198.text: The tool that updates the system's data storage now automatically checks for and uses a secure key manager if it is available. This internal change improves how the system handles sensitive information during updates without requiring any action from users.

f662f6b5e19599bd4cd3d6de0b9c4adadad06a03.text: The assistant now checks for unproductive loops before starting file changes. This prevents confusing messages from appearing after work has already begun.

a43570ec04636f7a38125ca46b18939316455c86.text: The system updated the internal cost records for two advanced AI models. This change affects only backend bookkeeping and has no impact on the product's features or user experience.

a5423aef9cac05dd20553c49818748e32620efa2.text: The app now uses a secure service to handle its settings. This change does not affect how you use the product.

a353ad008ce4a61ca8c343ba237f74e33a682389.text: The assistant now explains every removed line of text. This prevents errors where changes are missed.

8990d2ea0de5d84de0fc91ea0857b743a45edd20.text: Fixed a small internal issue that could stop database updates from working correctly on some computers. Now, these updates will run smoothly regardless of the system used.

0348b5a9490bec7f2bc5a156e3663ceabeb3a26c.text: The website's internal startup tools now use a more reliable method to launch background services. This change is small and invisible to users, but it helps prevent occasional startup errors.

347deaaf718b8a84bd948c15c626ba291f04242b.text: The assistant can now use new, more powerful thinking models. It will also stop writing earlier when it knows what to do next, making responses faster and cleaner.

d51f479a1a409ac7291317650365fafbab6a97a4.text: The assistant no longer shows its private thinking steps in chat responses.

e1c1810bac639e58c4caa195d25b153d13d8ded8.title: Parallelize git commands in getGitChanges
e1c1810bac639e58c4caa195d25b153d13d8ded8.summary: Refactored `getGitChanges` in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` to execute `git status`, `git diff`, `git diff --cached`, and `git shortlog` concurrently via individual promise chains instead of sequential `await` calls. Each command now handles its own error logging and returns an empty string on failure, preventing a single command failure from aborting the entire context retrieval. This change reduces latency when fetching project file context.

f79be5425d9a5ce31fb22344a89898b659191a56.title: Handle ENOENT in getChangesSinceLastFileVersion
f79be5425d9a5ce31fb22344a89898b659191a56.summary: getChangesSinceLastFileVersion in npm-app/src/project-files.ts now returns a createPatch with empty current content when fs.readFileSync throws ENOENT. Other errors log via logger.error and return null. Return type explicitly set to Record<string, string>. Renamed param file to lastContents for clarity.

f32e6b0581ce13c8182457cf05795c17fd0e4da9.title: Offline scoring eval switched to top-2
f32e6b0581ce13c8182457cf05795c17fd0e4da9.summary: Changed `jaccardTop3` to `jaccardTop2` and updated `mrr` to top-2 in `scripts/ft-file-selection/relabel-for-offline-scoring.ts`. Eval logic now filters teacher and student outputs to the top 2 files before calculating Jaccard Similarity and Mean Reciprocal Rank. `LIMIT` for processed traces increased from 400 to 4000. Internal tooling only.

f6dccab6eadefa9a1223163aff1797d26eb7dd68.title: Move file utilities to common/util/file
f6dccab6eadefa9a1223163aff1797d26eb7dd68.summary: Refactored `isDir`, `isSubdir`, and `isValidProjectRoot` from `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` into `common/src/util/file.ts`. Updated imports in `cli.ts`, `menu.ts`, `terminal/base.ts`, and `utils/git.ts` to use the shared location. Added explicit `Promise<ProjectFileContext>` return type to `getProjectFileContext`.

7f28828ae0cf979cb67ac6bf24258b68423d2891.title: Backend adds unproductive loop detection
7f28828ae0cf979cb67ac6bf24258b68423d2891.summary: New `check-for-loop.ts` uses `gemini2_5_flash` to analyze the last 6 messages for non-productive cycles. `main-prompt.ts` triggers this check when `consecutiveAssistantMessages` exceeds 2 and no `end_turn` tool is called. If a loop is detected, the system injects an `end_turn` tool call and prompts the user to proceed. This prevents infinite agent loops by forcing a break in the conversation flow.

cf84049767d3fda35d5b3d7416cfd4390fd79f9b.title: Add KNOWLEDGEFILEUPDATED analytics event
cf84049767d3fda35d5b3d7416cfd4390fd79f9b.summary: Added `KNOWLEDGE_FILE_UPDATED` event to `AnalyticsEvent` enum. `main-prompt.ts` now tracks this event when `knowledge.md` files are queued for processing, capturing `agentStepId`, `clientSessionId`, `fingerprintId`, `userId`, and `repoName`. Scope covers backend prompt logic and shared analytics constants.

d2d9f3ae6eb94c0ae789e285535a8e1d4698ada2.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro default for agent modes; Sonnet experimental
d2d9f3ae6eb94c0ae789e285535a8e1d4698ada2.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview replaces Sonnet as the default model for 'normal' and 'max' agent cost modes in common/src/constants.ts. Sonnet is demoted to the 'experimental' tier. This change affects model selection logic for agent operations across all surfaces.

40154da3140adb1a3d3901a729d4fd31825fe613.title: Fix whitespace squashing logic in display.ts
40154da3140adb1a3d3901a729d4fd31825fe613.summary: Replaced naive regex newline collapsing with `squashNewlines` in `npm-app/src/display.ts`. New logic strips OSC/CSI sequences and zero-width chars via `string-width` to detect true whitespace-only lines. Prevents false positives where ANSI codes looked like empty lines. Updates `previous` state tracking to use `PREFIX` (`.\r\n`) for robust line boundary detection.

8fe7e9d8bb38a461a6967cde1c76e62870c81b02.title: Add thinkingBudget param to agent stream
8fe7e9d8bb38a461a6967cde1c76e62870c81b02.summary: Added optional `thinkingBudget` parameter to `getAgentStream` and `promptAiSdkStream`. Default fallback set to 128 tokens for Gemini models when not explicitly provided. Replaces hardcoded 0 budget in agent stream logic. Affects backend streaming APIs.

7f28828ae0cf979cb67ac6bf24258b68423d2891.text: The assistant now detects when it is stuck in a repetitive cycle. If this happens, it stops the loop and asks you to confirm how to proceed.

f6dccab6eadefa9a1223163aff1797d26eb7dd68.text: The software's file-handling tools were moved to a shared location to make the code easier to maintain. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

e1c1810bac639e58c4caa195d25b153d13d8ded8.text: The app now asks the computer for project details all at once instead of one after another. This makes the app load faster. If one request fails, the others still work, so the app keeps running smoothly.

f79be5425d9a5ce31fb22344a89898b659191a56.text: The system now handles missing files more gracefully, creating empty patches instead of failing. This improves stability for users who might encounter deleted or absent files.

f32e6b0581ce13c8182457cf05795c17fd0e4da9.text: The team updated an internal tool to check fewer results when testing the assistant. This change affects only how developers measure performance, not how you use the product.

cf84049767d3fda35d5b3d7416cfd4390fd79f9b.text: The system now records when your custom knowledge files are updated. This internal change helps the team track usage and does not affect how you use the product.

d2d9f3ae6eb94c0ae789e285535a8e1d4698ada2.text: The assistant now uses a different brain by default. This may change how it thinks and answers.

8fe7e9d8bb38a461a6967cde1c76e62870c81b02.text: The assistant now uses a small, fixed amount of extra effort to think through answers when no specific limit is set. This internal adjustment helps balance response speed and quality without changing how you interact with the product.

40154da3140adb1a3d3901a729d4fd31825fe613.text: The display logic now correctly identifies empty lines by ignoring invisible formatting codes. This prevents visual glitches where lines appeared blank but were actually hidden. The change is internal and improves text layout stability.

bd613eb21be70ac2ad1882719942c4869b09a4fe.title: Relax knowledge file update guidance in main-prompt
bd613eb21be70ac2ad1882719942c4869b09a4fe.summary: Removed the 'high bar' qualifier from the instruction prompting the agent to update knowledge files in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. This change aims to encourage more frequent knowledge base updates by lowering the perceived threshold for what constitutes 'useful' information. The modification affects the system prompt sent to the model during non-first user messages.

c1439b43948499b7c377ab1712ed237f9cb6d100.title: Fix login URL opening on Windows
c1439b43948499b7c377ab1712ed237f9cb6d100.summary: The CLI login flow now correctly opens the browser on Windows by detecting the platform and using `start` instead of `open`. Previously, the hardcoded `open` command failed on non-Unix systems. This change is isolated to `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

1444b463df73811cd59c1c6ff942cd38f3abfae9.title: Add duration to main prompt logging
1444b463df73811cd59c1c6ff942cd38f3abfae9.summary: Added duration calculation to main prompt logging in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Captures start time and logs elapsed milliseconds for prompt and response iterations. Internal observability change.

d28a2899ada8f0c8ad9a6d2d8f9341d2f01c1a1c.title: Support file:// prefix in ensureUrlProtocol
d28a2899ada8f0c8ad9a6d2d8f9341d2f01c1a1c.summary: Updated `ensureUrlProtocol` in `common/src/util/string.ts` to preserve existing `file://` prefixes and automatically prepend `file://` to absolute paths starting with `/`. This prevents absolute file paths from being incorrectly treated as domains and prefixed with `https://` or `http://`. Affects shared core utility functions.

9fe1f80112ceb1e4772a7141c6c8f961c0ad4f26.title: Switch git-evals to experimental cost mode
9fe1f80112ceb1e4772a7141c6c8f961c0ad4f26.summary: Daily git-evals now use 'experimental' cost mode instead of 'normal'. This enables testing of Gemini models within the evaluation harness. Change applies to evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts via new COST_MODE constant.

5079f20cd56303de5154809924493bfcdcb3934c.title: Remove env ENV from default ignored paths
5079f20cd56303de5154809924493bfcdcb3934c.summary: Renamed DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES to DEFAULT_IGNORED_PATHS and removed bare 'env' and 'ENV' entries from common/src/constants.ts. Eliminates over-broad matching that could ignore legitimate directories named env. Updates references in common/src/project-file-tree.ts for getProjectFileTree and isFileIgnored. Scoped to Shared/Core constants and file tree logic.

99ea9ed3b2b10f6e83fc5a4fde2ce271deedba1d.title: git metrics handle empty repos
99ea9ed3b2b10f6e83fc5a4fde2ce271deedba1d.summary: getRepoMetrics in npm-app/src/utils/git.ts catches isomorphic-git log() rejections on empty repos. Returns empty ReadCommitResult[] array, logs 'Error fetching git log. Is this an empty git repo?'. Prevents unhandled promise rejection during metrics collection.

cf3435fdb7832d01428b9fe3737a55ef83b08b6b.title: Checkpoint logic handles nested git repos and missing git CLI
cf3435fdb7832d01428b9fe3737a55ef83b08b6b.summary: CheckpointManager now throws CheckpointsDisabledError if git CLI is unavailable. file-manager adds gitAddAllIgnoringNestedRepos to temporarily rename nested .git dirs to .git.codebuffbackup during staging, preventing isomorphic-git errors. hasUnsavedChanges filters out ' M ' status lines to ignore modified submodules. gitAddAll excludes **/*.codebuffbackup paths.

542f1be338598c4f9e9944009c47afd6687d87fd.title: Reorder git add in nested repo checkpoints
542f1be338598c4f9e9944009c47afd6687d87fd.summary: Moved `gitAddAll` invocation before nested repo detection loop in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts`. Simplified `hasUnsavedChanges` to check raw output presence. Ensures staged files are added before checking for nested repos to prevent race conditions or missed changes.

cf7c3ece3945401c9f0aca127e6700fdf1a11b35.title: Prevent git root detection in home directory
cf7c3ece3945401c9f0aca127e6700fdf1a11b35.summary: New `isValidProjectRoot` helper in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` checks if a directory is a subdirectory of the home dir using `isSubdir`. `findGitRoot` in `npm-app/src/utils/git.ts` now rejects roots that fail this check, preventing accidental project initialization in `$HOME`. The greeting logic in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` was updated to use this new helper instead of direct `isSubdir` calls.

d28a2899ada8f0c8ad9a6d2d8f9341d2f01c1a1c.text: The app now correctly recognizes local file paths. This prevents errors when opening files from your computer.

5079f20cd56303de5154809924493bfcdcb3934c.text: The app no longer hides folders named 'env' by default. You can now see and use these folders if they contain normal project files.

1444b463df73811cd59c1c6ff942cd38f3abfae9.text: The system now tracks how long it takes to process requests. This internal update helps the team spot delays, but you will not see any changes in the product.

542f1be338598c4f9e9944009c47afd6687d87fd.text: We fixed a small internal bug that could cause some changes to be missed when saving your work. This makes the saving process more reliable.

cf7c3ece3945401c9f0aca127e6700fdf1a11b35.text: The tool now stops itself from accidentally starting a project in your main home folder.

c1439b43948499b7c377ab1712ed237f9cb6d100.text: The login process now opens your web browser correctly on Windows computers. This fixes an issue where the browser would not launch automatically during sign-in.

bd613eb21be70ac2ad1882719942c4869b09a4fe.text: The assistant now updates its knowledge base more often by lowering the threshold for what counts as useful information.

cf3435fdb7832d01428b9fe3737a55ef83b08b6b.text: The assistant can now save your work correctly even when your project contains other projects inside it. It also stops trying to save if the required background tool is missing, preventing errors.

99ea9ed3b2b10f6e83fc5a4fde2ce271deedba1d.text: The system now correctly handles projects with no saved history. This prevents errors when collecting usage data.

9fe1f80112ceb1e4772a7141c6c8f961c0ad4f26.text: The team updated a small internal tool to test new AI models. This change does not affect how you use the product.

840a5cfe8fbf6b384ab10c98f641809f1f2da2ea.title: Remove updatedby field from org feature route
840a5cfe8fbf6b384ab10c98f641809f1f2da2ea.summary: The `updated_by` field is removed from the `orgFeature` upsert logic in `web/src/app/api/admin/orgs/[orgId]/features/[feature]/route.ts`. This change aligns the code with the current database schema, which lacks the `updated_by` column. The modification ensures that feature configuration updates proceed without attempting to write to a non-existent field.

f914e147af1d6985f3b3c9c2ae6b217cd46d522d.title: Remove result verification instructions from agent prompt
f914e147af1d6985f3b3c9c2ae6b217cd46d522d.summary: Deleted a block of instructions requiring the agent to run terminal commands and review tool results to verify changes after every response. The remaining text directs the agent to check knowledge files for user-specified verification protocols instead. This change applies to the backend system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`. A typo in the preceding instruction ('Ommit' to 'Omit') was also corrected.

da734278793e858621e4ec242f7cc47c6d2af6d0.title: Add nx test targets to backend common npm-app
da734278793e858621e4ec242f7cc47c6d2af6d0.summary: New `test` targets added to `backend/project.json`, `common/project.json`, and `npm-app/project.json` using `nx:run-commands` executor. Root `package.json` gains a `test` script running `nx run-many` across these three projects with `--skip-nx-cache`. Backend and Common are new project definitions; npm-app updates existing config. Commands execute `bun test` against `*.test.ts` files in each source root.

6b6e431e66f67bfc112370bfb18a950dfc7f4ca4.title: Admin UI for org-specific model config
6b6e431e66f67bfc112370bfb18a950dfc7f4ca4.summary: Added admin interface to manage organization-specific model configurations via new API routes and UI components. Includes `checkAdminAuth` middleware for security and `ModelConfigSheet` for selecting finetuned Vertex models. Database interactions use Drizzle ORM with upsert logic on `orgFeature` table. Adopted `@tanstack/react-query` for data fetching in web package.

8c6ad54c0c633e22d707982c3321fdfbf9c19885.title: Enforce extreme conciseness in system prompts
8c6ad54c0c633e22d707982c3321fdfbf9c19885.summary: Updated main-prompt.ts and agent-instructions.md to mandate extreme conciseness. Added explicit instruction to respond with minimal words (e.g., "4" instead of "2+2 equals 4"). Revised Buffy persona to prioritize brevity, removing filler phrases and requiring single-sentence answers where possible. Scope limited to backend system prompt configuration.

e1a0281bc4129afbfdbf103a22481c40abab0a00.title: Reinforce ask mode tool restrictions
e1a0281bc4129afbfdbf103a22481c40abab0a00.summary: Added explicit system message instructing agent to avoid write_file and run_terminal_command when isAskMode is true. Prevents tool execution attempts in read-only ask mode. Scope: backend/src/main-prompt.ts. The message uses timeToLive 'agentStep' and asSystemMessage wrapper.

0422ab89d021af35cd82ac61b3382e427563442a.title: Custom file picker config for orgs
0422ab89d021af35cd82ac61b3382e427563442a.summary: Added `custom-file-picker` feature flag support for organizations. New `org_feature` table stores JSON config for model selection and file limits. `getCustomFilePickerConfigForOrg` retrieves and validates config against `CustomFilePickerConfigSchema`. Falls back to defaults if config is missing, inactive, or invalid.

885c07499a942aac2ec0e1ce6454777b4ec3b549.title: Allow createplan in ask mode
885c07499a942aac2ec0e1ce6454777b4ec3b549.summary: create_plan tool now permitted in ask mode via backend/src/tools.ts and main-prompt.ts. Previous logic excluded it alongside write_file and str_replace. Updated instructions allow overwriting plans with same filename, noting multiple uses are valid in ask mode.

5210e6206bf4f4f6d757ca6d993accc1e101811d.title: Update createplan tool test snapshot
5210e6206bf4f4f6d757ca6d993accc1e101811d.summary: Snapshot for `create_plan` tool updated. Instructions revised to allow plan overwriting via same filename and permit repeated use in ask mode. Internal test fixture change.

76edaada622722b10c9a81e1277ae796a06a3744.title: Refactor auth utilities into shared @codebuff/internal package
76edaada622722b10c9a81e1277ae796a06a3744.summary: Extracted authentication logic from backend and web into new `@codebuff/internal` package. Consolidated admin email lists and token validation into `packages/internal/src/utils/auth.ts`. Updated `backend`, `web`, and `evals` to depend on `@codebuff/internal` instead of duplicating auth code or using `@codebuff/integrations`.

840a5cfe8fbf6b384ab10c98f641809f1f2da2ea.text: The system no longer tries to record who last changed an organization's feature settings. This internal fix prevents errors when saving updates.

f914e147af1d6985f3b3c9c2ae6b217cd46d522d.text: The assistant no longer automatically checks its own work by running hidden commands after every reply. Instead, it only verifies results if you specifically ask for a certain check.

e1a0281bc4129afbfdbf103a22481c40abab0a00.text: A safety rule was added to stop the assistant from changing files or running commands when you are just asking questions. This keeps the tool in a safe, read-only mode.

6b6e431e66f67bfc112370bfb18a950dfc7f4ca4.text: Company admins can now choose which AI models their organization uses. This change is internal and does not affect regular users.

5210e6206bf4f4f6d757ca6d993accc1e101811d.text: The assistant can now update existing plans using the same filename and create plans multiple times in ask mode.

da734278793e858621e4ec242f7cc47c6d2af6d0.text: The system now runs automatic checks on three separate parts of the software at once. This helps catch errors earlier, making the product more stable for you.

885c07499a942aac2ec0e1ce6454777b4ec3b549.text: The assistant can now create and update plans while in question-and-answer mode, even if a plan with that name already exists.

0422ab89d021af35cd82ac61b3382e427563442a.text: Administrators can now customize file upload options for their organization. Regular users will see these settings applied automatically when selecting files.

8c6ad54c0c633e22d707982c3321fdfbf9c19885.text: The assistant now uses fewer words to answer questions, giving short, direct replies instead of long explanations. This makes conversations faster and easier to read.

14732e57b7cc6cd92104180ded4a7c59b681f8c7.title: Add endturn to TOOLSWHICHENDTHERESPONSE
14732e57b7cc6cd92104180ded4a7c59b681f8c7.summary: Added 'end_turn' to the TOOLS_WHICH_END_THE_RESPONSE array in backend/src/tools.ts. This ensures the agent correctly identifies end_turn as a stop sequence, terminating the response cycle appropriately. Scope limited to backend tool definitions.

7ca58ba30216393e548245c276a8d3a082e97c58.title: Upgrade @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch to 0.12.0
7ca58ba30216393e548245c276a8d3a082e97c58.summary: Dependency `@homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch` upgraded from `0.12.0-beta.5` to stable `0.12.0` in `npm-app/package.json`. Replaces beta release with stable version. Scope limited to `npm-app` package definition.

2dc51dd01d317d65ef0d5ca9f56899e2f564535d.title: Refactor typecheck scripts to include dependencies
2dc51dd01d317d65ef0d5ca9f56899e2f564535d.summary: Removed `typecheck-only` script across packages. `typecheck` now runs `build` (which implies `typecheck-this-package`) to ensure dependencies are checked. Updated `codebuff.json` and CI workflows to use `bun run typecheck` instead of `bun run typecheck-only`.

d7069b26853983bbee4578bb3090b86af616c75b.title: Remove no git root log
d7069b26853983bbee4578bb3090b86af616c75b.summary: Deleted `console.log('No git root found')` in `getRepoMetrics` within `npm-app/src/utils/git.ts`. Function returns empty object when `findGitRoot` fails, suppressing noisy stderr/stdout output for non-git directories. Internal logging cleanup only.

a3887a96ef09b27e692e55398c651355db10ed71.title: ftfilepickertopk003 added for top-2 file selection testing
a3887a96ef09b27e692e55398c651355db10ed71.summary: New finetuned model `ft_filepicker_topk_003` registered in `common/src/constants.ts` and `scripts/ft-file-selection/relabel-for-offline-scoring.ts`. This model combines `ft_filepicker_topk_002`'s top-2 selection strategy with `ft_filepicker_010`'s message history blobbing. The offline scoring script now includes this model in the evaluation set, while `print-recent-relabels.ts` updates to display model and output details for better debugging. Backend `request-files-prompt.ts` logic simplified to always use `ft_filepicker_010` for production, removing experimental cost-mode branching.

6d5132fe0079da1f755de28cc142653355ed8070.title: Rename admin/organizations route to admin/orgs
6d5132fe0079da1f755de28cc142653355ed8070.summary: Renamed `web/src/app/admin/organizations/page.tsx` to `web/src/app/admin/orgs/page.tsx` and updated internal API fetch paths from `/api/admin/organizations` to `/api/admin/orgs` and `/api/admin/organizations/export` to `/api/admin/orgs/export`. This standardizes URL slugs for the admin organization subsystem. The invite acceptance flow in `web/src/app/invites/[token]/page.tsx` now redirects to `/orgs/{slug}` instead of `/organizations/{slug}`.

4c6e211fd43468d6947146a0da1dfa93e66796ba.title: Extract waitForPreviousCheckpoint to sync tool execution
4c6e211fd43468d6947146a0da1dfa93e66796ba.summary: Refactor checkpoint synchronization logic into `waitForPreviousCheckpoint` in `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/checkpoint.ts`. `npm-app/src/client.ts` now awaits this helper before processing `str_replace`, `create_plan`, and `run_terminal_command` tool calls. Ensures previous file state saves complete before subsequent operations execute. Internal stability improvement for CLI checkpoint handling.

c07f2a21bfa2a51d9491920a940f4fd78c14a8ef.title: Fix terminal ANSI parsing and hook commands
c07f2a21bfa2a51d9491920a940f4fd78c14a8ef.summary: Split `stripColors` and `stripAnsi` in `common/src/util/string.ts` to handle OSC sequences correctly. Updated `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts` to use strict `IPty` types and dynamic needle patterns for command completion detection. `codebuff.json` hooks now separate unit tests from typechecking with simplified ANSI stripping.

481268890ead7e6df216c6c78649b97d8eaf1108.title: evals import integrations src, drop workspace deps
481268890ead7e6df216c6c78649b97d8eaf1108.summary: evals/git-evals/email-eval-results.ts imports sendBasicEmail from ../../packages/integrations/src instead of @codebuff/integrations. evals/package.json removes @codebuff/integrations, @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch, and codebuff workspace dependencies. This avoids needing to build the integrations package before running evals. Only async and lodash remain as evals dependencies.

b3635743890db81079ecc68fca3e23b4022dad6a.title: Prompt tweaks: end turn after 1 fix attempt, ask mode flag copy
b3635743890db81079ecc68fca3e23b4022dad6a.summary: System prompt instructs agent to stop and call end_turn after one fix attempt, replacing previous multi-refinement guidance. Lite mode prompt branch removed; unified instruction now allows clarify-or-complete. CLI --ask flag description shortened to "won't change code" in npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts. Unused isGPT4_1 constant deleted from backend/src/main-prompt.ts.

14732e57b7cc6cd92104180ded4a7c59b681f8c7.text: A small internal update ensures the assistant correctly recognizes when to stop its response. This prevents the assistant from continuing to talk after it has finished answering.

d7069b26853983bbee4578bb3090b86af616c75b.text: The system stopped printing a warning message when checking folders that do not contain project history. This small internal cleanup removes unnecessary clutter from the background logs.

7ca58ba30216393e548245c276a8d3a082e97c58.text: The app now uses a more reliable background tool for handling text input. This is a small internal update that improves stability without changing how you use the product.

6d5132fe0079da1f755de28cc142653355ed8070.text: The web address for the organization management page became shorter. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

2dc51dd01d317d65ef0d5ca9f56899e2f564535d.text: A small internal update ensures the system checks more thoroughly for errors before releasing new features.

481268890ead7e6df216c6c78649b97d8eaf1108.text: A small internal update simplifies how the system checks its own performance. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

4c6e211fd43468d6947146a0da1dfa93e66796ba.text: The assistant now waits for file saves to finish before running other commands. This internal change makes the tool more stable.

a3887a96ef09b27e692e55398c651355db10ed71.text: The system now uses a single, stable method for choosing files, removing experimental options that could cause inconsistent results. Testing tools were also updated to help developers check performance more easily.

b3635743890db81079ecc68fca3e23b4022dad6a.text: The assistant now stops after one attempt to fix an issue instead of trying repeatedly. A new setting lets you ask questions without changing your work.

c07f2a21bfa2a51d9491920a940f4fd78c14a8ef.text: Fixed issues with how the terminal displays text and detects commands, ensuring cleaner output and more accurate recognition of what you type.

7474488918ec1d9d750f2151b69cdc6b1e88a43e.title: Remove terminal cwdIdentifier tracking and consolidate hooks
7474488918ec1d9d750f2151b69cdc6b1e88a43e.summary: Removed `cwdIdentifier` logic from `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts` and deleted `runSinglePtyCommand`. `codebuff.json` hooks now merge unit tests and typechecks, using ANSI-stripping regex for cleaner output.

3831d39f0f1ac516d3ba805372f427c356c2d67a.title: Add @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch to evals
3831d39f0f1ac516d3ba805372f427c356c2d67a.summary: Added @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch (0.12.0-beta.5) to evals/package.json dependencies. Fixes homebridge installation in evals. Affects evals package only.

178ff024821759fd4218f34b9462517b7d377be2.title: Remove gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25 model references
178ff024821759fd4218f34b9462517b7d377be2.summary: Removed gemini2_5_pro_exp and its OpenRouter alias from common/src/constants.ts. Updated scripts/ft-file-selection/relabel-traces.ts to cast model as gemini2_5_pro_preview. Covers core model registry and internal trace tooling. Existing references to the deprecated experimental model are now stripped from type definitions and provider mappings.

47b7d8a51e19698b51793676075fca9c1c76f70f.title: Drop evals build step
47b7d8a51e19698b51793676075fca9c1c76f70f.summary: Removed `build` script and `outDir` from `evals/package.json` and `evals/tsconfig.json`. Eval scripts now run TypeScript files directly via `bun run` instead of compiled JS in `dist/`. File `run-eval-set.ts` moved to `git-evals/` directory, updating relative imports. No user-facing changes.

38ba1be288146175bb1e7036bfb3f6408b555022.title: Remove evals build target and IPty type
38ba1be288146175bb1e7036bfb3f6408b555022.summary: Removed build, clean, and dependsOn targets from evals/project.json. run-eval-set now executes git-evals/run-eval-set.ts directly via bun. Replaced specific IPty type with any in npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts PersistentProcess union. Dropped @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch type import.

92a9d9ffc967b74c6da37d418990ac7e2b3f6018.title: gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 replaces 05-06 in constants
92a9d9ffc967b74c6da37d418990ac7e2b3f6018.summary: The `gemini2_5_pro_preview` model identifier in `common/src/constants.ts` updated from `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06` to `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05`. This aligns the core constants with the latest Gemini Pro release. The change affects the shared model registry used across all Freebuff surfaces.

05eb927283b72ed9ac1b0f034715b58970d9b3d4.title: Add codebuff workspace dependency to evals
05eb927283b72ed9ac1b0f034715b58970d9b3d4.summary: Added `codebuff` to `dependencies` in `evals/package.json` and `implicitDependencies` in `evals/project.json`. This establishes an explicit workspace link to the core `codebuff` package for the evaluation suite. Scope limited to `evals` project configuration files. Dependency uses `workspace:*` protocol to ensure local package resolution.

919feca0c9dd5b71552e9315a3c5478d2a0d4a64.title: Exclude dist from evals tsconfig
919feca0c9dd5b71552e9315a3c5478d2a0d4a64.summary: Added 'dist' to the exclude array in evals/tsconfig.json. This prevents TypeScript from attempting to compile or type-check generated artifacts within the evals directory. Scope is limited to the evals subsystem configuration.

67ff237180cb905fc6e7962fe013d7993a793c8c.title: Fix terminal command hangs and split hooks
67ff237180cb905fc6e7962fe013d7993a793c8c.summary: Terminal commands no longer hang due to incorrect output parsing in `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts`. The `commandDonePattern` regex now uses `cwdIdentifier` instead of `promptIdentifier` to correctly detect command completion. `codebuff.json` file change hooks are split: unit tests and typechecks run as separate hooks for backend, npm-app, web, and common, replacing the chained `&&` commands.

919feca0c9dd5b71552e9315a3c5478d2a0d4a64.text: A small internal update fixes how the system checks its own test tools. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

47b7d8a51e19698b51793676075fca9c1c76f70f.text: The team simplified how the software checks its own accuracy behind the scenes. This change is small and internal, so users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

7474488918ec1d9d750f2151b69cdc6b1e88a43e.text: The app cleaned up how it tracks where you are working and combined two checks into one. This makes the results you see clearer and easier to read.

3831d39f0f1ac516d3ba805372f427c356c2d67a.text: A small internal update fixes a setup error for some automated tests. No changes to how the product works for you.

67ff237180cb905fc6e7962fe013d7993a793c8c.text: Commands now finish correctly instead of getting stuck. Internal checks run separately for better reliability.

b079c0e919038c49325b03e4692d910c76c06fe2.summary: Added @codebuff/integrations as workspace dependency in evals/package.json. Fixes broken codebuff integrations within the evaluation suite. Scope limited to evals package dependencies.

f6c7068c3e36a2803c699018a8ac13a98eb17e27.title: Remove relace tool formatter experiment

Removed local-only invocation logic and imports from `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This cleans up unused experimental code for parsing malformed XML tool calls via Relace API.

6dde6b9b6c63d71a7a11cbd578ac948a35de43bd.title: Add e2e cat app test script
6dde6b9b6c63d71a7a11cbd578ac948a35de43bd.summary: Added `e2e-cat-app-script.ts` to `evals` to run end-to-end tests against a 'cat app' backend and CLI. Includes `test:e2e-cat-app` npm script in `evals/package.json`.

6aabac5a3b27729e7bb58fcd22f42d6fbe75afb0.title: Remove old planning doc
6aabac5a3b27729e7bb58fcd22f42d6fbe75afb0.summary: Deleted `codebuff-export-agent-mode-planning.md`. This 140-line internal design document for Agent Mode is no longer relevant. Scope limited to repository root.

4314b9b04c81603d346c22ece0a495e522136c73.title: Pin AI SDK and provider dependencies to exact versions
4314b9b04c81603d346c22ece0a495e522136c73.summary: Pins `ai`, `@ai-sdk/google-vertex`, `@ai-sdk/openai`, `@google-cloud/vertexai`, and `@google/generative-ai` to exact versions in `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json`. 6da7097649cd6490bf022cfd3967bde498a85929.title: Resolve invitation first name from DB instead of request payload
6da7097649cd6490bf022cfd3967bde498a85929.summary: sendOrganizationInvitationEmail in packages/integrations/src/loops/client.ts now queries the user table via Drizzle to fetch the recipient's name, splitting the full name to extract the first token. Callers in web/src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/invitations/route.ts and bulk/route.ts no longer pass firstName, relying on the integration to resolve it or default to 'there' if the user record is missing or lookup fails.

e6a47725bfa7cdf648bd6683802382696c79b34c.title: Add error logging to validateAutoTopupStatus
e6a47725bfa7cdf648bd6683802382696c79b34c.summary: Added `logger.error` call in `validateAutoTopupStatus` catch block in `packages/billing/src/auto-topup.ts`. Ensures auto-topup validation failures are logged with error context. Internal change only, no user-facing behavior impact.

d2eddcb6a9a9369239a4a5cf928f1716e4b5a4f3.title: New integrations package for third-party services
d2eddcb6a9a9369239a4a5cf928f1716e4b5a4f3.summary: Added `@codebuff/integrations` package to centralize third-party service logic. Migrated Loops email utility from `backend/src/util/loops.ts` to `packages/integrations/src/loops/`, replacing raw fetch calls with the official `loops` SDK client. Updated `evals` and `web` auth/invite routes to consume the new package. Consolidated fileChangeHooks in `codebuff.json` by merging typecheck commands into unit test hooks.

304f2f3392465a401ec0cfd4ed09617ad623ac1c.title: Expose Gemini reasoning via includeThoughts in stream
304f2f3392465a401ec0cfd4ed09617ad623ac1c.summary: Switched to response.fullStream and set providerOptions.google.thinkingConfig.includeThoughts to true in promptAiSdkStream. This captures reasoning chunks and wraps them in <think_deeply> tags before yielding text-delta content. Scope limited to backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts.

6da7097649cd6490bf022cfd3967bde498a85929.text: Invitation emails now get the recipient's first name from the user database instead of the request data. If the name is missing, the email uses 'there' as a fallback. This is a small internal change.

e6a47725bfa7cdf648bd6683802382696c79b34c.text: The system now records more details when automatic top-ups fail. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

6dde6b9b6c63d71a7a11cbd578ac948a35de43bd.text: The team added an internal test to check the product's core functions. You won't notice a difference, but it helps the team catch problems before they reach you.

6aabac5a3b27729e7bb58fcd22f42d6fbe75afb0.text: The company removed an old internal document about the assistant's planning process. This change does not affect how the assistant works for you.

be9cd704489e65d16e3104d8e3959dcf43776d8f.text: Invitation links now use a fixed website address instead of changing based on how you open the page. This ensures team invites work reliably.

faddc8bd73f9615b5b097660ea5e2d921bbc6b52.text: The invitation page now fits better on the screen, and canceling an invitation shows a clearer pop-up message instead of a basic browser alert.

121f21767f0e319102ded87d84d9c772133a7d36.summary: Removed unnecessary info/debug log statements from organization and user auto top-up checks in backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts. 6e293d16cb835cbf5d8d01c24090826b9752cdf7.title: Remove terminal debug logging
6e293d16cb835cbf5d8d01c24090826b9752cdf7.summary: Removed temporary debug logging from `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. 8328215807fd545487b12ec415ded2afdceb3920.title: Remove tool end-of-stream test case
8328215807fd545487b12ec415ded2afdceb3920.summary: Deleted a specific test case from `backend/src/__tests__/xml-stream-parser.test.ts` that expected an INFO log for unclosed tools at stream end. ff94f9b459190ac8962fe83774f0e0fdd67b4d1c.title: Add typecheck runs for backend npm-app common

9addae7a5cdff64a2d5cedd9cb11f4cd9f4c2fad.summary: Added comprehensive unit tests for `CodebuffConfigSchema`, `StartupProcessSchema`, and `FileChangeHook` in `common/src/json-config/__tests__/constants.test.ts`. 5014af4859bbde92fd438d261f1a1fd362e106f4.summary: Added manager-prompt.ts and manager-system-prompt.ts to enable a supervisory agent mode that orchestrates coding tasks via terminal commands. Scope covers backend prompt logic, tool definitions, and websocket routing.

143623d373dd5e0f6e42638cd3d21b98edc048f0.text: The assistant no longer automatically checks its work after answering. It will only do this if you ask.

8328215807fd545487b12ec415ded2afdceb3920.text: Deleted a test that checked for a specific log message. This is a small internal change. It does not affect how the product works.
