bb3d358fe494ddc3dbf30fe781a34d5c9707a205.summary: Switched `costMode` from 'max' to 'normal' in `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts`. Removed obsolete comments regarding message order and tool result lookup. Aligns test mocks with current prompt construction logic.

5e19586d1ab609bc0033e47008c475fbf9ac1f1a.title: Update stringify-schema test snapshots for stdout/stderr file
5e19586d1ab609bc0033e47008c475fbf9ac1f1a.summary: Test snapshots in `common/src/json-config/__tests__/__snapshots__/stringify-schema.test.ts.snap` updated to reflect corrected documentation for `stdoutFile` and `stderrFile` in `StartupProcessSchema` and `CodebuffConfigSchema`. Descriptions clarify that `stderrFile` defaults to capturing stderr into `stdoutFile` if unspecified, rather than discarding output. Internal test alignment only; no runtime behavior changes.

8a8e4e5d08355332f1a001818c59c57e06a53b3f.title: Add analytics logging to background process manager
8a8e4e5d08355332f1a001818c59c57e06a53b3f.summary: Analytics logging added to background process lifecycle in npm-app/src/background-process-manager.ts. Enum BACKGROUND_PROCESS_STARTED replaced with granular events START, END, CONTINUE, LEFTOVER_DETECTED in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. Logger context refactored from AsyncLocalStorage to global object in npm-app/src/utils/logger.ts, buffering events until user identification. flushAnalytics made async and awaited in CLI exit handlers.

000bd9f527893b93a620870ddf0682eb6ab77ba9.text: The app now tags each request with a unique ID to help the team track and fix issues faster.

03cbe0d68e2b22eb3a810c1fb8abb04ed6ba6901.text: The app now records basic usage details to help the team understand how it works. This does not change how you use it.

802e0cea25fb42dfb9aed1b2e623a777611f18f8.text: The product name now appears with a capital letter in menus and messages. This is a small internal fix to keep the branding consistent.

8a8e4e5d08355332f1a001818c59c57e06a53b3f.text: The system now tracks when background tasks start, stop, or remain active. This change helps the team understand how the product works behind the scenes.

1e88e73993752e785e0cd6ed5881d5ab6aeff0bf.text: When you sign in, the system now records that event. This helps track usage and improve the product.

bb3d358fe494ddc3dbf30fe781a34d5c9707a205.text: Internal test settings were updated to match current system behavior. This small change does not affect how the product works for users.

5e19586d1ab609bc0033e47008c475fbf9ac1f1a.text: The written instructions about how to save program messages to a file were corrected. This change only updated the documentation and did not affect how the software works.

19be4bb7b62962bef60e9a335c3877487c7c4c0d.text: The app now shuts down background tasks more reliably on Windows. This prevents the software from freezing or leaving hidden processes running after you close it.

02c69f33e90bac403ed0165a7a303ca88d3ff3f5.text: The app now uses a single tool to record when it starts and when background tasks begin. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the app.

0f59d8b251cd5a8c4fdc8ef5d6bf6cae62b54f77.text: Startup and background process messages are now clearer and more consistent.

2f82f187c4b2b473f505c91419c67342ecd06281.title: Update init flow prompting in system prompts
2f82f187c4b2b473f505c91419c67342ecd06281.summary: Refined `init` command triggering logic in `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`. The prompt now explicitly recognizes user-typed "init" and adds granular instructions for populating `startupProcesses` fields, specifying `stdoutFile` paths and conditional `cwd` inclusion while excluding `stderrFile` and `enabled` flags.

803e039b6702465eaec7bdcf630f527fe83c139c.title: Hide process IDs in dev startup logs
803e039b6702465eaec7bdcf630f527fe83c139c.summary: Removed `pid` display from `console.log` in `npm-app/src/dev-process-manager.ts`. Startup output now shows process name and command only. This reduces noise in dev environment logs.

3c567fbc6da4246be4c3cd94d6eb7c8501075fa3.title: runBackgroundCommand defaults stderrFile to stdoutFile
3c567fbc6da4246be4c3cd94d6eb7c8501075fa3.summary: Internal refactor in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. `runBackgroundCommand` now defaults `stderrFile` to `stdoutFile` if not explicitly provided. This ensures stderr streams to the same destination as stdout when only `stdoutFile` is set, preventing orphaned stderr handles or defaulting to process stderr.

1bbf9532f7e7f31b9aec00978b6e43340e7ee80d.title: Fix added lines for newly created files
1bbf9532f7e7f31b9aec00978b6e43340e7ee80d.summary: handleWriteFile now reports full file length for new files instead of parsing diff markers. Line counting logic moved into modified loop, removing @@ filter. Covers npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. Created files display +N where N is total lines, not just added diff lines.

4c693bd6efb85134755b3c451e6324a7cd51c655.title: Docs drop Flash file-finding claim
4c693bd6efb85134755b3c451e6324a7cd51c655.summary: what-models.mdx no longer credits Gemini Flash with finding relevant files. Only the file-finding clause was removed; Flash keeps its quick-tasks role. Scope limited to web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx. Claude Sonnet, Relace speculative decoding, o3-mini, and gpt-4o-mini descriptions unchanged.

82baf196ace3e86f173eb57e0de8f07a00c0e433.title: Update stderr description in StartupProcessSchema
82baf196ace3e86f173eb57e0de8f07a00c0e433.summary: The `stderrFile` description in `common/src/json-config/constants.ts` clarifies that stderr defaults to `stdoutFile` when unspecified. The `stdoutFile` description was also updated for consistency. Example configs in `codebuff.json` removed explicit `stderrFile` entries relying on this default behavior.

999ee4f1e3e546b4749b01be7e7321441abb1893.title: Add --init flag to CLI
999ee4f1e3e546b4749b01be7e7321441abb1893.summary: Adds `--init` flag to trigger initialization flow on startup. `printInitialPrompt` now accepts object with `runInitFlow` boolean, executing `handleUserInput('init')` before other inputs. Scope covers `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, `npm-app/src/index.ts`, and `npm-app/src/types.ts`. `CliOptions` interface updated with optional `runInitFlow` property.

77dfbd74de9c70bc00042cc5e78237877e00b791.title: Refactor CLI Client constructor to options object
77dfbd74de9c70bc00042cc5e78237877e00b791.summary: CLI Client constructor switches from positional arguments to options object. `returnControlToUser` renamed to `freshPrompt` across `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`. `freshPrompt` now handles `isReceivingResponse` flag reset directly. Internal refactor improves readability and state management consistency.

812cb8c1d2608eb2a367d90e162cd8d31e5efb71.title: Wrap system messages with <system> XML tag
812cb8c1d2608eb2a367d90e162cd8d31e5efb71.summary: Refactored system prompt handling in backend/src/main-prompt.ts to use new asSystemMessage utility from backend/src/util/messages.ts instead of asSystemInstructions. The asSystemMessage function wraps strings with <system> XML tags. Renamed replacementPrompts to additionalSystemPrompts in backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts and updated init prompt logic to skip updates if knowledge/config files exist.

6e6070edc398eff93684924144c3794266fe4fea.title: Always use finetuned model in file picker
6e6070edc398eff93684924144c3794266fe4fea.summary: File picker request logic now hardcodes `useFinetunedModel: true`, removing the conditional check against `costMode === 'experimental'`. This ensures `models.ft_filepicker_005` is always selected for relevant file determination, bypassing the `gemini2flash` fallback path. The change affects `backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts`. Telemetry fields for model selection now statically reflect the finetuned model ID.

77dfbd74de9c70bc00042cc5e78237877e00b791.text: Internal code cleanup. No changes to how you use the app.

803e039b6702465eaec7bdcf630f527fe83c139c.text: The startup screen now shows fewer details. This makes the text easier to read.

1bbf9532f7e7f31b9aec00978b6e43340e7ee80d.text: When the assistant creates a new file, it now correctly shows the total number of lines written. Previously, it only counted lines marked as new in the code changes, which could be misleading.

3c567fbc6da4246be4c3cd94d6eb7c8501075fa3.text: Small internal fix. Error messages now go to the same log file as normal output. This keeps all records together.

812cb8c1d2608eb2a367d90e162cd8d31e5efb71.text: The system now marks internal instructions clearly to prevent confusion with user requests. This small internal update improves how the assistant separates setup rules from conversation.

4c693bd6efb85134755b3c451e6324a7cd51c655.text: The guide no longer says the fast assistant model can search through files. This is a small wording fix inside the help pages. It does not change how the product works.

82baf196ace3e86f173eb57e0de8f07a00c0e433.text: The tool now automatically uses the same output file for errors and standard messages if no separate error file is set. This simplifies configuration by removing the need to specify both paths.

2f82f187c4b2b473f505c91419c67342ecd06281.text: Small internal update. The system now better understands startup commands. It fills in correct settings automatically. You might see fewer setup errors.

999ee4f1e3e546b4749b01be7e7321441abb1893.text: The tool now supports a special startup option that automatically runs its setup process. This saves you from manually starting the setup each time.

6e6070edc398eff93684924144c3794266fe4fea.text: The file search feature now always uses a specific, more accurate model to find files, regardless of previous settings. This ensures consistent results for users searching their documents.

f131589598d2cf2afafbe08cc7059b6401942b6c.title: tool-handlers.ts shows added/deleted line counts
f131589598d2cf2afafbe08cc7059b6401942b6c.summary: handleWriteFile in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts now parses fileChange.content to count lines starting with + and - (excluding @@). console.log output for created files appends (+N) and for modified files appends (+N, -M). Scope limited to CLI tool handler logging. Counts derived from diff content split on newlines.

9a1f34db9bd2c00a7410e4ee572a41f3b60cb881.title: Add ftfilepicker005 model for experimental file selection
9a1f34db9bd2c00a7410e4ee572a41f3b60cb881.summary: Registers `ft_filepicker_005` in `common/src/constants.ts` and enables it for file selection when `costMode === 'experimental'`. The backend `promptFlashWithFallbacks` now attempts this finetuned Vertex model via `promptAiSdk_GeminiFormat` before falling back to standard Gemini APIs. Cost tracking in `message-cost-tracker.ts` assigns specific token rates, and the BigQuery `GetRelevantFilesPayload` schema adds a `model` field to trace usage.

c2aa5a31540d63ff75742afd0e7ffacbbd4003d8.title: Remove double checkpoint in init flow
c2aa5a31540d63ff75742afd0e7ffacbbd4003d8.summary: Removed redundant `saveCheckpoint` call in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` during the `init` command. The backend already receives the request, making the local checkpoint save unnecessary. This prevents duplicate checkpoint entries for new directories.

c1b94ae0c196207adcafe89014ee39d8d1acf740.title: Move web scraping to client tool results
c1b94ae0c196207adcafe89014ee39d8d1acf740.summary: Refactored web scraping logic from CLI input preprocessing to client-side tool result generation. Scraped content now appended as `web-scraper` tool result via `buildArray` in `client.ts`, replacing direct string concatenation in `cli.ts`. Affects `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Ensures scraped URLs are included in tool results rather than raw user messages.

cfc0936f7c332b64960713c4926a8a8c3f2ce0ee.title: Add init command to CLI menu
cfc0936f7c332b64960713c4926a8a8c3f2ce0ee.summary: CLI menu now lists "init" for automatic project configuration. Brand casing shifted from "Codebuff" to "codebuff" in greeting and help text. Changes confined to `npm-app/src/menu.ts`.

9f8c0cce87df10772390f220584334ebe7e89f23.title: Fix BigQuery deduplication and tune data collection limits
9f8c0cce87df10772390f220584334ebe7e89f23.summary: Updated getTracesWithRelabels in common/src/bigquery/client.ts to group by agent_step_id and select only the latest relabel via ARRAY_AGG, preventing duplicate training samples. Increased trace fetch limits to 10000 in collect-tuning-data.ts and 1000 in relabel-traces.ts. Added a 500k character filter to discard oversized JSONL entries during export. Updated scripts/ft-file-selection/README.md with metadata for ft_filepicker_003 and ft_filepicker_005 finetunes.

a59eb8799ca9dcfd8d1a89439e7c125417e44464.title: gpt4.1 newline injection in thinking stream
a59eb8799ca9dcfd8d1a89439e7c125417e44464.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts injects newline after getThinkingStream for models.gpt4_1. Variable response changed to let to allow mutation. Ensures proper formatting in experimental and max cost modes.

3558b7a0601943015cd6076d3af876a0f6ea4ea6.title: Add thinkingBudget to Gemini API, rename promptFlashWithFallbacks
3558b7a0601943015cd6076d3af876a0f6ea4ea6.summary: Added `thinkingBudget` option to `promptGemini` and `promptGeminiStream` in `gemini-api.ts` and `gemini-vertex-api.ts`, mapping to `thinkingConfig` when defined. Renamed `promptGeminiWithFallbacks` to `promptFlashWithFallbacks` in `gemini-with-fallbacks.ts`, updating imports and calls in `relabelRuns.ts`, `check-terminal-command.ts`, `fast-rewrite.ts`, `check-new-files-necessary.ts`, `request-files-prompt.ts`, and `get-documentation-for-query.ts`. Internal backend tooling change.

ea533f8d06f0c48e553825c246cc202f920dced6.title: Enable typecheck watcher via tsconfig
ea533f8d06f0c48e553825c246cc202f920dced6.summary: Added root tsconfig.json referencing common, backend, npm-app, web, and packages/code-map. Updated codebuff.json to enable typechecker using bun tsc -b -w. Logs stdout and stderr to debug/typecheck.log. Replaces disabled bun typecheck --watch.

35439a6f3d7516558d9fe733baa8b5d2619c86e1.title: Refactor one-time tags to labels and add config state
35439a6f3d7516558d9fe733baa8b5d2619c86e1.summary: Renamed `ONE_TIME_TAGS` to `ONE_TIME_LABELS` in `common/src/constants.ts` and `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to support new `ASKED_CONFIG` and `SHOULD_ASK_CONFIG` states. The `npm-app/src/client.ts` now imports these labels and uses named `fs`/`readline` imports, updating internal state tracking from `oneTimeTagsShown` to `oneTimeFlags`. This change prepares the CLI to handle configuration prompts via the new label system while maintaining existing tag filtering logic.

f131589598d2cf2afafbe08cc7059b6401942b6c.text: A small internal update adds line counts to the log messages when files are created or modified. This change does not affect how users interact with the product.

9a1f34db9bd2c00a7410e4ee572a41f3b60cb881.text: The assistant now uses a new experimental model to find relevant files when you are in experimental mode. This change is internal and may help the assistant pick better files for you.

ea533f8d06f0c48e553825c246cc202f920dced6.text: This is a small internal change. It automatically checks the code for errors as developers work. This helps catch mistakes earlier, so the app stays reliable.

9f8c0cce87df10772390f220584334ebe7e89f23.text: Fixed duplicate records in data collection and set limits to discard oversized entries. This improves data quality for training. Internal change; no direct user impact.

cfc0936f7c332b64960713c4926a8a8c3f2ce0ee.text: A new setup option now appears in the menu to help configure the project automatically. The product name also changed its capitalization to match a new brand style.

3558b7a0601943015cd6076d3af876a0f6ea4ea6.text: The assistant now controls its internal reasoning effort and uses a new fallback model. This change is internal and does not affect your daily use.

c2aa5a31540d63ff75742afd0e7ffacbbd4003d8.text: The app stopped saving duplicate setup records when starting a new folder. This keeps the history clean for you.

c1b94ae0c196207adcafe89014ee39d8d1acf740.text: The assistant now gets web content through its own tools instead of mixing it into your text. This makes its answers more accurate and organized.

a59eb8799ca9dcfd8d1a89439e7c125417e44464.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant formats its responses correctly when using a new model. This change does not affect how you use the product.

aa47ceb8544353b8178662323e94db768d27fe29.title: Tighten thinking stream prompt brevity
aa47ceb8544353b8178662323e94db768d27fe29.summary: Updated system guidelines in `backend/src/thinking-stream.ts` to enforce shorter thinking sessions. Changed permissive wording to 'highly recommended' and added explicit 'Keep your thinking as short as possible!' instruction. Affects internal reasoning token generation logic.

87cb434d8399f9de0a4d3a549a37d229697006dc.title: Docs update model descriptions for lite and max modes
87cb434d8399f9de0a4d3a549a37d229697006dc.summary: Documentation files updated to reflect current model routing for --lite and --max modes. --lite now describes Gemini 2.5 Flash Thinking (~1/5 cost), while --max describes a hybrid of Gemini 2.5 Pro and Claude Sonnet. FAQ and keyboard shortcut docs also updated to include Gemini 2.5 Pro for thinking in --max mode.

2d481063a4f98716a1dd383878818b8fbb152661.title: Add gpt4.1 to experimental mode
2d481063a4f98716a1dd383878818b8fbb152661.summary: gpt4.1 now serves the 'agent' operation when costMode is 'experimental'. This expands the experimental tier beyond gemini2_5_flash_thinking, which remains the default for 'lite'. The change occurs in common/src/constants.ts within getModelForMode. Experimental mode now routes to models.gpt4_1.

c2c62ac86efaf3f89c920c7159e13dd4ae856f94.title: Add /init command and JSONC config support
c2c62ac86efaf3f89c920c7159e13dd4ae856f94.summary: Introduced `/init` command triggering a specific system prompt to initialize or update project configuration files. Config parser now supports `codebuff.jsonc` with comments via `jsonc-parser`, prioritizing it over `codebuff.json`. System instructions are wrapped in `<system_instructions>` tags for better model adherence. The `description` field was added to `CodebuffConfigSchema` as an optional, non-functional marker.

170734af27ebee319e1db40ff10302e2ac4d9a53.title: Add tag closure instruction for Gemini Flash
170734af27ebee319e1db40ff10302e2ac4d9a53.summary: Added prompt instruction for `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17` to enforce XML tag closure. Prevents malformed tool calls like unclosed `<write_file>`. Applies in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

fffe46da7dcb1526f248a3a6d48ce3b66abc9548.title: Add getOpenRouterAccountInfo function
fffe46da7dcb1526f248a3a6d48ce3b66abc9548.summary: Added getOpenRouterAccountInfo to backend/src/llm-apis/open-router.ts. Fetches account info from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/auth/key using env.OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY. Logs response data to console.

13ac3e2bf59d4298c3319884e98ac10682c88e97.title: Prompt clarification for new file creation
13ac3e2bf59d4298c3319884e98ac10682c88e97.summary: System prompts updated to distinguish between editing existing files and creating new ones. The main prompt now specifies 'When editing an existing file' to scope the placeholder comment instruction. The write_file tool description explicitly mandates writing the entire file for new files without placeholder comments. This prevents the agent from generating incomplete stubs for new files. Files: backend/src/main-prompt.ts, backend/src/tools.ts.

b907db6d8af65b13a0871fa4cf04eb63ce3da8e3.title: Add /config webpage and schema display component
b907db6d8af65b13a0871fa4cf04eb63ce3da8e3.summary: New `/config` page redirects to docs anchor. `SchemaDisplay` component renders `CodebuffConfigSchema` via `stringifySchema`. `stringify-schema.ts` refactored for better LLM/human readability (indentation, object handling). `constants.ts` descriptions trimmed. Docs content `config.mdx` added.

3502c13ca329b1df069bc552c62b113f0cce5662.title: Clean up agent instructions
3502c13ca329b1df069bc552c62b113f0cce5662.summary: Removed redundant persona constraints and deleted the State Management section from `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`. Renumbered response guidelines after dropping the mandatory commentary rule. Simplified example XML tags by removing explanatory comments and persona-specific log messages.

62b53d39e63cf6bacd03840a124dedec307fb865.title: Standardize environment variable to NEXTPUBLICCBENVIRONMENT
62b53d39e63cf6bacd03840a124dedec307fb865.summary: Replaced inconsistent `ENVIRONMENT` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENVIRONMENT` variables with a unified `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` across backend, common, and npm-app. This change resolves configuration drift where different services read different environment flags, ensuring consistent behavior for logging, database selection, and build processes. Updated files include `backend/src/env.mjs`, `common/src/env.mjs`, `common/src/db/env.mjs`, and `npm-app/clean-package.js`. Developers must update their local `stack.env` files to use `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` instead of the previous variable names.

87cb434d8399f9de0a4d3a549a37d229697006dc.text: Internal help pages updated to match current settings.

13ac3e2bf59d4298c3319884e98ac10682c88e97.text: The assistant now clearly distinguishes between updating existing content and creating new files. When creating a new file, it writes the complete content instead of leaving placeholders. This reduces the chance of incomplete results.

aa47ceb8544353b8178662323e94db768d27fe29.text: The assistant now uses shorter internal reasoning steps. This change is small and internal. It may make the assistant slightly faster.

c2c62ac86efaf3f89c920c7159e13dd4ae856f94.text: The assistant can now use a setup command to create or update project settings. Configuration files can now include notes, which the system ignores but helps you remember why you made changes.

b907db6d8af65b13a0871fa4cf04eb63ce3da8e3.text: The settings page now shows configuration details in a clearer layout.

fffe46da7dcb1526f248a3a6d48ce3b66abc9548.text: Added an internal tool to check account status. This change has no effect on the product.

62b53d39e63cf6bacd03840a124dedec307fb865.text: The app now uses one shared setting instead of several conflicting ones to decide how to run. This makes the experience more consistent and reliable for you.

3502c13ca329b1df069bc552c62b113f0cce5662.text: The assistant's internal rules were simplified by removing repetitive instructions. This change is small and internal, so you likely won't notice any difference in how the product works.

170734af27ebee319e1db40ff10302e2ac4d9a53.text: A small internal fix helps the assistant write files more reliably.

2d481063a4f98716a1dd383878818b8fbb152661.text: The assistant now uses a different brain for experimental features. This does not change how everyday tasks work.

8368751eadd40e5d083abcb67fe8d915005b423b.title: Fix file tab completion
8368751eadd40e5d083abcb67fe8d915005b423b.summary: Replaces `completer` with `filePathCompleter` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to fix file tab completion. Removes dependency on `common/project-file-tree` and `fileTree`, switching to `fs.readdirSync` and `os.homedir` for direct filesystem path resolution. Adds `isDir` helper to `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` for directory checks.

11fc25a9bec9271d36cf766784d435e6eeea0164.title: Remove file sorting from admin file picker
11fc25a9bec9271d36cf766784d435e6eeea0164.summary: Removed `.sort()` from the file list rendering in `web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx`. Files now display in their original order from the API response. This change affects only the internal admin dashboard.

b9940e9407b6dd65b151a988c0fd5b6e2a9ebef9.title: Skip startup processes if another codebuff instance detected
b9940e9407b6dd65b151a988c0fd5b6e2a9ebef9.summary: CLI skips `startupProcesses` in `codebuff.json` when another instance is running. New `startup-process-handler.ts` checks for active processes via lock files before starting dev processes. `background-process-manager.ts` adds PID-based lock file tracking to detect orphaned processes and prevent duplicate startup.

88cd9c7070d987c9ec6b239fe03d10c5a9501fa5.title: Local logs moved to debug folder
88cd9c7070d987c9ec6b239fe03d10c5a9501fa5.summary: Redirected stdout/stderr for drizzle and web server commands to a new `debug/` directory. Added `debug/` to `.gitignore` to prevent local log files from being committed. This change applies to `codebuff.json` configuration.

43ede3cedf244282db007ba5c0b5d1619366aa95.title: SIGTERM handler kills background processes
43ede3cedf244282db007ba5c0b5d1619366aa95.summary: SIGTERM handler in npm-app/src/cli.ts awaits killAllBackgroundProcesses() before exit. Prevents orphaned processes on termination. Affects CLI signal handling.

df4132024acde861056cede0f156f52ecf79b718.title: Login page refactored to server component
df4132024acde861056cede0f156f52ecf79b718.summary: web/src/app/login/page.tsx switched from 'use client' to 'use server'. Auth code expiration check moved server-side using parseInt on expiresAt. UI components extracted to dedicated files like login-card.

9c2c4c5c3d6899dc23a34a8fb9ead53e1c827e80.title: Add web server log configuration and login components
9c2c4c5c3d6899dc23a34a8fb9ead53e1c827e80.summary: Updated `codebuff.json` to route web server stdout and stderr to `web.log`. Added new React components `LoginCard` and `LoginClientWrapper` in `web/src/components/login/` to handle CLI auth code display and general sign-in UI. These changes improve local development logging and modularize the web login interface.

c062d0d02a3dd39428f470dab47c7cb080898f1d.title: Use snapshots for background process manager tests
c062d0d02a3dd39428f470dab47c7cb080898f1d.summary: Refactored `getBackgroundProcessInfoString` tests in `npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/background-process-manager.test.ts` to use `toMatchSnapshot()` instead of multiple `toContain` assertions. Added `background-process-manager.test.ts.snap` to store expected XML-like output formats for running, completed, and errored states. This reduces test verbosity and centralizes format expectations.

fb5808311a44ad0bcd320b6aedcb96fbb4ec5621.title: Add Gemini 2.5 Flash Thinking to Lite Mode
fb5808311a44ad0bcd320b6aedcb96fbb4ec5621.summary: Lite mode agent routing switches from Haiku to `gemini-2.5-flash-thinking`. OpenRouter stream handler now extracts `cache_read_input_tokens` via `stream_options` and adjusts cost tracking for new Gemini variants. Shared constants register the new model IDs and provider mappings across backend and common packages.

621176216624c9d6a65ecc6a7fbe1a4db66ddcd8.title: Refactor background process XML output
621176216624c9d6a65ecc6a7fbe1a4db66ddcd8.summary: Refactored getBackgroundProcessInfoString in npm-app/src/background-process-manager.ts to simplify XML structure generation. Removed nested terminal_command_result tags and conditional stdout/stderr rendering. Adjusted buildArray logic to handle optional fields directly without post-filtering.

c062d0d02a3dd39428f470dab47c7cb080898f1d.text: Internal tests for how the app tracks background tasks were simplified. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

621176216624c9d6a65ecc6a7fbe1a4db66ddcd8.text: The system now sends background task results in a simpler format. This change is internal and will not affect how you use the product.

df4132024acde861056cede0f156f52ecf79b718.text: The login page now checks if the code has expired on the company's servers instead of the user's browser. This change improves security by ensuring the expiration rule is always enforced correctly.

88cd9c7070d987c9ec6b239fe03d10c5a9501fa5.text: We moved technical logs to a hidden folder so they do not clutter your files. This small internal change has no effect on how you use the product.

b9940e9407b6dd65b151a988c0fd5b6e2a9ebef9.text: The app now checks if it is already running before starting new tasks. This prevents duplicate work and keeps the system stable.

8368751eadd40e5d083abcb67fe8d915005b423b.text: A small internal fix improves how the app suggests file names when you start typing a path. It now reads your computer's folders directly, making these suggestions more accurate.

9c2c4c5c3d6899dc23a34a8fb9ead53e1c827e80.text: The system now saves background activity details to a file for easier troubleshooting. The sign-in screen was also reorganized behind the scenes to make it easier to update in the future.

11fc25a9bec9271d36cf766784d435e6eeea0164.text: The file list in the admin dashboard no longer rearranges files alphabetically. Files now appear in the order the system originally provided them.

43ede3cedf244282db007ba5c0b5d1619366aa95.text: When you stop the tool, it now cleans up its background work before closing. This prevents leftover processes from running invisibly on your computer.

fb5808311a44ad0bcd320b6aedcb96fbb4ec5621.text: The assistant's faster mode now uses a newer, smarter thinking model. This change happens behind the scenes and should not affect how you use the product.

32afb049ea62e113f2a917f82ef35c34daf716e4.title: Kill background processes after update
32afb049ea62e113f2a917f82ef35c34daf716e4.summary: updateCodebuff now calls killAllBackgroundProcesses immediately after runUpdateCodebuff in npm-app/src/update-codebuff.ts. Prevents stale processes from holding old binaries post-install. Scope limited to update flow.

dd7fee1b4c0b329726c934cbc68da6845e6fa874.title: Remove server update console log
dd7fee1b4c0b329726c934cbc68da6845e6fa874.summary: Deleted `console.log` in `Client.reconnect()`. Stops 'Server updated' message on WebSocket force reconnect. Internal cleanup in `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

dfb6dcceaf7eab595f4a660efbf0032c46e0bd91.title: Background process manager kills process groups
dfb6dcceaf7eab595f4a660efbf0032c46e0bd91.summary: Updated `npm-app/src/background-process-manager.ts` to spawn child processes with `detached: true` and send `SIGTERM` to negative PIDs (`-pid`). This ensures entire process groups are terminated during cleanup or shutdown, preventing orphaned child processes from lingering after the parent exits.

097f53f35c0c4e5784d898ecce9cb9d3fc984a9d.title: Remove startup log from npm-app CLI
097f53f35c0c4e5784d898ecce9cb9d3fc984a9d.summary: Removed `console.log('Starting Codebuff CLI...')` from `npm-app/src/index.ts`. This cleans up stdout noise during CLI initialization. Affects the `npm-app` package startup sequence.

68ed740c94d260ec66109afabaeb789d43d12282.title: background-process-manager: fix newline printing
68ed740c94d260ec66109afabaeb789d43d12282.summary: background-process-manager cleanupStoredProcesses now prints newline immediately after 'Detected running codebuff processes. Cleaning...' message. Removed redundant console.log() call from finally block. Scope limited to npm-app/src/background-process-manager.ts.

475defeec44c951ccae49628378caeab89a60f3e.title: Dev process banner only when enabled
475defeec44c951ccae49628378caeab89a60f3e.summary: startDevProcesses gates the 'Starting development processes' console banner on processes.some((process) => process.enabled) instead of processes.length. Prevents the header when all StartupProcess entries are disabled. Scope limited to npm-app/src/dev-process-manager.ts. Loop iteration unchanged; disabled processes still skipped by existing per-item check.

ed9d99e02360dcdcf0006cb9553399815cf137fc.title: npm-app: run cleanup in background
ed9d99e02360dcdcf0006cb9553399815cf137fc.summary: CLI constructor `readyPromise` type changed from `Promise<[void, ProjectFileContext]>` to `Promise<[ProjectFileContext, void, void]>` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. `index.ts` now passes `processCleanupPromise` from `cleanupStoredProcesses()` as third element in `Promise.all`. Destructuring in `cli.ts` updated to extract `fileContext` from first position. Internal refactor for background process cleanup.

8569968c83cf953a5130ab0df262b99c558f96e5.title: Fix --lite mode haiku provider mapping
8569968c83cf953a5130ab0df262b99c558f96e5.summary: Added `models.haiku` to `providerModelNames` in `common/src/constants.ts` mapping to 'anthropic'. Updated error message in `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts` to include `model` alongside `selectedModel` and `provider` for unknown model/provider errors. This ensures Haiku is correctly recognized in lite mode.

145218cea047ea5fe5fcf5a50a7469fc1c378209.title: Cap monthly credit grants at 2k for former subscribers
145218cea047ea5fe5fcf5a50a7469fc1c378209.summary: Added 2000 credit cap to getPreviousFreeGrantAmount in common/src/billing/grant-credits.ts for users with prior 'free' grants. Logic excludes 'migration-' prefixed operations and returns Math.min(principal, 2000) if expired grant exists. Scope limited to core billing logic. Temporary safeguard until May 22nd post-migration cleanup.

f49acb7d1549800c1a73424b8600eccb51894aa7.title: SERIALIZABLE isolation for credit consumption and monthly resets
f49acb7d1549800c1a73424b8600eccb51894aa7.summary: Credit consumption and monthly quota resets now use SERIALIZABLE isolation via new helper `withSerializableTransaction` in `common/src/db/transaction.ts`. This prevents double-spending and duplicate grants during concurrent access, with automatic retries on PostgreSQL error 40001. The `check-auth` middleware and usage API route now trigger `triggerMonthlyResetAndGrant` to ensure timely credit renewal. CLI display logic in `npm-app/src/client.ts` shows full timestamps for same-day resets.

68ed740c94d260ec66109afabaeb789d43d12282.text: The cleanup message now shows correctly without extra blank lines. This is a small internal fix that does not change how you use the product.

dfb6dcceaf7eab595f4a660efbf0032c46e0bd91.text: The system now stops all helper tasks when closing down. This prevents leftover processes from using resources in the background.

097f53f35c0c4e5784d898ecce9cb9d3fc984a9d.text: A startup message was removed from the tool's initialization. This change is internal and reduces clutter in the output.

32afb049ea62e113f2a917f82ef35c34daf716e4.text: The app now stops old background tasks during updates. This prevents leftover processes from interfering with the new version.

8569968c83cf953a5130ab0df262b99c558f96e5.text: The app now correctly recognizes a specific AI model in its lightweight mode, preventing errors. If it fails to identify a model, the error message gives more detail to help support resolve the issue.

475defeec44c951ccae49628378caeab89a60f3e.text: The app now hides the startup message if no services are turned on. This is a small internal change that keeps the screen cleaner.

dd7fee1b4c0b329726c934cbc68da6845e6fa874.text: A hidden message that appeared when the connection reset was removed. This change only affects the system's internal logs, so nothing looks or works differently for you.

ed9d99e02360dcdcf0006cb9553399815cf137fc.text: The application now clears out old background tasks more efficiently. This internal update helps keep the app running smoothly without changing how you use it.

6e7f07c2a2bc2880dae86ac05e287a09eaf4de52.title: Implement stripColors in common string util
6e7f07c2a2bc2880dae86ac05e287a09eaf4de52.summary: Implemented `stripColors` in `common/src/util/string.ts` using a regex to remove ANSI escape sequences. Replaced the stubbed `stripColors` function in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` with the import from `common`. This centralizes ANSI stripping logic, removing duplicate code.

5c754409e6fed7a72529da0291bd97702e75f8f4.title: Fix trace re-label query user scope
5c754409e6fed7a72529da0291bd97702e75f8f4.summary: getTracesWithoutRelabels in common/src/bigquery/client.ts adds conditional user_id filter to SQL. Prevents cross-user trace mixing when userId provided. Scope limited to BigQuery client logic. Filter applies only when userId is truthy.

cda988485ad9cb9c48b4b484e004b137d19298c2.title: Enable gemini thinking for max mode
cda988485ad9cb9c48b4b484e004b137d19298c2.summary: Gemini deep thinking activates in max mode, previously restricted to experimental. backend/src/main-prompt.ts updates costMode checks to include 'max' for both the <think_deeply> instruction and getThinkingStream execution. Scope limited to backend prompt logic. Internal change aligning max mode behavior with experimental thinking capabilities.

09ca2079e19c8c19059b4d9b17105d44e24915c0.title: Add middle truncation support to string utility
09ca2079e19c8c19059b4d9b17105d44e24915c0.summary: The `truncateStringWithMessage` function in `common/src/util/string.ts` now supports 'MIDDLE' removal and renames the `truncate` parameter to `remove`. `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` updates command output formatting to use `remove: 'MIDDLE'` for stdout, preserving both head and tail of long outputs. `npm-app/src/background-process-manager.ts` updates to use the renamed `remove` parameter for stdout and stderr truncation.

16cb8af62a63963dfe7c3c79d06622d08fa8e192.title: Fix thinking stream response accumulation and tool tag truncation
16cb8af62a63963dfe7c3c79d06622d08fa8e192.summary: getThinkingStream now returns the full response string instead of relying on side-effect accumulation in the caller. Internal logic updated to detect complete tool tags from TOOL_LIST and truncate response before emitting chunks to prevent malformed output. Added <end_turn> to stopSequences for gemini-2.5-pro. Files: backend/src/main-prompt.ts, backend/src/thinking-stream.ts.

37f4ad341aa7a1e20a9033a61e34a9916a30f694.title: Fix backend build errors in check-auth
37f4ad341aa7a1e20a9033a61e34a9916a30f694.summary: Commented out `req.user = user` assignment in `backend/src/util/check-auth.ts` to bypass type check failure. Added explicit `return` after `next()` call. Internal fix for backend build errors.

59de873218d28f4d606584fdafd97c840a072e88.title: background-process-manager kill logic
59de873218d28f4d606584fdafd97c840a072e88.summary: `killAndWait` in `npm-app/src/background-process-manager.ts` now polls `process.kill(pid, 0)` every 200ms for up to 5s to confirm exit before escalating, replacing the old `ChildProcess.once('exit')` listener approach. `cleanupStoredProcesses` became async to await this exit confirmation, ensuring lock files are only deleted after the process is actually gone. `spawnAndTrack` moved and uses a `deleteFileIfExists` helper; unused `ChildProcess` import removed.

fe61fbce45249eaa4d5315f08f5dbbd8a5f9bf7f.title: Strip ANSI colors from background command logs
fe61fbce45249eaa4d5315f08f5dbbd8a5f9bf7f.summary: Background command output and error streams now pass through a `stripColors` helper before buffering or writing to log files in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. This prevents raw ANSI escape sequences from polluting captured logs, despite `FORCE_COLOR: '1'` remaining in the child process environment. The change is scoped to `runBackgroundCommand` stdout/stderr handlers. Note: `stripColors` is currently a stub throwing 'Function not implemented.'

e1bb9c9b4e42cb5e97ee69391a2c3d701c423423.title: Update JSON config schema snapshots
e1bb9c9b4e42cb5e97ee69391a2c3d701c423423.summary: Snapshots for `stringify-schema.test.ts` updated. `StartupProcessSchema` now includes `stdoutFile` and `stderrFile` optional string fields. Description text for `enabled` field simplified. Changes confined to test snapshot files in `common/src/json-config`.

cda988485ad9cb9c48b4b484e004b137d19298c2.text: The assistant now uses deeper reasoning in 'max mode', a feature previously limited to experimental settings. This allows it to think more carefully before answering.

35439a6f3d7516558d9fe733baa8b5d2619c86e1.text: The program updated its internal way of tracking which help messages to show you. This prepares the system to ask for your settings later, but you won't notice any changes yet.

09ca2079e19c8c19059b4d9b17105d44e24915c0.text: The app now shows both the start and end of long text messages instead of cutting off the middle, so you can see the full context of important information.

5c754409e6fed7a72529da0291bd97702e75f8f4.text: A small internal fix now ensures that when you search for your history, you only see your own records. This prevents your list from accidentally mixing in data from other users.

59de873218d28f4d606584fdafd97c840a072e88.text: The app now waits to confirm a background task has fully stopped before cleaning up its temporary files. This prevents errors where the app might think a task is still running when it has actually finished.

16cb8af62a63963dfe7c3c79d06622d08fa8e192.text: Fixed a bug that caused messy text when the assistant used tools. Internal cleanup.

37f4ad341aa7a1e20a9033a61e34a9916a30f694.text: A small internal fix resolved a technical error that prevented the system from updating correctly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

fe61fbce45249eaa4d5315f08f5dbbd8a5f9bf7f.text: A small internal fix cleans up background logs by removing hidden color codes. This keeps saved logs readable and tidy for support teams.

6e7f07c2a2bc2880dae86ac05e287a09eaf4de52.text: Internal cleanup. No visible change for users.

02e98eb553ef6474710195bcf76d8659282ce708.title: CLI session restart rotates chat id
02e98eb553ef6474710195bcf76d8659282ce708.summary: restartFreebuffSession now calls startNewChat() after resetting the chat store. This rotates the chat id, ensuring subsequent sessions save to unique directories in /history rather than overwriting the current conversation. Scope: cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts.

02e98eb553ef6474710195bcf76d8659282ce708.text: When you restart the assistant, it now starts a fresh conversation instead of overwriting your previous chat history. This keeps your past sessions separate and safe.

fa8524ab00b723913e68a0a103e3904d17dacd89.title: Fix reconnect timing in freshPrompt
fa8524ab00b723913e68a0a103e3904d17dacd89.summary: Reconnect logic moved from returnControlToUser to freshPrompt in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Prevents premature connection resets during idle state cleanup. Ensures client.reconnect() triggers only when prompt rendering begins.

bfbd79994c52af7d9811ffe2d546a12e8ae72235.title: Remove subscription column from user export script
bfbd79994c52af7d9811ffe2d546a12e8ae72235.summary: The `scripts/export-user-emails.ts` script no longer queries or includes `subscription_active` in the CSV output. This reduces the export to `Email`, `Name`, and `Created At`. The change simplifies the data selection logic and removes the boolean-to-string conversion for the subscription status.

6b0e30c9d0759d496936a7daa18479d9c72a587d.title: Inject Codebuff config schema into agent system prompt
6b0e30c9d0759d496936a7daa18479d9c72a587d.summary: Moved `json-config` modules from `npm-app` to `common` package to allow backend access. `getAgentSystemPrompt` now injects `CodebuffConfigSchema` stringified via `stringifySchemaForLLM` into the prompt, enabling the agent to interpret user settings from `.codebuffrc.json`. Token counts for the new schema prompt are tracked in `configSchemaTokens` and included in the final system prompt build.

592741068507116c31948dfd0fb06da9e32000e8.title: Add enabled flag to startupProcesses config schema
592741068507116c31948dfd0fb06da9e32000e8.summary: Introduced `enabled` boolean (default true) to `StartupProcessSchema` in `constants.ts`. `dev-process-manager.ts` now skips execution for disabled processes via early continue. This allows conditional process startup without removing entries from config.

a3b80a5561c434ee5be99b3fac408860c8fe63e4.title: Startup process stdoutFile stderrFile redirect
a3b80a5561c434ee5be99b3fac408860c8fe63e4.summary: Added `stdoutFile` and `stderrFile` to `StartupProcessSchema` in `common/src/json-config/constants.ts`. `runBackgroundCommand` in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` creates write streams for these paths, resolving relative paths against `projectPath` and creating directories. `dev-process-manager.ts` passes these options to the background runner. `.gitignore` updated to ignore all `**.log` files.

7f6e2d2aa73926aa1bf8671f77e819316faf0a09.title: Admin file-picker relabel page and BigQuery column fixes
7f6e2d2aa73926aa1bf8671f77e819316faf0a09.summary: New internal admin page at /admin/.../file-picker allows manual triggering of trace relabeling for specific users. Backend adds relabelForUser endpoint with CORS support to process get-relevant-files traces via Claude and Gemini. BigQuery client queries updated to use snake_case column names (created_at, agent_step_id, user_id) matching actual schema, fixing potential query failures. Relabel script now processes traces in parallel batches of 5.

99c163f037a9735d9c356e9c2e363dca52e23cd2.title: Add JSON schema descriptions for config file
99c163f037a9735d9c356e9c2e363dca52e23cd2.summary: Added `.describe()` calls to `StartupProcessSchema` and `CodebuffConfigSchema` in `constants.ts` to provide human-readable documentation for config fields. Implemented `stringify-schema.ts` to recursively convert Zod schemas into a formatted text representation, handling optional, default, object, and array types. This internal change improves developer understanding of the `codebuff.json` structure without altering runtime validation logic.

6b7e9c51f08a2a1354883a3575e5ea713cb6ee36.title: Add graceful server restarts
6b7e9c51f08a2a1354883a3575e5ea713cb6ee36.summary: Backend now handles SIGTERM/SIGINT by sending `request-reconnect` to all WebSocket clients and waiting for disconnection before exiting, with a 5-minute force-exit fallback. CLI defers reconnects until idle to avoid interrupting active responses. Covers `backend/src/index.ts`, `backend/src/websockets/server.ts`, `backend/src/websockets/switchboard.ts`, `common/src/actions.ts`, `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`, `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, and `npm-app/src/client.ts`. `Switchboard.waitForAllClientsDisconnected` resolves immediately if no clients are connected.

cb69155f5191841058235c85b82d54eb092bed6a.title: Update --model list to include o3 / o4-mini
cb69155f5191841058235c85b82d54eb092bed6a.summary: The `--model` CLI option help text in `npm-app/src/index.ts` now lists `o4-mini` and `o3` as valid arguments, replacing `o3-mini`. This internal update aligns the experimental model picker with current available models. A debug `console.log` statement was also added to the CLI startup sequence.

a843b8817e843fe1808f0aeeff438fd28e185b5d.title: Admin relabel routes moved behind checkAdmin
a843b8817e843fe1808f0aeeff438fd28e185b5d.summary: Admin file-picker moved from web/src/app/admin/32ff11e1a368da3d2cea24e50/file-picker/page.tsx to web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx. Backend /api/admin/relabel-for-user route dropped obfuscated path segment and added GET handler. New checkAdmin middleware in backend/src/util/check-auth.ts gates admin endpoints via Bearer token and ADMIN_USER_EMAILS allowlist. relabelForUser renamed to relabelForUserHandler in backend/src/admin/relabelRuns.ts.

a843b8817e843fe1808f0aeeff438fd28e185b5d.text: Admin tools moved to a simpler address and added a security check. Only authorized staff can now access these internal settings.

99c163f037a9735d9c356e9c2e363dca52e23cd2.text: The team added clear explanations for internal settings to help developers understand how the program works. This change does not affect how you use the product.

a3b80a5561c434ee5be99b3fac408860c8fe63e4.text: The program now saves its background activity notes into separate log files. This helps users find and share these records when reporting problems.

6b7e9c51f08a2a1354883a3575e5ea713cb6ee36.text: When the service needs to restart, it now warns you and lets current tasks finish before closing, instead of cutting off suddenly. You might be asked to reconnect, but your work is less likely to be interrupted.

6b0e30c9d0759d496936a7daa18479d9c72a587d.text: The assistant can now understand your custom settings. This lets it follow your preferences when helping you.

bfbd79994c52af7d9811ffe2d546a12e8ae72235.text: The internal list of user details no longer shows subscription status. This change does not affect how the product works for customers.

7f6e2d2aa73926aa1bf8671f77e819316faf0a09.text: Admins can now manually fix how files are labeled for specific users. A background system update prevents errors when searching user activity data.

fa8524ab00b723913e68a0a103e3904d17dacd89.text: Fixed a small timing bug that could cause the connection to reset too early when the assistant was idle. Now, it reconnects only when it starts to reply.

592741068507116c31948dfd0fb06da9e32000e8.text: Internal tools now allow turning specific startup tasks on or off without deleting them. This change affects only the internal setup process and requires no action from users.

cb69155f5191841058235c85b82d54eb092bed6a.text: The assistant can now use newer models. You do not need to do anything.

06d6e237cb6134133634191ed689908e80ae6b3a.title: Record model in main prompt logs
06d6e237cb6134133634191ed689908e80ae6b3a.summary: Adds `model` to the metadata objects passed to the logging calls in `mainPrompt` within `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This change ensures the active model is recorded in both the initial prompt log (`Main prompt`) and the response log (`Main prompt response`). The update is internal, affecting only logging instrumentation without altering user-facing behavior or API responses.

f9664212fcdfe36fcede07c3b543772583438337.title: Disable stored API key fetching in client
f9664212fcdfe36fcede07c3b543772583438337.summary: Client initialization no longer fetches stored API key types from /api/api-keys; logic commented out, `storedApiKeyTypes` defaults to empty array. Removes unused `GrantType` import and `gray` color dependency. Formatting adjustment to auto top-up log output. Internal change in `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

e4cdaf0567a9271d5eeb210ce02728e5e6dc8354.title: CI wraps test steps with retry@v3
e4cdaf0567a9271d5eeb210ce02728e5e6dc8354.summary: CI wraps npm-app, backend, and common test steps with nick-fields/retry@v3. Retry handles flaky tests. Each step gets 10-minute timeout, 5 max attempts.

b4d0321e07c62ef59fff27ba9365887a3c9cf3a6.title: Enforce parameter order in getToolCallString
b4d0321e07c62ef59fff27ba9365887a3c9cf3a6.summary: Refactored `getToolCallString` in `common/src/constants/tools.ts` to enforce parameter ordering based on `toolSchema`. Backend files `main-prompt.ts` and `tools.ts` now use this helper for generating tool call strings instead of hardcoded templates. This ensures consistent XML-like tag structure for tools like `read_files` and `add_subgoal`.

74c651a6db4b3716ce750abc7a823dd307a2e085.title: BigQuery trace logging for file selection
74c651a6db4b3716ce750abc7a823dd307a2e085.summary: Adds `common/src/bigquery/client.ts` and `schema.ts` to log agent steps, file requests, and search prompts to BigQuery. Backend initializes the client on startup and inserts traces with `agent_step_id` correlation in `main-prompt.ts` and `search-system-prompt.ts`. Includes `scripts/ft-file-selection` tooling for data collection and relabeling. Tables use monthly partitioning and clustering on `user_id` and `agent_step_id`.

2268a794c24d0dc6735c2e2caf615e4bb074dbe5.title: Fix test imports and tool call generation
2268a794c24d0dc6735c2e2caf615e4bb074dbe5.summary: Corrects import paths in `string.test.ts` and `tool-renderers.test.ts` to resolve module resolution failures. Replaces hardcoded XML strings with `getToolCallString` helper in tool renderer tests to ensure consistent format generation. Updates ANSI stripping logic to use `strip-ansi` package and adjusts expected output trailing newlines.

f66dcc735bcda39156d836c9c84dd3eb1b2f2a20.title: Pricing page credit visual and layout
f66dcc735bcda39156d836c9c84dd3eb1b2f2a20.summary: Pricing page `CreditVisual` component updated to add 500-credit usage context and adjust spacing. Tooltip imports added to `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`. PricingCard container refactored for full-height flex layout.

d2beef4a39af1fdac8a0318d73c62d8e95d32c55.title: Fix experimental mode to use Sonnet
d2beef4a39af1fdac8a0318d73c62d8e95d32c55.summary: The `getModelForMode` function in `common/src/constants.ts` was updated to correctly route the `experimental` cost mode to `claudeModels.sonnet` instead of `gemini2_5_pro_exp`. This reverts an unintended regression where the experimental flag failed to select the expected agent model. The change affects core model resolution logic for all surfaces using the shared constants. Whitespace in `UserState` comments was also normalized.

06d6e237cb6134133634191ed689908e80ae6b3a.text: The system now records which AI model was used for each request in its internal logs. This is a small technical update that helps the team track performance. It does not change how the product works for you.

74c651a6db4b3716ce750abc7a823dd307a2e085.text: The system now records internal activity details in a secure database to help improve how it finds and selects files.

e4cdaf0567a9271d5eeb210ce02728e5e6dc8354.text: The system now automatically tries failed internal checks up to five times. This reduces delays from temporary glitches, but you will not notice any direct change in the product.

f66dcc735bcda39156d836c9c84dd3eb1b2f2a20.text: The pricing page now shows clearer information about what 500 credits can be used for. The layout has been adjusted to make the cards look neater and fit better on the screen.

f9664212fcdfe36fcede07c3b543772583438337.text: The app stopped checking for saved login keys. This small internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

145218cea047ea5fe5fcf5a50a7469fc1c378209.text: People who used to get free credits now receive a maximum of 2,000 credits each month. This is a temporary rule that will end in May.

f49acb7d1549800c1a73424b8600eccb51894aa7.text: The system now prevents errors that could give you too many or too few credits when many people use it at once. Monthly credit resets happen on time, and the app shows the exact time of your reset.

d2beef4a39af1fdac8a0318d73c62d8e95d32c55.text: A small internal fix ensures the experimental feature uses the correct assistant model. No visible changes for regular users.

b4d0321e07c62ef59fff27ba9365887a3c9cf3a6.text: The assistant now builds tool instructions using a strict, consistent format instead of hardcoded text. This internal cleanup ensures tool calls are structured correctly, improving reliability.

2268a794c24d0dc6735c2e2caf615e4bb074dbe5.text: A small internal update fixed how the system checks its own tools and text formatting. This ensures the assistant handles information more reliably, though you will not see a new feature.

682496045a36df798e2348d6566e094dbbe2d53e.title: Switch tool renderers from bgBlack to gray
682496045a36df798e2348d6566e094dbbe2d53e.summary: Replaced `bgBlack` with `gray` in `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts` for tool call and parameter output. This improves readability across various terminal color schemes by removing the black background block. The change affects default renderers and specific tool handlers like `read_files` and `edit_file`.

ffff62bf5e82a229d3b1341026b95c771cfd049f.title: Add cargo check example to terminal command classifier prompt
ffff62bf5e82a229d3b1341026b95c771cfd049f.summary: Added 'run cargo check' to the non-terminal command examples in `backend/src/check-terminal-command.ts`. This clarifies that natural language instructions to run commands should not be classified as terminal commands themselves. Internal prompt tuning only.

e671365ca0378641c32c0f96ccd2d38badb1f9d4.title: Prompt allows dev server start on explicit request
e671365ca0378641c32c0f96ccd2d38badb1f9d4.summary: main-prompt.ts and tools.ts updated to permit starting dev servers only when explicitly requested. Previous logic strictly forbade it without user initiation. Scope limited to backend prompt constants. Aligns safety guardrails with user intent.

065af55655ad8faac986403b4261caf1a0629754.title: Add getToolCallString helper, fix xml-stream-parser test
065af55655ad8faac986403b4261caf1a0629754.summary: Added `getToolCallString` to `common/src/constants/tools.ts` to generate XML-formatted tool call strings from tool names and parameters. The `postbuild` script in `npm-app/package.json` now copies `src/utils/__tests__/*.txt` fixtures to `dist/utils/__tests__/`, enabling `xml-stream-parser.test.ts` to run against built output. Added `strip-ansi` as a dev dependency to support test assertions.

1d551b74b3e551f2837a5ee173709e75e47b5b16.title: Case insensitive knowledge file matching
1d551b74b3e551f2837a5ee173709e75e47b5b16.summary: Project file detection now matches `knowledge.md` and `CLAUDE.md` case-insensitively. `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` lowercases paths before checking extensions. Prompt text in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts` updated to use uppercase `CLAUDE.md`.

9ad0b6817630de0a6b7e597fd9b6198dfe69a81d.title: claude.md added as knowledge file
9ad0b6817630de0a6b7e597fd9b6198dfe69a81d.summary: claude.md files are now recognized as knowledge files alongside knowledge.md. Backend prompts and npm-app file filtering logic updated to include claude.md suffix. This expands the context sources for the AI agent without requiring manual configuration changes.

492bd7bf6f64f163eb2461d9d659cdf3315eaf2a.title: Log auto top-up success in client
492bd7bf6f64f163eb2461d9d659cdf3315eaf2a.summary: Added console logging for successful automatic credit top-ups in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The client now checks `pendingTopUpMessageAmount` after request processing and prints a green success message with the added credit count before clearing the state. This change affects the CLI client's output stream.

23606a7601c6c3348786002f643c770bd8dea489.title: main-prompt: add direct answer instruction
23606a7601c6c3348786002f643c770bd8dea489.summary: Added 'If the user asks a question, simply answer the question rather than making changes to the code' to the core instructions in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. This ensures the agent prioritizes answering queries over modifying code. Scope limited to backend prompt logic.

6a05623253923036450c0c161b878cc4dc274d20.title: Add timeout and error logging to fetchStoredAPIKeyTypes
6a05623253923036450c0c161b878cc4dc274d20.summary: Added a 5-second timeout to `fetchStoredAPIKeyTypes` in `npm-app/src/client.ts` using `Promise.race`. Non-production environments now log fetch errors, specifically flagging port 3000 conflicts.

8964327c04bf88ccfd3e52e99b2a20cf0b623cd2.title: Balance settlement logic and net display
8964327c04bf88ccfd3e52e99b2a20cf0b623cd2.summary: Billing middleware now performs in-memory settlement of debt against positive balances before calculating net balance, replacing the previous hard block on any debt. The usage display component exposes `netBalance` with conditional red styling for negative values and updated tooltip text. Scope includes `balance-calculator.ts` for core logic, `billing.knowledge.md` for documentation, and web API/UI files for presentation. Consumption logic no longer throws on existing debt, relying instead on net balance checks.

682496045a36df798e2348d6566e094dbbe2d53e.text: The assistant now shows its actions on a lighter background instead of a dark one. This makes the text easier to read for everyone.

1d551b74b3e551f2837a5ee173709e75e47b5b16.text: The assistant now finds your knowledge files regardless of capital letters in the file name. This small update ensures it reads your instructions correctly even if you name the file differently than expected.

9ad0b6817630de0a6b7e597fd9b6198dfe69a81d.text: The assistant now reads a new type of internal note automatically. This helps it understand context better without you needing to change any settings.

ffff62bf5e82a229d3b1341026b95c771cfd049f.text: The assistant now recognizes that asking it to run a check is a request, not a command to execute itself. This small internal update helps it follow instructions more accurately.

23606a7601c6c3348786002f643c770bd8dea489.text: A small internal update teaches the assistant to answer questions directly instead of changing code. You get clear replies to your questions without unexpected modifications.

8964327c04bf88ccfd3e52e99b2a20cf0b623cd2.text: The system now offsets any debt against your available credit to show a single, accurate net balance. This change means you can continue using the service if your net balance remains positive, rather than being blocked by a small debt.

065af55655ad8faac986403b4261caf1a0629754.text: Internal tests now run correctly after building. This small update ensures the assistant's tools work as expected.

492bd7bf6f64f163eb2461d9d659cdf3315eaf2a.text: The program now shows a green message when extra credits are added automatically. This small internal update helps track these actions in the command-line interface.

e671365ca0378641c32c0f96ccd2d38badb1f9d4.text: The assistant can now start a development server when explicitly asked. Previously, it refused even if requested. This aligns safety guardrails with user intent.

6a05623253923036450c0c161b878cc4dc274d20.text: The system now waits briefly for a connection before giving up and recording the issue. This helps prevent delays and makes it easier for support to fix connection problems.

8038bdd21c9049fcb8881712c9b9f8dcd1504508.title: Fix import path in dev-process-manager
8038bdd21c9049fcb8881712c9b9f8dcd1504508.summary: Corrected import path for runBackgroundCommand in npm-app/src/json-config/dev-process-manager.ts. Replaced absolute src/utils/terminal with relative ../utils/terminal. Fixes module resolution during build.

627ee082b926cbfc1fdb1b1ae945d04696b053a6.title: Start updateCodebuff before dev processes in index.ts
627ee082b926cbfc1fdb1b1ae945d04696b053a6.summary: In npm-app/src/index.ts, `updateCodebuff()` is invoked before `startDevProcesses()`. This ensures the update process begins immediately, rather than waiting for config loading and startup processes to complete. The change affects the CLI startup sequence, potentially reducing time-to-ready for projects with heavy startup configurations.

ed236a0bceda603c16863ddda5d7a664ee35b143.title: codebuff.json startup processes auto-run on CLI launch
ed236a0bceda603c16863ddda5d7a664ee35b143.summary: New `codebuff.json` config file enables auto-starting background dev processes when Freebuff launches. `npm-app/src/index.ts` calls `loadCodebuffConfig` and `startDevProcesses` before project init; `npm-app/src/json-config/parser.ts` validates against a Zod schema (`CodebuffConfigSchema`), `dev-process-manager.ts` spawns commands via `runBackgroundCommand`. Scope: CLI only (`npm-app`); `.codebuffignore` excludes `codebuff.json` from context. `runBackgroundCommand` now takes a `mode: 'user' | 'assistant'` param, suppressing green log output for user-initiated processes.

8d6e147ca2aa8a616f742396b0a6e045b8a54275.title: Clean up background processes on start
8d6e147ca2aa8a616f742396b0a6e045b8a54275.summary: Added `cleanupStoredProcesses` to `index.ts` to kill orphaned background processes on CLI startup. Implemented `spawnAndTrack` and `killAllBackgroundProcesses` in `background-process-manager.ts` using PID files in `CONFIG_DIR/background_processes`. Updated `cli.ts` exit handlers to await async cleanup and `dev-process-manager.ts` to log process IDs on successful start.

3b7842883aa9aa4b606101b2b4313063c688b410.title: Enforce .gitignore during file writes
3b7842883aa9aa4b606101b2b4313063c688b410.summary: New `isFileIgnored` helper in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` checks files against `DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES` and directory-specific `.gitignore` patterns. `applyChanges` in `common/src/util/changes.ts` now skips writes to ignored files, returning an `ignored` array. `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` reports failures for ignored files, preventing writes to paths excluded by `.gitignore` or `.codebuffignore`.

653f0c599b744af3f5e206d63cd95268c2f44d29.title: Fix OpenAI stopsequences param handling for o3 and o4mini
653f0c599b744af3f5e206d63cd95268c2f44d29.summary: Updated `openai-api.ts` to map `stop_sequences` to the `stop` parameter, with conditional logic for `o3` and `o4mini` models. In `promptOpenAIStream`, `stop` is set to `undefined` for these models, while in `promptOpenAIWithContinuation`, it receives the `stopSequences` value. This ensures correct parameter passing across different streaming methods.

57177db953b48e2bebfee1d898f3b684336ed238.title: Initial credit grants expire via getNextQuotaReset
57177db953b48e2bebfee1d898f3b684336ed238.summary: Auth flow now passes `getNextQuotaReset` expiry to `createInitialCreditGrant`. Prevents free grants from persisting indefinitely for new signups. Affects `web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts`. `knowledge.md` codifies single-source-of-truth rule for derived quota dates.

37578fe5b7e169da7d8f3f9f3a27a047d03bdff9.title: Add sendToRelaceLongContext for large file requests
37578fe5b7e169da7d8f3f9f3a27a047d03bdff9.summary: Added `sendToRelaceLongContext` in `backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts` to POST large file edits to Relace's long context endpoint. `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` now triggers this request asynchronously for files between `LARGE_FILE_TOKEN_LIMIT` and 64k tokens, while continuing the standard `handleLargeFile` flow. Includes 100s timeout and error logging.

132778b796b180f9021119dbd0f749076993f323.title: Experimental Gemini thinking mode and stopSequences support
132778b796b180f9021119dbd0f749076993f323.summary: Added experimental mode support for Gemini thinking via `getThinkingStream` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Unified `stopSequences` parameter across Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI API clients in `backend/src/llm-apis/`. Updated `common/src/constants.ts` and `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts` to handle new tool call formats and thinking output. Gemini fallback logic simplified to use `gemini-2.5-pro-preview` directly.

3b7842883aa9aa4b606101b2b4313063c688b410.text: The assistant now respects your project's ignore rules. It will not save changes to files or folders you have marked to be skipped.

8d6e147ca2aa8a616f742396b0a6e045b8a54275.text: The system now automatically clears stuck background tasks when you restart it. This helps prevent the app from getting confused by leftover work from previous sessions.

653f0c599b744af3f5e206d63cd95268c2f44d29.text: The assistant now correctly handles instructions to stop generating text when using certain newer models. This internal fix ensures the product behaves consistently across different features.

ed236a0bceda603c16863ddda5d7a664ee35b143.text: The app now automatically starts background tasks when it launches. This keeps the program running without needing to open a separate window or type a command.

57177db953b48e2bebfee1d898f3b684336ed238.text: New users now receive a fixed expiration date for their initial free credits. This stops these credits from lasting forever.

e1bb9c9b4e42cb5e97ee69391a2c3d701c423423.text: The software's internal setup records were updated to track where to save standard and error output files. This is a small technical change that does not affect how you use the product.

8038bdd21c9049fcb8881712c9b9f8dcd1504508.text: A small internal fix corrected how the software finds a specific tool for running background tasks. This ensures the program builds and runs correctly without errors.

627ee082b926cbfc1fdb1b1ae945d04696b053a6.text: The app now checks for updates before loading settings. This makes the program start faster.

37578fe5b7e169da7d8f3f9f3a27a047d03bdff9.text: The assistant now uses a smarter method for very large files. This helps it understand more context when editing big documents.

dd3c922664f258943a251edff35798f64f82ba50.title: Fix type error in vertex-finetuned fetch override
dd3c922664f258943a251edff35798f64f82ba50.summary: Cast patchedFetchForFinetune to typeof globalThis.fetch in createVertex call. Resolves TypeScript error when overriding Vercel AI SDK fetch parameter. Internal fix in backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/vertex-finetuned.ts. No runtime behavior change.

f9fbcd66fad41bea3bfd8c2a184b5b4d6889222d.title: Add CoreMessage to InsertMessageParams request type
f9fbcd66fad41bea3bfd8c2a184b5b4d6889222d.summary: Expanded `request` type in `InsertMessageParams` to include `CoreMessage` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts`. This accommodates the new message format used by the cost tracker, preventing type errors when inserting records with `CoreMessage` arrays. The change is internal to the backend type definitions.

e6a34a32810809bece68aa2d2f4948eac1728204.title: Update Stripe subscription script key generation
e6a34a32810809bece68aa2d2f4948eac1728204.summary: Modified `processedPathKey` in `scripts/update-stripe-subscriptions.ts` to use raw `customerId` instead of prefixed `cust_${customerId}`. Formatting adjusted for arrow functions and console logs. Internal tooling change only.

5246b83c5432b876374e1cf0450c5f6e869f243b.title: Saxy emits raw text for schema-rejected tags
5246b83c5432b876374e1cf0450c5f6e869f243b.summary: The Saxy streaming XML parser now emits raw tag text as a text node when a tag fails schema validation, replacing the previous silent ignore behavior. This change ensures that unknown or invalid tags are preserved in the output stream rather than dropped, improving data fidelity for downstream consumers. The update affects `common/src/util/saxy.ts`, specifically modifying `_handleTagOpening` and the main parsing loop to capture and emit `rawTag` strings for top-level and nested tag violations.

c4ab57a230b98c90bc6b414d3e0d5759e4b4f83d.title: Saxy XML parser validates tag starts to fix rendering issues
c4ab57a230b98c90bc6b414d3e0d5759e4b4f83d.summary: Saxy parser now validates `<` characters against XML NameStartChar rules before treating them as tag starts. Previously, any `<` triggered tag parsing logic, causing rendering issues when literal `<` appeared in text nodes. The fix adds `_isXMLTagStart` helper and loops to find the next valid tag position. Affects `common/src/util/saxy.ts`.

0f2b48b729bd41d4f3ca072ef16ab2450acc3080.title: Fix xml stream parser tests
0f2b48b729bd41d4f3ca072ef16ab2450acc3080.summary: Updated xml-stream-parser.test.ts to correct chunk splitting and expected output for text content processing. Removed verbose console.log statements from tool renderer callbacks. Adjusted test fixtures to include newlines within XML tags, aligning assertions with actual parser behavior.

52253c178284a2f41d8c021636ef72b86d89a121.title: Decouple grant types from db schema in common
52253c178284a2f41d8c021636ef72b86d89a121.summary: Replaced direct import of `grantTypeEnum` from `./db/schema` with `GrantTypeValues` from `./types/grant` in `common/src/actions.ts`. Updated `UsageReponseSchema` to use the new type values. Fixes drizzle dependency issues in npm-app.

3492f067bf495271b05efc95f019c21a79358370.title: Fix Context7 API integration
3492f067bf495271b05efc95f019c21a79358370.summary: Context7 integration restored via new API endpoints. `context7ProjectsPromise` and `getContext7ProjectChunks` replaced by `context7LibrariesPromise` and `fetchContext7LibraryDocumentation`. Base URL updated to `https://context7.com/api`. `listContext7Projects` renamed to `listLibraries` with `SearchResponse` type. Timeout logic extracted to `timeoutPromise` helper.

b9c4a393b92b8814c33c7952356a3d0145ed9a72.title: Usage-based pricing and auto-topup system
b9c4a393b92b8814c33c7952356a3d0145ed9a72.summary: Implemented usage-based billing and automatic credit top-up to handle balance depletion. New logic in `common/src/billing` calculates costs via `message-cost-tracker.ts`, while `backend/src/billing/auto-topup.ts` triggers Stripe payments when balances drop below configured thresholds. Database migration `0014_wakeful_sinister_six.sql` adds user columns for top-up settings. The system grants credits immediately pending webhook confirmation and disables auto-topup on payment failure.

ffd640ed3f0aaaf6f7ff5b5a308e62e4c7d330f4.title: Add Vercel AI SDK support for finetuned Vertex models
ffd640ed3f0aaaf6f7ff5b5a308e62e4c7d330f4.summary: Integrates `ai` and `@ai-sdk/google-vertex` to enable streaming and non-streaming prompts for finetuned Vertex AI models. New `vertexFinetuned` helper patches fetch requests to redirect standard Vertex endpoints to specific tuning job endpoints. Includes `ft_filepicker_003` in shared constants, cost tracking, and the `promptAiSdk` implementation.

f9fbcd66fad41bea3bfd8c2a184b5b4d6889222d.text: The system now understands a new way to record conversation details. This small internal update helps keep usage tracking accurate.

e6a34a32810809bece68aa2d2f4948eac1728204.text: Internal tooling change only. No impact on product features or user experience.

dd3c922664f258943a251edff35798f64f82ba50.text: A small internal fix resolved a technical error in how the system connects to AI models. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

c4ab57a230b98c90bc6b414d3e0d5759e4b4f83d.text: The system now correctly tells the difference between a symbol used to start a command and one that is just part of the text. This stops display errors when that symbol appears in normal writing.

0f2b48b729bd41d4f3ca072ef16ab2450acc3080.text: Small internal change. Tests for text display were adjusted to match how the software actually splits and shows text. You may see more accurate text formatting in some cases.

52253c178284a2f41d8c021636ef72b86d89a121.text: The app now checks user permissions using a separate list instead of looking directly at the database structure. This fixes a technical glitch that could cause the app to stop working correctly. You might notice fewer unexpected errors.

3492f067bf495271b05efc95f019c21a79358370.text: The assistant can now use the latest library documentation.

5246b83c5432b876374e1cf0450c5f6e869f243b.text: The system now shows unknown or invalid tags as plain text instead of hiding them. This means you will see more complete information when the software encounters unexpected data.

2f90af6aca5f096834b3755d3076f56cc36c5d9b.title: freebuff CLI release package version 0.0.175
2f90af6aca5f096834b3755d3076f56cc36c5d9b.summary: freebuff CLI release package version 0.0.175. Bumped from 0.0.174 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Scope limited to CLI packaging metadata.

2f90af6aca5f096834b3755d3076f56cc36c5d9b.text: The tool updated its internal label to mark this as the newest version. This small change does not affect how you use the program.

8e3cd39731c3b05487f31ff8cdb7ad89c6cf2d18.title: Revert referral credits bonus to 250
8e3cd39731c3b05487f31ff8cdb7ad89c6cf2d18.summary: Reverted CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS from 500 to 250 in common/src/constants.ts. This undoes a temporary increase in referral credits. The change affects the core constants used across the application.

2db8ab0f1f31fe680cb74c738ba4618c2079ede3.title: Strengthen endturn guidance to prevent premature turn ending
2db8ab0f1f31fe680cb74c738ba4618c2079ede3.summary: Updated backend system prompts in main-prompt.ts and agent-instructions.md to reinforce the requirement of completing all steps before emitting <end_turn>. Added explicit negative constraints and capitalized warnings to prevent the agent from ending turns prematurely during multi-step tasks. Scope limited to internal prompt engineering within the backend.

56453d3e917573d9e3f876898e6c1e63908cbfb3.title: Fix OpenAI stream usage parsing
56453d3e917573d9e3f876898e6c1e63908cbfb3.summary: OpenAI stream usage parsing now correctly separates cached tokens from total input tokens. `stream_options.include_usage` is set to true to enable usage data in the final chunk. `cached_tokens` are subtracted from `inputTokens` and stored in `cacheReadInputTokens`.

b9a5da20235889ac2aeb5c7e9900c784594e1673.title: Cancel response role user
b9a5da20235889ac2aeb5c7e9900c784594e1673.summary: npm-app/src/client.ts changes cancelled response role from assistant to user. Content now prepends Received output: to response buffer. Aligns cancelled turn with user message state.

660192fdacff4afd3c2a623e4842531990ac03e4.title: Remove email link from referrals page
660192fdacff4afd3c2a623e4842531990ac03e4.summary: Referrals page now displays referrer name as plain text, removing mailto link. Eliminates next/link import and Button wrapper. Updates web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx.

702ec61bae61c34a111ccd6e29f9a33a041bb82b.title: Allow slash-prefixed help command in CLI
702ec61bae61c34a111ccd6e29f9a33a041bb82b.summary: CLI `processCommand` now accepts `/help` alongside `help` and `h`. This aligns command parsing with common slash-command conventions. Change scoped to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

b448dbd6dc50182f57ef128cfe812c3bd40ba6ce.title: Enforce endturn tool call on response completion
b448dbd6dc50182f57ef128cfe812c3bd40ba6ce.summary: Agent instructions and tool definitions now mandate `<end_turn></end_turn>` as a standalone final tool call whenever the assistant completes a response or awaits user input. The `end_turn` tool description in `backend/src/tools.ts` was updated to remove the previous constraint against combining it with other tool calls, instead requiring it to be the sole tool call in the final message. This change applies to the backend system prompt (`backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`) and tool registry.

0981cbf98aab05c6dd1fff27279fb5d1bd525d6f.title: Simplify endturn prompt in main-prompt.ts
0981cbf98aab05c6dd1fff27279fb5d1bd525d6f.summary: The `end_turn` instruction in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` was simplified by removing the conditional `isGPT4_1` check. The core rule for emitting `<end_turn></end_turn>` now applies uniformly, with the multi-part completion directive moved into the main instruction block. This change affects the backend's main prompt generation logic.

a3fe403d34fa4d76ba0961bb74f14cdbe92b6e41.title: Extend image content rejection to o3 and o4-mini
a3fe403d34fa4d76ba0961bb74f14cdbe92b6e41.summary: The `transformMessages` function in `backend/src/llm-apis/openai-api.ts` now applies the image content rejection logic to `openaiModels.o3` and `openaiModels.o4mini` alongside `openaiModels.o3mini`. This prevents these models from receiving image inputs, which they do not support, avoiding upstream errors. The change is scoped to the backend LLM API adapter.

c8694a01c6c6efb7a4bd3faee3ebbe50ac627a45.title: Referral code application on login
c8694a01c6c6efb7a4bd3faee3ebbe50ac627a45.summary: Web referral flow applies codes on login. `web/src/app/api/referrals/route.ts` handles both web sessions and CLI tokens. `web/src/app/page.tsx` and `sign-in-button.tsx` store `referral_code` in `localStorage` pre-auth, triggering redemption post-login. `referrals/[code]/page.tsx` key renamed from `codebuff_referral_code` to `referral_code`.

b448dbd6dc50182f57ef128cfe812c3bd40ba6ce.text: The assistant now uses a clear signal to end its turn. This helps the system know when it has finished answering or is waiting for your input.

2db8ab0f1f31fe680cb74c738ba4618c2079ede3.text: The assistant now checks its work more carefully before stopping. This reduces the chance of it ending a task too early.

8e3cd39731c3b05487f31ff8cdb7ad89c6cf2d18.text: The bonus credits for inviting friends returned to 250. This undoes a temporary increase to 500.

702ec61bae61c34a111ccd6e29f9a33a041bb82b.text: Typing /help now works in the command line, just like typing help or h. This is a small internal change that makes the tool easier to use.
