c8694a01c6c6efb7a4bd3faee3ebbe50ac627a45.text: The system now applies referral codes automatically when you sign in. This ensures your referral credit is added without extra steps.

56453d3e917573d9e3f876898e6c1e63908cbfb3.text: A small internal fix ensures the system correctly counts how many tokens are reused from memory versus newly processed. This helps keep usage tracking accurate, though you likely won't notice any direct change in how the assistant responds.

660192fdacff4afd3c2a623e4842531990ac03e4.text: The referrals page no longer shows an email link. The referrer's name appears as plain text instead.

0981cbf98aab05c6dd1fff27279fb5d1bd525d6f.text: The assistant's internal instructions were simplified. This change is small and happens behind the scenes. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

b9a5da20235889ac2aeb5c7e9900c784594e1673.text: The system now marks cancelled responses as user messages, so they look correct in the chat history. This is a small internal fix that keeps the conversation display neat.

a3fe403d34fa4d76ba0961bb74f14cdbe92b6e41.text: The system now blocks unsupported image requests for certain models. This prevents errors when you try to upload pictures.

8330bae36895631f1304fc6a9f1a76544d8952cb.title: Update referral instructions to include cd command
8330bae36895631f1304fc6a9f1a76544d8952cb.summary: Referral page instructions updated to prepend 'cd /my/project/dir' to the 'codebuff' command. This ensures users navigate to their project directory before running the CLI. Change isolated to web/src/app/referrals/[code]/page.tsx.

c6434887277061959deedd47604d65d78b6176cd.title: Add intro text when starting in home directory
c6434887277061959deedd47604d65d78b6176cd.summary: The CLI greeting now detects if `getProjectRoot()` matches `os.homedir()` and displays specific onboarding instructions before returning early. This prevents users from seeing confusing git-related errors when launching Freebuff without a project context. The change is isolated to `npm-app/src/menu.ts`.

82155f758be1037060fc3e513fb91e2bbec69a4f.title: Store referral code in localStorage on unauthenticated visit
82155f758be1037060fc3e513fb91e2bbec69a4f.summary: The `web/src/app/referrals/[code]/page.tsx` file now persists the referral `code` to `localStorage` under the key `codebuff_referral_code` when the user is `unauthenticated`. This ensures the code survives navigation or refreshes before login. The change is scoped to the web referrals page.

c683317d851c3081aa173f237081a1a09eead58a.title: Rename browseraction tool to browserlogs
c683317d851c3081aa173f237081a1a09eead58a.summary: Renamed `browser_action` to `browser_logs` across backend prompts, common schemas, and CLI handlers. This clarifies the tool's purpose for retrieving console logs and errors. Updates include `main-prompt.ts`, `tools.ts`, `browser-actions.ts`, `constants/tools.ts`, `tool-handlers.ts`, and `tool-renderers.ts`.

fa7e7bcf3b80ee78a2fdba4cf2f736914ddd0a71.title: Add o3 and o4-mini models to Freebuff
fa7e7bcf3b80ee78a2fdba4cf2f736914ddd0a71.summary: Added `o3-2025-04-16` and `o4-mini-2025-04-16` to `openaiModels` in `common/src/constants.ts`. Updated `shortModelNames` and `providerModelNames` mappings to expose these models to the CLI picker and backend. `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` includes new token cost entries for input, output, and cache-read.

81e4c5b655665872eba00da2e04eaeaae3d37627.title: Skip checkpoint init in home dir
81e4c5b655665872eba00da2e04eaeaae3d37627.summary: Added guard in initializeCheckpointFileManager to return early if projectDir matches os.homedir(). Prevents bare repo creation in home directory. Scope: npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts. Mechanism: direct string equality check against os.homedir().

f2a76411487f328117048b0d4f61dc185f59941f.title: Add git commit guide to system prompt
f2a76411487f328117048b0d4f61dc185f59941f.summary: New `gitCommitGuidePrompt` constant added to `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`, detailing a four-step workflow for creating commits. The guide mandates reviewing diffs and logs, analyzing changes in `<commit_analysis>` tags, and using a specific HEREDOC format with a `Co-Authored-By: Codebuff` footer. This prompt is injected into the `run_terminal_command` tool description in `backend/src/tools.ts`. Constraints include forbidding git config changes, pushes, and interactive flags.

e9194839f09c07d29defdb1e2d66f2f35bb5e3f5.title: Move checkpoint handlers into cli-handlers/checkpoint.ts
e9194839f09c07d29defdb1e2d66f2f35bb5e3f5.summary: Refactor: CLI checkpoint logic (`handleUndo`, `handleRedo`, command regexes) extracted from `npm-app/src/cli.ts` into new file `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/checkpoint.ts`. `cli.ts` now imports these handlers and the `checkpointManager` directly. `freshPrompt` in `cli.ts` updated to accept optional `userInput`, clearing and rewriting the readline line state to support restored checkpoint prompts.

a55a6d5f83a3fa1eae52a2a4604d077f8eeec0fb.title: Add checkpoint menu and save command
a55a6d5f83a3fa1eae52a2a4604d077f8eeec0fb.summary: Added interactive checkpoint menu and explicit save command to CLI. Refactored checkpoint command handling in cli.ts to use centralized checkpointCommands object and isCheckpointCommand helper. Updated CheckpointManager.addCheckpoint to accept saveWithNoChanges flag, allowing checkpoint creation even when no file changes are staged. Covers npm-app checkpoint-manager.ts, cli-handlers/checkpoint.ts, and cli.ts.

60a75f471aa4a05410ab3d44b15e09560ad01c1e.title: Extract CLI handlers to dedicated modules
60a75f471aa4a05410ab3d44b15e09560ad01c1e.summary: Refactored `npm-app/src/cli.ts` by moving `detectApiKey`, `handleDiff`, and `showEasterEgg` into new files under `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/`. Updated `CheckpointManager` logic to correctly handle `saveWithNoChanges` flag during checkpoint creation. Scope limited to internal CLI structure; no user-facing behavior changes.

f2a76411487f328117048b0d4f61dc185f59941f.text: The assistant now follows a strict guide when saving changes. This makes it double-check its work and add a clear note about who helped.

82155f758be1037060fc3e513fb91e2bbec69a4f.text: The site now remembers a friend's invite code even if you refresh the page or move around before signing up. This helps ensure you get credit for the referral when you eventually create an account.

fa7e7bcf3b80ee78a2fdba4cf2f736914ddd0a71.text: The app now supports two new artificial intelligence options. You can pick them from the menu to generate text.

c683317d851c3081aa173f237081a1a09eead58a.text: The feature that shows browser activity errors was renamed for clarity. This is a small internal update with no visible change to how you use the product.

c6434887277061959deedd47604d65d78b6176cd.text: The tool now checks if you are starting in your main folder. If so, it shows helpful setup steps instead of confusing errors.

8330bae36895631f1304fc6a9f1a76544d8952cb.text: The setup instructions now tell you to open your project folder first. This helps the tool find your files correctly.

e9194839f09c07d29defdb1e2d66f2f35bb5e3f5.text: The tool that lets you undo or redo actions now remembers your typed text better when you restore a previous step. This small internal update keeps your work safe and makes the undo feature feel smoother.

a55a6d5f83a3fa1eae52a2a4604d077f8eeec0fb.text: A new menu lets you save your work at any time, even if you haven't made changes. This gives you more control over when to create a backup point.

60a75f471aa4a05410ab3d44b15e09560ad01c1e.text: The program's internal organization was improved for better maintenance. This change does not affect how the product works or looks to users.

81e4c5b655665872eba00da2e04eaeaae3d37627.text: The app no longer creates hidden backup folders in your main home directory. This keeps your personal folders cleaner.

c025a7b51e6566c548c85616f7135c7a3ce688d3.title: Disable checkpoints in home directory
c025a7b51e6566c548c85616f7135c7a3ce688d3.summary: CheckpointManager throws CheckpointsDisabledError when getProjectRoot() equals os.homedir(). Prevents checkpoint creation in user home directories. Internal change in npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts.

98c359de87a1f4c30a5bed0a440eb85fa1ce2af3.title: Expand few-shot examples in checkTerminalCommand
98c359de87a1f4c30a5bed0a440eb85fa1ce2af3.summary: Added explicit 'yes' and 'no' few-shot examples to the LLM prompt in `backend/src/check-terminal-command.ts`. This aims to reduce false positives where natural language inputs are misclassified as executable terminal commands. The change affects the `checkTerminalCommand` function's prompt construction logic.

e8c8234508d08ace059d25a52d767d9f51fead51.title: Refine endturn prompting for GPT-4.1
e8c8234508d08ace059d25a52d767d9f51fead51.summary: Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to explicitly instruct GPT-4.1 to end turn immediately after simple responses. This adjustment aims to improve turn termination reliability for concise outputs while maintaining the requirement to complete all parts of multi-part requests. Scope limited to internal prompt logic for `isGPT4_1`.

f9feef47a9aa22cfe899d5b705eee5e2adc3926b.title: Reset bare repo path on project root change
f9feef47a9aa22cfe899d5b705eee5e2adc3926b.summary: CheckpointManager.clearCheckpoints now accepts resetBareRepoPath flag. setProjectRoot passes true when switching directories, clearing stale bareRepoPath references. Prevents checkpoint corruption from lingering repo paths during directory changes.

faf7dc7431ec61a3216b47bdd073984870bad1e6.title: Support absolute paths and tilde expansion in cd command
faf7dc7431ec61a3216b47bdd073984870bad1e6.summary: Terminal utility now handles absolute paths and tilde expansion for cd commands. Previously, relative path joining logic caused errors when users provided absolute paths or ~ shortcuts. The change introduces conditional checks for ~, ~/ prefix, and absolute paths before setting the project root. Also updates a comment in checkpoint-manager.ts to reflect correct worker script path.

ac1ff026ad92929d401c9821b4f5ed3203ec9143.title: Rename Best Practices title
ac1ff026ad92929d401c9821b4f5ed3203ec9143.summary: Changed frontmatter title in `web/src/content/tips/best-practices.mdx` from 'Best Practices' to 'Codebuff Best Practices'. Aligns doc metadata with sidebar section navigation fix. No functional code changes.

775f66ad3b7313c43d63c38b392fd17cff856890.title: Add sonnet 3.7 to message cost tracker
775f66ad3b7313c43d63c38b392fd17cff856890.summary: Added `models.sonnet3_7` to `TOKENS_COST_PER_M` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` for `input`, `output`, `cache_creation`, and `cache_read`. Rates match existing `models.sonnet` entries ($3/$15/$3.75/$0.3 per M tokens). Internal cost tracking update; no user-facing changes.

ebf8103ea303805eb97fd7c1afa09dbfdcae2559.title: Throw server error on invalid model in getAgentStream
ebf8103ea303805eb97fd7c1afa09dbfdcae2559.summary: Added validation in `getAgentStream` to throw an error if `selectedModel` is not a key in `shortModelNames`. This prevents downstream failures when an invalid model string is passed to the backend stream handler. The change applies to `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`. The error message lists valid models via `Object.keys(shortModelNames).join(', ')`.

5274ebc2a99d52319396c6213a4678118cd005f0.title: Home dir project tree disables file listing
5274ebc2a99d52319396c6213a4678118cd005f0.summary: getProjectFileTree in common/src/project-file-tree.ts sets maxFiles to 0 when projectRoot matches os.homedir(), preventing any file enumeration. This blocks reading permissioned files in the home directory (#110). The change applies to shared core logic used by CLI and Web surfaces. Previously, the limit was 1000 files.

ac1ff026ad92929d401c9821b4f5ed3203ec9143.text: The document title was updated to 'Codebuff Best Practices' to match the navigation menu. This is a small internal change that does not affect how the product works.

e8c8234508d08ace059d25a52d767d9f51fead51.text: The assistant now stops talking sooner after simple answers. This change helps it avoid unnecessary extra text.

5274ebc2a99d52319396c6213a4678118cd005f0.text: The assistant no longer scans your entire home folder to list files, a change that prevents it from accessing private documents there.

132778b796b180f9021119dbd0f749076993f323.text: The assistant now shows its reasoning steps more clearly. It also stops generating text at specific points to avoid rambling.

f9feef47a9aa22cfe899d5b705eee5e2adc3926b.text: When you switch project folders, the app now clears old data links to prevent errors. This small fix keeps your saved work safe.

98c359de87a1f4c30a5bed0a440eb85fa1ce2af3.text: The system now better distinguishes between regular speech and computer commands, reducing accidental execution of text that wasn't meant to be a command.

ebf8103ea303805eb97fd7c1afa09dbfdcae2559.text: The system now checks if a requested assistant model exists before starting a conversation. If an invalid choice is made, it immediately reports an error instead of failing later.

faf7dc7431ec61a3216b47bdd073984870bad1e6.text: The terminal now correctly handles full file paths and shortcuts when changing directories. This prevents errors when navigating to specific locations using these formats.

c025a7b51e6566c548c85616f7135c7a3ce688d3.text: The app now blocks saving certain backup files to your main home folder. This prevents cluttering your personal directory with system-generated files.

775f66ad3b7313c43d63c38b392fd17cff856890.text: The system now tracks costs for a new assistant model. This is an internal update. You will not see any changes.

425676d520c1042d399a919b44b787c563d65a4c.title: Remove logger test file
425676d520c1042d399a919b44b787c563d65a4c.summary: Deleted backend/src/util/__tests__/logger.test.ts. The file contained 181 lines of tests for splitData covering primitives, objects, arrays, and nested structures. Removal indicates the tests were deemed unnecessary or redundant.

4886cec452d9cc08f5ee5a481ad47871efa645b0.title: Send tool call id in background process tool result
4886cec452d9cc08f5ee5a481ad47871efa645b0.summary: Background process updates now return an array of ToolResult objects with the original tool call id instead of a single aggregated result with a generated compact id. `BackgroundProcessInfo` splits `id` into `pid` and `toolCallId`, and `getBackgroundProcessUpdates` maps each process to its own `ToolResult`. `runTerminalCommand` and `runBackgroundCommand` in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` and `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` thread the tool call id through to the process manager. `npm-app/src/client.ts` spreads the array into `toolResults` rather than conditionally concatenating.

dc5bfd0da3fc8b9dd049fd9e9bca6a3a2107b1d1.title: Remove knowledge file creation condition
dc5bfd0da3fc8b9dd049fd9e9bca6a3a2107b1d1.summary: The condition `hasKnowledgeFiles` was removed from the prompt instruction for updating knowledge files in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This allows the agent to consider creating new knowledge files even when none currently exist, provided it is not the first user message.

a5057f5991af09804645b38ed2ec44339375b39c.title: Background process updates sent every prompt action
a5057f5991af09804645b38ed2ec44339375b39c.summary: Refactors background process reporting in `npm-app` to send updates on every prompt action rather than only on user prompts. `getBackgroundProcessUpdates` in `background-process-manager.ts` now returns a structured `ToolResult` or `null`, integrating directly with the agent state. `client.ts` appends these updates to `toolResults` during the non-complete prompt loop, ensuring real-time status visibility for long-running tasks.

a56079cfa56d0b6dc5ee7b9a51e288e501f75db1.title: Replace lastUserPromptIndex with consecutiveAssistantMessages counter
a56079cfa56d0b6dc5ee7b9a51e288e501f75db1.summary: Refactored agent state tracking in `common/src/types/agent-state.ts` and `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Replaced `lastUserPromptIndex` with a `consecutiveAssistantMessages` counter to simplify logic for detecting excessive assistant turns. Initial state now defaults to 0 instead of -1. The warning trigger and `end_turn` tool call remain functionally identical.

968af547bb4e66152ab80c3d0c07b5209dfbded8.title: Referral bonus raised to 500 credits
968af547bb4e66152ab80c3d0c07b5209dfbded8.summary: CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS increased from 250 to 500 in common/src/constants.ts. Adjusts incentive value for user referrals. Change scoped to shared core constants. Existing affiliate limits (AFFILIATE_USER_REFFERAL_LIMIT = 500) remain unchanged.

7fe3167b36cb8dc119d4736b84a649eadc1a022b.title: Refactor splitData into dedicated util module
7fe3167b36cb8dc119d4736b84a649eadc1a022b.summary: Extracted `splitData` logic from `backend/src/util/logger.ts` into new `backend/src/util/split-data.ts`. Implements robust chunking for plain objects and strings, calculating JSON size overhead and handling edge cases like empty strings and oversized keys. `logger.ts` now imports from the new module, reducing inline complexity. Covers backend core utilities; no user-facing API or model changes.

c7f818857794f59f69a714a1c2c0afaa3b28d4f7.title: Add gpt-4.1 model and --model CLI param support
c7f818857794f59f69a714a1c2c0afaa3b28d4f7.summary: Added `gpt-4.1` to OpenAI model constants, cost tracking, and message transformation logic. Introduced `prompt-agent-stream.ts` to centralize model selection based on `selectedModel` param or cost mode, replacing direct provider calls in `main-prompt.ts`. Updated `websocket-action.ts` and `actions.ts` schema to pass `model` string from client. Added specific instruction suppression for `gpt-4.1` in `main-prompt.ts` to handle its reasoning behavior.

a56079cfa56d0b6dc5ee7b9a51e288e501f75db1.text: The system now counts assistant replies in a simpler way to better manage conversation flow. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

7fe3167b36cb8dc119d4736b84a649eadc1a022b.text: The team moved part of the system to its own place to make it cleaner. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

4886cec452d9cc08f5ee5a481ad47871efa645b0.text: Background tasks now report their results individually instead of combining them into one summary. This helps the assistant keep track of separate running processes more accurately.

ffd640ed3f0aaaf6f7ff5b5a308e62e4c7d330f4.text: The assistant now uses a new, customized version of its underlying model. This change is internal and does not alter how you interact with the product.

a5057f5991af09804645b38ed2ec44339375b39c.text: The app now checks on long-running background tasks during every interaction, not just when you type. This means status updates appear more quickly and reliably.

b9c4a393b92b8814c33c7952356a3d0145ed9a72.text: The app now charges for usage and can automatically add more funds when the balance gets low. Users can turn this auto-renewal on or off in their settings.

968af547bb4e66152ab80c3d0c07b5209dfbded8.text: The reward for inviting a friend doubled to 500 credits. This means you get more credits when you successfully refer new users to the service.

dc5bfd0da3fc8b9dd049fd9e9bca6a3a2107b1d1.text: The assistant can now create new notes even if it has none yet. This helps it keep track of information from the start of a conversation.

425676d520c1042d399a919b44b787c563d65a4c.text: The team removed some internal checks that tested how the software handles data. This is a small, behind-the-scenes cleanup that does not change how the product works for you.

cc65c7a3c53c54602fcef62e9dba933a034c95b3.title: Update main-prompt tests for async generator mocks
cc65c7a3c53c54602fcef62e9dba933a034c95b3.summary: Replaced ReadableStream mocks with async generator implementations in main-prompt.test.ts. Updated streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks, promptClaudeStream, and promptGeminiStream mocks to yield strings directly. Scope limited to backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts.

d08272cd612503e01bad0a8d8a1426390be54a53.title: Revert main prompt user instructions to pre-Gemini rewrite
d08272cd612503e01bad0a8d8a1426390be54a53.summary: Reverted the user instructions section in backend/src/main-prompt.ts to its pre-Gemini rewrite state. The previous version contained extensive bold markdown, nested bullet points, and explicit override/supersede logic that likely caused formatting or adherence issues. The new version uses plain text paragraphs, simplified tool formatting rules (no XML attributes), and direct instructions for clarification, file reading, subgoals, and code preservation. Scope limited to the backend main prompt construction.

a5aa2af8f37961c5d5375b88b64fe88f22962fe7.title: Add /vibe redirect for referral link
a5aa2af8f37961c5d5375b88b64fe88f22962fe7.summary: Added a new redirect rule in web/next.config.mjs mapping /vibe to the codebuff.com referral URL. This provides a shorter, easier-to-share link for users. The redirect is configured as non-permanent.

73c28e89e02dedfca7546682f8fae519dc21ac0d.title: browseraction tool enables headless console log reading
73c28e89e02dedfca7546682f8fae519dc21ac0d.summary: Adds `browser_action` tool for navigating URLs and capturing console logs in headless mode. Default `headless` set to `true` in `BROWSER_DEFAULTS`. Pre/post screenshots and 'Browser started' log disabled in `browser-runner.ts`. Handler returns JSON string instead of object.

127613a4956730779e13b49791c39a1eeef2fc7a.title: Fix type error in background-process-manager tests
127613a4956730779e13b49791c39a1eeef2fc7a.summary: Split `bun:test` imports in `background-process-manager.test.ts` into separate statements with targeted `@ts-ignore` comments. Replaces a single block ignoring all types with granular suppression for the test runner types. Scope limited to `npm-app` test utilities.

b154c52e1781895a6edb887004b9af01bf5e4bff.title: Skip slow rewrite tests
b154c52e1781895a6edb887004b9af01bf5e4bff.summary: Marked `preserveCommentsInEditSnippet` and `rewriteWithOpenAI` test suites as skipped in `backend/src/__tests__/fast-rewrite.test.ts`. Change addresses slow execution times for these specific integration tests. Scope limited to backend test configuration; no production code or user-facing features affected. Tests remain in codebase but excluded from default run.

fdd8132d50b598b7531f127d5aeca78ccafb0e28.title: Refine docs search prompt constraints
fdd8132d50b598b7531f127d5aeca78ccafb0e28.summary: Updated the JSON schema instruction in `get-documentation-for-query.ts` to explicitly restrict `topic` field generation to relevant documentation keywords only. This change tightens the prompt to reduce noise in search queries by enforcing stricter relevance criteria during LLM extraction. Scope limited to backend documentation retrieval logic.

186aa68c16ef589274f609c1873311ebc255e728.title: ts-ignore for bun:test import
186aa68c16ef589274f609c1873311ebc255e728.summary: Added @ts-ignore directive to bun:test import in background-process-manager.test.ts. Suppresses TypeScript type-checking errors for the test module. Internal change affecting npm-app test suite only.

68f85fd4c9cc9441b1cfb768df3f7aa65ab024af.title: Fix logger splitter
68f85fd4c9cc9441b1cfb768df3f7aa65ab024af.summary: Rewrote backend/src/util/logger.ts splitData function to handle nested objects and arrays correctly. Previous implementation failed on complex structures due to naive string slicing and incorrect overhead calculation. New logic recursively splits plain objects and arrays while respecting JSON serialization limits and key overheads. Updated tests in backend/src/util/__tests__/logger.test.ts cover edge cases for large strings and deep nesting.

894cfcb85b60b8b9fd0edb37d03319389a5bd171.title: Add Context7 documentation fetching to agent prompt
894cfcb85b60b8b9fd0edb37d03319389a5bd171.summary: New backend integration fetches relevant documentation chunks from Context7 based on user queries. Uses Gemini to analyze query relevance and select optimal project/topic. Injects retrieved context directly into main agent prompt as user message. Covers backend API client and prompt assembly logic.

d08272cd612503e01bad0a8d8a1426390be54a53.text: We reset the assistant's core instructions to an older, simpler version to fix formatting issues. This small internal change helps the assistant follow rules more reliably without altering its main capabilities.

cc65c7a3c53c54602fcef62e9dba933a034c95b3.text: Developers updated internal tools that check how the assistant streams text. This small change helps the team test the feature more accurately, but you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

127613a4956730779e13b49791c39a1eeef2fc7a.text: A small internal fix corrected how test files check their own setup. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

fdd8132d50b598b7531f127d5aeca78ccafb0e28.text: The system now focuses on relevant keywords when searching for help articles, reducing irrelevant results.

186aa68c16ef589274f609c1873311ebc255e728.text: A small internal fix stopped a technical warning from appearing during testing. This change does not affect how you use the product.

73c28e89e02dedfca7546682f8fae519dc21ac0d.text: The assistant can now check website messages without opening a visible browser window. This makes web checks faster and quieter for you.

894cfcb85b60b8b9fd0edb37d03319389a5bd171.text: The assistant can now look up relevant documentation to answer questions better. This change is small and internal.

68f85fd4c9cc9441b1cfb768df3f7aa65ab024af.text: Fixed a tool that organizes internal system notes. This small update helps staff track software issues more accurately. You will not see any changes.

a5aa2af8f37961c5d5375b88b64fe88f22962fe7.text: A short web link now sends users to a partner site. This makes it easier to share the link.

b154c52e1781895a6edb887004b9af01bf5e4bff.text: Slow checks were skipped during testing. Nothing changes for users.

260093037778f6d99c17b7064bc177a6a4817bef.title: logger skips splitAndLog when ENVIRONMENT=local
260093037778f6d99c17b7064bc177a6a4817bef.summary: logger export conditionally uses raw pinoLogger when process.env.ENVIRONMENT === 'local', bypassing splitAndLog. Non-local environments retain the custom split-and-log wrapper. Change affects backend/src/util/logger.ts.

dc65613d159180225b42160b448ab102c3d3c11e.title: Logger: fix chunk overflow, string split
dc65613d159180225b42160b448ab102c3d3c11e.summary: Fixes logging chunk overflow in `backend/src/util/logger.ts`. Reduces context `BUFFER` 5000 to 1000; corrects recursive split budget to account for `[],` delimiter; adds dedicated string chunker using `JSON.stringify`/`JSON.parse` to avoid breaking escape sequences. Internal backend logging only.

62b05acf9f9cf6d90d4abb0f837e1377987c2e43.title: Move process kill logging before summary output in CLI
62b05acf9f9cf6d90d4abb0f837e1377987c2e43.summary: Relocated the `backgroundProcesses` kill loop in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to execute before the credit summary and final exit message. This ensures 'Killed process' logs appear before the aggregated output during shutdown. Internal refactor; no functional change to process termination logic.

8bd79ed84c6021d429eeb34bd9e4ea196e962657.title: Increase logger chunk buffer to 5000
8bd79ed84c6021d429eeb34bd9e4ea196e962657.summary: Renamed TOLERANCE to BUFFER and increased value from 2000 to 5000 in backend/src/util/logger.ts. Adjusts availableDataLimit calculation in splitAndLog to reserve more space for context before chunking. Internal logging utility change affecting backend only.

bae6577e52869979f91cb276fbe2f7faa1ae5d1c.title: CLI shutdown logs killed background processes
bae6577e52869979f91cb276fbe2f7faa1ae5d1c.summary: Moved background process termination logic in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to execute after credit summary logging. Added explicit console output for each killed process command and formatted error reporting for failed kills using `yellow` and `red` utilities. This change affects only the CLI exit sequence, ensuring process cleanup visibility occurs immediately before the final 'Codebuff out!' message.

56ab198ea52e28db5c0b4f22e7db16ccd2cd1e5e.title: Adjust recursive chunk length in logger splitData
56ab198ea52e28db5c0b4f22e7db16ccd2cd1e5e.summary: Recursive calls in `splitData` now subtract delimiter lengths (`','` for arrays, `{"${key}":},` for objects) from `characterLimit`. This prevents chunks from exceeding the limit when delimiters are added during serialization. Internal change to `backend/src/util/logger.ts`.

c01863b6a8c0af42bab2e1e3e61cb367e548302b.title: Send background process output to backend
c01863b6a8c0af42bab2e1e3e61cb367e548302b.summary: Background process stdout/stderr now sent to backend via new `background_process_updates` tool results. `getBackgroundProcessUpdates` in `background-process-manager.ts` slices new output since last report, formats it, and appends to `lastToolResults` in `client.ts` before sending prompts. `terminal.ts` refactored: `formatResult` includes command, `getBackgroundProcessInfoString` moved to manager, `exitCode` removed from `BackgroundProcessInfo`. Covers npm-app core, client, and terminal utils; limits output to 5000 chars per stream.

4a82b75160973eb5a773413995e008d3fa6444a4.title: Add experimental cost mode for Gemini 2.5 Pro
4a82b75160973eb5a773413995e008d3fa6444a4.summary: Introduced `experimental` cost mode to the `CostMode` type and CLI options, routing agent operations to `streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks` instead of the previous `max` mode behavior. The `--experimental` flag is added to `npm-app` with a magenta greeting message, while `max` now defaults to standard high-quality models. Documentation in `what-models.mdx` updated to describe the new mode's use of cutting-edge features and potential instability.

8a760c9361c7486fd1d37518cf6a23987f7a5c7d.title: Drop gemini pro flags
8a760c9361c7486fd1d37518cf6a23987f7a5c7d.summary: Removed --gemini and --pro CLI options from npm-app/src/index.ts. Help menu restructured in index.ts to list templates before examples, with added '!' prefix note in menu.ts. Scope limited to npm-app CLI. CostMode logic simplified to check only options.max for 'max' mode.

e6d9990b88cc6b604af5b6fe08ea1056123565e7.title: Truncate background process stderr from start
e6d9990b88cc6b604af5b6fe08ea1056123565e7.summary: Refactored `truncateStringWithMessage` in `common/src/util/string.ts` to accept an options object with a `truncate` direction. `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` now truncates background process `stderr` from the start to preserve recent error context. `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` updated to use the new signature.

dc65613d159180225b42160b448ab102c3d3c11e.text: Fixed an internal issue where system logs could get cut off or broken. This change is small and only affects how the software records information behind the scenes.

c01863b6a8c0af42bab2e1e3e61cb367e548302b.text: The app now sends the output from background tasks to the server. This helps the assistant see what is happening in the background.

8bd79ed84c6021d429eeb34bd9e4ea196e962657.text: The system now stores more temporary data during logging. This internal update improves how errors are recorded, but users will not see any change.

bae6577e52869979f91cb276fbe2f7faa1ae5d1c.text: The program now shows which hidden tasks it stops when you close it. This small internal update makes the shutdown process clearer and more reliable for everyone.

62b05acf9f9cf6d90d4abb0f837e1377987c2e43.text: Shutdown messages now appear in a clearer order. This is a small internal cleanup. You will see no change in how the app works.

260093037778f6d99c17b7064bc177a6a4817bef.text: When running the software locally, the system now logs messages directly instead of using the standard splitting process. This internal change does not affect how the product works for users.

4a82b75160973eb5a773413995e008d3fa6444a4.text: The assistant can now use a new, advanced model that may offer better results but is still being tested for stability. This change is experimental, so you might occasionally encounter errors or unexpected behavior when using it.

8a760c9361c7486fd1d37518cf6a23987f7a5c7d.text: The app removed two specific settings for choosing different assistant models. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the app.

56ab198ea52e28db5c0b4f22e7db16ccd2cd1e5e.text: Small internal change. Improved how the system splits large messages to prevent errors.

e149d3a326e893650d788669092b77b0fdca2a5b.title: Add background process support to runterminalcommand
e149d3a326e893650d788669092b77b0fdca2a5b.summary: Added `process_type` parameter to `run_terminal_command` supporting `SYNC` and `BACKGROUND` modes. New `background-process-manager.ts` tracks active processes via PID-keyed Map with stdout/stderr buffering. CLI cleanup kills running background processes on exit. Updated `toolSchema` in `common/src/constants/tools.ts` to require the new parameter.

8fc97a62296b489f996b2c36eb3714f8efc4c8c5.title: Logger Tolerance Increased to 2000
8fc97a62296b489f996b2c36eb3714f8efc4c8c5.summary: The `TOLERANCE` constant in `backend/src/util/logger.ts` increased from 1000 to 2000. This expands the buffer for log context to prevent truncation of larger payloads. Internal change; no user-facing impact.

47797595b7874c359f8fe0967ddf293e21299ce2.title: Remove debug logs from logger splitData
47797595b7874c359f8fe0967ddf293e21299ce2.summary: Removed two temporary console.log statements from `backend/src/util/logger.ts`. These logs were inside `splitData` and `splitAndLog`, used for debugging data chunking. This cleans up the backend logging utility.

2215183fd2c618ca1ea990e8ea29d83cf644d464.title: Fix undo checkpoints
2215183fd2c618ca1ea990e8ea29d83cf644d464.summary: Undo operations now restore `lastToolResults` alongside `agentState`. The `Checkpoint` interface includes a `lastToolResultsString` field. `CheckpointManager.addCheckpoint` accepts and serializes tool results. `Client.lastToolResults` visibility changed to public. CLI restore logic parses and applies the saved tool results.

3f35d98849c0cd31d310e377c891d30ca41033f7.title: Update readfile tool call response format to nested XML
3f35d98849c0cd31d310e377c891d30ca41033f7.summary: read_file tool responses now use nested XML structure with separate <path> and <content> tags instead of attribute-based format. This change improves parsing reliability for file contents containing special characters or newlines. The update affects backend/src/util/parse-tool-call-xml.ts renderReadFilesResult and parseReadFilesResult functions. Regex pattern updated to match new structure; path values now trimmed during parsing.

ae3212816638584c7964a09743fbe79a392acf68.title: Prompt hardening: JSON.stringify input, reordered context, structured
ae3212816638584c7964a09743fbe79a392acf68.summary: Prompt templates in backend/src/check-terminal-command.ts and backend/src/find-files/ now wrap user inputs in JSON.stringify instead of raw interpolation or backticks to prevent injection and delimiter confusion. Error handling in check-terminal-command.ts switches to structured logging with pino-style object passing and explicit message extraction. main-prompt.ts updates the file_updates system message to enforce stronger consideration of user modifications. Import order standardization applied across request-files-prompt.ts and check-new-files-necessary.ts.

5c872dacbe6ab3a18ad665a447dc2e688b304b8b.title: Catch XML parsing errors in backend tool calls
5c872dacbe6ab3a18ad665a447dc2e688b304b8b.summary: Added error handling for `parseRawToolCall` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to catch malformed XML tool calls before execution. Invalid calls now return a structured error result to the client instead of crashing the agent loop. Also cleaned up debug logging in `backend/src/llm-apis/open-router.ts` and improved error messaging in `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

b59b93cc5415e7b299c9848c2c7d4e1946719199.title: Tone down Buffy persona
b59b93cc5415e7b299c9848c2c7d4e1946719199.summary: Updated system prompts to reduce Buffy's enthusiasm, shifting from 'enthusiastic' to 'helpful and upbeat'. Removed mandatory high-energy phrases and specific incorrect formatting examples from `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`, and `backend/src/tools.ts`. Tone instructions now allow moderate positivity without excessive exclamation marks.

72ad881ebfb1ff0e97ef12627183014f14e30b9f.title: Drop Gemini 2.5 Pro preview API fallback step
72ad881ebfb1ff0e97ef12627183014f14e30b9f.summary: Removes the direct Gemini API `gemini-2.5-pro-preview` attempt from `streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks`, shortening the chain to two Gemini exp steps, one OpenRouter preview step, and Claude Sonnet. Fallback logs now include `accumulatedContent` to aid debugging mid-stream failures. `main-prompt.ts` explicitly sets `temperature: 0` for the Gemini path.

7fa2f34c2d5c93bf654ee6cf573a029943156805.title: Logger adds chunking for large payloads
7fa2f34c2d5c93bf654ee6cf573a029943156805.summary: Backend logger wraps pino to split oversized JSON payloads into chunks under 100k chars. Handles nested arrays and objects via recursive `splitData`. Extends `LoggerContext` with `fingerprintId`, `clientRequestId`, `messageId`. WebSocket middleware normalizes `discordId` to `undefined`.

47797595b7874c359f8fe0967ddf293e21299ce2.text: The system stopped recording extra internal notes about how it handles data. This change is small and internal. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

ae3212816638584c7964a09743fbe79a392acf68.text: The system now handles user text more safely to prevent errors. This internal update improves stability without changing how you use the product.

e149d3a326e893650d788669092b77b0fdca2a5b.text: The assistant can now run long tasks in the background while you keep working.

b59b93cc5415e7b299c9848c2c7d4e1946719199.text: The assistant's personality was adjusted to be calmer and less overly excited. This means replies will feel more natural and less repetitive.

7fa2f34c2d5c93bf654ee6cf573a029943156805.text: Internal system updates help the computer handle large amounts of data more smoothly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2215183fd2c618ca1ea990e8ea29d83cf644d464.text: When you undo an action, the assistant now correctly remembers the information it gathered from previous steps. This small internal fix ensures the conversation stays consistent after reversing changes.

8fc97a62296b489f996b2c36eb3714f8efc4c8c5.text: The system now keeps a larger record of internal activity details. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

5c872dacbe6ab3a18ad665a447dc2e688b304b8b.text: The assistant now handles broken instructions safely instead of stopping. This keeps the chat running smoothly when errors occur.

3f35d98849c0cd31d310e377c891d30ca41033f7.text: The system now reads files more reliably, especially those with special characters or line breaks. This internal update helps the assistant understand file contents correctly without errors.

72ad881ebfb1ff0e97ef12627183014f14e30b9f.text: A small internal change simplified how the system finds a backup option if the first one fails. This makes the process slightly faster and more reliable.

ce0623e2b73f3a8732c7d0644468cba3fbe1a3bf.title: Enforce nested XML elements for tool parameters
ce0623e2b73f3a8732c7d0644468cba3fbe1a3bf.summary: System prompts and tool instructions now mandate nested XML elements for parameters, explicitly forbidding XML attributes. This prevents parser errors caused by malformed tool calls. Changes apply to backend/src/main-prompt.ts, backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md, and backend/src/tools.ts. Examples updated to highlight correct nested structure.

24da962235ece29c99c9730d825d436ad187a2d0.title: writefile tool description drops XML attribute example
24da962235ece29c99c9730d825d436ad187a2d0.summary: Removed the literal `<write_file path="foo">` negative example from the `write_file` tool description in `backend/src/tools.ts`. The warning against XML attributes remains, now stated without the code snippet. Scope limited to the backend tool definition. This reduces prompt token usage and avoids potential parsing confusion from embedded XML tags in the instructions.

e053ff3f6459b021b89a072c2cfa33cc3e2fa47e.title: Constrain tool usage to listed tools in main prompt
e053ff3f6459b021b89a072c2cfa33cc3e2fa47e.summary: Added explicit instruction to backend/src/main-prompt.ts to restrict tool usage to the `TOOL_LIST`. This prevents unintended display issues when the model hallucinates unlisted tools. Scope limited to the backend prompt generation logic.

8530b2ba3ca97bf6f621b3c0dbde2a271339cd8a.title: FAQ Dockerfile link updated
8530b2ba3ca97bf6f621b3c0dbde2a271339cd8a.summary: Updated the Dockerfile link in `web/src/content/help/faq.mdx`. Points to `codebuff-community/tree/main/utils/docker` instead of `codebuff-docker`.

0a0e09c432c0b1f0eaee15fbd6ca62858015eca1.title: Add Gemini API preview step to stream fallback chain
0a0e09c432c0b1f0eaee15fbd6ca62858015eca1.summary: Inserts Gemini API direct call for `gemini-2.5-pro-preview` as step 3 in `streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks`, shifting OpenRouter preview to step 4. This prioritizes internal Gemini key usage over OpenRouter for preview models before final Claude Sonnet fallback. Scope limited to `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts`. Log message updated to reflect new fallback target.

25022813ff557c458d638f78fce60549a696d6e9.title: Refactor system prompts for strict tool formatting
25022813ff557c458d638f78fce60549a696d6e9.summary: Updated `main-prompt.ts` and `tools.ts` to enforce strict XML tool formatting, explicitly banning Markdown wrappers and mandating empty lines around tool calls. The `agent-instructions.md` file introduces a 'Buffy' persona with specific tone guidelines and clarifies state management rules. These changes aim to prevent parsing failures caused by improper tool call syntax.

fd74605d71216ccf102d9d46a47487eec69c9eb5.title: Preserve partial content in LLM stream fallbacks
fd74605d71216ccf102d9d46a47487eec69c9eb5.summary: Stream fallback logic in `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` now appends partially generated content to the message history before attempting the next provider. Previous implementations discarded mid-stream failures, causing context loss during rate limits or upstream errors. The change applies to Gemini 2.5 Pro (exp/preview) and OpenRouter streams, ensuring Claude Sonnet final fallback receives the full accumulated context.

cefd642960b736ed0799a58188960ec19bcd51e9.title: Remove Gemini API key prompt from CLI
cefd642960b736ed0799a58188960ec19bcd51e9.summary: Deleted `displayGeminiKeyPromptIfNeeded` and associated state from `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Removed logic that prompted users for a Gemini API key when in max mode. This eliminates a temporary workaround implemented while waiting for Gemini 2.5 Pro availability.

dc031beaedfd476f7e0d00fd00200dcc3bc1122c.title: OpenRouter error logging fix
dc031beaedfd476f7e0d00fd00200dcc3bc1122c.summary: OpenRouter stream error logging now passes raw error object to logger.error instead of extracting message. Replaces 'Error calling OpenAI API' with 'Error calling OpenRouter API Stream'. Adds console.log debug statement. Affects backend/src/llm-apis/open-router.ts.

ce0623e2b73f3a8732c7d0644468cba3fbe1a3bf.text: The system now requires a stricter format for internal instructions. This prevents errors that could stop the assistant from working.

e053ff3f6459b021b89a072c2cfa33cc3e2fa47e.text: The assistant now only uses approved features. This stops it from showing broken or fake options.

8530b2ba3ca97bf6f621b3c0dbde2a271339cd8a.text: A broken link in the help guide was fixed. This small change helps you find the correct setup instructions.

fd74605d71216ccf102d9d46a47487eec69c9eb5.text: If an AI response gets interrupted, the system now keeps the partial text instead of losing it. This helps the next attempt understand what was already said, reducing confusion during errors.

24da962235ece29c99c9730d825d436ad187a2d0.text: The assistant's internal instructions were slightly shortened by removing a redundant example. This change is small and internal. It does not affect how you use the product.

dc031beaedfd476f7e0d00fd00200dcc3bc1122c.text: The system now records clearer details when the assistant fails to respond. This helps support teams fix problems faster, but you will not see any difference in how the app works.

0a0e09c432c0b1f0eaee15fbd6ca62858015eca1.text: The assistant now tries a new, direct connection to its main brain before falling back to other options. This makes responses faster and more reliable for you.

cefd642960b736ed0799a58188960ec19bcd51e9.text: A hidden setup step asking for a specific service key was removed. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

25022813ff557c458d638f78fce60549a696d6e9.text: The assistant now uses a clearer format when asking other programs for information. This small internal fix helps prevent errors when the assistant tries to do things like search the web or check your calendar.

54a429841fcb251aba97cfb5406a54f88f426390.title: Add -y flag guidance to terminal tool instructions
54a429841fcb251aba97cfb5406a54f88f426390.summary: Added instruction 11 to backend/src/tools.ts recommending -y or --yes flags for commands supporting them. This prevents hangs caused by interactive confirmation prompts in non-interactive environments. Scope limited to backend tool prompt configuration.

8985862e597817d73737c756a71927e50df87a21.title: Fix reading edited files in main-prompt
8985862e597817d73737c756a71927e50df87a21.summary: Updated `getFileReadingUpdates` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to filter messages by `assistant` role before parsing file blocks. This prevents user messages containing `<write_file` strings from being incorrectly identified as edited files. Scope limited to backend main prompt logic. Follow-up constraint: ensure user prompts do not trigger file update logic.

bf69696e0f8b19dc50032099c1b1f113a992f6ed.title: Fix typo in git command safety rule
bf69696e0f8b19dc50032099c1b1f113a992f6ed.summary: Corrected `git that` to `git commands` in system prompt. File: `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

f381f57e68a242a353feedd5dffd444066c58afc.title: Add writefile example to agent instructions
f381f57e68a242a353feedd5dffd444066c58afc.summary: Added a simplified example response demonstrating correct `write_file` tool call syntax to `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`. Removed redundant instruction about using markdown for code display from `backend/src/tools.ts` as the new example clarifies tool usage. This internal change aims to improve agent consistency in applying file edits.

65dc85d48e6b059bcc14ec17f298ca50edf2f980.title: Referrals page credits badge uses actual user data
65dc85d48e6b059bcc14ec17f298ca50edf2f980.summary: Referrals page `CreditsBadge` now renders `data.referredBy.credits` and `r.credits` instead of static `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS`. This ensures the badge reflects the actual credits balance of the referred user at the time of referral. Change applies to `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx`.

1cc019b921c42b3ca53252da284e0083f3c856f4.title: Skip flaky main prompt integration test
1cc019b921c42b3ca53252da284e0083f3c856f4.summary: The 'should add end_turn when LLM stream yields only text' test in `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.integration.test.ts` is now marked `it.skip`. Import statements were reordered alphabetically. This change isolates the flaky assertion from the CI pipeline.

1cbc08e7eaafe9095b0a216a6d3fbdd73ef292ba.title: CLI crash guards and tool call error handling
1cbc08e7eaafe9095b0a216a6d3fbdd73ef292ba.summary: Added process-level handlers for `unhandledRejection` and `uncaughtException` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to prevent silent CLI crashes. Wrapped tool call execution logic in `npm-app/src/client.ts` with `try/catch` blocks to catch and display errors from `handleToolCall` without terminating the session. Changes are internal to the CLI package.

a00ff2818ca9386935333a9d33525c488a6ba6ab.title: Update April 2025 Hackathon details
a00ff2818ca9386935333a9d33525c488a6ba6ab.summary: Adjusts event schedule to April 12th, 2:00 PM - 8:00 PM PDT. Adds judges section listing James Grugett, Charles Lien, and Cher Hu. Updates copy to emphasize free dinner and Codebuff credits.

bb37a001c0175bbf146f0523b2ad0c724a7a2c3e.title: Prompt Gemini to use tools better
bb37a001c0175bbf146f0523b2ad0c724a7a2c3e.summary: Updated system prompts in backend/src/main-prompt.ts and backend/src/tools.ts to improve tool usage. Instructions now explicitly forbid XML attributes in favor of nested tags (e.g., <write_file><path>...) and clarify edit behavior to 'write' rather than 'highlight' changed parts. Minor typo fixes ('derivable') and stricter warnings about tool failure modes were also applied.

032e10876f009524f01fb693ce9f27a9d140a27e.title: Gemini fallbacks use internal keys and OpenRouter
032e10876f009524f01fb693ce9f27a9d140a27e.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro streaming fallbacks now prioritize internal API keys and OpenRouter endpoints, removing user-key and Vertex AI attempts. This simplifies the retry chain to Internal Gemini, OpenRouter Free, OpenRouter Preview, then Claude Sonnet. The change affects backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts and adds openrouterModels to common/src/constants.ts. Cost tracking for openrouter_gemini2_5_pro_preview was added to message-cost-tracker.ts.

65dc85d48e6b059bcc14ec17f298ca50edf2f980.text: The referral page now shows the exact number of credits the referred user actually has, rather than a fixed default amount. This ensures the displayed balance is accurate for each individual person.

8985862e597817d73737c756a71927e50df87a21.text: A small internal fix prevents the assistant from mistakenly thinking you edited a file just because you pasted specific text into the chat.

bb37a001c0175bbf146f0523b2ad0c724a7a2c3e.text: The AI assistant received clearer instructions on how to read and edit files, reducing mistakes when handling complex tasks. This is an internal update that makes the assistant more reliable without changing how you use it.

bf69696e0f8b19dc50032099c1b1f113a992f6ed.text: The assistant's instructions were corrected to ensure it properly recognizes safety rules for specific actions. This small internal fix helps the tool follow its guidelines more accurately.

54a429841fcb251aba97cfb5406a54f88f426390.text: The assistant now automatically answers 'yes' to routine safety checks that used to wait for a reply. This stops tasks from freezing when no one is there to click confirm.

1cc019b921c42b3ca53252da284e0083f3c856f4.text: A small internal cleanup temporarily turned off a check that fails randomly. You will not notice any difference in how the assistant works.

1cbc08e7eaafe9095b0a216a6d3fbdd73ef292ba.text: The command-line tool now catches errors instead of closing unexpectedly. This keeps your session running even if a specific action fails.

a00ff2818ca9386935333a9d33525c488a6ba6ab.text: The event date changed to April 12, and the schedule now runs from 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The page lists new judges and highlights free dinner and credits.

032e10876f009524f01fb693ce9f27a9d140a27e.text: The system now tries a fixed list of backup options when the main one fails. This simplifies how it finds a working connection to answer your requests.

f381f57e68a242a353feedd5dffd444066c58afc.text: The assistant now uses a clearer guide for saving text into files. This small internal update helps it handle these tasks more consistently.

0d29aa3c0f170c037d1361797a01dbb65934830b.title: Add XML attribute warning to file edit tool prompt
0d29aa3c0f170c037d1361797a01dbb65934830b.summary: Added a warning in `backend/src/tools.ts` instructing the agent not to use XML attributes (e.g., `<path name="foo">`) as they break the tool. Removed unused `logger` import. This change affects the system prompt for the file editing tool.

c1205d24205ed2a2d46d047cc5097a7c11c3ad93.title: Fix last-line deletion when tool calls end turn
c1205d24205ed2a2d46d047cc5097a7c11c3ad93.summary: Added `end_turn` check to console newline logic in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Last line sometimes deleted when tool calls ended turn without returning results. Ensures proper spacing by emitting newline if `end_turn` is present.

336178888ea7b62b16044caa0fadcabd34911663.title: Use Google Generative AI SDK
336178888ea7b62b16044caa0fadcabd34911663.summary: Added `@google/generative-ai` and refactored `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-api.ts` to use official SDK types (`Content`, `Part`) instead of manual `ts-pattern` matching. Replaced `transformMessages` with `transformMessagesToGoogle` to map OpenAI messages to Google format, including explicit `safetySettings` configuration. Scope limited to backend Gemini integration.

d452b52b7e26006237d0091dae5d465e53deece6.title: Prioritize user key for Gemini 2.5 Pro exp
d452b52b7e26006237d0091dae5d465e53deece6.summary: Reorders fallback chain in `streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks` to attempt user's Gemini API key first for `gemini-2.5-pro-exp`, followed by OpenRouter, Vertex, and internal keys. Adds `gemini-2.5-pro-preview` constant and implements tiered cost calculation logic in `message-cost-tracker.ts`. Updates `common/src/constants.ts` to map agent max mode to the exp model ID.

1f561a4c640de3af4907585b5782985657b8fe89.title: Add runterminalcommand single-call rule to tools.ts
1f561a4c640de3af4907585b5782985657b8fe89.summary: Added instruction 10 to backend/src/tools.ts prohibiting multiple run_terminal_command calls in a single response. This enforces sequential execution, requiring the agent to wait for tool results before invoking the next command. Scope limited to backend tool definitions.

c41a74e13876be3326142e6bc1fa60515066ad27.title: Add Claude fallback notification tag
c41a74e13876be3326142e6bc1fa60515066ad27.summary: Yields `<codebuff_claude_fallback_info>` when all Gemini API attempts fail and execution falls back to Claude Sonnet. Replaces hardcoded string checks with `ONE_TIME_TAGS` constants in `common/src/constants.ts` to standardize rate-limit and fallback notifications. Updates `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` to use `GoogleGenerativeAIError` for 429 detection and `npm-app/src/client.ts` to manage one-time display state via a generic tag map.

2ade59eedf3a1ddf3d8a02d31ccb4d8d1b3b04a0.title: api-keys route auth via Bearer header
2ade59eedf3a1ddf3d8a02d31ccb4d8d1b3b04a0.summary: GET /api/api-keys now extracts auth token from Authorization header instead of JSON body. Client sends Bearer token in headers, dropping body payload. Server validates prefix and splits token, returning 401 on missing header. Covers npm-app client and web api-keys route.

2b20c41c8caf11b91e3a9db6c1e0e4497c908837.title: Move getMessagesSubset to util/messages and apply to file search
2b20c41c8caf11b91e3a9db6c1e0e4497c908837.summary: The `getMessagesSubset` function was moved from `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to `backend/src/util/messages.ts` to allow reuse in file search operations. `backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts` and `backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts` now use `getMessagesSubset` with a 100k token buffer to truncate messages before sending prompts to Gemini. This change also removes the `useGPT4oInsteadOfClaude` flag from `checkNewFilesNecessary`.

64c6a2013c52f196e42446853e569d8b46bb13ed.title: Add invalid API key handling and cost tracking for user keys
64c6a2013c52f196e42446853e569d8b46bb13ed.summary: Gemini fallback logic detects API_KEY_INVALID errors to yield user-specific warnings via new CODEBUFF_INVALID_KEY_INFO constant. Message cost tracker now accepts usesUserApiKey flag to adjust credit calculation based on key ownership. Stream processors trim chunks before tag detection to prevent whitespace issues in client display.

e6d9990b88cc6b604af5b6fe08ea1056123565e7.text: Error messages now show the most recent part of the text first. This helps you see the important details without having to read through old or less relevant information.

64c6a2013c52f196e42446853e569d8b46bb13ed.text: The system now clearly warns you if your personal access key is invalid. It also calculates usage costs more accurately when you use your own key.

0d29aa3c0f170c037d1361797a01dbb65934830b.text: The assistant received clearer instructions to avoid a specific formatting mistake when editing files. This small internal update helps prevent errors during file changes.

c1205d24205ed2a2d46d047cc5097a7c11c3ad93.text: The assistant stopped accidentally deleting the final line of its response when using certain tools. This ensures the last sentence always displays correctly.

336178888ea7b62b16044caa0fadcabd34911663.text: The system now uses an official tool to talk to the AI. This helps keep conversations safe and reliable.

1f561a4c640de3af4907585b5782985657b8fe89.text: The assistant now runs one command at a time and waits for the result before starting the next.

d452b52b7e26006237d0091dae5d465e53deece6.text: The assistant now tries your own service account before using its default connections when accessing a specific new model. This ensures your usage counts against your own plan first. A cost tracking update also adjusts how expenses for this model are calculated.

c41a74e13876be3326142e6bc1fa60515066ad27.text: If the main service fails, the assistant now uses a backup model and shows a clear notice. This makes reliability better and avoids confusing messages.

2b20c41c8caf11b91e3a9db6c1e0e4497c908837.text: The assistant now trims long message histories before analyzing files, improving efficiency. This internal update helps the system manage memory better when searching for documents.

2ade59eedf3a1ddf3d8a02d31ccb4d8d1b3b04a0.text: The app now checks your login details in the message header instead of the body. This is a small internal update that does not change how you use the product.

d16dc3de0a0bd7e716dde06b243cd3b69de81adb.title: Unescape HTML entities in terminal commands
d16dc3de0a0bd7e716dde06b243cd3b69de81adb.summary: Added `transformRunTerminalCommand` to decode `&` to `&` in `run_terminal_command` parameters. Applied in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` before client tool call construction. Ensures shell commands with ampersands execute correctly.

74352a7abbddf4ace7a80d21ad4bd373561e1761.title: Smart redirecting fix attempt
74352a7abbddf4ace7a80d21ad4bd373561e1761.summary: Updated redirect logic in `web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts` to distinguish between CLI and Web auth flows. If an `auth_code` query param is present, it redirects to `/onboard` preserving all params; otherwise, it allows relative or same-origin URLs to pass through, defaulting to `baseUrl` for external/invalid targets. Added `logger` import to track these routing decisions.

908706b65c46689f8a4a55ddf412d9cb70919521.title: Wait for ready promise before storing API key
908706b65c46689f8a4a55ddf412d9cb70919521.summary: CLI now awaits `this.readyPromise` before calling `handleAddApiKey`. Prevents race condition where API key storage attempt occurs before client initialization completes. Spinner displays during wait. Internal fix in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

9f1f23959d962776a202355db2f6f2e2ac44d241.title: Add troubleshooting info to docs
9f1f23959d962776a202355db2f6f2e2ac44d241.summary: The `getting-started.mdx` file now includes structured troubleshooting steps for installation issues. It adds a requirement for Node version 18+ with a version check command, alongside existing permission and reinstall advice. This change affects the web documentation surface only. The update uses HTML list elements with Tailwind classes for styling.

d6c53eb3197e539f7d3a7ea8537b6380803f7c60.title: Replace getServerSession with db query in api-keys route
d6c53eb3197e539f7d3a7ea8537b6380803f7c60.summary: The `api-keys` route handlers now accept `authToken` in the request body and resolve the user via a direct `db.query.session` lookup, removing the dependency on `next-auth`'s `getServerSession`. The `npm-app` client was updated to include `authToken` in GET and POST payloads and to await `fetchStoredApiKeyTypes` to ensure correct sequencing. This change affects `web/src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

929fa1954a73f3cce70c64cb8dd08e463c2d5472.title: Add session logging to api-keys GET handler
929fa1954a73f3cce70c64cb8dd08e463c2d5472.summary: Added console.log({ session }) to the GET handler in web/src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts. Import order cleaned up, moving common/db and constants before crypto/schema imports. Prettier formatting applied to logger.info call.

2a0b3726e7ff6a8aa45a857d1a6cf1ddfe78d7aa.title: Undo smart redirect logic in NextAuth
2a0b3726e7ff6a8aa45a857d1a6cf1ddfe78d7aa.summary: Reverted complex redirect handling in `web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts` to a simpler query-param-based redirect to `/onboard`. Removed `logger` dependency and associated logging statements. Simplified `web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-button.tsx` by removing client-side `callbackUrl` construction and `usePathname`/`useSearchParams` hooks, relying on default `signIn` behavior.

5ef9c11bf56fb8dc330e5c756ac65e587e219a8c.title: Fix sign-in redirect logic for authcode
5ef9c11bf56fb8dc330e5c756ac65e587e219a8c.summary: Updated `SignInButton` to calculate `callbackUrl` dynamically based on `pathname` and `searchParams`. If the user is on `/login` with an `auth_code`, the redirect target becomes `/onboard` preserving query params; otherwise it defaults to `/`. This ensures proper routing after OAuth completion. The change affects `web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-button.tsx`.

fde2dbec23446274503a18292ca9b8e43f4d0afa.title: Add encrypted API key storage and Gemini client support
fde2dbec23446274503a18292ca9b8e43f4d0afa.summary: New `common/src/api-keys` module introduces AES-256-GCM encryption for Anthropic, Gemini, and OpenAI keys, with `retrieveAndDecryptApiKey` exported for backend use. `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-api.ts` now accepts an optional `apiKey` parameter, instantiating per-key OpenAI clients while retaining a shared instance for the internal `GEMINI_API_KEY`. `main-prompt.ts` switches to `streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks` and filters `<codebuff_rate_limit_info>` and `<codebuff_no_user_key_info>` tags from the final response string. A new `web/src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts` endpoint exposes key management to the frontend.

21a9235fb756a9868f482c6b3dc98bf653ba5332.title: CLI API key detection via regex
21a9235fb756a9868f482c6b3dc98bf653ba5332.summary: Refactored CLI input handling to detect API keys using regex patterns in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Replaced simple prefix/length checks with `detectApiKey` method returning typed results (`found`, `prefix_only`, `not_found`). Handles valid keys via `handleApiKeyInput` and warns on prefix matches with incorrect length/format. Internal refactor for improved key detection logic.

9f1f23959d962776a202355db2f6f2e2ac44d241.text: The help pages now include clear steps for fixing setup problems. If you have trouble installing the software, the guide tells you how to check your system requirements and try again.

908706b65c46689f8a4a55ddf412d9cb70919521.text: The app now waits for the connection to be ready before saving your key. This small internal fix prevents errors when you add a new key.

d16dc3de0a0bd7e716dde06b243cd3b69de81adb.text: The assistant now correctly reads commands containing the '&' symbol, allowing it to run certain background tasks or combine instructions without errors.

929fa1954a73f3cce70c64cb8dd08e463c2d5472.text: The system now records internal login details during key checks. This change is small and invisible to users.

21a9235fb756a9868f482c6b3dc98bf653ba5332.text: The tool now checks access codes more carefully. It tells you if a code looks wrong before you try to use it.

d6c53eb3197e539f7d3a7ea8537b6380803f7c60.text: A background security check was updated to use a different method for verifying user identity. This internal change ensures the system continues to work correctly without altering how you use the product.

5ef9c11bf56fb8dc330e5c756ac65e587e219a8c.text: Fixed sign-in routing. Users now go to the right page after logging in.

74352a7abbddf4ace7a80d21ad4bd373561e1761.text: The system now better understands where to send you after logging in. This helps prevent errors when switching between different login methods.

2a0b3726e7ff6a8aa45a857d1a6cf1ddfe78d7aa.text: The sign-in process was simplified to fix how users are redirected after logging in. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

fde2dbec23446274503a18292ca9b8e43f4d0afa.text: Your private access codes for the assistant are now stored in a secure, locked vault. The assistant can also use a new model and automatically switches to a backup if the main one is busy or unavailable.

0e378ecb4fff72500e96ebbc69ea4214247031cb.title: Remove unused startDate from quota check result
0e378ecb4fff72500e96ebbc69ea4214247031cb.summary: Dropped startDate from CheckQuotaResult type and AnonymousQuotaManager/AuthenticatedQuotaManager return objects in common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts. Field was unused and removed to clean up quota response shape. Internal change only.

b9ca62bd9bc1906a4339801efa2fff35726383cb.title: Fix nested gitignore pattern resolution
b9ca62bd9bc1906a4339801efa2fff35726383cb.summary: parseGitignore now accepts projectRoot to correctly resolve relative ignore patterns. Logic updated to trim lines, handle negations, and prefix rooted patterns with the relative directory path. This ensures nested ignore files apply rules relative to their location rather than treating them as absolute or global. Affects common/src/project-file-tree.ts and npm-app/src/project-files.ts.

aeca6290626a96dea7060dcddef7e3461aa5262f.title: Add Hackathon April 2025 page
aeca6290626a96dea7060dcddef7e3461aa5262f.summary: New web route at /hackathon-april-2025 renders event details and prize tiers for Codebuff Hackathon @ Mox. Uses Next.js App Router page.tsx with client-side components. Scope limited to web/src/app/hackathon-april-2025/page.tsx. Page includes hardcoded metadata for date, location, and prizes.

ae194dc9bbd65478c8aed2c99ffbb238a6cbee6a.title: Web UI refresh: neo-brutalist buttons, green theme, favicon fix
ae194dc9bbd65478c8aed2c99ffbb238a6cbee6a.summary: Website UI updated to neo-brutalist style. Pricing and navbar buttons now use `DecorativeBlocks` with `framer-motion` hover effects and white/black contrast instead of blue/purple gradients. Referral and pricing cards switched to green/emerald gradient palettes. Favicon path corrected to `favicon-32x32.ico` in `layout.tsx`. Hero text capitalized in `page.tsx`.

e556eff04f4d707cf39f024447cb713a7bdadfae.title: checkQuota reads Stripe period for active subs
e556eff04f4d707cf39f024447cb713a7bdadfae.summary: AuthenticatedQuotaManager.checkQuota now fetches current_period_start/end from Stripe via getCurrentSubscription when subscription_active and stripe_customer_id are set, replacing the static next_quota_reset - 1 month calculation. Falls back to next_quota_reset with console.warn if Stripe reports non-active status. Covers common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts, common/src/util/stripe.ts, and web/src/lib/stripe-utils.ts. getCurrentSubscription moved to common/src/util/stripe.ts; web/src/app/api/stripe/subscription/route.ts imports from common instead of stripe-utils.

6c04ddd7f853b6b4f0b34655d3c132e2ccef7bcb.title: CLI shows usage limit warnings
6c04ddd7f853b6b4f0b34655d3c132e2ccef7bcb.summary: npm-app/src/client.ts calls showUsageWarning() on every usage response. Removed referralLink from common/src/actions.ts UsageReponseSchema. Added returnControlToUser() in backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts and client.ts. Ensures CLI displays limit warnings immediately.

ceb58b10a8882ac97daad91a16c76253b2104648.title: encryptedapikeys table and AES-256-GCM crypto utilities
ceb58b10a8882ac97daad91a16c76253b2104648.summary: Added `encrypted_api_keys` table to the database schema to store user API keys securely. Introduced `common/src/api-keys/crypto.ts` providing AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption functions requiring a 32-byte `API_KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET`. The schema defines an `api_key_type` enum (`anthropic`, `gemini`, `openai`) with a composite primary key on `user_id` and `type`. Migration `0012_fluffy_naoko` applies the new table and foreign key constraint to the `user` table.

6e951a730e2a7acc6c8a2329f23727451c411e80.title: Remove 🃏 emoji from CLI greeting
6e951a730e2a7acc6c8a2329f23727451c411e80.summary: Stripped the 🃏 emoji from the welcome message in `npm-app/src/menu.ts`. The greeting now ends with 'What would you like to do?' without the trailing icon. Scope limited to the CLI `displayGreeting` function.

59567a4df76501aeb4f2605211f209875554ce97.title: Affiliates page, handle column, referral limit 500
59567a4df76501aeb4f2605211f209875554ce97.summary: New /affiliates page lets users set unique handles via web/src/app/affiliates/actions.ts, raising referral_limit to 500 (AFFILIATE_USER_REFFERAL_LIMIT). DB migration 0013 adds user.handle text column with UNIQUE constraint. CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS drops 500 to 250 in common/src/constants.ts. /{sponsee} route now queries db by handle instead of static sponseeConfig map.

b9ca62bd9bc1906a4339801efa2fff35726383cb.text: The app now correctly reads folder-specific ignore rules. Files inside nested folders are hidden or shown as intended.

e556eff04f4d707cf39f024447cb713a7bdadfae.text: The system now checks the actual billing cycle from the payment provider to determine when your usage limits reset, rather than using a fixed estimate. This ensures your reset date matches your real subscription period.

aeca6290626a96dea7060dcddef7e3461aa5262f.text: A new page shows event details and prizes for the April 2025 hackathon.

c7f818857794f59f69a714a1c2c0afaa3b28d4f7.text: The assistant can now use a new AI model and lets you pick which one to use.

ceb58b10a8882ac97daad91a16c76253b2104648.text: Your saved keys are now locked with strong security. This protects them from being read by others.

ae194dc9bbd65478c8aed2c99ffbb238a6cbee6a.text: The website's buttons and cards look different, using a bold green and black style instead of blue gradients. The small icon in the browser tab now displays correctly.

0e378ecb4fff72500e96ebbc69ea4214247031cb.text: The system stopped sending an unused date in a background check for usage limits. This is a small internal cleanup. You will not notice any changes.

6c04ddd7f853b6b4f0b34655d3c132e2ccef7bcb.text: The command-line tool now shows usage limit warnings right away.

6e951a730e2a7acc6c8a2329f23727451c411e80.text: The welcome message no longer shows a playing card icon. This small change makes the greeting text cleaner.

1a72b48e2b0ff4b6fd2e9ebe1e1074258139a3a9.title: Joker emoji added to CLI greeting
1a72b48e2b0ff4b6fd2e9ebe1e1074258139a3a9.summary: Appends a 🃏 emoji to the `displayGreeting` output string in `npm-app/src/menu.ts`. This is a cosmetic update to the CLI welcome message.

c32f38e54c6fb7b66ff820ab5f49dc055a2da1c9.title: Type fixes in main-prompt test
c32f38e54c6fb7b66ff820ab5f49dc055a2da1c9.summary: Updated `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts` to satisfy TypeScript strict checks. Added explicit `as any` casts for `content` array access and reformatted long variable assignments to prevent linting errors. Scope limited to backend test suite.

7c6a3873c1eacd433d116334df6071b06b4a7d63.title: Refactor LRU cache to native Map
7c6a3873c1eacd433d116334df6071b06b4a7d63.summary: LRUCache in common/src/util/lru-cache.ts now relies on native Map insertion order instead of a custom MinHeap for eviction tracking. The get method deletes and re-sets keys to mark them as recently used, while set evicts the first key from the Map's iterator when capacity is exceeded. This removes dependency on common/src/util/min-heap.ts for cache logic, though the heap class remains in the codebase with minor variable renaming. Constructor validation throws an error if maxSize is not positive.

2af716acdbb25762ae53b86c5352ec5e04848fe2.title: Fix null character stripping in message cost tracker
2af716acdbb25762ae53b86c5352ec5e04848fe2.summary: Refactored `saveMessage` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` to use a new recursive utility `stripNullCharsFromObject` from `backend/src/util/object.ts`. Previously, null characters were stripped from the `request` field by serializing and deserializing the entire object via JSON, which could fail or be inefficient. The new utility traverses objects and arrays, applying `stripNullChars` directly to string values. This ensures robust cleaning of request and response payloads before database insertion without relying on JSON round-trips.

1b900b1bf625bc3267901f2e95644b10ed3a469a.title: terminal tool prompt fixes ampersand escaping
1b900b1bf625bc3267901f2e95644b10ed3a469a.summary: Added rule 9 to `backend/src/tools.ts` instructing the model to write raw `&` instead of `&`. Clarified that `cd` does not persist between commands in the notes section. Internal prompt adjustment only.

360e748770224a069eb6622b9bf8e907e5862582.title: Fix main-prompt test assertions
360e748770224a069eb6622b9bf8e907e5862582.summary: Rewrote `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts` to strictly verify message history order. Replaced loose `find` checks with explicit index assertions for tool results, instructions, prompt, and assistant messages. Updated prompt content validation to expect array structures with text blocks.

85d3d6ddf10ac1cd963b30839b1bee382c6d4fd9.title: Add pagination and fix overage stats in analyze-overages script
85d3d6ddf10ac1cd963b30839b1bee382c6d4fd9.summary: Updated `scripts/analyze-overages.ts` to fetch active subscriptions using pagination instead of a single limit-100 call. Fixed subscription null check and corrected overage statistics calculations to filter for actual overages, use proper cents-to-dollars conversion, and distinguish between established customers and those with overages.

1b0767f9b5193fe1c26fc42e2e1ed981a863ab50.title: Enforce unique fingerprints and update auth logic
1b0767f9b5193fe1c26fc42e2e1ed981a863ab50.summary: CLI fingerprints now append 8 random bytes to ensure uniqueness across identical hardware, preventing session collisions. Auth flow updates include removing fingerprint auto-insertion from `/api/auth/cli/code`, adding `expiresAt` to response payloads, and resetting `sig_hash` on logout. Backend WebSocket logging context drops `authToken` to reduce sensitive data exposure. Changes span `npm-app/src/fingerprint.ts`, `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/*`, and `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`.

f22b4d03a0a972455c39ad9e224a836ac651dc3e.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro added to max cost mode
f22b4d03a0a972455c39ad9e224a836ac651dc3e.summary: Backend routes 'max' cost mode requests to new streamGemini25Pro function, replacing Claude default. Implements fallback chain: OpenRouter stream -> Gemini API stream -> Vertex AI stream. Updates main-prompt.ts to conditionally select model based on costMode. Adds debug-subset.log to .gitignore and renames OpenRouter stream functions for clarity.

a205282c954f2ca2ae047908e299d9e1c825aee0.title: Clarify tool call XML formatting in backend prompt
a205282c954f2ca2ae047908e299d9e1c825aee0.summary: Refined system prompt instructions in `backend/src/tools.ts` to explicitly forbid wrapping raw tool call XML in markdown code blocks. Added concrete negative and positive examples to prevent parsing errors caused by ```xml fences. This internal change targets prompt adherence to ensure correct tool execution.

1a72b48e2b0ff4b6fd2e9ebe1e1074258139a3a9.text: The welcome message now includes a joker emoji. This is a small visual change that does not affect how the product works.

a205282c954f2ca2ae047908e299d9e1c825aee0.text: The assistant now receives clearer instructions on how to format its internal requests to other tools. This prevents errors that could stop it from completing tasks.

2af716acdbb25762ae53b86c5352ec5e04848fe2.text: The system now cleans up messages more reliably before saving them. This small internal fix helps prevent errors when recording usage.

c32f38e54c6fb7b66ff820ab5f49dc055a2da1c9.text: A small internal update fixed hidden errors in the system's self-checking tools. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

85d3d6ddf10ac1cd963b30839b1bee382c6d4fd9.text: A small internal fix corrected errors in overage reports. This means the numbers shown for extra charges are now accurate.

1b900b1bf625bc3267901f2e95644b10ed3a469a.text: The assistant now handles web addresses with ampersands correctly. You can type them normally, and they will work as expected.

7c6a3873c1eacd433d116334df6071b06b4a7d63.text: The app's memory management was simplified internally to improve reliability. This change is small and has no visible effect for users.

f22b4d03a0a972455c39ad9e224a836ac651dc3e.text: The assistant's high-performance mode now uses a different underlying engine. This change is internal and does not alter the product's visible features.

1b0767f9b5193fe1c26fc42e2e1ed981a863ab50.text: The system now creates a unique ID for each device to prevent login mix-ups. This small internal update also removes sensitive data from logs and clears old login details when you sign out.

360e748770224a069eb6622b9bf8e907e5862582.text: The system now checks conversation history more strictly to ensure messages appear in the correct order. This internal fix improves reliability but does not change how you use the product.

ea0ebdfd45a2e313e1346a6b957dd6709681fe94.title: Add type assertions to messages test suite
ea0ebdfd45a2e313e1346a6b957dd6709681fe94.summary: Added explicit `as any` type assertions to content array accesses in `backend/src/util/__tests__/messages.test.ts`. This resolves TypeScript strict-mode typing errors when accessing `.text` properties on union-typed message content blocks. The change is limited to test files and does not affect runtime behavior or production code.

184039842a6b2fdfd491ad3f32d67424f19b9c36.title: Remove noisy websocket logging in deadConnectionCleaner
184039842a6b2fdfd491ad3f32d67424f19b9c36.summary: Removed `logger.info` and `logger.error` calls in `backend/src/websockets/server.ts` within the `deadConnectionCleaner` function. This eliminates redundant log entries for inactive connection terminations and individual connection check errors, reducing noise in the backend logs. The change is internal, affecting only the websocket server's logging behavior.

7194441fa69e3c64b590e664fc0b913c6b3dbbab.title: Change VS Code ESLint fixAll to always
7194441fa69e3c64b590e664fc0b913c6b3dbbab.summary: Updated .vscode/settings.json to set editor.codeActionsOnSave.source.fixAll.eslint to "always". Replaces boolean true with explicit string value. Scope limited to local development environment configuration.

f6f380735fd0aeab7a8a51079c3187d36fbcec08.title: Add ESLint import ordering and VS Code settings
f6f380735fd0aeab7a8a51079c3187d36fbcec08.summary: Introduced .eslintrc.json with plugin:import/recommended and import/order rule enforcing grouped, alphabetized imports.
