Added .vscode/settings.json enabling formatOnSave and source.fixAll.eslint code action. Scope limited to repo configuration files. Uses @typescript-eslint/parser and typescript resolver.

b89142e4054b2ef112559c95d8245acd2097b72d.title: Logger context adds logTrace field with user info
b89142e4054b2ef112559c95d8245acd2097b72d.summary: Logger mixin now wraps AsyncLocalStorage context in a `logTrace` field instead of spreading it directly. Middleware resolves `UserInfo` via `getUserInfoFromAuthToken` and injects `userId`, `userEmail`, `discordId`, and `clientSessionId` into the logger context. Affects `backend/src/util/logger.ts`, `backend/src/websockets/auth.ts`, and `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts`. Removed `silent` flag from middleware halt logging.

0eb3abf36efb50b013298c896cde7f23805ad854.title: Fix import paths in main-prompt.ts
0eb3abf36efb50b013298c896cde7f23805ad854.summary: Corrects import statements in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Functions `simplifyReadFileResults` and `simplifyReadFileToolResult` are now imported from `./util/simplify-tool-results` instead of `./util/parse-tool-call-xml`. This aligns imports with actual module structure.

a3c2420addf103825f58187ff477c7aaf415b899.title: yes command blacklist updated to multi-word check
a3c2420addf103825f58187ff477c7aaf415b899.summary: Refactored `isBlacklistedTerminalCommand` in `backend/src/check-terminal-command.ts` to distinguish single-word from multi-word commands. `yes` moved from `blacklistedSingleWordCommands` to `blacklistedMultiWordCommands`. Logic now checks the first word for multi-word entries. Prevents false positives for commands like `yesterday` while blocking `yes`.

6baeeab1a6450bcd49bfb45b5356164a89a1442c.title: trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit adds terminal output simplification
6baeeab1a6450bcd49bfb45b5356164a89a1442c.summary: trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit now simplifies terminal command outputs via simplifyTerminalCommandResults, keeping only the 5 most recent full outputs. Trimming targets 50% of MAX_MESSAGE_TOKENS to reserve space for new messages, replacing the previous full-limit fill. Updates backend/src/util/messages.ts and corresponding tests.

7c1d32a9f89af5d53a27952e563ff9296e54205d.title: Rename simplifyTerminalCommandResult to
7c1d32a9f89af5d53a27952e563ff9296e54205d.summary: Function `simplifyTerminalCommandResult` renamed to `simplifyTerminalCommandToolResult` in `backend/src/util/simplify-tool-results.ts`. Call sites updated in `simplifyTerminalCommandResults`. Scope limited to backend utility module.

24fade14d192a9fec4519c32dc97be7a73228e4b.title: Fix newline on paste in CLI
24fade14d192a9fec4519c32dc97be7a73228e4b.summary: Prevents readline from triggering execution when pasting previous commands in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Replaces direct rl.write with cursor movement hack and internal line refresh.

ea0ebdfd45a2e313e1346a6b957dd6709681fe94.text: A small internal fix was made to the software's testing system. This does not change how the product works or looks for you.

6baeeab1a6450bcd49bfb45b5356164a89a1442c.text: The assistant now keeps only the five most recent results from complex tasks, saving space for new messages. This small internal update helps the assistant handle longer conversations more efficiently without losing recent context.

b89142e4054b2ef112559c95d8245acd2097b72d.text: The system now automatically attaches user details to internal records for better tracking. This small background change does not affect how you use the product.

184039842a6b2fdfd491ad3f32d67424f19b9c36.text: The system stopped recording routine messages about inactive connections. This keeps the internal logs cleaner without changing how the product works for you.

7194441fa69e3c64b590e664fc0b913c6b3dbbab.text: The code editor now automatically fixes small mistakes in the text every time you save your work, instead of just checking for them.

f6f380735fd0aeab7a8a51079c3187d36fbcec08.text: The team updated internal tools to automatically organize and check code style when developers save their work. This change is small and only affects how the team writes code, so users will not see any difference in the product.

7c1d32a9f89af5d53a27952e563ff9296e54205d.text: The team improved internal labels for how the assistant handles terminal commands. This change helps keep the system organized but does not affect how you use the product.

24fade14d192a9fec4519c32dc97be7a73228e4b.text: A small internal fix stops the tool from running commands too early when you paste text into it.

a3c2420addf103825f58187ff477c7aaf415b899.text: The system now checks entire command phrases, not just the first word. This stops it from blocking safe words that start with 'yes' while still stopping the risky 'yes' command.

0eb3abf36efb50b013298c896cde7f23805ad854.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system finds specific tools for processing file data. This improves stability and ensures features work as expected, with no visible changes to the user interface.

dfb5716bf6a147f31157182f6aa2eb1d0ed4cafb.title: parseToolCallXml returns strings only
dfb5716bf6a147f31157182f6aa2eb1d0ed4cafb.summary: parseToolCallXml in backend/src/util/parse-tool-call-xml.ts now returns Record<string, string>, removing type coercion for booleans, numbers, and nested range tags. All XML values are assigned as raw strings after whitespace trimming. Scope limited to backend utility; no CLI or Web surface changes indicated. This simplifies parsing logic by delegating type interpretation to consumers.

896aa1b61626f7b18c1b7bab5e4b0991bb9b4dad.title: Upgrade ignore to 7.0.3 and remove slash prefix stripping
896aa1b61626f7b18c1b7bab5e4b0991bb9b4dad.summary: Upgraded the ignore package from 5.3.2 to 7.0.3 in npm-app/package.json. Removed manual stripping of leading slashes from gitignore, codebuffignore, and manicodeignore lines in common/src/project-file-tree.ts, as v7 handles absolute path patterns natively.

9077874c7bd33bc48035090e458182045b3d7337.title: Refactor checkpoint error handling and imports
9077874c7bd33bc48035090e458182045b3d7337.summary: CheckpointManager.disabledReason now stores a string instead of a CheckpointsDisabledError instance, requiring explicit error construction on throw. CLI and client.ts updated to read the string directly, and getLatestCheckpoint wrapped in try/catch to handle disabled states gracefully. Import statements across checkpoint-manager.ts, cli.ts, and client.ts reordered for consistency.

d0edf14d10e19dfefb1e8f8e2cba605493cfb806.title: Fix filepath check in getFileReadingUpdates
d0edf14d10e19dfefb1e8f8e2cba605493cfb806.summary: Corrects partition logic in `getFileReadingUpdates` to check `loadedFiles[path] !== null` instead of verifying `loadedFiles.content`. Previous condition incorrectly validated a non-existent `content` property on the `loadedFiles` object rather than the file-specific entry. Scope limited to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Ensures accurate detection of existing vs. non-existing file paths.

ae65f86e78660e76628f4b441e046fbababcc189.title: Fix file creation by handling optional file reads
ae65f86e78660e76628f4b441e046fbababcc189.summary: Added `requestOptionalFile` and `toOptionalFile` to safely handle file reads that may return null or error statuses, replacing direct `requestFile` usage in `main-prompt.ts`. Updated `project-files.ts` with `getFilesOrNull` to filter out hidden file read statuses before processing changes. Fixed a variable scope error in `changes.ts` where `path` was incorrectly used instead of `filePath` in error logging.

7922b9b45c3d6dbc0efcc5509353392ccdb16cd7.title: readfiles reports specific status for missing, ignored, or oversized
7922b9b45c3d6dbc0efcc5509353392ccdb16cd7.summary: The `read_files` tool now returns explicit status strings like `[FILE_DOES_NOT_EXIST]` or `[FILE_IGNORED_BY_GITIGNORE_OR_CODEBUFF_IGNORE]` instead of generic nulls. This provides the LLM with precise context on why a file couldn't be read, improving agent reasoning. Changes span `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` for detection and `common/src/constants.ts` for status definitions. `FILE_TOO_LARGE` now includes the actual file size in MB.

c82696f7121ad9cf25d1a60564d5937bb886bf42.title: Mock logger in main-prompt tests
c82696f7121ad9cf25d1a60564d5937bb886bf42.summary: Added mocks for `logger.debug`, `logger.error`, `logger.info`, and `logger.warn` in `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts`. Suppresses log output during `mainPrompt` test execution. Internal change affecting test suite only.

bb46f041631b662febe4be3ae09c93e151e15649.title: Switch Relace AI fallback from Gemini Flash to o3-mini
bb46f041631b662febe4be3ae09c93e151e15649.summary: Relace API fallback logic in backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts now invokes promptOpenAI with models.o3mini instead of promptGeminiWithFallbacks with geminiModels.gemini2flash. The prompt instruction changed to allow markdown output, with results processed via parseMarkdownCodeBlock to extract code. This replaces the previous direct text return mechanism.

be93e9c7a9ad166a3f966d7670e62899912a0d7c.title: Refactor simplify-tool-results, add terminal command simplifier
be93e9c7a9ad166a3f966d7670e62899912a0d7c.summary: Extracted generic `simplifyToolResults` helper into new `backend/src/util/simplify-tool-results.ts`. Added `simplifyTerminalCommandResults` for `run_terminal_command` outputs. Moved `simplifyReadFileResults` out of `parse-tool-call-xml.ts`. Removes `read_files` specific logic from XML parser.

957f50c280ba823d04fad59c08122a6b8acfc61c.title: Force assistant endturn after 20 consecutive messages
957f50c280ba823d04fad59c08122a6b8acfc61c.summary: Added a hard limit of 20 consecutive assistant messages in `mainPrompt` to force `end_turn` and return a warning string, preventing infinite loops. Introduced `lastUserPromptIndex` to `AgentState` to track the last user prompt position for accurate message counting. This change applies to the backend agent loop and shared state types.

dfb5716bf6a147f31157182f6aa2eb1d0ed4cafb.text: The system now reads instructions exactly as written without guessing their meaning. This small internal update makes the software more predictable.

9077874c7bd33bc48035090e458182045b3d7337.text: This is a small internal cleanup. It makes the system handle errors more consistently behind the scenes.

ae65f86e78660e76628f4b441e046fbababcc189.text: The app now handles missing or hidden files more safely. This prevents crashes when creating new files.

7922b9b45c3d6dbc0efcc5509353392ccdb16cd7.text: The assistant now tells you exactly why it cannot read a file, such as whether the file is missing, ignored, or too large. This helps it understand the situation better and give you more accurate answers.

896aa1b61626f7b18c1b7bab5e4b0991bb9b4dad.text: The app now handles file hiding rules more accurately. This means it won't accidentally show or hide the wrong files when you ignore certain folders.

c82696f7121ad9cf25d1a60564d5937bb886bf42.text: Test runs now hide background messages. This is a small internal change. You will not see any difference.

be93e9c7a9ad166a3f966d7670e62899912a0d7c.text: The assistant's internal logic for handling command outputs was reorganized to be cleaner and more modular. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

957f50c280ba823d04fad59c08122a6b8acfc61c.text: The assistant now stops if it tries to reply too many times without a new message from you. This prevents endless loops and keeps the chat responsive.

bb46f041631b662febe4be3ae09c93e151e15649.text: The system now uses a different AI assistant when the main one fails. This change helps it provide clearer answers and code examples.

d0edf14d10e19dfefb1e8f8e2cba605493cfb806.text: The system now correctly identifies whether a file is already loaded. This prevents it from trying to read files that do not exist. This is a small internal fix with no visible changes to users.

f39b1d6f04fd27f94f95f0c4181ce2fc523a05c4.title: Replace mock.module with spyOn in main-prompt tests
f39b1d6f04fd27f94f95f0c4181ce2fc523a05c4.summary: Refactored `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts` to use `spyOn` and `mock.restore` instead of manual `mock.module` swapping and restoration. This simplifies mock lifecycle management by automatically restoring original implementations after each test. The change is internal to the test suite and does not affect production code or user-facing behavior.

6e97eb90e4b3b9fa9368efc51ef7c77af6143f26.title: Restore mocked modules in main-prompt tests
6e97eb90e4b3b9fa9368efc51ef7c77af6143f26.summary: Refactored `mainPrompt` tests to restore original modules after each test. Moved mocks inside `describe` block with `beforeEach` and `afterEach` hooks. Prevents mock leakage between tests.

a72b42b796dcbe23dc6c2cf30d8170716df14769.title: Fix readfiles tool call logging and return values
a72b42b796dcbe23dc6c2cf30d8170716df14769.summary: Updated `getFileReadingUpdates` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to correctly return `addedFiles` instead of `newFiles`. Enhanced debug logging for `read_files` tool calls to include `addedFilesPaths`, `nonExistingPaths`, and `updatedFilePaths`. This resolves internal state tracking issues for file reading operations.

33b2e10c844c7e25e234ffee3c380cc67fade0ad.title: Remove filesAlreadyRead from readfiles result
33b2e10c844c7e25e234ffee3c380cc67fade0ad.summary: Dropped filesAlreadyRead computation and rendering in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. read_files result no longer lists files already read in the conversation. Internal cleanup of unused logic.

9fdad5633eb69054c86960f49e32cb82d9631af1.title: Add Troubleshooting Install to Docs
9fdad5633eb69054c86960f49e32cb82d9631af1.summary: Added Troubleshooting section to `web/src/content/help/getting-started.mdx`. Documents `sudo npm install -g codebuff` for Mac/Linux and admin prompt for Windows on permission errors. Recommends reinstalling Node if failure persists.

2876575615ed9aa91c8df4bfdcdc5b9ce9633d04.title: Rename createFileBlock to createWriteFileBlock
2876575615ed9aa91c8df4bfdcdc5b9ce9633d04.summary: Renamed `createFileBlock` to `createWriteFileBlock` in `common/src/util/file.ts`. Updated import and usage in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. Added unit test for main-prompt.

c7591186338e34ae81780518f88d0f6abd057496.title: Revert tool result simplification and endturn logic
c7591186338e34ae81780518f88d0f6abd057496.summary: Reverts previous changes to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/util/parse-tool-call-xml.ts`. Removes `simplifyReadFileToolResult` export and restores inline simplification logic. Reinstates specific `end_turn` instruction handling for terminal commands.

f33f7ec279296b67b59b9f69f02db55a99716de9.title: Remove user-input client action schema, add writefile debug log
f33f7ec279296b67b59b9f69f02db55a99716de9.summary: Removed 'user-input' type from CLIENT_ACTION_SCHEMA in common/src/actions.ts. Added debug logging for write_file operations in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Scope covers shared action definitions and backend prompt processing.

d7303e3a320dfe599bb499741c829f30c2eb2801.title: Relax attribute parsing and export for tests
d7303e3a320dfe599bb499741c829f30c2eb2801.summary: process-stream.ts updates parseAttributes regex to allow whitespace around equals signs. Function exported to enable direct unit testing. Tests moved to backend/src/__tests__.

33b2e10c844c7e25e234ffee3c380cc67fade0ad.text: The assistant no longer lists files it has already read. This is a small internal cleanup.

59567a4df76501aeb4f2605211f209875554ce97.text: A new page lets users set their own unique profile names. Referral bonuses now offer half the previous reward, while the total number of referrals allowed per user has increased.

a72b42b796dcbe23dc6c2cf30d8170716df14769.text: Fixed a small internal error in how the assistant tracks files it reads. This improves reliability without changing visible features.

2876575615ed9aa91c8df4bfdcdc5b9ce9633d04.text: The team updated an internal label for a file-saving feature to make its purpose clearer. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

f39b1d6f04fd27f94f95f0c4181ce2fc523a05c4.text: The team simplified how they test a core part of the assistant's logic. This internal change improves testing reliability but does not affect how the product works for users.

d7303e3a320dfe599bb499741c829f30c2eb2801.text: This is a small internal update that helps the system read certain settings more flexibly. Regular users will not notice any difference.

9fdad5633eb69054c86960f49e32cb82d9631af1.text: The help guide now explains how to fix common setup problems on your computer. This small update helps you find the right steps if the program won't start.

c7591186338e34ae81780518f88d0f6abd057496.text: The assistant's internal rules for handling certain tasks were adjusted back to a previous, more reliable setting. This small internal change helps ensure the assistant responds correctly when completing specific actions.

f33f7ec279296b67b59b9f69f02db55a99716de9.text: The assistant stopped accepting a specific type of user command, and added internal notes when saving files. This is a small technical cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

6e97eb90e4b3b9fa9368efc51ef7c77af6143f26.text: A small internal fix ensures that test settings do not accidentally affect each other. This improves reliability for developers, but you will not notice any change in how the product works.

329031e75f4e2133392a91230287585461952b70.title: Log discord username on role add
329031e75f4e2133392a91230287585461952b70.summary: Added discordUsername to logger.info payload in web/src/discord/client.ts. This aids debugging by capturing the username alongside userId and discordId when adding verified role. Scope limited to Discord bot client logging.

060a630a5c78235f73f227ec9bcc0133c5aaa47f.title: Reword knowledge files system prompt
060a630a5c78235f73f227ec9bcc0133c5aaa47f.summary: Updated `knowledgeFilesPrompt` in `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`. Clarified file creation context, consolidated update triggers, and tightened inclusion/exclusion lists. Scope limited to backend system prompt logic.

e95547801c583a4233d60240f0c797a57fd66888.title: Add VERIFIEDROLEID constant
e95547801c583a4233d60240f0c797a57fd66888.summary: Added `VERIFIED_ROLE_ID` constant to Discord interaction route. Updated trailing commas in response flags. Scope limited to `web/src/app/api/discord/interactions/route.ts`. Role assignment logic not yet implemented in diff.

840c30c49390890c07d6a53877dbafd098158b23.title: VERIFIEDROLEID in Discord interactions route changed to string
840c30c49390890c07d6a53877dbafd098158b23.summary: VERIFIED_ROLE_ID in `web/src/app/api/discord/interactions/route.ts` changed from number to string literal. Discord snowflake IDs exceed JS Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, risking precision loss in numeric representation. Affects Discord interaction request verification logic.

32458bca8729c98d3585808918afd113f106a47d.title: Fix agent loop bug and simplify tool result handling
32458bca8729c98d3585808918afd113f106a47d.summary: Corrected strange loop bug by adding explicit end_turn instructions for terminal commands and refactoring tool result placement to avoid redundant read_file calls. Extracted simplifyReadFileToolResult helper in parse-tool-call-xml.ts to standardize file path rendering in tool results. Updated main-prompt.ts to conditionally inject tool instructions and streamline message history construction. Changes confined to backend prompt logic and XML parsing utilities.

05bc43e718f37af5141e80fb8bb56d7f22def5ed.title: PostHog user identification via session email
05bc43e718f37af5141e80fb8bb56d7f22def5ed.summary: Added useEffect in web/src/lib/PostHogProvider.tsx to call posthog.identify and posthog.alias when a NextAuth session is active. Uses session.user.email as the primary distinct_id while storing session.user.id as a property and creating an alias between them. Updates web/knowledge.md to document this identification strategy for consistent cross-system tracking.

083ba34e1b8127271cab8501c442e98772ee098e.title: Switch Discord integration to Gateway API
083ba34e1b8127271cab8501c442e98772ee098e.summary: Discord bot logic migrated from Interactions API to Gateway API using discord.js. New `web/scripts/discord/index.ts` starts the client, while `register-commands.ts` handles slash command registration via REST. Removed dependency on `discord-interactions` and deleted the Next.js API route `web/src/app/api/discord/interactions/route.ts`. Rate limiter moved to `web/src/discord/rate-limiter.ts`.

34726d285b632fcf26051267f34879732cfcf109.title: Discord interactions use flags 64
34726d285b632fcf26051267f34879732cfcf109.summary: Replaced `ephemeral: true` with `flags: 64` in `web/src/app/api/discord/interactions/route.ts`. Aligns with Discord API standard for ephemeral messages. Updated `authentication.knowledge.md` to document storing Discord IDs over usernames.

825f3c07c5f942cb1395d6c02a0be27e04ed8ccb.title: Discord bot auto-replies to new members in welcome channel
825f3c07c5f942cb1395d6c02a0be27e04ed8ccb.summary: Discord bot now listens for `MessageCreate` events in the welcome channel (`1272621334580429053`) to automatically reply to system `GuildMemberJoin` messages (type 7) with instructions to use `/link`. This change requires adding `GuildMessages` and `MessageContent` intents to the client initialization. The `/link` command logic was also refactored to perform a single `select` query using `or` conditions to check for existing `discord_id` or `email` matches, replacing the previous `update` with `isNull` check, to ensure accurate validation of account linkage status before updating the database.

e977634108b72c1eff8bc68e07db8bfded59eeb5.title: Revert endturn prompt and tool result simplification changes
e977634108b72c1eff8bc68e07db8bfded59eeb5.summary: Reverts the previous fix regarding end_turn instructions and updated file placement in tool results. The change restores the original prompt logic in backend/src/main-prompt.ts and removes the simplifyReadFileToolResult export from backend/src/util/parse-tool-call-xml.ts. This rollback addresses issues introduced by the prior commit, specifically affecting how terminal command successes and file read results are communicated to the model.

825f3c07c5f942cb1395d6c02a0be27e04ed8ccb.text: New members joining the chat automatically get a welcome message telling them how to link their account.

060a630a5c78235f73f227ec9bcc0133c5aaa47f.text: The assistant's instructions for handling knowledge files were clarified to better define when to create or update them. This internal adjustment helps the assistant follow rules more consistently.

e977634108b72c1eff8bc68e07db8bfded59eeb5.text: A recent update that changed how the assistant handles certain instructions was undone because it caused problems. This restores the previous behavior for how the assistant receives and acts on information.

329031e75f4e2133392a91230287585461952b70.text: Small internal update. Support staff can now see usernames when adding roles. This helps them fix issues faster.

05bc43e718f37af5141e80fb8bb56d7f22def5ed.text: The system now links your account to your usage activity. This helps track your progress consistently across the product.

083ba34e1b8127271cab8501c442e98772ee098e.text: The app now talks to the messaging service using a different method. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

840c30c49390890c07d6a53877dbafd098158b23.text: Fixed a rare bug where Discord interactions might fail due to large ID numbers. This internal update improves reliability for users.

e95547801c583a4233d60240f0c797a57fd66888.text: The system now knows about a special verified status, but nothing changes for users yet.

32458bca8729c98d3585808918afd113f106a47d.text: Fixed a bug that caused the assistant to get stuck in loops. The assistant now handles file information more efficiently, leading to smoother responses.

34726d285b632fcf26051267f34879732cfcf109.text: A small internal update ensures private replies stay visible only to you, not everyone in the channel.

edef5e00209aa5a2d7b9481da9790232d6154ce2.title: Enable Gemini stream usage stats
edef5e00209aa5a2d7b9481da9790232d6154ce2.summary: Added stream_options: {include_usage: true} to Gemini streaming API calls. This ensures usage statistics are returned alongside streamed responses. The change applies to backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-api.ts.

6149275ecdf5c64575ecfe4c495d658ab94a17e9.title: Refine file request prompt and token counting scope
6149275ecdf5c64575ecfe4c495d658ab94a17e9.summary: Split token counting for file requests into messagesForFileRequest. Updated check-new-files-necessary.ts criteria to trigger on single user messages. Modified getFileVersionUpdates to skip readFilesMessage when requestedFiles is empty. Affects backend/src/main-prompt.ts and backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts.

f3f6d8319b554023b6bf98bea46b94992dfab588.title: Refine heuristic for new file necessity
f3f6d8319b554023b6bf98bea46b94992dfab588.summary: Updated prompt logic in `check-new-files-necessary.ts` to improve detection of when to load new files. Added positive triggers for topic shifts and explicit mentions of new functions; clarified negative triggers for greetings and simple commands. Scope limited to backend file-finding heuristics. Refines decision boundaries for `YES`/`NO` classification.

a6655b63d3863d1e3c2800853a0e5b26144160ce.title: Remove verbose agentContext debug logs
a6655b63d3863d1e3c2800853a0e5b26144160ce.summary: Deleted `logger.debug` calls for 'Updated agent context' in `main-prompt.ts` and 'Updated context' in `tools.ts`. Refactored `websocket-action.ts` to spread `params` instead of manually listing quota fields in the 'Sending usage info' log. Reduces noise in backend logs without altering functional behavior.

6fde2cbd3467f24217ab8640a5795756ec808925.title: Document model stack in FAQ and advanced docs
6fde2cbd3467f24217ab8640a5795756ec808925.summary: Added explicit model usage documentation to `web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx` and `web/src/content/help/faq.mdx`. Clarified the multi-model stack: Claude Sonnet (primary coding), Gemini Flash (file retrieval), Relace AI speculative decoding (rewrites), o3-mini (fallback), and gpt-4o-mini (trivial tasks). Scope limited to Web documentation surfaces.

c7b243c61fcc0f765d37586a5fe744cbf6c71ed1.title: Force display of explicitly requested files in context
c7b243c61fcc0f765d37586a5fe744cbf6c71ed1.summary: Modified `getFileVersionUpdates` to include `options.requestedFiles` in the returned `newFiles` list, even if the file was already present in `previousFilePaths`. This ensures files explicitly requested by the assistant are re-sent, working around the model's inability to recognize existing context. Scope limited to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The logic now merges `newFilesWithoutRequestedFiles` with `options.requestedFiles` using `uniq`.

8dbf4f061611d6890e2f3ad3b5a12ccd2bc99880.title: Add Relace rerank endpoint wrapper
8dbf4f061611d6890e2f3ad3b5a12ccd2bc99880.summary: Implemented rerank function in backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts calling https://ranker.endpoint.relace.run/v1/code/rank. Converts FileWithPath inputs to Relace format, sends prompt as query, and parses string array response. Includes 100s timeout, error handling returning original file order, and telemetry logging via saveMessage for non-test users. New types RankedFile and FileWithPath exported.

94a86e1476a5c8fddc37794dd9fe484687dc4ca6.title: Relax fast-rewrite test diff size threshold
94a86e1476a5c8fddc37794dd9fe484687dc4ca6.summary: The `linesChanged` assertion in `backend/src/__tests__/fast-rewrite.test.ts` now allows up to 10 lines instead of 5. This change addresses flakiness in the `rewriteWithOpenAI` test suite caused by strict diff size limits. The update is internal, affecting only the backend test configuration.

e9e6bfa2552ed87cced63694ac7f044c0ff7ee82.title: Add saveAgentRequest debug helper
e9e6bfa2552ed87cced63694ac7f044c0ff7ee82.summary: Adds `saveAgentRequest` in `backend/src/system-prompt/save-agent-request.ts` to write prompt state to disk. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` gates agent context and user instructions on `prompt` presence and wires the helper behind a `debugPromptCaching` flag. Helper serializes system and messages with cache control to `system-prompts/`.

454988686e03f8ea672270fc20dc55814ba53a36.title: Add Discord API integration and slash commands
454988686e03f8ea672270fc20dc55814ba53a36.summary: New Discord bot integration via `/api/discord/interactions` endpoint handling slash commands like `/link <email>`. Requests verified using ed25519 signatures with in-memory rate limiting (5 requests/minute/user) and ephemeral responses for privacy. Database schema updated with `discord_id` column (migration `0011_familiar_ezekiel_stane.sql`) to link Discord accounts to user profiles. Covers Web API route, rate-limiter, command registration script, and environment variables (`DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY`, `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`, `DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID`).

c7b243c61fcc0f765d37586a5fe744cbf6c71ed1.text: The assistant now re-sends specific files you ask for, even if it saw them before. This helps it remember your request.

454988686e03f8ea672270fc20dc55814ba53a36.text: The service now connects to Discord, letting users link their accounts using a simple command. This connection keeps personal details private and prevents spam by limiting how often requests can be made.

f3f6d8319b554023b6bf98bea46b94992dfab588.text: The assistant better understands when to look up new information, so it answers more accurately. This is a small internal update.

8dbf4f061611d6890e2f3ad3b5a12ccd2bc99880.text: The system now better sorts files to find the most relevant ones for your questions. If this step fails, it simply shows files in their original order.

6fde2cbd3467f24217ab8640a5795756ec808925.text: The company updated its help pages to explain how different tools work together. This change only affects the documentation, so the app itself works exactly the same way.

6149275ecdf5c64575ecfe4c495d658ab94a17e9.text: The system now checks for new files only when you send a message, not automatically in the background. This makes the process faster and more predictable.

edef5e00209aa5a2d7b9481da9790232d6154ce2.text: A small internal update now tracks how much you use the AI assistant during conversations. This helps the system measure activity but does not change how the assistant replies to you.

a6655b63d3863d1e3c2800853a0e5b26144160ce.text: The system now writes fewer unhelpful notes to its internal record. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

94a86e1476a5c8fddc37794dd9fe484687dc4ca6.text: The company loosened a strict rule used to check the assistant's writing style during internal tests. This change fixes minor testing errors but does not affect how the assistant works for users.

e9e6bfa2552ed87cced63694ac7f044c0ff7ee82.text: The team added an internal tool to save conversation data for debugging. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

a670ce167ad29c50e1567d0a24489f2fe91471d9.title: Update testimonials section copy
a670ce167ad29c50e1567d0a24489f2fe91471d9.summary: Updated heading text in `web/src/components/ui/landing/testimonials-section.tsx` from "See them raving" to "Watch them rave". This change improves clarity in the landing page testimonials section. No functional logic or styling was altered.

017c24c785fc424fd44da9348ae74da9ec97696a.title: Restore user input on undo redo
017c24c785fc424fd44da9348ae74da9ec97696a.summary: CLI undo and redo commands now restore the original user input to the prompt after checkpoint restoration. CheckpointManager.restoreCheckointFileState accepts a resetUndoIds flag to clear the undo chain during explicit checkpoint restores. Input restoration skips commands matching the checkpoint restore regex to prevent recursion. Implemented in npm-app/src/cli.ts and npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts.

7013cc6a0c68f7d94e42951b34cc6db0284c07db.title: Update favicon assets and logo priority
7013cc6a0c68f7d94e42951b34cc6db0284c07db.summary: Replaced and added favicon assets in web/public/favicon, including new apple-touch-icon-light.png and favicon-32x32.ico. Updated footer.tsx and navbar.tsx to set priority on logo images. Adjusted CTA section spacing in cta-section.tsx.

3ea21c0bf5c767ff7bf49eacc27f03ae18ed0e61.title: Refactor checkpoint error handling and worker messaging
3ea21c0bf5c767ff7bf49eacc27f03ae18ed0e61.summary: Introduced `CheckpointsDisabledError` class and updated `disabledReason` type in `CheckpointManager`. Modified `WorkerMessage` and `WorkerResponse` interfaces to include unique `id` fields for better request-response correlation in worker threads. Updated `cli.ts` to handle checkpoint errors gracefully with try-catch blocks, removing direct `disabledReason` string checks. Worker thread logic in `checkpoint-worker.ts` now extracts message fields early and includes `id` in responses.

254095ba25df1931af14d0fc48f39aef06460ad6.title: Web hero section mobile height fix and IDE demo formatting
254095ba25df1931af14d0fc48f39aef06460ad6.summary: `Section` component now checks `useIsMobile` before applying `95svh` height, defaulting to `auto` on mobile. `IDEDemo` component formatting adjusted for mobile visibility. Changes affect web UI layout responsiveness.

fca2d740496f13e80bc48a46e9415258d68f9415.title: Move user instructions to top of agent message stack
fca2d740496f13e80bc48a46e9415258d68f9415.summary: Relocates `userInstructions` from the bottom of the `agentMessages` array to the top in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This ensures instruction priority is maintained regardless of message history trimming logic. The change also removes redundant `lastAssistantMessage` trimming and reorganizes context injection.

65cec2d69e90bd0b25e6657d312310527f69bc04.title: Extract withCacheControl helper
65cec2d69e90bd0b25e6657d312310527f69bc04.summary: Added withCacheControl helper to common/src/util/messages.ts to standardize cache_control attachment. Updated backend/src/main-prompt.ts to use this helper instead of inline logic. This refactoring centralizes message transformation logic.

bd51b864ff7db8ed47bad306b99c012f0434930e.title: Update docs
bd51b864ff7db8ed47bad306b99c012f0434930e.summary: Updated four advanced documentation files (`claude-code-comparison.mdx`, `how-does-it-work.mdx`, `troubleshooting.mdx`, `what-models.mdx`) to reflect current model usage and add troubleshooting guidance. Model references generalized from 'Claude 3.7 Sonnet' to 'Claude Sonnet' and 'Claude 3.5 Haiku' to 'Claude Haiku'. Added `sudo` workaround for npm install failures in troubleshooting. Scope limited to web content docs.

3f1365de20974594e130701a2f8ad0e9a14cc010.title: Landing page UI updates
3f1365de20974594e130701a2f8ad0e9a14cc010.summary: Hero section layout refactored to full viewport height with simplified demo transition logic. Docs navigation arrows replaced with SVG icons and styled buttons. `IDEDemo` timeout logic consolidated into named constants with proper cleanup.

531e3bbdf9d49fed8e7c5d9ee0abc65038cb86e7.title: Prompt agent to accommodate user file edits
531e3bbdf9d49fed8e7c5d9ee0abc65038cb86e7.summary: main-prompt.ts now partitions addedFiles into updatedFilePaths and newFiles, injecting explicit instruction to accommodate user modifications in read_files tool results. agent-instructions.md clarifies that user edits appear in subsequent read_file results and must be treated as explicit instructions for future write_file operations. Covers backend prompt assembly and system instructions; no CLI/Web surface changes. Updated files are appended after new files in the tool result with dedicated header text.

fca2d740496f13e80bc48a46e9415258d68f9415.text: The assistant now reads your custom instructions before looking at past chats. This helps it follow your rules more reliably, even in long conversations.

3f1365de20974594e130701a2f8ad0e9a14cc010.text: The landing page now looks cleaner and works more smoothly. The main image section fills the screen, and navigation buttons use clearer icons.

7013cc6a0c68f7d94e42951b34cc6db0284c07db.text: The site updated its browser tab icons and logo display settings. These changes only affect how the website looks and loads, not how you use it.

a670ce167ad29c50e1567d0a24489f2fe91471d9.text: The heading above the customer reviews now reads "Watch them rave" instead of "See them raving." This small text update makes the section clearer for visitors.

3ea21c0bf5c767ff7bf49eacc27f03ae18ed0e61.text: The app now handles disabled features more clearly and tracks background tasks better to prevent confusion.

254095ba25df1931af14d0fc48f39aef06460ad6.text: The website now adjusts its top section to fit smaller screens properly. This change improves how the page looks and feels on mobile devices.

65cec2d69e90bd0b25e6657d312310527f69bc04.text: The team organized how the system remembers recent chats. This internal cleanup does not change what you see or do.

017c24c785fc424fd44da9348ae74da9ec97696a.text: The program now puts your previous typed command back into the text box when you use undo or redo. This helps you see exactly what you did before without retyping it.

531e3bbdf9d49fed8e7c5d9ee0abc65038cb86e7.text: The assistant now automatically notices when you change a file and uses that updated version for future tasks. This ensures it follows your latest edits without needing extra instructions.

bd51b864ff7db8ed47bad306b99c012f0434930e.text: Updated help pages to use current assistant names. Added steps for fixing installation errors.

ec645def0e60d84b36ae620b6159b65ab5840651.title: Fast rewrite fallback uses GPT-4o for 16k token limit
ec645def0e60d84b36ae620b6159b65ab5840651.summary: Fast rewrite fallback switched from Gemini Flash to GPT-4o via `rewriteWithOpenAI` in `backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts` to support 16k token outputs, addressing Gemini's 8k limit. `common/src/util/file.ts` adds `parseMarkdownCodeBlock` for response parsing. Scope covers backend rewrite logic and common file utilities. `predictedContent` passed to `promptOpenAI` ensures context alignment.

570831eff513a245158889574f6021a585dd6993.title: Profit margin raised to 0.3
570831eff513a245158889574f6021a585dd6993.summary: PROFIT_MARGIN constant increased from 0.2 to 0.3 in backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts. Adjusts internal cost calculation logic. Scope limited to backend cost tracking module.

06c65a9acde8f942931df3c4ee85ff9209dd2444.title: Trim incomplete comment in fast-rewrite.ts
06c65a9acde8f942931df3c4ee85ff9209dd2444.summary: Comment in backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts truncated. Removed trailing text about Gemini flash output limit. Internal cleanup only.

e8b6afa4c44e491938b76bfcdd87c865aeabfd12.title: Prompt caching refactor and file request limits
e8b6afa4c44e491938b76bfcdd87c865aeabfd12.summary: Prompt caching implementation (#96) refactors system prompt structure in `agent-system-prompt.ts` to use explicit `cache_control` blocks, removing dynamic file history injection from the base prompt. `check-new-files-necessary.ts` and `request-files-prompt.ts` remove `previousFiles` dependency, relying on conversation history for context, while capping file requests at 30 (`MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST`). `main-prompt.ts` updates tool result handling to support simplified read-file results and partitioning logic.

94c6a1f3431f0ad539c432bad5a4d747da3adf6a.title: gpt-4o snapshot bumped to 2024-11-20
94c6a1f3431f0ad539c432bad5a4d747da3adf6a.summary: gpt-4o constant updated from gpt-4o-2024-08-06 to gpt-4o-2024-11-20 in common/src/constants.ts. Reflects upstream OpenAI release of a newer 4o snapshot. Change applies globally via the openaiModels map, affecting all surfaces using this constant. No migration logic required.

8807e7c761039f32d9662636b84e3cd83336fa36.title: Landing page redesign
8807e7c761039f32d9662636b84e3cd83336fa36.summary: Web landing page refactored with new section components. `page.tsx` rewritten to use modular `Hero`, `FeatureSection`, `CompetitionSection`, `TestimonialsSection`, `CTASection`. `BrowserPreview`, `IDEDemo`, `TerminalDemo` components added. `layout-wrapper.tsx` introduced. Favicon assets updated. `web/landing-page-refactor.md` plan added. Pricing page badge styling fixed.

1857561a2c060c839ccf1b76dd07d9f47cc902c4.title: Remove which and where from multiWordCommands
1857561a2c060c839ccf1b76dd07d9f47cc902c4.summary: Removed 'which' and 'where' from the multiWordCommands array in backend/src/check-terminal-command.ts. This change prevents these commands from being classified as multi-word commands, altering how they are handled during terminal command checks.

3b14eb62d7ff07249716d3d0b56d47acc4d70613.title: Clarify prompt instructions on comments and ambiguity
3b14eb62d7ff07249716d3d0b56d47acc4d70613.summary: Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to tighten agent behavior. Clarifying questions now trigger only when interpretations lead to very different outcomes. Instructions explicitly require preserving original user comments line-for-line during `write_file` operations.

1353fca7fa528a93f5518a4761ac856ac44936be.title: Update hero title and tagline
1353fca7fa528a93f5518a4761ac856ac44936be.summary: The hero component title changed from 'Codeflow' to 'AI Coding', and the tagline updated to 'Simple. Fast. Powerful.' followed by 'Codebuff works in your'. This copy adjustment modifies the primary value proposition text in web/src/components/ui/hero.tsx. The TypingEffect component remains intact.

5fb0f5407f8ac0f706f8808ce282355b0d529516.title: Switch rewrite model to o3-mini
5fb0f5407f8ac0f706f8808ce282355b0d529516.summary: Fast rewrite backend switches from gpt4o to o3-mini. Cost drops by half with comparable latency and improved accuracy. Change affects backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts only.

94c6a1f3431f0ad539c432bad5a4d747da3adf6a.text: The app now uses a newer version of the AI model. You might see slight improvements in how it answers questions. No action is needed from you.

06c65a9acde8f942931df3c4ee85ff9209dd2444.text: Developers fixed a small internal note in the code. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

ec645def0e60d84b36ae620b6159b65ab5840651.text: The rewrite feature now uses a different AI model that can handle much longer text outputs, removing previous length restrictions.

1353fca7fa528a93f5518a4761ac856ac44936be.text: The main text on the landing page changed. It now says 'AI Coding' and 'Simple. Fast. Powerful.' instead of the previous wording.

3b14eb62d7ff07249716d3d0b56d47acc4d70613.text: The assistant now only asks for clarification when your request is truly unclear. It also strictly preserves your original text and comments when editing files.

570831eff513a245158889574f6021a585dd6993.text: The system now assumes a higher profit margin when calculating internal costs. This change is small and only affects internal tracking. You will not notice any difference when using the product.

1857561a2c060c839ccf1b76dd07d9f47cc902c4.text: The system no longer treats 'which' and 'where' as complex commands. This internal update slightly changes how these specific tools are processed, but you will likely see no difference in everyday use.

8807e7c761039f32d9662636b84e3cd83336fa36.text: The landing page got a fresh look with new demo previews and clearer sections. This update only affects how the page appears, not how the product works.

e8b6afa4c44e491938b76bfcdd87c865aeabfd12.text: The assistant now remembers files more efficiently, reducing repeated requests and speeding up conversations. It limits how many files it asks for at once to keep things smooth.

5fb0f5407f8ac0f706f8808ce282355b0d529516.text: The software now uses a faster and more accurate system to rewrite text. This change cuts costs in half without slowing down the service, so you get better results at the same speed.

f2964699fe0a27c33aa00d9c5ef313b113dfea2f.title: Disable comment preservation in fastRewrite
f2964699fe0a27c33aa00d9c5ef313b113dfea2f.summary: Removed `preserveCommentsInEditSnippet` call from `fastRewrite` in `backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts`. The edit snippet now passes directly to `promptRelaceAI` without an intermediate LLM step to restore comments. This eliminates the `editSnippetWithComments` variable and associated timing metrics (`commentPreservationDuration`).

b4cfc60a624a82c7e4b53b134fb523b467c0755b.title: Suppress websocket send errors
b4cfc60a624a82c7e4b53b134fb523b467c0755b.summary: Comment out console.error in APIRealtimeClient send action catch block. Relies on automatic reconnection for error recovery. Affects common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts.

5dc9e20b7174e8410c56f1ee4aafb7b82581010b.title: Add quick-build script for npm-app start
5dc9e20b7174e8410c56f1ee4aafb7b82581010b.summary: Added `quick-build` script to `npm-app/package.json` running only `tsc` and `tsc-alias`. Modified `start` and `start-js` scripts to invoke `quick-build` and `build` respectively before execution, skipping full monorepo dependency rebuilds during local development. This change affects only the `npm-app` package scripts.

ac61a3dcb6d91484a6c784e623921c7f660732cb.title: CLI parser migrated to Commander library
ac61a3dcb6d91484a6c784e623921c7f660732cb.summary: Replaced manual `process.argv` parsing with `commander` in `npm-app/src/index.ts`. Adds `commander` dependency and updates `npm-app/package.json` scripts to remove hardcoded `--git stage` flag. Enables structured help text, versioning, and option handling for flags like `--create`, `--lite`, and `--max`.

92bbfc1519ef829bf72ef2cf1c4d3ba8be2dce6f.title: Remove blank line before terminal command display
92bbfc1519ef829bf72ef2cf1c4d3ba8be2dce6f.summary: Removed `console.log()` calls in `runCommandPty` and `runCommandChildProcess` within `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. This eliminates the extra newline printed before the green command prompt when `mode === 'assistant'`. Affects terminal output formatting for command execution.

71ac9b657e2e5006b0cfb6592cd215eb06e6921d.title: Limit bare git log to last 5 commits
71ac9b657e2e5006b0cfb6592cd215eb06e6921d.summary: Special case in `runTerminalCommand` (`npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`) rewrites exact `git log` to `git log -n 5`. Prevents output flooding when agent requests full history. Covers both PTY and child_process fallback paths.

91b3aed1da4af4e61c9793ac3a8ef3e315ea66dd.title: Guard message-cost-response sends on open websocket
91b3aed1da4af4e61c9793ac3a8ef3e315ea66dd.summary: Added `ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN` check before sending `message-cost-response` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` to prevent writes to closed sockets. `backend/src/websockets/server.ts` gains per-connection error handling and `logger.warn` calls in `deadConnectionCleaner` to catch `SWITCHBOARD.getClient` failures and log inactive terminations. Scope limited to backend websocket and cost tracking subsystems. Missing client entries now trigger explicit termination instead of silent failure.

4456de5e52c0de58db25dd6050493865b3c6d245.title: Update preserveCommentsInEditSnippet prompt and agent instructions
4456de5e52c0de58db25dd6050493865b3c6d245.summary: Refined the `preserveCommentsInEditSnippet` prompt in `backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts` to prioritize preserving the edit snippet structure while adding back original comments and removing meta-comments. Added a rule to `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md` requiring agents to run newly created unit tests. Includes updated tests in `backend/src/__tests__/fast-rewrite.test.ts`.

a1241ac65cad91f81e70464f7c18445e72511a07.title: Extract fastRewrite to backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts
a1241ac65cad91f81e70464f7c18445e72511a07.summary: Moves `fastRewrite` and `shouldAddFilePlaceholders` from `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` into new `backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts`. Removes `[UPDATED_BY_ANOTHER_ASSISTANT]` early return from `processFileBlock`. Updates `processFileBlock` to import `fastRewrite` and `shouldAddFilePlaceholders` from the new module. Deletes dead code from `process-file-block.ts`.

1c0db17a18120507fe9a679429276efe3b4b466e.title: Websocket error handling and client exit on failure
1c0db17a18120507fe9a679429276efe3b4b466e.summary: Websocket server refactored to pass through zod schema errors correctly. Client now rejects transactions on close instead of resolving, and exits with a message to get latest version on send errors. Covers backend server and common client.

92bbfc1519ef829bf72ef2cf1c4d3ba8be2dce6f.text: A small internal fix removes an empty line that appeared before commands in the assistant's terminal view. This makes the output look cleaner.

b4cfc60a624a82c7e4b53b134fb523b467c0755b.text: The app no longer shows error messages when a live connection briefly drops. It automatically reconnects, so you won't see annoying pop-ups for temporary glitches.

a1241ac65cad91f81e70464f7c18445e72511a07.text: The system's internal organization was improved to make it easier to manage. You will not notice any changes in how the assistant behaves.

1c0db17a18120507fe9a679429276efe3b4b466e.text: The app now shows clearer error messages when something goes wrong. If a connection fails, the app will tell you to update instead of getting stuck.

4456de5e52c0de58db25dd6050493865b3c6d245.text: The assistant now keeps original notes when editing text and removes its own instructions from the result. It also runs new checks to ensure changes work correctly.

ac61a3dcb6d91484a6c784e623921c7f660732cb.text: The tool now uses a standard library to handle commands. This fixes how options work and cleans up the help text.

5dc9e20b7174e8410c56f1ee4aafb7b82581010b.text: Developers added a shortcut to the internal setup tools. This change is small and only affects the team building the software.

71ac9b657e2e5006b0cfb6592cd215eb06e6921d.text: The assistant now limits full history checks to the five most recent items. This prevents screens from filling with too much text when it looks up past activity.

f2964699fe0a27c33aa00d9c5ef313b113dfea2f.text: The tool now skips a background step that previously tried to keep special notes inside code text intact. This change is small and internal, so it should not affect how the product looks or works for you.

91b3aed1da4af4e61c9793ac3a8ef3e315ea66dd.text: The system now checks if a connection is active before sending cost updates, preventing errors when the connection closes. This ensures smoother performance and clearer logs for internal monitoring, with no visible change for users.

7775aa33d0f6879497aff01816d1fbf3dc8713ff.title: Update check-new-files prompt for single-message context
7775aa33d0f6879497aff01816d1fbf3dc8713ff.summary: Added instruction to read relevant files when user has only sent one message in `backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts`. This refines the heuristic for determining necessary file reads in the initial request phase. Scope limited to backend file-finding logic. The change ensures broader context gathering for single-turn queries.

a17bd88894ce4de861b23db36b08f46c0788adbd.title: Catch errors in websocket sendAction
a17bd88894ce4de861b23db36b08f46c0788adbd.summary: APIRealtimeClient.sendAction now awaits sendMessage inside try/catch, logging action and error message on failure. npm-app Client.init removed its external .catch handler, relying on the centralized error capture in common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts. Affects shared websocket layer and CLI client initialization.

c70a7bd007480d503affbbdc6648917752cd48de.title: Soften git command restrictions in main prompt
c70a7bd007480d503affbbdc6648917752cd48de.summary: The `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` guideline for git and script execution was softened from prohibiting actions without specific instructions to requiring specific requests. The updated text adds a rationale about preventing costly accidents and explicitly states that the user is in charge, instructing the agent not to refuse user requests. This change applies to the core system prompt logic.

e097b3f55689b7a7712e2408242c355237eacf01.title: Fix line endings in processFileBlock
e097b3f55689b7a7712e2408242c355237eacf01.summary: processFileBlock now preserves original line endings in returned content and patch by moving normalization to the return step. Removed pre-normalization of updatedContent and post-normalization of patch before diff generation. Ensures consistency with normalizedInitialContent and fixes unit test failures. Affects backend/src/process-file-block.ts.

8df0d11f7528869f7a9b936b5c25e4ea67104dae.title: Skip request files only when prompt empty
8df0d11f7528869f7a9b936b5c25e4ea67104dae.summary: Changed `skipRequestingFiles` logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to `!prompt` instead of `justUsedATool`. This ensures file context requests are skipped only when no user prompt is provided, rather than based on tool usage history.

4eee2dd5a47c061ac2cfa13ec1d705d133d793d3.title: readfiles tool renderer updated to display trimmed content
4eee2dd5a47c061ac2cfa13ec1d705d133d793d3.summary: The read_files tool renderer in npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts now uses defaultToolCallRenderer with custom handlers. onParamChunk returns null to suppress intermediate chunk rendering, while onParamEnd returns content.trim() to display the final file content. This change affects how file reading operations are visualized in the CLI and Web/Desktop tool output surfaces.

de61584048a43d6ffd1a153de63b4adef04fb5a2.title: Fix tool result ordering in main prompt
de61584048a43d6ffd1a153de63b4adef04fb5a2.summary: Refactors backend/src/main-prompt.ts to append tool results directly to message history before user prompts, eliminating intermediate arrays. This ensures correct chronological ordering of assistant responses and tool outputs for the LLM. Internal logic change only; no API or UI surface impact.

404c7a37e1937c7e68170eb5ae9823377e24a22e.title: Add onToolEnd newline to Read renderer
404c7a37e1937c7e68170eb5ae9823377e24a22e.summary: Added `onToolEnd` hook to `Read` tool renderer in `tool-renderers.ts`. Returns `\n` after tool execution. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts`. Note: Tests missing.

307ad70ab086e54912205100a22a3942805600a5.title: addsubgoal schema gains log field
307ad70ab086e54912205100a22a3942805600a5.summary: The `add_subgoal` tool schema in `common/src/constants/tools.ts` now accepts a `log` field, aligning with `update_subgoal`. This ensures subgoal creation can capture initial log entries directly, matching the update workflow. Scope limited to shared core tool definitions.

2d86909ff04f6c3d79bf105e6115e6ee399e7b9a.title: Tweak checkNewFilesNecessary logic
2d86909ff04f6c3d79bf105e6115e6ee399e7b9a.summary: Updated `checkNewFilesNecessary` prompt to enforce aggressive file reading at conversation start. Removed single-message constraint from YES conditions, moved it to explicit YES directive. Added newline to `read_files` tag in `main-prompt.ts`. Covers backend file-finding logic.

2d86909ff04f6c3d79bf105e6115e6ee399e7b9a.text: The assistant now checks for new files more thoroughly at the start of a conversation. This small internal update helps it better understand context without missing important information.

7775aa33d0f6879497aff01816d1fbf3dc8713ff.text: A small internal update helps the assistant check more files when you send just one message. This may improve how well it understands your request.

de61584048a43d6ffd1a153de63b4adef04fb5a2.text: The system now lists the assistant's replies and its results in the correct order. This keeps the conversation flow accurate.

a17bd88894ce4de861b23db36b08f46c0788adbd.text: The app now automatically catches and records errors when sending commands. This helps developers fix issues faster, but you will not notice a change.

e097b3f55689b7a7712e2408242c355237eacf01.text: A small internal fix now keeps the assistant's edits matching your original text formatting exactly. This prevents minor display glitches in the editor.

404c7a37e1937c7e68170eb5ae9823377e24a22e.text: This small internal update fixes how text displays after the assistant reads a file. It ensures a new line appears, making the output easier to read.

8df0d11f7528869f7a9b936b5c25e4ea67104dae.text: A small internal update changes how the assistant decides when to skip asking for file context. It now only skips this step when no user prompt is provided, rather than based on past tool usage.

307ad70ab086e54912205100a22a3942805600a5.text: The assistant can now record notes when you first create a subgoal. This ensures initial details are captured immediately, matching how updates work.

c70a7bd007480d503affbbdc6648917752cd48de.text: The assistant now follows user commands more freely, though it still asks for confirmation before risky actions to prevent costly mistakes. This is a small internal update to how the assistant decides when to act.

4eee2dd5a47c061ac2cfa13ec1d705d133d793d3.text: File reading now shows only the final text, hiding the messy loading steps. You see a clean result instead of a stream of partial content.

f32b6ff3ed8db914de1187c2b4b44635c8f893a1.title: Remove debug log from CheckpointManager
f32b6ff3ed8db914de1187c2b4b44635c8f893a1.summary: Deleted a stray console.log('asdf', {targetId}) in npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts. This cleanup removes unnecessary debug noise from checkpoint restoration logic. Scope limited to the checkpoint-manager.ts file within npm-app.

9fb5b4a08247ddbd73c7dcca05d8aed36a7589ed.title: Feed endpoint switches to Substack JSON API
9fb5b4a08247ddbd73c7dcca05d8aed36a7589ed.summary: web/src/app/api/feed/route.ts now fetches https://news.codebuff.com/api/v1/posts instead of the RSS feed. Zod schemas validate the JSON response, replacing fragile XML regex parsing. This internal change affects only the Web feed route. The Article interface remains unchanged, mapping Substack fields to existing properties.

7d80bfcfaf40b60a3321533e365e2d23497f6526.title: Stop spinner before tool calls in client
7d80bfcfaf40b60a3321533e365e2d23497f6526.summary: Added `Spinner.get().stop()` before state assignment in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Prevents spinner from running during tool execution. Internal client behavior change.

cb26ddc3796a646656e02e5e13caa3cc7d45f049.title: Remove redundant spinner start in client.ts
cb26ddc3796a646656e02e5e13caa3cc7d45f049.summary: Removed Spinner.get().start() call in npm-app/src/client.ts during incomplete prompt continuation. Eliminates redundant UI spinner activation when sending tool results via WebSocket. Internal cleanup only.

9e9be1917697c97278d5b2362e12fe697e759c68.title: Hide prompt when rejecting empty input
9e9be1917697c97278d5b2362e12fe697e759c68.summary: CLI clears readline prompt before validating empty input in `handleUserInput`. Prevents prompt display when input is rejected. Affects `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

82cb8bbaede30bf2e00ef695a7f64c07aa0d69e8.title: Add blacklisted terminal commands
82cb8bbaede30bf2e00ef695a7f64c07aa0d69e8.summary: Added blacklist check for 'halt', 'reboot', 'yes' in checkTerminalCommand. Blocks these commands before LLM validation. Internal security guard.

b241d9279c541e2eb7a4eb0b867561c20f43fe04.title: Fix git fallback logic in checkpoints file manager
b241d9279c541e2eb7a4eb0b867561c20f43fe04.summary: Corrected git command execution in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` to prevent unnecessary fallback to isomorphic-git when native git succeeds. Adjusted `stdio` configuration for `git status` and ensured `gitCommit` returns valid commit hashes from both native and fallback paths. This internal fix improves checkpoint reliability by properly handling git command outputs and return values.

105df9c10b72a55a483d0a6f5a7252545cfd23eb.title: Expand createplan tool triggers for new features and refactoring
105df9c10b72a55a483d0a6f5a7252545cfd23eb.summary: The `create_plan` tool description now explicitly includes "new feature" and "refactoring" as triggers alongside the existing "plan" keyword. The system prompt separates complex request handling into distinct directives: `think_deeply` for complexity and `create_plan` for feature/refactoring starts. This change applies to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/tools.ts`. The previous combined condition for `think_deeply` was simplified to focus solely on complexity.

0d502c7e7288be983f9f95e1a7200f7d3e7a1c8f.title: Show usage credits on each message
0d502c7e7288be983f9f95e1a7200f7d3e7a1c8f.summary: New `message-cost-response` action pushes real-time credit usage to clients after each LLM message. `saveMessage` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` locates the active WebSocket via `SWITCHBOARD` and sends the cost immediately. Auth logic moved from `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts` to shared `backend/src/util/check-auth.ts`, enabling a new `POST /api/usage` endpoint in `backend/src/api/usage.ts`. `genUsageResponse` signature changed to accept `clientSessionId` and `requestedByUser` flags.

459ea4195ed3508bd72e694c5372b5cb47996a4d.title: Add redo command and checkpoint parent tracking
459ea4195ed3508bd72e694c5372b5cb47996a4d.summary: Implements redo functionality and parent tracking in CheckpointManager. Adds `redo` CLI command, `parentId` field to Checkpoint interface, and `restoreUndoCheckpoint`/`restoreRedoCheckpoint` methods. Worker responses now include original message for validation.

0d502c7e7288be983f9f95e1a7200f7d3e7a1c8f.text: The system now displays the exact cost of each message right after you send it. This lets you track your spending in real-time.

cb26ddc3796a646656e02e5e13caa3cc7d45f049.text: The app no longer shows a loading icon twice when sending data. This small internal cleanup keeps the visual feedback clean and consistent.

7d80bfcfaf40b60a3321533e365e2d23497f6526.text: The loading indicator now stops before the assistant runs a tool. This prevents the spinner from staying on while the tool works.

9fb5b4a08247ddbd73c7dcca05d8aed36a7589ed.text: The system now gets news articles from a more reliable source. This internal change makes the feed more stable, so you might see fewer errors when loading the latest posts.

b241d9279c541e2eb7a4eb0b867561c20f43fe04.text: Fixed an internal glitch that caused the app to use a slower backup method even when the main one worked. This makes saving checkpoints faster and more reliable.

9e9be1917697c97278d5b2362e12fe697e759c68.text: The program now hides the text cursor when you submit a blank line. This change is small and internal. It makes the screen look cleaner when you accidentally hit enter without typing anything.

82cb8bbaede30bf2e00ef695a7f64c07aa0d69e8.text: A small internal update blocks specific dangerous commands from running. This prevents accidental system shutdowns or restarts.

105df9c10b72a55a483d0a6f5a7252545cfd23eb.text: The assistant now automatically creates a step-by-step plan when asked to build new features or improve existing code, rather than only when explicitly asked to 'plan'. This helps break down complex tasks into manageable steps without extra instructions.

459ea4195ed3508bd72e694c5372b5cb47996a4d.text: The software can now redo actions after undoing them. It also tracks previous steps to ensure undo and redo work correctly.

f32b6ff3ed8db914de1187c2b4b44635c8f893a1.text: A small internal cleanup removed unnecessary debug noise from the system's checkpoint restoration logic.

64dde186e5ca7b4e0ff2401f2af7cf14961199a8.title: Normalize line endings in processFileBlock
64dde186e5ca7b4e0ff2401f2af7cf14961199a8.summary: Added `patch.replaceAll('\n', lineEnding)` in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` to normalize line endings within the patch string. This ensures consistent line ending usage when processing file blocks. Scope limited to backend file processing logic.

a07fa2b893936873e96cf80160da83b1458f930c.title: Clear checkpoints on project root change
a07fa2b893936873e96cf80160da83b1458f930c.summary: Added checkpointManager.clearCheckpoints() call to setProjectRoot() in npm-app/src/project-files.ts. Prevents stale checkpoints from previous directories when switching project roots.

a94529d60072531f3172605b9d6ca329aa125a52.title: Suppress git command output in checkpoints
a94529d60072531f3172605b9d6ca329aa125a52.summary: Added `stdio: 'ignore'` to `execFileSync` calls in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts`. This prevents git status and progress messages from polluting the agent's output stream during checkpoint creation. The change affects `gitCommandIsAvailable`, `getLatestCommit`, `gitAddAll`, and `gitCommit`.

d300f180a0152ba44abedcf405fd895c0a4f5826.title: Sequential file processing per path
d300f180a0152ba44abedcf405fd895c0a4f5826.summary: Refactored `main-prompt.ts` to process file blocks sequentially per path, preventing race conditions from concurrent writes to the same file. Updated `process-file-block.ts` to accept an initial content promise and return full content alongside patches, normalizing line endings before patch generation. Internal backend change affecting `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`.

a0ac982ba134446924f9fd30fbdf91a826e8150a.title: CLI skip checkpoint restore prompt on restore
a0ac982ba134446924f9fd30fbdf91a826e8150a.summary: Extracted `restoreCheckpointRegex` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and use it to skip `rl.write` when `checkpoint.userInput` matches `/^checkpoint\s+(\d+)$/`. Restoring a checkpoint created from another restore no longer fills the prompt with a literal 'checkpoint xxx' string. Internal CLI behavior only.

a5e8e0b1b94ecc896a8ee912a80991bea27c76ac.title: Update CLI prompt on directory change
a5e8e0b1b94ecc896a8ee912a80991bea27c76ac.summary: Added `this.setPrompt()` call in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to refresh the prompt after directory changes. This ensures the displayed working directory updates correctly when navigating via `cd`.

5396f20c74fb3efde805856b2ae2f1b2bbcc8f8b.title: Tweak Gemini prompt and fallback logic in process-file-block
5396f20c74fb3efde805856b2ae2f1b2bbcc8f8b.summary: Updated prompt instructions in backend/src/process-file-block.ts to enforce coherent integration of edit snippets while preserving original formatting and excluding placeholders. Refined fallback logic in fastRewrite to trigger Gemini rewriting only when lazy edits appear in both the input snippet and the final response, avoiding unnecessary processing. This change impacts the backend file processing subsystem.

fd9fb1d8e2d9590db8bfe8da8bdd87101d9df2ab.title: CLI freshPrompt clears stale input before re-prompt
fd9fb1d8e2d9590db8bfe8da8bdd87101d9df2ab.summary: Added private freshPrompt() in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Stops Spinner, resets readline cursor, clears rl.line, then calls rl.prompt(). Replaces bare rl.prompt() calls across help, login, logout, diff, checkpoint, and SIGINT handlers. Prevents stale user input from appearing when control returns to the prompt.

ae551e15b0befaf867661627e85e5bb8e2c6650d.title: Add pino logger to npm-app
ae551e15b0befaf867661627e85e5bb8e2c6650d.summary: Added `npm-app/src/utils/logger.ts` introducing a pino-based logger. Uses `AsyncLocalStorage` for context propagation and a file transport writing to `debug.log` at debug level. Internal utility for the npm-app package.

e6bdcf4ae10c7ec740fa7126cbfdc44d592bd02b.title: CLI checkpoint saves restricted to specific commands
e6bdcf4ae10c7ec740fa7126cbfdc44d592bd02b.summary: Checkpoint saving moved from unconditional `beforeProcessCommand` to explicit calls in `saveCheckpoint` for `undo`, `checkpoint list`, `restore`, and `forwardUserInput`. `login` now clears checkpoints. Checkpoint confirmation log format changed from colored `Checkpoint #id saved!` to plain `[checkpoint #id saved]`.

a5e8e0b1b94ecc896a8ee912a80991bea27c76ac.text: The command line tool now updates its display when you change folders. This keeps the shown location accurate.

a94529d60072531f3172605b9d6ca329aa125a52.text: The assistant now hides background technical messages when saving your work. This keeps the conversation clean and easier to read.

d300f180a0152ba44abedcf405fd895c0a4f5826.text: The assistant now handles file updates one by one to prevent conflicts. This internal fix ensures your changes are saved correctly without overwriting each other.

64dde186e5ca7b4e0ff2401f2af7cf14961199a8.text: The system now standardizes how text lines are formatted during file processing. This internal fix ensures consistent handling of document structure.

fd9fb1d8e2d9590db8bfe8da8bdd87101d9df2ab.text: The command line now clears leftover text before asking for new input. This stops old or half-typed answers from appearing unexpectedly.

e6bdcf4ae10c7ec740fa7126cbfdc44d592bd02b.text: The app now saves its history only when you use undo or restore features, rather than after every action. Logging in clears this history, and saved history messages are now plain text instead of colored.

a0ac982ba134446924f9fd30fbdf91a826e8150a.text: A small internal fix stops the command tool from adding unwanted text when restoring a previous state.

ae551e15b0befaf867661627e85e5bb8e2c6650d.text: The team added an internal tool to track how the application works behind the scenes. This change does not affect how you use the product, but it helps support staff understand and fix issues more easily.

5396f20c74fb3efde805856b2ae2f1b2bbcc8f8b.text: The file processing system now better preserves original formatting and avoids unnecessary rewrites, resulting in cleaner and more consistent document updates.

a07fa2b893936873e96cf80160da83b1458f930c.text: Switching to a different project folder now clears old saved points from the previous folder. This helps prevent the app from using outdated information when you work in a new location.

2ea746abe49347978c1a31d8956bf2f73bcde972.title: Refine thinkdeeply prompt guidance
2ea746abe49347978c1a31d8956bf2f73bcde972.summary: Updated think_deeply tool prompt in backend/src/tools.ts. Replaced verbose example with concise placeholder and added instruction to keep initial thinking steps under 5 words. Removed redundant usage criteria. Internal prompt engineering only.

116e23c2a5a3aea16627c3d43d420daa05383f5c.title: Fix cancelled response usage capture
116e23c2a5a3aea16627c3d43d420daa05383f5c.summary: Added `responseStopped` flag in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to ensure usage data is captured for cancelled responses. Moved `promptId` check to reject non-matching actions early. On stop, `unsubscribeComplete` and `xmlStreamParser.end` are called to finalize state.

7348c640bb9308878bd4ffd9085529e98f307ac7.title: Replace CheckpointManager boolean with disabledReason
7348c640bb9308878bd4ffd9085529e98f307ac7.summary: Refactors `CheckpointManager` state management by replacing the `enabled` boolean with a `disabledReason` string to capture specific failure causes. Updates `checkpoint-manager.ts` and `cli.ts` to check `disabledReason !== null` instead of `!enabled`, propagating the reason into error messages for undo and restore commands. Scope covers core checkpoint logic and CLI user feedback. Migration behavior ensures 'Project too large' remains the sole reason string currently, allowing future distinct reasons without boolean checks.

40521de35528c488d39557a4ef9e774351831a81.title: Strip null chars in saveMessage() to prevent DB errors
40521de35528c488d39557a4ef9e774351831a81.summary: Added `stripNullChars` utility in `common/src/util/string.ts` to remove U+0000 characters. Applied to `request` and `response` fields in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` before DB insertion. Prevents PostgreSQL errors when storing LLM messages containing null bytes. Request objects are serialized to JSON, cleaned, then parsed back to ensure nested null chars are removed.

193d18c027e53bf15765ab673db01e66f2b52aab.title: Fix terminal hang for commands without output
193d18c027e53bf15765ab673db01e66f2b52aab.summary: Corrects a hang in `runCommandPty` within `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` when commands produce no output. The prompt identifier trimming logic now checks `(commandOutput + pendingOutput).trim() === ''` instead of just `commandOutput.trim() === ''`. This ensures the condition evaluates correctly against accumulated data, preventing the process from stalling.

09dcc50f0c0925f20cb6c989762653af1215cae7.title: Add weekly usage calculation script
09dcc50f0c0925f20cb6c989762653af1215cae7.summary: New `scripts/calculate-weekly-usage.ts` aggregates credit consumption for active subscribers over the last 7 days. Uses `drizzle-orm` to query `message` and `user` tables, filtering by `subscription_active = true` and `finished_at >= sevenDaysAgo`. Outputs total credits, per-user breakdown (sorted desc), and daily aggregates to console. Internal tooling only; no user-facing UI changes.

ec76265ba536b400093d8604cf490320bf93f134.title: Fix null checkpoint crash in CLI undo and client completion
ec76265ba536b400093d8604cf490320bf93f134.summary: Added null checks for `checkpointManager.getLatestCheckpoint()` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The CLI `handleUndo` method now verifies checkpoints are enabled and exist before processing, returning specific error messages for disabled or missing states. The `Client` completion log conditionally renders the checkpoint revert hint only when a valid checkpoint ID is present. This prevents runtime crashes when checkpointing is disabled due to project size or when no checkpoints are recorded.

09425b4ead90942452204181dd3d67679347c665.title: Replace pie emoji with clover in CLI greeting
09425b4ead90942452204181dd3d67679347c665.summary: Greeting string in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` changed from 🥧 to 🍀. Includes Prettier formatting adjustments for long `console.log` statements and imports. Internal cosmetic update.

9b7e25c267e23cc232b323f6004d1b2018dc9c95.title: Fix checkpoint saving on empty diffs
9b7e25c267e23cc232b323f6004d1b2018dc9c95.summary: Refactored `storeFileState` to use a new `gitCommit` helper that validates changes before committing. This prevents empty commits when no file modifications are detected, fixing a bug where checkpoints were saved unnecessarily. The change also updates `resolveRef` and `init` calls to use `gitdir` instead of `dir` for bare repositories. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts`.

d6357823470aa9c365a19bdee374d4410646356b.title: Prompt tuning for file reading and plan execution
d6357823470aa9c365a19bdee374d4410646356b.summary: Updated system prompts to enforce aggressive file reading before edits and mandate complete plan implementation. Replaced 'think_deeply' references with 'create_plan' in agent instructions. Modified `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md` to prioritize context acquisition and full task execution over minimal steps.

9b7e25c267e23cc232b323f6004d1b2018dc9c95.text: The system now saves backup points only when you actually change something, avoiding unnecessary clutter.

09425b4ead90942452204181dd3d67679347c665.text: The greeting message in the internal tool now shows a clover instead of a pie. This cosmetic change does not affect how the tool works.

40521de35528c488d39557a4ef9e774351831a81.text: The system now removes invisible error-causing characters from messages before saving them. This prevents occasional crashes when storing conversations.

09dcc50f0c0925f20cb6c989762653af1215cae7.text: A background tool now tracks how much you use the assistant each week. This helps the team understand usage patterns. You will not see any changes in the app.

2ea746abe49347978c1a31d8956bf2f73bcde972.text: The assistant's internal instructions were simplified. This small change does not affect how you use the product.

116e23c2a5a3aea16627c3d43d420daa05383f5c.text: A small internal update fixes how the system records usage when you stop a response early. This ensures accurate tracking even if you cancel an action.

7348c640bb9308878bd4ffd9085529e98f307ac7.text: An internal change made the save point feature report a reason when it cannot be used. If undo or restore is unavailable, the message now explains why, such as the project being too large.

ec76265ba536b400093d8604cf490320bf93f134.text: The app no longer crashes when you try to undo changes if the safety feature is turned off or no recent steps were saved. Instead, it shows a clear message explaining why the undo cannot happen.

193d18c027e53bf15765ab673db01e66f2b52aab.text: Fixed a bug where the app would freeze if a command produced no text. Now, empty commands finish normally without hanging.

b326939d5dfc96ed494f512ac658b599419558c8.title: Upgrade @anthropic-ai/sdk to 0.39.0
b326939d5dfc96ed494f512ac658b599419558c8.summary: Bumped @anthropic-ai/sdk from ^0.36.3 to ^0.39.0 in backend/package.json. Internal dependency update.

c1d96037d902848e46d7b1be21b283389e6fb72d.title: Drop checkout from storeFileState in file-manager
c1d96037d902848e46d7b1be21b283389e6fb72d.summary: Removed redundant `checkout` call from `storeFileState` in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` and refactored `restoreFileState` to eliminate `resetDone` flag. Internal logic now relies on `git reset --hard` or isomorphic-git `checkout` + `resetIndex` only during restore, not store. Renamed `stageFiles` to `gitAddAll` and added JSDoc comments.

b4f522ef10553fcd59f63f000089fb8d02c745cf.title: Standardize lazy edit placeholder comments
b4f522ef10553fcd59f63f000089fb8d02c745cf.summary: Prompts in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/tools.ts` now enforce language-specific comment syntax (e.g., `// ... existing code ...`) for lazy edits instead of bare ellipses. `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` updated to explicitly reject these markers during apply-model processing. `common/src/util/string.ts` adds detection for the standardized `... existing code ...` pattern in `hasLazyEdit`.

0a2adb636c9c14cb40d6f8b26ffc83d17fb8f978.title: Add colored diff output to SWE-bench eval
0a2adb636c9c14cb40d6f8b26ffc83d17fb8f978.summary: Added console logging of the generated git patch in `evals/swe-bench-eval.ts`. Uses `picocolors` to highlight additions in green, deletions in red, and hunk headers in cyan. This change is internal to the evaluation harness and does not affect the Freebuff CLI or Web UI.

506a760c80c202983ffb04369b60357e0794277d.title: Print prompt during evals
506a760c80c202983ffb04369b60357e0794277d.summary: Added console log in evals/scaffolding.ts loopMainPrompt to print the prompt before execution. Uses picocolors blue for visibility. Internal evals tooling change.

e2b522b7208e4b6c6c3edd96f207458b77ef1340.title: Remove workers copy from npm-app postbuild
e2b522b7208e4b6c6c3edd96f207458b77ef1340.summary: postbuild script in npm-app/package.json no longer copies src/workers to dist/src/workers. Change reverts prior addition of worker bundling step. Scope limited to npm-app build pipeline. tsc-alias remains final step.

cedba23a052dd10e0e19fd0f5b47196058dcf7f2.title: Saxy ignores unclosed tags
cedba23a052dd10e0e19fd0f5b47196058dcf7f2.summary: Saxy parser no longer throws Error on unclosed tags. Node.tagClose case now returns silently instead of invoking callback with error. Affects common/src/util/saxy.ts.

f91c7f4911e4ade7152333ea11effa84c8b073bd.title: Fix checkpoint manager import path
f91c7f4911e4ade7152333ea11effa84c8b073bd.summary: Corrected relative import path in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts`. Replaced `src/project-files` with `../project-files` to ensure proper module resolution. Minor whitespace formatting adjustments also included.
