Previously, `setProjectRoot` was called without updating the local reference, causing subsequent relative path resolutions within the same execution context to use stale root paths. This change ensures `projectRoot` reflects the new directory immediately after the `cd` command is processed. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`.

d9361f97059416156af3b2b2706f8c0ba49ae077.title: Fix toolcall tracking and update Haiku costs
d9361f97059416156af3b2b2706f8c0ba49ae077.summary: Updated @anthropic-ai/sdk to ^0.33.1 and adjusted Haiku token costs in `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts`. Refactored `backend/src/claude.ts` to remove redundant API key checks, switch to `logger.error`, and ensure `saveMessage` runs unconditionally on `message_delta` unless database logging is ignored. Fixed stream processing in `backend/src/process-stream.ts` to continue instead of break on completion. Simplified `start-server` script in root `package.json`.

e47cfaa4d0d93073fecdbe019fae9a8a87edc43c.title: Fix Stripe webhook quota update for downgrades
e47cfaa4d0d93073fecdbe019fae9a8a87edc43c.summary: Stripe webhook `handleSubscriptionChange` now sets `baseQuota` directly from `PLAN_CONFIGS[usageTier].limit` instead of querying `AuthenticatedQuotaManager.getStripeSubscriptionQuota`. This ensures downgrades apply the new plan's quota immediately. Cancellation detection logic updated to use `subscription.canceled_at` timestamp (checking if <= 5 minutes from now) rather than `cancellation_details.reason`, correctly handling scheduled cancellations.

0848e5169e83b1cc9d6b335d7f518e42a54d4fa6.title: Clarify git push permission in system prompt
0848e5169e83b1cc9d6b335d7f518e42a54d4fa6.summary: Updated system prompt to explicitly state that user requests to commit changes do not imply permission to push. This change modifies the guidelines for the `git commit` and `git rebase` commands in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The update ensures the agent requires explicit permission for push operations, preventing unintended remote repository updates.

bb7a30ef9cea709728f973a3a9042fa064f8a5ec.title: Correct typecheck command in knowledge.md
bb7a30ef9cea709728f973a3a9042fa064f8a5ec.summary: Updated verification instructions in knowledge.md to use `bun run --cwd backend typecheck` instead of `bun run --cwd backend tsc`. This ensures developers run the correct script defined in package.json for type checking. Scope limited to internal documentation.

d91ef3f135dd1cca6dcda7b8dc7f98f097c5edf0.title: system-prompt.ts cap file tree tokens
d91ef3f135dd1cca6dcda7b8dc7f98f097c5edf0.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts caps project file tree prompt tokens at 100,000 via Math.min in getProjectFileTreePrompt. miscTokens budgets increased to 10,000 (search) and 15,000 (agent) to account for system info and response format prompts. Agent context file tree inclusion now evaluated by token count (2,500 lite / 10,000 max) rather than string length. logger.debug calls expanded to report granular token breakdowns for files, tree, system info, and response format.

db5076fef7fe4d056544d1fe80ce722266a15f7f.title: Update system prompt for git push and script safety
db5076fef7fe4d056544d1fe80ce722266a15f7f.summary: Tightened command execution guidelines in backend/src/system-prompt.ts to explicitly prohibit `git push` without permission and restrict scripts with side effects. Replaced vague 'probably don't run scripts' with strict side-effect checks, and clarified the 30-second timeout by specifying `npm start` alongside `npm run dev` as examples of forbidden long-running processes.

7043e237da9c08540c354264c1ccaf0e1814272f.title: Rename --pro to --max in CLI and docs
7043e237da9c08540c354264c1ccaf0e1814272f.summary: The premium mode flag `--pro` is renamed to `--max`, with `--o1` added as an alias. Internal `costMode` remains 'pro'. Docs in `modes.knowledge.md`, `npm-app/README.md`, and `web/src/content/help/*` reflect the new name and model usage details. CLI help text in `npm-app/src/index.ts` lists `--max, --pro, --o1`.

c3fa982685f2b2cf8d9117c1074bf488fb1cf199.title: Rename pro mode to max and deprecate --pro flag
c3fa982685f2b2cf8d9117c1074bf488fb1cf199.summary: Cost mode 'pro' renamed to 'max' across core constants, CLI, and prompts. The --pro flag now triggers a deprecation warning and exits, forcing users to restart with --max. Plan display name changed from 'Pro Max' to 'Pro Plus'. Updates cover backend logic, npm-app CLI, and documentation.

b361e9fe6f8e32245a7c08f0284e2f75eb82bbfb.title: ripgrep prompt clarifies automatic quote handling
b361e9fe6f8e32245a7c08f0284e2f75eb82bbfb.summary: System prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` updated to inform agent that quotes are automatically added around code search patterns. Previous instruction required manual quoting for special characters; now directs user to escape characters like '-' or '.' instead. Affects internal LLM guidance for `code_search` tool.

bb7a30ef9cea709728f973a3a9042fa064f8a5ec.text: Internal instructions for checking software health were corrected. You will see no change in how the product works.

0193b3a0d465ba1adf4ed441230b342e9ce781fb.text: A small internal fix ensures the tool correctly tracks your current folder after navigation. This prevents errors when accessing files using relative paths.

0848e5169e83b1cc9d6b335d7f518e42a54d4fa6.text: The assistant now needs your clear permission before sending changes to a shared online location. This prevents it from updating shared files automatically when you only ask it to save your work.

b361e9fe6f8e32245a7c08f0284e2f75eb82bbfb.text: A small internal update helps the assistant search text more reliably. You no longer need to format your search words in a special way.

c3fa982685f2b2cf8d9117c1074bf488fb1cf199.text: The 'Pro' setting is now called 'Max'. If you previously used the 'Pro' option, you must restart the application using 'Max' to continue.

7043e237da9c08540c354264c1ccaf0e1814272f.text: The premium mode button label changed from 'Pro' to 'Max'.

d9361f97059416156af3b2b2706f8c0ba49ae077.text: Fixed how usage is tracked and updated pricing. Costs are now calculated correctly.

e47cfaa4d0d93073fecdbe019fae9a8a87edc43c.text: When you switch to a smaller plan, your usage limits now update immediately. If you cancel your subscription, the system correctly recognizes it as an active cancellation.

d91ef3f135dd1cca6dcda7b8dc7f98f097c5edf0.text: The assistant now limits how much file information it processes to prevent slowdowns. It also uses smarter checks to ensure responses stay quick and accurate.

db5076fef7fe4d056544d1fe80ce722266a15f7f.text: The assistant now requires permission before sharing changes and avoids running background programs that could slow down the system.

b44f1d9a895a0797a3df472e2617707c2f0b7081.title: Fix terminal first command execution on Windows
b44f1d9a895a0797a3df472e2617707c2f0b7081.summary: Added logic in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` to trim the prompt identifier from the first line of terminal output when it appears. This fixes an issue where the first command wasn't executing correctly on Windows due to prompt interference. The change applies specifically to the `runTerminalCommand` function's data handling.

f008686b5ffc15440d464376d1b08b1a98f98f23.title: Terminal: Use special prompt ID to detect complete commands
f008686b5ffc15440d464376d1b08b1a98f98f23.summary: Terminal command detection switched from fragile regex patterns to a unique string identifier `@36261@`. This prevents false positives when command output mimics standard shell prompts. Unix shells now receive `--login` and have `PS1` explicitly set post-RC sourcing. Windows relies on the `PROMPT` environment variable. Changes apply to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`.

f68b71753130d7822e19cfc2c1b30632ffcc8a34.title: Payment change page replaces generic success redirect
f68b71753130d7822e19cfc2c1b30632ffcc8a34.summary: New /payment-change page handles plan modifications. Replaces static /payment-success redirect with dynamic confirmation showing current plan limits. Updates web app routing and adds plan-change.png asset. Onboard page image source updated from .jpg to .png.

36927f7bdb7ac9fba3b030e4983e3211baddabb2.title: calculate-average-spend splits new vs existing
36927f7bdb7ac9fba3b030e4983e3211baddabb2.summary: calculate-average-spend.ts now separates new and existing customers by first invoice date, reporting per-group totals. Queries 2 months of paid Stripe invoices to establish history, but counts only last 30 days for spend. Adds top spenders list for customers over $49 and sorts distribution ranges by count descending.

c42c1d8fc932b4b33f75238ccdcf68b11539c902.title: GPT-4o and reduced context for file reading checks
c42c1d8fc932b4b33f75238ccdcf68b11539c902.summary: File-reading decision logic now uses gpt-4o for non-lite modes, replacing the previous gpt-4o-mini default. The prompt sent to this model was significantly trimmed, removing the system message and project file tree in favor of conversation history and the user request. This change targets speed and accuracy in determining whether new files need to be read. Scope is limited to backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts and common/src/constants.ts.

3e66e5307621f23e926f16efde9dcc61f0482756.title: Add typecheck script to scripts package
3e66e5307621f23e926f16efde9dcc61f0482756.summary: Added `typecheck` script to `scripts/package.json` and configured project references in `scripts/tsconfig.json` pointing to `../backend` and `../common`. This enables isolated type checking for the scripts package, ensuring dependencies are correctly resolved during CI or local development. Scope limited to internal tooling configuration.

baba7b8b0a573668dbc63cccdfce33348204b2f4.title: Add Stripe billing portal link to user dropdown
baba7b8b0a573668dbc63cccdfce33348204b2f4.summary: User dropdown now routes active subscribers to the Stripe customer portal with a prefilled email. Previously, active users saw a disabled 'You are on the pro tier!' button. The `FreePlanButton` also accepts `userEmail` to prefill the portal on downgrades. Changes affect `web/src/components/navbar/user-dropdown.tsx`, `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`, and `web/src/components/pricing/free-plan-button.tsx`.

35cfba10d6e1cfe94f7669dcc5b11a9713b64934.title: Scale down file tree tokens based on message count
35cfba10d6e1cfe94f7669dcc5b11a9713b64934.summary: The system prompt generators now accept a `messagesTokens` argument to calculate dynamic token budgets for the file tree. `getSearchSystemPrompt` and `getAgentSystemPrompt` subtract message tokens and a fixed 5k misc buffer from the context limit (64k/200k) to determine the remaining space for file content. This prevents context overflow by scaling down the included file tree when message history grows. The `FILE_TOKEN_BUDGET` constant in `main-prompt.ts` was also reduced from 30k/90k to 25k/80k.

506c48b036eaf6147d393735610cf963d92889fa.title: Add description to Stripe meter events for referral credits
506c48b036eaf6147d393735610cf963d92889fa.summary: Referral credit adjustments now include a description field in the Stripe billing.meterEvents.create payload, removing the previous invoices.update call. This change ensures credit visibility in invoice line items without modifying invoice descriptions during checkout sessions, per updated billing knowledge docs. Scope limited to web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts and backend/src/billing/billing.knowledge.md. Meter events with negative values remain the preferred method for usage-based credits over coupons or invoice metadata edits.

f455c371952754aa6399023a9e599d0e6b2dfd86.title: CLI tab complete matches common prefix
f455c371952754aa6399023a9e599d0e6b2dfd86.summary: Tab completion in npm-app/src/cli.ts now auto-completes to the longest common prefix when multiple tokens match the current word. This behavior is implemented by extracting suffixes from matching tokens and iteratively finding shared characters. The 'print' command was also added to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts.

f68b71753130d7822e19cfc2c1b30632ffcc8a34.text: When you change your plan, you now see a confirmation page showing your new limits instead of a generic success message.

506c48b036eaf6147d393735610cf963d92889fa.text: Referral credits now appear clearly in billing records without altering invoice descriptions. This ensures users see credit adjustments accurately when reviewing their bills.

b44f1d9a895a0797a3df472e2617707c2f0b7081.text: A small internal fix ensures the first command you enter in the terminal works correctly on Windows.

baba7b8b0a573668dbc63cccdfce33348204b2f4.text: Subscribers can now click a link in their profile menu to manage their account details and payment information directly. This replaces a previous button that only showed their current plan status.

f455c371952754aa6399023a9e599d0e6b2dfd86.text: Typing a partial command and pressing the completion key now fills in the shared letters automatically. This saves you from typing the rest of the command if the start is unique. A printing command was also added to the list of skipped steps.

35cfba10d6e1cfe94f7669dcc5b11a9713b64934.text: The assistant now adjusts how much file content it includes based on chat length to prevent memory overflow.

f008686b5ffc15440d464376d1b08b1a98f98f23.text: The system now uses a unique marker to tell the difference between real commands and text that just looks like one. This makes the terminal more reliable by preventing it from getting confused by output that mimics standard prompts.

3e66e5307621f23e926f16efde9dcc61f0482756.text: A small internal tool update improves how the system checks its own code for errors. This helps keep the product stable without changing anything you see.

c42c1d8fc932b4b33f75238ccdcf68b11539c902.text: The system now uses a smarter model to decide which files to read. This change aims to make responses faster and more accurate.

36927f7bdb7ac9fba3b030e4983e3211baddabb2.text: The report now separates new customers from existing ones to show spending for each group. This helps you see exactly how much money comes from first-time buyers versus returning ones.

caad2a8f527d86af19df2b4268cfeb8ca0b94d24.title: Fix typos in system prompt terminal command guidance
caad2a8f527d86af19df2b4268cfeb8ca0b94d24.summary: Corrected text errors in backend/src/system-prompt.ts. Fixed missing parentheses in test execution example and misspelled 'globally' in permission guidelines. Internal documentation update only.

b37633c1c9c60972bc76d853f4c9675e772f34a7.title: Tighten terminal command safety and timeout guidance in system prompt
b37633c1c9c60972bc76d853f4c9675e772f34a7.summary: The system prompt for the `run_terminal_command` tool was updated to enforce stricter safety guidelines and clarify execution constraints. A 30-second timeout limit was explicitly added, prohibiting long-running or server-starting commands. Instructions regarding script execution were hardened, requiring explicit user permission for actions with permanent effects or significant environmental changes like installing global packages or virtual environments. Redundant references to grep/find and test script examples were removed or simplified to focus on core safety mechanics.

5d25488cfc53270b3a014df054637b3fd4dbec5e.title: Revert git stage new changes in cli.ts
5d25488cfc53270b3a014df054637b3fd4dbec5e.summary: Reverted commit fixing git staging logic in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Staging condition reverted to use allChanges instead of changesAlreadyApplied. Internal CLI logic adjustment.

854143b9093caeabb5a147fc7eb953493663a586.title: Fix git stage condition in CLI
854143b9093caeabb5a147fc7eb953493663a586.summary: The CLI now checks `changesAlreadyApplied.length` instead of `allChanges.length` when determining whether to stage files. This corrects the logic to only trigger `stagePatches` when there are actual changes to stage, preventing unnecessary operations or errors when no changes are present. The fix is isolated to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

377d549540468ab0aa8fdabd38b2db573e87a628.title: Add onWebSocketReconnect callback to APIRealtimeClient
377d549540468ab0aa8fdabd38b2db573e87a628.summary: APIRealtimeClient now accepts an onReconnect callback invoked upon successful reconnection, replacing hardcoded console logging. CLI and Client classes updated to pass this callback, ensuring proper UI state reset (prompting, stopping animations) via returnControlToUser. Covers common/websocket-client.ts and npm-app client/cli implementations.

e5e8438d6a64ffec26f9af957516d14bbf060a23.title: CI typecheck scripts split into package-local and full-build variants
e5e8438d6a64ffec26f9af957516d14bbf060a23.summary: CI workflow calls `typecheck-this-package` instead of `build`/`typecheck` for backend, npm-app, and web. Each package now defines `typecheck-this-package` (tsc --noEmit + tsc-alias) and a wrapper `typecheck` that builds `common` (and `code-map` for npm-app) first. Scope: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `backend/package.json`, `npm-app/package.json`, `web/package.json`. Backend previously ran `build` (tsc --build + tsc-alias) in CI; now runs `typecheck-this-package` (tsc --noEmit + tsc-alias), aligning with other packages.

beb7c4ab2ec83b7d54ebed31d8c542f291857aaa.title: Add git stage flag to Client
beb7c4ab2ec83b7d54ebed31d8c542f291857aaa.summary: Client constructor accepts git parameter. stagePatches called before applyChanges when git equals stage. CLI passes this.git to Client. Ensures files are staged prior to modification.

013a51e080edf3d610661982eac933a5ea0ad8f3.title: Fix terminal.ts import path
013a51e080edf3d610661982eac933a5ea0ad8f3.summary: Corrected import path in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` from `src/project-files` to `../project-files`. Resolves module resolution errors during build. No user-facing behavior change.

92608f821299aba1dba330d57c1b0dfb3fcfaebe.title: Anon tier limit reduced to 250 credits
92608f821299aba1dba330d57c1b0dfb3fcfaebe.summary: The ANON plan configuration in common/src/constants.ts reduces the credit limit from 500 to 250. This change enforces stricter usage constraints for unauthenticated users. The modification applies globally via the shared core constants.

3609a538a5f3139cf9a405b48e71d1114fec3566.title: Upgrade @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch to 0.12.0-beta.5
3609a538a5f3139cf9a405b48e71d1114fec3566.summary: Bumped optional dependency @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch from 0.11.14 to 0.12.0-beta.5 in npm-app/package.json. Update targets pty prebuilt multiarch support. Scope limited to npm-app package and lockfile.

b37633c1c9c60972bc76d853f4c9675e772f34a7.text: The assistant now stops commands that take too long and asks for permission before making major changes to your computer. This keeps your system safer and prevents it from getting stuck.

377d549540468ab0aa8fdabd38b2db573e87a628.text: When the connection drops and returns, the app now automatically resets the screen instead of leaving a loading animation running.

caad2a8f527d86af19df2b4268cfeb8ca0b94d24.text: Small internal text corrections were made to the assistant's instructions. This fixes minor errors in how it explains certain actions to users.

e5e8438d6a64ffec26f9af957516d14bbf060a23.text: The team improved the automatic checks that scan the software for errors. These checks are now faster and cover more areas, helping to catch problems before they reach you.

92608f821299aba1dba330d57c1b0dfb3fcfaebe.text: Users without an account now get 250 free credits instead of 500. This limit applies everywhere in the product.

beb7c4ab2ec83b7d54ebed31d8c542f291857aaa.text: The app now automatically saves changes to a temporary holding area before applying them. This small internal update helps keep your work organized and prevents accidental loss.

854143b9093caeabb5a147fc7eb953493663a586.text: The assistant now checks if changes exist before saving them. This prevents unnecessary work and errors when nothing needs to be saved.

3609a538a5f3139cf9a405b48e71d1114fec3566.text: A small internal update improves how the app handles text terminals. This may make the experience smoother for some users.

013a51e080edf3d610661982eac933a5ea0ad8f3.text: Fixed a behind-the-scenes problem that stopped the program from working correctly when built. No visible changes for you.

5d25488cfc53270b3a014df054637b3fd4dbec5e.text: The tool now looks at every update, not just the ones it already applied, when saving your work.

6546a77b438f1d8a268a4f2f767a213d05f27e6a.title: Code search output preview limited to 3 lines
6546a77b438f1d8a268a4f2f767a213d05f27e6a.summary: handleCodeSearch in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts now prints up to 3 lines of raw grep results before the count. Header format changed to 'Searching [basename] for "pattern":'. Full output remains truncated to 10000 chars for the agent.

a7f8c0182cbbedd3a18e79f9809c8544ede315a7.title: Remove --login flag from persistent PTY spawn
a7f8c0182cbbedd3a18e79f9809c8544ede315a7.summary: The `pty.spawn` call in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` no longer passes `--login` to non-Windows shells. This change ensures persistent PTYs start without login shell overhead or potential profile conflicts. Scope is limited to the internal terminal utility used by the CLI.

91537f0d53f45b8dc993fedfff319536140140b5.title: Fix stream start event for empty chunks in client
91537f0d53f45b8dc993fedfff319536140140b5.summary: The client now checks `chunk.trim()` before triggering `onStreamStart()`. This prevents the stream start event from firing on empty or whitespace-only chunks, ensuring it only activates when actual content is received. The change affects `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

917bbde1858dc6cc6c07edbd59d9e256fdb8d1da.title: Terminal execution timeout raised to 30 seconds
917bbde1858dc6cc6c07edbd59d9e256fdb8d1da.summary: MAX_EXECUTION_TIME constant in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts increased from 10_000 to 30_000 milliseconds. Allows longer-running commands to complete without premature termination. Internal utility change affecting terminal command execution limits.

473544be8885257c683c7ec3ff33551956ac9a17.title: Add average spend calculation script
473544be8885257c683c7ec3ff33551956ac9a17.summary: New `scripts/calculate-average-spend.ts` computes average monthly spend per customer from Stripe invoices. It aggregates paid invoices from the last 30 days, normalizes cents to dollars, and outputs total spend, average per customer, and spend distribution buckets. Internal tooling only; no user-facing behavior changes.

dd07bc673668d98facdf9bee7a38d26be7721cf1.title: Add lockfiles to default ignored files
dd07bc673668d98facdf9bee7a38d26be7721cf1.summary: Added `package-lock.json` and `bun.lockb` to `DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES` in `common/src/constants.ts`. Prevents agent from processing large dependency manifests. Scope limited to core shared constants.

f1590167d684f272710b2b2e319ef7239b74c069.title: Suppress redundant output when prompt detected in tool handler
f1590167d684f272710b2b2e319ef7239b74c069.summary: Removes manual stdout writing and newline appending when a prompt is detected in `handleRunTerminalCommand` within `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. This prevents duplicate output display, as the stream is already handled elsewhere or disposed immediately after detection. Scope is limited to the terminal command tool handler. The `dataDisposable` and `clearTimeout` calls remain to properly clean up the listener.

d02430ff07e656278bf8926cafb01b6e4c831e18.title: Extract runTerminalCommand to utils/terminal
d02430ff07e656278bf8926cafb01b6e4c831e18.summary: Moved `runTerminalCommand`, `resetPtyShell`, and PTY logic from `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` to new file `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. Added `truncateStringWithMessage` helper in `common/src/util/string.ts` to handle output truncation with explicit markers. Updated imports in `npm-app/src/index.ts` and `tool-handlers.ts` to reflect the new module structure. This refactor isolates terminal execution concerns from general tool handlers.

f27dc96467a6e1a6504927fb60566d2a485f89f7.title: Terminal PTY spawn adds login flag, UTF-8 locale, resize handler
f27dc96467a6e1a6504927fb60566d2a485f89f7.summary: createPty in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts spawns Unix shells with `--login` flag and sets `LANG`/`LC_ALL` to `en_US.UTF-8`. Windows PTY spawn remains flagless. Added `process.stdout.on('resize')` handler forwards `pty.resize` to persistent process. `SHELL` env var now strips `.exe` suffix via `shell.split('.')[0]`. Documented in npm-app/knowledge.md.

Updated `where-codebuff-shines.mdx` clarifies the file pattern and removes redundant task tips. Scope limited to web content tips.

6573107d01347935aadf697c09bca758bdb5e9ce.title: Add interactive terminal demo and PostHog analytics
6573107d01347935aadf697c09bca758bdb5e9ce.summary: Landing page now features an interactive terminal demo backed by a new `/api/demo` route using DeepSeek. PostHog analytics integrated for web traffic, requiring user consent via `CookieConsentCard`. Scope covers `web` package, including new components, API routes, and provider setup.

c77783dc1a17c67ec0a9a146dd070e0dbcec5d46.text: The website now correctly shows the 'Get Started' button to people who are not logged in. Previously, these visitors might have seen a confusing 'Downgrade' option instead.

2043ab4a67b6cd5f4ed1819b90a8c263516b14e4.text: The assistant can now recognize more Windows command prompt styles when it runs commands. This helps it understand where a command is being entered in Windows. It is a small internal improvement with no visible change for users.

6573107d01347935aadf697c09bca758bdb5e9ce.text: The website now shows a live demo that lets you try the assistant directly. It also added a consent pop-up to track visitor activity.

8c81f3aa4e37a2cb5dd1547c2b18e039ef512b19.text: The assistant now recognizes when it tries to skip writing parts of a file and automatically rewrites the whole thing instead. This ensures you get complete files without missing sections.

d35d51e295dfede403c0df56a48b5039d045db31.text: The assistant can now run on computers that block certain background features. If one feature fails, it automatically switches to a backup method so the program keeps working.

e71a809870d31cd002ccb4cca70a60e646aedcfb.text: Visitors who are not signed in now see an 'Upgrade' button on the pricing page. Clicking this button takes them to the login page first.

38aeb1c921aa31c27514693c07df77e715c2827b.text: A small internal fix corrected a naming mismatch that could cause the app to fail. This change improves reliability for everyone using the product.

aeb348fdcaeca28f3de97d59c3083b2144f69a25.text: Added instructions on how to share project details with the assistant. This helps the assistant understand your work better.

b3d5eaab4e0c94e8a8296df4865f63d2b989e86b.text: The tool now uses a simpler rule to decide when to save previous changes. This internal cleanup makes the code easier to maintain but does not change how you use the product.

99d576e61c043c7a94ab28bed7e116e699311e0c.text: A small internal update teaches the assistant to use precise instructions for changing files. This helps prevent accidental data loss or incomplete edits when the tool updates content.

d3f2357b21c36b29846d3bc35ac92bc9c3cc49c2.title: Fix code search pipe handling and add result count
d3f2357b21c36b29846d3bc35ac92bc9c3cc49c2.summary: handleCodeSearch now strips double quotes from input.pattern before wrapping it in shell-safe double quotes for ripgrep. This fixes failures when the pattern contains pipe characters or existing quotes. The tool handler also prints the number of results found using stdout line count. Changes are limited to npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

017f18a6991ec32e11a7e393b70e282c9bd49f21.title: Windows PTY spawns cmd.exe outside PowerShell
017f18a6991ec32e11a7e393b70e282c9bd49f21.summary: npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts createPty now calls detectShell() to pick powershell.exe or cmd.exe on win32, replacing hardcoded powershell.exe. New npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts probes $PSVersionTable, COMSPEC, and parent process via wmic/ps to resolve the active shell. Scope limited to CLI tool handlers; Web/Desktop unaffected. Unix path still defaults to bash.

9330c43a06996ca4d64ff92f38d1b661facd6df4.title: Revert Windows cmd.exe shell detection
9330c43a06996ca4d64ff92f38d1b661facd6df4.summary: Reverts Windows shell detection logic in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. `createPty` now hardcodes `powershell.exe` for `win32` and `bash` otherwise, removing the `detectShell` import. Deletes `npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts` which previously used `execSync` and `wmic` to identify parent shells. Scope limited to CLI tool handlers; no user-facing config changes.

e73fbb33f6392a6c3bf10bf29201761c337cb3f4.title: Add German error detection to handleRunTerminalCommand
e73fbb33f6392a6c3bf10bf29201761c337cb3f4.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand now checks for additional German error strings indicating command not found in PowerShell. This improves error handling for non-English locales. Affects npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

7b75881543bc0af917b79daa032c27848ac84b62.title: AWS keys in .env.example and Claude retry logic refactor
7b75881543bc0af917b79daa032c27848ac84b62.summary: Added AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY to .env.example. Refactored promptClaudeStream in backend/src/claude.ts to use manual loop with exponential backoff for APIConnectionError instead of withRetry. Removed obsolete sections from backend/knowledge.md.

9432f8961c0bcaa8d7a21768f833e02d4c7fadac.title: Windows PTY spawns cmd.exe outside PowerShell
9432f8961c0bcaa8d7a21768f833e02d4c7fadac.summary: Reverts previous revert to restore `cmd.exe` fallback for Windows PTY creation when not running within PowerShell. `createPty` in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` now calls `detectShell()` from new `npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts` to determine the active shell. `detectShell` checks `$PSVersionTable` via `execSync` to identify PowerShell, falling back to `COMSPEC` or parent process inspection via `wmic` for `cmd.exe`. Unix systems continue to use `bash`.

16ff9a300de5251929aaf5a429704d4eca67f7bb.title: Stripe webhook handles expired canceled unpaid subscription states
16ff9a300de5251929aaf5a429704d4eca67f7bb.summary: Stripe webhook route.ts adds ts-pattern match for customer.subscription.updated. Handles incomplete_expired, unpaid, and immediate canceled states by downgrading to UsageLimits.FREE. Preserves current plan for cancel_at_period_end: true until subscription.deleted event. Other states (active, trialing, past_due) proceed with existing plan resolution logic.

3abfb85ab2fa33ecb2e02d339132beb0b4f78461.title: Persistent PTY shell replaces childprocess for terminal commands
3abfb85ab2fa33ecb2e02d339132beb0b4f78461.summary: Terminal command execution in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts switched from `child_process.spawn` to a persistent `node-pty` shell. This unifies stdout/stderr into a single stream, matching real terminal behavior and simplifying output parsing. The CLI and tool handlers now rely on `resetPtyShell` for initialization and timeout recovery, removing separate stderr handling. Jest testing infrastructure added via `npm-app/jest.config.js` and `package.json` devDependencies.

a698cd8441363e0d429b1e191b7295ce9880620c.title: Add MRR calculation script
a698cd8441363e0d429b1e191b7295ce9880620c.summary: Added scripts/calculate-mrr.ts to compute Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Annual Run Rate (ARR) via Stripe API. The script paginates active subscriptions, filters out those scheduled for cancellation (cancel_at_period_end), and sums only licensed base fees. Exposed as bun run --cwd scripts mrr in scripts/package.json. Documented in backend/src/billing/billing.knowledge.md.

0d8894ca77aef154b2d414afb75c21846988c335.title: Self-serve plan upgrades for Pro and Moar Pro
0d8894ca77aef154b2d414afb75c21846988c335.summary: Adds self-serve plan changes for `PRO` and `MOAR_PRO` through `web/src/app/api/stripe/subscription/change/route.ts`, new `common/src/types/plan.ts`, and subscription confirm UI components, supporting multiple subscription tiers with licensed base and metered overage items. `common/src/constants.ts` replaces `PAID`/`PRO_PLUS` limits with `PLAN_CONFIGS`, `OVERAGE_RATE_PRO`, `OVERAGE_RATE_MOAR_PRO`, and `BILLING_PERIOD_DAYS`; `common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts` now defaults to `PRO`. `backend/src/env.mjs` removes `STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_ID`, while `.env.example` adds per-tier Stripe price IDs, `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL`, and provider API key entries. Claude streaming retries move to shared `withRetry` in `common/src/util/promise.ts`, applying only to `APIConnectionError`.

e73fbb33f6392a6c3bf10bf29201761c337cb3f4.text: The assistant now recognizes error messages in German when a command fails. This helps it explain problems clearly for users who set their computer language to German.

16ff9a300de5251929aaf5a429704d4eca67f7bb.text: A background update improves how the system recognizes when a subscription ends or payment fails. This ensures users lose access to paid features immediately when required, preventing accidental free usage.

a698cd8441363e0d429b1e191b7295ce9880620c.text: The company added a tool to calculate monthly and annual revenue from subscription data. This is an internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

3abfb85ab2fa33ecb2e02d339132beb0b4f78461.text: The system now runs commands in a single, steady channel like a real terminal window. This makes the output easier to read and handle.

d3f2357b21c36b29846d3bc35ac92bc9c3cc49c2.text: The search feature now handles special characters correctly and displays the total number of results found.

017f18a6991ec32e11a7e393b70e282c9bd49f21.text: The assistant now automatically detects which system command tool you are using on Windows instead of forcing one type. This small internal change fixes a startup issue so the assistant works correctly regardless of your default settings.

9330c43a06996ca4d64ff92f38d1b661facd6df4.text: The system now uses a fixed program for running commands on Windows instead of checking which program is active. This internal change makes command execution more consistent without affecting how you use the product.

9432f8961c0bcaa8d7a21768f833e02d4c7fadac.text: The program now correctly chooses the right command tool on Windows. This internal fix helps it run commands reliably when not using the main system shell.

7b75881543bc0af917b79daa032c27848ac84b62.text: The assistant now handles connection errors more reliably and the setup instructions were updated. This change is internal and does not affect user experience.

0d8894ca77aef154b2d414afb75c21846988c335.text: You can now upgrade or change your plan directly inside the app. This gives you control over your subscription without needing to contact support.

6a3165ecbf753be2ffc95b333e6b0520b47bdd45.title: Reduce anonymous tier credits to 250
6a3165ecbf753be2ffc95b333e6b0520b47bdd45.summary: Anonymous tier credit limit reduced from 500 to 250 in common/src/constants.ts. Updates CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS for ANON. Affects quota enforcement logic.

673bb02bba2b4e4e1886a17a0facb9cfb19e797b.title: German command not found detection
673bb02bba2b4e4e1886a17a0facb9cfb19e797b.summary: Added German error string 'ist entweder falsch geschrieben oder konnte nicht gefunden werden' to command failure detection in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. Fixes false negatives when shell outputs localized errors. Scope limited to terminal command handler.

378b851f01a1bd8f4a8ac4e83f2e31d8d65d2508.title: gpt4o fallback rewrite in pro mode
378b851f01a1bd8f4a8ac4e83f2e31d8d65d2508.summary: processFileBlock now threads costMode to applyRemainingChanges. Fallback rewrite model switches from gpt4omini to gpt4o when costMode === 'pro'. Internal backend logic; no user-facing config or model picker change.

6f539a6136f42ed8db0e420e471ee07f380ca725.title: Add German command not found detection
6f539a6136f42ed8db0e420e471ee07f380ca725.summary: Added 'Der Befehl' string check to error detection logic in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. This enables proper identification of German-language 'command not found' errors during terminal command execution. Scope limited to internal error handling utilities.

0cb901cdd22d5e3ab65784b92843a5ef07a8f67a.title: DeepSeek model added for diff retries in lite cost mode
0cb901cdd22d5e3ab65784b92843a5ef07a8f67a.summary: The `retryDiffBlocksPrompt` function in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` now accepts a `costMode` parameter. When `costMode` is set to 'lite', the system uses `promptDeepseek` with the `models.deepseekChat` model instead of `promptClaude` with `models.sonnet`. The `processFileBlock` and `mainPrompt` functions were updated to propagate the `costMode` argument through the call chain. This change reduces costs for diff retry operations in lite mode by leveraging a cheaper model.

890b5912499975c4ea7f615e6a74dddd5241c641.title: Filter hallucinated new files in getFileVersionUpdates
890b5912499975c4ea7f615e6a74dddd5241c641.summary: getFileVersionUpdates now filters newFiles to existingNewFilePaths before calling getRelevantFileInfoMessage. Checks loadedFiles[path] and content !== null. Prevents hallucinated files from triggering file info messages.

ee30ecb6f13737dc8dbfae749174dffefd7f31f7.title: Add prev/next navigation to docs category pages
ee30ecb6f13737dc8dbfae749174dffefd7f31f7.summary: Added DocNavigation component to docs category pages, rendering prev/next links based on section order. Uses sections array from doc-sidebar to determine adjacent categories. Component placed after sortedDocs map in page.tsx.

4a1c1090ec8373b0f2e1242fab2d79bf473ee973.title: Remove generate-knowledge-files, pass costMode to planning
4a1c1090ec8373b0f2e1242fab2d79bf473ee973.summary: Deleted backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts. Updated backend/src/planning.ts and backend/src/main-prompt.ts to thread costMode into getSearchSystemPrompt. Fixes type errors from missing parameter.

8b70e9059a23d07ab8233568dabbb5de21f24ddd.title: Docs layout flexbox fix
8b70e9059a23d07ab8233568dabbb5de21f24ddd.summary: Docs layout uses flexbox for main content and mobile sheet. Sidebar links handle external subsections correctly. Updates `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx` and `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`. External subsection links now use `target=_blank`.

ae3804a62d8269be646f6b94cd9436b94a56492b.title: Revert persistent shell and colors
ae3804a62d8269be646f6b94cd9436b94a56492b.summary: Reverts persistent PTY shell implementation, restoring child_process spawn for terminal commands. Removes node-pty dependency and associated terminal emulation logic. Updates handleRunTerminalCommand to return separate stdout and stderr streams instead of combined PTY output. Affects npm-app CLI, tool handlers, and backend prompt processing.

0cb901cdd22d5e3ab65784b92843a5ef07a8f67a.text: When the system retries a failed task in lite cost mode, it now uses a cheaper, less powerful assistant model instead of the standard one. This saves money for the provider without changing the outcome for you.

378b851f01a1bd8f4a8ac4e83f2e31d8d65d2508.text: In pro mode, the system now uses a smarter backup option when the main one fails. This internal update improves reliability without changing how you use the product.

ee30ecb6f13737dc8dbfae749174dffefd7f31f7.text: Documentation pages now show previous and next links. Readers can move between sections without using the menu.

8b70e9059a23d07ab8233568dabbb5de21f24ddd.text: A small internal fix improves how the documentation pages arrange their content. Links to outside resources now open in new windows, preventing accidental navigation away from the help guides.

6f539a6136f42ed8db0e420e471ee07f380ca725.text: The system now recognizes German 'command not found' errors. This helps the tool handle these messages correctly when running commands.

ae3804a62d8269be646f6b94cd9436b94a56492b.text: The system switched back to an older way of running terminal commands. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

890b5912499975c4ea7f615e6a74dddd5241c641.text: The assistant now ignores reports of files that do not actually exist. This prevents it from trying to read or describe non-existent files.

4a1c1090ec8373b0f2e1242fab2d79bf473ee973.text: The team removed an unused background task and improved how the assistant selects information sources based on cost settings. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

6a3165ecbf753be2ffc95b333e6b0520b47bdd45.text: People who use the service without creating an account now get half as many free credits. This means they can ask fewer questions before needing to sign up.

673bb02bba2b4e4e1886a17a0facb9cfb19e797b.text: The assistant now recognizes German error messages when a command fails. This helps it give correct feedback instead of missing the problem. This is a small internal fix.

ea07c1a5ac11e6650f7b1b2dd17d46d7f730652a.title: Navbar right alignment
ea07c1a5ac11e6650f7b1b2dd17d46d7f730652a.summary: Added `ml-auto` to the navbar `nav` element in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. This pushes the links to the right side of the container, preventing distraction from the logo.

7d63183f5701c34d55ed2671dbca5120c0b1259e.title: Version bump to 1.0.124
7d63183f5701c34d55ed2671dbca5120c0b1259e.summary: Version bump to 1.0.124. Routine release increment. Covers npm-app/package.json.

a42ced07e08c3226a8584e9f6972afd158b6409a.title: Reduce file token budgets in lite cost mode
a42ced07e08c3226a8584e9f6972afd158b6409a.summary: getSearchSystemPrompt, getAgentSystemPrompt, and getProjectFileTreePrompt now accept costMode to scale token limits. Lite mode lowers file version budgets from 90,000 to 30,000, file tree truncation from 80,000 to 30,000, and agent context inclusion threshold from 40,000 to 10,000. Updates backend/src/main-prompt.ts and backend/src/system-prompt.ts. The FILE_TOKEN_BUDGET constant was moved into getFileVersionUpdates to enable per-mode evaluation.

502c8a171f713aaf91af8ed3ead28e0668af5971.title: Homepage UI, docs updates, model docs
502c8a171f713aaf91af8ed3ead28e0668af5971.summary: Homepage layout and copy refreshed. Docs updated: `--lite` now cites Deepseek V3 (1/10 cost). Case studies and tips restructured. Pricing copy tweaked. Marquee speed adjusted.

25bf18c95dc060332e914ac83a8cba130aa81966.title: Hide referral banner for unauthenticated users
25bf18c95dc060332e914ac83a8cba130aa81966.summary: Referral banner in `web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx` now checks `session?.user` via `useSession` and returns `null` if absent. Prevents unauthenticated users from seeing a banner that requires login to claim credits. Scope limited to web UI component. Condition updated to `if (!isVisible || !session?.user) return null`.

b1b052c78616d75d58f67dd82eb8d6b25c253ff0.title: Add tab completion for file paths and token names in CLI
b1b052c78616d75d58f67dd82eb8d6b25c253ff0.summary: Tab completion added to CLI readline interface using `completer` callback. Matches file paths from `fileContext.fileTree` and token names from `fileTokenScores`. Client now exposes `fileContext` publicly, updated during `initFileVersions` and file change actions. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

65cfd5a0fcd047942bd548117e6700b37a1f0581.title: DeepSeek Chat added as backend for Lite mode
65cfd5a0fcd047942bd548117e6700b37a1f0581.summary: DeepSeek Chat (`deepseek-chat`) now powers Lite mode requests via new `backend/src/deepseek-api.ts` streaming handler. This replaces Claude Haiku for `costMode === 'lite'` in `main-prompt.ts` and `request-files-prompt.ts`, using OpenAI-compatible API with Helicone proxying. Cost tracking in `message-cost-tracker.ts` adds DeepSeek token rates ($0.14/$0.28 per M input/output), while `common/src/constants.ts` exports `deepseekModels`.

6290ea41cfa2cd1c46381d5fe38cd3182e9405f2.title: Add webm fallback to intro video
6290ea41cfa2cd1c46381d5fe38cd3182e9405f2.summary: Home page intro video adds `/codebuff-intro1.webm` as `<source>` fallback alongside existing MP4. New `disableRemotePlayback` and `preload="auto"` attributes added to `<video>` element. Scope: `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/public/codebuff-intro1.webm`.

6a7f6623edd8adaa109fc0a08f77ad85b5d3f01d.title: New home page with concise title, video
6a7f6623edd8adaa109fc0a08f77ad85b5d3f01d.summary: Home page layout simplified to a concise headline and an inline autoplaying video, replacing the previous multi-section structure with a modal-triggered demo and terminal install snippet. The change is scoped to the web package, specifically `web/src/app/page.tsx` and `web/src/lib/constant.ts`. A new binary asset `web/public/codebuff-intro1.mp4` is added to support the inline video, while the site description in constants is updated to match the new headline.

0676fd902eaef8c6d6bcc3f00447aa92c784b079.title: Persistent PTY replaces childprocess for terminal commands
0676fd902eaef8c6d6bcc3f00447aa92c784b079.summary: Terminal command execution in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts switched from child_process.spawn to a persistent PTY using @cdktf/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch. This change unifies stdout and stderr into a single stream to better emulate real terminal behavior and preserve colors, requiring updates to handleRunTerminalCommand return types and CLI output handling in npm-app/src/cli.ts. A resetPtyShell function was added to restart the shell on timeouts or initialization, replacing the previous kill logic. Backend prompt handling in backend/src/main-prompt.ts was also updated to strip STOP_MARKER from printed chunks.

ea07c1a5ac11e6650f7b1b2dd17d46d7f730652a.text: A small internal change moves the navigation links to the right side of the screen. This layout adjustment helps keep the logo as the main focus.

7d63183f5701c34d55ed2671dbca5120c0b1259e.text: A small internal update occurred. Users will not notice any changes.

6290ea41cfa2cd1c46381d5fe38cd3182e9405f2.text: The homepage intro video now loads faster and works on more devices.

b1b052c78616d75d58f67dd82eb8d6b25c253ff0.text: The assistant now finishes file names and token names when you press Tab. This saves typing time.

0676fd902eaef8c6d6bcc3f00447aa92c784b079.text: The system now runs terminal commands in a way that better matches how real terminals work, combining outputs and keeping colors intact. This internal change makes command results look and behave more like what you would see on a standard computer screen.

502c8a171f713aaf91af8ed3ead28e0668af5971.text: The website looks cleaner and the help pages now explain a cheaper way to use the assistant. This is a small update that makes it easier to find information.

a42ced07e08c3226a8584e9f6972afd158b6409a.text: The system now limits how much information it reads in a low-cost mode, reducing processing overhead. This keeps the assistant efficient but may slightly shorten context for very large projects.

6a7f6623edd8adaa109fc0a08f77ad85b5d3f01d.text: The main page now shows a short title and a video playing automatically. This replaced the older layout that required clicking a button to see a demo or copy installation commands.

25bf18c95dc060332e914ac83a8cba130aa81966.text: The site no longer shows a referral banner to users who are not logged in. This prevents visitors from seeing an offer they cannot use without an account.

65cfd5a0fcd047942bd548117e6700b37a1f0581.text: The app now uses a different, cheaper AI model for its 'Lite' mode. This change aims to lower costs for the service without altering how you interact with the chat.

fb17d9888659f8054532d4a90a7b8bb5027043e9.text: The system now recognizes a new program for verified YC companies. This means these companies can earn $1,000 in credits after collecting $1,000.

18d5e003dee7ea5b7933c08cd58ab5f429b2c405.title: Add terminal command check instruction to main prompt
18d5e003dee7ea5b7933c08cd58ab5f429b2c405.summary: Added conditional instruction in `getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt` requiring agents to run specified terminal commands (e.g., type/test checks) after changes if defined in knowledge files. This ensures automated validation steps embedded in project knowledge are executed. Scope limited to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

b5f8015e91062d3fb747cbe6e0775c61dc981176.title: Relax assistant message pause limit 3 to 6
b5f8015e91062d3fb747cbe6e0775c61dc981176.summary: mainPrompt increases shouldPause threshold from 3 to 6 consecutive assistant messages in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt now accepts justUsedATool and numAssistantMessages, gating plan_complex_change suggestions on tool usage. conversation-progress.ts adds example phrase for unbounded iteration detection. Scope limited to backend conversation logic.

ca216648702c2cce0358fe9baca28e0122c38b21.title: Expand planning file selection prompt
ca216648702c2cce0358fe9baca28e0122c38b21.summary: Refined the user prompt in `getRelevantFilesForPlanning` within `backend/src/planning.ts`. The instruction now explicitly requests `knowledge.md`, example code, tests, and second-order files to improve context gathering. This change targets the internal planning subsystem to ensure more comprehensive file retrieval for complex requests.

4853758b7a91f6e226b73b7d571e3efa273581df.title: main-prompt.ts plancomplexchange threshold raised
4853758b7a91f6e226b73b7d571e3efa273581df.summary: System prompt instruction for pro cost mode changed from 'complex' to 'very complex' requests. Added explicit guidance to use plan_complex_change sparingly. This adjustment discourages unnecessary planning tool invocation while using o1-preview model.

3cdf87242f07ca2829e21b9d7ef6b6eafdea23cb.title: Swap tiktoken for gpt-tokenizer in backend
3cdf87242f07ca2829e21b9d7ef6b6eafdea23cb.summary: Replaces `tiktoken` with `gpt-tokenizer` 2.8.1 for token counting in `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts`. Imports `encode` from `gpt-tokenizer/esm/model/gpt-4o` instead of instantiating an `encoding_for_model` encoder, simplifying the count logic to a direct function call. Scope is limited to the backend dependency list and token utility. The fallback behavior remains `Math.ceil(text.length / 3)` on error.

d527e4775bb4d882fb072b1e7f2938a1cfb48029.title: Conditional minimal-edit instruction in agent mode
d527e4775bb4d882fb072b1e7f2938a1cfb48029.summary: System prompt logic in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now conditionally omits the 'minimal edits' and 'pause for instructions' directive when allowUnboundedIteration is true. This allows the agent to perform more extensive changes without stopping for user input during unbounded iterations. The change propagates the allowUnboundedIteration flag through getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt.

c03c11d7b0be9bb8a98ec3eb544c575fee88f3fa.title: Force unbounded iteration for plan execution
c03c11d7b0be9bb8a98ec3eb544c575fee88f3fa.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts now detects if the assistant is executing a plan by checking for 'plan_complex_change' in the response. If detected, allowUnboundedIterationPromise resolves true immediately, bypassing the checkToAllowUnboundedIteration call. The logic for handling generated plans was refactored to trigger a 'continue' tool call with a specific implementation prompt instead of manually setting state flags. System instruction tags in getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt were renamed from <important_instruction> to <system_instruction>.

f50573107e2ef2f3f222cb0c45ef8a0c05e2900f.title: o1 reverted to o1-preview
f50573107e2ef2f3f222cb0c45ef8a0c05e2900f.summary: o1 model constant reverted to o1-preview. OpenRouter lacks access to o1-2024-12-17. Planning module imports updated to openai-api. Common constants reflect change.

2be5ae7a6594f5cd817dba1ecf97199e599fe81a.title: Extract main prompt instructions into helper function
2be5ae7a6594f5cd817dba1ecf97199e599fe81a.summary: Refactors `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` by extracting inline user prompt instructions into `getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt`. Adds conditional logic to suggest knowledge file updates when knowledge files exist and it is not the first user message. Scope limited to backend prompt generation logic.

79d15dd36fb8d58a489777bc568e4330ec072627.title: Route o1 through OpenRouter
79d15dd36fb8d58a489777bc568e4330ec072627.summary: Switched `o1` model routing to OpenRouter backend, replacing direct API usage. Added `open-router.ts` to handle streaming completions via `openai/o1` prefix and `OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY` env var. Updated `planning.ts` imports and `constants.ts` to use `o1-2024-12-17`. Scope includes backend routing logic, environment validation, and shared model definitions.

18d5e003dee7ea5b7933c08cd58ab5f429b2c405.text: The assistant now automatically runs specific checks after making changes, if those checks were defined in the project's instructions. This helps ensure the work is done correctly without you needing to ask.

4853758b7a91f6e226b73b7d571e3efa273581df.text: The assistant now uses its detailed planning feature only for very hard tasks instead of moderately complex ones. This means it will skip unnecessary planning steps, making responses faster and cheaper without losing quality on difficult problems.

ca216648702c2cce0358fe9baca28e0122c38b21.text: The assistant now looks for more helpful background files before answering. This small internal update may improve the quality of complex responses.

b5f8015e91062d3fb747cbe6e0775c61dc981176.text: The assistant can now send more messages in a row before pausing to check in with you. This small internal update helps it handle complex tasks that require several steps without stopping as often.

3cdf87242f07ca2829e21b9d7ef6b6eafdea23cb.text: The system now uses a different tool to measure text length. This internal update improves how the assistant processes information, but you will not notice any changes.

2be5ae7a6594f5cd817dba1ecf97199e599fe81a.text: This small internal update helps the assistant remember to suggest saving new information if you have already started a conversation. You will see no immediate changes to how you use the product.

79d15dd36fb8d58a489777bc568e4330ec072627.text: The assistant now uses a different system to access its latest thinking model. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

f50573107e2ef2f3f222cb0c45ef8a0c05e2900f.text: The assistant uses an older version of its reasoning model because the newest version is not currently available. This means you will see slightly less advanced thinking in responses until the update can be applied.

c03c11d7b0be9bb8a98ec3eb544c575fee88f3fa.text: The assistant now handles complex tasks more smoothly by automatically continuing its work when needed, without waiting for extra confirmation steps.

d527e4775bb4d882fb072b1e7f2938a1cfb48029.text: When the assistant is set to keep working without stopping for your input, it now makes bigger changes instead of just small edits. This helps it finish complex tasks on its own.

beb0a7f320489f054fabc167238bb0bce726e643.title: Add Oliver case study content
beb0a7f320489f054fabc167238bb0bce726e643.summary: New MDX file `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx` added. Documents user 'Oliver' workflow with Codebuff for European grant platform. Internal repo content only.

43aa27fdfc1d3345b4131cb6d610d196672b0cdc.title: Add paragraph break in Oliver case study
43aa27fdfc1d3345b4131cb6d610d196672b0cdc.summary: Split paragraph in `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx`. Separates Codebuff comparison from prior tool limitations. Improves readability. No logic changes.

a605eb68cacd92404eb936c1f6d3f193ed458efe.title: Fix stagePatches to skip deleted files
a605eb68cacd92404eb936c1f6d3f193ed458efe.summary: stagePatches in common/src/util/git.ts now filters file paths using fs.existsSync before executing git add. This prevents errors when attempting to stage files that have been deleted from the working directory. The function returns false if no existing files remain to stage. Unused imports for os and diff were removed.

c19645815c47cbab0acc37544e20a74b0ce4193e.title: Fix git stage logic in CLI
c19645815c47cbab0acc37544e20a74b0ce4193e.summary: Added `changes.length > 0` check to git staging logic in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Prevents staging previous changes when no new changes exist. Refactored `staged` variable to `didStage` for clarity.

1ffa07da0d957e4a9059e5de94d1b71b4a59f0da.title: Exclude cta.mdx from Contentlayer build
1ffa07da0d957e4a9059e5de94d1b71b4a59f0da.summary: Added `contentDirExclude` to `web/contentlayer.config.ts` to ignore `case-studies/_cta.mdx` during build. Prevents Contentlayer from processing the partial file as a standalone document. Scope limited to web docs configuration.

8ba905bca1fbdde31bd7335204efc5a38ac44093.title: Restructure Oliver case study with subheaders
8ba905bca1fbdde31bd7335204efc5a38ac44093.summary: Added Markdown subheaders to `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx` for better readability. Condensed narrative to focus on initial tool failures and Codebuff's specific advantages. Removed redundant paragraphs about workflow flexibility and `knowledge.md` details.

de59cd8a129423f999301e25c50e987f241d8baa.title: Add codesearch tool using ripgrep
de59cd8a129423f999301e25c50e987f241d8baa.summary: Added code_search tool to system prompt and handlers, enabling pattern search in project files via ripgrep. New handleCodeSearch function in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts spawns rg process, truncates output to 10000 chars stdout/1000 chars stderr. Backend main-prompt.ts extracts pattern attribute from code_search calls. Requires @vscode/ripgrep 1.15.9 dependency added to npm-app/package.json and root package.json trustedDependencies.

b3d2a104156df34952fbf27576e79dda625769ca.title: Add isValidFilePath filter to planning file selection
b3d2a104156df34952fbf27576e79dda625769ca.summary: Added isValidFilePath to common/src/util/file.ts and applied it in backend/src/planning.ts getRelevantFilesForPlanning. Replaced simple non-empty line filter with validation rejecting whitespace and illegal filesystem characters. Planning prompt updated to explicitly instruct model to ignore previous user instructions. Scope limited to shared util and backend planning logic.

aefb207e1738a672e5eeffb2086838226be2f7a3.title: Calculate quota from Stripe metered tiers
aefb207e1738a672e5eeffb2086838226be2f7a3.summary: QuotaManager adds getStripeSubscriptionQuota to derive limits and overage rates from active Stripe subscription metered price tiers, replacing hardcoded CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS values. Stripe webhook handleSubscriptionChange and Web usage page now consume this dynamic quota via AuthenticatedQuotaManager, removing redundant direct Stripe API calls from route handlers. Scope covers common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts, web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts, and web/src/app/usage/page.tsx. Unhandled webhook events return 405 Method Not Allowed; processing errors return 500 with message instead of silent 405.

8151ce2028b89f39a1159fe0f49102ceb2c92046.title: Add o1 model support and complex change planning tool
8151ce2028b89f39a1159fe0f49102ceb2c92046.summary: Added `o1` model to cost tracker (input $15/M, output $60/M) and implemented `planComplexChange` in `backend/src/planning.ts` to generate detailed solutions using `o1` via streaming. Refactored `promptOpenAI` into `promptOpenAIStream` async generator in `backend/src/openai-api.ts`, removing manual timeout logic in favor of native streaming and updated token accounting. `main-prompt.ts` now integrates planning tools, while `conversation-progress.ts` requires explicit `costMode` for system prompt generation.

43aa27fdfc1d3345b4131cb6d610d196672b0cdc.text: A small text change adds a blank line to break up a long paragraph in the Oliver case study, making it easier to read.

beb0a7f320489f054fabc167238bb0bce726e643.text: Added a new example of how a user named Oliver used the tool to build a grant platform. This is just for internal records and does not change how the product works for you.

a605eb68cacd92404eb936c1f6d3f193ed458efe.text: The app now skips missing files when saving changes. This stops errors from happening.

c19645815c47cbab0acc37544e20a74b0ce4193e.text: A small internal update stops the tool from accidentally saving old edits when there are no new changes to save.

b3d2a104156df34952fbf27576e79dda625769ca.text: The system now checks file names to ignore invalid or empty entries during planning. This prevents errors from messy lists. The change is internal.

8ba905bca1fbdde31bd7335204efc5a38ac44093.text: The Oliver case study page now uses clear section headings to make it easier to read. The text was shortened to focus on the main points, removing extra details.

8151ce2028b89f39a1159fe0f49102ceb2c92046.text: The assistant can now use a new, more capable model to plan complex tasks. This improves how it handles detailed requests.

1ffa07da0d957e4a9059e5de94d1b71b4a59f0da.text: This internal update fixes a small background issue to ensure the website builds correctly. It does not change how the product looks or works for you.

de59cd8a129423f999301e25c50e987f241d8baa.text: The assistant can now search through project files for specific text patterns. This change is internal and does not alter the user interface.

dd3012203660f7eb2d79cabe28a9245c56f006a2.title: Pass newFiles directly to getRelevantFileInfoMessage
dd3012203660f7eb2d79cabe28a9245c56f006a2.summary: getFileVersionUpdates in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now passes newFiles directly to getRelevantFileInfoMessage, removing the intermediate readFilesPaths array. 1e3e7fd9a68962ae2944ee3187f9cf43e3638146.summary: Added engines.node >=14 to npm-app/package.json. Enforces minimum Node.js version for the CLI package. Scope limited to npm-app package metadata. npm will warn or fail on install if host Node version is below 14.

1681e199385ce89a1d33766a2354d82f471572e2.title: request-files-prompt.ts updates file reading heuristic
1681e199385ce89a1d33766a2354d82f471572e2.summary: backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts adds two negative constraints to the file-reading heuristic. Follow-up requests and non-specific greetings now suppress new file reads. Change applies to the promptOpenAI call for request-files-prompt.ts. No user-facing surfaces affected.

e6d16d0bfec019acef0ac4b8deeff1f3c44cf154.title: Windows command notes added to system prompt
e6d16d0bfec019acef0ac4b8deeff1f3c44cf154.summary: Windows-specific command notes injected into system prompt for `win32` platforms. Maps Unix commands to Windows equivalents (`mkdir`, `findstr`, `dir`, `move`, `del`, `copy`) and handles PowerShell distinction. Affects `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` only.

4b737984c62adeefece6a6e70d32d349ca94154e.title: Remove foundEndOfResponse flag from main-prompt stream handler
4b737984c62adeefece6a6e70d32d349ca94154e.summary:
Deleted `foundEndOfResponse` boolean and associated post-loop concatenation in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The stream handler previously tracked whether `
[END]` appeared in printed chunks, then appended it back to `fullResponse` after the loop. The flag and its conditional append were redundant since the token is already stripped from user-visible output and `fullResponse` accumulates raw chunks directly. No behavioral change to chunk rendering or tool-call detection.

70f42362b0771f5ca0130285f72a4b9270236ad6.title: Overage rate now plan-aware
70f42362b0771f5ca0130285f72a4b9270236ad6.summary: Overage billing uses plan-specific rates via new OVERAGE_RATE_PRO ($0.99) and OVERAGE_RATE_PRO_PLUS ($0.90) constants in common/src/constants.ts. Previously the usage page hardcoded $0.90 for all plans, undercharging Pro users. Scope: pricing page and usage page now import these constants; overage calculation drops Math.ceil in favor of exact per-credit rate.

92c08115233436487f5e0c757584e36e585e3b3e.title: Fetch overage rate from Stripe
92c08115233436487f5e0c757584e36e585e3b3e.summary: Overage rate calculation in the usage page now fetches real-time data from Stripe instead of guessing based on total quota. The `UsageData` schema adds an `overageRate` field, and `npm-app` CLI warnings remove hardcoded rates. This ensures users see accurate pricing derived from their active subscription's metered price tiers.

24d7ad7fc30c6dbf98d51d0c7835d78858be2d9e.title: Git stage command execution order
24d7ad7fc30c6dbf98d51d0c7835d78858be2d9e.summary: Moved `stagePatches` call to precede `applyChanges` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Ensures previous changes are staged before new file modifications are applied. Scope limited to CLI git staging logic. Prevents race condition where new changes might be inadvertently staged or previous changes missed.

a7294e394d936ec3782b9c4445ef9f63c66489df.title: Stripe webhook adds referral credit note to invoice
a7294e394d936ec3782b9c4445ef9f63c66489df.summary: web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts now calls stripeServer.invoices.update after adding the referral credit line item. Sets invoice description to 'Referral bonus: ${referralCredits} credits deducted'. Scope limited to Stripe webhook invoice creation handler.

4075972ed32841af532cdd8a572bd2b67e4cb005.title: Fix overage rate null handling in usage types and UI
4075972ed32841af532cdd8a572bd2b67e4cb005.summary: Updated `overageRate` in `usageDataSchema` to `z.number().nullable()` and adjusted local state in `UsagePage` to initialize as `null` instead of `OVERAGE_RATE_PRO`. The web usage page now conditionally renders overage fee details only when `overageRate` is present, preventing errors for users without a defined rate. This ensures correct type safety and UI behavior for accounts lacking an overage rate.

92c08115233436487f5e0c757584e36e585e3b3e.text: The system now checks your current subscription price directly to calculate extra usage fees. This ensures the amount you see matches your actual plan, rather than an estimate.

1681e199385ce89a1d33766a2354d82f471572e2.text: The assistant now skips opening files when you send follow-up questions or simple greetings. This small internal change stops unnecessary file reads, so it only helps the assistant work more efficiently.

4075972ed32841af532cdd8a572bd2b67e4cb005.text: The system now correctly handles accounts that do not have a set overage fee rate. Users without a defined rate no longer see errors or broken fee details on the usage page.

1e3e7fd9a68962ae2944ee3187f9cf43e3638146.text: The software now checks that your computer uses a recent enough system to run it. If your system is too old, the installation will warn you or stop.

70f42362b0771f5ca0130285f72a4b9270236ad6.text: Pro users were undercharged for extra usage. The system now applies the correct higher rate for Pro plans, while Pro Plus keeps its lower rate.

4b737984c62adeefece6a6e70d32d349ca94154e.text: A small internal change removed a redundant step that checked for the end of a response. This cleanup makes the system simpler but does not change how the product works or what you see.

dd3012203660f7eb2d79cabe28a9245c56f006a2.text: A small internal cleanup simplified how the system tracks new files. This change makes the code easier to maintain without altering how the product works for users.

a7294e394d936ec3782b9c4445ef9f63c66489df.text: When a referral bonus applies, the system now adds a line item to the invoice and updates the description to show the number of credits deducted. This makes the credit visible to the customer on their bill.

e6d16d0bfec019acef0ac4b8deeff1f3c44cf154.text: The assistant now recognizes Windows-specific commands and translates them into the correct format for your computer. This internal update ensures it provides accurate instructions when you ask for help with file management tasks on Windows.

24d7ad7fc30c6dbf98d51d0c7835d78858be2d9e.text: The tool now saves your previous edits before adding new ones. This prevents it from accidentally missing or mixing up changes.

4afd0074a494a5135098f5231c4ce1977847999c.title: Update benjamin-bryant case study
4afd0074a494a5135098f5231c4ce1977847999c.summary: Corrects phrasing in the benjamin-bryant.mdx case study, removing the 'if not' qualifier to state implementation time reduction to minutes directly. Change affects only the web content file.

56063ff50d80541ea0d50110670ac0f676b04c1f.title: CLI exits on Ctrl+Z via SIGTSTP handler
56063ff50d80541ea0d50110670ac0f676b04c1f.summary: Added `process.on('SIGTSTP', ...)` to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to trigger `handleExit()` when the user presses Ctrl+Z. This ensures the CLI terminates cleanly on suspend signals rather than backgrounding or freezing. Scope is limited to the CLI surface. The handler maps the POSIX stop signal directly to the existing exit logic.

99e74e93b4adf5f45b132df8c66fdbac2c8e2fd1.title: Fix case-study wording in benjamin-bryant.mdx
99e74e93b4adf5f45b132df8c66fdbac2c8e2fd1.summary: Corrects 'two minutes' to 'minutes' in Codebuff case study. Fixes logical contradiction in implementation time description. Affects web/src/content/case-studies/benjamin-bryant.mdx only.

03e91522f6de843ecbddeffd88285bfd390e003a.summary: Disables example and test/config file request promises in generateFileRequests for non-lite cost modes. 37fa4c785cf3fcbd46be0456614c951464d2edc7.title: Apply referral credits before invoice finalization
37fa4c785cf3fcbd46be0456614c951464d2edc7.summary: Referral credits now apply to Stripe usage meters during `invoice.created` events, not just `invoice.paid`. New `handleInvoiceCreated` function in `web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` injects negative credit values into `stripeServer.billing.meterEvents` to reduce billable amounts before finalization. Logic extracted from `handleSubscriptionChange` into `getTotalReferralCreditsForCustomer` for reuse. `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts` cleaned up with minor syntax fixes and removed commented debug code. `package.json` adds `start-studio` script.

ac5d79136aa688830f28c0c60793bbe95f9f0263.title: Update Dennis Beatty testimonial in web testimonials.ts
ac5d79136aa688830f28c0c60793bbe95f9f0263.summary: Replaced Dennis Beatty's testimonial quote and link in `web/src/lib/testimonials.ts`. The new text references @CodebuffAI usage and links to a newer tweet ID. This is a content-only change to the web marketing copy.

53a1670cfe1d31ed6b3a3acb51d3f35dc3646c66.title: Case study copy fixes
53a1670cfe1d31ed6b3a3acb51d3f35dc3646c66.summary: Updated `benjamin-bryant.mdx` case study text. Changed 'Amplifies' to 'Increases' in title and heading. Replaced inconsistent name usage ('Benjamin' vs 'Ben') with 'Ben' in body paragraphs. Fixed grammar in 'enables him take' sentence.

af2dd8415506131f5a49ae8ffade5e1329a0fb0f.summary: Rewrote the Benjamin Bryant case study in `web/src/content/case-studies/benjamin-bryant.mdx`. Updated title to "How Codebuff Amplifies Developer Productivity" and simplified tags to just "productivity". Polished narrative copy for clarity and flow.

99e74e93b4adf5f45b132df8c66fdbac2c8e2fd1.text: A small wording fix corrected a contradiction in a success story, changing 'two minutes' to 'minutes' to accurately reflect the implementation time. This does not affect how the product works.

53a1670cfe1d31ed6b3a3acb51d3f35dc3646c66.text: Small internal text updates. Case study wording and names corrected. No product changes.

ac5d79136aa688830f28c0c60793bbe95f9f0263.text: The website now shows an updated quote from Dennis Beatty, including a link to his latest post. This is a small internal change to the marketing text and does not affect how you use the product.
